sense_translations.zh_definition: 可上诉的；可以通过上诉程序请求复核的。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jidentifikaw liema deċiżjoni hija appellabbli u jispjegaw għaliex.
formal.en: In the exercise, students must identify which decision is appealable and explain why.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，学生须指出哪项决定可以上诉，并解释原因。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser deċiżjoni appellabbli? Mark: Tfisser li jista' jsir appell kontra dik id-deċiżjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does an appealable decision mean? Mark: It means that an appeal can be made against that decision.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“可上诉的决定”是什么意思？Mark：意思是可以针对那个决定提出上诉。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: “可上诉的决定”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does an appealable decision mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li jista' jsir appell kontra dik id-deċiżjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li jista' jsir appell kontra dik id-deċiżjoni.
messages.zh: 意思是可以针对那个决定提出上诉。
messages.en: It means that an appeal can be made against that decision.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象判决旁有一个“可以申请复核”的按钮，把这个形容词直接与“可上诉”配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or party who asks for a judgment or decision to be reviewed through an appeal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过上诉请求复核判决或决定的人或当事方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew parti li tressaq appell biex sentenza jew deċiżjoni terġa' tiġi eżaminata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上诉人；提出上诉、请求复核判决或决定的当事方。
提起上诉的；作为上诉一方的。

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tal-lezzjoni, l-appellant jippreżenta l-argumenti tiegħu u jitlob reviżjoni tad-deċiżjoni.
formal.en: In the lesson's example, the appellant presents his arguments and requests a review of the decision.
formal.zh: 在课堂示例中，上诉人陈述自己的论据，并请求复核该决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu l-appellant f'dan l-eżempju? Mark: Huwa min ressaq l-appell; hawnhekk hija l-kumpanija appellanti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the appellant in this example? Mark: It is whoever lodged the appeal; here it is the appellant company.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个例子中的上诉人是谁？Mark：就是提出上诉的一方；这里是那家提起上诉的公司。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个例子中的上诉人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the appellant in this example?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa min ressaq l-appell; hawnhekk hija l-kumpanija appellanti.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa min ressaq l-appell; hawnhekk hija l-kumpanija appellanti.
messages.zh: 就是提出上诉的一方；这里是那家提起上诉的公司。
messages.en: It is whoever lodged the appeal; here it is the appellant company.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把上诉材料递交出去的那一方记作上诉人；作形容词时，则给相关当事方贴上“提起上诉的”标签。

gloss_zh: 通称的；普通名词性质的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a name or noun that denotes a general class rather than a particular individual.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指名称或名词表示一般类别，而非某个特定个体的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jindika klassi ġenerali ta' persuni jew affarijiet, aktar milli individwu partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通称的；表示一般类别而非特定个体的。

collocations.en: an appellative noun; a common noun

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'belt' hija nom appellattiv għax tirreferi għal klassi ta' postijiet, mhux għal belt partikolari.
formal.en: The word 'city' is an appellative noun because it refers to a class of places, not to a particular city.
formal.zh: “城市”是普通名词，因为它指一类地方，而不是某座特定城市。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kelma 'belt' hija nom appellattiv? Pawlu: Iva, għax hija isem ġenerali. 'Valletta' hija isem proprju.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the word 'city' an appellative noun? Pawlu: Yes, because it is a general name. 'Valletta' is a proper name.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：“城市”这个词是普通名词吗？保罗：是的，因为它是通称。“瓦莱塔”是专名。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: “城市”这个词是普通名词吗？
messages.en: Is the word 'city' an appellative noun?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax hija isem ġenerali. 'Valletta' hija isem proprju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax hija isem ġenerali. 'Valletta' hija isem proprju.
messages.zh: 是的，因为它是通称。“瓦莱塔”是专名。
messages.en: Yes, because it is a general name. 'Valletta' is a proper name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“城市”和“瓦莱塔”并排记：前者泛指一类，便能联想到 appellattiv 的“通称的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put something into use, submit a request for a position, or be relevant to a particular case.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某事物付诸使用，提出职位申请，或适用于某种具体情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juża xi ħaġa fil-prattika, jagħmel talba għal pożizzjoni, jew ikun jgħodd għal każ partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 应用；实施；把方法、知识或规则付诸使用。
申请职位；提出求职申请。
适用于；对某人、某事或某种情况有效。

collocations.zh: 这条规则适用于所有人

formal.mt: Il-kandidat applika għal pożizzjoni ta' għalliem u spjega kif kien se japplika l-metodu l-ġdid fil-klassi.
formal.en: The candidate applied for a teaching position and explained how he would apply the new method in the classroom.
formal.zh: 这名应聘者申请了一个教师职位，并说明了自己将如何在课堂上应用新方法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tapplika għal dak l-impjieg? Mark: Iva, se nibgħat id-dokumenti llum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to apply for that job? Mark: Yes, I'll send the documents today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你打算申请那份工作吗？马克：是的，我今天就把材料发过去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算申请那份工作吗？
messages.en: Are you going to apply for that job?

messages.speaker: Mark (求职者)
messages.zh: 是的，我今天就把材料发过去。
messages.en: Yes, I'll send the documents today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个场景串记 applika：把方法用起来、向职位递申请、让规则适用于某人；结合宾语判断词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relevant to a particular situation and able to be used or applied in it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某种具体情况相关，并能够在该情况下使用或实施的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħodd għal sitwazzjoni partikolari u jista' jintuża jew jiġi applikat fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 适用的；能够用于某种情况或对象的。

formal.mt: Din il-proċedura hija applikabbli għall-applikazzjonijiet kollha li jaslu qabel l-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: This procedure is applicable to all applications received before the end of the month.
formal.zh: 这一程序适用于月底之前收到的所有申请。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan l-iskont huwa applikabbli għal dan il-ktieb ukoll? Toni: Iva, jgħodd għall-kotba kollha fuq din l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this discount applicable to this book too? Toni: Yes, it applies to all the books on this shelf.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个折扣也适用于这本书吗？托尼：是的，这个架子上的所有书都适用。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-iskont huwa applikabbli għal dan il-ktieb ukoll?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-iskont huwa applikabbli għal dan il-ktieb ukoll?
messages.zh: 这个折扣也适用于这本书吗？
messages.en: Is this discount applicable to this book too?

messages.speaker: Toni (书店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jgħodd għall-kotba kollha fuq din l-ixkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jgħodd għall-kotba kollha fuq din l-ixkaffa.
messages.zh: 是的，这个架子上的所有书都适用。
messages.en: Yes, it applies to all the books on this shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给规则贴上“此处可用”的标签：applikabbli 描写的是“适用的”这种性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or extent of being relevant and usable in a particular situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种方法、规则或观点能够用于具体情况的性质或程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew il-grad ta' kemm metodu, regola jew idea jistgħu jintużaw f'sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 适用性；某事物能够用于特定情况的性质或程度。

formal.mt: L-istudju jevalwa l-applikabilità ta' dan il-metodu fi skejjel b'riżorsi limitati.
formal.en: The study evaluates the applicability of this method in schools with limited resources.
formal.zh: 这项研究评估了该方法在资源有限的学校中的适用性。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-metodu jidher tajjeb, imma kif niċċekkjaw l-applikabilità tiegħu fil-klassi tagħna? David: Nippruvawh ma' grupp żgħir l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Nina: The method looks good, but how do we check its applicability in our classroom? David: Let's try it with a small group first.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个方法看起来不错，但我们怎么检验它在我们课堂上的适用性？戴维：我们先找一个小组试试。

messages.speaker: Nina (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-metodu jidher tajjeb, imma kif niċċekkjaw l-applikabilità tiegħu fil-klassi tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Il-metodu jidher tajjeb, imma kif niċċekkjaw l-applikabilità tiegħu fil-klassi tagħna?
messages.zh: 这个方法看起来不错，但我们怎么检验它在我们课堂上的适用性？
messages.en: The method looks good, but how do we check its applicability in our classroom?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.zh: 我们先找一个小组试试。
messages.en: Let's try it with a small group first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“适用吗”变成可讨论、可评估的“适用性”，就记住名词 applikabilità；可搭配方法或规则。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who formally requests a job, a place on a course, or another opportunity or service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式申请工作、课程名额或其他机会与服务的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel talba formali għal impjieg, post f'kors, jew opportunità jew servizz ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 申请人；提出正式申请的人，也可指职位应聘者。

formal.mt: Kull applikant għandu jissottometti l-formola mimlija u kopja taċ-ċertifikati meħtieġa.
formal.en: Each applicant must submit the completed form and a copy of the required certificates.
formal.zh: 每位申请人都必须提交填妥的表格及所需证书的副本。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jien applikant għall-kors tal-Malti. Fejn għandi mmur? Rita: Mur fil-kamra tnejn; hemmhekk qed jilqgħu lill-applikanti.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm an applicant for the Maltese course. Where should I go? Rita: Go to room two; they're receiving applicants there.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我是马耳他语课程的申请人。我该去哪里？丽塔：去二号房间，他们在那里接待申请人。

messages.speaker: Mark (课程申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien applikant għall-kors tal-Malti. Fejn għandi mmur?
messages.mt_standard: Jien applikant għall-kors tal-Malti. Fejn għandi mmur?
messages.zh: 我是马耳他语课程的申请人。我该去哪里？
messages.en: I'm an applicant for the Maltese course. Where should I go?

messages.speaker: Rita (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mur fil-kamra tnejn; hemmhekk qed jilqgħu lill-applikanti.
messages.mt_standard: Mur fil-kamra tnejn; hemmhekk qed jilqgħu lill-applikanti.
messages.zh: 去二号房间，他们在那里接待申请人。
messages.en: Go to room two; they're receiving applicants there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个拿着申请表排队的人，把人物标签 applikant 与“申请人”绑定，注意它指人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal request or application letter, or the practical use of something for a purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式提出的申请或申请信，也指为某种目的而进行的实际应用或使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Talba formali jew ittra li biha ssir talba, jew l-użu prattiku ta' xi ħaġa għal skop partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 申请；应用，具体含义由语境决定。
利用；使用；把某事物用于实际目的。
申请信；以书信形式提出申请的文件。

collocations.en: the practical application of the theory

formal.mt: Fl-applikazzjoni tiegħu għall-impjieg, il-kandidat iddeskriva l-esperjenza tiegħu fl-applikazzjoni prattika tal-metodu.
formal.en: In his job application letter, the candidate described his experience in the practical application of the method.
formal.zh: 这名应聘者在求职申请信中描述了自己实际应用该方法的经验。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Lestejt l-applikazzjoni għall-kors? Samwel: Kważi. Għandi nimla l-aħħar parti u nibgħatha.
colloquial.en: Elena: Have you finished the application for the course? Samwel: Almost. I need to fill in the last part and send it.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你完成课程申请了吗？萨姆韦尔：快了。我还得填好最后一部分，然后发出去。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你完成课程申请了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished the application for the course?

messages.speaker: Samwel (课程申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi. Għandi nimla l-aħħar parti u nibgħatha.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi. Għandi nimla l-aħħar parti u nibgħatha.
messages.zh: 快了。我还得填好最后一部分，然后发出去。
messages.en: Almost. I need to fill in the last part and send it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 applikazzjoni：递交申请信，以及把理论用于实践；看到搭配再判断是“申请”还是“应用”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To transfer a file from a device to an online service or another computer; the form can also mean that he uploaded it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把文件从设备传送到线上服务或另一台计算机；该形式也可表示“他上传了”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittrasferixxi fajl minn apparat għal servizz fuq l-internet jew kompjuter ieħor; il-forma tista' wkoll tfisser li hu għamel dan fil-passat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上传了；表示上传动作已经发生，此形式可指“他上传了”。
上传；把文件从设备传送到线上服务或另一台计算机。

collocations.en: upload a photo to the website
collocations.zh: 把一张照片上传到网站

formal.mt: L-istudent applowdja r-rapport fuq il-pjattaforma tal-kors qabel l-iskadenza.
formal.en: The student uploaded the report to the course platform before the deadline.
formal.zh: 这名学生在截止时间之前把报告上传到了课程平台。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Applowdja r-ritratt fuq is-sit, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Tajjeb, se nagħmel hekk issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Upload the photo to the website, please. Mark: Okay, I'll do that now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：请把照片上传到网站。马克：好的，我现在就上传。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Applowdja r-ritratt fuq is-sit, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Applowdja r-ritratt fuq is-sit, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请把照片上传到网站。
messages.en: Upload the photo to the website, please.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好的，我现在就上传。
messages.en: Okay, I'll do that now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象文件沿向上的箭头进入网站来记“上传”；再比较“他上传了”和“请上传”，留意 applowdja 的句子语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression indicating that an action is done deliberately or for a particular purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某个行为是有意而为，或是为了特定目的而做。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li azzjoni ssir b'intenzjoni jew għal skop partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 故意；特意；出于明确意图。
有意地；故意地。
有意地；存心地；故意地。
故意地；有意地；特意地。

formal.mt: L-għalliem ħalla żball fit-test apposta biex l-istudenti jsibuh u jikkoreġuh.
formal.en: The teacher deliberately left an error in the text so that the students would find and correct it.
formal.zh: 教师特意在文本中留了一个错误，让学生找出来并改正。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ġejt apposta biex tarani? Sara: Iva, ridt nara kif int.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you come specifically to see me? Sara: Yes, I wanted to see how you were.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你是特意来看我的吗？萨拉：是的，我想看看你怎么样。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是特意来看我的吗？
messages.en: Did you come specifically to see me?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我想看看你怎么样。
messages.en: Yes, I wanted to see how you were.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给行为画一个明确的目标箭头：apposta 表示带着意图去做，按语境可译成“故意”或“特意”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A leading disciple of Jesus who spread his teaching.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 耶稣的主要门徒之一，负责传播他的教导。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wieħed mid-dixxipli ewlenin ta' Ġesù li xandar it-tagħlim tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使徒，传播宗教信仰与教导的人。
使徒，特指耶稣的主要门徒。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi r-rwol tal-appostlu Pietru fit-tixrid tat-tagħlim ta' Ġesù.
formal.en: The text describes the role of the apostle Peter in spreading Jesus' teaching.
formal.zh: 这篇文章描述了使徒彼得在传播耶稣教导方面的作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu r-raġel f'din l-istampa? Mark: Hu l-appostlu Pietru, wieħed mid-dixxipli ta' Ġesù.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the man in this picture? Mark: He is the apostle Peter, one of Jesus' disciples.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这幅画里的男人是谁？马克：他是使徒彼得，是耶稣的门徒之一。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这幅画里的男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the man in this picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu l-appostlu Pietru, wieħed mid-dixxipli ta' Ġesù.
messages.mt_standard: Hu l-appostlu Pietru, wieħed mid-dixxipli ta' Ġesù.
messages.zh: 他是使徒彼得，是耶稣的门徒之一。
messages.en: He is the apostle Peter, one of Jesus' disciples.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 appostlu 和“使徒彼得”的人物画面一起记：看到人物，想到传播耶稣教导的门徒。

gloss_zh: 使徒的；与使徒教导有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the apostles or to their teaching and mission.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与使徒，或与使徒的教导和使命有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-appostli, mat-tagħlim tagħhom jew mal-missjoni tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使徒的；与使徒的教导或使命有关的。

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddiskuti t-tagħlim appostoliku u r-rabta tiegħu mal-ħajja tal-komunità.
formal.en: The study discusses apostolic teaching and its connection with the life of the community.
formal.zh: 这项研究讨论使徒教导及其与团体生活的联系。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi jfisser appostoliku hawn? Pawlu: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-appostli u mat-tagħlim tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does apostolic mean here? Pawlu: It means that it relates to the apostles and their teaching.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这里的 appostoliku 是什么意思？保罗：意思是与使徒及其教导有关。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 appostoliku 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does apostolic mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-appostli u mat-tagħlim tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-appostli u mat-tagħlim tagħhom.
messages.zh: 意思是与使徒及其教导有关。
messages.en: It means that it relates to the apostles and their teaching.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 appostoliku 放进“使徒教导”这一固定画面记忆；再配合 missjoni appostolika 观察形容词随名词变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give help or backing to a person, plan, or idea, or express approval of it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予某人、计划或想法帮助与支持，或明确表示赞同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti għajnuna jew sostenn lil persuna, pjan jew idea, jew jesprimi qbil magħhom.

sense_translations.en_definition: to support, to back, to endorse
sense_translations.zh_definition: 支持；声援；为某人、计划或观点提供支持，或表示赞同。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat appoġġja l-proposta biex il-librerija tibqa' miftuħa għal aktar sigħat.
formal.en: The committee supported the proposal to keep the library open for longer hours.
formal.zh: 委员会支持了延长图书馆开放时间的提议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu appoġġja l-idea tiegħek? Nina: Iva, u offra li jgħinni norganizza l-attività.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Pawlu support your idea? Nina: Yes, and he offered to help me organize the activity.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗支持你的想法了吗？妮娜：支持了，他还主动提出帮我组织活动。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗支持你的想法了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu support your idea?

messages.speaker: Nina (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u offra li jgħinni norganizza l-attività.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u offra li jgħinni norganizza l-attività.
messages.zh: 支持了，他还主动提出帮我组织活动。
messages.en: Yes, and he offered to help me organize the activity.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人为提议举手赞成，又主动伸手帮忙：把“赞同”和“支持行动”一起关联到 appoġġja。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To recognize the value of someone or something, or to feel grateful for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认识并肯定某人或某事的价值，或对得到的帮助等表示感激。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħraf il-valur ta' xi ħadd jew ta' xi ħaġa, jew tħoss gratitudni għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欣赏、认可某人或某事的价值；感激。
欣赏、重视；敬重某人。

formal.mt: Id-direttur apprezza l-isforz tat-tim u rringrazzja lil kull membru.
formal.en: The director appreciated the team's effort and thanked every member.
formal.zh: 主任肯定了团队的努力，并感谢了每一位成员。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Grazzi talli għentni lbieraħ; apprezzajt ħafna l-għajnuna tiegħek. Mark: Ta' xejn! Jekk ikollok bżonn, nerġa' ngħinek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Thanks for helping me yesterday; I really appreciated your help. Mark: You're welcome! If you need anything, I'll help you again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谢谢你昨天帮我，我真的很感激你的帮助。马克：不客气！你有需要的话，我还会帮你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi talli għentni lbieraħ; apprezzajt ħafna l-għajnuna tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi talli għentni lbieraħ; apprezzajt ħafna l-għajnuna tiegħek.
messages.zh: 谢谢你昨天帮我，我真的很感激你的帮助。
messages.en: Thanks for helping me yesterday; I really appreciated your help.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ta' xejn! Jekk ikollok bżonn, nerġa' ngħinek.
messages.mt_standard: Ta' xejn! Jekk ikollok bżonn, nerġa' ngħinek.
messages.zh: 不客气！你有需要的话，我还会帮你。
messages.en: You're welcome! If you need anything, I'll help you again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 apprezza 连到两个场景：看作品时“欣赏”，受帮助时“感激”，共同点是肯定其价值。

gloss_zh: 获益；利用机会得到好处

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gain a benefit or advantage from an opportunity or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某个机会或处境中获得好处或优势。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikseb benefiċċju jew vantaġġ minn opportunità jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获益；从某事或某个机会中得到好处。

formal.mt: L-istudent approfitta mill-opportunità li jistudja barra minn Malta.
formal.en: The student benefited from the opportunity to study outside Malta.
formal.zh: 这名学生利用到马耳他以外求学的机会获益。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex xtrajt il-biljett illum? Mark: Approfittajt mill-iskont u ffrankajt għaxar ewro.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you buy the ticket today? Mark: I took advantage of the discount and saved ten euros.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么今天买票？马克：我利用了折扣，省了十欧元。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么今天买票？
messages.en: Why did you buy the ticket today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Approfittajt mill-iskont u ffrankajt għaxar ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Approfittajt mill-iskont u ffrankajt għaxar ewro.
messages.zh: 我利用了折扣，省了十欧元。
messages.en: I took advantage of the discount and saved ten euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“遇到折扣，抓住机会，得到实惠”的连续画面，把 approfitta 与“从中获益”相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make knowledge, understanding, or an investigation deeper and more detailed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使知识、理解或调查更加深入、细致。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel l-għarfien, il-fehim jew l-investigazzjoni aktar fil-fond u fid-dettall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加深；使理解、知识或研究等更加深入。

collocations.en: deepened the study of the subject
collocations.zh: 深化了对该课题的研究

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur approfondixxa l-istudju tas-suġġett permezz ta' intervisti ma' għalliema.
formal.en: The researcher deepened the study of the subject through interviews with teachers.
formal.zh: 研究人员通过访谈教师，深化了对该课题的研究。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ktieb għenek tifhem aħjar is-suġġett? Mark: Iva, approfondixxa l-għarfien tiegħi u tani ħafna eżempji.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did this book help you understand the subject better? Mark: Yes, it deepened my knowledge and gave me many examples.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书帮助你更好地理解这个主题了吗？马克：是的，它深化了我的知识，还提供了很多例子。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb għenek tifhem aħjar is-suġġett?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb għenek tifhem aħjar is-suġġett?
messages.zh: 这本书帮助你更好地理解这个主题了吗？
messages.en: Did this book help you understand the subject better?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, approfondixxa l-għarfien tiegħi u tani ħafna eżempji.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, approfondixxa l-għarfien tiegħi u tani ħafna eżempji.
messages.zh: 是的，它深化了我的知识，还提供了很多例子。
messages.en: Yes, it deepened my knowledge and gave me many examples.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把学习想成向下挖井：从表面了解挖到深入理解，用这个画面记 approfondixxa 的“深化”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take something for one's own possession or use, especially without permission.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物据为己有或用于自身目的，尤指未经许可的占用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tieħu xi ħaġa għalik jew għall-użu tiegħek, speċjalment mingħajr permess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 占为己有；把某物据为己用，尤指未经许可。

collocations.en: appropriated someone else's property for himself
collocations.zh: 将别人的财产占为己有

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-uffiċjal approprja għalih fondi li kienu maħsuba għall-iskola.
formal.en: In the novel, the official appropriated for himself funds intended for the school.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，那名官员将原本拨给学校的资金据为己有。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex keċċew lill-maniġer fil-film? Mark: Għax approprja għalih flus il-kumpanija mingħajr permess.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did they fire the manager in the film? Mark: Because he appropriated the company's money for himself without permission.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影里，他们为什么解雇了那个经理？马克：因为他未经许可，把公司的钱据为己有。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影里，他们为什么解雇了那个经理？
messages.en: Why did they fire the manager in the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax approprja għalih flus il-kumpanija mingħajr permess.
messages.mt_standard: Għax approprja għalih flus il-kumpanija mingħajr permess.
messages.zh: 因为他未经许可，把公司的钱据为己有。
messages.en: Because he appropriated the company's money for himself without permission.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把公用钱袋拉到自己面前，说“归我了”，用这个动作记 approprja 的“占为己有”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of taking something for one's own possession or use, especially without permission.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物据为己有或用于自身目的的行为，尤指未经许可的占用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tieħu xi ħaġa għalik jew għall-użu tiegħek, speċjalment mingħajr permess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 占用；将某物据为己有或据为己用的行为。

collocations.en: the appropriation of someone else's property
collocations.zh: 将他人财产据为己有的行为

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddiskuti l-approprjazzjoni ta' riżorsi komuni għal skopijiet privati.
formal.en: The article discusses the appropriation of shared resources for private purposes.
formal.zh: 这篇文章讨论了为私人目的占用公共资源的行为。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tfisser approprjazzjoni f'din l-istorja? Mark: Tfisser li xi ħadd ħa għalih xi ħaġa li ma kinitx tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does appropriation mean in this story? Mark: It means that someone took something that was not theirs for themselves.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个故事里的“占为己有”是什么意思？马克：意思是有人把原本不属于自己的东西据为己有。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的“占为己有”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does appropriation mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li xi ħadd ħa għalih xi ħaġa li ma kinitx tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li xi ħadd ħa għalih xi ħaġa li ma kinitx tiegħu.
messages.zh: 意思是有人把原本不属于自己的东西据为己有。
messages.en: It means that someone took something that was not theirs for themselves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“拿走公用物品”的动作定格成一件事：approprjazzjoni 是“占用这一行为”的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express or estimate a quantity using a value close to its exact value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用接近精确值的数值表示或估算某个数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tesprimi jew tistma kwantità b'valur qrib il-valur eżatt tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 求近似值；以接近精确值的数值表示或估算。

collocations.zh: 求出了该数值的近似值

formal.mt: Għall-kalkolu, l-istudent approssima l-valur ta' 49.7 għal 50.
formal.en: For the calculation, the student approximated the value of 49.7 as 50.
formal.zh: 计算时，这名学生将49.7近似取为50。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ktibt 50 flok 49.7? Mark: Approssimajt il-valur biex nagħmel il-kalkolu aktar faċli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you write 50 instead of 49.7? Mark: I approximated the value to make the calculation easier.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把49.7写成50？马克：我取了近似值，让计算更容易。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么把49.7写成50？
messages.en: Why did you write 50 instead of 49.7?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Approssimajt il-valur biex nagħmel il-kalkolu aktar faċli.
messages.mt_standard: Approssimajt il-valur biex nagħmel il-kalkolu aktar faċli.
messages.zh: 我取了近似值，让计算更容易。
messages.en: I approximated the value to make the calculation easier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画出“49.7 → 50”，把变成方便计算的近似数这个动作与 approssima 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Close to the exact amount, value, or measurement, but not exact.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接近准确数量、数值或测量结果，但并非精确的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qrib l-ammont, il-valur jew il-kejl eżatt, iżda mhux eżatt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 近似的；大概的；接近精确值但不完全准确的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jagħti numru approssimattiv ta' parteċipanti, peress li l-għadd finali għadu mhux magħruf.
formal.en: The report gives an approximate number of participants, since the final count is not yet known.
formal.zh: 由于最终人数尚未确定，报告提供了大概的参与人数。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm se jdum il-vjaġġ? Mark: Il-ħin approssimattiv hu siegħa, imma jiddependi mit-traffiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long will the journey take? Mark: The approximate time is an hour, but it depends on traffic.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：路上要花多长时间？马克：大概一小时，不过要看交通情况。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.zh: 路上要花多长时间？
messages.en: How long will the journey take?

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħin approssimattiv hu siegħa, imma jiddependi mit-traffiku.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħin approssimattiv hu siegħa, imma jiddependi mit-traffiku.
messages.zh: 大概一小时，不过要看交通情况。
messages.en: The approximate time is an hour, but it depends on traffic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象时间旁边写着“约一小时”：approssimattiv 用来描述这种“大概、近似”的数值。

teaching_sense.en_definition: About a stated amount, number or time, without claiming exactness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示数量、数值或时间接近所说的数目，但并非精确数值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qrიბ l-ammont, in-numru jew il-ħin imsemmi, mingħajr ma jkun eżatt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大约；近似地；表示所给数值并不完全精确。

formal.mt: L-istħarriġ juri li approssimattivament mitt persuna jużaw dan is-servizz kuljum.
formal.en: The survey shows that approximately one hundred people use this service each day.
formal.zh: 调查显示，每天大约有一百人使用这项服务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm se ddum il-mixja? Mark: Approssimattivament għoxrin minuta, jekk nimxu bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long will the walk take? Mark: Approximately twenty minutes if we walk slowly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：步行要多久？马克：如果慢慢走，大约二十分钟。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 步行要多久？
messages.en: How long will the walk take?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Approssimattivament għoxrin minuta, jekk nimxu bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Approssimattivament għoxrin minuta, jekk nimxu bil-mod.
messages.zh: 如果慢慢走，大约二十分钟。
messages.en: Approximately twenty minutes if we walk slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和钟表旁的约等号一起记：说时间或数量时，它提醒你只是大约。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An estimate or representation that is close to an exact value or form, or the process of producing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接近精确数值或形式的估算、表示或结果，也指求取这种近似结果的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stima jew rappreżentazzjoni qrib valur jew forma eżatta, jew il-proċess biex tinkiseb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 近似；近似值；估算；也指进行近似处理的过程或接近原物的表示。

collocations.zh: 较好的近似值或近似表示

formal.mt: Iċ-ċifra fir-rapport hija approssimazzjoni tal-ispiża totali u tista' tinbidel.
formal.en: The figure in the report is an approximation of the total cost and may change.
formal.zh: 报告中的数字是总费用的估算值，可能会发生变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-prezz se jkun eżattament ħamsin ewro? Mark: Le, dik hija biss approssimazzjoni; għad irridu niċċekkjaw.
colloquial.en: Maja: Will the price be exactly fifty euros? Mark: No, that is only an approximation; we still need to check.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：价格会正好是五十欧元吗？马克：不会，那只是估算；我们还得核实。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-prezz se jkun eżattament ħamsin ewro?
messages.mt_standard: Il-prezz se jkun eżattament ħamsin ewro?
messages.zh: 价格会正好是五十欧元吗？
messages.en: Will the price be exactly fifty euros?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dik hija biss approssimazzjoni; għad irridu niċċekkjaw.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dik hija biss approssimazzjoni; għad irridu niċċekkjaw.
messages.zh: 不会，那只是估算；我们还得核实。
messages.en: No, that is only an approximation; we still need to check.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象账单上先用铅笔写下估算金额：这个名词指近似结果，也能指估算过程。

gloss_zh: 批准；认可；赞同；正式核准

teaching_sense.en_definition: To accept something as satisfactory, express support for it, or formally authorize or ratify it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为某事可以接受并表示认可或支持，也可指正式批准或核准。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaċċetta xi ħaġa bħala xierqa, jesprimi appoġġ għaliha jew jagħtiha kunsens uffiċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 批准；认可；表示某事符合要求或可以接受。
赞同；支持；对某项主张、决定或提议表示认可。
批准；正式核准，使某项协议或决定获得正式认可。

collocations.zh: 批准或正式核准了协议

formal.mt: Il-kumitat approva l-ftehim wara li eżamina l-kundizzjonijiet kollha.
formal.en: The committee approved the agreement after examining all the conditions.
formal.zh: 委员会审查了所有条件后批准了该协议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-maniġer approva l-pjan tagħna? Mark: Iva, approva l-pjan dalgħodu, u nistgħu nibdew għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the manager approve our plan? Mark: Yes, he approved the plan this morning, and we can start tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：经理批准我们的计划了吗？马克：批准了，他今天早上批准了计划，我们明天可以开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 经理批准我们的计划了吗？
messages.en: Did the manager approve our plan?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, approva l-pjan dalgħodu, u nistgħu nibdew għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, approva l-pjan dalgħodu, u nistgħu nibdew għada.
messages.zh: 批准了，他今天早上批准了计划，我们明天可以开始。
messages.en: Yes, he approved the plan this morning, and we can start tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词配上盖章动作来记：点头表示认可，盖章表示正式批准，都是它的常见用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Permission or formal acceptance, or a favorable opinion expressing agreement or support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 允许或正式接受某事的批准，也指表示赞同或支持的认可态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Permess jew kunsens uffiċjali, jew opinjoni favorevoli li turi qbil jew appoġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 批准；许可；认可或赞同，既可指正式同意，也可指支持的态度。

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol jista' jibda biss wara l-approvazzjoni bil-miktub tal-kumitat.
formal.en: The work may begin only after the committee's written approval.
formal.zh: 只有在获得委员会的书面批准后，工作才可以开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nistgħu nordnaw it-tagħmir illum? Mark: Għadna qed nistennew l-approvazzjoni tal-maniġer.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we order the equipment today? Mark: We are still waiting for the manager's approval.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们今天可以订购设备吗？马克：我们还在等经理批准。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我们今天可以订购设备吗？
messages.en: Can we order the equipment today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 我们还在等经理批准。
messages.en: We are still waiting for the manager's approval.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它想成文件上的批准章这个名词：可以等待批准，也可以得到某人的认可。

gloss_zh: 主动接洽；与人接触商谈

teaching_sense.en_definition: To initiate contact with someone in order to discuss a matter, seek help or propose cooperation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了商谈事情、寻求帮助或提出合作而主动与某人接触。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel kuntatt ma' xi ħadd biex jiddiskuti xi ħaġa, jitlob għajnuna jew jipproponi kooperazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主动接洽；向某人展开接触，以便商谈、提出请求或寻求合作。

collocations.zh: 与一家公司进行了接洽

formal.mt: Il-koordinatur approwċja lil kumpanija lokali biex jiddiskuti l-possibbiltà ta' kooperazzjoni.
formal.en: The coordinator approached a local company to discuss the possibility of cooperation.
formal.zh: 协调员主动接洽了一家本地公司，商讨合作的可能性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi ħadd diġà tkellem mal-klijent il-ġdid? Mark: Iva, Pawlu approwċja lill-klijent ilbieraħ biex joffrilu s-servizzi tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has anyone spoken to the new client yet? Mark: Yes, Pawlu approached the client yesterday to offer him our services.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：有人已经和那位新客户谈过了吗？马克：有，保罗昨天主动联系了客户，向他介绍我们的服务。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd diġà tkellem mal-klijent il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd diġà tkellem mal-klijent il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 有人已经和那位新客户谈过了吗？
messages.en: Has anyone spoken to the new client yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Pawlu approwċja lill-klijent ilbieraħ biex joffrilu s-servizzi tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Pawlu approwċja lill-klijent ilbieraħ biex joffrilu s-servizzi tagħna.
messages.zh: 有，保罗昨天主动联系了客户，向他介绍我们的服务。
messages.en: Yes, Pawlu approached the client yesterday to offer him our services.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己主动走向客户并开口谈合作：用这个场景记住它表示主动接洽的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To choose or assign someone to a position, office or responsibility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 选择或指派某人担任某个职位、职务或承担某项职责。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħżel jew jassenja lil xi ħadd għal kariga, pożizzjoni jew responsabbiltà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 任命；委任；指派某人担任某项职务或职责。

formal.mt: Il-bord appunta lil Marija bħala direttur tal-proġett għal sentejn.
formal.en: The board appointed Marija as project director for two years.
formal.zh: 董事会任命玛丽亚为项目主管，任期两年。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jmexxi t-tim issa? Mark: Il-maniġer appunta lil Pawlu bħala kap tat-tim.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will lead the team now? Mark: The manager appointed Pawlu as team leader.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：现在由谁带领团队？马克：经理任命保罗为组长了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 现在由谁带领团队？
messages.en: Who will lead the team now?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)

预约；会面；约会。

四月；指一年中的第四个月。
四月；一年中的第四个月。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To settle a dispute by hearing the opposing sides and giving a decision as an arbitrator.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为仲裁者听取争议双方的意见，并作出解决争议的裁决。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tisma' ż-żewġ naħat ta' tilwima u tagħti deċiżjoni biex issolviha bħala arbitru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仲裁；作为仲裁者对争议作出裁决。

formal.mt: Espert indipendenti arbitra t-tilwima bejn iż-żewġ kumpaniji wara li sema' liż-żewġ partijiet.
formal.en: An independent expert arbitrated the dispute between the two companies after hearing both parties.
formal.zh: 一位独立专家在听取双方意见后，对两家公司之间的争议进行了仲裁。

colloquial.en: Lara: Who arbitrated the dispute? Mark: An independent expert; he heard both sides and gave a decision.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)

gloss_zh: 植物名：Spergularia media（英语 greater sea-spurry）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant species Spergularia media, known in English as greater sea-spurry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Spergularia media 的植物，英语名称为 greater sea-spurry。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta bl-isem xjentifiku Spergularia media, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala greater sea-spurry.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 植物名，指 Spergularia media，英语称 greater sea-spurry。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jinkludi ritratt tal-arenarja u jagħti l-isem xjentifiku tagħha bħala Spergularia media.

formal.zh: 目录收录了 arenarja 的照片，并注明其学名为 Spergularia media。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jisimha din il-pjanta fir-ritratt? Lara: Arenarja. L-isem xjentifiku tagħha huwa Spergularia media.

colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的这株植物叫什么？拉拉：马耳他语叫 arenarja，英语叫 greater sea-spurry，学名是 Spergularia media。

gloss_zh: 植物名：Spergularia rubra（英语 red sandspurry）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reason or set of reasons supporting an opinion, or a disagreement in which people express opposing views.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支持某种观点的理由或论证，也可指双方表达相反意见的争论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġuni jew sensiela ta' raġunijiet li jsostnu opinjoni, jew tilwima bejn persuni b'opinjonijiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 论点、论据或论证；也可指争论、争执，具体依语境判断。

collocations.en: an argument in favour of the proposal

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta argument konvinċenti favur aktar spazji ħodor fil-belt.
formal.en: The report presents a convincing argument for more green spaces in the city.
formal.zh: 报告提出了有说服力的论证，支持在城市中增设绿地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kien hemm argument bejnek u bejn Luqa? Sara: Ma qbilniex dwar il-ħin, imma issa solvejna l-problema.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why was there an argument between you and Luqa? Sara: We disagreed about the time, but we've sorted out the problem now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你和卢卡为什么起了争执？萨拉：我们对时间安排有分歧，不过现在已经解决了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kien hemm argument bejnek u bejn Luqa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kien hemm argument bejnek u bejn Luqa?
messages.zh: 你和卢卡为什么起了争执？
messages.en: Why was there an argument between you and Luqa?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma qbilniex dwar il-ħin, imma issa solvejna l-problema.
messages.mt_standard: Ma qbilniex dwar il-ħin, imma issa solvejna l-problema.
messages.zh: 我们对时间安排有分歧，不过现在已经解决了。
messages.en: We disagreed about the time, but we've sorted out the problem now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 argument 配两张情境卡：一张是写着理由的论证纸，一张是两人意见不合的对话；看到上下文后，再判断是「论证」还是「争执」。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express disagreement or defend a view with reasons; also, to behave in an argumentative way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达不同意见、用理由维护某种观点，也可指表现得好争辩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimi nuqqas ta' qbil jew jiddefendi fehma permezz ta' raġunijiet; ukoll joqgħod jikkontradixxi u jfittex it-tilwim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 争论；争辩；提出理由维护自己的看法。

sense_translations.en_definition: to argue (to make a logical argument)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 论证；通过有逻辑的理由说明或支持某个观点。
好争辩；表现得爱反驳、爱与人争论。

collocations.en: argued in favour of the proposal

formal.mt: L-awtur argumenta li l-proposta għandha tiġi riveduta, u sostna l-fehma tiegħu b'eżempji ċari.
formal.en: The author argued that the proposal should be revised and supported his view with clear examples.
formal.zh: 作者论证了修改提案的必要性，并用清楚的例子支持自己的观点。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex toqgħod targumenta fuq kollox? Mark: Irrid nispjega għaliex ma naqbilx. Ejja nitkellmu bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you keep arguing about everything? Mark: I want to explain why I disagree. Let's talk calmly.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么什么事情都要争辩？马克：我想解释为什么我不同意。我们平静地谈谈吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么什么事情都要争辩？
messages.en: Why do you keep arguing about everything?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid nispjega għaliex ma naqbilx. Ejja nitkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid nispjega għaliex ma naqbilx. Ejja nitkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 我想解释为什么我不同意。我们平静地谈谈吧。
messages.en: I want to explain why I disagree. Let's talk calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个动作记 argumenta：与人争论、举理由论证、凡事都反驳。再把 argument 想成纸上的论点，把 argumenta 想成开口表达的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to argue or disagree; also describing writing that presents reasons for a position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人爱争辩、常反对别人的意见；也可形容通过理由支持立场的论证性文字。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb jargumenta jew jikkontradixxi; ukoll jiddeskrivi kitba li tippreżenta raġunijiet biex issostni pożizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好争辩的、爱反驳的；用于文章等时可指论证性的。

formal.mt: F'test argumentattiv, il-kittieb għandu jippreżenta pożizzjoni ċara u jsostniha b'raġunijiet.
formal.en: In an argumentative text, the writer should present a clear position and support it with reasons.
formal.zh: 在论证性文章中，作者应提出明确的立场，并用理由加以支持。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum tidher argumentattiv. Xi ġralek? Luqa: Għandi ftit stress. Se nipprova nitkellem b'aktar kalma.
colloquial.en: Maja: You seem argumentative today. What's happened? Luqa: I'm a bit stressed. I'll try to speak more calmly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天好像很爱争辩。怎么了？卢卡：我有点压力。我会尽量平静些说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天好像很爱争辩。怎么了？
messages.en: You seem argumentative today. What's happened?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ftit stress. Se nipprova nitkellem b'aktar kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ftit stress. Se nipprova nitkellem b'aktar kalma.
messages.zh: 我有点压力。我会尽量平静些说话。
messages.en: I'm a bit stressed. I'll try to speak more calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 argumentattiv 当作一张描述标签：贴在人身上可表示「好争辩的」，贴在文章上可表示「论证性的」。练习时先看它修饰什么。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of developing and presenting connected reasons to support or challenge a position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 组织并提出相互关联的理由，以支持或质疑某种立场的论证过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' żvilupp u preżentazzjoni ta' raġunijiet marbuta flimkien biex isostnu jew jikkontestaw pożizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 论证；组织、展开并提出理由以支持或反驳某个观点的过程。

formal.mt: L-esej jippreżenta argumentazzjoni loġika li torbot l-evidenza mal-konklużjoni.
formal.en: The essay presents logical argumentation that connects the evidence to the conclusion.
formal.zh: 这篇文章的论证合乎逻辑，将证据与结论联系起来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif nista' ntejjeb l-argumentazzjoni fl-esej tiegħi? Maja: Agħti raġuni għal kull punt u spjega kif l-eżempji jsostnuha.
colloquial.en: Sara: How can I improve the argumentation in my essay? Maja: Give a reason for each point and explain how the examples support it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：怎样才能改进我文章里的论证？玛雅：给每个论点提供理由，并解释例子如何支持这个理由。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nista' ntejjeb l-argumentazzjoni fl-esej tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nista' ntejjeb l-argumentazzjoni fl-esej tiegħi?
messages.zh: 怎样才能改进我文章里的论证？
messages.en: How can I improve the argumentation in my essay?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħti raġuni għal kull punt u spjega kif l-eżempji jsostnuha.
messages.mt_standard: Agħti raġuni għal kull punt u spjega kif l-eżempji jsostnuha.
messages.zh: 给每个论点提供理由，并解释例子如何支持这个理由。
messages.en: Give a reason for each point and explain how the examples support it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把「观点、理由、例子、结论」几张卡片用箭头连起来，这整套组织理由的过程就是 argumentazzjoni；用流程图帮助记住「论证」。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Aristotle, the ancient Greek philosopher.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 亚里士多德，古希腊哲学家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Filosfu Grieg tal-qedem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亚里士多德，古希腊哲学家的人名。

collocations.zh: 阅读关于亚里士多德的资料

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jagħti introduzzjoni għall-filosofija ta' Aristotile.
formal.en: This chapter provides an introduction to the philosophy of Aristotle.
formal.zh: 本章介绍亚里士多德的哲学。

colloquial.mt: Luqa: Dwar min qed taqra? Sara: Dwar Aristotile. Għada għandna diskussjoni fil-klassi tal-filosofija.
colloquial.en: Luqa: Who are you reading about? Sara: Aristotle. We have a discussion in philosophy class tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：你在读关于谁的资料？萨拉：亚里士多德。明天哲学课上我们要进行讨论。

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.zh: 你在读关于谁的资料？
messages.en: Who are you reading about?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar Aristotile. Għada għandna diskussjoni fil-klassi tal-filosofija.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar Aristotile. Għada għandna diskussjoni fil-klassi tal-filosofija.
messages.zh: 亚里士多德。明天哲学课上我们要进行讨论。
messages.en: Aristotle. We have a discussion in philosophy class tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语人物卡：Aristotile—Aristotle—亚里士多德，旁边写「古希腊哲学家」；再朗读 ta' Aristotile，练习表达「亚里士多德的」。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The mixture of gases around us that we breathe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 周围供人和其他生物呼吸的气体，即空气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-taħlita ta' gassijiet ta' madwarna li nieħdu n-nifs minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 空气

formal.mt: It-twieqi tal-klassi għandhom jinfetħu regolarment biex tidħol arja friska.
formal.en: The classroom windows should be opened regularly to let fresh air in.
formal.zh: 教室的窗户应定期开启，让新鲜空气流入。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Niftħu t-tieqa? Għandna bżonn ftit arja friska. Pawlu: Iva, niftaħha jien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we open the window? We need some fresh air. Pawlu: Yes, I'll open it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们把窗户打开好吗？我们需要一点新鲜空气。保罗：好，我来开。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Niftħu t-tieqa? Għandna bżonn ftit arja friska.
messages.mt_standard: Niftħu t-tieqa? Għandna bżonn ftit arja friska.
messages.zh: 我们把窗户打开好吗？我们需要一点新鲜空气。
messages.en: Shall we open the window? We need some fresh air.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 好，我来开。
messages.en: Yes, I'll open it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arja 放进“开窗换空气”的画面里，再连读 arja friska，记住“新鲜空气”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bow used to play a string instrument, or a curved line forming part of a circle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于演奏弦乐器的弓；也指构成圆周一部分的弧线。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex jindaqq strument tal-kordi, jew linja mgħawġa li tifforma parti minn ċirku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弓，例如演奏弦乐器时使用的琴弓。
弧；弧线。

formal.mt: L-istudent immarka żewġ punti fuq iċ-ċirku u pinġa ark bejniethom.
formal.en: The student marked two points on the circle and drew an arc between them.
formal.zh: 学生在圆上标出两个点，并在两点之间画了一段弧。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu l-ark tal-vjolin? David: Fil-kaxxa, ħdejn il-vjolin.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the violin bow? David: In the case, beside the violin.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：小提琴弓在哪里？戴维：在琴盒里，小提琴旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (小提琴学生)
messages.zh: 小提琴弓在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the violin bow?

messages.speaker: David (音乐教师)
messages.zh: 在琴盒里，小提琴旁边。
messages.en: In the case, beside the violin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作两张 ark 图卡：一张画小提琴弓，一张画圆弧；分别配上 tal-vjolin 和 ta' ċirku，靠搭配区分词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An ark, especially Noah's vessel in the biblical story or a sacred chest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 方舟，尤指圣经故事中的诺亚方舟；也可指盛放圣物的柜子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bastiment bħal dak ta' Noè fir-rakkont bibliku, jew kaxxa li fiha jinżammu oġġetti sagri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 方舟；盛放圣物的柜子，如圣约柜
非常；很

formal.mt: Fl-istampa tal-ktieb, l-arka ta' Noè tidher fuq l-ilma.
formal.en: In the book's illustration, Noah's ark is shown on the water.
formal.zh: 在书中的插图里，诺亚方舟浮在水面上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed tpinġi? Mark: L-arka ta' Noè, bl-annimali ħdejha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you drawing? Mark: Noah's ark, with the animals beside it.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你在画什么？马克：诺亚方舟，旁边还有动物。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你在画什么？
messages.en: What are you drawing?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 诺亚方舟，旁边还有动物。
messages.en: Noah's ark, with the animals beside it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一艘方舟、一只圣柜”两幅图记 arka 的名词义；“非常、很”另做义项卡，分开复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to archaeology and the study of past human life through material remains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与考古学有关的，即通过遗址、器物等实物遗存研究过去人类生活的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-arkeoloġija u mal-istudju tal-ħajja tal-bniedem fl-imgħoddi permezz ta' fdalijiet materjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 考古的；考古学的；与古代实物遗存研究有关的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi sit arkeoloġiku fejn instabu għodod u fdalijiet ta' bini antik.
formal.en: The report describes an archaeological site where tools and remains of ancient buildings were found.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一处考古遗址，那里发现了工具和古代建筑遗存。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid iżżur il-mużew arkeoloġiku għada? Luqa: Iva, nixtieq nara l-oġġetti antiki li hemm fih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to visit the archaeological museum tomorrow? Luqa: Yes, I'd like to see the ancient objects it contains.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：明天想去考古博物馆吗？卢卡：想，我想看看里面的古代器物。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 明天想去考古博物馆吗？
messages.en: Do you want to visit the archaeological museum tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq nara l-oġġetti antiki li hemm fih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq nara l-oġġetti antiki li hemm fih.
messages.zh: 想，我想看看里面的古代器物。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to see the ancient objects it contains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“考古遗址”和“考古博物馆”两幅画面中记忆；它用来描述与考古有关的事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose profession is designing buildings and preparing plans for them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以设计建筑和绘制建筑方案为职业的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tiddisinja l-bini u tħejji l-pjanti tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑师

formal.mt: L-arkitett ippreżenta l-pjanti tal-bini l-ġdid waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The architect presented the plans for the new building during the meeting.
formal.zh: 建筑师在会议上展示了新建筑的设计图。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jiddisinja d-dar il-ġdida tagħkom? David: Arkitett li rrakkomandalna ħabib.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is going to design your new house? David: An architect a friend recommended to us.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你们的新房子由谁来设计？戴维：一位朋友推荐给我们的建筑师。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jiddisinja d-dar il-ġdida tagħkom?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jiddisinja d-dar il-ġdida tagħkom?
messages.zh: 你们的新房子由谁来设计？
messages.en: Who is going to design your new house?

messages.speaker: David (房主)
messages.zh: 一位朋友推荐给我们的建筑师。
messages.en: An architect a friend recommended to us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位拿着建筑图纸的人，在图纸旁写上 arkitett，把“建筑师”和工作场景一起记。

gloss_zh: 档案；档案库；一组归档文件

teaching_sense.en_definition: A collection of records or papers kept for reference, or the place where they are stored.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为备查而保存的一组记录或文件，也指保存这些材料的档案库。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' dokumenti jew rekords miżmuma għal referenza, jew il-post fejn jinżammu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 档案；档案库；档案保存处
卷宗；归集在一起的一组纸质文件

formal.mt: Id-dokumenti oriġinali jinżammu fl-arkivju tal-iskola għal referenza fil-futur.
formal.en: The original documents are kept in the school's archive for future reference.
formal.zh: 原始文件保存在学校档案库中，以备日后查阅。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn nista' nsib l-ittra tas-sena l-oħra? Joseph: Fl-arkivju tal-uffiċċju. Ejja nfittxuha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where can I find last year's letter? Joseph: In the office archive. Let's look for it together.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：去年的那封信在哪里能找到？约瑟夫：在办公室的档案里。我们一起找吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nsib l-ittra tas-sena l-oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nsib l-ittra tas-sena l-oħra?
messages.zh: 去年的那封信在哪里能找到？
messages.en: Where can I find last year's letter?

messages.speaker: Joseph (办公室职员)
messages.zh: 在办公室的档案里。我们一起找吧。
messages.en: In the office archive. Let's look for it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给旧信件分类归档，再打开电脑里的数字档案库；两个收纳场景都贴上 arkivju。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that shows the time, such as a clock or a watch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 显示时间的器具，例如挂钟、座钟或手表。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li juri l-ħin, bħal wieħed imdendel mal-ħajt jew milbus mal-polz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钟；时钟
计时器具；钟表
手表；随身携带的表

formal.mt: L-arloġġ tal-ħajt fil-klassi juri li huma d-disgħa.
formal.en: The wall clock in the classroom shows that it is nine o'clock.
formal.zh: 教室里的挂钟显示现在是九点。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'ħin hu? L-arloġġ tiegħi waqaf. Ben: Is-sagħtejn. Għad għandna nofs siegħa.
colloquial.en: Anna: What time is it? My watch has stopped. Ben: Two o'clock. We still have half an hour.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：几点了？我的表停了。本：两点。我们还有半小时。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 几点了？我的表停了。
messages.en: What time is it? My watch has stopped.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 两点。我们还有半小时。
messages.en: Two o'clock. We still have half an hour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先指墙上的钟，再指手腕上的表，两次都说 arloġġ；用位置搭配区分具体是哪一种。

gloss_zh: 武器；伤害或控制他人的手段；纹章；快点！

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object used to attack or defend in combat; figuratively, a means of harming or controlling others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于战斗中攻击或防御的器具；也可比喻伤害或控制他人的手段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jintuża biex wieħed jattakka jew jiddefendi ruħu fil-ġlied; b'mod figurattiv, mezz biex jagħmel ħsara lil ħaddieħor jew jikkontrollah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 武器。

sense_translations.en_definition: weapon (instrument of attack or defense in combat)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 武器；战斗中用于攻击或防御的器具。

sense_translations.en_definition: weapon (means of harming or exerting control)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 比喻用于伤害他人或施加控制的手段。
纹章；代表家族、机构等身份的徽章图案。
催促加快速度的呼喊：快点！

collocations.zh: 把恐惧当作控制他人的手段

formal.mt: L-arma tal-familja tidher fuq il-bieb prinċipali tal-palazz.
formal.en: The family's coat of arms appears above the palace's main entrance.
formal.zh: 这座宫殿的正门上方有该家族的纹章。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik arma vera jew ġugarell? Luqa: Ġugarell; xtrajtu għall-kostum tal-karnival.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that a real weapon or a toy? Luqa: A toy; I bought it for my carnival costume.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是真武器还是玩具？卢卡：是玩具，我为狂欢节服装买的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是真武器还是玩具？
messages.en: Is that a real weapon or a toy?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 是玩具，我为狂欢节服装买的。
messages.en: A toy; I bought it for my carnival costume.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张学习卡区分：手中的武器、门上的纹章、催人加速的呼喊；比喻义则联想“把某种手段当武器”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Almost; very close to a state, amount, or completed action, without fully reaching it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 几乎；表示非常接近某种状态、数量或动作的完成，但尚未完全达到。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kważi; qrib ħafna li tintlaħaq kundizzjoni jew kwantità, jew li titlesta azzjoni, iżda mhux għalkollox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 几乎；差不多；尚差一点才完全达到。
几乎；差一点；用于修饰接近实现的动作或状态。

formal.mt: Fi tmiem il-laqgħa, armajn kulħadd kien qabel mal-proposta.
formal.en: By the end of the meeting, almost everyone had agreed with the proposal.
formal.zh: 到会议结束时，几乎所有人都同意了这项提案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lest biex nitilqu? Luqa: Armajn lest; għad irrid nilbes iż-żarbun.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you ready to leave? Luqa: Almost ready; I still need to put on my shoes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：准备好出发了吗？卢卡：差不多了，还要穿上鞋。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 准备好出发了吗？
messages.en: Are you ready to leave?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Armajn lest; għad irrid nilbes iż-żarbun.
messages.mt_standard: Armajn lest; għad irrid nilbes iż-żarbun.
messages.zh: 差不多了，还要穿上鞋。
messages.en: Almost ready; I still need to put on my shoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象进度条已经接近终点，却还留着一点空白：armajn 表示“几乎到了”，并不表示已经完全完成。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A man whose wife has died and who has not remarried.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 妻子去世后尚未再婚的男子，即鳏夫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel li martu mietet u li ma reġax iżżewweġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鳏夫；妻子去世后尚未再婚的男子

formal.mt: Ir-raġel huwa armel u jgħix ma' bintu.
formal.en: The man is a widower and lives with his daughter.
formal.zh: 这名男子已经丧偶，与女儿同住。

colloquial.mt: Marija: In-nannu tiegħek jgħix waħdu? Toni: Iva, huwa armel, imma mmur narah kuljum.
colloquial.en: Marija: Does your grandfather live alone? Toni: Yes, he is a widower, but I visit him every day.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你爷爷一个人住吗？托尼：是的，他已经丧偶，不过我每天都去看他。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爷爷一个人住吗？
messages.en: Does your grandfather live alone?

messages.speaker: Toni (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa armel, imma mmur narah kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa armel, imma mmur narah kuljum.
messages.zh: 是的，他已经丧偶，不过我每天都去看他。
messages.en: Yes, he is a widower, but I visit him every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用完整句 huwa armel 记“他已丧偶”，同时记牢这里说的是妻子去世的男子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a country in the South Caucasus, officially the Republic of Armenia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 南高加索地区的国家名称，正式名称为亚美尼亚共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' pajjiż fil-Kawkasu tan-Nofsinhar, bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika tal-Armenja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亚美尼亚

sense_translations.en_definition: Armenia (a country in the South Caucasus region of Asia, considered to belong politically to Europe; official name: Repubblika tal-Armenja)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 亚美尼亚：位于亚洲南高加索地区、在政治上被视为属于欧洲的国家；正式名称为亚美尼亚共和国

formal.mt: L-istudenta għażlet l-Armenja bħala s-suġġett tal-preżentazzjoni tagħha.
formal.en: The student chose Armenia as the subject of her presentation.
formal.zh: 这名女学生选择了亚美尼亚作为她的报告主题。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Fejn tixtieq tivvjaġġa s-sena d-dieħla? Adam: Nixtieq inżur l-Armenja.
colloquial.en: Elena: Where would you like to travel next year? Adam: I'd like to visit Armenia.
colloquial.zh: 埃琳娜：你明年想去哪里旅行？亚当：我想去亚美尼亚。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明年想去哪里旅行？
messages.en: Where would you like to travel next year?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想去亚美尼亚。
messages.en: I'd like to visit Armenia.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地图上的亚美尼亚旁写 Armenja，再读 lejn l-Armenja，连同“前往这个国家”的表达一起记。

gloss_zh: 亚美尼亚的；亚美尼亚人；亚美尼亚语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Armenia, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于、来自或涉及亚美尼亚及其人民或文化的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu tal-Armenja, ġej minnha, jew għandu x'jaqsam magħha, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: Armenian (of, from or relating to Armenia)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 亚美尼亚的；来自亚美尼亚的；与亚美尼亚有关的

sense_translations.en_definition: Armenian (native or inhabitant of Armenia) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 亚美尼亚人；亚美尼亚本地人或居民，通常指男性
亚美尼亚语

collocations.en: an Armenian man who lives in Malta
collocations.zh: 住在马耳他的亚美尼亚男子

formal.mt: Il-kittieb Armenjan ippreżenta l-ktieb tiegħu lill-istudenti.
formal.en: The Armenian writer presented his book to the students.
formal.zh: 这位亚美尼亚作家向学生们介绍了自己的书。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Liema lingwa qed titgħallem? Luqa: L-Armenjan. Ħabib tiegħi huwa Armenjan u jgħinni nipprattika.
colloquial.en: Marta: Which language are you learning? Luqa: Armenian. A friend of mine is Armenian and helps me practise.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你在学哪种语言？卢卡：亚美尼亚语。我的一位朋友是亚美尼亚人，他帮我练习。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 你在学哪种语言？
messages.en: Which language are you learning?

messages.speaker: Luqa (语言学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: L-Armenjan. Ħabib tiegħi huwa Armenjan u jgħinni nipprattika.
messages.mt_standard: L-Armenjan. Ħabib tiegħi huwa Armenjan u jgħinni nipprattika.
messages.zh: 亚美尼亚语。我的一位朋友是亚美尼亚人，他帮我练习。
messages.en: Armenian. A friend of mine is Armenian and helps me practise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Armenjan 做三张情境卡：作家旁记“亚美尼亚的”，人物旁记“亚美尼亚人”，课本旁记“亚美尼亚语”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman whose husband has died and who has not remarried.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 丈夫已经去世、尚未再婚的女性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara li żewġha miet u li ma reġgħetx iżżewġet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寡妇；丈夫已经去世的女性。

formal.mt: L-armla talbet informazzjoni dwar il-pensjoni li setgħet tirċievi.
formal.en: The widow requested information about the pension she could receive.
formal.zh: 这位丧偶女性询问了自己可以领取的抚恤金的相关信息。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dik is-sinjura hija armla? Pawlu: Iva, żewġha miet sentejn ilu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is that lady a widow? Pawlu: Yes, her husband died two years ago.
colloquial.zh: Marija：那位女士是寡妇吗？Pawlu：是的，她丈夫两年前去世了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 那位女士是寡妇吗？
messages.en: Is that lady a widow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，她丈夫两年前去世了。
messages.en: Yes, her husband died two years ago.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 armla 放进人物关系图中记忆：她的丈夫已经去世；这个词表示身份，不表示年龄。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pleasing agreement between people or things, or the musical combination of notes sounded together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人与人或事物之间协调融洽的状态；也指音乐中同时发声的音所构成的和声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qbil u bilanċ bejn nies jew affarijiet, jew il-kombinazzjoni mużikali ta' noti li jinstemgħu flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 和谐、协调；音乐中的和声。

formal.mt: Il-proġett għandu l-għan li jsaħħaħ l-armonija bejn il-komunitajiet.
formal.en: The project aims to strengthen harmony between the communities.
formal.zh: 该项目旨在促进各社区之间的和谐。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif tmorru int u sħabek fid-dar? Ben: Tajjeb ħafna; ngħixu fl-armonija u naqsmu x-xogħol tad-dar.
colloquial.en: Lara: How do you and your housemates get along? Ben: Very well; we live in harmony and share the housework.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你和室友相处得怎么样？Ben：很好，我们相处和睦，也一起分担家务。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif tmorru int u sħabek fid-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif tmorru int u sħabek fid-dar?
messages.zh: 你和室友相处得怎么样？
messages.en: How do you and your housemates get along?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna; ngħixu fl-armonija u naqsmu x-xogħol tad-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna; ngħixu fl-armonija u naqsmu x-xogħol tad-dar.
messages.zh: 很好，我们相处和睦，也一起分担家务。
messages.en: Very well; we live in harmony and share the housework.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几个人合唱、几种颜色搭配得恰到好处，用两个画面一起记住 armonija 的和声与和谐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small musical instrument held at the mouth and played by blowing and drawing air through its holes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放在嘴边，通过向音孔吹气和吸气来演奏的小型乐器，即口琴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mużikali żgħir li jindaqq billi tonfoħ u tiġbed l-arja mit-toqob tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 口琴；通过吹气和吸气发声的小型吹奏乐器。

formal.mt: Matul il-kunċert, il-mużiċista daqq melodija tradizzjonali fuq l-armonika.
formal.en: During the concert, the musician played a traditional melody on the harmonica.
formal.zh: 音乐会上，这位音乐家用口琴演奏了一首传统曲调。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għandek fil-but? Sam: Armonika żgħira. Trid tismagħni ndoqq?
colloquial.en: Nina: What have you got in your pocket? Sam: A small harmonica. Would you like to hear me play?
colloquial.zh: Nina：你口袋里装着什么？Sam：一把小口琴。想听我吹吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你口袋里装着什么？
messages.en: What have you got in your pocket?

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.zh: 一把小口琴。想听我吹吗？
messages.en: A small harmonica. Would you like to hear me play?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 armonika 和口袋里的小乐器联系起来：拿到嘴边，吹气吸气，记住它是口琴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing a balanced, pleasing combination, or relating to musical harmony or harmonic relationships.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现出协调、均衡之美的；也指与音乐和声或谐波关系有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri qbil u bilanċ bejn il-partijiet, jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-armonija mużikali jew mal-armoniċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现出和谐的；各部分协调、均衡的。
和声的；谐波的；与谐波关系有关的。

formal.mt: Id-disinn il-ġdid joħloq bilanċ armoniku bejn il-bini u l-ġnien.
formal.en: The new design creates a harmonious balance between the building and the garden.
formal.zh: 新设计使建筑与花园形成了和谐的平衡。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif jidher dan id-disinn? Leo: Jidher armoniku; il-kuluri jaqblu tajjeb flimkien.
colloquial.en: Marta: How does this design look? Leo: It looks harmonious; the colours go well together.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这个设计看起来怎么样？Leo：很协调，颜色搭配得很好。

messages.speaker: Marta (设计师)
messages.zh: 这个设计看起来怎么样？
messages.en: How does this design look?

messages.speaker: Leo (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jidher armoniku; il-kuluri jaqblu tajjeb flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Jidher armoniku; il-kuluri jaqblu tajjeb flimkien.
messages.zh: 很协调，颜色搭配得很好。
messages.en: It looks harmonious; the colours go well together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个语境记 armoniku：设计里是协调和谐，音乐或物理里则要想到和声或谐波。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make different elements agree or work together, or to add suitable harmony to a melody.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使不同要素协调一致、共同发挥作用；也指为旋律配上合适的和声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel elementi differenti jaqblu jew jaħdmu tajjeb flimkien, jew iżid armonija xierqa ma' melodija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使协调、使一致；为旋律配和声。

collocations.zh: 协调各项规则，使其一致

formal.mt: Il-kompożitur armonizza l-melodija għal kor b'erba' vuċijiet.
formal.en: The composer harmonized the melody for a four-part choir.
formal.zh: 作曲家为这段旋律配上了适合四声部合唱团的和声。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-melodija lesta, imma jonqosha xi ħaġa. Mark: Armonizza l-melodija b'akkordi sempliċi u mbagħad nerġgħu nisimgħuha.
colloquial.en: Anna: The melody is ready, but something is missing. Mark: Harmonize the melody with simple chords, and then we'll listen to it again.
colloquial.zh: Anna：旋律写好了，但总觉得缺点什么。Mark：用简单的和弦给旋律配上和声，然后我们再听一遍。

messages.speaker: Anna (音乐学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-melodija lesta, imma jonqosha xi ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-melodija lesta, imma jonqosha xi ħaġa.
messages.zh: 旋律写好了，但总觉得缺点什么。
messages.en: The melody is ready, but something is missing.

messages.speaker: Mark (音乐教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Armonizza l-melodija b'akkordi sempliċi u mbagħad nerġgħu nisimgħuha.
messages.mt_standard: Armonizza l-melodija b'akkordi sempliċi u mbagħad nerġgħu nisimgħuha.
messages.zh: 用简单的和弦给旋律配上和声，然后我们再听一遍。
messages.en: Harmonize the melody with simple chords, and then we'll listen to it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 armonizza 配一个动作画面：把不同声音或规则调整到彼此协调，突出它表示使之和谐的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or result of making different elements consistent, or of providing harmony for a melody.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使不同要素协调一致的过程或结果；也指为旋律配置和声的过程或成果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew ir-riżultat ta' tqabbil bejn elementi differenti biex jaqblu, jew taż-żieda ta' armonija ma' melodija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 协调、统一；和声编配。

formal.mt: L-armonizzazzjoni tal-proċeduri għandha tnaqqas id-differenzi bejn id-dipartimenti.
formal.en: The harmonization of procedures should reduce differences between departments.
formal.zh: 程序的协调统一应能减少各部门之间的差异。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed inqabblu r-regoli taż-żewġ gruppi? David: Qed naħdmu fuq l-armonizzazzjoni tagħhom, biex kulħadd isegwi l-istess regoli.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are we comparing the two groups' rules? David: We're working on their harmonization so that everyone follows the same rules.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们为什么要比较这两个小组的规则？David：我们正在协调统一这些规则，好让大家都遵循同一套规则。

messages.speaker: Sara (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed inqabblu r-regoli taż-żewġ gruppi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed inqabblu r-regoli taż-żewġ gruppi?
messages.zh: 我们为什么要比较这两个小组的规则？
messages.en: Why are we comparing the two groups' rules?

messages.speaker: David (小组负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naħdmu fuq l-armonizzazzjoni tagħhom, biex kulħadd isegwi l-istess regoli.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naħdmu fuq l-armonizzazzjoni tagħhom, biex kulħadd isegwi l-istess regoli.
messages.zh: 我们正在协调统一这些规则，好让大家都遵循同一套规则。
messages.en: We're working on their harmonization so that everyone follows the same rules.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 armonizzazzjoni 当作一项工作来记：协调规则、编配和声，关注整个过程或完成后的成果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A musical instrument with a frame and strings that are plucked; also a name for the fish-eating bird Pandion haliaetus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有琴架、通过拨动琴弦演奏的乐器，即竖琴；也指以鱼为食的鸟类鹗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mużikali b'qafas u kordi li jindaqqu bis-swaba'; ukoll għasfur li jiekol il-ħut, Pandion haliaetus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 竖琴；通过拨动琴弦演奏的弦乐器。
鹗（Pandion haliaetus）；以鱼为主要食物的猛禽。

formal.mt: Fl-orkestra, l-arpa żiedet ħoss delikat mal-melodija ewlenija.
formal.en: In the orchestra, the harp added a delicate sound to the main melody.
formal.zh: 在管弦乐队的演奏中，竖琴为主旋律增添了细腻的音色。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Dak l-istrument kbir bil-kordi x'inhu? Toni: Dik arpa. Il-mużiċista ddoqqha bis-swaba'.
colloquial.en: Elena: What is that large instrument with strings? Toni: That's a harp. The musician plays it with her fingers.
colloquial.zh: Elena：那个带琴弦的大乐器是什么？Toni：那是竖琴。演奏者用手指弹奏它。

messages.speaker: Elena (观众)
messages.zh: 那个带琴弦的大乐器是什么？
messages.en: What is that large instrument with strings?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是竖琴。演奏者用手指弹奏它。
messages.en: That's a harp. The musician plays it with her fingers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 arpa 准备两张记忆卡：音乐厅里拨弦的竖琴，水面上捕鱼的鹗；靠语境选择对应词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To play music on a harp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用竖琴演奏音乐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idoqq mużika fuq l-arpa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弹竖琴；用竖琴演奏。

collocations.en: play the harp during the concert

formal.mt: Il-mużiċista arpeġġja waqt iċ-ċerimonja u ħoloq atmosfera kalma.
formal.en: The musician played the harp during the ceremony and created a calm atmosphere.
formal.zh: 这位音乐家在仪式上弹奏竖琴，营造了平静的氛围。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Tista' tarpeġġja ftit għalina? Paul: Iva, indoqq melodija qasira fuq l-arpa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can you play the harp for us for a little while? Paul: Yes, I'll play a short melody on the harp.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你能为我们弹一会儿竖琴吗？Paul：可以，我用竖琴弹一小段旋律。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能为我们弹一会儿竖琴吗？
messages.en: Can you play the harp for us for a little while?

messages.speaker: Paul (竖琴演奏者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, indoqq melodija qasira fuq l-arpa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, indoqq melodija qasira fuq l-arpa.
messages.zh: 可以，我用竖琴弹一小段旋律。
messages.en: Yes, I'll play a short melody on the harp.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 arpeġġja 时想象演奏者双手拨动竖琴琴弦，把整个弹竖琴的动作与这个词联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make an error, to feel regret, or to drop anchor, according to the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依上下文可表示犯错、感到后悔，或船只抛锚；学习时应分别辨认这些用法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skont il-kuntest, jiżbalja, jiddispjaċih, jew jitfa' l-ankra.

sense_translations.en_definition: to err, to regret or to drop anchor
sense_translations.zh_definition: 犯错；后悔；抛锚。具体含义须依据上下文判断。
驾！用于催促马、驴等向前走的呼喊。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, 'arra' fis-sens ta' 'żbalja' għandu jiġi distint minn 'arra' fis-sens ta' 'tefa' l-ankra'.
formal.en: In the exercise, 'arra' meaning 'erred' should be distinguished from 'arra' meaning 'dropped anchor'.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，应区分表示“犯了错”的 arra 和表示“抛了锚”的 arra。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'Arra!' meta xi ħadd jgħidha lil żiemel? Pawlu: Qed iħeġġu jimxi; bl-Ingliż tgħid 'Giddyup!'
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'Arra!' mean when someone says it to a horse? Pawlu: They are urging it to move; in English you say 'Giddyup!'
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：有人对马喊“Arra!”是什么意思？保罗：是在催它走；英语里说“Giddyup!”，中文可以说“驾！”。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'Arra!' meta xi ħadd jgħidha lil żiemel?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'Arra!' meta xi ħadd jgħidha lil żiemel?
messages.zh: 有人对马喊“Arra!”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Arra!' mean when someone says it to a horse?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 是在催它走；英语里说“Giddyup!”，中文可以说“驾！”。
messages.en: They are urging it to move; in English you say 'Giddyup!'

cognitive_memory_aid: 分别画出判断出错、心中后悔、船只抛锚三幅图；再给催马的“驾！”单独做卡片，用场景区分同形词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of taking someone into official custody, usually by the police.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常由警方将某人置于正式羁押之下的行为，即逮捕或拘留。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li persuna tittieħed taħt il-kustodja tal-awtoritajiet, normalment mill-pulizija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逮捕，指由警方等执法机关依法控制某人的人身自由。
逮捕；拘留，指被执法机关控制并处于羁押状态。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-pulizija jiddeskrivi ċ-ċirkostanzi tal-arrest.
formal.en: The police report describes the circumstances of the arrest.
formal.zh: 警方报告描述了此次逮捕的具体情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kien hemm il-pulizija fit-triq? Mark: Kien hemm arrest, imma ma nafx id-dettalji.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why were the police in the street? Mark: There was an arrest, but I don't know the details.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：街上为什么有警察？马克：有人被捕了，不过我不知道具体情况。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 街上为什么有警察？
messages.en: Why were the police in the street?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm arrest, imma ma nafx id-dettalji.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm arrest, imma ma nafx id-dettalji.
messages.zh: 有人被捕了，不过我不知道具体情况。
messages.en: There was an arrest, but I don't know the details.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arrest 放进“逮捕令”和“被拘押”两个场景记忆：它是表示逮捕行为或拘押状态的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take someone into official custody, usually as a police action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某人置于正式羁押之下，通常指警方实施逮捕或拘留。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu persuna taħt il-kustodja tal-awtoritajiet, normalment bħala azzjoni tal-pulizija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逮捕，指执法人员将某人控制并带入羁押。
逮捕；拘留，指由执法机关限制某人的人身自由并予以看管。

formal.mt: L-uffiċjal tal-pulizija arresta lis-suspettat wara l-investigazzjoni.
formal.en: The police officer arrested the suspect after the investigation.
formal.zh: 调查结束后，警员逮捕了嫌疑人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ġara ħdejn il-ħanut? Pawlu: Pulizija arresta raġel, imma ma nafx għaliex.
colloquial.en: Nina: What happened near the shop? Pawlu: A police officer arrested a man, but I don't know why.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：商店附近发生什么事了？保罗：一名警员逮捕了一个男人，不过我不知道原因。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 商店附近发生什么事了？
messages.en: What happened near the shop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Pulizija arresta raġel, imma ma nafx għaliex.
messages.mt_standard: Pulizija arresta raġel, imma ma nafx għaliex.
messages.zh: 一名警员逮捕了一个男人，不过我不知道原因。
messages.en: A police officer arrested a man, but I don't know why.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“警员逮捕了谁”记 arresta：它表示动作；例句中的 arresta 可对应“他逮捕了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone or something richer in money, knowledge, experience, or quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或事物在财富、知识、经验或内涵等方面更加丰富。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa aktar għanja fil-ġid, fl-għarfien, fl-esperjenza jew fil-kwalità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使富裕；使丰富；充实，可指增加财富，也可指丰富知识、经验或内容。

formal.mt: Il-proġett arrikkixxa l-esperjenza edukattiva tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The project enriched the students' educational experience.
formal.zh: 这个项目丰富了学生的学习体验。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għoġbok il-kors tal-Malti? David: Iva, arrikkixxa l-vokabularju tiegħi u tgħallimt ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you like the Maltese course? David: Yes, it enriched my vocabulary, and I learned a lot.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你喜欢这门马耳他语课程吗？戴维：喜欢，它丰富了我的词汇量，我也学到了很多。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这门马耳他语课程吗？
messages.en: Did you like the Maltese course?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, arrikkixxa l-vokabularju tiegħi u tgħallimt ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, arrikkixxa l-vokabularju tiegħi u tgħallimt ħafna.
messages.zh: 喜欢，它丰富了我的词汇量，我也学到了很多。
messages.en: Yes, it enriched my vocabulary, and I learned a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本书让你的“词汇宝箱”更充实，用这个画面记 arrikkixxa 表示“使丰富、使充实”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element arsenic, represented by the symbol As.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素砷，元素符号为 As。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku arseniku, li għandu s-simbolu As.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 砷，一种化学元素，元素符号为 As。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-laboratorju jindika l-konċentrazzjoni tal-arseniku fil-kampjun.
formal.en: The laboratory report indicates the concentration of arsenic in the sample.
formal.zh: 实验室报告列明了样本中的砷浓度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu s-simbolu tal-arseniku? Mark: As. Niktbu A kbira u s żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the symbol for arsenic? Mark: As. We write a capital A and a lowercase s.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：砷的元素符号是什么？马克：As。写一个大写 A 和一个小写 s。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 砷的元素符号是什么？
messages.en: What is the symbol for arsenic?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: As. Niktbu A kbira u s żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: As. Niktbu A kbira u s żgħira.
messages.zh: As。写一个大写 A 和一个小写 s。
messages.en: As. We write a capital A and a lowercase s.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arseniku、中文“砷”和元素符号 As 写在同一张卡片上，通过三项配对巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 柔软的；松弛的；过分纵容的；清音的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Soft to the touch or easy to press, bend, or compress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 触感柔软，或容易按压、弯曲、压缩的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinħass ħafif u ċedevoli meta tmissu, jew li jingħafas jew jitgħawweġ faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柔软的；软的，指触感或质地不坚硬。
松弛的；不绷紧的。

sense_translations.en_definition: excessively indulgent (said, e.g., of a parent in relation to a child)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 过分纵容的；溺爱的，例如形容父母对孩子过于宽纵。
软的；不硬的，强调物体容易受压或发生形变。
清音的；发音时声带不振动的。

collocations.en: a father who is too indulgent with his children
collocations.zh: 对孩子过于纵容的父亲

formal.mt: Għal dan il-prodott ntgħażel drapp artab li jkun komdu mal-ġilda.
formal.en: A soft fabric that feels comfortable against the skin was chosen for this product.
formal.zh: 这款产品选用了贴肤舒适的柔软布料。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-ħobż artab? Pawlu: Iva, artab ħafna. Għadu frisk.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this bread soft? Pawlu: Yes, very soft. It's still fresh.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个面包软吗？保罗：软，很松软。还很新鲜。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个面包软吗？
messages.en: Is this bread soft?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (面包店店员)
messages.zh: 软，很松软。还很新鲜。
messages.en: Yes, very soft. It's still fresh.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“软面包”记 artab 的基本义，再分别记“绳子松、人太宽纵、语音为清音”，依语境选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A table or raised structure used for religious offerings or ceremonies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于宗教献祭或仪式的台桌或高台，即祭坛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mejda jew struttura għolja li tintuża għall-offerti jew għaċ-ċerimonji reliġjużi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 祭坛，宗教场所中用于献祭或举行仪式的台桌或高台。

formal.mt: L-artal tal-knisja huwa magħmul mill-irħam u jinsab fiċ-ċentru tal-presbiterju.
formal.en: The church altar is made of marble and stands in the center of the sanctuary.
formal.zh: 教堂的祭坛由大理石制成，位于圣所中央。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se npoġġu l-fjuri? David: Quddiem l-artal, ħdejn dawk l-oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall we put the flowers? David: In front of the altar, next to the others.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们把花放在哪里？戴维：祭坛前，放在其他那些花旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (教堂志愿者)
messages.zh: 我们把花放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we put the flowers?

messages.speaker: David (教堂志愿者)
messages.zh: 祭坛前，放在其他那些花旁边。
messages.en: In front of the altar, next to the others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象教堂里摆着鲜花的祭坛，把 artal 与“祭坛前”quddiem l-artal 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inflammation of one or more arteries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一条或多条动脉发生的炎症。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Infjammazzjoni ta' arterja waħda jew aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动脉炎，即动脉血管发生的炎症。

formal.mt: It-test mediku jispjega li l-arterite hija infjammazzjoni ta' arterja waħda jew aktar.
formal.en: The medical text explains that arteritis is inflammation of one or more arteries.
formal.zh: 这篇医学文本解释说，动脉炎是一条或多条动脉发生的炎症。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser arterite? Mark: Tfisser infjammazzjoni tal-arterji. Hekk jispjega l-ktieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does arteritis mean? Mark: It means inflammation of the arteries. That's how the book explains it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：动脉炎是什么意思？马克：意思是动脉发生炎症。书上是这样解释的。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 动脉炎是什么意思？
messages.en: What does arteritis mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser infjammazzjoni tal-arterji. Hekk jispjega l-ktieb.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser infjammazzjoni tal-arterji. Hekk jispjega l-ktieb.
messages.zh: 意思是动脉发生炎症。书上是这样解释的。
messages.en: It means inflammation of the arteries. That's how the book explains it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arterite 配上一幅“动脉出现炎症”的示意图，与 arterja“动脉”并排记，注意两者词尾不同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A blood vessel that carries blood away from the heart.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将血液从心脏输送出去的血管。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tubu fil-ġisem li jwassal id-demm mill-qalb lejn partijiet oħra tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动脉，将血液从心脏输送到身体其他部位的血管。
