formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi arterja li twassal id-demm mill-qalb lejn il-pulmuni.
formal.en: The diagram shows an artery that carries blood from the heart to the lungs.
formal.zh: 这张示意图展示了一条将血液从心脏输送到肺部的动脉。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din arterja jew vina? Pawlu: Arterja. Il-vleġġa turi li d-demm sejjer mill-qalb lejn il-pulmuni.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this an artery or a vein? Pawlu: An artery. The arrow shows that the blood is going from the heart to the lungs.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这是动脉还是静脉？保罗：动脉。箭头表示血液正从心脏流向肺部。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这是动脉还是静脉？
messages.en: Is this an artery or a vein?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Arterja. Il-vleġġa turi li d-demm sejjer mill-qalb lejn il-pulmuni.
messages.mt_standard: Arterja. Il-vleġġa turi li d-demm sejjer mill-qalb lejn il-pulmuni.
messages.zh: 动脉。箭头表示血液正从心脏流向肺部。
messages.en: An artery. The arrow shows that the blood is going from the heart to the lungs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一颗心脏和一支向外的箭头，把 arterja 写在箭头旁，记住动脉的关键是血液流离心脏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the arteries, the blood vessels that carry blood away from the heart.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与动脉有关的；动脉是将血液从心脏输送出去的血管。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-arterji, il-vini li jwasslu d-demm mill-qalb lejn il-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动脉的；与动脉有关的

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi l-kejl tal-pressjoni arterjali tal-pazjent.
formal.en: The report includes the patient's arterial blood pressure measurement.
formal.zh: 报告包含患者的动脉血压测量结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'arterjali' f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Tfisser li għandha x'taqsam mal-arterji.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'arterial' mean in this sentence? Pawlu: It means that it relates to the arteries.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句话里的“动脉的”是什么意思？保罗：意思是与动脉有关。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的“动脉的”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'arterial' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 意思是与动脉有关。
messages.en: It means that it relates to the arteries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arterjali 放进“动脉血压”这个词组一起记，想象血压报告上标出的动脉数值。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition in which the walls of arteries become thickened and less elastic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动脉壁增厚、弹性减弱的病变，称为动脉硬化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha l-ħitan tal-arterji jeħxienu u jitilfu l-elastiċità tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动脉硬化，即动脉壁增厚、变硬及弹性减弱的病变

formal.mt: It-test jispjega li l-arterjosklerożi tinvolvi tħaxxin u telf ta' elastiċità fil-ħitan tal-arterji.
formal.en: The text explains that arteriosclerosis involves thickening and loss of elasticity in the walls of arteries.
formal.zh: 课文解释说，动脉硬化涉及动脉壁增厚和弹性减弱。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'arterjosklerożi'? Mark: Tfisser li l-ħitan tal-arterji jeħxienu u jsiru inqas elastiċi.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'arteriosclerosis' mean? Mark: It means that the walls of the arteries become thicker and less elastic.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：“动脉硬化”是什么意思？马克：意思是动脉壁变厚，弹性也变差。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: “动脉硬化”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'arteriosclerosis' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-ħitan tal-arterji jeħxienu u jsiru inqas elastiċi.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-ħitan tal-arterji jeħxienu u jsiru inqas elastiċi.
messages.zh: 意思是动脉壁变厚，弹性也变差。
messages.en: It means that the walls of the arteries become thicker and less elastic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记这个长词时，脑中配一幅动脉管壁变厚、弹性减弱的示意图，把整词与“动脉硬化”对应。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant Eruca sativa, known as rocket or arugula, whose leaves are used as food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 芝麻菜，学名 Eruca sativa，其叶可作食材，英语称 rocket 或 arugula。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta Eruca sativa, li l-weraq tagħha jintuża bħala ikel, pereżempju fl-insalati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芝麻菜（Eruca sativa），英语亦称 rocket 或 arugula

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob li l-weraq tal-aruka jinħasel qabel ma jiżdied mal-insalata.
formal.en: The recipe calls for the arugula leaves to be washed before they are added to the salad.
formal.zh: 食谱要求先洗净芝麻菜叶，再将其加入沙拉。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Inżid ftit aruka mal-insalata? Luqa: Iva, imma aħsel il-weraq l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Nina: Shall I add some arugula to the salad? Luqa: Yes, but wash the leaves first.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：要不要往沙拉里加点芝麻菜？卢卡：好，不过先把叶子洗一洗。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 要不要往沙拉里加点芝麻菜？
messages.en: Shall I add some arugula to the salad?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，不过先把叶子洗一洗。
messages.en: Yes, but wash the leaves first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象做沙拉时拿起一把芝麻菜，边放进碗里边念 aruka，让词音与食材画面相连。

gloss_zh: 野生芝麻菜类植物（Diplotaxis viminea）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant species Diplotaxis viminea, known in English as southern rocket.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专指植物 Diplotaxis viminea，英语名称为 southern rocket；学习时应与 aruka 所指的芝麻菜区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta tal-ispeċi Diplotaxis viminea, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala southern rocket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 野生芝麻菜类植物，专指 Diplotaxis viminea，英语称 southern rocket

collocations.zh: 一株 Diplotaxis viminea 植物
对 Diplotaxis viminea 的辨识

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-pjanti, l-isem 'aruka salvaġġa' jirreferi għall-ispeċi Diplotaxis viminea.
formal.en: In the plant list, the name 'aruka salvaġġa' refers to the species Diplotaxis viminea.
formal.zh: 在这份植物名录中，名称 aruka salvaġġa 指的是 Diplotaxis viminea 这一物种。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jisimha din il-pjanta fir-ritratt? Toni: Skont it-tikketta, hija aruka salvaġġa, Diplotaxis viminea.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is the plant in this photograph called? Toni: According to the label, it is southern rocket, Diplotaxis viminea.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：照片里的这株植物叫什么？托尼：标签上写的是 aruka salvaġġa，也就是 Diplotaxis viminea。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is the plant in this photograph called?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Skont it-tikketta, hija aruka salvaġġa, Diplotaxis viminea.
messages.mt_standard: Skont it-tikketta, hija aruka salvaġġa, Diplotaxis viminea.
messages.zh: 标签上写的是 aruka salvaġġa，也就是 Diplotaxis viminea。
messages.en: According to the label, it is southern rocket, Diplotaxis viminea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张对照卡：aruka 配 Eruca sativa，aruka salvaġġa 配 Diplotaxis viminea，靠完整名称避免混淆物种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cockles, a kind of shellfish, or the shells of these animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟蛤这种贝类，也可指鸟蛤的贝壳；具体所指由上下文决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' molluski b'żewġ qxur, jew il-qxur ta' dawn il-molluski.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟蛤；鸟蛤的贝壳

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-qxur tal-arzell u ddeskrivew il-forma tagħhom fir-rapport.
formal.en: The students observed the cockleshells and described their shape in the report.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了鸟蛤壳，并在报告中描述了它们的形状。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandkom arzell frisk illum? Rita: Iva, kemm tixtieq?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have fresh cockles today? Rita: Yes, how much would you like?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天有新鲜鸟蛤吗？丽塔：有，你想要多少？

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天有新鲜鸟蛤吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh cockles today?

messages.speaker: Rita (摊主)
messages.zh: 有，你想要多少？
messages.en: Yes, how much would you like?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 arzell 配两幅图：市场里的鸟蛤和观察桌上的空贝壳，用场景记住它既能指贝，也能指壳。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of islands considered together as a geographical unit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在地理上作为一个整体看待的一组岛屿，即群岛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' gżejjer li jitqiesu flimkien bħala unità ġeografika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 群岛；在地理上形成一个整体的一组岛屿。

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi l-gżejjer kollha li jiffurmaw dan l-arċipelagu.
formal.en: The map shows all the islands that form this archipelago.
formal.zh: 地图展示了组成这片群岛的所有岛屿。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-mappa turi gżira waħda? Pawlu: Le, turi arċipelagu, jiġifieri grupp ta' gżejjer.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does this map show one island? Pawlu: No, it shows an archipelago, meaning a group of islands.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这张地图画的是一座岛吗？保罗：不是，画的是群岛，也就是一组岛屿。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这张地图画的是一座岛吗？
messages.en: Does this map show one island?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, turi arċipelagu, jiġifieri grupp ta' gżejjer.
messages.mt_standard: Le, turi arċipelagu, jiġifieri grupp ta' gżejjer.
messages.zh: 不是，画的是群岛，也就是一组岛屿。
messages.en: No, it shows an archipelago, meaning a group of islands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画出一张地图，把几座岛用一个大圈圈起来；圈内整个岛群就是 arċipelagu，帮助记住“群岛”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A senior bishop in a Christian church, holding the office of archbishop.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基督教教会中担任总主教或大主教职务的高级主教。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isqof ta' grad għoli fil-Knisja li għandu l-kariga ta' arċisqof.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 总主教；大主教，基督教教会中的高级主教职衔或担任该职务的人。

formal.mt: L-arċisqof indirizza lill-parteċipanti waqt il-laqgħa u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet tagħhom.
formal.en: The archbishop addressed the participants during the meeting and answered their questions.
formal.zh: 总主教在会议期间向与会者讲话，并回答了他们的问题。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jitkellem fil-laqgħa? Mark: L-arċisqof. Wara d-diskors, nistgħu nagħmlulu xi mistoqsijiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is going to speak at the meeting? Mark: The archbishop. After the speech, we can ask him some questions.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁将在会上讲话？马克：总主教。讲话结束后，我们可以向他提些问题。

messages.speaker: Sara (与会者)
messages.zh: 谁将在会上讲话？
messages.en: Who is going to speak at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: L-arċisqof. Wara d-diskors, nistgħu nagħmlulu xi mistoqsijiet.
messages.mt_standard: L-arċisqof. Wara d-diskors, nistgħu nagħmlulu xi mistoqsijiet.
messages.zh: 总主教。讲话结束后，我们可以向他提些问题。
messages.en: The archbishop. After the speech, we can ask him some questions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议名牌上写着 arċisqof，旁边标注“总主教”；把人物职衔与讲话场景一起记，避免只记住抽象拼写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover the surface of an object with a layer of silver.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物体表面覆上一层银，即给物体镀银。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tiksi l-wiċċ ta' oġġett b'saff ta' fidda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给……镀银；在……表面覆上一层银。

collocations.en: coated the surface of the object with silver
collocations.zh: 给物体表面覆上了银层

formal.mt: L-artiġjan arġenta l-kuċċarina billi kesa l-wiċċ tagħha b'saff ta' fidda.
formal.en: The craftsman silvered the spoon by coating its surface with a layer of silver.
formal.zh: 工匠给勺子镀了银，在其表面覆上了一层银。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'għamel l-artiġjan b'din il-kuċċarina? Mark: Arġentaha; kesa l-wiċċ tagħha b'saff ta' fidda.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did the craftsman do to this spoon? Mark: He silvered it; he covered its surface with a layer of silver.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：工匠对这把勺子做了什么？马克：他给它镀了银，在表面覆上了一层银。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 工匠对这把勺子做了什么？
messages.en: What did the craftsman do to this spoon?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Arġentaha; kesa l-wiċċ tagħha b'saff ta' fidda.
messages.mt_standard: Arġentaha; kesa l-wiċċ tagħha b'saff ta' fidda.
messages.zh: 他给它镀了银，在表面覆上了一层银。
messages.en: He silvered it; he covered its surface with a layer of silver.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工匠给勺子表面加上一层银，把 arġenta 记成“进行镀银这个动作”；用动作画面区别表示工艺的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of covering an object's surface with a layer of silver.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物体表面覆上一层银的过程或工艺，即镀银。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-wiċċ ta' oġġett jinkesa b'saff ta' fidda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镀银；在物体表面覆上银层的过程或工艺。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċess tal-arġentatura tal-kuċċarini, li matulu l-wiċċ tagħhom jinkesa b'saff ta' fidda.
formal.en: The report describes the process of silvering the spoons, during which their surface is coated with a layer of silver.
formal.zh: 报告描述了勺子的镀银过程，即在勺子表面覆上一层银。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi l-arġentatura? Pawlu: Hija l-proċess li bih oġġett jinkesa b'saff ta' fidda, bħal din il-kuċċarina.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is silvering? Pawlu: It is the process by which an object is coated with a layer of silver, like this spoon.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：什么是镀银？保罗：就是在物体表面覆上一层银的过程，比如这把勺子。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.zh: 什么是镀银？
messages.en: What is silvering?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija l-proċess li bih oġġett jinkesa b'saff ta' fidda, bħal din il-kuċċarina.
messages.mt_standard: Hija l-proċess li bih oġġett jinkesa b'saff ta' fidda, bħal din il-kuċċarina.
messages.zh: 就是在物体表面覆上一层银的过程，比如这把勺子。
messages.en: It is the process by which an object is coated with a layer of silver, like this spoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arġentatura 写在工艺流程图的标题处，下面画出物体覆上银层的过程；记住它是表示“镀银工艺”的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shop or workshop where a silversmith makes, repairs or sells silver objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 银匠制作、修理或出售银器的店铺或作坊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħanut jew ħanut tax-xogħol fejn jinħadmu, jissewwew jew jinbiegħu oġġetti tal-fidda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 银匠店；制作或修理银器的作坊。

formal.mt: Il-mużew bagħat it-tazza tal-fidda f'arġenterija biex tissewwa.
formal.en: The museum sent the silver cup to a silversmith's workshop to be repaired.
formal.zh: 博物馆将银杯送到银匠作坊修理。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nista' nsewwi din il-brazzuletta tal-fidda? Luqa: Hemm arġenterija ħdejn il-pjazza. Ejja mmorru flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I get this silver bracelet repaired? Luqa: There's a silversmith's shop near the square. Let's go together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这条银手链可以去哪里修？卢卡：广场旁边有家银匠店。我们一起去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nsewwi din il-brazzuletta tal-fidda?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nsewwi din il-brazzuletta tal-fidda?
messages.zh: 这条银手链可以去哪里修？
messages.en: Where can I get this silver bracelet repaired?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm arġenterija ħdejn il-pjazza. Ejja mmorru flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm arġenterija ħdejn il-pjazza. Ejja mmorru flimkien.
messages.zh: 广场旁边有家银匠店。我们一起去吧。
messages.en: There's a silversmith's shop near the square. Let's go together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿着银手链走进修理店：把 arġenterija 记成整个店铺或作坊的名称，再与表示工匠本人的 arġentier 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A craftsperson who makes or repairs objects made of gold or silver.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作或修理金器、银器的工匠，可按语境指金匠或银匠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna tas-sengħa li taħdem jew issewwi oġġetti tad-deheb jew tal-fidda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金匠；制作或修理金器的工匠。
银匠；制作或修理银器的工匠。

collocations.en: take a ring to the goldsmith or silversmith

formal.mt: L-arġentier sewwa ċ-ċurkett tad-deheb u naddaf it-tazza tal-fidda.
formal.en: The goldsmith and silversmith repaired the gold ring and cleaned the silver cup.
formal.zh: 这位金银匠修好了金戒指，并清洁了银杯。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Int l-arġentier li jsewwi ċ-ċrieket? Pawlu: Iva. Ġib iċ-ċurkett u naraw x'għandu bżonn.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are you the goldsmith who repairs rings? Pawlu: Yes. Bring the ring and we'll see what it needs.
colloquial.zh: 马克：您就是修戒指的金匠吗？保罗：是的。把戒指拿来，我们看看需要怎么修。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 您就是修戒指的金匠吗？
messages.en: Are you the goldsmith who repairs rings?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (金匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Ġib iċ-ċurkett u naraw x'għandu bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Ġib iċ-ċurkett u naraw x'għandu bżonn.
messages.zh: 是的。把戒指拿来，我们看看需要怎么修。
messages.en: Yes. Bring the ring and we'll see what it needs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中画一位拿工具修金戒指、擦银杯的工匠，给人物贴上 arġentier；再用金器和银器两幅画面记住它的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Argentina, a country in South America.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 阿根廷，位于南美洲的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Amerka t'Isfel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阿根廷，国家专名。
阿根廷，南美洲的一个国家。

formal.mt: L-istudenti sabu l-Arġentina fuq il-mappa tal-Amerka t'Isfel.
formal.en: The students found Argentina on the map of South America.
formal.zh: 学生们在南美洲地图上找到了阿根廷。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se tmur għall-vaganza? Maja: Se mmur l-Arġentina biex inżur lil ħabib tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are you going on holiday? Maja: I'm going to Argentina to visit a friend of mine.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你打算去哪里度假？玛雅：我要去阿根廷看望一位朋友。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur l-Arġentina biex inżur lil ħabib tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur l-Arġentina biex inżur lil ħabib tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我要去阿根廷看望一位朋友。
messages.en: I'm going to Argentina to visit a friend of mine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Arġentina 写在南美洲地图上，再配对练习 fl-Arġentina「在阿根廷」和 immur l-Arġentina「去阿根廷」，用位置与方向帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pine tree, or the wood obtained from pine trees.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 松树；也指取自松树、可用于制作家具等物品的木材。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġra tal-arżnu, jew l-injam li jinkiseb minn din is-siġra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 松树。
松木；松树的木材。
松树，指树木本身。

formal.mt: L-imwejjed tal-kamra tal-qari huma magħmula mill-injam tal-arżnu.
formal.en: The tables in the reading room are made of pine wood.
formal.zh: 阅览室里的桌子是用松木制作的。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn xiex hi magħmula din l-ixkaffa? Mark: Mill-injam tal-arżnu; jogħġobni l-kulur ċar tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this shelf made of? Mark: Pine wood; I like its light colour.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个架子是用什么做的？马克：松木，我喜欢它浅浅的颜色。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn xiex hi magħmula din l-ixkaffa?
messages.mt_standard: Minn xiex hi magħmula din l-ixkaffa?
messages.zh: 这个架子是用什么做的？
messages.en: What is this shelf made of?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mill-injam tal-arżnu; jogħġobni l-kulur ċar tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Mill-injam tal-arżnu; jogħġobni l-kulur ċar tiegħu.
messages.zh: 松木，我喜欢它浅浅的颜色。
messages.en: Pine wood; I like its light colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一棵松树和一件松木家具并排想象：同一个 arżnu 既能说树，也能说木材；看 siġra 和 injam 来辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a person who experiences little or no sexual attraction, or reproduction that occurs without the fusion of sex cells.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容很少或不体验性吸引的人；在生物学中，也形容不经生殖细胞融合的无性生殖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi persuna li tesperjenza ftit jew ebda attrazzjoni sesswali, jew riproduzzjoni mingħajr l-għaqda ta' ċelloli sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无性恋的，指很少或不体验性吸引；也指生物学上的无性生殖的

formal.mt: Fil-kapitlu tal-bijoloġija, l-aġġettiv 'asesswali' jiddeskrivi riproduzzjoni mingħajr l-għaqda ta' ċelloli sesswali.
formal.en: In the biology chapter, the adjective 'asexual' describes reproduction without the fusion of sex cells.
formal.zh: 在生物学章节中，形容词“无性的”描述不经生殖细胞融合的繁殖方式。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Jiena asesswali; ftit li xejn inħoss attrazzjoni sesswali. Nina: Grazzi talli għedtli.
colloquial.en: Lara: I'm asexual; I feel little or no sexual attraction. Nina: Thanks for telling me.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我是无性恋者，几乎不体验性吸引。妮娜：谢谢你告诉我。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiena asesswali; ftit li xejn inħoss attrazzjoni sesswali.
messages.mt_standard: Jiena asesswali; ftit li xejn inħoss attrazzjoni sesswali.
messages.zh: 我是无性恋者，几乎不体验性吸引。
messages.en: I'm asexual; I feel little or no sexual attraction.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢你告诉我。
messages.en: Thanks for telling me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 asesswali 分别放在“人”和“繁殖”旁练习：描述人时想到无性恋，描述繁殖时想到无性生殖。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The experience of little or no sexual attraction; in biology, the state of being asexual.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 很少或不体验性吸引的性取向或状态，即无性恋；在生物学语境中，也指无性状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-esperjenza ta' ftit jew ebda attrazzjoni sesswali; fil-bijoloġija, l-istat li jkun asesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无性恋，即很少或不体验性吸引的性取向或状态；生物学语境中也指无性状态

formal.mt: L-artiklu jispjega l-asesswalità bħala esperjenza ta' ftit jew ebda attrazzjoni sesswali.
formal.en: The article explains asexuality as the experience of little or no sexual attraction.
formal.zh: 文章将无性恋解释为很少或不体验性吸引。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qrajt artiklu dwar l-asesswalità. Sara: Tista' tibgħatli l-link? Nixtieq nifhem aktar.
colloquial.en: Mark: I read an article about asexuality. Sara: Can you send me the link? I'd like to understand more.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我读了一篇关于无性恋的文章。萨拉：能把链接发给我吗？我想多了解一些。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我读了一篇关于无性恋的文章。
messages.en: I read an article about asexuality.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tibgħatli l-link? Nixtieq nifhem aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tibgħatli l-link? Nixtieq nifhem aktar.
messages.zh: 能把链接发给我吗？我想多了解一些。
messages.en: Can you send me the link? I'd like to understand more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一组搭配区分词性：asesswali 用来描述人，asesswalità 是可以阅读、讨论和了解的“无性恋”概念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dark material used to make the surface of roads and other paved areas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于铺设道路及其他地面的深色材料，称为沥青或沥青铺路材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal skur li jintuża biex jinkesa l-wiċċ tat-toroq u ta' żoni oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沥青；用于道路等地面铺设的沥青材料

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema qiegħdu saff ġdid ta' asfalt fuq il-wiċċ tat-triq.
formal.en: The workers laid a new layer of asphalt on the road surface.
formal.zh: 工人在路面上铺了一层新的沥青。

colloquial.mt: Luqa: Għaliex it-triq magħluqa? Rita: Qed iqiegħdu saff ġdid ta' asfalt.
colloquial.en: Luqa: Why is the road closed? Rita: They're laying a new layer of asphalt.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：这条路为什么封了？丽塔：他们正在铺一层新的沥青。

messages.speaker: Luqa (路人)
messages.zh: 这条路为什么封了？
messages.en: Why is the road closed?

messages.speaker: Rita (附近居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed iqiegħdu saff ġdid ta' asfalt.
messages.mt_standard: Qed iqiegħdu saff ġdid ta' asfalt.
messages.zh: 他们正在铺一层新的沥青。
messages.en: They're laying a new layer of asphalt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到新铺的黑色路面就默念 asfalt，再配着 saff ta' asfalt“一层沥青”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Asia, the largest continent, situated between Europe and the Pacific Ocean.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 亚洲，位于欧洲与太平洋之间、面积最大的洲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-Asja, l-akbar kontinent, li jinsab bejn l-Ewropa u l-Oċean Paċifiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亚洲。

sense_translations.en_definition: Asia (the largest continent, located between Europe and the Pacific Ocean)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 亚洲，世界上面积最大的洲，位于欧洲与太平洋之间。

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi l-klima u l-popolazzjoni ta' diversi pajjiżi fl-Asja.
formal.en: This chapter describes the climate and population of several countries in Asia.
formal.zh: 本章介绍亚洲几个国家的气候和人口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qatt mort l-Asja? Pawlu: Iva, mort il-Ġappun mal-familja tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you ever been to Asia? Pawlu: Yes, I went to Japan with my family.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你去过亚洲吗？Pawlu：去过，我和家人一起去过日本。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你去过亚洲吗？
messages.en: Have you ever been to Asia?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 去过，我和家人一起去过日本。
messages.en: Yes, I went to Japan with my family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Asja 与地图上的“亚洲”直接配对，再连读 fl-Asja“在亚洲”；用地点短语帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a strong desire or ambition to achieve something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强烈希望实现某个目标，或立志达到某种成就。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu xewqa qawwija jew ambizzjoni li jilħaq għan jew jikseb xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 渴望有所成就；立志追求某个目标。

collocations.en: aspire to the position of director

formal.mt: Sa minn żgħożitu, Mark aspira għal karriera fir-riċerka xjentifika.
formal.en: From his youth, Mark aspired to a career in scientific research.
formal.zh: 马克从年轻时起就立志从事科学研究。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għal xiex qed taspira wara l-istudji? Mark: Qed naspira għal xogħol fejn nista' ngħin lin-nies.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you aspiring to after your studies? Mark: I'm aspiring to a job where I can help people.
colloquial.zh: Sara：完成学业后，你向往做什么？Mark：我希望找到一份能帮助别人的工作。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal xiex qed taspira wara l-istudji?
messages.mt_standard: Għal xiex qed taspira wara l-istudji?
messages.zh: 完成学业后，你向往做什么？
messages.en: What are you aspiring to after your studies?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naspira għal xogħol fejn nista' ngħin lin-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naspira għal xogħol fejn nista' ngħin lin-nies.
messages.zh: 我希望找到一份能帮助别人的工作。
messages.en: I'm aspiring to a job where I can help people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己望着未来目标，说 aspira għal“立志追求”；把动词与目标前的 għal 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deliberately murder a prominent person, especially for political reasons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蓄意杀害某位重要人物，尤其指出于政治动机实施暗杀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joqtol apposta persuna prominenti, speċjalment għal raġunijiet politiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暗杀，尤指出于政治动机蓄意杀害重要人物。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif raġel armat assassina lill-mexxej politiku waqt żjara uffiċjali.
formal.en: The report describes how an armed man assassinated the political leader during an official visit.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一名持械男子如何在一次正式访问期间暗杀了这位政治领袖。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi ġara fl-aħħar tal-film? Toni: Wieħed mill-karattri assassina lill-president, u l-pulizija bdiet tinvestiga.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened at the end of the film? Toni: One of the characters assassinated the president, and the police began investigating.
colloquial.zh: Lara：电影结尾发生了什么？Toni：其中一个角色暗杀了总统，警方随后展开调查。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影结尾发生了什么？
messages.en: What happened at the end of the film?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wieħed mill-karattri assassina lill-president, u l-pulizija bdiet tinvestiga.
messages.mt_standard: Wieħed mill-karattri assassina lill-president, u l-pulizija bdiet tinvestiga.
messages.zh: 其中一个角色暗杀了总统，警方随后展开调查。
messages.en: One of the characters assassinated the president, and the police began investigating.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用政治悬疑片中的“暗杀总统”场景记 assassina，突出蓄意针对重要人物这一含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give a task, resource, or share to a particular person or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把任务、资源或份额分配给某个人或群体；指派或拨给。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti kompitu, riżorsa jew sehem lil persuna jew grupp partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肯定；确认某事属实。

sense_translations.en_definition: to assign, to allocate, to allot
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指派；分配；拨给一定的资源或份额。

formal.mt: Id-direttur assenja fondi addizzjonali lill-proġett biex jitlesta fil-ħin.
formal.en: The director allocated additional funds to the project so that it could be completed on time.
formal.zh: 主管向该项目追加拨款，以便项目按时完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min assenja dan il-kompitu lilek? Luqa: Il-maniġer; talabni nlestih sa għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who assigned this task to you? Luqa: The manager; he asked me to finish it by tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把这个任务交给你的？卢卡：经理，他让我明天之前完成。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 谁把这个任务交给你的？
messages.en: Who assigned this task to you?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.zh: 经理，他让我明天之前完成。
messages.en: The manager; he asked me to finish it by tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象主管把任务卡和资金分别交到负责人手中，用“把某物分给某人”记住分配义；“肯定”义另作一张卡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stay away from a place or activity where one is expected to be present.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不去本应出席的地点或活动；使自己缺席。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jonqos milli jattendi post jew attività fejn ikun mistenni li jkun preżenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己缺席；不出席本应参加的活动。

formal.mt: Il-membru assenta ruħu mis-seduta u bagħat spjegazzjoni bil-miktub lis-segretarju.
formal.en: The member absented himself from the session and sent a written explanation to the secretary.
formal.zh: 该成员缺席了会议，并向秘书提交了书面说明。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Pawlu assenta ruħu mil-laqgħa? Ġanni: Kellu appuntament mat-tabib u avża lill-organizzatur minn qabel.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did Pawlu absent himself from the meeting? Ġanni: He had a doctor's appointment and informed the organizer beforehand.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu 为什么缺席会议？Ġanni：他预约了看医生，事先通知了组织者。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: Pawlu 为什么缺席会议？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu absent himself from the meeting?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellu appuntament mat-tabib u avża lill-organizzatur minn qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Kellu appuntament mat-tabib u avża lill-organizzatur minn qabel.
messages.zh: 他预约了看医生，事先通知了组织者。
messages.en: He had a doctor's appointment and informed the organizer beforehand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 assenta ruħu 想成“让自己缺席”，再接 mil-laqgħa“从会议中缺席”，整块记住反身表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To examine something carefully in order to judge its quality, value, level, or condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过仔细检查，对事物的质量、价值、程度或状况作出判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jeżamina xi ħaġa bir-reqqa biex jiġġudika l-kwalità, il-valur, il-livell jew il-kundizzjoni tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 评估；根据检查或分析评定质量、价值、程度或状况。

formal.mt: L-espert assessja l-kundizzjoni tal-bini qabel ma ppreżenta r-rapport tiegħu.
formal.en: The expert assessed the condition of the building before presenting his report.
formal.zh: 专家在提交报告前评估了建筑物的状况。

colloquial.mt: Nina: L-għalliem assessja x-xogħol tiegħek? Karl: Iva, u qalli li l-ideat kienu tajbin iżda kelli nirranġa l-istruttura.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did the teacher assess your work? Karl: Yes, and he told me the ideas were good but I needed to improve the structure.
colloquial.zh: Nina：老师评定你的作业了吗？Karl：评了，他说想法不错，但我需要调整结构。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 老师评定你的作业了吗？
messages.en: Did the teacher assess your work?

messages.speaker: Karl (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u qalli li l-ideat kienu tajbin iżda kelli nirranġa l-istruttura.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u qalli li l-ideat kienu tajbin iżda kelli nirranġa l-istruttura.
messages.zh: 评了，他说想法不错，但我需要调整结构。
messages.en: Yes, and he told me the ideas were good but I needed to improve the structure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 assessja 和英语 assess 对照着记：先检查材料，再作评估；用“老师评作业”的画面固定含义。

gloss_zh: 投保；承保；向人保证；确保

teaching_sense.en_definition: To provide insurance or take on insured risk; to reassure someone or make certain that something happens.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为财产等投保或承担保险责任；也指向人作出保证，或确保某事发生、落实无误。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel assigurazzjoni jew jieħu r-riskju kopert minnha; ukoll iserraħ moħħ xi ħadd jew jagħmel ċert li xi ħaġa sseħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为人或财产投保，或提供保险保障。
承保；同意承担保险合同规定的风险和赔付责任。
向某人保证，使其相信或放心。
确保；采取措施使某种结果得以实现。
确认无误；弄清楚或确保某事得到落实。

collocations.en: ensure the success of the project

collocations.mt: assigura ruħu li kollox kien lest
collocations.en: make sure that everything was ready
collocations.zh: 确认一切已经准备就绪

formal.mt: Il-maniġer assigura lill-klijenti li s-servizz kien se jibqa' disponibbli matul ix-xogħlijiet.
formal.en: The manager assured the customers that the service would remain available during the works.
formal.zh: 经理向客户保证，施工期间仍会提供服务。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Assigurajt id-dar il-ġdida? Pawlu: Iva, għażilt polza li tkopri wkoll il-ħsara min-nar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Have you insured the new house? Pawlu: Yes, I chose a policy that also covers fire damage.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你给新房投保了吗？Pawlu：投保了，我选了一份也承保火灾损失的保单。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你给新房投保了吗？
messages.en: Have you insured the new house?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (房主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għażilt polza li tkopri wkoll il-ħsara min-nar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għażilt polza li tkopri wkoll il-ħsara min-nar.
messages.zh: 投保了，我选了一份也承保火灾损失的保单。
messages.en: Yes, I chose a policy that also covers fire damage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个场景串记 assigura：给房屋“投保”、向客户“保证”、检查准备情况以“确保无误”；按语境选择中文义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To absorb and understand new information, or to make something part of an existing system or culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吸收并理解新的知识或信息；也指将某事物融入已有体系或文化，使之同化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jassorbi u jifhem tagħrif ġdid, jew jinkorpora xi ħaġa f'sistema jew kultura eżistenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吸收并消化理解知识或信息；使融入某一体系或文化，使同化。

formal.mt: Wara li qara l-kapitlu darbtejn, l-istudent assimila l-kunċetti ewlenin u applikahom fl-eżerċizzji.
formal.en: After reading the chapter twice, the student assimilated the main concepts and applied them in the exercises.
formal.zh: 读了两遍这一章后，学生理解掌握了主要概念，并将其运用于练习。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Diġà assimilajt l-informazzjoni kollha tal-lezzjoni? David: Għad le; irrid naqra n-noti mill-ġdid u nagħmel ftit eżerċizzji.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you already assimilated all the information from the lesson? David: Not yet; I need to reread the notes and do a few exercises.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你已经消化理解这节课的全部信息了吗？David：还没有；我需要重读笔记，再做几道练习。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 你已经消化理解这节课的全部信息了吗？
messages.en: Have you already assimilated all the information from the lesson?

messages.speaker: David (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad le; irrid naqra n-noti mill-ġdid u nagħmel ftit eżerċizzji.
messages.mt_standard: Għad le; irrid naqra n-noti mill-ġdid u nagħmel ftit eżerċizzji.
messages.zh: 还没有；我需要重读笔记，再做几道练习。
messages.en: Not yet; I need to reread the notes and do a few exercises.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把学习新知识想成“吃进去还要消化”：assimila 强调吸收后融入自己的理解，可搭配信息和概念记忆。

gloss_zh: 同化的；促进同化或吸收的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to or promoting assimilation, the process of becoming similar to or integrated into something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与同化有关的，或促进同化、吸收的；使某事物逐渐与另一事物相似或融入其中的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-assimilazzjoni jew jgħinha sseħħ, sabiex xi ħaġa ssir aktar simili għal oħra jew tiġi integrata fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所给释义未明确标注含义，无法据此确定具体中文义项。
同化的；具有同化或吸收作用的。

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi proċess assimilattiv li fih ħoss isir aktar simili għal ħoss ieħor qrib tiegħu.
formal.en: The study describes an assimilative process in which a sound becomes more similar to another sound near it.
formal.zh: 该研究描述了一种同化过程，其中一个语音变得更接近邻近的另一个语音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'assimilattiv' f'dan l-eżempju? Pawlu: Ifisser li ħoss qed isir aktar simili għal ħoss ieħor qrib tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'assimilative' mean in this example? Pawlu: It means that one sound is becoming more similar to another sound near it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个例子里的“同化的”是什么意思？保罗：意思是一个语音正在变得更接近它旁边的另一个语音。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个例子里的“同化的”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'assimilative' mean in this example?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li ħoss qed isir aktar simili għal ħoss ieħor qrib tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li ħoss qed isir aktar simili għal ħoss ieħor qrib tiegħu.
messages.zh: 意思是一个语音正在变得更接近它旁边的另一个语音。
messages.en: It means that one sound is becoming more similar to another sound near it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个相邻声音逐渐变得相像，把 assimilattiv 与“同化作用”一起记忆；这是意义联想，不是词源分析。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To help someone with a task or need; also, to be present at an event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 帮助某人完成任务或应对需要；也可表示在某个活动现场出席。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħin lil xi ħadd f'xogħol jew f'xi bżonn; ukoll ikun preżenti għal avveniment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 协助；向某人提供帮助。
协助，帮助某人完成事情或解决困难。
在场；出席某个活动或场合。

formal.mt: L-uffiċjal assista lill-applikanti biex jimlew il-formoli meħtieġa.
formal.en: The officer assisted the applicants in completing the required forms.
formal.zh: 工作人员协助申请人填写所需表格。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min assista lil ommok fl-isptar? Rita: Infermier ġentili għenha ssib is-sala u spjegalha fejn kellha tistenna.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who assisted your mother at the hospital? Rita: A kind nurse helped her find the ward and explained where she should wait.
colloquial.zh: Mark：谁在医院帮助了你母亲？Rita：一位友善的护士帮她找到了病房，并告诉她该在哪里等候。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁在医院帮助了你母亲？
messages.en: Who assisted your mother at the hospital?

messages.speaker: Rita (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Infermier ġentili għenha ssib is-sala u spjegalha fejn kellha tistenna.
messages.mt_standard: Infermier ġentili għenha ssib is-sala u spjegalha fejn kellha tistenna.
messages.zh: 一位友善的护士帮她找到了病房，并告诉她该在哪里等候。
messages.en: A kind nurse helped her find the ward and explained where she should wait.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 assista：伸手“帮助某人”，到场“出席仪式”；看到人物或活动搭配时再判断具体词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To release someone from guilt or blame, especially by granting religious forgiveness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 免除某人的罪责或过失责任，尤指在宗教中赦免罪过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jeħles lil xi ħadd mill-ħtija, speċjalment billi jagħtih il-maħfra tad-dnubiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赦免某人的罪过；免除某人的罪责。

formal.mt: Wara l-qrar, il-qassis assolva lill-penitent minn dnubietu.
formal.en: After confession, the priest absolved the penitent of his sins.
formal.zh: 告解后，神父赦免了忏悔者的罪过。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'għamel il-qassis wara li sema' l-qrar? Pietru: Assolva lill-penitent u tah parir.
colloquial.en: Anna: What did the priest do after hearing the confession? Pietru: He absolved the penitent and gave him advice.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：神父听完告解后做了什么？彼得：他赦免了忏悔者，并给了他一些建议。

messages.speaker: Anna (教理班学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamel il-qassis wara li sema' l-qrar?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamel il-qassis wara li sema' l-qrar?
messages.zh: 神父听完告解后做了什么？
messages.en: What did the priest do after hearing the confession?

messages.speaker: Pietru (教理老师)
messages.zh: 他赦免了忏悔者，并给了他一些建议。
messages.en: He absolved the penitent and gave him advice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象肩上写着“罪责”的重担被卸下，用“赦免后放下重担”的画面记忆这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To connect a person, thing, or idea with another in thought.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在思想中把某个人、事物或概念与另一个联系起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jorbot persuna, ħaġa jew idea ma' oħra fil-ħsieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把……联系起来；将……与……相联想。
订阅。

collocations.en: associated the colour with a feeling
collocations.zh: 把颜色与一种感受联系起来

collocations.en: associated the name with the place
collocations.zh: 把名字与地点联系起来

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tiegħu, l-awtur assoċja l-kulur aħmar mal-periklu.
formal.en: In his analysis, the author associated the colour red with danger.
formal.zh: 作者在分析中把红色与危险联系起来。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Pawlu ftakar fil-baħar meta ra din l-istampa? Mark: Għax assoċja l-kulur blu mal-baħar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did Pawlu think of the sea when he saw this picture? Mark: Because he associated the colour blue with the sea.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：保罗看到这幅图时，为什么想起了大海？马克：因为他把蓝色与大海联系起来了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu ftakar fil-baħar meta ra din l-istampa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu ftakar fil-baħar meta ra din l-istampa?
messages.zh: 保罗看到这幅图时，为什么想起了大海？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu think of the sea when he saw this picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为他把蓝色与大海联系起来了。
messages.en: Because he associated the colour blue with the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看见蓝色就想到大海，用一条心理连线记住“联系、联想”；“订阅”义另配订阅杂志的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized group of people with a shared purpose, or a connection between things or ideas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为共同目的组织起来的团体，也可指事物或观念之间的关联。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqda ta' nies b'għan komuni, jew rabta bejn affarijiet jew ideat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 协会、社团；事物或观念之间的关联、联想。

formal.mt: L-assoċjazzjoni tal-istudenti organizzat laqgħa biex tiddiskuti s-servizzi tal-librerija.
formal.en: The students' association organized a meeting to discuss library services.
formal.zh: 学生协会组织了一次会议，讨论图书馆的服务。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Int membru tal-assoċjazzjoni tal-istudenti? Luqa: Iva, u llum għandna laqgħa wara l-lezzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you a member of the students' association? Luqa: Yes, and today we have a meeting after classes.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你是学生协会的成员吗？卢卡：是的，我们今天下课后有个会议。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你是学生协会的成员吗？
messages.en: Are you a member of the students' association?

messages.speaker: Luqa (学生协会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u llum għandna laqgħa wara l-lezzjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u llum għandna laqgħa wara l-lezzjonijiet.
messages.zh: 是的，我们今天下课后有个会议。
messages.en: Yes, and today we have a meeting after classes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一群学生围桌开会的画面贴在词旁，记住“协会”；再画两点相连，帮助记住“关联”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To accept something as true without confirmation, or to take on a duty, role, or responsibility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未经证实便认为某事属实，或接下某项职责、角色或责任。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqis xi ħaġa bħala vera mingħajr konferma, jew jieħu fuqu dmir, rwol jew responsabbiltà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 假定；未经证实便认为某事属实。

sense_translations.en_definition: to assume, to take on, to undertake
sense_translations.zh_definition: 承担；接下职责、任务或角色。

collocations.zh: 以为一切已经准备好了

formal.mt: Il-koordinatur il-ġdid assuma r-responsabbiltà għall-organizzazzjoni tal-laqgħat.
formal.en: The new coordinator took on responsibility for organizing the meetings.
formal.zh: 新任协调员承担了组织会议的责任。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex Mark ma ċempilx qabel ġie? David: Assuma li konna d-dar, imma ma staqsiex.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why didn't Mark call before coming? David: He assumed we were at home, but he didn't ask.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：马克来之前为什么没打电话？戴维：他以为我们在家，但没有问过。

messages.speaker: Elena (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ma ċempilx qabel ġie?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ma ċempilx qabel ġie?
messages.zh: 马克来之前为什么没打电话？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark call before coming?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Assuma li konna d-dar, imma ma staqsiex.
messages.mt_standard: Assuma li konna d-dar, imma ma staqsiex.
messages.zh: 他以为我们在家，但没有问过。
messages.en: He assumed we were at home, but he didn't ask.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张卡片区分：脑中先认定一件事是“假定”，肩上接过一项任务是“承担”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The deliberate practice of refraining from a particular activity or from consuming something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有意识地不进行某种活动，或不摄入某种食物、饮品等的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika li wieħed jagħżel li ma jagħmilx ċerta attività jew ma jikkunsmax xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 禁欲；戒除或避免某种行为、饮食或饮酒等。

collocations.zh: 一段戒 abstain 的时期

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi perjodu ta' astinenza mill-alkoħol li dam tliet xhur.
formal.en: The report describes a period of abstinence from alcohol lasting three months.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一段持续三个月的不饮酒时期。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Trid tazza nbid mal-ikel? Ġanni: Le, grazzi. Għażilt xahar ta' astinenza mill-alkoħol.
colloquial.en: Rita: Would you like a glass of wine with your meal? Ġanni: No, thank you. I've chosen a month of abstinence from alcohol.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：吃饭时要喝一杯葡萄酒吗？詹尼：不用，谢谢。我决定这个月不喝酒。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 吃饭时要喝一杯葡萄酒吗？
messages.en: Would you like a glass of wine with your meal?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, grazzi. Għażilt xahar ta' astinenza mill-alkoħol.
messages.mt_standard: Le, grazzi. Għażilt xahar ta' astinenza mill-alkoħol.
messages.zh: 不用，谢谢。我决定这个月不喝酒。
messages.en: No, thank you. I've chosen a month of abstinence from alcohol.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上一个月的酒杯都被画上叉，记住这是有意识地克制、暂不摄取或不参与。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Concerning ideas or qualities considered apart from particular physical objects or concrete examples.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 抽象的；涉及脱离具体实物或实例而思考的概念、性质等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jittratta ideat jew kwalitajiet meqjusa separatament minn oġġetti fiżiċi jew eżempji konkreti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抽象的；以概念或性质为对象而不依赖具体实例的。
摘要；概括文章、研究等主要内容的简短文字。

formal.mt: L-astratt tal-artiklu jiġbor fil-qosor l-għan, il-metodu u r-riżultati ewlenin tal-istudju.
formal.en: The article's abstract briefly presents the study's aim, method, and main findings.
formal.zh: 文章摘要简要介绍了研究目的、方法和主要结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kunċett hu astratt wisq għalija. Pawlu: Ejja nagħtu eżempju mill-ħajja ta' kuljum biex ikun aktar ċar.
colloquial.en: Maja: This concept is too abstract for me. Pawlu: Let's give an example from everyday life to make it clearer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个概念对我来说太抽象了。保罗：我们举个日常生活中的例子，让它更清楚些。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kunċett hu astratt wisq għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kunċett hu astratt wisq għalija.
messages.zh: 这个概念对我来说太抽象了。
messages.en: This concept is too abstract for me.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nagħtu eżempju mill-ħajja ta' kuljum biex ikun aktar ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nagħtu eżempju mill-ħajja ta' kuljum biex ikun aktar ċar.
messages.zh: 我们举个日常生活中的例子，让它更清楚些。
messages.en: Let's give an example from everyday life to make it clearer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两格记忆：描述概念时是“抽象的”，指文章开头的一段概述时是“摘要”；结合句中位置辨认词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A practice that interprets the positions of stars and planets as signs concerning human character or events.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把恒星和行星的位置解释为与人的性格或事件有关的征兆的一种做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prattika li tinterpreta l-pożizzjonijiet tal-kwiekeb u l-pjaneti bħala sinjali dwar il-karattru tan-nies jew il-ġrajjiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 占星术；根据星体位置解读人的性格或预测事件的做法。

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddeskrivi l-astroloġija bħala prattika li tagħti tifsiriet lill-pożizzjonijiet tal-pjaneti.
formal.en: The article describes astrology as a practice that assigns meanings to the positions of planets.
formal.zh: 文章把占星术描述为一种赋予行星位置特定含义的做法。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dwar xiex inhu dak il-ktieb? Karl: Dwar l-astroloġija. Qed naqrah għax jinteressani kif in-nies jinterpretaw is-sinjali.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is that book about? Karl: Astrology. I'm reading it because I'm interested in how people interpret the signs.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那本书讲什么？卡尔：占星术。我在读它，因为我对人们如何解读星座感兴趣。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 那本书讲什么？
messages.en: What is that book about?

messages.speaker: Karl (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar l-astroloġija. Qed naqrah għax jinteressani kif in-nies jinterpretaw is-sinjali.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar l-astroloġija. Qed naqrah għax jinteressani kif in-nies jinterpretaw is-sinjali.
messages.zh: 占星术。我在读它，因为我对人们如何解读星座感兴趣。
messages.en: Astrology. I'm reading it because I'm interested in how people interpret the signs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本用星盘解释性格的书，把整个词与“占星术”绑定；记忆重点是解读星象这一活动。

gloss_zh: 从占星术角度；按占星术解释

teaching_sense.en_definition: From the perspective of astrology or according to its interpretations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从占星术的角度，或按照占星术的解释方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mill-perspettiva tal-astroloġija jew skont l-interpretazzjonijiet tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从占星术上看；按照占星术的解释。

formal.mt: Fl-esej, l-awtriċi tispjega kif il-karattri tar-rumanz jiġu interpretati astroloġikament.
formal.en: In the essay, the author explains how the novel's characters are interpreted astrologically.
formal.zh: 作者在文章中说明了如何从占星术角度解读小说人物。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'jiġifieri li tħares lejn din id-data astroloġikament? Toni: Jiġifieri li tinterpretaha mill-perspettiva tal-astroloġija.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does it mean to look at this date astrologically? Toni: It means interpreting it from the perspective of astrology.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：从占星术角度看这个日期是什么意思？托尼：就是用占星术的观点来解释这个日期。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri li tħares lejn din id-data astroloġikament?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri li tħares lejn din id-data astroloġikament?
messages.zh: 从占星术角度看这个日期是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean to look at this date astrologically?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.zh: 就是用占星术的观点来解释这个日期。
messages.en: It means interpreting it from the perspective of astrology.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在“解释”这个动作旁加上“从占星术角度”的便签，记住它说明如何解释，作副词使用。

gloss_zh: 占星术的；与占星术有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to astrology and its interpretations of stars, planets, and human affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与占星术及其对星体和人事的解释有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-astroloġija u mal-interpretazzjonijiet tagħha tal-kwiekeb, il-pjaneti u l-ħajja tan-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 占星术的；与占星术有关的。
占星术的；涉及占星术的。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu janalizza t-tbassir astroloġiku li jidher fir-rivista.
formal.en: The chapter analyses the astrological predictions that appear in the magazine.
formal.zh: 这一章分析了杂志上刊登的占星预测。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan kalendarju astroloġiku? Ben: Iva, fih is-sinjali taż-żodijaku u tbassir għal kull xahar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this an astrological calendar? Ben: Yes, it has the signs of the zodiac and predictions for each month.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这是一本占星历吗？本：是的，里面有黄道十二宫的星座和每个月的预测。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这是一本占星历吗？
messages.en: Is this an astrological calendar?

messages.speaker: Ben (书店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fih is-sinjali taż-żodijaku u tbassir għal kull xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fih is-sinjali taż-żodijaku u tbassir għal kull xahar.
messages.zh: 是的，里面有黄道十二宫的星座和每个月的预测。
messages.en: Yes, it has the signs of the zodiac and predictions for each month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“占星术的”标签贴在日历或预测旁，记住这个词修饰名词，说明事物与占星术有关。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The science that studies stars, planets, and other objects and phenomena in space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究恒星、行星及其他宇宙天体和现象的科学。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xjenza li tistudja l-istilel, il-pjaneti u oġġetti u fenomeni oħra fl-ispazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天文学；研究宇宙天体及相关现象的科学。

formal.mt: Il-kors ta' introduzzjoni għall-astronomija jispjega kif jiġu osservati l-istilel u l-pjaneti.
formal.en: The introductory astronomy course explains how stars and planets are observed.
formal.zh: 这门天文学入门课程讲解如何观测恒星和行星。

colloquial.mt: Vera: X'qed taqra? Pawlu: Ktieb dwar l-astronomija. Irrid nitgħallem aktar dwar l-istilel.
colloquial.en: Vera: What are you reading? Pawlu: A book about astronomy. I want to learn more about the stars.
colloquial.zh: Vera：你在读什么？Pawlu：一本关于天文学的书。我想多了解一些恒星的知识。

messages.speaker: Vera (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ktieb dwar l-astronomija. Irrid nitgħallem aktar dwar l-istilel.
messages.mt_standard: Ktieb dwar l-astronomija. Irrid nitgħallem aktar dwar l-istilel.
messages.zh: 一本关于天文学的书。我想多了解一些恒星的知识。
messages.en: A book about astronomy. I want to learn more about the stars.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 astronomija 放进“打开天文学课本、抬头认识星空”的画面中，记住它指学科。

teaching_sense.en_definition: From an astronomical point of view, or to an extremely great degree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从天文学的角度而言；也可比喻程度极高或幅度极大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mill-perspettiva tal-astronomija, jew b'mod li jindika grad jew ammont kbir ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从天文学角度；以天文学的方式。

sense_translations.en_definition: implying a great degree or extent
sense_translations.zh_definition: 极大地；以夸张方式表示程度极高或幅度极大。

collocations.zh: 在天文学上具有重要意义的

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li l-ispejjeż tal-proġett żdiedu astronomikament matul is-sena.
formal.en: The report shows that the project's costs rose astronomically during the year.
formal.zh: 报告显示，该项目的成本在这一年中大幅飙升。

colloquial.mt: Vera: Kemm jiswa lejl f'dik il-lukanda? Pawlu: Il-prezzijiet huma astronomikament għoljin. Ejja nfittxu post ieħor.
colloquial.en: Vera: How much does a night at that hotel cost? Pawlu: The prices are astronomically high. Let's look for somewhere else.
colloquial.zh: Vera：那家酒店住一晚多少钱？Pawlu：价格高得惊人。我们找别的地方吧。

messages.speaker: Vera (旅伴)
messages.zh: 那家酒店住一晚多少钱？
messages.en: How much does a night at that hotel cost?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-prezzijiet huma astronomikament għoljin. Ejja nfittxu post ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Il-prezzijiet huma astronomikament għoljin. Ejja nfittxu post ieħor.

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to astronomy, or extremely large in amount, degree, or extent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与天文学有关的；也可形容数量、程度或规模极其巨大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-astronomija, jew li hu kbir ħafna fl-ammont, fil-grad jew fil-firxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天文学的；与天文学研究或观测有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: of a great degree or extent
sense_translations.zh_definition: 极其巨大的；形容程度、数量或规模大得惊人。

formal.mt: Il-grupp żar osservatorju astronomiku biex jitgħallem dwar l-osservazzjoni tal-pjaneti.
formal.en: The group visited an astronomical observatory to learn about observing planets.
formal.zh: 该小组参观了一座天文台，学习有关行星观测的知识。

colloquial.mt: Vera: Se tixtri dak it-teleskopju? Pawlu: Le, għandu prezz astronomiku. Se nfittex wieħed irħas.
colloquial.en: Vera: Are you going to buy that telescope? Pawlu: No, it has an astronomical price. I'll look for a cheaper one.
colloquial.zh: Vera：你要买那台望远镜吗？Pawlu：不买，价格高得惊人。我会找一台便宜些的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who studies stars, planets, and other objects and phenomena in space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究恒星、行星及其他宇宙天体和现象的人；天文学家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tistudja l-istilel, il-pjaneti u oġġetti u fenomeni oħra fl-ispazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天文学家；从事天体及宇宙现象研究的人。

formal.mt: L-astronomu ppreżenta r-riżultati tal-osservazzjonijiet tiegħu waqt konferenza xjentifika.
formal.en: The astronomer presented the results of his observations at a scientific conference.
formal.zh: 这位天文学家在一场科学会议上介绍了他的观测结果。

colloquial.mt: Vera: Min se jagħti t-taħdita llejla? Pawlu: Astronomu. Se jitkellem dwar il-pjaneti.
colloquial.en: Vera: Who is giving the talk tonight? Pawlu: An astronomer. He'll be talking about the planets.

messages.speaker: Vera (同学)

messages.en: An astronomer. He'll be talking about the planets.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位天文学家站在望远镜旁做记录：astronomu 指研究的人，astronomija 指研究的学科。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A kite, a bird of prey; the supplied senses include black kites and the red kite.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黑鸢，学名 Milvus migrans。

a photograph of a black kite
