gloss_zh: 不停咳嗽；私通；表现得好色

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cough repeatedly or a great deal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复咳嗽或咳嗽得很厉害；这是本条重点练习的义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tisgħol ħafna jew ripetutament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发生婚外或非婚性关系；私通，通常带贬义。
不停咳嗽；频繁地咳嗽。
好色；表现出淫荡或过分贪恋性欲的样子。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent badbad matul il-lejl, u l-infermiera niżżlet dan fin-noti tagħha.
formal.en: The patient coughed repeatedly during the night, and the nurse recorded this in her notes.
formal.zh: 病人在夜间频繁咳嗽，护士将这一情况记入护理记录。

colloquial.zh: 安娜：你爸爸睡得好吗？马克：不好，他咳嗽了一整夜。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A suitcase used to carry clothes and other belongings when travelling; also an individual item of luggage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旅行时装衣物等随身物品的箱子，也可指一件行李。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Valiġġa biex iġġorr il-ħwejjeġ u oġġetti oħra waqt vjaġġ; ukoll biċċa waħda mill-bagalji.

一件行李。
一件行李；行李物件。
专指手提箱或旅行箱。

formal.mt: Kull passiġġier jista' jġib bagalja waħda fuq din il-vettura.
formal.en: Each passenger may bring one item of luggage onto this vehicle.
formal.zh: 每位乘客可以携带一件行李上车。

colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能帮我拿一下这个旅行箱吗？马克：当然。它可真重！

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large travelling trunk or piece of luggage; also the luggage compartment of a vehicle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于旅行的大箱子或大型行李，也指车辆存放行李的后备箱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kaxxa kbira għall-ħwejjeġ u l-oġġetti tal-ivvjaġġar; ukoll il-kompartiment tal-bagalji f'vettura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大衣箱；大型旅行箱。

sense_translations.en_definition: large piece of luggage or baggage
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一件大型行李；大行李箱。
车辆的后备箱；行李厢。

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesebixxi bagoll tal-injam li kien jintuża biex jinġarru l-ħwejjeġ waqt il-vjaġġi.
formal.en: The museum displays a wooden travelling trunk that was used to carry clothes on journeys.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出一只木制大行李箱，过去用于在旅途中装运衣物。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn inpoġġi l-bagalja? David: Fil-bagoll tal-karozza; hemm biżżejjed spazju.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall I put the suitcase? David: In the car's trunk; there's enough room.

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel hatred, strong dislike, or disgust towards someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事怀有憎恨、强烈反感或厌恶。

深恶痛绝；极其厌恶。
极度厌恶；对某人或某事深感反感。
不喜欢；反感。
使人产生憎恨；引起某人的厌恶。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal li jitwieled minn taħlita bejn ħmar u żiemel.

杂种；王八蛋，属于侮辱性称呼。

messages.en: Yes, he behaved like a brute.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“骡子驮货”记住 bagħal 的核心名词义，再把杂交、骂人和不结果实分别做成词卡；动词义另列，避免把同形词义混成一种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dung, especially cow dung.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动物排出的粪便，尤指牛粪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħmieġ tal-annimali, speċjalment tal-baqar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牛粪。
动物的排泄物；动物粪便。
粪；粪便。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ġabar il-bagħar tal-baqar biex jużah bħala fertilizzant fl-għalqa.
formal.en: The farmer collected the cow dung to use it as fertilizer in the field.
formal.zh: 农民收集牛粪，准备把它用作田里的肥料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Oqgħod attent, hemm il-bagħar ħdejn il-bieb. Mark: Rajtu, se ngħaddi min-naħa l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Watch out, there's dung next to the door. Mark: I saw it; I'll go around the other side.
colloquial.zh: Maja：小心，门旁边有粪便。Mark：我看到了，我从另一边绕过去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Oqgħod attent, hemm il-bagħar ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Oqgħod attent, hemm il-bagħar ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 小心，门旁边有粪便。
messages.en: Watch out, there's dung next to the door.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看到了，我从另一边绕过去。
messages.en: I saw it; I'll go around the other side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bagħar 放进农场清理牛粪的画面里，连着 bagħar tal-baqar 一起记，注意它指粪便。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To send a person, an object, or a message to someone or somewhere.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人派往某处，或把物品、信息发送给某人或某地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwassal persuna, oġġett jew messaġġ għand xi ħadd jew lejn xi post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发送；寄送；派遣。
遣走；让某人离开；辞退。
解除某人的职务或职责。
解雇；开除。
发短信；通过短信发送信息。

formal.mt: Is-segretarju bagħat kopja tar-rapport lill-membri kollha tal-kumitat.
formal.en: The secretary sent a copy of the report to every member of the committee.
formal.zh: 秘书向委员会的每位成员发送了一份报告副本。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu bagħat messaġġ dwar il-laqgħa? Mark: Iva, qal li se jasal fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu send a message about the meeting? Mark: Yes, he said he'll arrive at eight.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 发来关于见面的消息了吗？Mark：发了，他说八点到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 发来关于见面的消息了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu send a message about the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qal li se jasal fit-tmienja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qal li se jasal fit-tmienja.
messages.zh: 发了，他说八点到。
messages.en: Yes, he said he'll arrive at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“信寄出去、人派出去、短信发出去”串联 bagħat；遇到职务语境，再联系遣走或解雇的意思。

gloss_zh: 触摸；抚弄；用手指拨弄；乱动

teaching_sense.en_definition: To touch or handle something or someone, including fondling, fingering, or meddling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手触摸或摆弄物品、触碰他人；也可表示抚弄、用手指拨弄或擅自乱动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imiss jew joqgħod imiss xi ħaġa jew lil xi ħadd, jew ibagħbas f'xi ħaġa mingħajr bżonn jew permess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 触摸；碰触。
抚摸；爱抚；抚弄。
用手指触摸、拨弄或摆弄。
擅自乱动；胡乱摆弄；干预不该插手的事。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li xi ħadd bagħbas fl-apparat mingħajr permess.
formal.en: The report indicates that someone tampered with the equipment without permission.
formal.zh: 报告指出，有人未经许可擅自摆弄了设备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi ħadd bagħbas fil-buttuni tar-radju? Mark: Iva, it-tifel kien qed jilgħab bihom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has someone been fiddling with the radio buttons? Mark: Yes, the boy was playing with them.
colloquial.zh: Maja：是不是有人乱按过收音机的按钮？Mark：是啊，那男孩刚才在玩那些按钮。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 是不是有人乱按过收音机的按钮？
messages.en: Has someone been fiddling with the radio buttons?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-tifel kien qed jilgħab bihom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-tifel kien qed jilgħab bihom.
messages.zh: 是啊，那男孩刚才在玩那些按钮。
messages.en: Yes, the boy was playing with them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只手不停摸按钮：bagħbas 的记忆中心是“动手摸弄”，再按语境区分抚弄与擅自乱动。

gloss_zh: 爱动手摸东西或碰人的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who habitually touches things or other people, especially while talking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 习惯伸手摸东西或碰触他人的人，尤其指说话时有这种习惯的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha d-drawwa li tmiss l-oġġetti jew lin-nies, speċjalment waqt li titkellem.

sense_translations.en_definition: one who is given to touching things or people (e.g. while speaking)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱伸手摸东西或碰触他人的人，例如说话时经常碰别人的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: a person who has the habit of touching things or people when talking
sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话时习惯摸东西或碰触他人的人。

collocations.en: someone who is always touching things or people
collocations.zh: 特别爱摸东西或碰人的人

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-karattru huwa deskritt bħala bagħbus li jmiss l-oġġetti ta' madwaru waqt li jitkellem.
formal.en: In the text, the character is described as someone who habitually touches the objects around him while talking.
formal.zh: 文中把这个人物描写成一个说话时习惯摸身边物品的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu bagħbus kbir; waqt li jitkellem joqgħod imissli driegħi. Mark: Għidlu bil-kalma li dan idejqek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu is always touching people; he keeps touching my arm while he talks. Mark: Tell him calmly that it bothers you.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 特别爱碰人，说话时老摸我的胳膊。Mark：平静地告诉他，这让你不舒服。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu bagħbus kbir; waqt li jitkellem joqgħod imissli driegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu bagħbus kbir; waqt li jitkellem joqgħod imissli driegħi.
messages.zh: Pawlu 特别爱碰人，说话时老摸我的胳膊。
messages.en: Pawlu is always touching people; he keeps touching my arm while he talks.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 平静地告诉他，这让你不舒服。
messages.en: Tell him calmly that it bothers you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bagħbus 记成对人的称呼：脑中放一个说话时手总闲不住的人，提醒自己这个词是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A harrier, especially the western marsh harrier.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鹞，一类猛禽；尤指西方泽鹞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-priża tat-tip harrier, speċjalment il-western marsh harrier.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鹞；鹞类猛禽。

sense_translations.en_definition: harrier, especially the western marsh harrier
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鹞，尤指西方泽鹞。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, il-grupp ra bagħdan itir fuq l-għalqa.
formal.en: During the birdwatching session, the group saw a harrier flying over the field.
formal.zh: 观鸟时，小组看到一只鹞从田野上空飞过。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq l-għalqa! Mark: Dak bagħdan; ħares lejh bit-tromba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that bird over the field! Mark: That's a harrier; look at it through the binoculars.
colloquial.zh: Maja：快看田野上空那只鸟！Mark：那是一只鹞，用双筒望远镜看看。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟伙伴)
messages.zh: 快看田野上空那只鸟！
messages.en: Look at that bird over the field!

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟伙伴)
messages.zh: 那是一只鹞，用双筒望远镜看看。
messages.en: That's a harrier; look at it through the binoculars.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 bagħdan 配一张观鸟卡片，正面画飞翔的鹞，背面写“鹞；尤指西方泽鹞”，靠图像对应记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The western marsh harrier, the bird species Circus aeruginosus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 白头鹞，也称西方泽鹞，学名为 Circus aeruginosus 的鸟类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-priża tal-ispeċi Circus aeruginosus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白头鹞；泽鹞，本词条所指的鸟类。
白头鹞（西方泽鹞，学名 Circus aeruginosus）。

collocations.en: he observes a western marsh harrier
a photograph of a western marsh harrier

collocations.zh: 一只正在飞翔的白头鹞

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-osservazzjoni, l-għasfur ġie identifikat bħala bagħdan aħmar, Circus aeruginosus.
formal.en: In the observation report, the bird was identified as a western marsh harrier, Circus aeruginosus.
formal.zh: 在观察报告中，这只鸟被鉴定为白头鹞，学名 Circus aeruginosus。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għasfur hemm f'dan ir-ritratt? Mark: Dak bagħdan aħmar. Maja: Nista' nikteb ismu ħdejn ir-ritratt? Mark: Iva, hekk tiftakru aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What bird is in this photograph? Mark: That's a western marsh harrier. Maja: Can I write its name beside the photograph? Mark: Yes, that will help you remember it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张照片里是什么鸟？Mark：那是一只白头鹞。Maja：我可以把它的名字写在照片旁边吗？Mark：可以，这样更容易记住。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 这张照片里是什么鸟？
messages.en: What bird is in this photograph?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟同伴)
messages.zh: 那是一只白头鹞。
messages.en: That's a western marsh harrier.

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 我可以把它的名字写在照片旁边吗？
messages.en: Can I write its name beside the photograph?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟同伴)
messages.zh: 可以，这样更容易记住。
messages.en: Yes, that will help you remember it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bagħdan aħmar 作为完整鸟名写在白头鹞图片下，再配上 Circus aeruginosus；用同一张图片连接马耳他语、中文和学名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Growing on unirrigated land, or describing a field that is not irrigated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容作物生长在未灌溉的土地上，也形容田地不经灌溉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi għelejjel li jikbru f'art mhux imsaqqija, jew art li ma tissaqqiex.

sense_translations.en_definition: growing on unirrigated land (used of crops)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 生长在未灌溉土地上的；旱作的，用于形容作物。
未经灌溉的；不灌溉的，用于形容田地。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kultivazzjoni tal-qamħ bagħli f'dan ir-reġjun.
formal.en: The report describes the cultivation of wheat without irrigation in this region.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了这一地区旱作小麦的种植情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-qamħ jissaqqa? Mark: Le, dan qamħ bagħli; jiddependi fuq ix-xita.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this wheat irrigated? Mark: No, it's grown without irrigation; it depends on rain.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这片小麦需要灌溉吗？Mark：不，这是旱作小麦，靠下雨。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 这片小麦需要灌溉吗？
messages.en: Is this wheat irrigated?

messages.speaker: Mark (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan qamħ bagħli; jiddependi fuq ix-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan qamħ bagħli; jiddependi fuq ix-xita.
messages.zh: 不，这是旱作小麦，靠下雨。
messages.en: No, it's grown without irrigation; it depends on rain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块没有灌溉水管、等待下雨的麦田，把 bagħli 同时贴在田地和作物上，记住它是形容词。

gloss_zh: 粗暴待人的家伙（骂人用语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An insulting term for a person who treats others abusively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对粗暴、辱骂或欺凌他人的人的侮辱性称呼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma ta' insult għal persuna li ġġib ruħha b'mod abbużiv ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: an insult for an abusive person (from 'bagħal')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 辱骂粗暴待人者的称呼（源自 bagħal）。
粗暴待人、辱骂或欺凌他人的人。

collocations.en: an abusive brute who shouts at people

formal.mt: Fid-djalogu tar-rumanz, il-kelma 'bagħlunazz' tintuża bħala insult għal raġel li jabbuża minn ħaddieħor.
formal.en: In the novel's dialogue, the word 'bagħlunazz' is used as an insult for a man who treats others abusively.
formal.zh: 在小说的对话中，bagħlunazz 被用来辱骂一个粗暴待人的男人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak il-bagħlunazz reġa' beda jgħajjat man-nies. Mark: Ejja nitbiegħdu minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: That abusive brute has started shouting at people again. Mark: Let's move away from here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个粗暴的混蛋又开始冲人吼叫了。Mark：咱们离这儿远一点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-bagħlunazz reġa' beda jgħajjat man-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-bagħlunazz reġa' beda jgħajjat man-nies.
messages.zh: 那个粗暴的混蛋又开始冲人吼叫了。
messages.en: That abusive brute has started shouting at people again.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 咱们离这儿远一点吧。
messages.en: Let's move away from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bagħlunazz 放进有人愤怒指责粗暴者的对白中记忆，并在词卡上标“骂人用语”，保留它的强烈语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk or wade through mud, or to till wet land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在泥中行走或蹚过泥地；也指耕作湿润泥泞的土地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi jew jgħaddi fit-tajn, jew jaħdem art imxarrba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蹚过泥地；在泥中艰难前行。
走过泥地；在泥中行走。
耕作湿地；翻耕潮湿的土地。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita qawwija, il-bidwi bagħtar fit-tajn biex jasal sal-bieb tal-għalqa.
formal.en: After the heavy rain, the farmer waded through the mud to reach the field gate.
formal.zh: 大雨过后，农民蹚过泥地，走到田地的入口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex iż-żraben ta' Pawlu mimlijin tajn? Mark: Għax bagħtar fit-tajn biex iġib il-ballun.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are Pawlu's shoes covered in mud? Mark: Because he waded through the mud to get the ball.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 的鞋怎么沾满了泥？Mark：因为他为了捡球，蹚过了那片泥地。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex iż-żraben ta' Pawlu mimlijin tajn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex iż-żraben ta' Pawlu mimlijin tajn?
messages.zh: Pawlu 的鞋怎么沾满了泥？
messages.en: Why are Pawlu's shoes covered in mud?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax bagħtar fit-tajn biex iġib il-ballun.
messages.mt_standard: Għax bagħtar fit-tajn biex iġib il-ballun.
messages.zh: 因为他为了捡球，蹚过了那片泥地。
messages.en: Because he waded through the mud to get the ball.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鞋子陷进泥里又拔出来，把 bagħtar 与 fit-tajn 一起记；换到农耕语境，再联想到翻耕湿地。

gloss_zh: 使人纵情玩乐；喧闹地尽兴

teaching_sense.en_definition: To draw someone into carefree enjoyment or frivolity, or to enjoy oneself in a lively, boisterous way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使别人投入无拘束的玩乐，或自己热热闹闹地纵情取乐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jintelaq għat-tgawdija jew għad-divertiment ħafif, jew jieħu gost hu stess b'mod storbjuż.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make sb. indulge in enjoyment or frivolity
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人沉浸于享乐或嬉闹。
喧闹地玩乐；热热闹闹地尽兴。

collocations.zh: 和朋友们热热闹闹地玩乐

collocations.en: enjoyed himself boisterously during the celebration
collocations.zh: 在庆祝活动中纵情嬉闹

formal.mt: Wara li temm xogħlu, Pawlu bahrad mal-ħbieb waqt il-festa tar-raħal.
formal.en: After finishing his work, Pawlu enjoyed himself boisterously with his friends during the village celebration.
formal.zh: 完成工作后，Pawlu 在村里的庆祝活动中与朋友们热热闹闹地玩了一场。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif qatta' l-lejla Pawlu? Mark: Bahrad mal-ħbieb; kien hemm ħafna daħk u kant.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Pawlu spend the evening? Mark: He had a boisterous time with his friends; there was lots of laughter and singing.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu 晚上过得怎么样？Mark：他和朋友们玩得很尽兴，大家又笑又唱。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 晚上过得怎么样？
messages.en: How did Pawlu spend the evening?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bahrad mal-ħbieb; kien hemm ħafna daħk u kant.
messages.mt_standard: Bahrad mal-ħbieb; kien hemm ħafna daħk u kant.
messages.zh: 他和朋友们玩得很尽兴，大家又笑又唱。
messages.en: He had a boisterous time with his friends; there was lots of laughter and singing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上聚会中又唱又笑的画面：自己可以纵情嬉闹，也可以带动别人玩乐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Eggs laid by birds, especially those used as food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类所产的蛋，日常尤其指用来食用的蛋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bajd li jbidu l-għasafar, speċjalment dak li jintuża bħala ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蛋，通常指多个蛋或作为食材的蛋。
男性的睾丸，属口语用法。
蛋；一个或多个蛋，具体数量依语境而定。
卵；卵细胞，可指一个或多个。
睾丸。

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, ħabbat il-bajd fi skutella qabel iżżid id-dqiq.
formal.en: For this recipe, beat the eggs in a bowl before adding the flour.
formal.zh: 制作这道食谱时，先在碗中打散鸡蛋，再加入面粉。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid bajd għall-kolazzjon? Mark: Iva, żewġ bajdiet mgħollija, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like eggs for breakfast? Mark: Yes, two boiled eggs, please.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：早餐想吃鸡蛋吗？马克：想，请给我两个水煮蛋。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 早餐想吃鸡蛋吗？
messages.en: Would you like eggs for breakfast?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żewġ bajdiet mgħollija, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żewġ bajdiet mgħollija, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 想，请给我两个水煮蛋。
messages.en: Yes, two boiled eggs, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用早餐盘里的煮蛋和煎蛋记住 bajd；遇到生物学语境可理解为卵，遇到身体部位的口语语境则要辨认睾丸义。

gloss_zh: 略白的；苍白的；幽灵般的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat white or pale in colour, rather than strongly coloured.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色略微发白或显得苍白、色泽较淡的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu lewn kemxejn abjad jew pallidu, b'kulur mhux qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 略白的；泛白的。
苍白的；颜色淡的。
幽灵般的；苍白得如同幽灵的。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun għandu lewn bajdan li jidher aktar ċar taħt dawl naturali.
formal.en: The sample has a whitish hue that is more apparent in natural light.
formal.zh: 样品略微发白的色调在自然光下更加明显。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għażilt dan id-drapp? Nina: Għax għandu lewn bajdan li jogħġobni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you choose this fabric? Nina: Because it has a whitish hue that I like.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你为什么选这块布？妮娜：因为我喜欢它略微发白的色调。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么选这块布？
messages.en: Why did you choose this fabric?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandu lewn bajdan li jogħġobni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandu lewn bajdan li jogħġobni.
messages.zh: 因为我喜欢它略微发白的色调。
messages.en: Because it has a whitish hue that I like.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bajdan 配上“颜色淡到有点发白”的色卡来记：描述物体是泛白，描述面孔是苍白，营造气氛时可有幽灵般的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of sea extending into the land, partly surrounded by the coast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海水向陆地伸入、由海岸部分环绕形成的水域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti mill-baħar li tidħol fl-art u tkun imdawra parzjalment mill-kosta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海湾。

sense_translations.en_definition: bay, bight (roundish recess in the coastline)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 海湾；海岸线向内凹入形成的较圆弧形湾曲。

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi bajja żgħira bejn żewġ promontorji.
formal.en: The map shows a small bay between two headlands.
formal.zh: 地图显示，两处岬角之间有一个小海湾。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn se mmorru ngħumu? David: Hemm bajja żgħira wara dik l-għolja.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where shall we go swimming? David: There's a small bay behind that hill.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们去哪里游泳？戴维：那座小山后面有个小海湾。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去哪里游泳？
messages.en: Where shall we go swimming?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm bajja żgħira wara dik l-għolja.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm bajja żgħira wara dik l-għolja.
messages.zh: 那座小山后面有个小海湾。
messages.en: There's a small bay behind that hill.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画一条向陆地弯进去的海岸线，把弯曲处的海水标成 bajja；用“海岸抱住一湾水”的画面记住海湾义。

gloss_zh: 刷白；粉刷；消化；擦亮；粉刷工；产蛋的；白色土壤

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover a wall or another surface with whitewash or paint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用石灰水或涂料涂刷墙壁等表面，使其刷白或获得涂层。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tiksi ħajt jew wiċċ ieħor bil-ġir jew biż-żebgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用石灰水刷白。

sense_translations.en_definition: to paint (used of walls or other surfaces)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 粉刷；给墙壁或其他表面涂漆。
刷白工；用石灰水粉刷的人。
产蛋的，用于描述家禽。

sense_translations.en_definition: to whitewash, to paint a wall
sense_translations.zh_definition: 刷白；粉刷墙壁。
消化。
擦亮；抛光。
油漆工；粉刷匠；刷白工。
白色土壤。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem bajjad il-ħitan tal-klassi qabel il-bidu tas-sena skolastika.
formal.en: The worker painted the classroom walls before the start of the school year.
formal.zh: 工人在学年开始前粉刷了教室的墙壁。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min bajjad il-kamra? Toni: Ħija. Għamel kollox ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who painted the room? Toni: My brother. He did everything yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：谁粉刷了房间？托尼：我兄弟。他昨天全弄好了。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 谁粉刷了房间？
messages.en: Who painted the room?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 我兄弟。他昨天全弄好了。
messages.en: My brother. He did everything yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“拿刷子粉刷墙壁”记住 bajjad 的教学主义；再把粉刷工、产蛋的、消化、擦亮和白色土壤分别做成语境卡，按词性辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A two-wheeled vehicle that a rider usually moves by pushing pedals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常由骑车人踩动踏板来驱动的两轮交通工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vettura b'żewġ roti li normalment titmexxa minn persuna billi tagħfas il-pedali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自行车；脚踏车。

formal.mt: L-istudent juża l-bajsikil biex imur l-iskola kuljum.
formal.en: The student uses his bicycle to go to school every day.
formal.zh: 这名学生每天骑自行车上学。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif se tmur il-ħanut? Ġużeppi: Bil-bajsikil. Nasal malajr.
colloquial.en: Marta: How are you going to the shop? Ġużeppi: By bicycle. I'll get there quickly.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你怎么去商店？朱塞佩：骑自行车，很快就到。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么去商店？
messages.en: How are you going to the shop?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.zh: 骑自行车，很快就到。
messages.en: By bicycle. I'll get there quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bajsikil 与“踩踏板、两轮转”的动作一起记，再整块练习 bil-bajsikil，表达“骑自行车”这种出行方式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Figs: soft, sweet fruits containing many small seeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无花果，果肉柔软、味甜，内部有许多细小的籽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frott artab u ħelu tas-siġra tat-tin, li fih ħafna żrieragħ żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无花果，指多个果实或这类水果。

formal.mt: Aħsel il-bajtar frisk bil-mod u aqsmu qabel isservih.
formal.en: Wash the fresh figs gently and cut them before serving.
formal.zh: 轻轻洗净新鲜无花果，切开后再上桌。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Trid ftit bajtar frisk? Luqa: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Se nieklu wara l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Marija: Would you like some fresh figs? Luqa: Yes, please. I'll eat them after the meal.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：要一些新鲜无花果吗？卢卡：好的，谢谢。我饭后吃。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 要一些新鲜无花果吗？
messages.en: Would you like some fresh figs?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Se nieklu wara l-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Se nieklu wara l-ikel.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。我饭后吃。
messages.en: Yes, please. I'll eat them after the meal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把无花果切开，里面密密麻麻都是小籽，用这个画面记 bajtar；再用 frisk 和 imqadded 分别记鲜果与果干。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Prickly pear: the fruit of the cactus Opuntia ficus-indica, or the plant itself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仙人掌果，指仙人掌属植物 Opuntia ficus-indica 的果实，也可指该植物本身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-frott tal-kaktus Opuntia ficus-indica, jew il-pjanta nnifisha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仙人掌果；也可指结这种果实的仙人掌植物。
印度无花果，即仙人掌属植物 Opuntia ficus-indica，或其果实。

formal.mt: Qabel ma tiekol il-bajtar tax-xewk, neħħi l-qoxra b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: Before eating prickly pears, carefully remove the skin.
formal.zh: 食用仙人掌果前，要小心去掉果皮。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Dan il-bajtar tax-xewk lest biex jittiekel? Pietru: Iva, diġà neħħejtlu l-qoxra. Ħu ftit.
colloquial.en: Elena: Are these prickly pears ready to eat? Pietru: Yes, I've already peeled them. Have some.
colloquial.zh: 埃琳娜：这些仙人掌果可以直接吃了吗？彼得：可以，我已经去皮了。吃一点吧。

messages.speaker: Elena (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-bajtar tax-xewk lest biex jittiekel?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-bajtar tax-xewk lest biex jittiekel?
messages.zh: 这些仙人掌果可以直接吃了吗？
messages.en: Are these prickly pears ready to eat?

messages.speaker: Pietru (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, diġà neħħejtlu l-qoxra. Ħu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, diġà neħħejtlu l-qoxra. Ħu ftit.
messages.zh: 可以，我已经去皮了。吃一点吧。
messages.en: Yes, I've already peeled them. Have some.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bajtar tax-xewk 整组配上“仙人掌上结着带刺果实”的图片来记；同时练习“成熟果实”和“果酱”两个使用场景。

gloss_zh: 预先行动；抢先；结出当季初果

teaching_sense.en_definition: To anticipate something or be among the first; of a plant, to produce the first fruit of the season.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 预先行动或成为最早的一批；用于植物时，指结出当季最早的果实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel xi ħaġa minn kmieni jew qabel oħrajn; għal pjanta, tagħti l-ewwel frott tal-istaġun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预先想到或采取行动；抢先一步。
成为最早行动或出现的一批。

sense_translations.en_definition: to yield the first fruit of the season
sense_translations.zh_definition: 结出该季最早的果实。
产出初果，即最先成熟的一批果实。

formal.mt: Din is-sena l-ħawħ bakar u ta l-ewwel frott qabel is-soltu.
formal.en: This year the peach tree produced its first fruit earlier than usual.
formal.zh: 今年这棵桃树比往年更早结出了初果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Diġà għandek ħawħ misjur? Pawlu: Iva, il-ħawħ bakar din is-sena. Maja: Mela nistgħu nduquh illum!
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you already have ripe peaches? Pawlu: Yes, the peach tree bore fruit early this year. Maja: Then we can taste them today!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你已经有熟桃子了？保罗：是啊，桃树今年结果早。玛雅：那我们今天就能尝尝了！

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 你已经有熟桃子了？
messages.en: Do you already have ripe peaches?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (果园主人)
messages.zh: 是啊，桃树今年结果早。
messages.en: Yes, the peach tree bore fruit early this year.

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 那我们今天就能尝尝了！
messages.en: Then we can taste them today!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bakar 配上“抢先一步”的画面：人先行动，果树先结果；用同一个“早”字串起这些义项。

gloss_zh: 早起；提早开始；惯常早起的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get up early or to begin an activity early.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 早起，或为了做某事而提早开始。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qam kmieni jew beda attività kmieni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 早起；很早起床。
提早开始；早早着手或出发。

sense_translations.en_definition: someone who habitually wakes up early
sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯常早起的人；有早醒习惯的人。
早起；提早起床。

collocations.en: he got an early start for work
he got up early to study
he got up early every day

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur bakkar biex iħejji l-materjal qabel il-bidu tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: The researcher got up early to prepare the material before the meeting began.
formal.zh: 研究员早早起床，以便在会议开始前准备好材料。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif lestejt kollox daqshekk kmieni? Mark: Illum bakkart biex naħdem fil-kwiet. Anna: Jien għadni kemm qomt! Mark: Jien inħobb nibda l-ġurnata kmieni.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did you finish everything so early? Mark: I got up early today to work in peace. Anna: I've only just got up! Mark: I like starting the day early.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你怎么这么早就把事情都做完了？Mark：我今天早起，好安安静静地工作。Anna：我才刚起床呢！Mark：我喜欢早点开始一天的生活。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 你怎么这么早就把事情都做完了？
messages.en: How did you finish everything so early?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我今天早起，好安安静静地工作。
messages.en: I got up early today to work in peace.

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 我才刚起床呢！
messages.en: I've only just got up!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我喜欢早点开始一天的生活。
messages.en: I like starting the day early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用清晨闹钟画面记 bakkar：动作卡写“早起、提早开始”，人物卡写“惯常早起的人”。同一拼写要按动词和名词分别记忆。

gloss_zh: 咿呀乱说；说些不知所云的话

teaching_sense.en_definition: To babble or speak in a confused, unintelligible way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 咿呀地说话，或杂乱地说出让人听不明白的话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titkellem b'mod imħawwad jew tgħid kliem li ma jinftihemx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咿呀说话；含混而杂乱地说个不停。
说些让人听不懂或不知所云的话。
叽里咕噜地乱说；含混不清地说话。

collocations.zh: 含混地说些没有意义的话

formal.mt: Waqt il-logħba, it-tifel balbal kliem bla sens u daħak.
formal.en: During the game, the boy babbled meaningless words and laughed.
formal.zh: 游戏时，男孩咿呀乱说着没有意义的话，还笑了起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fhimt x'qal Leo? Mark: Le, balbal u ma fhimt xejn. Maja: Se nitolbu jerġa' jgħidha bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you understand what Leo said? Mark: No, he babbled and I didn't understand anything. Maja: I'll ask him to say it again slowly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听懂利奥说什么了吗？马克：没有，他叽里咕噜地说，我什么也没听懂。玛雅：我请他再慢慢说一遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听懂利奥说什么了吗？
messages.en: Did you understand what Leo said?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, balbal u ma fhimt xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, balbal u ma fhimt xejn.
messages.zh: 没有，他叽里咕噜地说，我什么也没听懂。
messages.en: No, he babbled and I didn't understand anything.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我请他再慢慢说一遍。
messages.en: I'll ask him to say it again slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 balbal 的重复字形想成嘴里反复“巴拉巴拉”，提醒自己这里强调话语含混或不知所云；这只是记忆联想。

gloss_zh: 马耳他番茄炒蛋；乱糟糟的局面

teaching_sense.en_definition: A traditional Maltese dish of eggs scrambled with tomatoes and onions; also, a mess.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种用番茄、洋葱和鸡蛋炒成的马耳他传统菜；也可指一团糟的事物或局面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Platt tradizzjonali Malti ta' bajd imħawwad mat-tadam u l-basal; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll taħwid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用鸡蛋和番茄炒成的一道菜。

sense_translations.en_definition: A traditional Maltese dish featuring scrambled eggs cooked with tomatoes and onions.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种马耳他传统菜，以鸡蛋配番茄和洋葱炒制而成。
一团糟；混乱或杂乱的状态。

collocations.en: scrambled eggs with tomatoes and onions

collocations.zh: 配面包吃的热番茄炒蛋

collocations.en: made a mess of the work

formal.mt: Għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar, ġiet servuta balbuljata bit-tadam u l-basal, flimkien ma' ħobż frisk.
formal.en: For lunch, balbuljata made with tomatoes and onions was served with fresh bread.
formal.zh: 午餐供应了用番茄和洋葱炒成的马耳他炒蛋，并配有新鲜面包。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'se nieklu llum? Anna: Għamilt balbuljata bit-tadam u l-basal. Mark: Tajjeb! Inġib il-ħobż?
colloquial.en: Mark: What are we eating today? Anna: I made balbuljata with tomatoes and onions. Mark: Great! Shall I get the bread?
colloquial.zh: 马克：今天吃什么？安娜：我做了番茄洋葱炒蛋。马克：好啊！我去拿面包吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 今天吃什么？
messages.en: What are we eating today?

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.zh: 我做了番茄洋葱炒蛋。
messages.en: I made balbuljata with tomatoes and onions.

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 好啊！我去拿面包吗？
messages.en: Great! Shall I get the bread?

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记一锅番茄、洋葱和鸡蛋炒在一起的 balbuljata，再另记“事情混成一团”的乱局义；这是联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fool around or mess about instead of doing something seriously.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 瞎闹、胡混，或不认真地做事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaddi l-ħin tilgħab jew tagħmel affarijiet bla serjetà minflok taħdem bis-serjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瞎闹；不认真做事。
胡混；漫不经心地瞎折腾。

formal.mt: Matul il-ħin tal-istudju, l-istudent ballas minflok lesta l-eżerċizzji.
formal.en: During study time, the student fooled around instead of finishing the exercises.
formal.zh: 自习期间，这名学生只顾瞎闹，没有完成练习。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Leo lesta x-xogħol? Mark: Le, ballas mal-ħbieb il-ħin kollu. Sara: Mela għad għandu ħafna x'jagħmel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Leo finish the work? Mark: No, he messed about with his friends the whole time. Sara: Then he still has a lot to do.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：利奥把活干完了吗？马克：没有，他一直和朋友瞎闹。萨拉：那他还有很多事要做。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 利奥把活干完了吗？
messages.en: Did Leo finish the work?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 没有，他一直和朋友瞎闹。
messages.en: No, he messed about with his friends the whole time.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 那他还有很多事要做。
messages.en: Then he still has a lot to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ballas 放进“作业还没动，人却一直瞎闹”的画面，记住它描述不认真做事或胡混的动作。

gloss_zh: 捶打；砸平；夯实；持木槌捶打的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pound or beat something down so that it becomes flatter or more firmly packed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过反复捶打，使物体变平或使土壤等变得紧实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħabbat xi ħaġa bis-saħħa biex tagħmilha ċatta jew trossha, bħalma jsir bil-ħamrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力捶打；反复砸打。
弄平；砸平。

sense_translations.en_definition: to pack by beating down (e.g. used of earth or soil)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过捶打或夯打使其紧实，例如夯实泥土或土壤。

sense_translations.en_definition: one who pounds sth. with a beetle (a type of wooden tool). This expression is often used in the context of traditional roof-surfacing using crushed potsherds
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用一种木制夯槌捶打物料的人；常用于以碎陶片铺设传统屋顶表面的语境。
向下捶打；用力砸打。
用反复向下捶打的方式压紧或夯实。

collocations.en: pounded the ground with a mallet

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ballat il-ħamrija b'mazza biex il-wiċċ isir ċatt u sod.
formal.en: The worker pounded the soil with a mallet to make the surface flat and firm.
formal.zh: 工人用槌子夯打土壤，使表面平整而坚实。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex din il-ħamrija daqshekk iebsa? Pawlu: Mark ballat il-ħamrija dalgħodu. Maja: Issa nifhem għaliex il-wiċċ hu ċatt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this soil so hard? Pawlu: Mark pounded the soil down this morning. Maja: Now I understand why the surface is flat.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这块土怎么这么硬？保罗：马克今天早上把土夯实了。玛雅：现在我明白表面为什么这么平了。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 这块土怎么这么硬？
messages.en: Why is this soil so hard?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.zh: 马克今天早上把土夯实了。
messages.en: Mark pounded the soil down this morning.

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa nifhem għaliex il-wiċċ hu ċatt.
messages.mt_standard: Issa nifhem għaliex il-wiċċ hu ċatt.
messages.zh: 现在我明白表面为什么这么平了。
messages.en: Now I understand why the surface is flat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象木槌一下一下落地：动作是捶打，结果是变平、变实；另用人物卡记住同形名词指持木槌捶打的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A weasel; in a separate fish sense, a rockling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼬，一种体形细长的小型哺乳动物；另一个独立义项指英语称为 rockling 的鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir b'ġisem twil u saqajn qosra; f'tifsira oħra, ħuta magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala rockling.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼬；一种身体细长、腿短的小型哺乳动物。
rockling 鱼；此处是鱼类名称，与表示鼬的义项分开理解。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, dehret ballottra żgħira tiċċaqlaq fil-ħaxix.
formal.en: During the observation, a small weasel was seen moving through the grass.
formal.zh: 观察时，人们看见一只小鼬在草丛中穿行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt dak l-annimal fil-ħaxix? Mark: Iva, kienet ballottra. Sara: Kemm ġriet malajr!
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you see that animal in the grass? Mark: Yes, it was a weasel. Sara: It ran so fast!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看到草丛里那只动物了吗？马克：看到了，是一只鼬。萨拉：它跑得真快！

messages.speaker: Sara (散步者)
messages.zh: 你看到草丛里那只动物了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that animal in the grass?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，是一只鼬。
messages.en: Yes, it was a weasel.

messages.speaker: Sara (散步者)
messages.zh: 它跑得真快！
messages.en: It ran so fast!

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 ballottra 做两张图卡：一张画草中的鼬，一张画标有 rockling 的鱼；同词分图，靠上下文选择义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A round object used in games and sports, for example for kicking, throwing, or catching.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 游戏或运动中使用的球形物体，例如用来踢、投掷或接住的球。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett tond li jintuża fil-logħob u fl-isport, pereżempju biex tagħtih bis-sieq, titfgħu jew taqbdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 球；用于游戏或运动的球形物体。

formal.mt: Qabel il-logħba, l-għalliem poġġa ballun tal-futbol f'nofs il-grawnd.
formal.en: Before the game, the teacher placed a football in the middle of the pitch.
formal.zh: 比赛开始前，老师把一个足球放在球场中央。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-ballun? Leo: Taħt il-bank. Maja: Ġibu ħalli nilagħbu!
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the ball? Leo: Under the bench. Maja: Bring it so we can play!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：球在哪儿？利奥：在长凳下面。玛雅：拿过来，我们一起玩！

messages.speaker: Maja (玩伴)
messages.zh: 球在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is the ball?

messages.speaker: Leo (玩伴)
messages.zh: 在长凳下面。
messages.en: Under the bench.

messages.speaker: Maja (玩伴)
messages.zh: 拿过来，我们一起玩！
messages.en: Bring it so we can play!

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ballun 就想象一个在地上滚动的球，再配合“扔球、接球、踢球”的动作练习，把名词和使用场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An oak tree, including the holm oak, Quercus ilex; also, oak wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 橡树，也可特指冬青栎（Quercus ilex）；还可指橡木这种木材。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġra tal-ballut, fosthom il-balluta magħrufa bħala Quercus ilex; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għall-injam tal-ballut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 橡树；栎树。
橡木；橡树的木材。
冬青栎，学名 Quercus ilex。
橡树或橡木，具体指树还是木材须看上下文。

formal.mt: Il-mejda tal-qari hija magħmula mill-injam tal-ballut.
formal.en: The reading table is made of oak wood.
formal.zh: 这张阅览桌由橡木制成。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din il-mejda tal-ballut? Mark: Iva, għamilha n-nannu. Anna: Kemm hi sabiħa!
colloquial.en: Anna: Is this table made of oak? Mark: Yes, Grandpa made it. Anna: It's so beautiful!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这张桌子是橡木做的吗？马克：是啊，是爷爷做的。安娜：真漂亮！

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.zh: 这张桌子是橡木做的吗？
messages.en: Is this table made of oak?

messages.speaker: Mark (主人)
messages.zh: 是啊，是爷爷做的。
messages.en: Yes, Grandpa made it.

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.zh: 真漂亮！
messages.en: It's so beautiful!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ballut 连成“树木—木料—桌子”三幅图，分别记橡树与橡木；再单独配上冬青栎的学名卡，避免混淆泛称与具体树种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A soothing balm or balsam; figuratively, something that brings emotional comfort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于涂抹的舒缓香膏或香脂；也比喻能安抚心情、带来慰藉的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li tintuża bħala ingwent biex ittaffi; figurattivament, xi ħaġa li tagħti faraġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 香膏；具有舒缓作用的涂抹用膏剂。
香膏；香脂。
慰藉；使人心情得到安抚的事物。

formal.mt: Il-kliem ta' appoġġ kien balzmu għal qalbha f'dak il-mument diffiċli.
formal.en: The words of support were a balm to her heart at that difficult moment.
formal.zh: 在那个艰难的时刻，支持的话语给了她心灵上的慰藉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek balzmu għall-ġilda? Rita: Iva, qiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have any skin balm? Rita: Yes, it's on the shelf.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你有护肤香膏吗？Rita：有，在架子上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有护肤香膏吗？
messages.en: Do you have any skin balm?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，在架子上。
messages.en: Yes, it's on the shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 balzmu 想成一罐香膏：涂在皮肤上帮助舒缓，用在比喻里则安抚心灵；用“皮肤”和“心”两个画面记住实义与引申义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Maltese variety of pear known as the June pear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他的一种梨，称为六月梨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Varjetà ta' lanġas Malti magħrufa bħala l-lanġas ta' Ġunju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他六月梨。

sense_translations.en_definition: Maltese June pear (Pyrus communis var. bambinella)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他六月梨（Pyrus communis var. bambinella）。

collocations.zh: 一颗成熟的马耳他六月梨

collocations.en: the taste of the Maltese June pear

formal.mt: Il-bambinella hija varjetà ta' lanġas Malti magħrufa bħala l-lanġas ta' Ġunju.
formal.en: The bambinella is a Maltese pear variety known as the June pear.
formal.zh: bambinella 是马耳他的一种梨，称为六月梨。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-bambinella misjura? Pawlu: Iva, tista' tikolha issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this June pear ripe? Pawlu: Yes, you can eat it now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这颗六月梨熟了吗？Pawlu：熟了，现在就可以吃。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这颗六月梨熟了吗？
messages.en: Is this June pear ripe?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (水果摊主)
messages.zh: 熟了，现在就可以吃。
messages.en: Yes, you can eat it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在六月的日历旁画一颗梨，并标上 bambinella；把“马耳他、六月、梨”三个提示一起记，不要只记成泛指的梨。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A banana, the fruit that is peeled before eating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 香蕉，一种通常剥皮后食用的水果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta li titqaxxar qabel ma tittiekel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 香蕉。
香蕉，指水果。

formal.mt: Għall-kolazzjon, kull parteċipant irċieva banana u tazza ilma.
formal.en: For breakfast, each participant received a banana and a glass of water.
formal.zh: 早餐时，每位参与者都领到了一根香蕉和一杯水。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid banana? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Għandi l-ġuħ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Would you like a banana? Mark: Yes, please. I'm hungry.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你想吃根香蕉吗？Mark：想，谢谢。我饿了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想吃根香蕉吗？
messages.en: Would you like a banana?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。我饿了。
messages.en: Yes, please. I'm hungry.

cognitive_memory_aid: banana 的拼写与英语 banana 相同，可直接联想香蕉；再把 qoxra tal-banana 和香蕉皮的画面配对，连同常用搭配一起记。

gloss_zh: 禁止；排斥；放逐；一边；角度；乐队；管乐队

teaching_sense.en_definition: To ban or exclude someone, including ostracising them from a group or sending them into exile.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 禁止或排除某人，包括将其排斥在群体之外，或将其放逐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ipprojbixxa jew eskluda lil xi ħadd, warrbu minn grupp jew bagħtu fl-eżilju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 禁止；不准参与或进入。
排斥；使某人受到群体的孤立。
放逐；流放；迫使某人离开其所属的地方。
一边；一侧；某个方向或方面。
角度；看待问题的立场或观点。
乐队；共同演奏音乐的一组人。
合奏团；由多名演奏者组成的音乐团体。
铜管乐队；以铜管乐器演奏为主的乐队。

collocations.en: from the other side of the street
from another perspective; on the other hand
collocations.zh: 从另一个角度看；另一方面

formal.mt: Il-kumitat banda lill-membru mill-għaqda wara ksur serju tar-regoli.
formal.en: The committee banned the member from the association after a serious breach of the rules.
formal.zh: 该成员严重违反规章后，委员会禁止其继续参与协会。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se ddoqq il-banda llejla? David: Fil-pjazza, mill-banda l-oħra tat-triq. Lara: Immorru nisimgħuha? David: Iva, niltaqgħu hemm fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the band playing tonight? David: In the square, on the other side of the street. Lara: Shall we go and listen? David: Yes, let's meet there at eight.
colloquial.zh: Lara：乐队今晚在哪里演奏？David：在街道另一边的广场上。Lara：我们去听听吧？David：好，我们八点在那里见。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 乐队今晚在哪里演奏？
messages.en: Where is the band playing tonight?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 在街道另一边的广场上。
messages.en: In the square, on the other side of the street.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去听听吧？
messages.en: Shall we go and listen?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我们八点在那里见。
messages.en: Yes, let's meet there at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 banda 分开画三组记忆卡：动词画“禁止、排斥、放逐”，方位名词画“一边、看问题的角度”，音乐名词画“乐队、合奏团、铜管乐队”。这些只是分类助记，不表示它们具有共同词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To swing or rock something, moving it repeatedly from side to side or back and forth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物反复左右或前后摇动、摆动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċaqlaq xi ħaġa ripetutament minn naħa għal oħra jew 'il quddiem u lura.

sense_translations.en_definition: to rock from side to side
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使左右摇动。
使摆动；摇摆。
使摆动；摇动。

formal.mt: Il-missier bandal il-benniena bil-mod sakemm it-tarbija raqdet.
formal.en: The father gently rocked the cradle until the baby fell asleep.
formal.zh: 父亲轻轻摇着摇篮，直到婴儿睡着。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Bandal il-benniena bil-mod, jekk jogħġbok. David: Hekk sew? Ara, it-tarbija qed torqod.
colloquial.en: Rita: Rock the cradle gently, please. David: Is this all right? Look, the baby is falling asleep.
colloquial.zh: Rita：请轻轻摇一下摇篮。David：这样可以吗？看，宝宝快睡着了。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 请轻轻摇一下摇篮。
messages.en: Rock the cradle gently, please.

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Hekk sew? Ara, it-tarbija qed torqod.
messages.mt_standard: Hekk sew? Ara, it-tarbija qed torqod.
messages.zh: 这样可以吗？看，宝宝快睡着了。
messages.en: Is this all right? Look, the baby is falling asleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 bandal 时，用手做来回摇摇篮的动作，把词和“反复摆动”绑定；与名词 bandla 对照，分别记住动作和秋千这个物件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flag or banner displaying colours, a symbol, or a message.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 展示颜色、标志或文字的旗帜或横幅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp b'kuluri, simbolu jew kliem, li tittella' jew tintwera bħala sinjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旗；旗帜。
横幅；标语旗帜。

formal.mt: Fil-bidu taċ-ċerimonja, l-istudenti tellgħu l-bandiera ta' Malta.
formal.en: At the beginning of the ceremony, the students raised the flag of Malta.
formal.zh: 仪式开始时，学生们升起了马耳他国旗。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn inpoġġu l-bandiera? Toni: Ħdejn il-bieb, biex jaraha kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall we put the flag? Toni: By the door, so everyone can see it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们把旗放在哪里？Toni：放在门旁边，这样大家都能看见。

messages.speaker: Sara (活动志愿者)
messages.zh: 我们把旗放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we put the flag?

messages.speaker: Toni (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 放在门旁边，这样大家都能看见。
messages.en: By the door, so everyone can see it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bandiera 写在一面迎风展开的旗上，再配动作 ittella' l-bandiera“升旗”；用旗帜的画面和升旗的动作共同帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hanging seat that swings back and forth; also a pendulum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 悬挂着、可以来回摆动的座椅，即秋千；也可指摆锤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sedil imdendel li jitbandal 'il quddiem u lura; ukoll pendlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 秋千。
秋千，指悬挂着的座椅。
摆锤；钟摆。

formal.mt: Il-bandla fil-park ġiet spezzjonata qabel ma nfetħet iż-żona tal-logħob.
formal.en: The swing in the park was inspected before the play area opened.
formal.zh: 游乐区开放前，公园里的秋千经过了检查。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Nista' noqgħod fuq il-bandla? Marija: Iva, żomm sew il-ħbula.
colloquial.en: Lina: Can I sit on the swing? Marija: Yes, hold the ropes firmly.
colloquial.zh: Lina：我可以坐秋千吗？Marija：可以，抓紧绳子。

messages.speaker: Lina (女儿)
messages.zh: 我可以坐秋千吗？
messages.en: Can I sit on the swing?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 可以，抓紧绳子。
messages.en: Yes, hold the ropes firmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bandla 联想成来回摆动的秋千，再把同样的摆动画面缩小成钟摆；用共同的运动形象串联两个名词义，不把它当成动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bath, meaning washing or soaking in water, or the tub used for it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 洗澡或泡澡这一活动；也指供洗澡使用的浴缸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħasil jew it-tixrib tal-ġisem fl-ilma, jew il-vaska li tintuża għal dan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洗澡；泡澡。
浴缸；洗澡用的缸。

formal.mt: Qabel tieħu banju, iċċekkja t-temperatura tal-ilma.
formal.en: Before taking a bath, check the water temperature.
formal.zh: 洗澡前，请检查水温。

colloquial.mt: Ben: L-ilma fil-banju għadu sħun? Anna: Iva, tista' tieħu banju issa.
colloquial.en: Ben: Is the water in the bathtub still warm? Anna: Yes, you can take a bath now.
colloquial.zh: Ben：浴缸里的水还热吗？Anna：还热，现在可以洗澡。

messages.speaker: Ben (丈夫)
messages.zh: 浴缸里的水还热吗？
messages.en: Is the water in the bathtub still warm?

messages.speaker: Anna (妻子)
messages.zh: 还热，现在可以洗澡。
messages.en: Yes, you can take a bath now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个连续画面记 banju：先往浴缸放水，再进去泡澡；timla l-banju 对应容器，tieħu banju 对应洗澡活动。

gloss_zh: 银行；长凳；水下浅滩；柜台；工作台；法官席

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bank as a financial institution or its building; depending on context, also a bench, an underwater bank, a business counter, a worktable, or a judge's seat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 银行机构或其建筑；依语境也可指长凳、水下浅滩、营业柜台、工作台或法官席。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Istituzzjoni finanzjarja jew il-bini tagħha; skont il-kuntest, ukoll sedil twil, art taħt l-ilma ogħla minn ta' madwarha, mejda ta' ħanut jew tax-xogħol, jew is-sedil tal-imħallef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 银行。
长凳；供人坐的长座椅。
银行，指金融机构或其营业建筑。

sense_translations.en_definition: bank (an underwater area of higher elevation, a sandbank)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 水下浅滩；沙洲，指比周围水底地势高的区域。

sense_translations.en_definition: counter (table or board on which business is transacted)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 柜台；进行交易或办理业务的台面。
工作台；用于进行作业的桌台。
法官席；法官审理案件时就座的位置。

formal.mt: Il-klijent ippreżenta d-dokumenti meħtieġa biex jiftaħ kont fil-bank.
formal.en: The customer submitted the required documents to open a bank account.
formal.zh: 客户提交了在银行开户所需的文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-bank vojt? Karl: Iva, ejja noqogħdu hawn u nistrieħu ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this bench free? Karl: Yes, let's sit here and rest for a bit.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张长凳没人坐吗？Karl：没人，我们坐这里休息一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张长凳没人坐吗？
messages.en: Is this bench free?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja noqogħdu hawn u nistrieħu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja noqogħdu hawn u nistrieħu ftit.
messages.zh: 没人，我们坐这里休息一会儿吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's sit here and rest for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bank 做成六张情境卡：银行账户、公园长凳、水下沙洲、商店柜台、工作台和法官席。读句子时先看周围词，用 kont、park、ramel 等线索选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large, formal meal held to celebrate an occasion or honour guests.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为庆祝某个场合或款待宾客而举行的正式大型宴席。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikla kbira u formali organizzata biex tiġi ċċelebrata okkażjoni jew jingħata ġieħ lill-mistednin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宴会；通常为庆祝活动或款待宾客而举行的正式宴席。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat organizza bankett biex jiċċelebra l-ħamsin anniversarju tal-għaqda.
formal.en: The committee organised a banquet to celebrate the association's fiftieth anniversary.
formal.zh: 委员会举办了一场宴会，庆祝协会成立五十周年。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tmur għall-bankett tat-tieġ? Mark: Iva, u se noqgħod fuq il-mejda ħdejn il-familja tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to the wedding banquet? Mark: Yes, and I'll sit at the table next to your family.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你会去参加婚宴吗？Mark：会，我会坐在你家人旁边那桌。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你会去参加婚宴吗？
messages.en: Are you going to the wedding banquet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u se noqgħod fuq il-mejda ħdejn il-familja tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u se noqgħod fuq il-mejda ħdejn il-familja tiegħek.
messages.zh: 会，我会坐在你家人旁边那桌。
messages.en: Yes, and I'll sit at the table next to your family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bankett 放进婚宴场景：长桌、宾客、正式上菜，一起帮助记住“宴会”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The paved area beside a road where people walk, or the raised edge separating it from the road.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 道路旁供行人步行的铺装区域，也可指它与车行道之间的路缘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti pavimentata maġenb triq fejn jimxu n-nies, jew ix-xifer tagħha li jifridha mit-triq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人行道；道路旁供行人行走的铺装路面。
路缘，或道路旁供行人步行的人行道。

formal.mt: Il-bankina għandha tinżamm ħielsa minn ostakli biex il-persuni mexjin ikunu jistgħu jgħaddu b'mod sigur.
formal.en: The pavement should be kept clear of obstacles so that pedestrians can pass safely.
formal.zh: 人行道应保持畅通，不得堆放障碍物，以便行人安全通行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn nistennew ix-xarabank? Pawlu: Fuq il-bankina, ħdejn it-tabella tal-waqfa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where do we wait for the bus? Pawlu: On the pavement, next to the bus stop sign.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们在哪里等公交车？Pawlu：在人行道上，公交站牌旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里等公交车？
messages.en: Where do we wait for the bus?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 在人行道上，公交站牌旁边。
messages.en: On the pavement, next to the bus stop sign.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象等公交时站在人行道上，再看脚边凸起的路缘，用同一幅画面记住 bankina 的两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To state something repeatedly and firmly in order to insist that it is true or important.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以坚定的语气反复陈述某件事，强调其真实性或重要性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid xi ħaġa kemm-il darba b'mod sod biex jinsisti li hija vera jew importanti.

sense_translations.en_definition: to repeat something in an assertive manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以坚定、强调的语气反复说某件事。
一再断言；反复坚称。

collocations.en: he repeatedly insisted that he was right
collocations.zh: 他一再坚称自己是对的

collocations.en: he repeated the same thing assertively

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, ir-rappreżentant bannas li s-sigurtà tal-ħaddiema kellha tingħata prijorità.
formal.en: During the meeting, the representative repeatedly insisted that workers' safety should be given priority.
formal.zh: 会议期间，代表一再强调，应优先保障工人的安全。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qal Mark dwar il-ħin tal-laqgħa? Sara: Bannas li kellna nkunu hemm fit-tmienja, u qalha tliet darbiet!
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Mark say about the meeting time? Sara: He kept insisting that we had to be there at eight, and he said it three times!
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 对开会时间说了什么？Sara：他一再强调我们八点必须到，还说了三遍！

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: Mark 对开会时间说了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark say about the meeting time?

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Bannas li kellna nkunu hemm fit-tmienja, u qalha tliet darbiet!
messages.mt_standard: Bannas li kellna nkunu hemm fit-tmienja, u qalha tliet darbiet!
messages.zh: 他一再强调我们八点必须到，还说了三遍！
messages.en: He kept insisting that we had to be there at eight, and he said it three times!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时想象一个人坚定地把同一句话说三遍：bannas 同时包含“重复”和“坚称”的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a plant to develop or put out a stem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物长出茎部或抽出新的茎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal pjanta meta tiżviluppa zokk jew toħroġ zokk ġdid.

sense_translations.en_definition: to sprout a stem (used of plants)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 抽茎；指植物萌发并长出茎。
生出茎；长出茎部。

collocations.en: the sunflower put out a stem
it put out a stem in spring

formal.mt: Wara ġimagħtejn ta' osservazzjoni, il-ġirasol bannat u kompla jikber fid-dawl.
formal.en: After two weeks of observation, the sunflower put out a stem and continued growing in the light.
formal.zh: 观察两周后，向日葵长出了茎，并继续在光照下生长。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Il-ġirasol li ħawwilt kiber? Pawlu: Iva, bannat! Ejja ara z-zokk żgħir.
colloquial.en: Lina: Has the sunflower you planted grown? Pawlu: Yes, it has put out a stem! Come and look at the little stem.
colloquial.zh: Lina：你种的向日葵长大了吗？Pawlu：长了，已经抽茎了！来看看这根小茎。

messages.speaker: Lina (邻居)
messages.zh: 你种的向日葵长大了吗？
messages.en: Has the sunflower you planted grown?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bannat! Ejja ara z-zokk żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bannat! Ejja ara z-zokk żgħir.
messages.zh: 长了，已经抽茎了！来看看这根小茎。
messages.en: Yes, it has put out a stem! Come and look at the little stem.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bannat 配上一张植物成长图，特别圈出新长出的茎，记住重点是“抽茎”这一步。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remain in a place or state, or to continue an action; in some constructions, to agree on an arrangement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 留在某处或保持某种状态，也可表示持续做某事；在某些结构中表示商定安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibqa' f'post jew fi stat, jew ikompli jagħmel xi ħaġa; f'ċerti kostruzzjonijiet jintuża wkoll biex jesprimi ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 留下；继续处于原来的位置或状态。
停留；待在某处。
继续进行；接着做下去。
持续；坚持不停止。
留下；停留；保持原来的处境。
达成一致；商定某项安排。

sense_translations.en_definition: Used with a following active participle to convey a continuous action
sense_translations.zh_definition: 后接主动分词，表示某个动作持续进行。

sense_translations.en_definition: Used with an intransitive verb in the imperfect to convey a habitual or repeated action
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与未完成式的不及物动词连用，表示习惯性或反复发生的动作。

sense_translations.en_definition: Used with a transitive verb in the imperfect to convey a continuous action
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与未完成式的及物动词连用，表示持续进行某个动作。

formal.mt: Wara li ntemmet il-laqgħa, ir-riċerkatur baqa' jaħdem fuq ir-rapport sakemm lestieh.
formal.en: After the meeting ended, the researcher continued working on the report until he finished it.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，研究员继续撰写报告，直到完成为止。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark telaq? Sara: Le, baqa' hawn jistenna lil ħuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Mark left? Sara: No, he stayed here waiting for his brother.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 走了吗？Sara：没有，他留在这里等他兄弟。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 走了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark left?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, baqa' hawn jistenna lil ħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Le, baqa' hawn jistenna lil ħuh.
messages.zh: 没有，他留在这里等他兄弟。
messages.en: No, he stayed here waiting for his brother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“人留下，动作继续”记住 baqa'：人在原地是停留，后面接动作则常表示一直做下去；约定义另配见面场景记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For milk to form curds, or to cause milk to coagulate into curds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指奶液凝结成凝乳，或使奶液发生这种凝结。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għall-ħalib meta jagħqad u jifforma l-baqta, jew għall-azzjoni li ġġiegħel il-ħalib jagħqad.

sense_translations.en_definition: to curdle (used in a dairy context)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 凝结成凝乳；用于奶或乳制品加工的语境。
使奶凝结成凝乳，或指奶本身凝结。

collocations.mt: baqat wara li żdied il-meraq tal-lumi
collocations.en: it curdled after lemon juice was added
collocations.zh: 它在加入柠檬汁后凝结了

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni, il-ħalib baqat wara li żdied miegħu l-meraq tal-lumi.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the milk curdled after lemon juice was added to it.
formal.zh: 演示过程中，奶在加入柠檬汁后凝结成了凝乳。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex il-ħalib sar hekk? Anna: Baqat wara li żidt il-lumi; ara l-biċċiet żgħar li ffurmaw.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why has the milk turned like this? Anna: It curdled after I added the lemon; look at the little lumps that formed.
colloquial.zh: Mark：奶怎么变成这样了？Anna：我加了柠檬后，它就凝结了；看看形成的这些小块。

messages.speaker: Mark (烹饪学员)
messages.zh: 奶怎么变成这样了？
messages.en: Why has the milk turned like this?

messages.speaker: Anna (烹饪教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Baqat wara li żidt il-lumi; ara l-biċċiet żgħar li ffurmaw.
messages.mt_standard: Baqat wara li żidt il-lumi; ara l-biċċiet żgħar li ffurmaw.
messages.zh: 我加了柠檬后，它就凝结了；看看形成的这些小块。
messages.en: It curdled after I added the lemon; look at the little lumps that formed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象往奶里加柠檬汁，奶液出现小凝块，用这个可见变化记住 baqat 的“凝乳”含义。

gloss_zh: 冒泡；咕嘟作响；沸腾；激怒；咿呀作声；喋喋不休

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bubble, gurgle or boil; also to make cooing sounds, chatter, or get someone worked up and angry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指液体冒泡、咕嘟作响或沸腾，也可指发出咿呀声、喋喋不休，或使人激动生气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel il-bżieżaq jew ħoss ta' likwidu jagħli; jista' jfisser ukoll li jagħmel ħsejjes ta' tarbija, iparla ħafna, jew iqanqal ir-rabja ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冒泡；产生或冒出气泡。
发出咕噜或咕嘟声。
沸腾；煮沸。

sense_translations.en_definition: to get sb. worked up and angry
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人情绪激动并生气；激怒某人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to bubble up, to boil violently
sense_translations.zh_definition: 翻涌冒泡；剧烈沸腾。
发出轻柔的咕咕声或咿呀声，尤指婴儿发声。
叽叽喳喳地说话；喋喋不休。

collocations.zh: 小男孩高兴地咿呀作声

formal.mt: Meta t-temperatura telgħet, il-likwidu baqbaq u dehru bżieżaq kbar fuq il-wiċċ.
formal.en: When the temperature rose, the liquid bubbled and large bubbles appeared on the surface.
formal.zh: 温度升高时，液体开始咕嘟冒泡，表面出现了大气泡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien dak il-ħoss fil-kċina? Mark: L-ilma baqbaq fil-borma; issa nista' nżid l-għaġin.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was that sound in the kitchen? Mark: The water was bubbling in the pot; now I can add the pasta.
colloquial.zh: Maja：厨房里刚才是什么声音？Mark：水在锅里咕嘟冒泡；现在可以下意面了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 厨房里刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound in the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ilma baqbaq fil-borma; issa nista' nżid l-għaġin.
messages.mt_standard: L-ilma baqbaq fil-borma; issa nista' nżid l-għaġin.
messages.zh: 水在锅里咕嘟冒泡；现在可以下意面了。
messages.en: The water was bubbling in the pot; now I can add the pasta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习时用“咕嘟咕嘟”的声音联想 baqbaq，再分别配上水冒泡、婴儿咿呀和人不停说话的画面；“激怒”义另记为情绪被搅动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verbal noun of baqa' referring to staying or remaining, or to being in agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: baqa' 的动名词，表示停留、留下这一行为，也可表示意见一致或达成的约定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom verbali ta' baqa' li jfisser il-fatt li wieħed jibqa' jew joqgħod f'post, jew il-fatt li jkun hemm qbil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 停留；留下这一行为。
意见一致；处于相互同意的状态。
动词 baqa' 的动名词，表示停留或意见一致。
停留；逗留的一段时间。
一致；协议；约定。

formal.mt: Il-baqgħa tar-riċerkatur f'Għawdex damet ġimgħa u ppermettietlu jiġbor aktar informazzjoni.
formal.en: The researcher's stay in Gozo lasted a week and allowed him to collect more information.
formal.zh: 研究员在戈佐岛停留了一周，得以收集更多资料。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kienet il-baqgħa tiegħek f'Għawdex? Mark: Qasira, imma sabiħa ħafna; id-darba li jmiss irrid noqgħod aktar.
colloquial.en: Sara: How was your stay in Gozo? Mark: Short, but lovely; next time I want to stay longer.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你在戈佐岛待得怎么样？Mark：时间短，不过非常愉快；下次我想多待一阵。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在戈佐岛待得怎么样？
messages.en: How was your stay in Gozo?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅行归来的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qasira, imma sabiħa ħafna; id-darba li jmiss irrid noqgħod aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Qasira, imma sabiħa ħafna; id-darba li jmiss irrid noqgħod aktar.
messages.zh: 时间短，不过非常愉快；下次我想多待一阵。
messages.en: Short, but lovely; next time I want to stay longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baqa' 的“留下”动作装进名词框，变成 baqgħa“停留”；另画两个人点头的图，记住“一致、约定”义。

gloss_zh: 虱子；小虫；臭虫、床虱（集合称呼）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small parasitic insects, including lice or bedbugs; used collectively for the insects or their kind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小型寄生虫，可指虱子或臭虫、床虱；可集合地指这些虫子或这一类虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insetti żgħar parassitiċi, bħal qamel jew insetti li jgħixu fis-saqqijiet; il-kelma tista' tirreferi għalihom bħala grupp jew tip.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虱子。
小虫；虫子。

sense_translations.en_definition: bugs, bedbugs (several or the species as such)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 臭虫、床虱；指若干只，或集合地指这一类虫。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport isemmi l-baqq li nstab fis-saqqu tal-kamra.
formal.en: The report mentions the bedbugs found in the room's mattress.
formal.zh: 报告提到了在该房间床垫里发现的臭虫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sibt baqq fis-saqqu. Mark: Mela ma norqdux f'din il-kamra llejla.
colloquial.en: Maja: I found bedbugs in the mattress. Mark: Then let's not sleep in this room tonight.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我在床垫里发现了臭虫。马克：那我们今晚就别睡这间房了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在床垫里发现了臭虫。
messages.en: I found bedbugs in the mattress.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ma norqdux f'din il-kamra llejla.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ma norqdux f'din il-kamra llejla.
messages.zh: 那我们今晚就别睡这间房了。
messages.en: Then let's not sleep in this room tonight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baqq 和床垫里的小虫画面一起记；看到这个词，先判断语境指虱子还是床虱，并记住它可集合地称呼虫群。

gloss_zh: 给植物大量浇水；充分浇灌

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give plants a large amount of water, watering them abundantly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给植物浇很多水，使其得到充分浇灌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saqqa l-pjanti b'ħafna ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给植物大量浇水；充分浇灌植物。
大量浇水；用充足的水浇灌。

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar baqqa l-pjanti filgħodu għax il-ħamrija kienet niexfa ħafna.
formal.en: The gardener watered the plants abundantly in the morning because the soil was very dry.
formal.zh: 园丁早上给植物充分浇了水，因为土壤非常干燥。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex l-art għadha mxarrba? Pawlu: Il-ġardinar baqqa l-pjanti dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the ground still wet? Pawlu: The gardener gave the plants plenty of water this morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：地面怎么还湿着？保罗：园丁今天早上给植物浇了很多水。

messages.speaker: Sara (住户)
messages.zh: 地面怎么还湿着？
messages.en: Why is the ground still wet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 园丁今天早上给植物浇了很多水。
messages.en: The gardener gave the plants plenty of water this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baqqa 想成给花盆浇足一大壶水；重点记住水量充足，并用词尾没有撇号来区分 baqqa'。

gloss_zh: 使某人留下；让某人继续待着

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to stay in a place instead of leaving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人继续留在某处，或让原本可能离开的人留下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jibqa' f'post minflok jitlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人留下；让某人继续待着。
使某人留下；让某人留在某处。

collocations.en: made the student stay in the classroom
made the guest stay for a meal

formal.mt: L-għalliem baqqa' lill-istudent fil-klassi għal ftit minuti biex jispjegalu l-eżerċizzju.
formal.en: The teacher made the student stay in the classroom for a few minutes to explain the exercise to him.
formal.zh: 老师让学生在教室里多留几分钟，以便给他讲解练习。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex wasal tard Mark? Sara: L-għalliem baqqa' lil Mark fil-klassi wara l-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark arrive late? Sara: The teacher made Mark stay in the classroom after the lesson.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么来晚了？萨拉：老师让马克下课后留在教室里。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 马克为什么来晚了？
messages.en: Why did Mark arrive late?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għalliem baqqa' lil Mark fil-klassi wara l-lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: L-għalliem baqqa' lil Mark fil-klassi wara l-lezzjoni.
messages.zh: 老师让马克下课后留在教室里。
messages.en: The teacher made Mark stay in the classroom after the lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baqqa' 配上老师请学生留下的画面；词尾撇号是拼写的一部分，抄写时连同它一起记，避免与浇水的 baqqa 混淆。

gloss_zh: 用镐凿破；用镐作业；性交（口语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To work with a pickaxe, especially to break stone or another hard material in masonry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用镐进行作业，尤其指在石工作业中凿破石头等坚硬材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħadem bil-baqqun, speċjalment biex ikisser il-ġebel jew materjal iebes ieħor fix-xogħol tal-ġebel.

sense_translations.en_definition: to break sth. with a pickaxe (especially used in stone masonry)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用镐把某物凿破或凿碎，尤其用于石工作业。
性交；发生性关系（口语用法）。
用镐工作；进行镐凿作业。

collocations.en: broke the stone with a pickaxe
worked with a pickaxe for two hours

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem baqqan il-ġebel biex jiftaħ passaġġ dejjaq.
formal.en: The worker broke the stone with a pickaxe to open a narrow passage.
formal.zh: 工人用镐凿开石头，开出了一条狭窄的通道。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark għajjien daqshekk? Toni: Baqqan għal sagħtejn dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is Mark so tired? Toni: He worked with a pickaxe for two hours this morning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克怎么这么累？托尼：他今天早上用镐干了两个小时。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 马克怎么这么累？
messages.en: Why is Mark so tired?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 他今天早上用镐干了两个小时。
messages.en: He worked with a pickaxe for two hours this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baqqan 记成挥镐凿石的动作，再与工具名 baqqun 成对练习；遇到口语中的性义时，要靠上下文另行判断。

gloss_zh: 使凝结；使牛奶凝乳；凝固剂（名词义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a liquid, especially milk, coagulate or form curds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使液体凝结，尤其指使牛奶凝固并形成凝乳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel likwidu, speċjalment il-ħalib, jagħqad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使凝结；使形成凝乳。
凝固剂；促使液体凝结的物质。
使牛奶凝固；使牛奶形成凝乳。

collocations.en: curdled the milk to make cheese
collocations.zh: 使牛奶凝乳以制作奶酪

formal.mt: Il-bidwi baqqat il-ħalib bħala l-ewwel pass fil-produzzjoni tal-ġobon.
formal.en: The farmer curdled the milk as the first step in cheese production.
formal.zh: 农民先使牛奶凝乳，作为制作奶酪的第一步。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għamel Pawlu bil-ħalib? Mark: Baqqat il-ħalib biex jagħmel il-ġobon.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did Pawlu do with the milk? Mark: He curdled the milk to make cheese.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：保罗把牛奶怎么处理了？马克：他让牛奶凝乳，用来做奶酪。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗把牛奶怎么处理了？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do with the milk?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他让牛奶凝乳，用来做奶酪。
messages.en: He curdled the milk to make cheese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象牛奶逐渐结成凝乳块，把 baqqat 与这个变化画面绑定；动词记使其凝结，名词另记促成凝结的凝固剂。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A heavy hand tool with a pointed metal head, used to break stone or hard ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有尖头金属镐头的重型手工具，用于凿石或挖开坚硬地面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda tqila b'ras tal-metall bil-ponta, li tintuża biex tkisser il-ġebel jew l-art iebsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一把镐；鹤嘴镐。
镐；用于凿石或挖开硬地的工具。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża baqqun biex ikisser is-saff iebes tal-art.
formal.en: The worker used a pickaxe to break the hard layer of ground.
formal.zh: 工人用镐凿开了坚硬的地层。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Fejn hu l-baqqun? Lara: Fil-garaxx, ħdejn il-pala.
colloquial.en: Toni: Where is the pickaxe? Lara: In the garage, next to the shovel.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：镐在哪里？拉拉：在车库里，铲子旁边。

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 镐在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the pickaxe?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 在车库里，铲子旁边。
messages.en: In the garage, next to the shovel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 baqqun 配一张长柄尖头镐的图片；与 baqqan 对照时，一个记工具名称，一个记挥镐工作的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adult female bovine, often kept on a farm for milk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成年雌性牛，常在农场饲养以获取牛奶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal bovin femminili adult, li spiss jitrabba f'razzett għall-ħalib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 母牛；成年雌性牛。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi jaħleb il-baqra kull filgħodu u jiġbor il-ħalib f'kontenitur nadif.
formal.en: The farmer milks the cow every morning and collects the milk in a clean container.
formal.zh: 农民每天早上给母牛挤奶，把牛奶收集到干净的容器里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik baqra tal-ħalib? Pawlu: Iva, missieri jaħlibha kull filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that a dairy cow? Pawlu: Yes, my father milks her every morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是一头奶牛吗？保罗：是的，我爸爸每天早上给它挤奶。

messages.speaker: Maja (农场访客)
messages.zh: 那是一头奶牛吗？
messages.en: Is that a dairy cow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主的儿子)
messages.zh: 是的，我爸爸每天早上给它挤奶。
messages.en: Yes, my father milks her every morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baqra 与农场里正在被挤奶的母牛画面一起记；练习 baqra tal-ħalib 时，同时记住母牛这一性别含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove material with a file or smooth and polish a surface by rubbing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用锉刀去除材料，或通过磨擦使表面平滑、光洁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa materjal b'lima, jew għamel wiċċ lixx u jleqq billi għorku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用锉刀锉去；通过锉削去除材料。
磨光；抛光，使表面光洁。
磨光、抛光；用锉刀锉削。

collocations.en: filed the edge of the metal
polished the surface to make it smooth

formal.mt: It-tekniku barad it-tarf tal-metall b'lima biex ineħħi l-partijiet li jaqtgħu.
formal.en: The technician filed the edge of the metal with a file to remove the sharp parts.
formal.zh: 技术员用锉刀锉削金属边缘，去掉锋利的部分。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min barad it-tarf ta' din il-biċċa metall? Mark: Pawlu; issa t-tarf lixx.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who filed the edge of this piece of metal? Mark: Pawlu did; the edge is smooth now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁锉过这块金属的边缘？马克：保罗锉的，现在边缘平滑了。

messages.speaker: Sara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Min barad it-tarf ta' din il-biċċa metall?
messages.mt_standard: Min barad it-tarf ta' din il-biċċa metall?
messages.zh: 谁锉过这块金属的边缘？
messages.en: Who filed the edge of this piece of metal?

messages.speaker: Mark (工匠)
messages.zh: 保罗锉的，现在边缘平滑了。
messages.en: Pawlu did; the edge is smooth now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象锉刀来回磨过金属，把毛刺去掉并让表面变平滑；用这个连续画面串起 barad 的锉削与磨光两类意思。

gloss_zh: 扭转；卷起；口语中也指偷窃、欺骗或想到

teaching_sense.en_definition: To turn or wind something so that it becomes twisted or rolled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物扭转、拧紧或卷起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idawwar jew jgħawweġ xi ħaġa biex titgħawweġ jew titkebbeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扭；拧；使扭转。
偷；窃取，属于口语用法。
扭转；卷起。
小偷小摸；偷拿少量物品。
欺骗；以计谋胜过或耍弄对方。
被某人想到；浮现于某人脑海。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem baram it-truf tal-wajer flimkien biex jgħaqqadhom.
formal.en: The worker twisted the ends of the wire together to join them.
formal.zh: 工人把金属丝的两端拧在一起，将它们连接起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min baram il-ħabel hekk? Mark: Jien. Issa se nħollu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who twisted the rope like this? Mark: I did. I'll untwist it now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把绳子拧成这样了？Mark：是我。我现在把它解开。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把绳子拧成这样了？
messages.en: Who twisted the rope like this?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是我。我现在把它解开。
messages.en: I did. I'll untwist it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手把绳子拧成麻花，用扭绳动作记住 baram；遇到偷窃、欺骗或想到的义项时，再结合语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scratch or scrape a surface with nails, a sharp object, or a tool.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用指甲、尖物或工具抓划或刮擦表面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tobrox wiċċ bid-dwiefer, b'oġġett bil-ponta jew b'għodda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抓；抓划；划出抓痕。
刮；刮擦；刮去表面的东西。
刮擦；抓划。

sense_translations.en_definition: to win everything easily (in a gamble, for example)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻松赢走全部筹码或赢得所有可赢的东西，例如赌博时通吃。
偷窃；顺手偷拿少量东西。

collocations.en: scraped the paint off the wall

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem barax iż-żebgħa l-qadima mill-bieb qabel żebgħu mill-ġdid.
formal.en: The worker scraped the old paint off the door before repainting it.
formal.zh: 工人在重新刷漆之前，先刮掉了门上的旧漆。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min barax il-mejda? Pawlu: Il-qattus barax il-mejda bid-dwiefer tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who scratched the table? Pawlu: The cat scratched the table with its claws.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：谁把桌子抓花了？保罗：猫用爪子抓花了桌子。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 谁把桌子抓花了？
messages.en: Who scratched the table?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (儿子)
messages.zh: 猫用爪子抓花了桌子。
messages.en: The cat scratched the table with its claws.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想猫爪抓花桌面，再想工具刮掉旧漆，把“抓、刮”连成一个动作画面；赢光和偷拿另用情境卡片记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cold or chill, especially the coldness of the weather or the sensation it causes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 寒冷或寒意，尤指天气的冷及其带来的感受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kesħa fit-temp jew is-sensazzjoni ta' kesħa li jħoss il-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寒冷；冷。
寒意；使人感到冷的感觉。
寒意；寒冷的天气。

formal.mt: Minħabba l-bard qawwi, l-attività se ssir ġewwa.
formal.en: Because of the intense cold, the activity will take place indoors.
formal.zh: 由于天气严寒，活动将在室内举行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tħoss il-bard? Mark: Iva, agħlaq it-tieqa, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you feeling the cold? Mark: Yes, close the window, please.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你觉得冷吗？马克：觉得冷，请把窗户关上。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你觉得冷吗？
messages.en: Are you feeling the cold?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 觉得冷，请把窗户关上。
messages.en: Yes, close the window, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bard 想成窗外吹进来的一股寒气：它是可感受到的“寒冷、寒意”，用名词画面记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling cold or chilly, used to describe someone who needs warmth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到寒冷的，形容需要取暖的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss il-bard u jkollu bżonn jisħon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 觉得凉的；感到有些冷的。
冷的；感到寒冷的。

formal.mt: It-tifel kien bardan wara li qagħad barra fix-xita, għalhekk l-għalliema tatu kutra.
formal.en: The boy felt cold after being outside in the rain, so the teacher gave him a blanket.
formal.zh: 男孩在外面淋雨后觉得冷，因此老师给了他一条毯子。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Jien bardan ħafna. Marija: Ħu din il-kutra u oqgħod ħdejn il-heater.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: I'm very cold. Marija: Take this blanket and sit near the heater.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：我觉得很冷。玛丽亚：拿这条毯子，坐到暖气旁边。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (儿子)
messages.zh: 我觉得很冷。
messages.en: I'm very cold.

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu din il-kutra u oqgħod ħdejn il-heater.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu din il-kutra u oqgħod ħdejn il-heater.
messages.zh: 拿这条毯子，坐到暖气旁边。
messages.en: Take this blanket and sit near the heater.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用对照句记忆：bard 是“寒冷”这个名词，bardan 描写“觉得冷”的人；想象一个裹着毯子的男孩。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A blessing: an expression or act of wishing someone divine favour, protection, or well-being.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 祝福，即祈愿某人获得神的恩惠、庇佑或安好的话语或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem jew att li bih wieħed jitlob il-ħarsien u l-ġid mingħand Alla għal xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个祝福；一次祝福；一份福分。
祝福；赐福；福分。

formal.mt: Fi tmiem iċ-ċerimonja, il-qassis ta l-barka lill-familji kollha.
formal.en: At the end of the ceremony, the priest gave a blessing to all the families.
formal.zh: 仪式结束时，神父为所有家庭祝福。

colloquial.mt: Anna: In-nanna tatni l-barka qabel il-vjaġġ. Lara: Kemm hu sabiħ! Żgur ferħet li ċempiltilha.
colloquial.en: Anna: Grandma gave me her blessing before the trip. Lara: How lovely! I'm sure she was happy you called her.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：出发旅行前，奶奶给了我祝福。拉拉：真好！你给她打电话，她一定很高兴。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 出发旅行前，奶奶给了我祝福。
messages.en: Grandma gave me her blessing before the trip.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu sabiħ! Żgur ferħet li ċempiltilha.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu sabiħ! Żgur ferħet li ċempiltilha.
messages.zh: 真好！你给她打电话，她一定很高兴。
messages.en: How lovely! I'm sure she was happy you called her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象临行前长辈送上一句平安祝愿，把 barka 和“收到一份祝福”的温暖场景一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A twist or turn made by rotating something, such as a rope or a lid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过旋转某物形成的一次扭转或拧动，例如扭绳子或拧盖子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawra li tagħti lil xi ħaġa, bħal ħabel jew għatu, billi ddawwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次扭转；一拧。
扭转；卷动；搓卷。
粗壮；厚实；壮实的程度或状态。

formal.mt: Biex tiftaħ il-kontenitur, agħti barma lill-għatu lejn ix-xellug.
formal.en: To open the container, give the lid a twist to the left.
formal.zh: 要打开容器，请把盖子向左拧一下。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-għatu ma jridx jinfetaħ. Mark: Agħtih barma oħra lejn ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Lara: The lid won't open. Mark: Give it another twist to the left.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：盖子打不开。马克：再向左拧一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 盖子打不开。
messages.en: The lid won't open.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 再向左拧一下。
messages.en: Give it another twist to the left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 握住瓶盖做一次拧转，给这个动作贴上 barma；“粗壮”另画一根粗绳辅助记忆，不把两个义项混成一个定义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An open container, usually with a handle, used for carrying water or other materials.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常带提手的敞口容器，用于盛装和搬运水或其他物料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent miftuħ minn fuq, ġeneralment b'manku, li jintuża biex iġorr l-ilma jew materjal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 桶；用于盛水或其他物料的桶。
提桶；通常带提手的小桶。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem mela barmil bl-ilma biex jaħsel l-art.
formal.en: The worker filled a bucket with water to wash the floor.
formal.zh: 工人往桶里装满水，用来清洗地面。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn hu l-barmil? Pawlu: Ħdejn il-bieb; imlieh bl-ilma u nġibu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where is the bucket? Pawlu: By the door; fill it with water and we'll bring it together.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：桶在哪里？保罗：在门旁边；你装上水，我们一起把它提过来。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 桶在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the bucket?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-bieb; imlieh bl-ilma u nġibu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-bieb; imlieh bl-ilma u nġibu flimkien.
messages.zh: 在门旁边；你装上水，我们一起把它提过来。
messages.en: By the door; fill it with water and we'll bring it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象提着一桶水去洗地，把桶身、提手和水一起画出来，再在桶上写 barmil，形成具体物件记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hood or cowl that covers the head, often attached to a coat or cloak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 罩住头部的兜帽或风帽，常连接在外套或斗篷上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għata għar-ras, spiss imwaħħal ma' kowt jew mantell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 兜帽；风帽；斗篷或长袍上罩住头部的帽子。

formal.mt: Minħabba x-xita u r-riħ, huwa libes kowt bil-barnuż.
formal.en: Because of the rain and wind, he wore a coat with a hood.
formal.zh: 由于下雨又刮风，他穿了一件带兜帽的外套。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Bdiet ix-xita! Mark: Tella' l-barnuż sakemm naslu d-dar.
colloquial.en: Anna: It's started raining! Mark: Pull up your hood until we get home.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：开始下雨了！马克：先把兜帽戴上，等到家再放下来。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 开始下雨了！
messages.en: It's started raining!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 先把兜帽戴上，等到家再放下来。
messages.en: Pull up your hood until we get home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见外套后面垂着的兜帽，就想起 barnuż；再做一个拉起兜帽遮雨的动作，把词和用途一起记住。

gloss_zh: 排除；避开；荒漠；荒地；荒野；咕咕叫

teaching_sense.en_definition: To exclude someone from a group, activity, or place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人排除在群体或活动之外，或不准其进入某个地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħalli lil xi ħadd barra minn grupp jew attività, jew ma tħallihx jidħol f'post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排除；不让加入或参与。
刻意避开；回避交往；疏远。
沙漠；荒漠。
荒地；荒芜、未开发的土地。
荒野；未经开发的自然地区。
发出咕咕声，例如鸽子的叫声。

collocations.en: excluded a member from the group
collocations.zh: 把一名成员排除出群体

formal.mt: Il-kumitat barr membru mil-laqgħa minħabba kunflitt ta' interess.
formal.en: The committee excluded a member from the meeting because of a conflict of interest.
formal.zh: 委员会因利益冲突而不让一名成员参加会议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-klabb barr lil Pawlu? Mark: Għax kiser ir-regoli diversi drabi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the club exclude Pawlu? Mark: Because he broke the rules several times.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：俱乐部为什么把保罗除名了？马克：因为他多次违反规定。

messages.speaker: Lara (俱乐部成员)
messages.zh: 俱乐部为什么把保罗除名了？
messages.en: Why did the club exclude Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Mark (俱乐部成员)
messages.zh: 因为他多次违反规定。
messages.en: Because he broke the rules several times.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 barr 分画三张卡：门外的人记“排除、疏远”，空旷土地记名词“荒漠、荒地、荒野”，鸽子记动词“咕咕叫”；同形分义记忆。

gloss_zh: 排除；禁止参加；拒绝；在外面；在国外；除……之外

teaching_sense.en_definition: To exclude someone from a group or activity, prevent participation, or refuse admission.
