teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人排除在团体或活动之外，禁止其参加，或拒绝其进入。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħalli lil xi ħadd barra minn grupp jew attività, ma tħallihx jieħu sehem, jew ma taċċettahx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排除；不把……包括在内。
禁止参加；取消参与资格。
拒绝；不予接受。
表示处于或移到某个范围之外。
在……外面。
表示在国外或到国外。
表示在海外或到海外。
在外面；向外面。
在露天；在户外。
与……分开；独立于……之外。
在外；在外面；在户外。
在国外；到国外。
在……外部；超出……的范围。
除……之外；把……排除在所述范围之外。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat barra lill-kandidat mill-kompetizzjoni għax ma ssodisfax il-kundizzjonijiet.
formal.en: The committee excluded the candidate from the competition because he did not meet the conditions.
formal.zh: 委员会把该候选人排除在比赛之外，因为他没有满足相关条件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nistennew, ġewwa jew barra? Mark: Nistennew barra, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we wait, inside or outside? Mark: Let's wait outside, near the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在哪里等，里面还是外面？马克：我们在外面等，就在门旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里等，里面还是外面？
messages.en: Where shall we wait, inside or outside?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在外面等，就在门旁边。
messages.en: Let's wait outside, near the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一道门：在门外对应“外面”，把人留在门外对应“排除”。这是记忆联想，读句时仍须区分动词、介词和副词。

gloss_zh: 锉刀；用于冷却水或食物的陶罐

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hand tool with a rough working surface, used to remove small amounts of material and smooth or shape an object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面粗糙的手工具，用来锉去少量材料，使物体平滑或成形，即锉刀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'wiċċ aħrax li tintuża biex tneħħi ftit materjal u tillixxa jew tagħti forma lil oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锉刀，一种用于锉削物体表面的工具。

sense_translations.en_definition: an earthenware jar for cooling water or foods such as cheese
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于冷却水或奶酪等食物的陶罐。
锉刀，用于切削少量材料或磨平表面的工具。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża barrada biex ineħħi x-xfar jaqtgħu mill-biċċa tal-metall.
formal.en: The worker used a file to remove the sharp edges from the piece of metal.
formal.zh: 工人用锉刀锉去了那块金属上的锋利边缘。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tagħtini l-barrada? Dan it-tarf għadu aħrax. Rita: Iva, qiegħda ħdejn il-martell.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can you pass me the file? This edge is still rough. Rita: Yes, it's next to the hammer.
colloquial.zh: 马克：能把锉刀递给我吗？这个边缘还很粗糙。丽塔：可以，就在锤子旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (修理工)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħtini l-barrada? Dan it-tarf għadu aħrax.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħtini l-barrada? Dan it-tarf għadu aħrax.
messages.zh: 能把锉刀递给我吗？这个边缘还很粗糙。
messages.en: Can you pass me the file? This edge is still rough.

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 可以，就在锤子旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it's next to the hammer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把锉刀反复磨平金属边缘的画面与 barrada 配对记忆；遇到水或奶酪的语境，再切换到“冷却用陶罐”的义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who comes from a country other than the country being discussed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自所谈论国家以外的另一个国家的人，即外国人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġejja minn pajjiż ieħor, differenti mill-pajjiż li jkun qed jissemma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 外国人；来自另一个国家的人。
外侨；相对于某一国家而言不具有该国国籍的人。
外国的；来自其他国家的。
具有外国人身份的；外来的。

formal.mt: Barrani li jitgħallem il-Malti jista' juża djalogi qosra biex jipprattika l-komunikazzjoni ta' kuljum.
formal.en: A foreigner learning Maltese can use short dialogues to practise everyday communication.
formal.zh: 学习马耳他语的外国人可以用简短对话练习日常交流。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Jien barrani u għadni qed nitgħallem il-Malti. Tista' titkellem bil-mod? Maja: Żgur, u jekk ma tifhimx kelma, nispjegahielek.
colloquial.en: Luca: I'm a foreigner and I'm still learning Maltese. Can you speak slowly? Maja: Of course, and if you don't understand a word, I'll explain it to you.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：我是外国人，还在学习马耳他语。你能说慢一点吗？玛雅：当然，如果有哪个词你不懂，我会给你解释。

messages.speaker: Luca (语言学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien barrani u għadni qed nitgħallem il-Malti. Tista' titkellem bil-mod?
messages.mt_standard: Jien barrani u għadni qed nitgħallem il-Malti. Tista' titkellem bil-mod?
messages.zh: 我是外国人，还在学习马耳他语。你能说慢一点吗？
messages.en: I'm a foreigner and I'm still learning Maltese. Can you speak slowly?

messages.speaker: Maja (语伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, u jekk ma tifhimx kelma, nispjegahielek.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, u jekk ma tifhimx kelma, nispjegahielek.
messages.zh: 当然，如果有哪个词你不懂，我会给你解释。
messages.en: Of course, and if you don't understand a word, I'll explain it to you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“来自另一个国家的人”这张人物卡记住 barrani；放在 student 后面时，把整组记成“外国学生”，同时练习形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool used to scrape material from a surface or to remove weeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来刮除表面材料或清除杂草的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex tneħħi materjal minn wiċċ billi tobrox, jew biex tneħħi l-ħaxix ħażin.

sense_translations.en_definition: a tool for scraping or weeding
sense_translations.zh_definition: 刮削或除草用的工具。
刮具；用于刮除附着物的刮刀。

collocations.en: to remove paint with a scraper

formal.mt: Qabel ma jiżbgħu l-bieb, il-ħaddiema neħħew iż-żebgħa l-qadima b'barraxa.
formal.en: Before painting the door, the workers removed the old paint with a scraper.
formal.zh: 工人们在给门上漆之前，用刮刀清除了旧漆。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif inneħħi din iż-żebgħa l-qadima? Mark: Uża l-barraxa, imma oqgħod attent li ma tagħmilx ħsara lill-injam.
colloquial.en: Rita: How do I remove this old paint? Mark: Use the scraper, but be careful not to damage the wood.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这层旧漆怎么除掉？马克：用刮刀，不过要小心，别弄坏木头。

messages.speaker: Rita (房主)
messages.zh: 这层旧漆怎么除掉？
messages.en: How do I remove this old paint?

messages.speaker: Mark (维修师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża l-barraxa, imma oqgħod attent li ma tagħmilx ħsara lill-injam.
messages.mt_standard: Uża l-barraxa, imma oqgħod attent li ma tagħmilx ħsara lill-injam.
messages.zh: 用刮刀，不过要小心，别弄坏木头。
messages.en: Use the scraper, but be careful not to damage the wood.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刮刀把旧漆一片片刮下，把这个动作画面贴到 barraxa 上；记住它也可指除草工具，具体用途由语境判断。

gloss_zh: 公牛；役用阉牛；乡野的、野生的；强壮者

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adult male bovine, especially a bull.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成年雄性牛，主要指公牛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal bovin maskili adult.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公牛；成年雄性牛。
役牛；通常指用于劳作的成年阉牛。
乡野的；野生的；野性的。
强壮者；体格健壮的人。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi żamm il-barri f'għalqa magħluqa biex jiżgura s-sigurtà tal-viżitaturi.
formal.en: The farmer kept the bull in an enclosed field to ensure the visitors' safety.
formal.zh: 农民把公牛留在围起来的田地里，以确保访客安全。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak il-barri hu kbir ħafna. Nista' nersaq lejh? Pawlu: Le, aħjar tibqa' hawn u ma tersaqx lejh.
colloquial.en: Maja: That bull is very big. Can I go near it? Pawlu: No, you'd better stay here and not go near it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那头公牛好大。我能靠近它吗？保罗：不行，你最好待在这里，别靠近它。

messages.speaker: Maja (农场访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-barri hu kbir ħafna. Nista' nersaq lejh?
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-barri hu kbir ħafna. Nista' nersaq lejh?
messages.zh: 那头公牛好大。我能靠近它吗？
messages.en: That bull is very big. Can I go near it?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, aħjar tibqa' hawn u ma tersaqx lejh.
messages.mt_standard: Le, aħjar tibqa' hawn u ma tersaqx lejh.
messages.zh: 不行，你最好待在这里，别靠近它。
messages.en: No, you'd better stay here and not go near it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用田里一头体格壮硕的公牛记住 barri，再分别记住“役牛”“乡野的”和“强壮者”；这些义项需要结合词性与语境辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where stone is extracted from the ground for building or other uses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从地面或地下开采建筑等用途石材的场所，即采石场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post minn fejn jinħareġ il-ġebel għall-bini jew għal użi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 采石场；开采石材的场所。
屏障；阻挡通行的障碍物。
采石场。

formal.mt: Il-ġebel użat fil-bini ġie minn barriera fil-qrib.
formal.en: The stone used in the building came from a nearby quarry.
formal.zh: 这座建筑所用的石材来自附近的一处采石场。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Minn fejn ġabu dan il-ġebel? Rita: Minn barriera ħdejn ir-raħal.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where did they get this stone? Rita: From a quarry near the village.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些石材是从哪里弄来的？丽塔：从村子附近的一处采石场。

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: 这些石材是从哪里弄来的？
messages.en: Where did they get this stone?

messages.speaker: Rita (当地居民)
messages.zh: 从村子附近的一处采石场。
messages.en: From a quarry near the village.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 barriera 配两张独立图片：一张是开采石材的采石场，一张是挡路的护栏；遇到石材或通行语境，就选对应图片。

gloss_zh: 背包；挎包；大垂耳山羊；驼背者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bag carried on the back or over the shoulder for personal belongings or supplies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 背在背上或挎在肩上，用于携带个人物品或补给品的包。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Borża li tinġarr fuq id-dahar jew fuq l-ispalla biex iġġorr affarijiet personali jew provvisti.

sense_translations.en_definition: knapsack, haversack, goat having large hanging ears, hunchbacked person
sense_translations.zh_definition: 背包、挎包；耳朵大而下垂的山羊；驼背的人。
背包；用于携带随身物品或补给品的挎包。

formal.mt: Qabel il-mixja, kull parteċipant poġġa flixkun ilma u ftit ikel fil-barżakka tiegħu.
formal.en: Before the walk, each participant put a bottle of water and some food in their knapsack.
formal.zh: 步行活动开始前，每位参加者都在自己的背包里放了一瓶水和一些食物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek spazju fil-barżakka għall-ħobż? Mark: Iva, poġġih ħdejn il-flixkun tal-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have room in the knapsack for the bread? Mark: Yes, put it next to the water bottle.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的背包里还有地方放面包吗？马克：有，把它放在水瓶旁边吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 你的背包里还有地方放面包吗？
messages.en: Do you have room in the knapsack for the bread?

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 有，把它放在水瓶旁边吧。
messages.en: Yes, put it next to the water bottle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门徒步时，把水瓶和面包放进 barżakka，以此记住“背包、挎包”；山羊和人的义项另做词卡，不把这些联想当作词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Onions considered as a food, a kind of plant, or a group of individual onions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为食材、植物种类或多个个体统称的洋葱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxix b'bozza magħmula minn saffi, użat fit-tisjir; il-kelma tista' tirreferi għall-ħaxix bħala tip jew għal diversi basaliet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洋葱；多个洋葱的统称。

sense_translations.en_definition: onion (as a mass or species); several onions
sense_translations.zh_definition: 洋葱，作为食材总称或植物种类；若干个洋葱。
鳞茎；由层状肉质叶等构成的植物地下贮藏器官。

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, il-basal għandu jinqata' f'biċċiet żgħar u jissajjar fuq nar baxx.
formal.en: For this recipe, the onions should be cut into small pieces and cooked over low heat.
formal.zh: 制作这道菜时，应把洋葱切成小块，再用小火烹煮。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandna basal għas-soppa? Mark: Iva, hemm ftit fil-qoffa ħdejn il-patata.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do we have onions for the soup? Mark: Yes, there's some in the basket next to the potatoes.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们有煮汤用的洋葱吗？马克：有，土豆旁边的篮子里有一些。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 我们有煮汤用的洋葱吗？
messages.en: Do we have onions for the soup?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ftit fil-qoffa ħdejn il-patata.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ftit fil-qoffa ħdejn il-patata.
messages.zh: 有，土豆旁边的篮子里有一些。
messages.en: Yes, there's some in the basket next to the potatoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一篮洋葱整体标为 basal，提醒自己它可以统称洋葱这种食材，也可以表示若干洋葱；植物语境中再联想到层层包裹的鳞茎。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say in advance what will or is likely to happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提前说出将要发生或可能发生的事情；预测、预见。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid minn qabel x'se jiġri jew x'aktarx se jiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预测；提前判断将发生什么。
预报；对未来情况作出预测。
占卜者；通过占卜推测未来的人。
先知；宣告预言的人。
预见、预言或预测尚未发生的事情。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, l-espert basar żieda fid-domanda matul ix-xhur li ġejjin.
formal.en: In his report, the expert forecast an increase in demand over the coming months.
formal.zh: 专家在报告中预测，未来几个月的需求将会上升。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif kien jaf li se jkun hemm daqshekk nies? Pawlu: Basar li l-kunċert se jkun popolari u xtara l-biljetti kmieni.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did he know there would be so many people? Pawlu: He predicted that the concert would be popular and bought the tickets early.
colloquial.zh: Marija：他怎么知道会有这么多人？Pawlu：他预料这场音乐会会很受欢迎，所以早早买了票。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien jaf li se jkun hemm daqshekk nies?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien jaf li se jkun hemm daqshekk nies?
messages.zh: 他怎么知道会有这么多人？
messages.en: How did he know there would be so many people?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Basar li l-kunċert se jkun popolari u xtara l-biljetti kmieni.
messages.mt_standard: Basar li l-kunċert se jkun popolari u xtara l-biljetti kmieni.
messages.zh: 他预料这场音乐会会很受欢迎，所以早早买了票。
messages.en: He predicted that the concert would be popular and bought the tickets early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 basar 放进“提前判断未来”的画面记忆：事情还没发生，预测已经说出口；作名词时再联想到作预言的人。

gloss_zh: 放屁；发出嘘声；另有名词义“公共汽车”

teaching_sense.en_definition: To release gas from the bowels through the anus, sometimes audibly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从肛门排出肠道气体，即放屁，有时会发出声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ gass mill-imsaren minn ġol-anus, xi drabi b'ħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排出肠道气体；放屁。
放屁。
排气；放屁这一行为。
放屁这一行为或现象。
大声放屁；放响屁。
向某人发出嘘声，表示不满或反对。
公共汽车；巴士。

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, wieħed mill-parteċipanti bass bla ma ried u talab skuża.
formal.en: During the meeting, one of the participants accidentally passed wind and apologized.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一位与会者不小心放了屁，随后道了歉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi ħadd bass? Mark: Iva, jien. Skużani!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did someone fart? Mark: Yes, I did. Sorry!
colloquial.zh: Maja：有人放屁了吗？Mark：对，是我。不好意思！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 有人放屁了吗？
messages.en: Did someone fart?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，是我。不好意思！
messages.en: Yes, I did. Sorry!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bass 配上“突然排气，赶紧道歉”的小场景来记；名词中的巴士义另画一辆车，按词性和语境分别记忆。

gloss_zh: 足够；只要；尽管；够了，停下

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be enough to meet a need or achieve a purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量或程度足以满足某项需要或达到某个目的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun biżżejjed biex jaqdi ħtieġa jew jintlaħaq għan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 足够；足以满足需要。
只要；条件是。
以……为条件；前提是。
尽管；虽然存在某种不利情况。
只要；在满足某项条件的情况下。
尽管；不顾。
够了！停下！闭嘴！用于要求停止，语气可较强硬。

collocations.en: provided that you arrive on time

formal.mt: L-ammont miġbur basta biex jitħallsu l-ispejjeż kollha tal-attività.
formal.en: The amount collected sufficed to cover all the expenses of the event.
formal.zh: 筹集到的款项足以支付这次活动的全部费用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' niġi magħkom għada? Mark: Iva, basta tkun hawn fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I come with you tomorrow? Mark: Yes, as long as you are here at eight.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我明天可以跟你们一起去吗？Mark：可以，只要你八点到这里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我明天可以跟你们一起去吗？
messages.en: Can I come with you tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以，只要你八点到这里。
messages.en: Yes, as long as you are here at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按三种场景记 basta：数量满足时是“足够”，提出条件时是“只要”，单独喊出来时是“够了”；再单记“尽管”这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stick used for support when walking, or a long, firm stick or rod.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 走路时用来支撑身体的手杖，也可指较长而坚实的棍棒或杆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda twila u soda li tintuża bħala appoġġ fil-mixi, jew bħala virga.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手杖；步行时用来支撑身体的杖。
手杖；拐杖。
棍子；棍棒。
杆；棒；长条状的硬质物。
手杖、棍棒或长杖。

formal.mt: Matul il-mixja, ir-raġel uża bastun biex iżomm il-bilanċ fuq l-art imħarbta.
formal.en: During the walk, the man used a walking stick to keep his balance on the uneven ground.
formal.zh: 步行时，这名男子借助手杖在崎岖的地面上保持平衡。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nannu, fejn ħallejt il-bastun? Ġużeppi: Ħdejn il-bieb; ġibhuli, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Anna: Grandpa, where did you leave your walking stick? Ġużeppi: By the door; bring it to me, please.
colloquial.zh: Anna：爷爷，你把手杖放哪儿了？Ġużeppi：在门旁边，请帮我拿过来。

messages.speaker: Anna (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷，你把手杖放哪儿了？
messages.en: Grandpa, where did you leave your walking stick?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (祖父)
messages.zh: 在门旁边，请帮我拿过来。
messages.en: By the door; bring it to me, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门边立着一根 bastun：拿起来辅助走路就是手杖，只看它的形状也可以是一根棍棒或长杆。

gloss_zh: 遭受；受苦；经历艰难；遇到困难

teaching_sense.en_definition: To experience pain, distress, hardship, or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经历身体或精神上的痛苦，或遭遇艰难和困难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġarrab uġigħ, tbatija, jew diffikultajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受苦；遭受身体或精神上的痛苦。
经历艰难；遭受困苦。
遇到困难；在做事或生活中遭遇阻碍。

collocations.zh: 吃了很多苦；遭受了很大痛苦

formal.mt: Il-pazjent bata minn uġigħ qawwi għal diversi jiem qabel ma beda t-trattament.
formal.en: The patient suffered from severe pain for several days before treatment began.
formal.zh: 开始治疗前，患者连续数日遭受剧烈疼痛。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif mar ħuk fl-ewwel ġimgħa tax-xogħol? David: Bata ftit fil-bidu, imma issa qed jidra.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did your brother get on in his first week at work? David: He struggled a little at first, but now he is getting used to it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你哥哥上班第一周怎么样？David：他一开始有点吃力，不过现在正在适应。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif mar ħuk fl-ewwel ġimgħa tax-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Kif mar ħuk fl-ewwel ġimgħa tax-xogħol?
messages.zh: 你哥哥上班第一周怎么样？
messages.en: How did your brother get on in his first week at work?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bata ftit fil-bidu, imma issa qed jidra.
messages.mt_standard: Bata ftit fil-bidu, imma issa qed jidra.
messages.zh: 他一开始有点吃力，不过现在正在适应。
messages.en: He struggled a little at first, but now he is getting used to it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bata 和“经历难受的过程”绑定：生病会受苦，新工作也可能令人吃力；注意不要与双写 t 的 batta 混淆。

gloss_zh: 空出来；停止工作；休息一下

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become empty or unoccupied, especially when a place or position is no longer taken.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变空或不再被占用，尤指座位、场所或职位空出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir vojt jew ma jibqax okkupat, bħal post jew siġġu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得空缺；不再有人占用或担任。
停止工作；停下正在进行的劳动。
空出来；变空；变得无人占用。
暂时停下来休息；歇一会儿。

formal.mt: Il-post batal wara li l-impjegat irriżenja, u l-kumpanija bdiet tfittex persuna oħra.
formal.en: The position became vacant after the employee resigned, and the company began looking for someone else.
formal.zh: 该员工辞职后，职位出现空缺，公司开始寻找接替人选。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Is-siġġu ħdejk batal? Karl: Iva, tista' toqgħod hawn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Has the seat next to you become free? Karl: Yes, you can sit here.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你旁边的座位空出来了吗？Karl：是的，你可以坐这里。

messages.speaker: Nina (乘客)
messages.zh: 你旁边的座位空出来了吗？
messages.en: Has the seat next to you become free?

messages.speaker: Karl (乘客)
messages.zh: 是的，你可以坐这里。
messages.en: Yes, you can sit here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“原本被占用，后来空出来”的变化记 batal：座位和职位都能空出；另外把停止工作、暂时休息作为独立义项记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give birth to young, used of animals such as rabbits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指兔等动物生下幼崽、产仔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiled il-frieħ, meta jingħad għal annimali bħall-fniek.

sense_translations.en_definition: to give birth (used of animals such as rabbits, etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 产仔；用于兔等动物生下幼崽。
想到一个主意；产生一个想法。

sense_translations.en_definition: to give birth, to breed (of animals)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指动物产仔、繁殖后代。
构思出一个想法；想出一个主意。

formal.mt: Skont ir-reġistru tar-razzett, il-fenka batnet matul il-lejl u l-frieħ instabu f'kundizzjoni tajba.
formal.en: According to the farm record, the female rabbit gave birth during the night, and the young were found in good condition.
formal.zh: 据农场记录，这只母兔在夜间产仔，幼崽被发现时状况良好。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-fenka batnet dalgħodu? Toni: Iva, u l-frieħ kollha jinsabu tajbin.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did the rabbit give birth this morning? Toni: Yes, and all the young are doing well.
colloquial.zh: Rita：母兔今天早上产仔了吗？Toni：是的，所有幼崽都很好。

messages.speaker: Rita (养兔人)
messages.zh: 母兔今天早上产仔了吗？
messages.en: Did the rabbit give birth this morning?

messages.speaker: Toni (农场助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u l-frieħ kollha jinsabu tajbin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u l-frieħ kollha jinsabu tajbin.
messages.zh: 是的，所有幼崽都很好。
messages.en: Yes, and all the young are doing well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 batan：兔子生出幼崽，脑中产生主意。这只是帮助区分义项的学习联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 给动物断尾；配重平衡；均分载荷

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut off part of an animal's tail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 切去动物尾巴的一部分；给动物断尾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqta' parti minn denb annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给动物断尾；切除其尾巴的一部分。
施加相反方向的重量以取得平衡；配重平衡。
将载荷平均分配；使各部分承受相等的重量。

sense_translations.en_definition: to dock (to cut off a section of an animal's tail)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 断尾，即切去动物尾巴的一段。

sense_translations.en_definition: to counterbalance (to apply weight in order to balance)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过施加重量来平衡；用配重抵消另一侧的重量。

collocations.en: balanced the load by distributing its weight

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem batar it-tagħbija bejn iż-żewġ naħat tal-karrettun biex il-piż jitqassam indaqs.
formal.en: The worker balanced the load between the two sides of the cart so that the weight was distributed equally.
formal.zh: 工人把载荷均衡分配到手推车两侧，使重量分布相等。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex il-karrettun m'għadux jinklina lejn ix-xellug? Pawlu: Mark batar it-tagħbija; issa ż-żewġ naħat għandhom l-istess piż.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why is the cart no longer leaning to the left? Pawlu: Mark balanced the load; now both sides carry the same weight.
colloquial.zh: Lina：手推车怎么不再向左倾斜了？Pawlu：Mark 把载荷调平衡了，现在两边的重量一样。

messages.speaker: Lina (搬运工)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-karrettun m'għadux jinklina lejn ix-xellug?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-karrettun m'għadux jinklina lejn ix-xellug?
messages.zh: 手推车怎么不再向左倾斜了？
messages.en: Why is the cart no longer leaning to the left?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark batar it-tagħbija; issa ż-żewġ naħat għandhom l-istess piż.
messages.mt_standard: Mark batar it-tagħbija; issa ż-żewġ naħat għandhom l-istess piż.
messages.zh: Mark 把载荷调平衡了，现在两边的重量一样。
messages.en: Mark balanced the load; now both sides carry the same weight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 batar 建立两张记忆卡：一张画动物尾巴被截短，另一张画载荷两侧调到平衡；用宾语区分两组含义。

gloss_zh: 减弱；平息；战胜；击倒；敲打

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become less strong or intense, as wind, rain, or noise does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强度减小或逐渐平息，例如风、雨或噪声减弱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jonqos fil-qawwa jew fl-intensità, bħar-riħ, ix-xita jew l-istorbju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减弱；强度或程度降低。
逐渐平息；消退。
战胜；克服。
击倒；撞倒；使倒下。
减弱、消退或平息。
敲；击打；拍打。
碰倒；撞翻；击翻。

formal.mt: Ir-riħ batta matul il-lejl, u sa filgħodu l-kundizzjonijiet fuq il-baħar kienu tjiebu.
formal.en: The wind abated during the night, and by morning conditions at sea had improved.
formal.zh: 夜间风势减弱，到早晨海上状况已有改善。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Għadu jonfoħ ħafna barra? Luqa: Le, ir-riħ batta; nistgħu noħorġu għal mixja.
colloquial.en: Emma: Is it still very windy outside? Luqa: No, the wind has died down; we can go for a walk.
colloquial.zh: Emma：外面风还很大吗？Luqa：不大了，风已经减弱，我们可以出去散步了。

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: 外面风还很大吗？
messages.en: Is it still very windy outside?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ir-riħ batta; nistgħu noħorġu għal mixja.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ir-riħ batta; nistgħu noħorġu għal mixja.
messages.zh: 不大了，风已经减弱，我们可以出去散步了。
messages.en: No, the wind has died down; we can go for a walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 batta 放在“风声慢慢变小”的画面里记减弱义；双写 t 要看清，再把战胜、击倒和敲打分别配上动作画面。

gloss_zh: 倒空；清空；耗尽；腾空；排便；空的；空置的

teaching_sense.en_definition: To empty something by taking out its contents, or to clear a place so that it is no longer occupied.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 取出或移走某物中的内容，使其变空；也可指腾出原先有人占用的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa dak li kien hemm f'xi ħaġa biex iħalliha vojta, jew ħalla post mingħajr nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倒空；使变空。

sense_translations.en_definition: to remove the contents of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 取出或清除某物中的内容。
耗尽；使储量或资源枯竭。
腾出；撤离原先占用的地方。
排便；排空肠道。
空的；里面没有东西的。
空着的；无人占用的。
荒废的；弃置失修的。
空置或空缺的，如房屋无人居住、职位尚无人担任。

formal.mt: Qabel it-tindif, il-ħaddiem battal il-kamra u poġġa l-għamara fil-kuritur.
formal.en: Before cleaning, the worker cleared out the room and put the furniture in the corridor.
formal.zh: 清洁前，工人腾空了房间，把家具放在走廊里。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min battal il-kexxun? Pawlu: Jien battaltu biex nagħmel spazju għall-kotba.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who emptied the drawer? Pawlu: I emptied it to make room for the books.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：谁把抽屉清空了？保罗：我清空的，为了腾地方放书。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把抽屉清空了？
messages.en: Who emptied the drawer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien battaltu biex nagħmel spazju għall-kotba.
messages.mt_standard: Jien battaltu biex nagħmel spazju għall-kotba.
messages.zh: 我清空的，为了腾地方放书。
messages.en: I emptied it to make room for the books.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 battal 连到“清空前后”的画面：桶里的水倒掉、抽屉里的东西取出、房间里的物品搬走，核心都是使原有内容离开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover a wall with plaster, forming a smooth or protective surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在墙面上涂抹灰浆，形成平整或具有保护作用的表层。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kesa ħajt b'saff ta' tikħil biex jagħmel il-wiċċ lixx jew jipproteġih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给墙壁抹灰；用灰浆覆盖墙面。

sense_translations.en_definition: a plasterer (especially sb. who plasters the inside of wells or cisterns)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 抹灰工，尤指给井或蓄水池内壁抹灰的人。
给墙壁抹灰；在墙面上涂抹灰浆。

collocations.en: plastered the walls of the room
plastered the walls of the cistern
collocations.zh: 给蓄水池的内壁抹了灰

formal.mt: Waqt ix-xogħol ta' tiswija, il-ħaddiem battam il-ħitan taċ-ċisterna b'saff ġdid ta' tikħil.
formal.en: During the repair work, the worker plastered the walls of the cistern with a new layer of plaster.
formal.zh: 维修期间，工人给蓄水池的内壁重新抹了一层灰浆。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min battam il-ħajt tal-kċina? Toni: Il-ħaddiem li ġie lbieraħ. Issa rridu nistennew sakemm jinxef.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who plastered the kitchen wall? Toni: The worker who came yesterday. Now we need to wait until it dries.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：厨房的墙是谁抹的灰？托尼：昨天来的工人。现在得等它干。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 厨房的墙是谁抹的灰？
messages.en: Who plastered the kitchen wall?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħaddiem li ġie lbieraħ. Issa rridu nistennew sakemm jinxef.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħaddiem li ġie lbieraħ. Issa rridu nistennew sakemm jinxef.
messages.zh: 昨天来的工人。现在得等它干。
messages.en: The worker who came yesterday. Now we need to wait until it dries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 battam 就想象工人拿着抹刀，把灰浆一层层抹在墙上；动词记动作，名词记做这项工作的人。

gloss_zh: 传来消息，通常为好消息；宣布

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring or announce news to someone, usually news that is welcome or good.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人传达或宣布消息，通常是令人高兴的好消息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wassal jew ħabbar aħbar lil xi ħadd, ġeneralment aħbar tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带来消息；通常指带来好消息。
宣布；告知消息。

sense_translations.en_definition: to announce, to bring news (usually of good news)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 宣布或传来消息，通常指好消息。

collocations.en: announced that he had passed the exam
announced that the work was finished

formal.mt: Id-direttur baxar lill-impjegati li l-proġett kien ġie approvat.
formal.en: The director announced to the employees that the project had been approved.
formal.zh: 主任向员工宣布，项目已经获批。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min baxar lill-familja li għaddejt mill-eżami? Mark: Jien! Kienu kollha ferħanin għalik.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who told the family the good news that I passed the exam? Mark: I did! They were all happy for you.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁把我考试通过的好消息告诉家里人了？马克：我呀！他们都为你高兴。

messages.speaker: Nina (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Min baxar lill-familja li għaddejt mill-eżami?
messages.mt_standard: Min baxar lill-familja li għaddejt mill-eżami?
messages.zh: 谁把我考试通过的好消息告诉家里人了？
messages.en: Who told the family the good news that I passed the exam?

messages.speaker: Mark (弟弟)
messages.zh: 我呀！他们都为你高兴。
messages.en: I did! They were all happy for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baxar 放进“考试通过，赶快报喜”的场景：先有值得分享的消息，再把消息告诉别人；好消息是常见语境。

gloss_zh: 低的；浅的；粗俗的；低下的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Low in height, level, or intensity; when describing water, shallow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 高度、水平或强度低的；形容水时表示水浅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu għoli, livell jew intensità żgħira; meta jingħad għall-ilma, ifisser li mhuwiex fond.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 低的；高度、水平或强度较小的。
浅的；用于形容水不深。
粗俗的；庸俗或低俗的。
低的；处于低处或较低位置的。

formal.mt: F'din iż-żona l-ilma huwa baxx, iżda l-viżitaturi għandhom joqogħdu attenti għall-blat.
formal.en: The water in this area is shallow, but visitors should watch out for rocks.
formal.zh: 这一区域的水较浅，但游客仍应留意岩石。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed titkellem b'leħen baxx? Luqa: Għax it-tarbija rieqda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you speaking so quietly? Luqa: Because the baby is asleep.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么这么小声说话？卢卡：因为宝宝睡着了。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 你为什么这么小声说话？
messages.en: Why are you speaking so quietly?

messages.speaker: Luqa (家人)
messages.zh: 因为宝宝睡着了。
messages.en: Because the baby is asleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 baxx 配一支向下的箭头：声音低、价格低、水深小。遇到形容言行的语境，再联想到评价低俗。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something lower or smaller in level or intensity, or to reduce someone's dignity or status.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物的位置、水平或强度降低；也可指贬低他人的尊严或地位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Naqqas l-għoli, il-livell jew l-intensità ta' xi ħaġa, jew naqqas id-dinjità jew l-istatus ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使降低；把某物移到较低位置或调低其水平。
减小；减弱；使程度或数量减少。
贬低；使地位、价值或尊严降低。
羞辱；使人感到屈辱或丢脸。

formal.mt: Il-bejjiegħ baxxa l-prezz tal-prodott biex ikun aktar aċċessibbli għall-klijenti.
formal.en: The seller lowered the price of the product to make it more affordable for customers.
formal.zh: 卖家降低了产品价格，让顾客更容易负担。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Min baxxa l-volum tat-televixin? Ben: Jien. Kien għoli wisq u ma stajtx naqra.
colloquial.en: Emma: Who turned down the television volume? Ben: I did. It was too loud, and I couldn't read.
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：谁把电视音量调低了？本：我调的。刚才太吵，我没法看书。

messages.speaker: Emma (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把电视音量调低了？
messages.en: Who turned down the television volume?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Kien għoli wisq u ma stajtx naqra.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Kien għoli wisq u ma stajtx naqra.
messages.zh: 我调的。刚才太吵，我没法看书。
messages.en: I did. It was too loud, and I couldn't read.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baxxa 记成手正在往下调旋钮的动作：音量调低、价格降低；用于人时，则可能表示把人的尊严压低，也就是贬低或羞辱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give or announce news to someone, often bringing good news.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人传达或宣布消息，常用于带来好消息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta jew ħabbar aħbar lil xi ħadd, spiss aħbar tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 传达消息；把消息告诉别人。
宣布；宣告。
宣告者；发布或播报消息的人。
与 baxar 同义：宣布或传来消息，通常为好消息。

collocations.en: gave the news to his friends
announced that he was getting married

collocations.mt: baxxar li l-proġett kien ġie approvat
collocations.en: announced that the project had been approved

formal.mt: Il-kap tal-iskola baxxar lill-istudenti li l-librerija l-ġdida kienet se tiftaħ ix-xahar ta' wara.
formal.en: The headteacher announced to the students that the new library would open the following month.
formal.zh: 校长向学生宣布，新图书馆将于下个月开放。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ġanni baxxar lill-ħbieb li se jiżżewweġ! Anna: Xi aħbar sabiħa! Meta se jkun it-tieġ?
colloquial.en: Rita: Ġanni told his friends the good news that he's getting married! Anna: What lovely news! When is the wedding?
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：詹尼把自己要结婚的好消息告诉朋友们了！安娜：真是好消息！婚礼什么时候举行？

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġanni baxxar lill-ħbieb li se jiżżewweġ!
messages.mt_standard: Ġanni baxxar lill-ħbieb li se jiżżewweġ!
messages.zh: 詹尼把自己要结婚的好消息告诉朋友们了！
messages.en: Ġanni told his friends the good news that he's getting married!

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi aħbar sabiħa! Meta se jkun it-tieġ?
messages.mt_standard: Xi aħbar sabiħa! Meta se jkun it-tieġ?
messages.zh: 真是好消息！婚礼什么时候举行？
messages.en: What lovely news! When is the wedding?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baxxar 与“向大家宣布喜讯”的画面绑定，并和 baxar 一起记为近义词；看到名词用法时，改想站出来发布消息的那个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An academic degree awarded after completing an undergraduate programme of study.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 完成本科阶段课程后获得的学位，即学士学位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grad akkademiku mogħti wara t-tlestija ta' kors universitarju tal-ewwel livell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学士学位。
学士学位，完成本科课程后取得的学位。

formal.mt: Għal din il-pożizzjoni huwa meħtieġ grad ta' baċellerat fl-istorja.
formal.en: A bachelor's degree in history is required for this position.
formal.zh: 这一职位要求具备历史学学士学位。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'grad għandek? David: Għandi baċellerat fl-istorja.
colloquial.en: Sara: What degree do you have? David: I have a bachelor's degree in history.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你有什么学位？戴维：我有历史学学士学位。

messages.speaker: Sara (新同事)
messages.zh: 你有什么学位？
messages.en: What degree do you have?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.zh: 我有历史学学士学位。
messages.en: I have a bachelor's degree in history.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baċellerat 放进“本科毕业领取学位证”的画面中，再整块记住 grad ta' baċellerat，帮助直接联想到学士学位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a person or animal fatter or chubbier.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或动物长胖，或使其体态变得更加圆胖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel lil persuna jew annimal aktar smin jew imlaħħam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使长胖；把动物养肥。
使变得圆胖或肉乎乎的。

formal.mt: L-għalf il-ġdid baċċaċ l-għoġol matul ix-xitwa.
formal.en: The new feed fattened the calf over the winter.
formal.zh: 这种新饲料在冬季把小牛养肥了。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan l-għoġol sar aktar smin! Pawlu: Iva, l-għalf il-ġdid baċċaċ l-għoġol.
colloquial.en: Rita: This calf has grown fatter! Pawlu: Yes, the new feed fattened the calf.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这头小牛长胖了！保罗：是啊，新饲料把小牛养肥了。

messages.speaker: Rita (农场访客)
messages.zh: 这头小牛长胖了！
messages.en: This calf has grown fatter!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主)
messages.zh: 是啊，新饲料把小牛养肥了。
messages.en: Yes, the new feed fattened the calf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一头小牛在喂养前后由瘦变圆，把 baċċaċ 和“使它长胖”连起来，特别记住这是使对象发生变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Yellow Sea, used as the proper name of a sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 黄海，一个海域的专有名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem proprju tal-baħar magħruf bħala l-Baħar l-Isfar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄海。

collocations.en: a map of the Yellow Sea
the coast of the Yellow Sea

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi l-Baħar l-Isfar u l-kosta tiegħu b'mod ċar.
formal.en: The map clearly shows the Yellow Sea and its coast.
formal.zh: 这张地图清楚地标示了黄海及其海岸。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' turini l-Baħar l-Isfar fuq il-mappa? Pawlu: Iva, ara hawn ħdejn dan l-isem. Sara: Issa sibtu. Se nimmarkah fil-ktieb tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you show me the Yellow Sea on the map? Pawlu: Yes, look here beside this name. Sara: I've found it now. I'll mark it in my book.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你能在地图上指给我看黄海吗？Pawlu：可以，看这里，就在这个名称旁边。Sara：现在我找到了。我会在书上标出来。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' turini l-Baħar l-Isfar fuq il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' turini l-Baħar l-Isfar fuq il-mappa?
messages.zh: 你能在地图上指给我看黄海吗？
messages.en: Can you show me the Yellow Sea on the map?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara hawn ħdejn dan l-isem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara hawn ħdejn dan l-isem.
messages.zh: 可以，看这里，就在这个名称旁边。
messages.en: Yes, look here beside this name.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa sibtu. Se nimmarkah fil-ktieb tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Issa sibtu. Se nimmarkah fil-ktieb tiegħi.
messages.zh: 现在我找到了。我会在书上标出来。
messages.en: I've found it now. I'll mark it in my book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地图上的黄海位置贴一张 Baħar l-Isfar 标签，反复练习 fil-Baħar l-Isfar（在黄海），把专名与位置场景连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak badly of someone, make slanderous statements, or suggest something damaging indirectly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说某人的坏话、作出诽谤性陈述，或用暗示的方式损害他人的名声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid kliem ħażin fuq xi ħadd, jimmalafamah, jew jagħmel insinwazzjonijiet li jagħmlu ħsara lir-reputazzjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说某人的坏话；贬损他人。
诽谤；用不实言论损害他人的名声。
含沙射影；作出带有贬损意味的暗示。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru baħat lill-ġar tiegħu u xerred stejjer foloz dwaru.
formal.en: In the novel, the character slandered his neighbour and spread false stories about him.
formal.zh: 在小说中，这个人物诽谤自己的邻居，并散布关于他的虚假故事。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex irrabja Toni? Sara: Għax xi ħadd baħat lilu quddiem sħabu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did Toni get angry? Sara: Because someone bad-mouthed him in front of his friends.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Toni 为什么生气了？Sara：因为有人当着他朋友的面说他的坏话。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: Toni 为什么生气了？
messages.en: Why did Toni get angry?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax xi ħadd baħat lilu quddiem sħabu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax xi ħadd baħat lilu quddiem sħabu.
messages.zh: 因为有人当着他朋友的面说他的坏话。
messages.en: Because someone bad-mouthed him in front of his friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三格画面记忆：背后说坏话、编造诽谤、拐弯暗示；共同点都是用言语损人名声。

gloss_zh: 洗涤；用大量水冲洗；吹宝螺壳

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wash or rinse something, especially with plenty of water; also, to blow through a cowrie shell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 洗涤或冲洗物品，尤其指用大量水冲洗；另有向宝螺壳内吹气的意思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħsel jew ilaħlaħ xi ħaġa, speċjalment b'ħafna ilma; jista' jfisser ukoll jonfoħ minn ġo qoxra ta' bebbuxu tal-baħar tat-tip cowrie.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洗；洗涤。

sense_translations.en_definition: to rinse using a lot of water
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用大量水冲洗；充分漂洗。

sense_translations.en_definition: to blow through a cowrie shell
sense_translations.zh_definition: 向宝螺壳内吹气，使气流穿过贝壳。
洗涤；冲洗；漂洗。

collocations.en: rinsed the clothes with plenty of water

formal.mt: Wara l-ħasil, il-ħaddiem baħbaħ il-kontenituri b'ħafna ilma nadif.
formal.en: After washing them, the worker rinsed the containers with plenty of clean water.
formal.zh: 洗涤之后，工作人员用大量清水充分冲洗了这些容器。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min baħbaħ it-tazzi? Luqa: Jien. Użajt ilma nadif u poġġejthom jinxfu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who rinsed the glasses? Luqa: I did. I used clean water and left them to dry.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁冲洗了这些玻璃杯？Luqa：我洗的。我用了清水，然后把它们放着晾干。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁冲洗了这些玻璃杯？
messages.en: Who rinsed the glasses?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Użajt ilma nadif u poġġejthom jinxfu.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Użajt ilma nadif u poġġejthom jinxfu.
messages.zh: 我洗的。我用了清水，然后把它们放着晾干。
messages.en: I did. I used clean water and left them to dry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想水哗哗流过杯子的冲洗画面；再单独记住吹宝螺壳这一义项，避免把不同动作混为一谈。

gloss_zh: 随和好相处的人；天真质朴的人；宝螺贝壳

teaching_sense.en_definition: A good-natured, friendly or ingenuous person; in a separate sense, cowrie shells.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 性情温厚、待人热情或天真质朴的人；另一个独立义项指宝螺贝壳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna ta' qalb tajba, soċjevoli jew sempliċi u sinċiera; f'tifsira oħra, qxur tal-baħar tat-tip cowrie.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 性情温厚、和善好相处的人。
天真质朴、坦率而不工于心计的人。
宝螺；宝螺贝壳。
待人热络、见面就能亲切交谈的人。

collocations.en: a good-natured person always ready to help
collocations.zh: 总是乐于助人的随和之人

collocations.en: a friendly fellow who talks to everyone
collocations.zh: 和谁都能聊起来的热情之人

formal.mt: L-awtur jippreżenta lil Toni bħala baħbuħ li jilqa' lil kulħadd u jgħin lill-ġirien.
formal.en: The author presents Toni as a good-natured fellow who welcomes everyone and helps his neighbours.
formal.zh: 作者把 Toni 塑造成一个性情和善的人，他热情迎接每个人，也帮助邻居。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif sibtu lill-ġar il-ġdid? Ben: Baħbuħ! Qagħad jitkellem magħna u offra li jgħinna.
colloquial.en: Anna: What did you think of the new neighbour? Ben: A friendly fellow! He stayed and chatted with us and offered to help.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你觉得新邻居怎么样？Ben：是个热情随和的人！他留下来和我们聊天，还主动提出帮忙。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 你觉得新邻居怎么样？
messages.en: What did you think of the new neighbour?

messages.speaker: Ben (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Baħbuħ! Qagħad jitkellem magħna u offra li jgħinna.
messages.mt_standard: Baħbuħ! Qagħad jitkellem magħna u offra li jgħinna.
messages.zh: 是个热情随和的人！他留下来和我们聊天，还主动提出帮忙。
messages.en: A friendly fellow! He stayed and chatted with us and offered to help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给单词做两张图卡：一张画笑着迎人的随和邻居，一张画宝螺贝壳；按语境选择义项，不强行联系来源。

gloss_zh: 做傻事；愚笨的；傻乎乎的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave foolishly or act without sensible judgment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 举止愚蠢，或做事缺乏明智的判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu b'mod iblah jew jaġixxi mingħajr ġudizzju tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做傻事；作出愚蠢的举动。
愚笨的；形容人欠缺判断力或做事糊涂。
愚蠢至极的；形容人时带有贬损意味。
愚笨的人；做事糊涂的人。
傻乎乎的人；举止可笑的人。
头脑简单的；愚笨的；不明智的。

collocations.en: acted foolishly in front of his friends

formal.mt: Fil-ħrafa, ir-raġel baħnan emmen kull wegħda mingħajr ma staqsa ebda mistoqsija.
formal.en: In the fable, the foolish man believed every promise without asking any questions.
formal.zh: 在寓言中，那个愚笨的男人不问任何问题，别人作出的每个承诺他都相信。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex baħnan hekk quddiem sħabu? Ġanni: Ried idaħħaqhom, imma ma ħasibx fil-konsegwenzi.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did he act so foolishly in front of his friends? Ġanni: He wanted to make them laugh, but he did not think about the consequences.
colloquial.zh: Marta：他为什么在朋友面前做出那样的傻事？Ġanni：他想逗大家笑，却没有考虑后果。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么在朋友面前做出那样的傻事？
messages.en: Why did he act so foolishly in front of his friends?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried idaħħaqhom, imma ma ħasibx fil-konsegwenzi.
messages.mt_standard: Ried idaħħaqhom, imma ma ħasibx fil-konsegwenzi.
messages.zh: 他想逗大家笑，却没有考虑后果。
messages.en: He wanted to make them laugh, but he did not think about the consequences.

cognitive_memory_aid: 围绕“傻”做三张语法卡：动词是做傻事，形容词是愚笨的，名词是傻乎乎的人；称呼别人时可能带贬义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A foolish or silly action that shows poor judgment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现出判断欠佳的愚蠢举动或傻事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għemil iblah jew azzjoni li turi nuqqas ta' ġudizzju tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一件傻事；一个愚蠢的举动。
愚蠢的行为；傻乎乎的举动。

formal.mt: Li jitħassru d-dokumenti kollha mingħajr kopja ta' riżerva kienet baħnanata kbira.
formal.en: Deleting all the documents without a backup was a very foolish act.
formal.zh: 没有备份就删除全部文件，是一个很愚蠢的举动。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għamilt baħnanata: ħallejt iċ-ċwievet ġewwa u għalaqt il-bieb. David: Għandek ċavetta oħra għand oħtok?
colloquial.en: Elena: I did something foolish: I left the keys inside and shut the door. David: Do you have another key at your sister's?
colloquial.zh: Elena：我做了件傻事：把钥匙留在屋里就关上了门。David：你姐姐或妹妹那里有备用钥匙吗？

messages.speaker: Elena (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt baħnanata: ħallejt iċ-ċwievet ġewwa u għalaqt il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt baħnanata: ħallejt iċ-ċwievet ġewwa u għalaqt il-bieb.
messages.zh: 我做了件傻事：把钥匙留在屋里就关上了门。
messages.en: I did something foolish: I left the keys inside and shut the door.

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.zh: 你姐姐或妹妹那里有备用钥匙吗？
messages.en: Do you have another key at your sister's?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象关门后才发现钥匙还在屋里，指着刚才那个举动说“这是一件傻事”，把词义落在行为上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who works on a ship, especially as a member of its crew.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在船上工作的人，尤指作为船员从事航行工作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem fuq vapur, speċjalment bħala membru tal-ekwipaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一名水手。
一名海员；从事海上航行的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: related to the sea or to navigation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与海洋或航海有关的。
水手；船员。
海事的；海上的；与航海有关的。

collocations.en: a sailor on a cargo ship

formal.mt: Il-baħri ċċekkja l-ħbula qabel ma l-vapur telaq mill-port.
formal.en: The sailor checked the ropes before the ship left the harbour.
formal.zh: 船离港前，水手检查了缆绳。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk x'jagħmel? Pawlu: Hu baħri u jaħdem fuq vapur tal-merkanzija.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does your brother do? Pawlu: He's a sailor and works on a cargo ship.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你兄弟做什么工作？保罗：他是海员，在一艘货船上工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟做什么工作？
messages.en: What does your brother do?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu baħri u jaħdem fuq vapur tal-merkanzija.
messages.mt_standard: Hu baħri u jaħdem fuq vapur tal-merkanzija.
messages.zh: 他是海员，在一艘货船上工作。
messages.en: He's a sailor and works on a cargo ship.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baħri 放进“船员拉紧缆绳”的画面来记；指人时是水手或海员，作形容词时表示与海洋、航海有关。

gloss_zh: 空无；空荡；走后留下的空落；没了！

teaching_sense.en_definition: Emptiness or a void, especially the empty state left when someone or something has gone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 空无或空荡的状态，尤其指人离开或东西消失后留下的空落。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vojt jew stat ta' post abbandunat, speċjalment wara li xi ħadd ikun telaq jew xi ħaġa tkun għebet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 空无；空荡的状态。
空白；空无之境。

sense_translations.en_definition: the aftermath of a departure or disappearance (used especially in children's language)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 人离去或东西消失后留下的空落状态，尤用于儿童语言。

sense_translations.en_definition: void, emptiness, a state of being deserted
sense_translations.zh_definition: 空无、空荡或空无一人的荒寂状态。
跑掉啦！没啦！全没啦！

formal.mt: L-awtriċi tiddeskrivi l-baħħ tad-dar wara t-tluq tal-familja.
formal.en: The author describes the emptiness of the house after the family's departure.
formal.zh: 作者描写了那家人离开后屋子里的空荡景象。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fejn mar il-bużżieqa? Omm: Baħħ! Tar 'il bogħod.
colloquial.en: Lina: Where did the balloon go? Mum: All gone! It flew away.
colloquial.zh: Lina：气球到哪里去了？妈妈：没啦！它飞走了。

messages.speaker: Lina (孩子)
messages.zh: 气球到哪里去了？
messages.en: Where did the balloon go?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 没啦！它飞走了。
messages.en: All gone! It flew away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象气球飞走后手里空空的：名词记“空无”，对孩子喊出的感叹词则记“没啦”。

gloss_zh: 熏蒸；用橄榄枝烟驱邪；航行；水手

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fumigate a place, including using olive-branch fumes for exorcism; in a separate sense, to sail or navigate at sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对场所进行熏蒸，也可指用橄榄枝的烟驱邪；另一个独立义项是乘船航行或在海上驾驶船只。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juża d-duħħan biex jiffumiga post jew biex ikeċċi l-ħażen bid-duħħan tal-friegħi taż-żebbuġ; f'tifsira oħra, jivvjaġġa jew imexxi bastiment fuq il-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 熏蒸；用烟气或熏蒸气体处理场所。

sense_translations.en_definition: to exorcise using the fumes from olive branches
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用橄榄枝产生的烟驱邪。
乘船航行；驾船航行。
在海洋上航行；驾驶船只航海。
水手；船员。
海员；航海者。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb who fumigates a place using the fumes from olive branches
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用橄榄枝的烟熏蒸场所的人。

formal.mt: Il-kaptan baħħar lejn il-gżira u wasal fil-port qabel niżlet ix-xemx.
formal.en: The captain sailed towards the island and reached the harbour before sunset.
formal.zh: 船长驾船驶向岛屿，并在日落前抵达港口。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Missierek x'kien jagħmel? Sam: Kien baħħar. Għal ħafna snin ħadem fuq vapuri kbar.
colloquial.en: Rita: What did your father do? Sam: He was a sailor. He worked on large ships for many years.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你父亲以前做什么工作？Sam：他是海员，在大船上工作了很多年。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你父亲以前做什么工作？
messages.en: What did your father do?

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien baħħar. Għal ħafna snin ħadem fuq vapuri kbar.
messages.mt_standard: Kien baħħar. Għal ħafna snin ħadem fuq vapuri kbar.
messages.zh: 他是海员，在大船上工作了很多年。
messages.en: He was a sailor. He worked on large ships for many years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时分成烟雾与海船两组画面，再看句法：做动作可指熏蒸或航行，指人时可指海员或熏蒸者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A supporting base or foundation, or the grounds on which an idea, argument, or activity rests.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支撑某物的底座或基础；也指思想、论证或活动所依据的根据。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti li fuqha tistrieħ xi ħaġa, jew is-sisien li fuqhom jinbnew idea, argument jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 底座；基础；基地，具体含义由语境决定。

sense_translations.en_definition: basis or ground (e.g. for an argument)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 基础；根据；依据，例如支撑论证的理由或事实。
底部的支撑或基础；也可指某事所依据的根据。

collocations.en: on the basis of these facts

formal.mt: Id-deċiżjoni ttieħdet fuq il-bażi tad-data miġbura matul is-sena.
formal.en: The decision was made on the basis of the data collected during the year.
formal.zh: 这项决定是依据全年收集的数据作出的。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Din il-mejda titbandal. Il-bażi tagħha mhix soda. David: Ejja nqiegħduha fuq art aktar ċatta.
colloquial.en: Marta: This table wobbles. Its base isn't stable. David: Let's put it on a more level floor.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这张桌子晃来晃去，底座不稳。戴维：我们把它放到更平的地面上吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-mejda titbandal. Il-bażi tagħha mhix soda.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-mejda titbandal. Il-bażi tagħha mhix soda.
messages.zh: 这张桌子晃来晃去，底座不稳。
messages.en: This table wobbles. Its base isn't stable.

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nqiegħduha fuq art aktar ċatta.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nqiegħduha fuq art aktar ċatta.
messages.zh: 我们把它放到更平的地面上吧。
messages.en: Let's put it on a more level floor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bażi 想成托住东西的底座：实物靠底座站稳，论证靠事实站稳。再把 fuq il-bażi ta' 整体记成“依据”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In the most essential or general terms, leaving aside smaller details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从最基本或总体的层面来说，暂且略去较小的细节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jiġbor l-aktar punti essenzjali jew ġenerali, mingħajr ma jidħol fid-dettalji żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 基本上；从根本上说；用于概括最主要的情况或意思。

formal.mt: Bażikament, il-proposta għandha l-għan li tnaqqas il-ħin ta' stennija u ttejjeb is-servizz.
formal.en: Basically, the proposal aims to reduce waiting times and improve the service.
formal.zh: 基本上，这项提案旨在缩短等候时间并改善服务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għandna nagħmlu għall-festa? Mark: Bażikament, għandna bżonn nixtru l-ikel u nħejju l-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do we need to do for the party? Mark: Basically, we need to buy the food and set up the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：聚会要准备些什么？马克：基本上，我们需要买食物，再把桌子布置好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 聚会要准备些什么？
messages.en: What do we need to do for the party?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bażikament, għandna bżonn nixtru l-ikel u nħejju l-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Bażikament, għandna bżonn nixtru l-ikel u nħejju l-mejda.
messages.zh: 基本上，我们需要买食物，再把桌子布置好。
messages.en: Basically, we need to buy the food and set up the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bażikament 想成说话前先按下“只讲要点”按钮：后面概括基本情况，细节可以稍后补充；常可译为“基本上”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Forming the foundation of something or covering its simplest, essential elements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 构成事物基础的，或涉及最简单、最必要内容的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jifforma l-pedament ta' xi ħaġa jew jittratta l-elementi l-aktar sempliċi u essenzjali tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 基本的；基础的；涉及必要入门内容的。

formal.mt: Dan il-kors jipprovdi għarfien bażiku tal-lingwa Maltija.
formal.en: This course provides basic knowledge of the Maltese language.
formal.zh: 本课程提供马耳他语基础知识。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kors diffiċli? Mark: Le, huwa kors bażiku. Nibdew mill-affarijiet sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this course difficult? Mark: No, it is a basic course. We start with simple things.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这门课难吗？马克：不难，是基础课程。我们从简单的内容开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (学员)
messages.zh: 这门课难吗？
messages.en: Is this course difficult?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa kors bażiku. Nibdew mill-affarijiet sempliċi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa kors bażiku. Nibdew mill-affarijiet sempliċi.
messages.zh: 不难，是基础课程。我们从简单的内容开始。
messages.en: No, it is a basic course. We start with simple things.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bażiku 放在入门课的封面上记忆：先学基础，再学复杂内容。

gloss_zh: 偏执而不容异见的人；衣着寒酸邋遢的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is intolerant of other views; in another sense, a person who is shabbily dressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指固执己见、不能容忍不同观点的人；另一个义项指衣着寒酸或邋遢的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ma tittollerax fehmiet differenti; f'sens ieħor, persuna liebsa ħwejjeġ żdingati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偏执而排斥异见的人；不能容忍不同信念或观点的人。
穿着破旧、寒酸或邋遢的人。

collocations.zh: 不能容忍异见的偏执者

formal.mt: Fil-kitba, il-kelma 'bażokk' tista' tindika persuna intolleranti jew persuna liebsa ħwejjeġ żdingati; il-kuntest jiddistingwi ż-żewġ tifsiriet.
formal.en: In writing, the word 'bażokk' can indicate an intolerant person or a shabbily dressed person; context distinguishes the two meanings.
formal.zh: 在书面语中，bażokk 可以指不能容忍异见的人，也可以指衣着寒酸邋遢的人；两种含义依靠语境区分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta għedt 'bażokk', kont qed titkellem fuq ħwejġu? Mark: Iva, fuq ħwejġu biss, mhux fuq il-fehmiet tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: When you said 'bażokk', were you talking about his clothes? Mark: Yes, only about his clothes, not his views.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你说 bażokk 时，是在说他的衣着吗？马克：对，只说他的衣着，没有说他的观点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta għedt 'bażokk', kont qed titkellem fuq ħwejġu?
messages.mt_standard: Meta għedt 'bażokk', kont qed titkellem fuq ħwejġu?
messages.zh: 你说 bażokk 时，是在说他的衣着吗？
messages.en: When you said 'bażokk', were you talking about his clothes?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fuq ħwejġu biss, mhux fuq il-fehmiet tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fuq ħwejġu biss, mhux fuq il-fehmiet tiegħu.
messages.zh: 对，只说他的衣着，没有说他的观点。
messages.en: Yes, only about his clothes, not his views.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 bażokk 画两张人物卡：一张拒听异见，一张衣着破旧；按上下文选择对应含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rupture, or a hernia in which internal tissue protrudes through a weak point in the surrounding tissue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指破裂；也指疝，即内部组织经周围组织薄弱处突出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qsim jew ftuq; fil-każ ta' ftuq, tessut intern joħroġ minn parti dgħajfa tat-tessut ta' madwaru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破裂；组织发生裂开或破损的情况。
疝；通常称为疝气，指内部组织经周围组织薄弱处突出。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport mediku, il-kelma 'bażwa' tirreferi għal ftuq.
formal.en: In the medical report, the word 'bażwa' refers to a hernia.
formal.zh: 在这份医疗报告中，bażwa 指疝气。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi 'bażwa'? Mark: F'din is-sentenza tfisser ftuq.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is a 'bażwa'? Mark: In this sentence it means a hernia.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：bażwa 是什么？马克：在这个句子里，它的意思是疝气。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: bażwa 是什么？
messages.en: What is a 'bażwa'?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 在这个句子里，它的意思是疝气。
messages.en: In this sentence it means a hernia.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bażwa 与“破裂、疝气”并排写在身体词汇卡上，用组织薄弱处鼓出的示意图辅助记忆。

gloss_zh: 把活干糟；使疲惫、变形或混乱；引起疝气；笨拙的工人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To carry out a task clumsily or badly, leaving the work poorly done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 笨拙或草率地执行任务，把工作做坏或做得不成样子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel biċċa xogħol bla sengħa jew b'mod goff, b'riżultat ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人筋疲力尽；把某人累垮。
笨手笨脚地完成某项任务。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause sth. to become disfigured or misshapen
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物外形受损、变形或走样。
工作能力差或工作质量低劣的工人。
常把自己的工作做坏、搞砸的人。
引起疝气；使发生疝。
干出粗糙笨拙的活；做工拙劣。
说话混乱；表达得颠三倒四。
使人困惑、慌乱或不知所措。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem bażwar ix-xogħol tat-tiswija, u l-mejda baqgħet ma toqgħodx dritta.
formal.en: The worker botched the repair, and the table still did not stand straight.
formal.zh: 工人把修理工作做砸了，桌子依然立不正。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-mejda għadha mgħawġa? Mark: Iva, min sewwieha bażwar ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the table still crooked? Mark: Yes, whoever repaired it botched the job.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：桌子还是歪的吗？马克：对，修理的人把活干砸了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 桌子还是歪的吗？
messages.en: Is the table still crooked?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 对，修理的人把活干砸了。
messages.en: Yes, whoever repaired it botched the job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“修桌子却越修越歪”的画面记 bażwar 的做坏义；另列疲惫、变形、说乱、慌乱和疝气义，名词另记为干活差的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rub a surface with a cloth or tool to make it smooth and shiny.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用布或工具摩擦物体表面，使其光滑并有光泽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jogħrok wiċċ b'ċarruta jew b'għodda biex jagħmlu lixx u jleqq.

sense_translations.en_definition: to buff (to polish and make shiny)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 抛光；通过擦拭或打磨使物体表面发亮。

formal.mt: It-tekniku bbaffja l-wiċċ tal-metall b'ċarruta ratba sakemm beda jleqq.
formal.en: The technician buffed the metal surface with a soft cloth until it began to shine.
formal.zh: 技术人员用软布擦亮金属表面，直到它开始泛出光泽。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-karozza tleqq ħafna! Min bbaffjaha? Mark: Missieri bbaffjaha dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: The car is really shiny! Who buffed it? Mark: My father buffed it this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这辆车真亮！谁给它抛的光？Mark：我爸爸今天早上给它抛了光。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这辆车真亮！谁给它抛的光？
messages.en: The car is really shiny! Who buffed it?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我爸爸今天早上给它抛了光。
messages.en: My father buffed it this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用软布反复擦车，车身亮得能照出人影；把这个“擦出光泽”的动作与 bbaffja 一起记。

gloss_zh: 以……为依据；建立在……之上；奠基

teaching_sense.en_definition: To use something as the basis or foundation for a decision, argument, or other work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某事物作为决定、论证或其他工作的依据或基础。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juża xi ħaġa bħala bażi jew pedament għal deċiżjoni, argument jew xogħol ieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: to base, to ground, to found
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以……为基础或依据；奠定基础；建立。

collocations.en: based the decision on the facts
collocations.zh: 以事实为依据作出了决定
以证据为基础提出了论点

formal.mt: Il-kumitat bbaża d-deċiżjoni tiegħu fuq ir-riżultati tal-istudju.
formal.en: The committee based its decision on the results of the study.
formal.zh: 委员会依据研究结果作出了决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq xiex bbaża d-deċiżjoni tiegħu Mark? Lara: Fuq il-prezz. Għażel l-orħos waħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Mark base his decision on? Lara: The price. He chose the cheapest one.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 是根据什么作出决定的？Lara：价格。他选了最便宜的那个。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex bbaża d-deċiżjoni tiegħu Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex bbaża d-deċiżjoni tiegħu Mark?
messages.zh: Mark 是根据什么作出决定的？
messages.en: What did Mark base his decision on?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 价格。他选了最便宜的那个。
messages.en: The price. He chose the cheapest one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把决定想成一座房子，把事实想成地基；用“把决定建在事实之上”的画面记住 bbaża，并连同 fuq 一起练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put a liquid or other product into bottles for storage or sale.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把液体或其他产品装入瓶中，以便储存或销售。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed likwidu jew prodott ieħor fi fliexken biex jinħażen jew jinbiegħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把……装入瓶中；装瓶。

formal.mt: Il-produttur bbottilja ż-żejt fi fliexken tal-ħġieġ skur biex jipproteġih mid-dawl.
formal.en: The producer bottled the oil in dark glass bottles to protect it from light.
formal.zh: 生产者把油装入深色玻璃瓶中，以免受到光照。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min bbottilja dan il-meraq? Mark: Ħija. Hemm flixkun għalik ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who bottled this juice? Mark: My brother. There's a bottle for you too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把这些果汁装瓶的？Mark：我哥哥。也有一瓶是给你的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把这些果汁装瓶的？
messages.en: Who bottled this juice?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我哥哥。也有一瓶是给你的。
messages.en: My brother. There's a bottle for you too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象漏斗插在瓶口，果汁一瓶一瓶灌进去；用完整的“把液体装进瓶子”动作记住 bbottilja。

gloss_zh: 小小的开端；微小的起步

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small or modest beginning, before something develops further.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事情尚未进一步发展时，一个规模很小或不起眼的开端。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidu żgħir jew umli ta' xi ħaġa, qabel ma tiżviluppa aktar.

sense_translations.en_definition: a modest beginning (the diminutive form of 'beda')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个微小、不起眼的开端（'beda' 的指小形式）。
小小的开始；规模有限的起步。

formal.mt: Il-proġett kellu bdejju umli: tliet persuni biss ħadu sehem fl-ewwel laqgħa.
formal.en: The project had a modest beginning: only three people took part in the first meeting.
formal.zh: 这个项目起步时规模很小：第一次会议只有三个人参加。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad għandna biss żewġ paġni. Mark: Mhux ħażin! Huwa bdejju tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: We still have only two pages. Mark: Not bad! It is a good small beginning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们目前还只有两页。马克：不错了！这是个良好的小小开端。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 我们目前还只有两页。
messages.en: We still have only two pages.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 不错了！这是个良好的小小开端。
messages.en: Not bad! It is a good small beginning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bdejju 想成刚写下的两页草稿：成果虽小，已经是一个值得继续的开端。

gloss_zh: 替换；改变；改变主意；让步

teaching_sense.en_definition: To change one's opinion or become less firm in one's position and relent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 改变原来的意见，或不再坚持原先的立场而作出让步。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ibiddel il-fehma tiegħu jew ma jibqax jinsisti fuq il-pożizzjoni li kellu qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 替换；以另一个人或事物取代原有的人或事物。
改变，例如改变意见或看法。
替代；用一个人或事物代替另一个。

sense_translations.en_definition: to change one's opinion, to relent
sense_translations.zh_definition: 改变主意；放松原先坚持的立场而让步。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-verb 'bdiel' jintuża fis-sens ta' bidla fil-fehma jew ta' ċediment minn pożizzjoni preċedenti.
formal.en: In this exercise, the verb 'bdiel' is used in the sense of changing one's opinion or relenting from a previous position.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，动词 bdiel 用来表达改变意见，或不再坚持原先立场而让步。

colloquial.mt: Maja: 'Bdiel' hawn ifisser li biddel fehmtu? Mark: Iva, ma baqax jinsisti fuq dak li ried qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does 'bdiel' here mean that he changed his mind? Mark: Yes, he stopped insisting on what he had wanted before.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 bdiel 是说他改变主意了吗？马克：对，他不再坚持先前想要的东西了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 bdiel 是说他改变主意了吗？
messages.en: Does 'bdiel' here mean that he changed his mind?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma baqax jinsisti fuq dak li ried qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma baqax jinsisti fuq dak li ried qabel.
messages.zh: 对，他不再坚持先前想要的东西了。
messages.en: Yes, he stopped insisting on what he had wanted before.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 bdiel 配一幅修改意见的画面：把旧选择换成新选择，再联想到改变主意和让步。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The formal recognition by the Catholic Church of a deceased person as blessed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天主教会正式宣布一位已故人士为真福的行为或程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih il-Knisja Kattolika tiddikjara persuna mejta bħala beata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他语。
宣福；列福品，即天主教会正式宣布已故人士为真福。

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddeskrivi ċ-ċerimonja tal-beatifikazzjoni u jispjega t-tifsira tagħha għall-komunità.
formal.en: The article describes the beatification ceremony and explains its significance for the community.
formal.zh: 这篇文章介绍了宣福典礼，并解释了它对该团体的意义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi beatifikazzjoni? Mark: Hija meta l-Knisja tiddikjara persuna mejta bħala beata.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is beatification? Mark: It is when the Church declares a deceased person blessed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：什么是宣福？马克：就是教会宣布一位已故人士为真福。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 什么是宣福？
messages.en: What is beatification?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija meta l-Knisja tiddikjara persuna mejta bħala beata.
messages.mt_standard: Hija meta l-Knisja tiddikjara persuna mejta bħala beata.
messages.zh: 就是教会宣布一位已故人士为真福。
messages.en: It is when the Church declares a deceased person blessed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 beatifikazzjoni 与“教会正式宣布真福”的典礼场景一起记忆，抓住宣告和真福两个要点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small animal with a soft body and a spiral shell that moves slowly; it may live on land or in water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体柔软、通常背着螺旋形外壳并缓慢移动的小动物，可指陆地蜗牛或水中的螺类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir b'ġisem artab u qoxra f'għamla ta' spirali li jimxi bil-mod; jista' jgħix fuq l-art jew fl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜗牛。
一只蜗牛。
一只海螺；生活在海中的螺类动物。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, l-istudenti osservaw il-bebbux fil-ġnien mingħajr ma messewh.
formal.en: After the rain, the students observed the snails in the garden without touching them.
formal.zh: 雨后，学生们在花园里观察蜗牛，没有触碰它们。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm hemm bebbux ħdejn il-bieb! Mark: Iva, oqgħod attenta fejn tirfes.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how many snails there are by the door! Mark: Yes, watch where you step.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看，门旁边有好多蜗牛！Mark：是啊，留意脚下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hemm bebbux ħdejn il-bieb!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hemm bebbux ħdejn il-bieb!
messages.zh: 看，门旁边有好多蜗牛！
messages.en: Look how many snails there are by the door!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，留意脚下。
messages.en: Yes, watch where you step.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一只背着螺旋小房子的蜗牛，在旁边写 bebbux；再画海浪，配上 tal-baħar，帮助区分海螺语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To begin or start an activity, event, or process.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始某项活动、事件或过程；着手做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti bidu għal attività, avveniment jew proċess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始；进入某事的起始阶段。
开始；着手进行。
开始；使某项活动或过程启动。

formal.mt: Il-kors beda nhar it-Tnejn b'laqgħa ta' introduzzjoni għall-istudenti l-ġodda.
formal.en: The course began on Monday with an introductory meeting for the new students.
formal.zh: 课程于星期一开始，首先为新生举行了一场介绍会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-film beda diġà? Mark: Iva, beda ħames minuti ilu. Ejja nidħlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the film started already? Mark: Yes, it started five minutes ago. Let's go in.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影已经开始了吗？马克：对，五分钟前开始的。我们进去吧。

messages.speaker: 玛雅 (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影已经开始了吗？
messages.en: Has the film started already?

messages.speaker: 马克 (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, beda ħames minuti ilu. Ejja nidħlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, beda ħames minuti ilu. Ejja nidħlu.
messages.zh: 对，五分钟前开始的。我们进去吧。
messages.en: Yes, it started five minutes ago. Let's go in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把电影刚开场的画面与 beda 配对，再用 beda jaħdem 记住“开始工作”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or business of selling goods or services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出售商品或服务的行为，也可指买卖业务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew in-negozju tal-bejgħ ta' prodotti jew servizzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出售；销售。
出售的行为；把商品卖给他人的活动。
生意；买卖业务。
出售；销售；卖东西这一行为或业务。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri żieda fil-bejgħ tal-kotba matul ix-xahar ta' Ottubru.
formal.en: The report shows an increase in book sales during October.
formal.zh: 报告显示，十月份的图书销售有所增长。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din ir-rota għall-bejgħ? Mark: Iva, qed nitlob ħamsin ewro għaliha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this bicycle for sale? Mark: Yes, I'm asking fifty euros for it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这辆自行车卖吗？马克：卖，我要价五十欧元。

messages.speaker: 玛雅 (买家)
messages.zh: 这辆自行车卖吗？
messages.en: Is this bicycle for sale?

messages.speaker: 马克 (卖家)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed nitlob ħamsin ewro għaliha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed nitlob ħamsin ewro għaliha.
messages.zh: 卖，我要价五十欧元。
messages.en: Yes, I'm asking fifty euros for it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象商品上挂着 għall-bejgħ 的牌子，把整个短语记成“待售”，其中 bejgħ 指销售。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To interpose something, interrupt, or discern a difference, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依语境表示插入话语等内容、打断，或辨别出差异。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idaħħal kelma jew kumment f'nofs diskors, jinterrompi, jew jagħraf differenza, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 插入；在其间加入话语或其他内容。
打断；使正在进行的话语或活动中断。
辨别；察觉并认出差异或特征。

formal.mt: Waqt id-dibattitu, Mark bejjen kumment qasir biex jiċċara l-punt.
formal.en: During the debate, Mark interposed a brief comment to clarify the point.
formal.zh: 辩论过程中，马克插入了一句简短的评论，以澄清这一点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nbejjen kelma hawn? Mark: Iva, x'tixtieq iżżid?
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I interject here? Mark: Yes, what would you like to add?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我能在这里插一句吗？马克：可以，你想补充什么？

messages.speaker: 玛雅 (同事)
messages.zh: 我能在这里插一句吗？
messages.en: Can I interject here?

messages.speaker: 马克 (同事)
messages.zh: 可以，你想补充什么？
messages.en: Yes, what would you like to add?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 bejjen 配两幅学习图：讨论中插入一句话，以及观察时辨出差异；靠语境区分义项。

gloss_zh: 筑巢；偎居；滋养情绪；怀恨

teaching_sense.en_definition: To build a nest or nestle; figuratively, to nourish a feeling or harbour a grudge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 筑巢或偎居；比喻在心中滋养某种情绪，或对某人怀恨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibni bejta jew joqgħod fiha; b'mod figurattiv, irawwem sentiment jew iżomm għadab kontra xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 筑巢；建造鸟巢。
偎居；安顿在巢中；筑巢。
反复思量并滋养某种情绪；让某种感受在心中积存。

sense_translations.en_definition: to build a grudge against someone
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人逐渐积怨；在心中怀恨。

formal.mt: L-għasfur bejjet fis-siġra ħdejn il-librerija, fejn il-friegħi offrew kenn mix-xita.
formal.en: The bird nested in the tree beside the library, where the branches offered shelter from the rain.
formal.zh: 这只鸟在图书馆旁的树上筑了巢，树枝可以为它遮雨。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek irrabjat ma' Pawlu? Mark: Le, ma rridx inbejjet mibegħda. Nippreferi nitkellem miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still angry with Pawlu? Mark: No, I don't want to harbour hatred. I'd rather talk to him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还在生保罗的气吗？马克：不了，我不想心怀仇恨。我更愿意和他谈谈。

messages.speaker: 玛雅 (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还在生保罗的气吗？
messages.en: Are you still angry with Pawlu?

messages.speaker: 马克 (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ma rridx inbejjet mibegħda. Nippreferi nitkellem miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ma rridx inbejjet mibegħda. Nippreferi nitkellem miegħu.
messages.zh: 不了，我不想心怀仇恨。我更愿意和他谈谈。
messages.en: No, I don't want to harbour hatred. I'd rather talk to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用小鸟筑巢记 bejjet，再把情绪想成在心里安家；这是帮助区分本义与比喻义的学习画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who sells goods, such as a vendor, seller, or salesman.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出售商品的人，可指卖家、商贩或售货员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tbigħ prodotti, pereżempju f'ħanut jew fis-suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 商贩；出售商品的人。
售货员；销售员。
卖家；卖方；商贩。

formal.mt: Il-bejjiegħ għandu jagħti lill-klijent informazzjoni ċara dwar il-prezz u l-kundizzjoni tal-prodott.
formal.en: The seller should give the customer clear information about the price and condition of the product.
formal.zh: 卖方应向顾客清楚说明商品的价格和状况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-bejjiegħ tal-ħaxix? Mark: Qiegħed ħdejn id-daħla tas-suq. Għandu tadam frisk illum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the vegetable vendor? Mark: He's beside the market entrance. He has fresh tomatoes today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：卖菜的人在哪里？马克：他在市场入口旁边。他今天有新鲜番茄。

messages.speaker: 玛雅 (顾客)
messages.zh: 卖菜的人在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the vegetable vendor?

messages.speaker: 马克 (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed ħdejn id-daħla tas-suq. Għandu tadam frisk illum.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed ħdejn id-daħla tas-suq. Għandu tadam frisk illum.
messages.zh: 他在市场入口旁边。他今天有新鲜番茄。
messages.en: He's beside the market entrance. He has fresh tomatoes today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用市场画面区分：bejgħ 是“销售”这件事，bejjiegħ 是摊位后面“卖东西的人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able or suitable to be sold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可以出售的，或具备适合销售的条件的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jinbiegħ jew li huwa adattat għall-bejgħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可出售的；形容能够被卖出的东西。
适于销售的；具备出售条件的。

formal.mt: Wara l-ispezzjoni, l-oġġett ġie deskritt bħala bejjiegħi minħabba l-kundizzjoni tajba tiegħu.
formal.en: After the inspection, the item was described as saleable because of its good condition.
formal.zh: 检查后，这件物品因状况良好而被认定为可出售。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-prodott għadu bejjiegħi? Mark: Iva, għadu f'kundizzjoni tajba. Nistgħu noffruh għall-bejgħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this product still saleable? Mark: Yes, it's still in good condition. We can offer it for sale.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个产品还适合出售吗？马克：适合，它的状况仍然很好。我们可以把它拿来卖。

messages.speaker: 玛雅 (店员)
messages.zh: 这个产品还适合出售吗？
messages.en: Is this product still saleable?

messages.speaker: 马克 (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadu f'kundizzjoni tajba. Nistgħu noffruh għall-bejgħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadu f'kundizzjoni tajba. Nistgħu noffruh għall-bejgħ.
messages.zh: 适合，它的状况仍然很好。我们可以把它拿来卖。
messages.en: Yes, it's still in good condition. We can offer it for sale.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bejjiegħi 放进 prodott bejjiegħi 整体记忆，提醒自己它描述商品“可以卖”的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Salt-cured pork, often smoked and served in slices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用盐腌制、常经烟熏并切片食用的猪肉，即培根。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laħam tal-majjal immellaħ, spiss affumikat, li normalment jittiekel fi flieli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 培根；通常切片食用的盐腌猪肉，常带烟熏风味。

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, aqta' l-bejken f'biċċiet żgħar u sajru qabel iżżid il-ħaxix.
formal.en: For this recipe, cut the bacon into small pieces and cook it before adding the vegetables.
formal.zh: 制作这道菜时，先把培根切成小块并烹熟，再加入蔬菜。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid bajd bil-bejken għall-kolazzjon? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Żewġ flieli tal-bejken biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like eggs with bacon for breakfast? Mark: Yes, please. Two slices of bacon are enough.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：早餐想吃鸡蛋配培根吗？马克：想，谢谢。两片培根就够了。

messages.speaker: 玛雅 (室友)
messages.zh: 早餐想吃鸡蛋配培根吗？
messages.en: Would you like eggs with bacon for breakfast?

messages.speaker: 马克 (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Żewġ flieli tal-bejken biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Żewġ flieli tal-bejken biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。两片培根就够了。
messages.en: Yes, please. Two slices of bacon are enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bejken 与早餐盘里的两片培根联系起来，再用 bajd bil-bejken 记住“鸡蛋配培根”。

gloss_zh: 在……之间；在……之中；在……范围内

teaching_sense.en_definition: Indicates a position or relationship between or among people or things, or within stated limits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示人或事物之间、群体之中的位置或关系，也可表示在指定界限之内。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika pożizzjoni jew relazzjoni bejn persuni jew affarijiet, jew firxa f'limiti speċifikati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在……之中；在多个成员组成的群体中间。
在……之间；表示事物之间的位置、联系或区别。
在……范围内；在所指的界限之内。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir bejn l-għaxra u nofsinhar, u d-diskussjoni se tkun bejn ir-rappreżentanti tal-iskejjel.
formal.en: The meeting will take place between ten o'clock and noon, and the discussion will be among the school representatives.
formal.zh: 会议将在十点至中午之间举行，讨论将在各校代表之间进行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn ħallejt iċ-ċwievet? Mark: Fuq il-mejda, bejn il-ktieb u t-telefon.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you leave the keys? Mark: On the table, between the book and the phone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把钥匙放在哪里了？马克：桌子上，在书和手机之间。

messages.speaker: 玛雅 (室友)
messages.zh: 你把钥匙放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you leave the keys?

messages.speaker: 马克 (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-mejda, bejn il-ktieb u t-telefon.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-mejda, bejn il-ktieb u t-telefon.
messages.zh: 桌子上，在书和手机之间。
messages.en: On the table, between the book and the phone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出书和手机，把钥匙放在两者中间并标上 bejn；再把同一画面换成时间的两个端点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The roof or upper covering of a building.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑物顶部的覆盖部分，即屋顶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' fuq ta' bini li tgħattih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑物的屋顶
屋顶
房屋；住宅

formal.mt: Il-bejt tal-iskola jeħtieġ tiswija qabel tibda x-xita.
formal.en: The school roof needs repair before the rain starts.
formal.zh: 学校的屋顶需要在开始下雨之前修缮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-qattus? Mark: Fuq il-bejt. Qed jistrieħ fix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the cat? Mark: On the roof. It is resting in the sun.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：猫在哪里？马克：在屋顶上，正晒着太阳休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 猫在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the cat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在屋顶上，正晒着太阳休息。
messages.en: On the roof. It is resting in the sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bejt 配上一幅屋顶晒太阳的画面，再用 fuq il-bejt 记住“在屋顶上”；遇到“房屋”义时另按语境理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A nest, den, or burrow used by an animal as a place to live or shelter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动物栖居或藏身的巢、窝或洞穴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jgħix jew jistkenn annimal, bħal għasfur jew fenek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个鸟巢；一个巢穴
一个兽窝；野兽栖身的洞穴
巢；鸟巢
动物挖掘或栖居的地洞

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, instabet bejta b'żewġ bajdiet fuq fergħa tas-siġra.
formal.en: During the observation, a nest containing two eggs was found on a branch of the tree.
formal.zh: 观察期间，在树的一根枝条上发现了一个有两枚蛋的鸟巢。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dik il-bejta fis-siġra! Pawlu: Rajtha. Ejja nħarsu lejha minn hawn biex ma nfixklux l-għasafar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that nest in the tree! Pawlu: I saw it. Let's watch it from here so we don't disturb the birds.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看树上的那个鸟巢！保罗：我看到了。我们在这里看吧，免得打扰鸟儿。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看树上的那个鸟巢！
messages.en: Look at that nest in the tree!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha. Ejja nħarsu lejha minn hawn biex ma nfixklux l-għasafar.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha. Ejja nħarsu lejha minn hawn biex ma nfixklux l-għasafar.
messages.zh: 我看到了。我们在这里看吧，免得打扰鸟儿。
messages.en: I saw it. Let's watch it from here so we don't disturb the birds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bejta 想成动物自己的小住处：树上是鸟巢，地下是洞穴，用“动物住处”把几个义项串起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cry or shed tears, or to mourn someone who has died.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 哭泣或流泪，也可指为逝者悲伤、哀悼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ixerred id-dmugħ, jew jesprimi niket għall-mewt ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哭；哭泣
流泪；落泪
哀悼某人；为某人的去世而悲伤
哀悼；因丧失而悲痛

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, ir-raġel beka lil missieru u tkellem dwar il-memorji tagħhom flimkien.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the man mourned his father and spoke about their memories together.
formal.zh: 仪式上，这名男子哀悼父亲，并讲述了他们共同的往事。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex beka t-tifel? David: Waqa' u weġġa' rkopptejh, imma issa qiegħed aħjar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the boy cry? David: He fell and hurt his knees, but he is better now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那个男孩为什么哭了？戴维：他摔倒后伤了膝盖，不过现在好些了。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 那个男孩为什么哭了？
messages.en: Why did the boy cry?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqa' u weġġa' rkopptejh, imma issa qiegħed aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Waqa' u weġġa' rkopptejh, imma issa qiegħed aħjar.
messages.zh: 他摔倒后伤了膝盖，不过现在好些了。
messages.en: He fell and hurt his knees, but he is better now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“眼里流泪”的画面记 beka：受伤会哭，开心也会哭；涉及逝者时，再联想到“哀悼”的意义。

gloss_zh: 海贝；蜘蛛螺；带纹骨螺（Hexaplex trunculus）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A seashell; in the specific species sense, the banded dye-murex, Hexaplex trunculus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种海贝；用于具体物种义时，指带纹骨螺 Hexaplex trunculus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qoxra tal-baħar; fis-sens ta' speċi partikolari, il-mollusk Hexaplex trunculus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海贝；海生软体动物的贝壳
蜘蛛螺；蜘蛛螺壳
带纹骨螺（Hexaplex trunculus）

collocations.zh: 一张 bekkum 海贝的照片
收藏中的一枚 bekkum 海贝

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jinkludi ritratt ta' bekkum u jidentifika l-ispeċi bħala Hexaplex trunculus.
formal.en: The catalogue includes a photograph of a bekkum and identifies the species as Hexaplex trunculus.
formal.zh: 目录中收录了一张 bekkum 的照片，并将其物种标为 Hexaplex trunculus。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jismu dan il-bebbux tal-baħar fir-ritratt? Toni: Bekkum. Ara, l-isem xjentifiku qiegħed miktub taħtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this sea snail in the photograph called? Toni: Bekkum. Look, its scientific name is written underneath.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的这只海螺叫什么？托尼：叫 bekkum。看，下面写着它的学名。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这只海螺叫什么？
messages.en: What is this sea snail in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Bekkum. Ara, l-isem xjentifiku qiegħed miktub taħtu.
messages.mt_standard: Bekkum. Ara, l-isem xjentifiku qiegħed miktub taħtu.
messages.zh: 叫 bekkum。看，下面写着它的学名。
messages.en: Bekkum. Look, its scientific name is written underneath.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 bekkum 做一张海贝图片卡：正面写词，背面分列“海贝、蜘蛛螺、带纹骨螺”三个义项，具体物种配学名记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A little bird.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体形小的鸟；小鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一只小鸟
小鸟

collocations.en: a little bird on a branch
a little bird in the garden

formal.mt: Fl-istampa jidher belbul fuq fergħa, ħdejn il-bejta tiegħu.
formal.en: The picture shows a little bird on a branch, beside its nest.
formal.zh: 图中有一只小鸟停在树枝上，旁边就是它的巢。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara l-belbul ħdejn it-tieqa! Adam: Rajtu! Kemm hu sabiħ meta jkanta.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at the little bird by the window! Adam: I saw it! It is so lovely when it sings.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看窗边的那只小鸟！亚当：我看到了！它唱起歌来真可爱。

messages.speaker: Nina (姐姐)
messages.zh: 看窗边的那只小鸟！
messages.en: Look at the little bird by the window!

messages.speaker: Adam (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu! Kemm hu sabiħ meta jkanta.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu! Kemm hu sabiħ meta jkanta.
messages.zh: 我看到了！它唱起歌来真可爱。
messages.en: I saw it! It is so lovely when it sings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 belbul 放进“小鸟停在树枝上唱歌”的画面，读词时轻点两下手指，帮助把词形和小鸟形象连起来。

gloss_zh: 一小口；一大口；吞咽；拖鞋

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sip, swig, or gulp of liquid, or an act of swallowing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喝下的一小口或一大口液体，也可指一次吞咽。
