teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont ta' likwidu li jinxtorob f'daqqa, jew l-att li wieħed jibla'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小口饮料或其他液体
一大口饮料或其他液体
一大口；一次大口吞咽
一小口；一大口；大口吞咽；吞咽动作
拖鞋

formal.mt: Il-kelliem waqaf għal mument u ħa belgħa ilma qabel kompla d-diskors.
formal.en: The speaker paused for a moment and took a sip of water before continuing the speech.
formal.zh: 演讲者停顿片刻，喝了一口水，然后继续演讲。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nieħu belgħa ilma? Għandi l-għatx. Mark: Dażgur. Hawn il-flixkun.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I have a sip of water? I'm thirsty. Mark: Of course. Here is the bottle.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我能喝一口水吗？我渴了。马克：当然，水瓶在这里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nieħu belgħa ilma? Għandi l-għatx.
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nieħu belgħa ilma? Għandi l-għatx.
messages.zh: 我能喝一口水吗？我渴了。
messages.en: Can I have a sip of water? I'm thirsty.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 当然，水瓶在这里。
messages.en: Of course. Here is the bottle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用喝水时的一次吞咽记 belgħa，再用 kbira 提醒自己也可指“一大口”；“拖鞋”义另做图片卡，分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To froth at the mouth, especially when describing a horse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 嘴边产生或吐出泡沫，尤其用于描述马口吐白沫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ ir-ragħwa minn ħalqu, speċjalment meta jingħad għal żiemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 口吐白沫，指马
口吐泡沫；嘴边起白沫

collocations.en: the horse frothed at the mouth
frothed at the mouth during training

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinnota li ż-żiemel belgħen waqt it-taħriġ ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The report notes that the horse frothed at the mouth during the morning training session.
formal.zh: 报告记载，那匹马在上午的训练期间口吐白沫。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Iż-żiemel belgħen illum? Rita: Iva, ftit. Rajt ir-ragħwa ma' ħalqu.
colloquial.en: Toni: Did the horse froth at the mouth today? Rita: Yes, a little. I saw foam around its mouth.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：那匹马今天嘴边起泡沫了吗？丽塔：是的，有一点。我看见它嘴边有泡沫。

messages.speaker: Toni (骑术教练)
messages.zh: 那匹马今天嘴边起泡沫了吗？
messages.en: Did the horse froth at the mouth today?

messages.speaker: Rita (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftit. Rajt ir-ragħwa ma' ħalqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftit. Rajt ir-ragħwa ma' ħalqu.
messages.zh: 是的，有一点。我看见它嘴边有泡沫。
messages.en: Yes, a little. I saw foam around its mouth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 belgħen 和一匹嘴边带泡沫的马配对记忆，并整句练习 iż-żiemel belgħen，让动作与典型主语一起进入记忆。

gloss_zh: 空洞的；无意义的；愚蠢的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lacking useful meaning, substance, or good sense; inane or foolish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺乏实际内容、意义或明智判断的；空洞无聊或愚蠢的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bla sens jew bla siwi; nieqes mill-għaqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 空洞无聊的；缺乏意义的
愚蠢至极的；用于贬斥缺乏判断力的表现
无益的；徒劳的；空洞的；无意义的
愚蠢的；极不明智的

formal.mt: L-awtur iwarrab id-diskors belhieni u jippreżenta argument ċar ibbażat fuq il-fatti.
formal.en: The author sets aside empty talk and presents a clear argument based on facts.
formal.zh: 作者摒弃空洞的言谈，提出了以事实为依据的清晰论证。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'taħseb dwar dak il-kumment? Pawlu: Kien kumment belhieni. Ma żied xejn mad-diskussjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you think of that comment? Pawlu: It was an inane comment. It added nothing to the discussion.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得那条评论怎么样？保罗：那是条空洞无聊的评论，对讨论毫无帮助。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你觉得那条评论怎么样？
messages.en: What do you think of that comment?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien kumment belhieni. Ma żied xejn mad-diskussjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Kien kumment belhieni. Ma żied xejn mad-diskussjoni.
messages.zh: 那是条空洞无聊的评论，对讨论毫无帮助。
messages.en: It was an inane comment. It added nothing to the discussion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个写了很多却没有内容的对话气泡，用 kumment belhieni 记“空洞评论”，再把缺少明智判断的“愚蠢”义连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put something briefly or partly into a liquid, for example when dipping food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西短暂或部分浸入液体中，例如把食物蘸一下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaddas xi ħaġa f'likwidu għal ftit ħin jew sa parti minnha, bħal meta tgħaddas l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西浸入液体中，尤指把食物放进去浸一下。
蘸；把东西的一部分浸入液体。

sense_translations.en_definition: to dip (immerse something shortly or partly into a liquid)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 蘸；将某物短暂或部分浸入液体。

collocations.en: dip the bread in the oil
dunk the biscuit in the milk

formal.mt: Qabel ma tiekol il-ħobż, bell tarf minnu fiż-żejt taż-żebbuġa.
formal.en: Before eating the bread, dip one end of it in the olive oil.
formal.zh: 吃面包前，把一端蘸一下橄榄油。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-gallettina iebsa wisq. Mark: Bellha ftit fil-ħalib.
colloquial.en: Lara: The biscuit is too hard. Mark: Dunk it briefly in the milk.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块饼干太硬了。马克：把它放进牛奶里浸一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这块饼干太硬了。
messages.en: The biscuit is too hard.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 把它放进牛奶里浸一下。
messages.en: Dunk it briefly in the milk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把饼干放进牛奶再拿起，用这个短暂浸入的动作记住 bell。

gloss_zh: 使惊叹；使惊讶得说不出话

teaching_sense.en_definition: To surprise or impress someone so strongly that they are amazed or left speechless.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人极其惊讶或赞叹，甚至一时说不出话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tissorprendi jew timpressjona lil xi ħadd tant li jibqa' mistagħġeb jew bla kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人惊叹；使某人十分惊讶。
使某人惊讶得说不出话。
使惊叹；使大为震惊。

formal.mt: Il-kantant bellah lill-udjenza bil-qawwa ta' leħnu.
formal.en: The singer amazed the audience with the power of his voice.
formal.zh: 这位歌手以富有力量的嗓音令观众惊叹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt il-kantanta? Pawlu: Iva, leħinha bellah lil kulħadd!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear the singer? Pawlu: Yes, her voice amazed everyone!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听到那位女歌手唱歌了吗？保罗：听到了，她的嗓音让所有人都惊叹不已！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到那位女歌手唱歌了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the singer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 听到了，她的嗓音让所有人都惊叹不已！
messages.en: Yes, her voice amazed everyone!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bellah 配上观众听完演唱后张口惊叹的画面，记住它强调使别人惊讶。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become ripe, especially when speaking of fruit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逐渐变熟，尤用于描述果实成熟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir misjur, speċjalment meta nitkellmu dwar il-frott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成熟；果实逐渐变熟。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi nnota li t-tin beda jbellaq, iżda għadu mhux lest għall-ġbir.
formal.en: The farmer noted that the figs had begun to ripen but were not yet ready for picking.
formal.zh: 农民注意到无花果已经开始成熟，但还不到采摘的时候。

colloquial.mt: Sara: It-tin lest biex niġbruh? Ġużeppi: Għadu le, iżda beda jbellaq.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are the figs ready for us to pick? Ġużeppi: Not yet, but they have begun to ripen.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：无花果可以摘了吗？朱塞佩：还不行，不过已经开始成熟了。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 无花果可以摘了吗？
messages.en: Are the figs ready for us to pick?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (果农)
messages.zh: 还不行，不过已经开始成熟了。
messages.en: Not yet, but they have begun to ripen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bellaq 放进果园画面：果实还不能摘，却正在一步步变熟，用成熟过程记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A whirlpool; also a monster described as living in wells and swallowing anyone who looks down into them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水中旋转的漩涡；也指住在井里、会吞下向井中张望者的怪物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawra ta' ilma li jdur fuq innifsu; ukoll mostru li joqgħod fil-bjar u jibla' lil min iħares għal ġo fihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个漩涡；旋转的水流。
漩涡。

sense_translations.en_definition: a monster dwelling in wells that swallows anyone looking down
sense_translations.zh_definition: 住在井中、会吞下向井里张望者的怪物。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi belliegħa qawwija li ġibdet id-dgħajsa lejn iċ-ċentru tagħha.
formal.en: The report describes a powerful whirlpool that pulled the boat towards its centre.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一个强劲的漩涡，它把小船拉向了漩涡中心。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min jgħix fil-bir f'din l-istorja? Rita: Il-belliegħa, mostru li jibla' lil min iħares għal ġol-bir!
colloquial.en: Nina: Who lives in the well in this story? Rita: The belliegħa, a monster that swallows anyone who looks down into the well!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个故事里是谁住在井中？丽塔：是 belliegħa，一种会吞下向井里张望的人的怪物！

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 这个故事里是谁住在井中？
messages.en: Who lives in the well in this story?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-belliegħa, mostru li jibla' lil min iħares għal ġol-bir!
messages.mt_standard: Il-belliegħa, mostru li jibla' lil min iħares għal ġol-bir!
messages.zh: 是 belliegħa，一种会吞下向井里张望的人的怪物！
messages.en: The belliegħa, a monster that swallows anyone who looks down into the well!

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张记忆卡：一张是水面漩涡，一张是故事里的井中怪物，分别记住两个义项。

gloss_zh: 天鹅绒；触感柔软舒适的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: Velvet, a fabric with a soft surface; also something soft and pleasant to touch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天鹅绒，一种表面柔软的织物；也指摸起来柔软舒适的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Drapp b'wiċċ artab; ukoll xi ħaġa ratba li tagħti sensazzjoni pjaċevoli meta tmissha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天鹅绒。

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. soft and pleasant to the touch
sense_translations.zh_definition: 触感柔软舒适的东西。

formal.mt: Għall-purtieri tas-sala ntgħażel bellus aħmar minħabba d-dehra eleganti tiegħu.
formal.en: Red velvet was chosen for the hall's curtains because of its elegant appearance.
formal.zh: 大厅的窗帘选用了红色天鹅绒，因为它看起来很典雅。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-kuxxin artab ħafna. Marija: Veru, qisu bellus meta tmissu.
colloquial.en: Anna: This cushion is very soft. Marija: It really is; it feels like velvet.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个靠垫真软。玛丽亚：确实，摸起来像天鹅绒。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个靠垫真软。
messages.en: This cushion is very soft.

messages.speaker: Marija (店员)
messages.zh: 确实，摸起来像天鹅绒。
messages.en: It really is; it feels like velvet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指轻轻划过天鹅绒表面，把 bellus 和柔软舒服的触感一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having light and dark shades, or a greyish, dusky colour between white and black.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有浅深色调的，或呈介于白色与黑色之间的灰暗颜色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu sfumaturi ċari u skuri, jew kulur griż bejn l-abjad u l-iswed.

sense_translations.en_definition: having both light and dark shades
sense_translations.zh_definition: 同时带有浅色与深色色调的；明暗相间的。

sense_translations.en_definition: of a color between white and black
sense_translations.zh_definition: 颜色介于白色与黑色之间的；灰色的。
暗沉的；色调偏暗的。

collocations.en: fabric with light and dark shades

formal.mt: Il-kampjun għandu kulur belqi, bejn l-abjad u l-iswed.
formal.en: The sample has a greyish colour, between white and black.
formal.zh: 该样品呈灰色，颜色介于白色与黑色之间。

colloquial.mt: David: Dan id-drapp iswed? Lara: Le, huwa belqi: bejn l-abjad u l-iswed.
colloquial.en: David: Is this fabric black? Lara: No, it is greyish: between white and black.
colloquial.zh: 戴维：这块布是黑色的吗？拉拉：不是，是灰色的，介于白色与黑色之间。

messages.speaker: David (顾客)
messages.zh: 这块布是黑色的吗？
messages.en: Is this fabric black?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa belqi: bejn l-abjad u l-iswed.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa belqi: bejn l-abjad u l-iswed.
messages.zh: 不是，是灰色的，介于白色与黑色之间。
messages.en: No, it is greyish: between white and black.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在白色与黑色之间画一条灰色色带，再加上深浅变化，用这个色卡记住 belqi。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The city that serves as a country's main seat of government.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为一个国家主要政府所在地的城市，即首都。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-belt li tkun is-sede ewlenija tal-gvern ta' pajjiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 首都；国家主要政府所在地的城市。
首都；国都。

collocations.en: the centre of the capital city

formal.mt: Il-Belt Valletta hija l-belt kapitali ta' Malta.
formal.en: Valletta is the capital city of Malta.
formal.zh: 瓦莱塔是马耳他的首都。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema hi l-belt kapitali ta' Malta? Pawlu: Il-Belt Valletta.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is the capital city of Malta? Pawlu: Valletta.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马耳他的首都是哪座城市？保罗：瓦莱塔。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema hi l-belt kapitali ta' Malta?
messages.mt_standard: Liema hi l-belt kapitali ta' Malta?
messages.zh: 马耳他的首都是哪座城市？
messages.en: What is the capital city of Malta?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 瓦莱塔。
messages.en: Valletta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地图上给首都画一颗星，把整组 belt kapitali 与“国家首都”一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 城市的；瓦莱塔的；城市居民；瓦莱塔人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of or relating to a city or to Valletta; also used to describe a city dweller or a person from Valletta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与城市或瓦莱塔有关的；也可用于描述城市居民或来自瓦莱塔的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tal-belt jew tal-Belt Valletta; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi persuna li tgħix fil-belt jew li hi mill-Belt Valletta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于描述住在城市里的人；城市居民。

sense_translations.en_definition: a person from Valletta (colloquially called 'Il-Belt', meaning 'The City')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于描述来自瓦莱塔的人；瓦莱塔口语中称为 Il-Belt，意为“这座城市”。
市政的；城市的；与城市有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Vallettan (of or pertaining to Valletta, the capital of Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 瓦莱塔的；与马耳他首都瓦莱塔有关的。

formal.mt: Il-proġett għandu jtejjeb l-ambjent belti u jżid l-ispazji għall-pubbliku.
formal.en: The project aims to improve the urban environment and increase public spaces.
formal.zh: 该项目旨在改善城市环境，并增加公共空间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int belti? Mark: Iva, jien mill-Belt Valletta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you from Valletta? Mark: Yes, I am from Valletta.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你是瓦莱塔人吗？马克：是的，我来自瓦莱塔。

messages.speaker: Maja (新同学)
messages.zh: 你是瓦莱塔人吗？
messages.en: Are you from Valletta?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，我来自瓦莱塔。
messages.en: Yes, I am from Valletta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 belti 配两张图：城市街景和瓦莱塔居民；结合语境判断是在说城市属性还是家乡身份。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Belgium, a country in Western Europe bordering the Netherlands, Germany, Luxembourg, and France.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 比利时，西欧国家，与荷兰、德国、卢森堡和法国接壤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Ewropa tal-Punent li għandu fruntieri mal-Pajjiżi l-Baxxi, mal-Ġermanja, mal-Lussemburgu u ma' Franza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 比利时。

sense_translations.en_definition: Belgium (a country in Western Europe that has borders with the Netherlands, Germany, Luxembourg and France; official name: Renju tal-Belġju)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 比利时，位于西欧，与荷兰、德国、卢森堡和法国接壤；正式名称为比利时王国。

formal.mt: Il-Belġju huwa pajjiż fl-Ewropa tal-Punent li għandu fruntiera ma' Franza.
formal.en: Belgium is a country in Western Europe that shares a border with France.
formal.zh: 比利时是一个位于西欧、与法国接壤的国家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn tgħix oħtok? Mark: Fil-Belġju. Se nżurha x-xahar id-dieħel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where does your sister live? Mark: In Belgium. I'm going to visit her next month.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你姐姐住在哪里？Mark：在比利时。我下个月要去看她。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你姐姐住在哪里？
messages.en: Where does your sister live?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在比利时。我下个月要去看她。
messages.en: In Belgium. I'm going to visit her next month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在西欧地图上给比利时贴上 Belġju 标签，再用 fil-Belġju 练习“在比利时”；国名书写时注意首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To build something by putting parts together; also to create or develop something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把材料或部件组合起来建造某物，也可指创作或逐步建立某事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqqad materjali jew partijiet biex jagħmel xi ħaġa; ukoll ħoloq jew żviluppa xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建造；修建。
把东西堆起来；堆积。
制作或创造某事物。
搭建；把东西叠放起来。
作曲；创作音乐。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill bena librerija ġdida biex ir-residenti jkollhom aċċess aħjar għall-kotba.
formal.en: The council built a new library so that residents would have better access to books.
formal.zh: 地方议会建造了一座新图书馆，让居民更方便地借阅书籍。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min bena dan il-ħajt? Pawlu: Missieri bena l-ħajt, u jien għentu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who built this wall? Pawlu: My father built the wall, and I helped him.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这堵墙是谁砌的？保罗：我爸爸砌的，我帮了他。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.zh: 这堵墙是谁砌的？
messages.en: Who built this wall?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri bena l-ħajt, u jien għentu.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri bena l-ħajt, u jien għentu.
messages.zh: 我爸爸砌的，我帮了他。
messages.en: My father built the wall, and I helped him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把砖块一层层组合成房屋，先记住 bena 的“建造”，再把画面延伸到建立信任和创作作品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who helps another person or an organization, especially by giving money or other support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向他人或机构提供帮助的人，尤其指给予金钱或其他支持的恩人、资助者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħin lil persuna oħra jew lil għaqda, speċjalment billi tagħti flus jew appoġġ ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恩人；为他人或机构提供帮助、捐助或资助的人。

formal.mt: L-iskola rringrazzjat lill-benefattur li ħallas għall-kotba tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The school thanked the benefactor who paid for the students' books.
formal.zh: 学校感谢了那位为学生支付书本费用的资助者。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ħallas għall-kotba l-ġodda? Mark: Benefattur anonimu. Lanqas nafu ismu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who paid for the new books? Mark: An anonymous benefactor. We don't even know his name.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：新书是谁出钱买的？马克：一位匿名资助者。我们连他的名字都不知道。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 新书是谁出钱买的？
messages.en: Who paid for the new books?

messages.speaker: Mark (图书管理员)
messages.zh: 一位匿名资助者。我们连他的名字都不知道。
messages.en: An anonymous benefactor. We don't even know his name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 benefattur 和“有人出钱帮学校买书”的场景绑定：重点记提供帮助的人，即恩人或资助者。

gloss_zh: 滋味；好食材带来的美味

teaching_sense.en_definition: The flavour of food, especially the pleasing taste that comes from good ingredients.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 食物的滋味，尤其指使用优质食材所带来的美味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-togħma tal-ikel, speċjalment it-togħma tajba li tiġi minn ingredjenti tajbin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滋味；食物的味道。

sense_translations.en_definition: the quality arising out of the use of good ingredients (used of food)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 食物因使用优质食材而具有的美味品质。

formal.mt: Il-benna ta' din is-soppa ġejja mill-ħaxix frisk u miż-żejt taż-żebbuġa.
formal.en: The flavour of this soup comes from the fresh vegetables and olive oil.
formal.zh: 这道汤的美味来自新鲜蔬菜和橄榄油。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din is-soppa għandha benna tajba! Marija: Użajt ħaxix frisk mis-suq.
colloquial.en: Nina: This soup has a lovely flavour! Marija: I used fresh vegetables from the market.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这汤味道真好！玛丽娅：我用了市场上买来的新鲜蔬菜。

messages.speaker: Nina (客人)
messages.zh: 这汤味道真好！
messages.en: This soup has a lovely flavour!

messages.speaker: Marija (主人)
messages.zh: 我用了市场上买来的新鲜蔬菜。
messages.en: I used fresh vegetables from the market.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象喝下一口用新鲜食材煮成的汤，把 benna 记成舌尖感受到的“好滋味”，它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose work is building structures, especially by laying stone or bricks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以建造建筑物为工作的人，尤其指砌石、砌砖的建筑工人或泥瓦匠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tibni, speċjalment bil-ġebel jew bil-briks.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑工人；从事建造工作的人。
建筑工人；砌石匠或泥瓦匠。

formal.mt: Bennej b'esperjenza eżamina l-ħajt qabel ma beda x-xogħol.
formal.en: An experienced builder examined the wall before starting work.
formal.zh: 一位经验丰富的建筑工人在开工前检查了这堵墙。

colloquial.mt: David: Taf xi bennej tajjeb? Rita: Iva, il-bennej li ħadem għandna kien tajjeb ħafna.
colloquial.en: David: Do you know a good builder? Rita: Yes, the builder who worked at our place was very good.
colloquial.zh: 戴维：你认识手艺好的建筑工人吗？丽塔：认识，之前来我们家干活的那位就很好。

messages.speaker: David (屋主)
messages.zh: 你认识手艺好的建筑工人吗？
messages.en: Do you know a good builder?

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-bennej li ħadem għandna kien tajjeb ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-bennej li ħadem għandna kien tajjeb ħafna.
messages.zh: 认识，之前来我们家干活的那位就很好。
messages.en: Yes, the builder who worked at our place was very good.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bena 和 bennej 放在同一幅砌墙画面中：bena 记“建造”这个动作，bennej 记拿着工具施工的人。

gloss_zh: 增添风味；使可口；轻摇摇篮或婴儿车

teaching_sense.en_definition: To add flavour to food or make it tasty; in another sense, to rock a cradle or pram gently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给食物增添风味，使其可口；另一个义项是轻轻摇动摇篮或婴儿车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żied it-togħma tal-ikel jew għamlu aktar tajjeb; f'sens ieħor, ċaqlaq benniena jew karozzina bil-mod 'il quddiem u lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增添风味；增加滋味。
使食物变得可口。

sense_translations.en_definition: to rock (used especially of a cradle or pram)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻轻来回摇动，尤指摇篮或婴儿车。
给食物调味；使带有某种风味。

formal.mt: Il-kok bennen is-soppa bi ftit ħwawar friski qabel ma servieha.
formal.en: The cook added flavour to the soup with a few fresh herbs before serving it.
formal.zh: 厨师在上菜前用少量新鲜香草给汤增添了风味。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tarbija raqdet? Mark: Iva, missieri bennen il-benniena bil-mod u t-tarbija raqdet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the baby fallen asleep? Mark: Yes, my father gently rocked the cradle and the baby fell asleep.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：宝宝睡着了吗？马克：睡着了，我爸爸轻轻摇了摇篮，宝宝就睡着了。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.zh: 宝宝睡着了吗？
messages.en: Has the baby fallen asleep?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, missieri bennen il-benniena bil-mod u t-tarbija raqdet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, missieri bennen il-benniena bil-mod u t-tarbija raqdet.
messages.zh: 睡着了，我爸爸轻轻摇了摇篮，宝宝就睡着了。
messages.en: Yes, my father gently rocked the cradle and the baby fell asleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 bennen 配两幅独立画面：厨房里给汤添香，房间里轻摇摇篮；用宾语判断当前是哪一个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bed for a baby, such as a cradle, cot, or crib.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供婴儿睡觉的小床，可指摇篮或婴儿床。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sodda żgħira għat-tarbija, li tista' tkun ukoll waħda li titbandal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 婴儿床。
摇篮。
婴儿床；有围栏的小床。
摇篮；婴儿床。

formal.mt: Il-mużew juri benniena tal-injam li kienet tintuża f'dar Maltija.
formal.en: The museum displays a wooden cradle that was used in a Maltese home.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出了一只曾在马耳他家庭中使用的木制摇篮。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hi t-tarbija? Pawlu: Qiegħda torqod fil-benniena. Nitkellmu bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the baby? Pawlu: She's sleeping in the cradle. Let's speak quietly.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：宝宝在哪里？保罗：她在摇篮里睡觉。我们小声说话吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 宝宝在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the baby?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 她在摇篮里睡觉。我们小声说话吧。
messages.en: She's sleeping in the cradle. Let's speak quietly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 benniena 贴在“宝宝睡的小床”这张图上；再用 bennen il-benniena 记住摇动的动作和摇篮这个物件。

gloss_zh: 使瘀伤；设法挽回面子；缓和

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause a bruise; figuratively, to make the best of a difficult situation while trying to save face, or to tone something down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使身体某处出现瘀伤；也可比喻在困境中设法应对并挽回面子，或减弱某事物的强度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikkawża tbenġil fil-ġisem; f'sens figurattiv, ipprova jsalva wiċċu f'sitwazzjoni diffiċli jew għamel xi ħaġa inqas qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使出现瘀伤；使碰青。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make the best of a difficult situation and seek to save face
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在困难处境中尽力应对，并设法挽回面子。
缓和；减弱语气、程度或强度。

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ, l-atleta waqa' u benġel irkopptu.
formal.en: During training, the athlete fell and bruised his knee.
formal.zh: 训练期间，这名运动员摔倒，碰青了膝盖。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara lil ħuk? Toni: Ħabat mal-mejda u benġel driegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to your brother? Toni: He bumped into the table and bruised his arm.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你兄弟怎么了？托尼：他撞到了桌子，碰青了手臂。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to your brother?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 他撞到了桌子，碰青了手臂。
messages.en: He bumped into the table and bruised his arm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张学习卡分别记 benġel：手臂碰青、困境中找台阶、把语气放缓；这是义项分组记忆，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stare at someone or something; in other senses, to search for something or to shine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 盯着某人或某物看；其他义项包括寻找某物和发光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħares fit-tul lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa; f'sensi oħra, fittex xi ħaġa jew idda.

sense_translations.en_definition: to stare at sb. or sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 凝视；盯着某人或某物看。
寻找某物。
发光；闪耀。

formal.mt: Meta sema' l-ħoss, ir-raġel waqaf jaqra u bera lejn il-bieb.
formal.en: When he heard the noise, the man stopped reading and stared at the door.
formal.zh: 听见响声后，那名男子停止阅读，盯着门看。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Pawlu waqaf jitkellem? Mark: Sema' ħoss u bera lejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Pawlu stop talking? Mark: He heard a noise and stared at the window.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗怎么突然不说话了？马克：他听见了响声，就盯着窗户看。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么突然不说话了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu stop talking?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sema' ħoss u bera lejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Sema' ħoss u bera lejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 他听见了响声，就盯着窗户看。
messages.en: He heard a noise and stared at the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅小图分别记 bera：眼睛盯着窗户、人在寻找物品、灯在黑暗中发光；这是义项提示，不表示词源关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bright flashes of light seen in the sky during a thunderstorm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雷暴时天空中出现的明亮闪光，即闪电。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dawl qawwi li jteptep fis-sema waqt maltempata bir-ragħad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪电；雷暴时天空中的电光。

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, il-maltempata ġabet magħha beraq u ragħad qawwi.
formal.en: During the night, the storm brought lightning and loud thunder.
formal.zh: 夜间，暴风雨带来了闪电和响亮的雷声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt dak il-beraq? Pawlu: Iva, dawwal is-sema kollu!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see that lightning? Pawlu: Yes, it lit up the whole sky!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到那道闪电了吗？保罗：看到了，把整个天空都照亮了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到那道闪电了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that lightning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，把整个天空都照亮了！
messages.en: Yes, it lit up the whole sky!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象天空突然闪亮，再听见雷声：beraq记作眼睛看见的闪电，和表示雷声的ragħad搭配记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To use money or other resources carelessly, wasting them instead of putting them to good use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不加珍惜或缺乏计划地耗用金钱等资源，使其白白浪费；尤指挥霍钱财。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juża flus jew riżorsi oħra bla għaqal, u jaħlihom minflok jużahom tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 浪费；使本可有效利用的资源白白耗去。
挥霍钱财；无节制或不明智地花钱。
浪费，挥霍；不加珍惜地耗用财物或其他资源。

formal.mt: Fi ftit xhur, ir-raġel berbaq il-wirt kollu fuq affarijiet li ma kellux bżonn.
formal.en: In a few months, the man squandered his entire inheritance on things he did not need.
formal.zh: 短短几个月内，这名男子就把全部遗产挥霍在了不需要的东西上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn marru l-flus ta' Toni? Mark: Berbaq kollox fuq affarijiet li ma kellux bżonn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did Toni's money go? Mark: He squandered it all on things he did not need.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：托尼的钱都去哪儿了？马克：他全都挥霍在不需要的东西上了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼的钱都去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Toni's money go?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Berbaq kollox fuq affarijiet li ma kellux bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Berbaq kollox fuq affarijiet li ma kellux bżonn.
messages.zh: 他全都挥霍在不需要的东西上了。
messages.en: He squandered it all on things he did not need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把berbaq放进“钱花光了，却没买到需要的东西”的场景，联想没有计划地挥霍和浪费。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To steal, especially small amounts or small items, or to cheat someone dishonestly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 偷取他人的财物，尤指小额钱财或小物件；也可指以不诚实的方式欺骗他人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jisraq, speċjalment ammonti żgħar jew oġġetti żgħar, jew iqarraq b'xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偷窃；未经允许取走他人的财物。
欺骗；以不诚实的手段蒙骗他人。
小偷小摸；偷偷拿走少量钱财或小物件。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, l-impjegat berbex ftit flus mill-kexxun tal-ħanut.
formal.en: According to the report, the employee pilfered a little money from the shop's drawer.
formal.zh: 据报告称，这名员工从商店的抽屉里偷拿了少量钱款。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex qed tgħodd il-muniti? Ġorġ: Xi ħadd berbex ftit flus mill-kexxun.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are you counting the coins? Ġorġ: Someone pilfered a little money from the drawer.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么在数硬币？乔治：有人从抽屉里偷拿了一点钱。

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 你为什么在数硬币？
messages.en: Why are you counting the coins?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd berbex ftit flus mill-kexxun.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd berbex ftit flus mill-kexxun.
messages.zh: 有人从抽屉里偷拿了一点钱。
messages.en: Someone pilfered a little money from the drawer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象抽屉里少了几枚硬币，用berbex记“小偷小摸”；再把“欺骗”作为相关但独立的义项记住。

gloss_zh: 嬉闹；四处游荡；喧闹；放荡度日

teaching_sense.en_definition: To romp noisily, gad about, or cause an uproar; it can also describe leading a debauched life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 嬉戏打闹、四处游荡或制造喧闹；也可指过放纵、放荡的生活。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jilgħab u jiġri b'ħafna storbju, jiġġerra jew iqajjem għagħa; jista' jfisser ukoll li jgħix ħajja bla rażan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嬉闹；活泼而喧闹地奔跑玩耍。
四处游荡；到处闲逛或寻乐。
制造喧闹；引起吵闹或骚动。
过放荡的生活；沉溺于无节制的享乐。

collocations.en: he gadded about in the streets

formal.mt: Waqt il-ħin tal-mistrieħ, it-tifel berdel fil-bitħa u għamel ħafna storbju.
formal.en: During the break, the boy romped in the yard and made a lot of noise.
formal.zh: 休息期间，那个男孩在院子里嬉闹，弄出了很大的声响。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Leo għajjien daqshekk? Marija: Berdel fil-bitħa wara l-iskola!
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is Leo so tired? Marija: He romped in the yard after school!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：利奥怎么这么累？玛丽亚：他放学后在院子里疯玩了一通！

messages.speaker: Anna (姑妈)
messages.zh: 利奥怎么这么累？
messages.en: Why is Leo so tired?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 他放学后在院子里疯玩了一通！
messages.en: He romped in the yard after school!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两组画面记berdel：孩子奔跑嬉闹、人们游荡喧闹；涉及成人生活时，另记“放荡度日”的较重含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small wingless parasitic insect that jumps and feeds on the blood of animals or people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种没有翅膀、善于跳跃并吸食动物或人血液的小型寄生昆虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett parassita żgħir bla ġwienaħ li jaqbeż u jixrob id-demm tal-annimali jew tan-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一只跳蚤。
跳蚤，一种吸血的寄生昆虫。

formal.mt: Il-veterinarju sab bergħud fil-pil tal-kelb waqt l-eżami.
formal.en: The veterinarian found a flea in the dog's fur during the examination.
formal.zh: 兽医在检查时发现狗的毛里有一只跳蚤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jinħakk il-kelb? Mark: Sibt bergħud fil-pil tiegħu. Se nċempel lill-veterinarju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the dog scratching? Mark: I found a flea in his fur. I'll call the vet.
colloquial.zh: Maja：狗为什么一直在挠痒？Mark：我在它毛里发现了一只跳蚤。我会给兽医打电话。

messages.speaker: Maja (宠物主人)
messages.zh: 狗为什么一直在挠痒？
messages.en: Why is the dog scratching?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt bergħud fil-pil tiegħu. Se nċempel lill-veterinarju.
messages.mt_standard: Sibt bergħud fil-pil tiegħu. Se nċempel lill-veterinarju.
messages.zh: 我在它毛里发现了一只跳蚤。我会给兽医打电话。
messages.en: I found a flea in his fur. I'll call the vet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象狗毛里有一个会跳的小黑点，把它标作 bergħud；再联想被叮后发痒的情景，记住“跳蚤”和叮咬搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cap worn on the head as a covering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戴在头上、用于遮盖头部的便帽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għata li jintlibes fuq ir-ras.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 便帽；戴在头上的帽子。
帽子，指戴在头上的便帽。

formal.mt: Meta t-temperatura tinżel, huwa utli li tilbes beritta tas-suf biex iżżomm rasek sħuna.
formal.en: When the temperature drops, wearing a woollen cap helps keep your head warm.
formal.zh: 气温下降时，戴一顶羊毛帽有助于头部保暖。

colloquial.mt: David: Fejn hi l-beritta tiegħi? Sara: Fuq is-siġġu, ħdejn il-kowt.
colloquial.en: David: Where is my cap? Sara: On the chair, next to the coat.
colloquial.zh: 戴维：我的帽子在哪儿？萨拉：在椅子上，外套旁边。

messages.speaker: David (哥哥)
messages.zh: 我的帽子在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is my cap?

messages.speaker: Sara (妹妹)
messages.zh: 在椅子上，外套旁边。
messages.en: On the chair, next to the coat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前先拿外套，再把beritta戴到头上；把这个词和“戴帽子”的动作一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Apricots: small, soft, yellow-orange fruits with a stone inside.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 杏子，体形较小、果肉柔软、颜色黄中带橙且内部有果核的水果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frott żgħir u artab, ta' lewn isfar fl-oranġjo, b'għadma fin-nofs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杏；杏子。
杏子；可指杏这种水果或若干杏子。

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, aħsel il-berquq, neħħi l-għadam u aqta' l-frott f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: For this recipe, wash the apricots, remove the stones, and cut the fruit into small pieces.
formal.zh: 制作这道食谱时，先洗净杏子、去核，再将果肉切成小块。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek berquq frisk illum? Ġużeppi: Iva, kemm tixtieq? Nina: Nofs kilo, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have fresh apricots today? Ġużeppi: Yes, how much would you like? Nina: Half a kilo, please.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：今天有新鲜杏子吗？朱塞佩：有，您要多少？妮娜：请给我半公斤。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天有新鲜杏子吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh apricots today?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (水果摊主)
messages.zh: 有，您要多少？
messages.en: Yes, how much would you like?

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我半公斤。
messages.en: Half a kilo, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把berquq放在水果摊的画面里：黄橙色杏子买半公斤，也能熬成ġamm tal-berquq杏酱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To open something wide, such as a door, or to make information or a statement public.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把门等充分打开、敞开；也指公开信息或声明，使人知晓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiftaħ xi ħaġa beraħ, bħal bieb, jew jagħmel informazzjoni jew stqarrija magħrufa lill-pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大大打开；使充分敞开。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make sth. public (especially a statement or piece of information)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 公开某事，尤指公布声明或信息。
把某物充分打开，例如把门敞开。
公布；使广为人知。

formal.mt: Wara l-laqgħa, il-president berraħ l-aħbar dwar il-proġett il-ġdid.
formal.en: After the meeting, the president made the news about the new project public.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，主席公布了有关新项目的消息。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Berraħ il-bieb, jekk jogħġbok; din il-kaxxa kbira. Toni: Hekk tajjeb? Elena: Iva, issa nista' ngħaddi.
colloquial.en: Elena: Open the door wide, please; this box is big. Toni: Is that wide enough? Elena: Yes, now I can get through.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：请把门开大一点，这个箱子很大。托尼：这样够大吗？埃莱娜：够了，现在我能过去了。

messages.speaker: Elena (搬家住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Berraħ il-bieb, jekk jogħġbok; din il-kaxxa kbira.
messages.mt_standard: Berraħ il-bieb, jekk jogħġbok; din il-kaxxa kbira.
messages.zh: 请把门开大一点，这个箱子很大。
messages.en: Open the door wide, please; this box is big.

messages.speaker: Toni (帮忙的朋友)
messages.zh: 这样够大吗？
messages.en: Is that wide enough?

messages.speaker: Elena (搬家住户)
messages.zh: 够了，现在我能过去了。
messages.en: Yes, now I can get through.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“打开”串起两个学习画面：把门打开是敞开，把消息向大家打开是公开；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lower the temperature of something, making it cooler.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 降低某物的温度，使其冷却或变得更凉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas it-temperatura ta' xi ħaġa u jagħmilha aktar kiesħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物冷却；降低某物的温度。
使更凉；使温度比原来更低。

formal.mt: Il-kok berred it-taħlita qabel ma żied l-ingredjenti l-oħra.
formal.en: The cook cooled the mixture before adding the other ingredients.
formal.zh: 厨师先将混合物冷却，再加入其余配料。

colloquial.mt: Marta: L-ilma għadu sħun wisq. Luqa: Berred ftit minnu bis-silġ. Marta: Tajjeb, hekk nista' nixorbu.
colloquial.en: Marta: The water is still too warm. Luqa: Cool some of it with ice. Marta: Good, then I can drink it.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：水还是太热了。卢卡：拿一些出来加冰降温吧。玛尔塔：好，这样我就能喝了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 水还是太热了。
messages.en: The water is still too warm.

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 拿一些出来加冰降温吧。
messages.en: Cool some of it with ice.

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，这样我就能喝了。
messages.en: Good, then I can drink it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象往温水里放冰块，温度慢慢下降：berred强调让某物变凉，可联系冷却饮料或给房间降温的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lay someone or something down, or to make someone lie down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人或某物放倒、放平，或使某人躺下；也可表示强迫其躺下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa mimduda, jew iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jimtedd.

sense_translations.en_definition: to lay sth. or sb. down
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物放平，或让某人躺下。
强迫某人躺下；把某人强行放倒。

collocations.en: lay the child down on the bed
force the opponent down onto the ground

formal.mt: Il-missier berrek lit-tifel fuq is-sodda bil-mod biex ma jqajmux.
formal.en: The father gently laid the child down on the bed so as not to wake him.
formal.zh: 父亲轻轻地把孩子放到床上，以免把他弄醒。

colloquial.mt: Marija: It-tifel raqad f'idejja. Pawlu: Berrek lit-tifel fuq is-sodda bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Marija: The child has fallen asleep in my arms. Pawlu: Gently lay the child down on the bed.
colloquial.zh: Marija：孩子在我怀里睡着了。Pawlu：轻轻地把孩子放到床上躺下。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子在我怀里睡着了。
messages.en: The child has fallen asleep in my arms.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 轻轻地把孩子放到床上躺下。
messages.en: Gently lay the child down on the bed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用动作画面记忆：把原本站着或抱着的人放到躺平的位置，联想到 berrek；加上强制动作，就能记住“强迫躺下”的义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small hand tool with a pointed, spiral end, used to bore holes, especially in wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种带尖头和螺旋钻身的小型手动工具，主要用于在木料上钻小孔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda żgħira tal-idejn b'ponta u parti spirali, li tintuża biex tagħmel toqob, speċjalment fl-injam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手钻；用手转动、在木料等材料上钻小孔的尖头工具。

collocations.en: make a hole with a gimlet

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa uża berrina biex jagħmel toqba żgħira fl-injam qabel daħħal il-vit.
formal.en: The carpenter used a gimlet to make a small hole in the wood before inserting the screw.
formal.zh: 木匠先用手钻在木料上钻了一个小孔，然后才拧入螺丝。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek berrina biex nagħmel toqba żgħira? Toni: Iva, qiegħda fil-kaxxa tal-għodda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a gimlet so I can make a small hole? Toni: Yes, it's in the toolbox.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你有手钻吗？我想钻个小孔。Toni：有，在工具箱里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek berrina biex nagħmel toqba żgħira?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek berrina biex nagħmel toqba żgħira?
messages.zh: 你有手钻吗？我想钻个小孔。
messages.en: Do you have a gimlet so I can make a small hole?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，在工具箱里。
messages.en: Yes, it's in the toolbox.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 berrina 和“手转小钻、木板小孔”这幅画面绑在一起记：拿起工具，旋转钻身，留下一个小孔。

gloss_zh: 甜瓜；使人或物松弛的事物；驴的睾丸

teaching_sense.en_definition: Melon as a fruit or food, with a rind and a soft, juicy interior.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 甜瓜这一类水果或其果肉，外有瓜皮，内部柔软多汁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frott b'qoxra minn barra u b'ġewwieni artab u mmerraq, li jittiekel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 甜瓜；一种瓜类水果。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. or sth. that causes flabbiness
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人或物变得松软、松弛的人或事物。
甜瓜；也可集合地指多个甜瓜或甜瓜这一类水果。
驴的睾丸。

formal.mt: Għad-deżerta, ir-restorant serva bettieħ frisk maqtugħ f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: For dessert, the restaurant served fresh melon cut into small pieces.
formal.zh: 餐厅的餐后甜点是切成小块的新鲜甜瓜。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid biċċa bettieħ? David: Iva, grazzi! Dan il-bettieħ ħelu ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Would you like a piece of melon? David: Yes, thanks! This melon is very sweet.
colloquial.zh: Nina：要来块甜瓜吗？David：好，谢谢！这甜瓜真甜。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 要来块甜瓜吗？
messages.en: Would you like a piece of melon?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi! Dan il-bettieħ ħelu ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi! Dan il-bettieħ ħelu ħafna.
messages.zh: 好，谢谢！这甜瓜真甜。
messages.en: Yes, thanks! This melon is very sweet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“切开甜瓜、分一块吃”的日常画面记住 bettieħ。其他义项另做小卡片，按具体语境辨认，避免见到这个词就套用同一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The liquid waste produced by the kidneys and passed out of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由肾脏产生并排出体外的液体废物，即尿液。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-likwidu ta' skart li jipproduċu l-kliewi u li joħroġ mill-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尿液；人体或动物排出的液体废物。
尿；尿液，对应英语中口语、粗俗或中性等不同表达。

formal.mt: Il-laboratorju rċieva l-kampjun tal-bewl għall-analiżi.
formal.en: The laboratory received the urine sample for testing.
formal.zh: 实验室收到了用于检测的尿液样本。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn inħalli l-kampjun tal-bewl? Rita: Agħtih lill-infermiera ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where should I leave the urine sample? Rita: Give it to the nurse by the door.
colloquial.zh: Mark：尿液样本放在哪里？Rita：交给门旁边的护士。

messages.speaker: Mark (患者)
messages.zh: 尿液样本放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I leave the urine sample?

messages.speaker: Rita (接待员)
messages.zh: 交给门旁边的护士。
messages.en: Give it to the nurse by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bewl 放进“尿液样本杯”的检查场景记忆，再连读 kampjun tal-bewl，让单词和常见搭配一起进入记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose job is to attend a building's entrance and receive or admit people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在建筑物入口值守，负责接待或放行来访者的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem fid-daħla ta' bini u tilqa' lin-nies jew tħallihom jidħlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 门房；在建筑物入口接待、值守的工作人员。

sense_translations.en_definition: one who stands on duty a the door
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在门口站岗或值班的人。
看门人；门卫。

formal.mt: Il-bewwieb tal-iskola talab lill-viżitaturi jistennew fid-daħla.
formal.en: The school doorkeeper asked the visitors to wait at the entrance.
formal.zh: 学校门卫请来访者在入口处等候。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-bieb magħluq. Kif nidħlu? Ġorġ: Staqsi lill-bewwieb; qiegħed hemm ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Sara: The door is closed. How do we get in? Ġorġ: Ask the doorkeeper; he's over there by the window.
colloquial.zh: Sara：门关着，我们怎么进去？Ġorġ：问问门卫，他就在那边窗户旁。

messages.speaker: Sara (来访者)
messages.zh: 门关着，我们怎么进去？
messages.en: The door is closed. How do we get in?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lill-bewwieb; qiegħed hemm ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lill-bewwieb; qiegħed hemm ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 问问门卫，他就在那边窗户旁。
messages.en: Ask the doorkeeper; he's over there by the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象入口旁一直有人值守，来客先向他问路：把这个“守在门口的人”的角色与 bewwieb 连起来记。

gloss_zh: 喷洒；洒；喷洒作业；农用喷洒药剂

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scatter liquid in small drops over someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把液体化成小滴喷到或洒到某人、某物的表面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ixerred likwidu fi qtar żgħir fuq xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喷；喷洒，使液体以细小液滴散布。
洒；把少量液体以小滴分散洒下。
喷洒这一动作或作业。
洒水或洒下小滴液体这一动作。

sense_translations.en_definition: insecticide sprayed over crops in agriculture
sense_translations.zh_definition: 农业中喷洒在作物上的杀虫剂。
喷洒；把液体以细滴喷出或洒下。

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar bexx ftit ilma fuq il-weraq tal-pjanti.
formal.en: The gardener sprayed a little water onto the plants' leaves.
formal.zh: 园丁在植物的叶子上喷了少量水。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-weraq mimli trab. Ben: Bexx ftit ilma fuqu, imbagħad imsaħ bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Anna: The leaves are covered in dust. Ben: Spray a little water on them, then wipe gently.
colloquial.zh: Anna：叶子上全是灰。Ben：往上面喷点水，再轻轻擦。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 叶子上全是灰。
messages.en: The leaves are covered in dust.

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bexx ftit ilma fuqu, imbagħad imsaħ bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Bexx ftit ilma fuqu, imbagħad imsaħ bil-mod.
messages.zh: 往上面喷点水，再轻轻擦。
messages.en: Spray a little water on them, then wipe gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用喷壶冒出细小水滴的画面记 bexx。再给例句贴上词性标签：动词是“喷洒”，名词是“喷洒作业”，农业语境还可指喷洒的杀虫剂。

gloss_zh: 稍微打开；使半开；保持半开；展开

teaching_sense.en_definition: To open something a little, leave or keep it partly open, or unfold something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物稍微打开，让其处于或保持半开状态；也可表示展开折叠的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiftaħ xi ħaġa ftit, iħalliha jew iżommha nofsha miftuħa, jew jiftaħ xi ħaġa mitwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 稍微打开；开一道小缝。
让门窗等留着缝隙，处于半开状态。
使门窗等保持半开状态。
展开；打开原先折叠的东西。

formal.mt: L-għalliem bexxaq it-tieqa biex tidħol ftit arja fil-klassi.
formal.en: The teacher opened the window slightly to let a little air into the classroom.
formal.zh: 老师把窗户打开一道缝，让一点空气进入教室。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Hawn sħana. Niftaħ il-bieb? Luqa: Iva, bexxaq il-bieb biex tidħol ftit arja.
colloquial.en: Marta: It's hot in here. Shall I open the door? Luqa: Yes, open the door a little to let some air in.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这里好热。我把门打开好吗？Luqa：好，把门开一点，让空气进来。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 这里好热。我把门打开好吗？
messages.en: It's hot in here. Shall I open the door?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bexxaq il-bieb biex tidħol ftit arja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bexxaq il-bieb biex tidħol ftit arja.
messages.zh: 好，把门开一点，让空气进来。
messages.en: Yes, open the door a little to let some air in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bexxaq 配上“一道门缝透进光”的画面，记住稍开、留缝和保持半开；“展开”义另配打开折叠物的动作来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spray or sprinkle liquid repeatedly, using a series of small applications.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 连续或多次把液体以细小液滴喷出、洒下，强调反复进行这一动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ixerred likwidu fi qtar żgħir għal diversi drabi wara xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复喷洒；多次喷出液体。
反复喷或洒；接连多次把液体以小滴散布。

collocations.en: spray water repeatedly onto the plants
spray the leaves repeatedly with water

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar bexxex l-ilma fuq il-pjanti b'diversi movimenti qosra.
formal.en: The gardener repeatedly sprayed water onto the plants using several short movements.
formal.zh: 园丁用数次短促的动作，反复向植物喷水。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kif nixxarrab dawn il-weraq? Samwel: Bexxex ftit ilma fuqhom sakemm jixxarrbu kollha.
colloquial.en: Elena: How do I wet these leaves? Samwel: Spray a little water onto them repeatedly until they're all wet.
colloquial.zh: Elena：这些叶子要怎么弄湿？Samwel：往上面反复喷一点水，直到全都湿了。

messages.speaker: Elena (园艺初学者)
messages.zh: 这些叶子要怎么弄湿？
messages.en: How do I wet these leaves?

messages.speaker: Samwel (园艺同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Bexxex ftit ilma fuqhom sakemm jixxarrbu kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Bexxex ftit ilma fuqhom sakemm jixxarrbu kollha.
messages.zh: 往上面反复喷一点水，直到全都湿了。
messages.en: Spray a little water onto them repeatedly until they're all wet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 bexxex 时配合手指连续按几次喷壶，口中默念“喷、喷、再喷”，用重复动作记住它强调反复喷洒的意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that sprays water, or a watering can used to water plants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喷洒水的装置，也可指给植物浇水用的洒水壶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jferrex l-ilma fi qtar, jew reċipjent li jintuża biex jissaqqew il-pjanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洒水器；将水喷洒出去的装置。
浇水壶；给植物浇水用的手提容器。

collocations.en: a watering can full of water

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar uża bexxiexa biex isaqqi l-pjanti żgħar mingħajr ma jagħmel ħsara lill-weraq.
formal.en: The gardener used a watering can to water the small plants without damaging the leaves.
formal.zh: 园丁用浇水壶给小植物浇水，避免损伤叶片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-bexxiexa? Irrid insaqqi l-fjuri. Toni: Ħdejn il-bieb. Imla l-bexxiexa qabel tibda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where's the watering can? I want to water the flowers. Toni: By the door. Fill the watering can before you start.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：浇水壶在哪儿？我想给花浇水。托尼：在门旁边。开始之前先把浇水壶装满。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-bexxiexa? Irrid insaqqi l-fjuri.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-bexxiexa? Irrid insaqqi l-fjuri.
messages.zh: 浇水壶在哪儿？我想给花浇水。
messages.en: Where's the watering can? I want to water the flowers.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-bieb. Imla l-bexxiexa qabel tibda.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-bieb. Imla l-bexxiexa qabel tibda.
messages.zh: 在门旁边。开始之前先把浇水壶装满。
messages.en: By the door. Fill the watering can before you start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bexxiexa 配上两幅浇花图：草地上的洒水器和手里的浇水壶，用同一喷水画面串起两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something, especially a face or flesh, soft, loose, and lacking firmness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物，尤其是面部或肌肉，变得松软、松弛而缺乏紧实感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa, speċjalment il-wiċċ jew il-laħam, ratba u mitluqa, mingħajr fermezza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变得松软、松弛。
使面部等部位变得松弛、不紧实。

formal.mt: Fil-ħrafa, is-saħħar bezzen wiċċ ir-raġel b'kelma waħda, u wiċċu sar artab u mitluq.
formal.en: In the fairy tale, the sorcerer made the man's face flabby with a single word, and his face became soft and loose.
formal.zh: 在童话中，巫师只说了一个词，就使那个男人的面部变得松软松弛。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser 'bezzen il-wiċċ' f'din il-ħrafa? Toni: Tfisser li għamel il-wiċċ artab u mitluq.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'bezzen il-wiċċ' mean in this fairy tale? Toni: It means that he made the face soft and flabby.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这篇童话里的“bezzen il-wiċċ”是什么意思？托尼：意思是他使面部变得松软松弛。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇童话里的“bezzen il-wiċċ”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'bezzen il-wiċċ' mean in this fairy tale?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li għamel il-wiċċ artab u mitluq.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li għamel il-wiċċ artab u mitluq.
messages.zh: 意思是他使面部变得松软松弛。
messages.en: It means that he made the face soft and flabby.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用紧实面孔变得松松垮垮的前后对照图记忆：bezzen 强调“使它变松弛”的动作。

gloss_zh: 小面包；长条面包；容易受骗的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bread roll or baguette; in another sense, a person who is easily deceived.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小面包或长条面包；另一个义项指容易受骗、被人愚弄的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħobża żgħira jew twila; f'tifsira oħra, persuna li titqarraq faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个小面包。
小面包；法式长条面包。
容易受骗的人；被人愚弄的冤大头。

formal.mt: Għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar, kull parteċipant ingħata bezzun bil-ġobon u flixkun ilma.
formal.en: For lunch, each participant was given a bread roll with cheese and a bottle of water.
formal.zh: 午餐时，每位参加者都领到了一个夹奶酪的小面包和一瓶水。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Nixtieq bezzun frisk, jekk jogħġbok. Ġużeppi: Tridu bil-ġobon? Marija: Iva, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Marija: I'd like a fresh bread roll, please. Ġużeppi: Would you like it with cheese? Marija: Yes, thank you.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：请给我一个新鲜的小面包。朱塞佩：要夹奶酪的吗？玛丽娅：要，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我一个新鲜的小面包。
messages.en: I'd like a fresh bread roll, please.

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (店员)
messages.zh: 要夹奶酪的吗？
messages.en: Would you like it with cheese?

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, thank you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张独立词义卡：一张是早餐小面包，一张是容易受骗的人；靠上下文选择 bezzun 的意思。

gloss_zh: 鸽子；幼鸽；亲爱的；容易受骗的傻瓜

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pigeon, especially a young pigeon; also an affectionate term for someone dear or a label for a gullible person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指鸽子，尤其是幼鸽；也可作亲昵称呼，或指头脑简单、容易受骗的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħamiema, speċjalment waħda żgħira; ukoll kelma ta' għożża għal persuna għażiża jew isem għal persuna li titqarraq malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一只鸽子。
幼鸽；尚年幼的小鸽子。
亲爱的；宝贝，用来亲昵地称呼某人。
傻瓜；头脑简单、容易受骗的人。

collocations.en: a baby pigeon in the nest

formal.mt: L-istudent osserva beċċun fil-bejta u kiteb deskrizzjoni qasira tad-dehra tiegħu.
formal.en: The student observed a baby pigeon in the nest and wrote a short description of its appearance.
formal.zh: 学生观察了巢里的一只幼鸽，并简要描写了它的外貌。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ejja hawn, il-beċċun tiegħi! Pawlu: Ġej, ma! Xi trid turini?
colloquial.en: Anna: Come here, my darling! Pawlu: Coming, Mum! What do you want to show me?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：过来，我的宝贝！保罗：来了，妈妈！你想给我看什么？

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 过来，我的宝贝！
messages.en: Come here, my darling!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (儿子)
messages.zh: 来了，妈妈！你想给我看什么？
messages.en: Coming, Mum! What do you want to show me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张图记 beċċun：巢中小鸽、母亲叫宝贝、轻信他人的人；最后一种看语气，不能一律译成亲爱的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel fear or be afraid of someone or something; also, to care for someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人、某物或某种情况感到害怕；另有关系义项，表示关心或照料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss biża' minn xi ħadd jew minn xi ħaġa; jista' wkoll ifisser li jieħu ħsieb xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 畏惧；害怕某人或某事。
感到害怕；处于恐惧之中。
畏惧；感到害怕。
关心；照料；用心照顾。

collocations.en: he was afraid to go in

formal.mt: It-tifel beża' mill-ħoss qawwi u talab lill-għalliem jibqa' ħdejh.
formal.en: The boy was frightened by the loud noise and asked the teacher to stay beside him.
formal.zh: 男孩听到巨响感到害怕，请老师留在自己身旁。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Pawlu ma daħalx fil-ġnien? Mark: Beża' mill-kelb, imma issa l-kelb qiegħed ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why didn't Pawlu go into the garden? Mark: He was afraid of the dog, but the dog is indoors now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗为什么没进花园？马克：他怕那只狗，不过狗现在已经在屋里了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么没进花园？
messages.en: Why didn't Pawlu go into the garden?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Beża' mill-kelb, imma issa l-kelb qiegħed ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Beża' mill-kelb, imma issa l-kelb qiegħed ġewwa.
messages.zh: 他怕那只狗，不过狗现在已经在屋里了。
messages.en: He was afraid of the dog, but the dog is indoors now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用角色对照记忆：beża' 是自己感到害怕，beżża' 是使别人害怕；先分清谁在怕，再选词。

gloss_zh: 吐；脱口说出；喷出；泄密；酷似

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spit or force something out; figuratively, to blurt something out, reveal a secret, or closely resemble someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吐出唾液或将东西喷出、猛烈甩脱；也可表示树木落叶、说话不经思考、泄露秘密或长得酷似某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ il-bżieq minn ħalqu jew jitfa' xi ħaġa 'l barra bil-qawwa; jista' wkoll ifisser li jgħid xi ħaġa bla ħsieb, jikxef sigriet, jew jixbah ħafna lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吐唾液；吐口水。

sense_translations.en_definition: to blurt out sth. without thinking
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不假思索地脱口说出某事。
喷出；排出；将某物推出或抛出。
猛烈甩掉；用力摆脱或抛脱。
指树木落叶或脱落其他部分。
泄露秘密；把秘密说出来。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be the spitting image of
sense_translations.zh_definition: 长得与某人极其相像；简直是某人的翻版。

formal.mt: Ir-raġel beżaq l-ilma li kien daħallu f'ħalqu waqt li kien jgħum.
formal.en: The man spat out the water that had entered his mouth while he was swimming.
formal.zh: 男子把游泳时进入嘴里的水吐了出来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex kulħadd jaf bis-sorpriża? Toni: Mark beżaq is-sigriet waqt l-ikel. Qal kollox bla ma ħaseb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does everyone know about the surprise? Toni: Mark let the secret out during the meal. He said everything without thinking.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么大家都知道那个惊喜了？托尼：马克吃饭时把秘密说漏了。他没多想就全说了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 为什么大家都知道那个惊喜了？
messages.en: Why does everyone know about the surprise?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark beżaq is-sigriet waqt l-ikel. Qal kollox bla ma ħaseb.
messages.mt_standard: Mark beżaq is-sigriet waqt l-ikel. Qal kollox bla ma ħaseb.
messages.zh: 马克吃饭时把秘密说漏了。他没多想就全说了。
messages.en: Mark let the secret out during the meal. He said everything without thinking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 beżaq 记成嘴里往外吐，再用学习画面联想把话和秘密吐出来；酷似某人的义项另配人物对照图记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A scare or fright: an occasion or sudden feeling of being afraid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次惊吓，或突然感到害怕的一阵恐惧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mument jew esperjenza li fiha persuna tħoss biża' għal għarrieda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次惊吓；令人受到惊吓的经历。
一阵惊恐；突然受到的惊吓。
一次惊吓；一阵突如其来的恐惧。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ħa beżgħa meta waqgħet kaxxa tqila ħdejh, iżda ma weġġax.
formal.en: The worker got a fright when a heavy box fell beside him, but he was not injured.
formal.zh: 一个沉重的箱子掉在工人身旁，把他吓了一跳，不过他没有受伤。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ħadt beżgħa meta smajt dak il-ħoss! Pawlu: Kien biss il-bieb. Għalaq bir-riħ.
colloquial.en: Nina: I got a fright when I heard that noise! Pawlu: It was just the door. The wind blew it shut.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：听见那个声音，我吓了一跳！保罗：只是门响了。风把门吹关了。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadt beżgħa meta smajt dak il-ħoss!
messages.mt_standard: Ħadt beżgħa meta smajt dak il-ħoss!
messages.zh: 听见那个声音，我吓了一跳！
messages.en: I got a fright when I heard that noise!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 只是门响了。风把门吹关了。
messages.en: It was just the door. The wind blew it shut.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 beżgħa 想成一次心里咯噔的惊吓事件，连着 ħa beżgħa 一起记，就能从名词想到吓了一跳。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling fear about something or someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某个人或某件事而感到害怕的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss biża' minn xi ħadd jew minn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 害怕的。
害怕的；处于恐惧之中的。

formal.mt: It-tifel kien beżgħan mid-dlam u talab li d-dawl jibqa' mixgħul.
formal.en: The boy was afraid of the dark and asked for the light to remain on.
formal.zh: 男孩怕黑，请求让灯继续亮着。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ma tidħolx? Pawlu: Jien beżgħan mill-kelb. Marija: Ejja miegħi; il-kelb qiegħed fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why don't you come in? Pawlu: I'm afraid of the dog. Marija: Come with me; the dog is in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你怎么不进来？保罗：我怕那只狗。玛丽娅：跟我来吧，狗在花园里。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么不进来？
messages.en: Why don't you come in?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我怕那只狗。
messages.en: I'm afraid of the dog.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 跟我来吧，狗在花园里。
messages.en: Come with me; the dog is in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与怕黑时紧抓手电筒的画面绑定，记住它描述的是人的害怕状态。

gloss_zh: 吮奶；喝时咂嘴；弄得一团糟；做菜难吃；说话喷唾沫

teaching_sense.en_definition: To suckle or make sucking or lip-smacking sounds while drinking; also, to make a mess, cook badly, or spit while talking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吮奶，或喝东西时发出吮吸、咂嘴声；也可表示弄得一团糟、烹饪得很差或说话时喷出唾沫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Terda' jew jagħmel ħsejjes bix-xufftejn waqt li jixrob; jista' wkoll ifisser li jagħmel taħwid, isajjar ħażin, jew joħroġ il-bżieq waqt li jitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吮奶；吃奶，或给幼儿、幼兽哺乳。

sense_translations.en_definition: to smack one's lips or make sucking sounds as one drinks
sense_translations.zh_definition: 喝东西时咂嘴或发出吮吸声。
弄得一团糟；把事情或环境搞乱。

sense_translations.en_definition: to smack one's lips while drinking
sense_translations.zh_definition: 喝东西时咂嘴，发出嘴唇开合的声音。
把饭菜做得很差；烹饪得不好。
说话时喷唾沫；讲话时有唾液飞出。

collocations.mt: beżlek waqt li kien qed jixrob
collocations.en: he smacked his lips while drinking

collocations.mt: beżlek waqt li kien qed jitkellem

formal.mt: Waqt l-ikla, it-tifel beżlek hu u jixrob il-ħalib, u ommu talbitu jixrob bil-kwiet.
formal.en: During the meal, the boy smacked his lips while drinking milk, and his mother asked him to drink quietly.
formal.zh: 吃饭时，男孩喝牛奶发出咂嘴声，母亲请他安静地喝。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min kien qed jagħmel dak il-ħoss waqt il-kolazzjon? Lara: Toni beżlek waqt li kien qed jixrob il-ħalib. Smajtu mill-kamra l-oħra!
colloquial.en: Maja: Who was making that noise at breakfast? Lara: Toni was smacking his lips while drinking milk. I heard him from the other room!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：早餐时是谁在发出那个声音？拉拉：托尼喝牛奶时在咂嘴。我在另一个房间都听见了！

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min kien qed jagħmel dak il-ħoss waqt il-kolazzjon?
messages.mt_standard: Min kien qed jagħmel dak il-ħoss waqt il-kolazzjon?
messages.zh: 早餐时是谁在发出那个声音？
messages.en: Who was making that noise at breakfast?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Toni beżlek waqt li kien qed jixrob il-ħalib. Smajtu mill-kamra l-oħra!
messages.mt_standard: Toni beżlek waqt li kien qed jixrob il-ħalib. Smajtu mill-kamra l-oħra!
messages.zh: 托尼喝牛奶时在咂嘴。我在另一个房间都听见了！
messages.en: Toni was smacking his lips while drinking milk. I heard him from the other room!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用喝奶时嘴巴发出啧啧声的画面记 beżlek，再分别给弄乱、做菜差和说话喷唾沫配小场景；这是记忆联想。

gloss_zh: 一口唾沫；一口吐出的东西；一点点液体

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gob of saliva or an act of spitting; also, a very small quantity of liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一口唾液或一次吐唾液的动作；也可指少量液体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont ta' bżieq li joħroġ mill-ħalq, jew darba li wieħed jobżoq; tista' wkoll tfisser kwantità żgħira ħafna ta' likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一口唾液；一团唾沫。
一次吐唾沫的动作，或吐出的一口唾沫。
一点点液体；极少量的液体。

collocations.en: a gob of saliva on the ground

formal.mt: L-addett għat-tindif neħħa beżqa li kien hemm fl-art ħdejn id-daħla.
formal.en: The cleaner removed a gob of saliva from the floor near the entrance.
formal.zh: 清洁人员清理了入口附近地上的一口唾沫。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fadal ilma fil-flixkun? Mark: Fadal biss beżqa ta' ilma. Inġib flixkun ieħor.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there any water left in the bottle? Mark: There's only a tiny bit of water left. I'll get another bottle.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：瓶子里还有水吗？马克：只剩一点点水了。我去拿另一瓶。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 瓶子里还有水吗？
messages.en: Is there any water left in the bottle?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fadal biss beżqa ta' ilma. Inġib flixkun ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Fadal biss beżqa ta' ilma. Inġib flixkun ieħor.
messages.zh: 只剩一点点水了。我去拿另一瓶。
messages.en: There's only a tiny bit of water left. I'll get another bottle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 beżqa 放进一口唾沫和瓶底一点水两幅图中，抓住少量液体的画面；并与动作词 beżaq 对照记忆。

gloss_zh: 吓唬；使恐惧；使惊骇；威吓

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone afraid, terrified, or appalled, or to threaten or intimidate them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使别人害怕、恐惧或惊骇，也可表示以威胁使人畏惧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jibża', iħoss terrur jew jitkexkex; jista' wkoll ifisser li jhedded jew jintimida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吓唬；使人害怕。
使极度恐惧；把人吓坏。
使惊骇；使人因可怕或恶劣之事而震惊。
威胁或恐吓；用威势使人害怕。
使害怕；吓唬；使受到惊吓。

formal.mt: Il-ħoss qawwi tal-allarm beżża' lit-tfal li kienu fil-klassi.
formal.en: The loud sound of the alarm frightened the children who were in the classroom.
formal.zh: 警报的巨响吓到了教室里的孩子们。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tibki Nina? Pawlu: Toni beżża' lil Nina meta qabeż minn wara l-bieb. Issa qed jipprova jikkalmaha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is Nina crying? Pawlu: Toni scared Nina when he jumped out from behind the door. Now he's trying to calm her down.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：妮娜为什么在哭？保罗：托尼从门后跳出来时吓到了妮娜。他现在正试着安抚她。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 妮娜为什么在哭？
messages.en: Why is Nina crying?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Toni beżża' lil Nina meta qabeż minn wara l-bieb. Issa qed jipprova jikkalmaha.
messages.mt_standard: Toni beżża' lil Nina meta qabeż minn wara l-bieb. Issa qed jipprova jikkalmaha.
messages.zh: 托尼从门后跳出来时吓到了妮娜。他现在正试着安抚她。
messages.en: Toni scared Nina when he jumped out from behind the door. Now he's trying to calm her down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 beżża' 的两个 ż，就在学习卡上画两个人：一个做出吓人的动作，一个被吓到，提醒自己这是使别人害怕。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spit repeatedly, producing saliva from the mouth several times.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接连多次吐唾液；反复吐口水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jobżoq diversi drabi, billi joħroġ il-bżieq minn ħalqu għal darba wara oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复吐唾液；接连吐口水。

collocations.en: he spat repeatedly on the ground
he spat repeatedly into the tissue
collocations.zh: 他接连往纸巾里吐唾液

formal.mt: Wara li daħallu t-trab f'ħalqu, il-ħaddiem beżżaq fit-tessut u mbagħad laħlaħ ħalqu bl-ilma.
formal.en: After dust got into his mouth, the worker spat repeatedly into a tissue and then rinsed his mouth with water.
formal.zh: 灰尘进入嘴里后，工人接连往纸巾里吐了几口，随后用水漱口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Toni beżżaq daqshekk? Mark: Daħallu ftit ramel f'ħalqu. Issa qed ilaħlaħ ħalqu bl-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Toni keep spitting like that? Mark: He got some sand in his mouth. Now he's rinsing his mouth with water.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：托尼为什么一直吐口水？马克：他嘴里进了点沙子。他现在正用水漱口。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼为什么一直吐口水？
messages.en: Why did Toni keep spitting like that?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Daħallu ftit ramel f'ħalqu. Issa qed ilaħlaħ ħalqu bl-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Daħallu ftit ramel f'ħalqu. Issa qed ilaħlaħ ħalqu bl-ilma.
messages.zh: 他嘴里进了点沙子。他现在正用水漱口。
messages.en: He got some sand in his mouth. Now he's rinsing his mouth with water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 beżżaq 写在连续吐了好几口的连环画下面，并与 beżaq 对照；用重复画面提醒自己这里强调反复吐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to suffer misfortune or to bring bad luck.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人遭遇不幸，或带来厄运、霉运。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jgħaddi minn sfortuna jew iġib ix-xorti ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人遭遇不幸。
带来不幸或霉运。

collocations.en: brought misfortune upon those who helped him
collocations.zh: 使帮助过他的人遭了殃

formal.mt: Skont il-leġġenda, il-barrani beżżel lill-familja li laqgħetu f'darha.
formal.en: According to the legend, the stranger brought misfortune upon the family that welcomed him into its home.
formal.zh: 据传说，那个陌生人给收留他的家庭带来了厄运。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex fir-rakkont jgħidu li l-barrani beżżel lill-familja? Pawlu: Għax jemmnu li ġabilha xorti ħażina.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why do they say in the story that the stranger brought misfortune upon the family? Pawlu: Because they believe he brought it bad luck.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：故事里为什么说那个陌生人给这家人带来了厄运？保罗：因为他们相信他带来了霉运。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex fir-rakkont jgħidu li l-barrani beżżel lill-familja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex fir-rakkont jgħidu li l-barrani beżżel lill-familja?
messages.zh: 故事里为什么说那个陌生人给这家人带来了厄运？
messages.en: Why do they say in the story that the stranger brought misfortune upon the family?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jemmnu li ġabilha xorti ħażina.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jemmnu li ġabilha xorti ħażina.
messages.zh: 因为他们相信他带来了霉运。
messages.en: Because they believe he brought it bad luck.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词配上故事画面：陌生人一来，全家接连倒霉，记住核心是“带来厄运”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Easily frightened or lacking courage when facing danger or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对危险或困难时容易害怕、缺乏勇气的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibża' malajr jew ma jurix kuraġġ quddiem il-periklu jew id-diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胆小怕事的；用于形容胆小鬼。
怯懦的，胆怯的，容易害怕的。

formal.mt: Fil-bidu tar-rakkont, it-tifel huwa beżżiegħ, iżda bil-mod il-mod jitgħallem juri kuraġġ.
formal.en: At the beginning of the story, the boy is timid, but gradually he learns to show courage.
formal.zh: 故事开头，那个男孩很胆怯，但他逐渐学会表现出勇气。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kelb tiegħek beżżiegħ? Mark: Iva, jibża' mill-ħsejjes qawwija. Kellmu bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is your dog easily frightened? Mark: Yes, he's afraid of loud noises. Speak to him gently.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的狗胆小吗？马克：是的，它怕很响的声音。跟它说话温柔一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.zh: 你的狗胆小吗？
messages.en: Is your dog easily frightened?

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jibża' mill-ħsejjes qawwija. Kellmu bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jibża' mill-ħsejjes qawwija. Kellmu bil-mod.
messages.zh: 是的，它怕很响的声音。跟它说话温柔一点。
messages.en: Yes, he's afraid of loud noises. Speak to him gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只听见巨响就躲起来的小狗，把 beżżiegħ 和“容易害怕、胆怯”一起记。

gloss_zh: 倒霉的；乳房（动物的）；乳头；倒霉的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having bad luck or experiencing unfortunate events.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 运气不好、遭遇不顺的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkollu xorti ħażina jew jgħaddi minn ġrajjiet sfortunati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容某人运气不好的；倒霉的。
母牛等动物的乳房。
乳头。
运气不好的人；倒霉的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel beżżul tilef il-flus u mbagħad falla l-vjaġġ tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the unlucky man lost his money and then his journey fell through.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个倒霉的男人丢了钱，随后他的行程也泡汤了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Illum inħossni beżżul. Rita: X'ġara? Mark: Tlift iċ-ċwievet u mbagħad tlift il-karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Mark: I feel unlucky today. Rita: What happened? Mark: I lost my keys and then missed the bus.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我今天觉得自己真倒霉。丽塔：怎么了？马克：我丢了钥匙，接着又没赶上公交车。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天觉得自己真倒霉。
messages.en: I feel unlucky today.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 怎么了？
messages.en: What happened?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlift iċ-ċwievet u mbagħad tlift il-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Tlift iċ-ċwievet u mbagħad tlift il-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 我丢了钥匙，接着又没赶上公交车。
messages.en: I lost my keys and then missed the bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成两张情境卡记忆：人物卡记倒霉，身体部位卡记乳房或乳头；再看词性区分倒霉的与倒霉的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Situated a long distance away from a person, place, or reference point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 距离某人、某地或某个参照点很远的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab f'distanza kbira minn persuna, post jew punt ta' riferiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遥远的；远处的。
距离远的；遥远的。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi raħal bgħid li jinsab bejn il-muntanji.
formal.en: The author describes a distant village situated among the mountains.
formal.zh: 作者描写了一个坐落在群山之间的遥远村庄。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħuk jgħix hawn? David: Le, jgħix f'pajjiż bgħid. Nitkellmu fuq it-telefon kull ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does your brother live here? David: No, he lives in a distant country. We speak on the phone every week.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你兄弟住在这里吗？大卫：不，他住在一个遥远的国家。我们每周通一次电话。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟住在这里吗？
messages.en: Does your brother live here?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jgħix f'pajjiż bgħid. Nitkellmu fuq it-telefon kull ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jgħix f'pajjiż bgħid. Nitkellmu fuq it-telefon kull ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 不，他住在一个遥远的国家。我们每周通一次电话。
messages.en: No, he lives in a distant country. We speak on the phone every week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上两个相隔很远的地点，把 bgħid 贴在远方那个地点旁，记住它形容“遥远的”。

gloss_zh: 兽；牲畜；粗暴或冷酷的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: An animal, especially livestock or a wild or dangerous beast; figuratively, a rough or hard-hearted person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动物，尤其指牲畜或野生、危险的兽类；比喻粗暴无礼或冷酷无情的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal, speċjalment wieħed tar-razzett jew wieħed selvaġġ jew perikoluż; b'mod figurattiv, persuna goffa jew bla qalb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一头兽；一只动物。

sense_translations.en_definition: a brute (figurative, used of rough or uncouth persons)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗暴无礼的人；比喻举止粗鲁、缺乏教养的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: a beast; an animal, usually either as livestock or as a wild and/or dangerous creature
sense_translations.zh_definition: 兽；动物，通常指牲畜，或野生及具有危险性的动物。
蛮横的人；冷酷无情的人。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-bhima tat-tagħbija kienet tintuża biex iġġorr il-prodotti mill-għalqa sar-raħal.
formal.en: The report describes how the beast of burden was used to carry produce from the field to the village.
formal.zh: 报告描述了人们如何利用驮畜把农产品从田里运到村庄。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhi dik il-bhima ħdejn il-bieb? Pietru: Dik baqra. Ejja nistennew lill-bidwi qabel nersqu lejha.
colloquial.en: Anna: What's that animal near the gate? Pietru: That's a cow. Let's wait for the farmer before going near it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：门旁边那是什么动物？彼得：那是一头牛。我们先等农夫来，再走近它吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (农场访客)
messages.zh: 门旁边那是什么动物？
messages.en: What's that animal near the gate?

messages.speaker: Pietru (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik baqra. Ejja nistennew lill-bidwi qabel nersqu lejha.
messages.mt_standard: Dik baqra. Ejja nistennew lill-bidwi qabel nersqu lejha.
messages.zh: 那是一头牛。我们先等农夫来，再走近它吧。
messages.en: That's a cow. Let's wait for the farmer before going near it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记农场里的一头牲畜，再记人物描写中的“粗暴冷酷的人”；用于人时带有贬义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A copy of the Bible, the collection of sacred writings used in Christianity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一本《圣经》，即基督教所使用的神圣经文集。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ktieb li fih il-ġabra ta' kitbiet sagri tal-Kristjaneżmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一本圣经；作为书籍或经文集的圣经。
《圣经》，基督教经书的专名。

formal.mt: Il-librerija għandha traduzzjoni tal-Bibbja bil-Malti li tista' tintuża għall-istudju.
formal.en: The library has a Maltese translation of the Bible that can be used for study.
formal.zh: 图书馆藏有可供学习使用的《圣经》马耳他语译本。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandek bibbja bil-Malti? Marija: Iva, tista' tissellef tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you have a Bible in Maltese? Marija: Yes, you can borrow mine.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你有马耳他语版的圣经吗？Marija：有，你可以借我的。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有马耳他语版的圣经吗？
messages.en: Do you have a Bible in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，你可以借我的。
messages.en: Yes, you can borrow mine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一本 bibbja”和“书名 il-Bibbja”作对照，分别记住普通书籍用法与专名用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pour liquid out or spill it; also to overflow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把液体倒出或洒出，也可表示液体溢出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iferragħ likwidu jew ixerrdu; ukoll ifur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 溢出；液体超出容器边缘。
倾倒；倒液体。
倒出；洒出；使液体流到外面。

collocations.en: to pour out or spill the water
to spill the milk on the table

formal.mt: Waqt l-esperiment, l-istudent bidded ftit ilma fuq il-mejda u mbagħad nixxfu b'ċarruta.
formal.en: During the experiment, the student spilled some water on the table and then wiped it up with a cloth.
formal.zh: 实验时，学生把一些水洒在桌上，随后用布擦干。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex hi mxarrba l-mejda? Ben: Ħija bidded il-ħalib fuqha. Rita: Ġib ċarruta, mela.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is the table wet? Ben: My brother spilled milk on it. Rita: Get a cloth, then.
colloquial.zh: Rita：桌子怎么湿了？Ben：我兄弟把牛奶洒在上面了。Rita：那拿块抹布来吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 桌子怎么湿了？
messages.en: Why is the table wet?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 我兄弟把牛奶洒在上面了。
messages.en: My brother spilled milk on it.

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 那拿块抹布来吧。
messages.en: Get a cloth, then.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象杯中液体流到外面的连续画面，用 bidded 串记“倒出、洒出、溢出”，再靠上下文判断具体意思。

gloss_zh: 改变；更换；交换；换衣服；改变主意

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something different, replace or exchange it, change clothes, or change one's mind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物发生变化，替换或交换事物，也可指换衣服或改变主意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa differenti, jibdilha ma' oħra, ibiddel il-ħwejjeġ jew ibiddel fehmtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 改变某事物；更换某物。
改动或修改某事物。
换衣服；更换身上的衣物。
改变；交换或兑换。
改变主意或原先的看法。

formal.mt: L-organizzatur biddel il-ħin tal-laqgħa biex ikunu jistgħu jattendu aktar nies.
formal.en: The organiser changed the meeting time so that more people could attend.
formal.zh: 组织者更改了会议时间，以便更多人能够参加。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadna sejrin il-baħar ma' Mark? Lara: Le, Mark biddel fehmtu. Se nibqgħu d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are we still going to the seaside with Mark? Lara: No, Mark changed his mind. We're staying home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们还和马克一起去海边吗？拉拉：不去了，马克改变主意了。我们待在家里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们还和马克一起去海边吗？
messages.en: Are we still going to the seaside with Mark?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, Mark biddel fehmtu. Se nibqgħu d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, Mark biddel fehmtu. Se nibqgħu d-dar.
messages.zh: 不去了，马克改变主意了。我们待在家里。
messages.en: No, Mark changed his mind. We're staying home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“换衣服、改时间、改主意”三个画面连起来记 biddel；注意词中写两个 d，并结合宾语判断具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To change or alter something, or exchange one thing for another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 改变或改动某事物，也可指把一件东西换成另一件东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel bidla f'xi ħaġa jew jagħti ħaġa biex jieħu oħra minflokha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 改变某事物；更换某物。
改动或修改某事物。
使某件事物发生变化。
交换；以物换物或兑换。
把某物与另一物交换；用某物换取另一物。

collocations.en: exchanged the book for another one
collocations.zh: 把这本书换成了另一本

formal.mt: L-istudent bidel il-ktieb ma' ieħor li kien aktar adattat għall-kors.
formal.en: The student exchanged the book for another one that was more suitable for the course.
formal.zh: 这名学生把书换成了另一本更适合该课程的书。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'għamel Pawlu bil-flokk li kien żgħir wisq? Mark: Bidel il-flokk ma' wieħed akbar.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did Pawlu do with the shirt that was too small? Mark: He exchanged the shirt for a larger one.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗怎么处理那件太小的上衣了？马克：他把它换成了一件大一点的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamel Pawlu bil-flokk li kien żgħir wisq?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamel Pawlu bil-flokk li kien żgħir wisq?
messages.zh: 保罗怎么处理那件太小的上衣了？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do with the shirt that was too small?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他把它换成了一件大一点的。
messages.en: He exchanged the shirt for a larger one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿一件小上衣换一件大的，记住 bidel 的“更换、交换”；本词只写一个 d，拼写时与 biddel 分开核对。

gloss_zh: 变化；改变；交换；修改；差异

teaching_sense.en_definition: A change in a situation or thing, an alteration, an exchange, or a difference.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 情况或事物发生的变化、改动，也可指交换或两者之间的差异。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tibdil f'sitwazzjoni jew f'xi ħaġa, skambju, jew differenza bejn ħaġa u oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次变化；一项改变。
一次交换或互换。
变化；改变这一过程或状态。
修改；对原有事物作出的调整。
差别；不同之处。

formal.mt: Il-bidla fl-iskeda tippermetti lill-istudenti jużaw il-librerija għal aktar ħin.
formal.en: The change in the timetable allows students to use the library for longer.
formal.zh: 时间表的调整让学生能够更长时间地使用图书馆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm xi bidla fil-pjan għal għada? Toni: Iva, se niltaqgħu fid-disgħa minflok fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there any change in the plan for tomorrow? Toni: Yes, we're meeting at nine instead of eight.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：明天的计划有什么变动吗？托尼：有，我们改在九点见面，原来是八点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xi bidla fil-pjan għal għada?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xi bidla fil-pjan għal għada?
messages.zh: 明天的计划有什么变动吗？
messages.en: Is there any change in the plan for tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se niltaqgħu fid-disgħa minflok fit-tmienja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se niltaqgħu fid-disgħa minflok fit-tmienja.
messages.zh: 有，我们改在九点见面，原来是八点。
messages.en: Yes, we're meeting at nine instead of eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把日程表上“八点”改成“九点”的那一处圈起来：圈出的这项“变化”就是 bidla，按名词来记。

gloss_zh: 开始；开端；起始；网站首页

teaching_sense.en_definition: The start or first part of an activity, event, or period; also the home page of a website.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 活动、事件或一段时期的开始、开端，也可指网站的首页。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ewwel parti ta' attività, ġrajja jew perjodu; ukoll il-paġna ewlenija ta' sit elettroniku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个起点；一次开始。
一个开端；某事的最初部分。
开始；启动这一阶段。
开头；起始阶段。
网站首页；网站的主页面。

collocations.en: at the beginning of the year

formal.mt: Fil-bidu tal-kors, l-għalliem jispjega l-għanijiet u l-metodu ta' valutazzjoni.
formal.en: At the beginning of the course, the teacher explains the objectives and the assessment method.
formal.zh: 课程开始时，教师会说明课程目标和考核方式。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt il-film kollu? Mark: Iva, mill-bidu sal-aħħar, u l-bidu kien sabiħ ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you watch the whole film? Mark: Yes, from beginning to end, and the beginning was very good.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看完整部电影了吗？马克：看完了，从头到尾都看了，开头特别好。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看完整部电影了吗？
messages.en: Did you watch the whole film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, mill-bidu sal-aħħar, u l-bidu kien sabiħ ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, mill-bidu sal-aħħar, u l-bidu kien sabiħ ħafna.
messages.zh: 看完了，从头到尾都看了，开头特别好。
messages.en: Yes, from beginning to end, and the beginning was very good.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bidu 放在时间线最左端，表示“开始”；再联想进入网站先到首页，把两个“入口”画面一起记住。

gloss_zh: 农民；农夫；乡村的；乡土的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A farmer: a person who works the land and grows crops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 农民；从事土地耕作、种植农作物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem l-art u tkabbar l-uċuħ tar-raba'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 农民；从事农业生产的人。
农夫；以耕作为生的农民。
乡村的；带有乡土特色的。

collocations.en: a farmer who works the land

formal.mt: Il-bidwi juża l-ilma b'attenzjoni biex ikabbar il-ħaxix matul ix-xhur niexfa.
formal.en: The farmer uses water carefully to grow vegetables during the dry months.
formal.zh: 这位农民在干旱的月份谨慎用水，以种植蔬菜。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan it-tadam minn fejn ġibtu? Pawlu: Xtrajtu mingħand bidwi li għandu għalqa qrib id-dar tagħna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did you get these tomatoes? Pawlu: I bought them from a farmer who has a field near our house.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些番茄你是从哪儿买的？保罗：我向一位农民买的，他在我们家附近有块田。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些番茄你是从哪儿买的？
messages.en: Where did you get these tomatoes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xtrajtu mingħand bidwi li għandu għalqa qrib id-dar tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Xtrajtu mingħand bidwi li għandu għalqa qrib id-dar tagħna.
messages.zh: 我向一位农民买的，他在我们家附近有块田。
messages.en: I bought them from a farmer who has a field near our house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位农民站在菜田里，把人物卡片标成 bidwi；作形容词时再联想到同一画面里的乡村气息。

gloss_zh: 一扇门板；柜门；桥或门的活动扇板

teaching_sense.en_definition: A movable panel forming one leaf of a door, a cupboard door, or a movable bridge panel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 构成门的一扇活动门板、柜门，或桥上的活动板。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pannell li jiċċaqlaq u jifforma parti minn bieb, bieb ta' armarju, jew parti li tiċċaqlaq ta' pont.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 门的一扇；构成门的单扇活动门板。
柜门；橱柜的活动门板。

sense_translations.en_definition: leaf (moveable panel of a bridge or door)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 活动扇板；桥或门上可以移动、开启的板件。

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa sewwa l-bieba tal-armarju sabiex tingħalaq sew.
formal.en: The carpenter repaired the cupboard door so that it would close properly.
formal.zh: 木匠修好了柜门，使它能够正常关上。
