colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-bieba tal-armarju ma tingħalaqx? Toni: Hemm kaxxa fin-nofs. Neħħiha u erġa' pprova.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why won't the cupboard door close? Toni: There's a box in the way. Remove it and try again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：柜门怎么关不上？托尼：有个盒子挡住了。把它拿开，再试一次。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 柜门怎么关不上？
messages.en: Why won't the cupboard door close?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm kaxxa fin-nofs. Neħħiha u erġa' pprova.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm kaxxa fin-nofs. Neħħiha u erġa' pprova.
messages.zh: 有个盒子挡住了。把它拿开，再试一次。
messages.en: There's a box in the way. Remove it and try again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双扇门中正在转动的那一扇，把它标作 bieba；再把同样的活动门板画到柜子上，记住“单扇板件”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lay eggs or release eggs as part of reproduction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指动物下蛋或排出卵，以进行繁殖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ibid il-bajd bħala parti mir-riproduzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下蛋；产卵。
产卵；排出卵，尤用于水生动物。
产下蛋或卵。

formal.mt: It-tiġieġa biedet bajda fil-bejta kmieni filgħodu.
formal.en: The hen laid an egg in the nest early in the morning.
formal.zh: 母鸡一大早就在窝里下了一个蛋。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tiġieġa biedet illum? Nanna: Iva, biedet bajda kbira. Ejja araha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the hen lay an egg today? Grandmother: Yes, she laid a large egg. Come and see it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：母鸡今天下蛋了吗？奶奶：下了，下了一个大蛋。过来看看。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 母鸡今天下蛋了吗？
messages.en: Did the hen lay an egg today?

messages.speaker: Nanna (奶奶)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, biedet bajda kbira. Ejja araha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, biedet bajda kbira. Ejja araha.
messages.zh: 下了，下了一个大蛋。过来看看。
messages.en: Yes, she laid a large egg. Come and see it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bied 配上“母鸡下蛋”的动作图；例句中的 biedet 仍表示下蛋，记动词动作时同时记住蛋和窝。

gloss_zh: 从事农业劳动；耕作土地；集体耕作

teaching_sense.en_definition: To carry out agricultural work or cultivate the land, including working it together as a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事农业劳动或耕作土地，也可指一群人共同耕作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xogħol agrikolu jew jaħdem l-art, ukoll flimkien ma' grupp ta' nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从事农业活动或农业劳动。
耕作土地；务农。

sense_translations.en_definition: to till the land in a group
sense_translations.zh_definition: 集体耕作土地；一群人共同进行耕作。

collocations.en: carried out agricultural work together with others
collocations.zh: 与他人一起从事农业劳动

formal.mt: Il-grupp bieda l-art flimkien biex iħejjiha għaż-żrigħ.
formal.en: The group worked the land together to prepare it for sowing.
formal.zh: 这群人一起耕作土地，为播种作准备。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'għamel Pawlu lbieraħ fir-razzett? Mark: Bieda l-art mal-ġirien biex iħejjuha għaż-żrigħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did Pawlu do at the farm yesterday? Mark: He worked the land with the neighbours to prepare it for sowing.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗昨天在农场做了什么？马克：他和邻居们一起耕作土地，为播种作准备。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗昨天在农场做了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do at the farm yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bieda l-art mal-ġirien biex iħejjuha għaż-żrigħ.
messages.mt_standard: Bieda l-art mal-ġirien biex iħejjuha għaż-żrigħ.
messages.zh: 他和邻居们一起耕作土地，为播种作准备。
messages.en: He worked the land with the neighbours to prepare it for sowing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 bieda 配一幅大家共同耕田的图，整词记成“务农、耕作”；再用“土地”这个宾语与 bied 的下蛋场景区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work of growing crops and raising animals to produce food and other agricultural products.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 种植作物、饲养牲畜，以生产食物及其他农产品的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol tat-tkabbir tal-għelejjel u t-trobbija tal-annimali għall-produzzjoni tal-ikel u ta' prodotti agrikoli oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 农业：通过种植及相关生产活动获取农产品。
农业、农耕或农牧业，涵盖作物种植和牲畜饲养。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif il-biedja tipprovdi l-ikel u x-xogħol lill-komunitajiet rurali.
formal.en: The report explains how agriculture provides food and employment for rural communities.
formal.zh: 报告说明了农业如何为农村社区提供食物和就业机会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tixtieq taħdem fil-biedja? Mark: Iva, inħobb nieħu ħsieb l-għelieqi u nkabbar il-ħxejjex.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to work in farming? Mark: Yes, I like looking after fields and growing vegetables.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想从事农业工作吗？马克：想，我喜欢照料农田和种蔬菜。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想从事农业工作吗？
messages.en: Would you like to work in farming?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inħobb nieħu ħsieb l-għelieqi u nkabbar il-ħxejjex.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inħobb nieħu ħsieb l-għelieqi u nkabbar il-ħxejjex.
messages.zh: 想，我喜欢照料农田和种蔬菜。
messages.en: Yes, I like looking after fields and growing vegetables.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 biedja 放进一幅有农田、蔬菜和牲畜的乡村图景中，联想整个农业生产活动，而不只是一块田。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give something to someone in exchange for money; also, to betray someone or their trust.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品交给他人以换取金钱；也指为自身利益等原因出卖他人或辜负信任。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti xi ħaġa lil xi ħadd bi ħlas; jista' jfisser ukoll li jittradixxi lil xi ħadd jew il-fiduċja tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卖；出售，以物品或其他可交易之物换取金钱。
出卖；背叛，做出损害他人利益或辜负信任的行为。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi biegħ il-prodotti tiegħu fis-suq lokali.
formal.en: The farmer sold his produce at the local market.
formal.zh: 农民在当地市场出售了自己的农产品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħadd m'għadu jafda lil Pawlu? Mark: Għax biegħ lil sħabu biex jikseb vantaġġ għalih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does nobody trust Pawlu anymore? Mark: Because he betrayed his companions to gain an advantage for himself.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么大家都不再信任保罗了？马克：因为他为了给自己谋取好处，出卖了同伴。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħadd m'għadu jafda lil Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħadd m'għadu jafda lil Pawlu?
messages.zh: 为什么大家都不再信任保罗了？
messages.en: Why does nobody trust Pawlu anymore?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax biegħ lil sħabu biex jikseb vantaġġ għalih.
messages.mt_standard: Għax biegħ lil sħabu biex jikseb vantaġġ għalih.
messages.zh: 因为他为了给自己谋取好处，出卖了同伴。
messages.en: Because he betrayed his companions to gain an advantage for himself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文的“卖东西”和“出卖朋友”串联 biegħ 的两个义项；看宾语和语境，判断是交易还是背叛。

gloss_zh: 使远离；保持距离；避开；防止

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep or move someone or something away from another person, place, or danger; also, to avert something harmful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或物远离某人、某处或危险，或使不利事件得以避免。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżomm jew iressaq lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa 'l bogħod minn persuna, post jew periklu; jista' jfisser ukoll li jevita xi ħaġa ta' ħsara.

sense_translations.en_definition: to keep sth or sb at a distance
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物或某人与其他人或事物保持距离。
避免；防止，使危险或不利事件不发生。
使远离；使不靠近某人、某物或某处。

collocations.en: he kept the children away from the fire

formal.mt: Il-gwardjan biegħed lit-tfal min-nar biex jevita korrimenti.
formal.en: The guard kept the children away from the fire to prevent injuries.
formal.zh: 看守人员让孩子们远离火源，以防受伤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark biegħed il-kaxxa mill-bieb? Pawlu: Biex ħadd ma jitfixkel fiha meta jidħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark move the box away from the door? Pawlu: So nobody trips over it when coming in.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么把箱子挪离门口？保罗：免得有人进门时被它绊倒。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么把箱子挪离门口？
messages.en: Why did Mark move the box away from the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ħadd ma jitfixkel fiha meta jidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ħadd ma jitfixkel fiha meta jidħol.
messages.zh: 免得有人进门时被它绊倒。
messages.en: So nobody trips over it when coming in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把箱子挪远、把孩子带离火源：biegħed 的核心画面是拉开距离，也可联系到避免危险。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a person or thing resemble an animal by giving them animal form or characteristics.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或事物呈现动物的形态或特征，即使其动物化或兽化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa sura jew karatteristiċi ta' annimal.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make sth or sb resemble an animal
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物或某人在形态或特征上像动物。
使动物化；使兽化，赋予动物的形态或特征。

collocations.en: he gave the character animal characteristics
collocations.zh: 他赋予了这个角色动物特征

collocations.en: he made the human figure resemble an animal
collocations.zh: 他把人形塑造成了动物模样

formal.mt: L-artist biehem lill-karattru billi tah sura ta' annimal.
formal.en: The artist animalized the character by giving him the form of an animal.
formal.zh: 艺术家赋予这个角色动物的外形，使其呈现兽化形象。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex l-artist biehem lill-karattru f'din l-istampa? Mark: Biex jidher qisu lupu u jqajjem il-biża'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the artist give the character animal features in this picture? Mark: To make him look like a wolf and evoke fear.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：艺术家为什么在这幅画里把角色画成动物模样？马克：为了让他看起来像狼，引起恐惧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-artist biehem lill-karattru f'din l-istampa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-artist biehem lill-karattru f'din l-istampa?
messages.zh: 艺术家为什么在这幅画里把角色画成动物模样？
messages.en: Why did the artist give the character animal features in this picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jidher qisu lupu u jqajjem il-biża'.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jidher qisu lupu u jqajjem il-biża'.
messages.zh: 为了让他看起来像狼，引起恐惧。
messages.en: To make him look like a wolf and evoke fear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 biehem 时想象画家给人物添上狼耳、兽脸：重点是“使其像动物”，可用角色造型帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pass urine from the body; English equivalents range from neutral 'urinate' to informal 'pee' and vulgar 'piss'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将尿液排出体外；英语对应词可因语体分别译为 urinate、pee 或粗俗的 piss。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ l-awrina mill-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排尿；小便，采用中性或较正式的表达。
撒尿；尿尿，此处对应英语粗俗说法 piss。
小便；撒尿；排尿，英语对应表达的正式程度和粗俗程度不同。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent biel f'kontenitur nadif għall-analiżi.
formal.en: The patient urinated into a clean container for analysis.
formal.zh: 患者将尿液排入干净的容器中，以供化验。

colloquial.mt: Marta: It-tifel biel fis-sodda matul il-lejl? Pawlu: Iva, diġà biddilt il-lożor u l-piġama tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did the boy wet the bed during the night? Pawlu: Yes, I've already changed the sheets and his pyjamas.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：孩子夜里尿床了吗？保罗：是的，我已经换了床单和他的睡衣。

messages.speaker: Marta (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子夜里尿床了吗？
messages.en: Did the boy wet the bed during the night?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, diġà biddilt il-lożor u l-piġama tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, diġà biddilt il-lożor u l-piġama tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，我已经换了床单和他的睡衣。
messages.en: Yes, I've already changed the sheets and his pyjamas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“厕所小便”和“孩子尿床”两个场景记 biel；翻成英语时，再按场合选择正式或口语表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bowl used to hold or serve food or other contents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛放或端上食物等物品的小碗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent żgħir f'għamla ta' skutella, li jintuża biex iżomm jew iservi l-ikel jew affarijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小碗；体积较小、可盛放食物等物品的碗状容器。

formal.mt: Poġġi l-jogurt f'bieqja u żid ftit frott frisk.
formal.en: Put the yoghurt in a small bowl and add some fresh fruit.
formal.zh: 将酸奶放入小碗，再加入少量新鲜水果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tagħtini bieqja għaż-żebbuġ? Mark: Żgur, hawn waħda nadifa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you give me a small bowl for the olives? Mark: Of course, here's a clean one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：能给我一个装橄榄的小碗吗？马克：当然，这里有一个干净的。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 能给我一个装橄榄的小碗吗？
messages.en: Can you give me a small bowl for the olives?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 当然，这里有一个干净的。
messages.en: Of course, here's a clean one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bieqja 想成手掌能托住、里面装着橄榄或酸奶的小碗，用具体餐桌画面记住容器和大小。

gloss_zh: 微温的；温凉的；不热情的；反应冷淡的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Only mildly warm or cool, without much heat; figuratively, showing little enthusiasm or interest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 温度微温或温凉、没有多少热度的；比喻缺乏热情或兴趣、反应冷淡的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta' temperatura moderata, bla ħafna sħana; b'mod figurattiv, bla wisq ħeġġa jew interess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微温的；温温的，热度很低。
不冷不热的；仅有些温热的。

sense_translations.en_definition: tepid; cool (lacking warmth, but not really cold either; of neutral temperature)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 微温的；温凉的，缺少暖意但也并不真正寒冷，温度较为中性。
态度不冷不热的；缺乏热情或积极性的。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ta rispons biered għall-proposta u ma weriex wisq interess fiha.
formal.en: The committee gave the proposal a lukewarm response and showed little interest in it.
formal.zh: 委员会对这项提案反应冷淡，没有表现出多少兴趣。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-te għadu sħun? Mark: Le, issa hu biered. Tridni nsaħħnu ftit?
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this tea still hot? Mark: No, it's lukewarm now. Would you like me to warm it up a little?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这茶还热吗？马克：不，现在只是温温的。要我稍微加热一下吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这茶还热吗？
messages.en: Is this tea still hot?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa hu biered. Tridni nsaħħnu ftit?
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa hu biered. Tridni nsaħħnu ftit?
messages.zh: 不，现在只是温温的。要我稍微加热一下吗？
messages.en: No, it's lukewarm now. Would you like me to warm it up a little?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一杯失去热度的温茶记 biered，再把“热度不足”联想到回应缺乏热情，串起温度和态度两个用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give a blessing to a person or thing, especially in a religious setting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 祝福某人或某物，尤指在宗教场合给予祝福。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti barka lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa, speċjalment f'kuntest reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 祝福某人或某物；为某人或某物祝圣。
祝福；给予祝福。

formal.mt: Wara ċ-ċerimonja, il-qassis bierek lill-familji kollha preżenti.
formal.en: After the ceremony, the priest blessed all the families present.
formal.zh: 仪式结束后，神父祝福了在场的所有家庭。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-qassis bierek id-dar il-ġdida? Pawlu: Iva, ġie lbieraħ u bierek id-dar kollha.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did the priest bless the new house? Pawlu: Yes, he came yesterday and blessed the whole house.
colloquial.zh: Marija：神父为新房祝福了吗？Pawlu：是的，他昨天来了，为整栋房子祝福。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 神父为新房祝福了吗？
messages.en: Did the priest bless the new house?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (房主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġie lbieraħ u bierek id-dar kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġie lbieraħ u bierek id-dar kollha.
messages.zh: 是的，他昨天来了，为整栋房子祝福。
messages.en: Yes, he came yesterday and blessed the whole house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bierek 放进“神父祝福新房”的画面里记忆，再用“祝福孩子”和“祝福房屋”练习人物与事物两类对象。

gloss_zh: 亲吻；另有游隼、燕隼和飞角鱼等名词义

teaching_sense.en_definition: To touch someone or something with the lips as a sign of affection, greeting, or respect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用嘴唇亲吻某人或某物，表达爱意、问候或敬意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imiss lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa bix-xufftejn biex juri mħabba, jagħti tislima jew juri rispett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亲吻；吻。
游隼（Falco peregrinus）。
燕隼（Falco subbuteo）。
飞角鱼（Dactylopterus volitans，一种海鱼）。

formal.mt: Qabel telaq għall-vjaġġ, it-tifel bies lil ommu fuq il-ħaddejn.
formal.en: Before leaving for the trip, the boy kissed his mother on the cheeks.
formal.zh: 出发旅行前，男孩亲吻了母亲的脸颊。

colloquial.mt: Anna: It-tifel bies lin-nanna qabel telaq? Mark: Iva, bies lin-nanna u qalilha ċaw.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did the boy kiss Grandma before he left? Mark: Yes, he kissed Grandma and said goodbye to her.
colloquial.zh: Anna：孩子走之前亲奶奶了吗？Mark：亲了，他亲了奶奶，还跟她说了再见。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子走之前亲奶奶了吗？
messages.en: Did the boy kiss Grandma before he left?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bies lin-nanna u qalilha ċaw.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bies lin-nanna u qalilha ċaw.
messages.zh: 亲了，他亲了奶奶，还跟她说了再见。
messages.en: Yes, he kissed Grandma and said goodbye to her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 bies 与“亲一下脸颊”的动作绑定；遇到鸟类或鱼类语境时，再切换到独立的名词卡片，避免混淆同形词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species known as Eleonora's falcon, Falco eleonorae.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名为埃莉氏隼的鸟类物种，学名为 Falco eleonorae。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' falkun bl-isem xjentifiku Falco eleonorae.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 埃莉氏隼（Falco eleonorae）。

collocations.en: a photograph of an Eleonora's falcon
an observation of an Eleonora's falcon
collocations.zh: 一次对埃莉氏隼的观察

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi ritratt ta' bies tar-reġina u d-data tal-osservazzjoni.
formal.en: The report includes a photograph of an Eleonora's falcon and the date of the observation.
formal.zh: 报告中附有一张埃莉氏隼的照片，并注明了观察日期。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fir-ritratt? Toni: Bies tar-reġina. Lara: Se nikteb l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this bird in the photograph called? Toni: An Eleonora's falcon. Lara: I'll write the name under the photograph.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：照片里的这只鸟叫什么？托尼：埃莉氏隼。拉拉：我要把名字写在照片下面。

messages.speaker: Lara (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 照片里的这只鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is this bird in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Toni (观鸟同伴)
messages.zh: 埃莉氏隼。
messages.en: An Eleonora's falcon.

messages.speaker: Lara (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 我要把名字写在照片下面。
messages.en: I'll write the name under the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语当作一张鸟类名牌记忆，正面写马耳他语，背面写埃莉氏隼及其学名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spend the night in a particular place, often away from home.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某个地方度过夜晚或留宿，常指在家以外的地方过夜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqatta' l-lejl f'post partikolari, spiss barra minn daru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某处过夜。

sense_translations.en_definition: to spend the night, to stay overnight
sense_translations.zh_definition: 过夜；留宿一晚。

collocations.en: stayed overnight at a friend's place
spent the night in a hotel

formal.mt: Minħabba li l-laqgħa ntemmet tard, id-delegat biet f'lukanda qrib l-istazzjon.
formal.en: Because the meeting ended late, the delegate spent the night in a hotel near the station.
formal.zh: 由于会议结束得很晚，代表在车站附近的一家旅馆过了夜。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn biet Mark ilbieraħ? Luqa: Biet għand ħabib, għax tilef l-aħħar karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did Mark spend the night yesterday? Luqa: He stayed at a friend's place because he missed the last bus.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark 昨晚在哪里过夜？Luqa：他住在朋友家，因为他错过了末班公交车。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 昨晚在哪里过夜？
messages.en: Where did Mark spend the night yesterday?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biet għand ħabib, għax tilef l-aħħar karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Biet għand ħabib, għax tilef l-aħħar karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 他住在朋友家，因为他错过了末班公交车。
messages.en: He stayed at a friend's place because he missed the last bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象错过末班车后在朋友家过夜，把 biet 与“一整夜在哪里度过”连起来记，再替换朋友家、旅馆等地点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Introduces the purpose of an action: in order to do something or so that something can happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引出行动的目的，表示“为了做某事”或“以便某事能够发生”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad azzjoni mal-għan tagħha u turi għal liema skop issir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为了；用于引出表示目的的动作。
为了；以便。

sense_translations.en_definition: so that; in order that; often rather expressed in English with to + infinitive
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以便；为了使；英语中常用 to 加动词原形表达相应的目的。
用什么？；借助什么工具或手段？

formal.mt: Il-librerija estendiet il-ħinijiet tal-ftuħ biex l-istudenti jkunu jistgħu jistudjaw filgħaxija.
formal.en: The library extended its opening hours so that students could study in the evening.
formal.zh: 图书馆延长了开放时间，以便学生能够在晚上学习。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ġibt dan il-ktieb? Ben: Biex nitgħallem ftit Malti qabel il-vjaġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you bring this book? Ben: To learn a little Maltese before the trip.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么带了这本书？Ben：为了在旅行前学一点马耳他语。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么带了这本书？
messages.en: Why did you bring this book?

messages.speaker: Ben (旅行者)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nitgħallem ftit Malti qabel il-vjaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nitgħallem ftit Malti qabel il-vjaġġ.
messages.zh: 为了在旅行前学一点马耳他语。
messages.en: To learn a little Maltese before the trip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 biex 当作“目的箭头”：前面是做什么，后面是为了什么。另设一张“用什么？”问句卡，分别记住它的提问用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say or spread false accusations about someone that damage their reputation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说出或传播针对他人的虚假指控，损害其名誉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid jew ixerred akkużi foloz dwar xi ħadd u jagħmel ħsara lir-reputazzjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 散布诽谤性言论，传播损害他人名誉的虚假说法。
诬蔑；中伤，以虚假指控损害他人名誉。
肆意诽谤；热衷于说或传播中伤他人的话。

formal.mt: Ix-xhud qal li r-raġel bieħet lil ġaru b'akkużi foloz.
formal.en: The witness said that the man had slandered his neighbour with false accusations.
formal.zh: 证人说，该男子以虚假指控诽谤了邻居。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu bieħet lil Marija quddiem kulħadd. Mark: Dak mhux sew; m'għandniex inxerrdu gideb dwar in-nies.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu slandered Marija in front of everyone. Mark: That's wrong; we shouldn't spread lies about people.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗当着大家的面中伤玛丽亚。马克：这样不对，我们不该散布关于别人的谎言。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu bieħet lil Marija quddiem kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu bieħet lil Marija quddiem kulħadd.
messages.zh: 保罗当着大家的面中伤玛丽亚。
messages.en: Pawlu slandered Marija in front of everyone.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak mhux sew; m'għandniex inxerrdu gideb dwar in-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Dak mhux sew; m'għandniex inxerrdu gideb dwar in-nies.
messages.zh: 这样不对，我们不该散布关于别人的谎言。
messages.en: That's wrong; we shouldn't spread lies about people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bieħet 联想到“编造坏话并传开”的场景，记住虚假内容和名誉受损这两个关键点。

gloss_zh: 勤奋的；勤勉的；积极肯干的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hardworking and diligent; putting sustained effort and care into work or study.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 工作或学习勤奋认真，愿意持续付出努力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaħdem jew jistudja b'ħeġġa, b'attenzjoni u bi sforz kontinwu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 积极肯干的；做事活跃而有干劲的。
勤劳的；工作努力的。
勤勉的；认真用功的。
勤奋认真的；勤勉努力的。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħha, l-għalliema ddeskriviet lil Daniel bħala student bieżel li jħejji x-xogħol tiegħu bir-reqqa.
formal.en: In her report, the teacher described Daniel as a diligent student who prepares his work carefully.
formal.zh: 老师在报告中将 Daniel 描述为一个勤奋的学生，他会认真准备自己的作业。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ħuk għadu jistudja? Lara: Iva, hu bieżel ħafna u jħejji ruħu għal kull lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is your brother still studying? Lara: Yes, he's very diligent and prepares for every lesson.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你哥哥还在学习吗？Lara：是啊，他很勤奋，每节课都会提前准备。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥还在学习吗？
messages.en: Is your brother still studying?

messages.speaker: Lara (妹妹)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu bieżel ħafna u jħejji ruħu għal kull lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu bieżel ħafna u jħejji ruħu għal kull lezzjoni.
messages.zh: 是啊，他很勤奋，每节课都会提前准备。
messages.en: Yes, he's very diligent and prepares for every lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“每天认真准备功课的学生”记 bieżel，重点联想持续努力与做事认真，再把同一形容词换到勤劳的工人身上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The variety of living organisms, their genetic differences, and the ecosystems in which they live.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生物的种类、生物之间的遗传差异，以及它们所处生态系统的多样性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-varjetà tal-ħlejjaq ħajjin, tad-differenzi ġenetiċi tagħhom u tal-ekosistemi fejn jgħixu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生物多样性，包括遗传、物种和生态系统等层面的多样性。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza li l-ħarsien tal-ħabitats naturali huwa essenzjali biex tinżamm il-bijodiversità.
formal.en: The report stresses that protecting natural habitats is essential for maintaining biodiversity.
formal.zh: 报告强调，保护自然栖息地对维持生物多样性至关重要。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm tant tipi ta' pjanti f'dan il-ġnien? Ben: Biex ngħinu l-bijodiversità; pjanti differenti jattiraw insetti differenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are there so many kinds of plants in this garden? Ben: To support biodiversity; different plants attract different insects.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个花园里为什么种了这么多种植物？Ben：为了促进生物多样性；不同植物会吸引不同的昆虫。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm tant tipi ta' pjanti f'dan il-ġnien?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm tant tipi ta' pjanti f'dan il-ġnien?
messages.zh: 这个花园里为什么种了这么多种植物？
messages.en: Why are there so many kinds of plants in this garden?

messages.speaker: Ben (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ngħinu l-bijodiversità; pjanti differenti jattiraw insetti differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ngħinu l-bijodiversità; pjanti differenti jattiraw insetti differenti.
messages.zh: 为了促进生物多样性；不同植物会吸引不同的昆虫。
messages.en: To support biodiversity; different plants attract different insects.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bijodiversità 画成一座有不同植物、昆虫和鸟类的花园：记住关键词是“多样”，再联想遗传差异与不同生态系统。

gloss_zh: 变得不能说话；说不出话来

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become unable to speak or to be unable to utter words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得无法说话，或处于说不出话来的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef il-ħila li jitkellem jew ma jkunx jista' joħroġ kelma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得不能说话；失去说话能力。
无法说话；说不出话来。

formal.mt: Meta sema' l-aħbar, ir-raġel bikem bis-sorpriża u għal ftit ma seta' jgħid xejn.
formal.en: When he heard the news, the man became speechless with surprise and could say nothing for a short time.
formal.zh: 听到消息时，那名男子惊讶得说不出话来，短时间内一句话也说不出来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qal Mark meta ra s-sorpriża? Luqa: Ma qal xejn għall-ewwel; bikem bis-sorpriża, imbagħad beda jidħak.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did Mark say when he saw the surprise? Luqa: He said nothing at first; he was speechless with surprise, then he started laughing.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark 看到惊喜时说了什么？Luqa：他一开始什么也没说；他惊讶得说不出话来，后来就笑了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 看到惊喜时说了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark say when he saw the surprise?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma qal xejn għall-ewwel; bikem bis-sorpriża, imbagħad beda jidħak.
messages.mt_standard: Ma qal xejn għall-ewwel; bikem bis-sorpriża, imbagħad beda jidħak.
messages.zh: 他一开始什么也没说；他惊讶得说不出话来，后来就笑了。
messages.en: He said nothing at first; he was speechless with surprise, then he started laughing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象收到意外消息后张口却说不出话，把 bikem 与“无法发言”的状态相连；再用害怕、惊讶两种情境练习记忆。

gloss_zh: 使惊呆；使极度难过；使说不出话

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave someone unable to speak because of shock, amazement, or intense distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因震惊、惊讶或强烈悲痛而使某人一时说不出话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jibqa' bla kliem minħabba sorpriża, xokk jew niket kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人惊得目瞪口呆。
使某人震惊得发愣或不知所措。
使某人极度难过或深受打击。
使某人不能说话或一时说不出话。

formal.mt: It-tħabbir tar-riżultat bikkem lil dawk kollha li kienu preżenti.
formal.en: The announcement of the result left everyone present speechless.
formal.zh: 结果公布后，在场的所有人都惊得说不出话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ir-riżultat bikkem lil Pawlu. Mark: Veru! Baqa' bla kliem għal ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: The result left Pawlu speechless. Mark: It really did! He couldn't say a word for a moment.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个结果把保罗惊呆了。马克：确实！他有一会儿一句话也说不出来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个结果把保罗惊呆了。
messages.en: The result left Pawlu speechless.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru! Baqa' bla kliem għal ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Veru! Baqa' bla kliem għal ftit.
messages.zh: 确实！他有一会儿一句话也说不出来。
messages.en: It really did! He couldn't say a word for a moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人听完消息后张着嘴却发不出声音，把 bikkem 与“震惊到失语”的画面连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Occurring near the beginning of a period or before the usual or expected time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发生在某段时间的初期，或比通常、预期时间更早的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jseħħ fil-bidu ta' perjodu jew qabel il-ħin tas-soltu jew mistenni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 时间早的；较通常或预期时间更早的。
属于较早时代的；早期的。
早早地；在较早的时间。

formal.mt: Il-proġett għadu fi stadju bikri, u d-dettalji se jitħabbru aktar tard.
formal.en: The project is still at an early stage, and the details will be announced later.
formal.zh: 项目仍处于早期阶段，详细情况将于稍后公布。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ġejt daqshekk bikri? Mark: Ridt insib post tajjeb qabel jasal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you come so early? Mark: I wanted to find a good spot before everyone arrived.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么来得这么早？马克：我想在大家到来之前找个好位置。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么来得这么早？
messages.en: Why did you come so early?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ridt insib post tajjeb qabel jasal kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Ridt insib post tajjeb qabel jasal kulħadd.
messages.zh: 我想在大家到来之前找个好位置。
messages.en: I wanted to find a good spot before everyone arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bikri 放在时间线靠前的位置：修饰阶段时记“早期的”，修饰到达动作时记“早早地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At a slow pace, through gradual change, or with gentle movement or force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以较慢的速度、逐步变化的方式，或轻柔的动作与力度进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'pass kajman, bi ftit ftit, jew b'moviment ħafif u delikat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缓慢地；慢慢地，强调速度不快。
逐渐地；一点一点地，强调变化逐步发生。
轻轻地；轻柔地，强调动作或力度柔和。

formal.mt: Il-livell tal-ilma żdied bil-mod matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The water level rose gradually during the night.
formal.zh: 水位在夜间逐渐上升。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tagħlaq il-bieb bil-mod? It-tarbija rieqda. Mark: Iva, noqgħod attent.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you close the door gently? The baby is asleep. Mark: Yes, I'll be careful.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能轻轻关门吗？宝宝睡着了。马克：可以，我会小心的。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħlaq il-bieb bil-mod? It-tarbija rieqda.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħlaq il-bieb bil-mod? It-tarbija rieqda.
messages.zh: 你能轻轻关门吗？宝宝睡着了。
messages.en: Can you close the door gently? The baby is asleep.

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 可以，我会小心的。
messages.en: Yes, I'll be careful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个动作记 bil-mod：走路放慢、水位渐升、关门放轻；分别对应速度、变化过程和动作力度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of equilibrium or a suitable distribution between things; also, the amount remaining in an account.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体或事物之间的平衡、适当分配；也可指账户中剩余的金额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' ekwilibriju jew tqassim xieraq bejn affarijiet; ukoll l-ammont li jibqa' f'kont.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平衡，指身体稳定或不同事物之间的均衡；也指账户余额。

formal.mt: L-istudent għandu jżomm bilanċ bejn l-istudju u l-mistrieħ.
formal.en: The student should maintain a balance between study and rest.
formal.zh: 学生应在学习与休息之间保持平衡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tlift il-bilanċ fuq ir-rota. Mark: Int sew? Ieqaf ftit u strieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: I lost my balance on the bicycle. Mark: Are you okay? Stop for a moment and rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我骑自行车时失去了平衡。马克：你没事吧？先停下来休息一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我骑自行车时失去了平衡。
messages.en: I lost my balance on the bicycle.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int sew? Ieqaf ftit u strieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Int sew? Ieqaf ftit u strieħ.
messages.zh: 你没事吧？先停下来休息一下。
messages.en: Are you okay? Stop for a moment and rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 bilanċ：骑车稳住身体是“平衡”，查看账户剩多少钱是“余额”，按搭配判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lark; in a more specific bird sense, the Mediterranean short-toed lark.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种云雀或百灵类鸟；在更具体的鸟名义项中指地中海短趾百灵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur magħruf bħala lark bl-Ingliż; f'sens aktar speċifiku, il-Mediterranean short-toed lark.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一只云雀或百灵类鸟。
云雀、百灵，指鸟类。
地中海短趾百灵，指特定鸟种。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa tal-ktieb tidher bilbla ħdejn għasafar oħra.
formal.en: The picture in the book shows a lark beside other birds.
formal.zh: 书中的图片展示了一只云雀，旁边还有其他鸟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik bilbla? Mark: Iva, dik hi l-bilbla li rajna fl-istampa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that a lark? Mark: Yes, that's the lark we saw in the picture.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是一只云雀吗？马克：是的，那就是我们在图片里看到的云雀。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 那是一只云雀吗？
messages.en: Is that a lark?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dik hi l-bilbla li rajna fl-istampa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dik hi l-bilbla li rajna fl-istampa.
messages.zh: 是的，那就是我们在图片里看到的云雀。
messages.en: Yes, that's the lark we saw in the picture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 bilbla 配上一张云雀图片，再用“云雀的鸣唱”作短语记忆；遇到具体鸟种语境时再对应地中海短趾百灵。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Necessarily or under compulsion, indicating that there is no choice about an action or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某个行动或情况具有必要性或强制性，没有选择余地，相当于“必须、非得”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod meħtieġ jew obbligatorju, meta ma jkunx hemm għażla oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示行动带有强制性：必须地、非做不可地。
强制地；被要求必须如此地。
强制的；必须遵守或完成的。
表示“不得不、必须做某事”的必要性。

formal.mt: Biex itemm il-kors, l-istudent bilfors irid jagħmel il-proġett finali.
formal.en: To complete the course, the student must do the final project.
formal.zh: 要完成这门课程，学生必须完成期末项目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Bilfors irridu nitilqu issa? Mark: Iva, inkella nitilfu l-karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we have to leave now? Mark: Yes, otherwise we'll miss the bus.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们非得现在走吗？马克：是的，不然就赶不上公交车了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们非得现在走吗？
messages.en: Do we have to leave now?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，不然就赶不上公交车了。
messages.en: Yes, otherwise we'll miss the bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bilfors 想成时刻表前的“非走不可”；再把整块短语 mhux bilfors 记成“不一定、未必必须”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Seated, with the body in a sitting position on a chair or another surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体在椅子或其他平面上呈坐姿的；坐着的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'pożizzjoni ta' min joqgħod fuq siġġu jew fuq wiċċ ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坐着的；已经就座的。
坐下；坐着，表示采取坐姿或处于坐姿。
坐着；处于坐姿状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: sitting; in a sitting position (used with verbs like qagħad, poġġa)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 坐着；以坐姿，常与 qagħad、poġġa 等动词连用。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom jibqgħu bilqiegħda sakemm tintemm il-preżentazzjoni.
formal.en: Participants should remain seated until the presentation ends.
formal.zh: 参与者应保持就座，直到演示结束。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn post ħdejk? Nixtieq noqgħod bilqiegħda. Mark: Iva, dan is-siġġu vojt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there a place beside you? I'd like to sit down. Mark: Yes, this chair is free.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你旁边有位置吗？我想坐下来。马克：有，这把椅子空着。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn post ħdejk? Nixtieq noqgħod bilqiegħda.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn post ħdejk? Nixtieq noqgħod bilqiegħda.
messages.zh: 你旁边有位置吗？我想坐下来。
messages.en: Is there a place beside you? I'd like to sit down.

messages.speaker: Mark (乘客)
messages.zh: 有，这把椅子空着。
messages.en: Yes, this chair is free.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bilqiegħda 想成椅子上的坐姿图标：oqgħod bilqiegħda 是“坐下”，ibqa' bilqiegħda 是“继续坐着”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stand up, expressed in phrases such as qam bilwieqfa; bilwieqfa itself describes a standing position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 站起来，见于 qam bilwieqfa 等表达；其中 bilwieqfa 本身表示站立的姿态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed iqum fuq saqajh, bħal fl-espressjoni qam bilwieqfa; bilwieqfa tindika l-pożizzjoni tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 站起来；可结合 qam bilwieqfa 这一表达学习。

sense_translations.en_definition: standing; in a standing position (used with verbs like qam)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 站着；处于站立姿势，常与 qam 等动词搭配。

formal.mt: Meta daħlet id-direttriċi, l-istudent qam bilwieqfa biex isellmilha.
formal.en: When the headteacher entered, the student stood up to greet her.
formal.zh: 校长进来时，那名学生站起来向她问好。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għadek bilwieqfa? Mark: Qed nistenna lil oħti; se nitilqu dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you still standing? Mark: I'm waiting for my sister; we're leaving soon.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么还站着？Mark：我在等我姐姐，我们马上就走。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么还站着？
messages.en: Why are you still standing?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nistenna lil oħti; se nitilqu dalwaqt.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nistenna lil oħti; se nitilqu dalwaqt.
messages.zh: 我在等我姐姐，我们马上就走。
messages.en: I'm waiting for my sister; we're leaving soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面定格在双脚着地、身体直立：bilwieqfa 提示站立姿态；连着 qam 一起记，就能记住“站起来”。

gloss_zh: 顺便说一句；理所应当地

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to introduce an additional thought or a change of topic; also, in a rightful or just manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于补充刚想起的事情或转换话题，意为“顺便说一句、对了”；也表示合乎道理或公正地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża biex tiddaħħal ħaġa oħra fil-kliem jew jinbidel is-suġġett; ukoll ifisser b'mod ġust jew mistħoqq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 顺便说一句；对了，用于引入补充话题。
正当地；公正地；理所应当地。

collocations.en: By the way, I forgot to tell you

formal.mt: Il-premju ngħata bilħaqq lill-istudenta li kisbet l-ogħla marka.
formal.en: The prize was rightfully awarded to the student who achieved the highest mark.
formal.zh: 奖项理所应当地授予了取得最高分的那位女学生。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Bilħaqq, ġibt il-ktieb tiegħi? Mark: Iva, qiegħed fil-basket.
colloquial.en: Maja: By the way, did you bring my book? Mark: Yes, it's in the bag.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：对了，你把我的书带来了吗？马克：带来了，在包里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 对了，你把我的书带来了吗？
messages.en: By the way, did you bring my book?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 带来了，在包里。
messages.en: Yes, it's in the bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bilħaqq 放进两个场景：聊天时忽然想起事情说“对了”，颁奖时认可结果说“理所应当”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A building or constructed structure; also the activity of building something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑物或建成的结构，也可指建造某物的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dar jew struttura mibnija; ukoll l-attività li biha tinbena xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一座建筑物。
建造；建筑施工这一活动。
结构；构筑物。
与 binja 同义，表示建筑物或结构。

formal.mt: Il-bini tal-iskola l-ġdida se jibda f'Jannar u għandu jitlesta qabel Settembru.
formal.en: Construction of the new school will begin in January and should be completed before September.
formal.zh: 新学校的建造将于一月开始，预计在九月之前完成。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu l-uffiċċju tiegħek? Pawlu: F'dak il-bini għoli ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is your office? Pawlu: In that tall building next to the square.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你的办公室在哪里？Pawlu：在广场旁边那栋高楼里。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的办公室在哪里？
messages.en: Where is your office?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 在广场旁边那栋高楼里。
messages.en: In that tall building next to the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅连续画面记 bini：先看工人“建造”，再看完成的“建筑物”。同一个词既能指过程，也能指成果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A building or constructed structure, such as a house.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一座建筑物或构筑物，例如房屋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dar jew struttura oħra li tkun inbniet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一座建筑物。
一项建筑实体；一处建成的构筑物。
建筑物，如房屋或其他结构。

formal.mt: Il-binja antika ġiet restawrata u issa tintuża bħala librerija pubblika.
formal.en: The old building was restored and is now used as a public library.
formal.zh: 这座老建筑经过修复，现在用作公共图书馆。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-binja hi l-librerija? Toni: Iva, id-daħla tinsab fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this building the library? Toni: Yes, the entrance is on the other side.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这栋楼就是图书馆吗？Toni：是的，入口在另一边。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.zh: 这栋楼就是图书馆吗？
messages.en: Is this building the library?

messages.speaker: Toni (图书馆员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, id-daħla tinsab fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, id-daħla tinsab fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
messages.zh: 是的，入口在另一边。
messages.en: Yes, the entrance is on the other side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象你指着街边一栋完整的房子说“这座建筑”：把 binja 与眼前有墙、有门的具体建筑物联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A female person in relation to her parent or parents; a daughter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相对于父亲或母亲而言的女性子女，即女儿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna ta' sess femminili fir-relazzjoni tagħha ma' ommha jew ma' missierha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 女儿；父母的女性子女。

formal.mt: Bint Marija rċeviet premju għall-ħidma tagħha fil-komunità.
formal.en: Marija's daughter received an award for her work in the community.
formal.zh: Marija 的女儿因其社区工作获得了奖项。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dik bint Marija? Ġorġ: Iva, jisimha Anna u taħdem fl-iskola.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is that Marija's daughter? Ġorġ: Yes, her name is Anna and she works at the school.
colloquial.zh: Nina：那是 Marija 的女儿吗？Ġorġ：是的，她叫 Anna，在学校工作。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 那是 Marija 的女儿吗？
messages.en: Is that Marija's daughter?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jisimha Anna u taħdem fl-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jisimha Anna u taħdem fl-iskola.
messages.zh: 是的，她叫 Anna，在学校工作。
messages.en: Yes, her name is Anna and she works at the school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在家庭关系图上，从母亲或父亲画一条线连到女儿，并标上 bint；再用 bint Marija 练习“某人的女儿”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A deep hole or shaft in the ground used to obtain or collect water; a well.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在地面向下开凿、用于取水或蓄水的深井。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħofra fonda fl-art li tintuża biex jinkiseb jew jinġabar l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水井；用于取水或蓄水的井。

formal.mt: Fil-bitħa hemm bir antik li jiġbor l-ilma tax-xita.
formal.en: In the courtyard there is an old well that collects rainwater.
formal.zh: 院子里有一口收集雨水的老井。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Minn fejn ġibt l-ilma għall-pjanti? Samwel: Mill-bir li hemm fil-bitħa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where did you get the water for the plants? Samwel: From the well in the courtyard.
colloquial.zh: Rita：浇植物的水是从哪里取的？Samwel：从院子里的井中取的。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 浇植物的水是从哪里取的？
messages.en: Where did you get the water for the plants?

messages.speaker: Samwel (家人)
messages.zh: 从院子里的井中取的。
messages.en: From the well in the courtyard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bir 写在一张水井简图旁：井口在上，水桶向下。借助“从井里取水”的动作记住这个名词。

gloss_zh: 变凉；冷静下来；变得冷淡

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become cooler or cold; figuratively, to calm down or lose interest in someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 温度降低、变凉或变冷；也比喻情绪平静下来，或对人、事逐渐失去热情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsir inqas sħun jew kiesaħ; ukoll li jikkalma jew jitlef l-interess f'xi ħadd jew f'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变凉；温度降低。
冷静下来；情绪逐渐平复。

sense_translations.en_definition: to become indifferent towards sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事或某人变得冷淡；逐渐不再关心或感兴趣。
变冷；变得冰凉。

formal.mt: Wara li bired, il-maniġer kompla d-diskussjoni b'ton aktar kalm.
formal.en: After calming down, the manager continued the discussion in a calmer tone.
formal.zh: 经理冷静下来后，以更平和的语气继续讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kafè bired? Mark: Iva, issa nista' nixorbu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the coffee cooled down? Mark: Yes, I can drink it now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：咖啡凉下来了吗？Mark：是的，现在我可以喝了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 咖啡凉下来了吗？
messages.en: Has the coffee cooled down?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，现在我可以喝了。
messages.en: Yes, I can drink it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 沿着“热度下降”记三个画面：咖啡变凉、怒气平息、兴趣冷却。这是帮助区分 bired 各义的学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lower the body into a kneeling, squatting, or lying position; also used of a camel lying down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把身体放低，跪下、蹲下或躺下；也可用于描述骆驼卧下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinżel għarkupptejh, joqgħod kokka jew jimtedd; jintuża wkoll għal ġemel li jinżel mal-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 躺下；使身体卧于地面等支撑面上。
跪下；以膝盖支撑身体。
蹲下；弯曲双腿，使身体降低。

sense_translations.en_definition: to lie down (of camels), to kneel
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指骆驼卧下；也表示跪下。

formal.mt: Ir-raġel birek quddiem l-artal u talab fis-skiet.
formal.en: The man knelt before the altar and prayed in silence.
formal.zh: 那名男子在祭坛前跪下，默默祈祷。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex birek il-ġemel? Pawlu: Biex it-turist ikun jista' jinżel minn fuqu.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why did the camel lie down? Pawlu: So the tourist could get off.
colloquial.zh: Lina：骆驼为什么卧下了？Pawlu：好让游客从它背上下来。

messages.speaker: Lina (游客)
messages.zh: 骆驼为什么卧下了？
messages.en: Why did the camel lie down?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex it-turist ikun jista' jinżel minn fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Biex it-turist ikun jista' jinżel minn fuqu.
messages.zh: 好让游客从它背上下来。
messages.en: So the tourist could get off.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 birek 配成一组身体降低的动作图：人跪下、人蹲下、骆驼卧下。再根据句中的主语和场景选择具体中文义。

gloss_zh: 比尔基卡拉，马耳他的城镇及地方议会区

teaching_sense.en_definition: Birkirkara, a town in Malta; the name also identifies its local council area in the Eastern Region.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 比尔基卡拉，马耳他的一个城镇；此名称也指其位于东部地区的地方议会辖区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Birkirkara hija belt f'Malta; l-isem jirreferi wkoll għal-lokalità u l-kunsill lokali tagħha fir-Reġjun tal-Lvant.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他的一个城镇，名为比尔基卡拉。

sense_translations.en_definition: Birkirkara (a city and local council of the Eastern Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 比尔基卡拉，马耳他东部地区的一座城市及其地方议会。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir f'Birkirkara nhar it-Tlieta filgħodu.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in Birkirkara on Tuesday morning.
formal.zh: 会议将于星期二上午在比尔基卡拉举行。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn toqgħod? David: Noqgħod f'Birkirkara, qrib l-iskola.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where do you live? David: I live in Birkirkara, near the school.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你住在哪里？David：我住在比尔基卡拉，靠近学校。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 你住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 我住在比尔基卡拉，靠近学校。
messages.en: I live in Birkirkara, near the school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Birkirkara 当作地图上的完整地名记忆，并反复练习 Noqgħod f'Birkirkara“我住在比尔基卡拉”；书写地名时首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An alcoholic drink called beer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 啤酒，一种含酒精的饮料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xarba alkoħolika magħrufa bħala birra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 啤酒。

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi birra lokali u għażla ta' xorb ieħor.
formal.en: The menu includes local beer and a selection of other drinks.
formal.zh: 菜单提供本地啤酒及其他多种饮料。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nixtieq birra kiesħa, jekk jogħġbok. Rita: Tridha fi flixkun jew f'tazza?
colloquial.en: Mark: I'd like a cold beer, please. Rita: Would you like it in a bottle or in a glass?
colloquial.zh: 马克：请给我一份冰啤酒。丽塔：您要瓶装的，还是装在杯子里的？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我一份冰啤酒。
messages.en: I'd like a cold beer, please.

messages.speaker: Rita (服务员)
messages.zh: 您要瓶装的，还是装在杯子里的？
messages.en: Would you like it in a bottle or in a glass?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 birra 和一杯冒泡的啤酒画面绑定，再连记 tazza birra，帮助点餐时整组提取。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Eurasian dotterel, a bird of the species Charadrius morinellus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小嘴鸻，学名为 Charadrius morinellus 的鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Charadrius morinellus, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala Eurasian dotterel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小嘴鸻。
小嘴鸻（学名 Charadrius morinellus）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a Eurasian dotterel

formal.mt: Il-gwida tinkludi ritratt ta' birwin u tagħti l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu, Charadrius morinellus.
formal.en: The guide includes a photograph of a Eurasian dotterel and gives its scientific name, Charadrius morinellus.
formal.zh: 这本指南收录了一张小嘴鸻的照片，并列出了它的学名 Charadrius morinellus。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fir-ritratt? Pawlu: Dan birwin. Ejja nfittxuh fil-gwida.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this bird in the photograph called? Pawlu: It's a Eurasian dotterel. Let's look it up in the guide.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的这只鸟叫什么？保罗：这是小嘴鸻。我们在指南里查一下吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟同伴)
messages.zh: 照片里的这只鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is this bird in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观鸟同伴)
messages.zh: 这是小嘴鸻。我们在指南里查一下吧。
messages.en: It's a Eurasian dotterel. Let's look it up in the guide.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张小嘴鸻图片卡，正面写 birwin，背面写中文鸟名与学名，用图像配对记忆。

gloss_zh: 比尔泽布贾，马耳他南部海滨城镇

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a seaside town in the south of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 比尔泽布贾，马耳他南部一座海滨城镇的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' belt ħdejn il-baħar fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: seaside town in the south of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 比尔泽布贾，马耳他南部的一座海滨城镇。

sense_translations.en_definition: Birżebbuġa (a town and local council of the Southern Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 比尔泽布贾（马耳他南部大区的一座城镇及其地方议会）。

formal.mt: Il-programm taż-żjara jinkludi waqfa f'Birżebbuġa, belt ħdejn il-baħar fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.
formal.en: The visit programme includes a stop in Birżebbuġa, a seaside town in the south of Malta.
formal.zh: 参观行程包括在比尔泽布贾停留；这是一座位于马耳他南部的海滨城镇。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn sejrin il-Ħadd? Toni: Ejja mmorru Birżebbuġa u nimxu ħdejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are we going on Sunday? Toni: Let's go to Birżebbuġa and walk by the sea.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们星期天去哪里？托尼：去比尔泽布贾，在海边走走吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们星期天去哪里？
messages.en: Where are we going on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja mmorru Birżebbuġa u nimxu ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja mmorru Birżebbuġa u nimxu ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.zh: 去比尔泽布贾，在海边走走吧。
messages.en: Let's go to Birżebbuġa and walk by the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在马耳他地图南部画一个海边定位点，标上 Birżebbuġa，把地名、方位和海滨画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Only or just, limiting an amount or scope; also used to introduce a condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示数量或范围受到限制，即“只、仅仅”；也可用于引出条件，表示“不过，条件是”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tillimita l-ammont jew il-firxa ta' xi ħaġa; tintuża wkoll biex tintroduċi kundizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仅仅；只是，用于限定数量、范围或情况。
只；仅，表示限定在所说的对象或范围内。
仅此；唯独，强调没有其他对象或情况。
不过，条件是；但须，用于提出限制条件。

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant jista' jibgħat applikazzjoni waħda biss.
formal.en: Each participant may submit only one application.
formal.zh: 每位参与者只能提交一份申请。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' niġi miegħek? Mark: Iva, biss trid tkun lesta fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I come with you? Mark: Yes, but you must be ready at eight.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我可以和你一起去吗？马克：可以，不过你得在八点准备好。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我可以和你一起去吗？
messages.en: Can I come with you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, biss trid tkun lesta fit-tmienja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, biss trid tkun lesta fit-tmienja.
messages.zh: 可以，不过你得在八点准备好。
messages.en: Yes, but you must be ready at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给数量画一道限制线：darba biss 是只一次；接着提出要求时，biss 可记成“不过有条件”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Next to, alongside, or opposite a person, place, or thing, depending on the spatial context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示空间位置，可指在某人、某地或某物旁边，也可指在其对面，具体由语境确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika post ħdejn jew faċċata ta' persuna, post jew ħaġa, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在……旁边；紧邻……。
在……一旁；与……并排。
在……对面。
位于……的对面；与……相对。

collocations.en: sitting next to one another or facing one another, depending on context
collocations.zh: 彼此相邻而坐或相对而坐，具体看语境

collocations.en: next to or opposite the church, depending on context
collocations.zh: 在教堂旁边或对面，具体看语境

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju jinsab biswit il-knisja, fuq in-naħa l-oħra tat-triq.
formal.en: The office is opposite the church, on the other side of the street.
formal.zh: 办公室位于教堂对面，在街道的另一侧。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu l-ħanut? Pawlu: Biswit il-bank. Aqsam it-triq u tarah.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the shop? Pawlu: Opposite the bank. Cross the street and you'll see it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：商店在哪里？保罗：在银行对面。过了马路你就能看到。

messages.speaker: Nina (问路人)
messages.zh: 商店在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the shop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (路人)
messages.mt_spoken: Biswit il-bank. Aqsam it-triq u tarah.
messages.mt_standard: Biswit il-bank. Aqsam it-triq u tarah.
messages.zh: 在银行对面。过了马路你就能看到。
messages.en: Opposite the bank. Cross the street and you'll see it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 biswit 配两幅位置图：一幅并排，一幅隔街相对；遇到实句再用道路、座位等线索判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An open area beside a house or enclosed by buildings, used as a yard or courtyard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 房屋旁边或建筑物围合起来的露天区域，即院子或庭院。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spazju miftuħ ħdejn dar jew imdawwar b'bini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 院子；房屋附近的露天空地。
庭院；建筑物围合的露天院落。

sense_translations.en_definition: yard, courtyard (open area by a house)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 院子；庭院，指房屋旁的露天区域。

collocations.en: in the yard of the house

formal.mt: Id-dar għandha bitħa żgħira b'mejda u erba' siġġijiet.
formal.en: The house has a small courtyard with a table and four chairs.
formal.zh: 这所房子有一个小庭院，里面放着一张桌子和四把椅子。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn inpoġġi l-pjanti? Marija: Poġġihom fil-bitħa, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where should I put the plants? Marija: Put them in the courtyard, near the door.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我把这些植物放在哪里？玛丽亚：放在院子里，靠近门的地方。

messages.speaker: Anna (女儿)
messages.zh: 我把这些植物放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put the plants?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 放在院子里，靠近门的地方。
messages.en: Put them in the courtyard, near the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从家门走进露天小院，把 bitħa 贴在院门上，再用 fil-bitħa 练习“在院子里”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A basket woven from wicker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用柳条等柔韧枝条编成的篮子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qoffa magħmula minn friegħi rqaq u flessibbli minsuġin flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柳条等柔韧枝条编成的篮子。

collocations.en: a wicker basket full of fruit

formal.mt: Fuq il-mejda tqiegħdet bixkilla mimlija frott frisk.
formal.en: A wicker basket full of fresh fruit was placed on the table.
formal.zh: 桌上放着一只装满新鲜水果的编篮。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għandek xi ħaġa fejn inpoġġi t-tuffieħ? Ġużi: Iva, ħu din il-bixkilla.
colloquial.en: Lina: Do you have something I can put the apples in? Ġużi: Yes, take this wicker basket.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你有没有什么东西可以让我装苹果？朱齐：有，拿这个编篮吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek xi ħaġa fejn inpoġġi t-tuffieħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek xi ħaġa fejn inpoġġi t-tuffieħ?
messages.zh: 你有没有什么东西可以让我装苹果？
messages.en: Do you have something I can put the apples in?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (邻居)
messages.zh: 有，拿这个编篮吧。
messages.en: Yes, take this wicker basket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把苹果逐个放进枝条交织的篮子，边放边说 bixkilla，用材质和动作共同记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The appearance or overall look of someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人或某物呈现出来的外观、面貌或整体样子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dehra jew l-aspett ġenerali ta' persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一瞥；概览，对事物作简略的整体观看或了解。
展望；总体看法或所呈现的前景。

sense_translations.en_definition: appearance (the way someone or something looks, appears)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 外观；面貌，指某人或某物看起来的样子。

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol ta' restawr ta lill-bini bixra ġdida.
formal.en: The restoration work gave the building a new look.
formal.zh: 修复工程使这座建筑焕然一新。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kamra għandha bixra differenti llum! Lara: Iva, biddilt il-purtieri u ċaqlaqt il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: The room has a different look today! Lara: Yes, I changed the curtains and moved the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：房间今天看起来不一样了！拉拉：是呀，我换了窗帘，还挪了桌子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 房间今天看起来不一样了！
messages.en: The room has a different look today!

messages.speaker: Lara (房主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, biddilt il-purtieri u ċaqlaqt il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, biddilt il-purtieri u ċaqlaqt il-mejda.
messages.zh: 是呀，我换了窗帘，还挪了桌子。
messages.en: Yes, I changed the curtains and moved the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用房间改造前后的照片记 bixra 的“面貌”，再把“看整体”的画面延伸到概览和展望。

gloss_zh: 蕾丝；花边织物；形容做工完美的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A delicate fabric with an open decorative pattern, used for trimming or making clothing and other textile items.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有镂空装饰图案的精细织物，用于衣物或其他纺织品的制作和装饰，即蕾丝或花边。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Drapp fin b'disinji miftuħa, li jintuża biex iżejjen jew jagħmel ħwejjeġ u oġġetti oħra tad-drapp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蕾丝；具有镂空花纹的花边。
蕾丝织物；花边织物。
做工完美的；制作极其精细的。

formal.mt: Il-libsa hija mżejna b'bizzilla fina madwar l-għonq u l-kmiem.
formal.en: The dress is decorated with fine lace around the neckline and sleeves.
formal.zh: 这条连衣裙的领口和袖子周围饰有精细的蕾丝。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Jogħġbok dan id-drapp għall-purtiera? Rita: Iva, il-bizzilla sabiħa ħafna u tħalli d-dawl jgħaddi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you like this fabric for the curtain? Rita: Yes, the lace is very pretty and lets the light through.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你喜欢用这块布做窗帘吗？丽塔：喜欢，这蕾丝很漂亮，还能透光。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢用这块布做窗帘吗？
messages.en: Do you like this fabric for the curtain?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-bizzilla sabiħa ħafna u tħalli d-dawl jgħaddi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-bizzilla sabiħa ħafna u tħalli d-dawl jgħaddi.
messages.zh: 喜欢，这蕾丝很漂亮，还能透光。
messages.en: Yes, the lace is very pretty and lets the light through.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 bizzilla，就想象领口一圈细密、镂空的蕾丝花边；名词记“蕾丝”，另把形容词义单独记成“做工完美”，避免混淆词性。

gloss_zh: 一块；一片；一件；棋子；作品

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece or portion of something, or a single item such as a game piece or an artistic work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物的一块、一片或一部分，也可指棋子、艺术作品等单独的一件事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti minn xi ħaġa, jew oġġett wieħed bħal biċċa f'logħba jew xogħol artistiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一块；一件；从整体中分出的一部分。
一片；切下来的薄片。
块；份；整体中的一部分。

sense_translations.en_definition: piece (chess: figure other than pawn; similar counter in other games)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 棋子，国际象棋中指兵以外的棋子；也指其他游戏中类似的棋子。
一件艺术作品；一首乐曲等独立创作。
一块布；布片。
硬币；一枚钱币。
一件事实；一桩事件。
事务；需要处理或关心的事情。

collocations.en: a piece of work; a task

formal.mt: Kull student irċieva biċċa drapp biex jużaha fil-proġett tal-arti.
formal.en: Each student received a piece of cloth to use in the art project.
formal.zh: 每位学生都领到了一块布，用于美术项目。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid biċċa kejk? Luqa: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma biċċa żgħira.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like a piece of cake? Luqa: Yes, please, but a small piece.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你想吃块蛋糕吗？Luqa：想，谢谢，不过要一小块。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想吃块蛋糕吗？
messages.en: Would you like a piece of cake?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma biċċa żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma biċċa żgħira.
messages.zh: 想，谢谢，不过要一小块。
messages.en: Yes, please, but a small piece.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象切出的一块蛋糕，再把 biċċa 扩展成“一件”：一件作品、一枚棋子或一桩事情。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To slaughter an animal or kill brutally; also to disfigure something or ruin it badly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 屠宰动物或残酷杀害，也可表示使外形损毁或把某物严重搞坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joqtol annimal għall-laħam jew joqtol b'mod brutali; ukoll jisfigura jew iħassar xi ħaġa sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 屠宰；宰杀。
宰杀并分割牲畜；屠宰。
毁容；使外形受到严重损伤。
毁坏；糟蹋；把事情搞砸。
残杀；以残酷的方式杀害。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-ħaddiem biċċer l-annimal fil-biċċerija.
formal.en: The report describes how the worker slaughtered the animal in the slaughterhouse.
formal.zh: 报告描述了工人在屠宰场宰杀该动物的过程。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif mar ix-xogħol taż-żebgħa? Ġanni: Ħażin! Min żebagħli l-kamra biċċer ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Marta: How did the painting work go? Ġanni: Badly! Whoever painted my room made a complete mess of the job.
colloquial.zh: Marta：刷漆的活做得怎么样？Ġanni：很糟！给我房间刷漆的人把活全搞砸了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 刷漆的活做得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the painting work go?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħażin! Min żebagħli l-kamra biċċer ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Ħażin! Min żebagħli l-kamra biċċer ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 很糟！给我房间刷漆的人把活全搞砸了。
messages.en: Badly! Whoever painted my room made a complete mess of the job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 biċċer 配两张记忆卡：动物对应“屠宰”，糟糕的工作成果对应“毁坏、搞砸”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To chop something or cut it into smaller pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物切碎或切成较小的块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqta' xi ħaġa f'biċċiet iżgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剁碎；切碎。
切成块；切成若干小片或小段。

collocations.en: to cut the paper into pieces

formal.mt: Il-kok biċċeċ il-ħaxix qabel żiedu mas-soppa.
formal.en: The cook chopped the vegetables before adding them to the soup.
formal.zh: 厨师先将蔬菜切碎，再加入汤中。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Biċċeċ il-karrotti, jekk jogħġbok. Toni: F'biċċiet żgħar jew kbar? Nina: Żgħar, għas-soppa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Chop the carrots, please. Toni: Into small pieces or large ones? Nina: Small ones, for the soup.
colloquial.zh: Nina：请把胡萝卜切一下。Toni：切小块还是大块？Nina：小块，用来煮汤。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 请把胡萝卜切一下。
messages.en: Chop the carrots, please.

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 切小块还是大块？
messages.en: Into small pieces or large ones?

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 小块，用来煮汤。
messages.en: Small ones, for the soup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 biċċeċ 记成菜刀连续落下、蔬菜变成小块的动作；用完整搭配帮助记住动词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose work involves slaughtering animals or preparing and selling meat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事屠宰动物，或处理和售卖肉类工作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li toqtol annimali għall-laħam jew tħejji u tbigħ il-laħam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一名肉贩或屠夫；处理、售卖肉类或从事屠宰的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: one who works in a slaughterhouse
sense_translations.zh_definition: 屠宰场工人。
肉贩；屠夫。

formal.mt: Il-biċċier ipprepara l-laħam skont l-ordni tal-klijent.
formal.en: The butcher prepared the meat according to the customer's order.
formal.zh: 肉贩按照顾客的订单准备了肉品。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Fejn xtrajt dan il-laħam? David: Għand il-biċċier tar-raħal. Elena: Se mmur għandu għada.
colloquial.en: Elena: Where did you buy this meat? David: At the village butcher's. Elena: I'll go to him tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Elena：这肉在哪里买的？David：在村里的肉贩那里。Elena：我明天去他那里买。

messages.speaker: Elena (邻居)
messages.zh: 这肉在哪里买的？
messages.en: Where did you buy this meat?

messages.speaker: David (邻居)
messages.zh: 在村里的肉贩那里。
messages.en: At the village butcher's.

messages.speaker: Elena (邻居)
messages.zh: 我明天去他那里买。
messages.en: I'll go to him tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 biċċier 写在肉店柜台后那个人的名牌上，整句记住 għand il-biċċier，表示“在肉贩那里”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something less severe, harsh, or intense, such as a punishment or criticism.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事的严厉程度或强度降低，例如减轻处罚或缓和批评。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas is-severità jew il-qawwa ta' xi ħaġa, bħal piena jew kritika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减轻；缓解，使严重程度降低。
缓和；使语气、表达或强度不那么强烈。
豁免；免除某人原本须承担的义务或要求。
保护；使免受伤害或不利影响。
缓和；减轻严厉程度或不利影响。

formal.mt: Wara li kkunsidra ċ-ċirkostanzi, il-kumitat biġġel il-piena imposta fuq l-istudent.
formal.en: After considering the circumstances, the committee reduced the severity of the punishment imposed on the student.
formal.zh: 委员会考虑了具体情况后，减轻了对该学生的处罚。

colloquial.mt: Rita: L-editur ħalla l-kritika kif kienet? Toni: Le, biġġel il-kritika qabel ippubblika l-artiklu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did the editor leave the criticism as it was? Toni: No, he toned down the criticism before publishing the article.
colloquial.zh: Rita：编辑保留了原来的批评措辞吗？Toni：没有，他在发表文章前缓和了批评。

messages.speaker: Rita (作者)
messages.zh: 编辑保留了原来的批评措辞吗？
messages.en: Did the editor leave the criticism as it was?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, biġġel il-kritika qabel ippubblika l-artiklu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, biġġel il-kritika qabel ippubblika l-artiklu.
messages.zh: 没有，他在发表文章前缓和了批评。
messages.en: No, he toned down the criticism before publishing the article.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“把严厉程度调低一格”的画面记 biġġel，分别练习减轻处罚和缓和批评；豁免、保护另做义项卡，按语境选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become diligent and hardworking in one's work or studies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在工作或学习中变得勤奋、用功。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir ħabrieki u jibda jaħdem jew jistudja b'aktar diliġenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得勤劳；开始努力工作。
变得勤奋；开始认真用功。

formal.mt: Matul dan is-semestru, l-istudent biżel fl-istudju u beda jtemm ix-xogħol fil-ħin.
formal.en: During this semester, the student became diligent in his studies and began completing his work on time.
formal.zh: 这个学期，这名学生在学习上变得用功，开始按时完成作业。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer Pawlu bl-istudju? Rita: Biżel ħafna dan l-aħħar; issa jistudja kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is Pawlu doing with his studies? Rita: He has become much more diligent lately; now he studies every day.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗最近学习怎么样？丽塔：他最近用功多了，现在每天都学习。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗最近学习怎么样？
messages.en: How is Pawlu doing with his studies?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biżel ħafna dan l-aħħar; issa jistudja kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Biżel ħafna dan l-aħħar; issa jistudja kuljum.
messages.zh: 他最近用功多了，现在每天都学习。
messages.en: He has become much more diligent lately; now he studies every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 biżel 配上“原来拖延，现在每天用功”的画面，重点记住勤奋状态的变化；与 biżżel 对照，前者是自己变勤奋。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To the amount or degree needed for a particular purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量或程度达到某一目的所需要的水平；足够地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fil-kwantità jew sal-grad meħtieġ għal skop partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 足够；达到所需的数量或程度。
足够；满足某项需要。
充分地；达到所需程度地。
足够地；充分地。

formal.mt: Il-baġit huwa kbir biżżejjed biex ikopri l-ispejjeż kollha tal-proġett.
formal.en: The budget is large enough to cover all the project's expenses.
formal.zh: 预算足以支付这个项目的全部费用。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandna ħobż biżżejjed għall-pranzu? Lara: Iva, għandna biżżejjed għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do we have enough bread for lunch? Lara: Yes, we have enough for everyone.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们午饭的面包够吗？拉拉：够，足够大家吃。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 我们午饭的面包够吗？
messages.en: Do we have enough bread for lunch?

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 够，足够大家吃。
messages.en: Yes, we have enough for everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给每个人分面包，分到最后仍然够吃，就说 biżżejjed；把 flus biżżejjed 和 kbir biżżejjed 分别记成“钱够”和“够大”。

gloss_zh: 使某人变得勤奋；促使某人用功

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to become diligent and hardworking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人变得勤奋，促使其认真工作或学习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwassal lil xi ħadd biex isir ħabrieki u jaħdem jew jistudja b'aktar diliġenza.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause sb. to become diligent and hardworking
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人变得勤奋、勤劳。
使某人用功；使某人变得勤勉。

formal.mt: L-inkoraġġiment kontinwu tal-għalliem biżżel lill-istudent u għenu jtejjeb ir-riżultati tiegħu.
formal.en: The teacher's continued encouragement made the student diligent and helped him improve his results.
formal.zh: 老师持续的鼓励使这名学生变得用功，并帮助他提高了成绩。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Pawlu issa jistudja kuljum! Maja: Iva, l-inkoraġġiment tal-għalliem biżżel lil Pawlu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Pawlu studies every day now! Maja: Yes, the teacher's encouragement made Pawlu more diligent.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：保罗现在每天都学习！玛雅：是啊，老师的鼓励让保罗变得更用功了。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.zh: 保罗现在每天都学习！
messages.en: Pawlu studies every day now!

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-inkoraġġiment tal-għalliem biżżel lil Pawlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-inkoraġġiment tal-għalliem biżżel lil Pawlu.
messages.zh: 是啊，老师的鼓励让保罗变得更用功了。
messages.en: Yes, the teacher's encouragement made Pawlu more diligent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用箭头记忆：老师的鼓励→学生变勤奋，就是 biżżel。把拼写中多出的一个 ż 当作提示卡，提醒自己这里有“使某人”的意思。

gloss_zh: 变白；变苍白；褪色；成熟待采的棉花或棉铃；白色状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become white or pale, or to lose colour and fade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变白或变得苍白，也可指失去原有颜色而褪色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir abjad jew pallidu, jew jitlef il-kulur tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变白；变得发白。
变得苍白；脸色发白。
成熟的棉铃。

sense_translations.en_definition: to become white, to lose colour, to fade
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变白；失去颜色；褪色。
变得苍白。
已经成熟、可以采摘的棉花。
白色的状态或性质；洁白程度。

collocations.en: the fabric faded in the sun

formal.mt: Wara żmien twil espost għax-xemx, id-drapp bjad u tilef il-kulur oriġinali tiegħu.
formal.en: After prolonged exposure to sunlight, the fabric faded and lost its original colour.
formal.zh: 经过长时间日晒，布料褪色发白，失去了原来的颜色。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark bjad hekk? Pawlu: Beża' meta sema' l-ħoss, imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark go so pale? Pawlu: He got frightened when he heard the noise, but he is fine now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克怎么脸色这么苍白？保罗：他听到响声时吓了一跳，不过现在没事了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克怎么脸色这么苍白？
messages.en: Why did Mark go so pale?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Beża' meta sema' l-ħoss, imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Beża' meta sema' l-ħoss, imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
messages.zh: 他听到响声时吓了一跳，不过现在没事了。
messages.en: He got frightened when he heard the noise, but he is fine now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“彩布晒到发白、脸受惊变苍白”记住 bjad 的动词义；再另画名词卡片，分别写“成熟棉铃、待采棉花、白色状态”，不要混成一个词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or state of being white.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈现白色的性质或状态，也可指洁白的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew l-istat ta' dak li hu abjad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白色的性质或状态；洁白；白度。

formal.mt: Il-bjuda tal-ħitan tagħmel il-kamra tidher aktar imdawla.
formal.en: The whiteness of the walls makes the room appear brighter.
formal.zh: 墙壁的洁白使房间显得更加明亮。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara l-bjuda ta' dawn il-lożor! Mark: Iva, jidhru nodfa ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look how white these sheets are! Mark: Yes, they look very clean.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看这些床单多白啊！马克：是啊，看起来很干净。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 看这些床单多白啊！
messages.en: Look how white these sheets are!

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 是啊，看起来很干净。
messages.en: Yes, they look very clean.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bjuda 写在一张纯白色卡片中央，记住它命名的是“白这种性质”。对照 bjad 的动词义：bjad 表示变白，bjuda 表示白的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of being unable to speak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无法说话的状态；指言语表达能力的缺失。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni li fiha persuna ma tkunx tista' titkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不能说话的状态；失去或缺乏说话能力。

collocations.en: a person who is unable to speak

formal.mt: Il-bkim ma jfissirx li persuna ma tistax tikkomunika bil-kitba jew b'mezzi oħra.
formal.en: Muteness does not mean that a person cannot communicate through writing or other means.
formal.zh: 不能说话并不意味着一个人无法通过书写或其他方式交流。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser bkim? Rita: Ifisser li persuna ma tistax titkellem; tista' tikkomunika b'modi oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does bkim mean? Rita: It means that a person cannot speak; they can communicate in other ways.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：bkim 是什么意思？丽塔：意思是一个人无法说话；可以用其他方式交流。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: bkim 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does bkim mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li persuna ma tistax titkellem; tista' tikkomunika b'modi oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li persuna ma tistax titkellem; tista' tikkomunika b'modi oħra.
messages.zh: 意思是一个人无法说话；可以用其他方式交流。
messages.en: It means that a person cannot speak; they can communicate in other ways.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“无法开口说话，但能写下想法”的场景记 bkim，抓住说话能力这一点；不要把它误记成单纯安静、没有想法或听不见。

gloss_zh: 当季最早成熟的果实，尤指葡萄；初熟果实

teaching_sense.en_definition: The first fruit to ripen in a season, especially grapes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个季节中最早成熟的果实，尤其用于指最早成熟的葡萄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ewwel frott li jimmatura fl-istaġun, speċjalment l-għeneb.

sense_translations.en_definition: early fruits in the season (typically used of grapes)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 当季较早成熟的果实，通常指葡萄。
初熟果实；一个季节最先成熟收获的果实。

collocations.en: the first ripe grapes of the season

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ġabar il-bkir tal-għeneb u ħalla l-bqija jimmatura fuq id-dwieli.
formal.en: The farmer picked the first ripe grapes of the season and left the rest to ripen on the vines.
formal.zh: 农民采下了当季最早成熟的葡萄，把其余葡萄留在藤上继续成熟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan l-għeneb diġà misjur? Pawlu: Iva, dan hu l-bkir; il-bqija għadu mhux lest għall-ġbir.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are these grapes ripe already? Pawlu: Yes, these are the first ripe grapes of the season; the rest are not ready to pick yet.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些葡萄已经熟了吗？保罗：是啊，这是当季最早熟的一批，其余的还没到采摘的时候。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这些葡萄已经熟了吗？
messages.en: Are these grapes ripe already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (果农)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan hu l-bkir; il-bqija għadu mhux lest għall-ġbir.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan hu l-bkir; il-bqija għadu mhux lest għall-ġbir.
messages.zh: 是啊，这是当季最早熟的一批，其余的还没到采摘的时候。
messages.en: Yes, these are the first ripe grapes of the season; the rest are not ready to pick yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象葡萄园里第一篮刚成熟的葡萄，给篮子贴上 bkir；重点记“当季最先成熟的一批果实”，不要只记成早晨采摘的水果。

gloss_zh: 当季初熟果实；初收果实

teaching_sense.en_definition: The first fruits to ripen or be gathered at the beginning of a season.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个季节最先成熟或最先采收的一批果实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ewwel frott li jimmatura jew jinġabar fil-bidu tal-istaġun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 当季较早成熟的果实；时令初果
最先采收的果实；初收果实

collocations.en: the first fruits of the season

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ġabar il-bkur u ħadu fis-suq biex ibigħu.
formal.en: The farmer gathered the first fruits and took them to the market to sell them.
formal.zh: 农夫采收了初熟果实，把它们带到市场出售。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-frott għadu kif inġabar? Pawlu: Iva, dan hu l-bkur tal-istaġun.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has this fruit just been picked? Pawlu: Yes, these are the first fruits of the season.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些水果是刚摘的吗？保罗：是啊，这是当季最先采收的一批。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这些水果是刚摘的吗？
messages.en: Has this fruit just been picked?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (果农)
messages.zh: 是啊，这是当季最先采收的一批。
messages.en: Yes, these are the first fruits of the season.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bkur 记成季节开始时果篮里的第一批果实：重点是最先成熟、最先采收。

teaching_sense.en_definition: By selling goods individually or in small quantities directly to customers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以零售方式，即直接向顾客逐件或少量出售商品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Billi jinbiegħu oġġetti wieħed wieħed jew fi kwantitajiet żgħar direttament lill-klijenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 批发；以批发方式
以零售方式；逐件或少量出售

formal.mt: Il-ħanut ibigħ il-prodotti bl-imnut direttament lill-konsumaturi.
formal.en: The shop sells the products by retail directly to consumers.
formal.zh: 这家商店以零售方式直接向消费者出售产品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tbigħu bl-imnut? Għandi bżonn waħda biss. Toni: Iva, tista' tixtri waħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you sell by retail? I only need one. Toni: Yes, you can buy one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们零售吗？我只需要一个。托尼：零售，你可以买一个。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbigħu bl-imnut? Għandi bżonn waħda biss.
messages.mt_standard: Tbigħu bl-imnut? Għandi bżonn waħda biss.
messages.zh: 你们零售吗？我只需要一个。
messages.en: Do you sell by retail? I only need one.

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.zh: 零售，你可以买一个。
messages.en: Yes, you can buy one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“我只买一个，也能按零售价购买”的柜台画面记住 bl-imnut 的教学主义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to indicate that an ingredient, means, accompanying thing, or quality is absent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示缺少或不带某种配料、手段、伴随事物或性质，相当于“没有……”或“不加……”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex turi li xi ingredjent, mezz, ħaġa oħra jew kwalità mhix preżenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 没有；不带；无
没有或不带某种配料、手段、伴随事物或性质

formal.mt: L-istudent temm l-eżerċizzju bla għajnuna.
formal.en: The student completed the exercise without help.
formal.zh: 这名学生没有借助他人帮助，完成了练习。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kafè, jekk jogħġbok. Sara: Biz-zokkor? Mark: Le, bla zokkor, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Mark: A coffee, please. Sara: With sugar? Mark: No, without sugar, thanks.
colloquial.zh: 马克：请给我一杯咖啡。萨拉：加糖吗？马克：不，不加糖，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我一杯咖啡。
messages.en: A coffee, please.

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.zh: 加糖吗？
messages.en: With sugar?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 不，不加糖，谢谢。
messages.en: No, without sugar, thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象点单时把糖罐移开：bla 后面接的就是没有、不要或不带的东西。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An attempt to deceive someone by pretending to have more strength, confidence, or ability than one actually has.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过装作比实际更强大、更有把握或更有能力来唬住别人的举动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tentattiv biex tqarraq b'xi ħadd billi tippretendi li għandek aktar saħħa, kunfidenza jew ħila milli għandek tassew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虚张声势；用来唬人的姿态或举动。

collocations.zh: 用来吓唬别人的虚张声势

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tal-logħba, il-kummentatur spjega li l-mossa kienet blaff biex tħawwad lill-avversarju.
formal.en: In the analysis of the game, the commentator explained that the move was a bluff intended to confuse the opponent.
formal.zh: 在比赛分析中，评论员解释说，这一步是在虚张声势，目的是迷惑对手。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qal li għandu l-aħjar karti. David: Naħseb li dan blaff. Sara: Mela nistennew u naraw.
colloquial.en: Sara: He said he has the best cards. David: I think that's a bluff. Sara: Then let's wait and see.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他说自己手里的牌最好。戴维：我觉得他是在唬人。萨拉：那就等着看吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (牌友)
messages.zh: 他说自己手里的牌最好。
messages.en: He said he has the best cards.

messages.speaker: David (牌友)
messages.zh: 我觉得他是在唬人。
messages.en: I think that's a bluff.

messages.speaker: Sara (牌友)
messages.zh: 那就等着看吧。
messages.en: Then let's wait and see.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手里牌很弱却摆出稳赢表情的人，用这幅画面记住虚张声势的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A blossom or a bud that is developing into a flower; also a very young person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 花朵或正在发育、尚未开放的花苞；也可指非常年幼的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fjur jew għoqda żgħira li minnha jiżviluppa fjur; jista' wkoll jirreferi għal persuna żgħira ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 花；花朵
花苞；尚未开放的花蕾
幼小者；非常年幼的人

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw blanzun tal-ward u rreġistraw kif infetaħ matul il-ġimgħa.
formal.en: The students observed a rosebud and recorded how it opened during the week.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了一朵玫瑰花苞，并记录它在一周内如何绽放。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dan il-blanzun! Ben: Għadu magħluq, imma dalwaqt jinfetaħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at this bud! Ben: It's still closed, but it will open soon.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看这个花苞！本：它还没开，不过很快就会绽放了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看这个花苞！
messages.en: Look at this bud!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 它还没开，不过很快就会绽放了。
messages.en: It's still closed, but it will open soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一幅花苞慢慢绽开的画面记住 blanzun，再把娇嫩、年幼的形象联系到“幼小者”。

gloss_zh: 变得愚笨；变得衰老糊涂

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become foolish, or to develop mental confusion associated with old age.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得愚笨、糊涂；也可指随年老而出现心智衰退。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir iblah, jew jibda jitlef iċ-ċarezza tal-ħsieb minħabba x-xjuħija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得愚笨；变得糊涂
因年老而变得糊涂；出现老年性心智衰退

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-re blieh u beda jieħu deċiżjonijiet bla ħsieb.
formal.en: In the story, the king became foolish and began making thoughtless decisions.
formal.zh: 在故事中，国王变得愚笨，开始不加思考地作决定。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ir-re ta r-renju tiegħu lil barrani? Leo: Għax blieh! Hekk jgħid ir-rakkont.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did the king give his kingdom to a stranger? Leo: Because he became foolish! That's what the story says.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：国王为什么把自己的王国送给陌生人？利奥：因为他变糊涂了呀！故事就是这么说的。

messages.speaker: Nina (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ir-re ta r-renju tiegħu lil barrani?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ir-re ta r-renju tiegħu lil barrani?
messages.zh: 国王为什么把自己的王国送给陌生人？
messages.en: Why did the king give his kingdom to a stranger?

messages.speaker: Leo (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 因为他变糊涂了呀！故事就是这么说的。
messages.en: Because he became foolish! That's what the story says.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 blieh 放进“故事里的国王变糊涂了”这句话，记住它强调变得糊涂这一变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lose colour or become lighter in shade; also to become mature or ripe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 失去原有颜色、褪色或变成较浅的色调；也可表示成熟或变熟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef il-kulur jew jieħu lewn iktar ċar; jista' wkoll ifisser li jsir misjur jew matur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 失去颜色；褪色
色调变浅
成熟；变熟
颜色变浅；变得较淡
变得成熟；达到成熟状态

formal.mt: Id-drapp blieq wara li tħalla għal żmien twil fix-xemx.
formal.en: The fabric faded after being left in the sun for a long time.
formal.zh: 布料在阳光下放置了很长时间后褪色了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan id-drapp kien iktar skur, hux? Mark: Iva, blieq għax ħallejnieh fix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Sara: This fabric used to be darker, didn't it? Mark: Yes, it faded because we left it in the sun.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这块布以前颜色更深，对吧？马克：对，我们把它放在太阳下，结果褪色了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-drapp kien iktar skur, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-drapp kien iktar skur, hux?
messages.zh: 这块布以前颜色更深，对吧？
messages.en: This fabric used to be darker, didn't it?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 对，我们把它放在太阳下，结果褪色了。
messages.en: Yes, it faded because we left it in the sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 blieq 配两张学习卡：一张是布料颜色变浅，一张是果实成熟，分别记住两类变化。

gloss_zh: 块；团块；一块大麻树脂（口语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A solid piece or lump of a substance, often described by naming the material.
