teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种物质形成的一块或一团固体，常与材料名称连用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa jew massa solida ta' xi materjal, li spiss tissemma flimkien mal-isem tal-materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 块；团块
一块大麻树脂（口语）
一块……；一团……

formal.mt: L-iskultur uża blokka ġebel biex joħloq l-istatwa.
formal.en: The sculptor used a block of stone to create the statue.
formal.zh: 雕塑家用一块石料雕成了这座雕像。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Din il-blokka silġ kbira wisq għall-kaxxa. Lara: Ejja nużaw kaxxa ikbar.
colloquial.en: Ben: This block of ice is too big for the box. Lara: Let's use a bigger box.
colloquial.zh: 本：这块冰太大了，箱子装不下。拉拉：我们换个大一点的箱子吧。

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-blokka silġ kbira wisq għall-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-blokka silġ kbira wisq għall-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 这块冰太大了，箱子装不下。
messages.en: This block of ice is too big for the box.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们换个大一点的箱子吧。
messages.en: Let's use a bigger box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 blokka 想成手里的一整块材料，后接冰、石头等材料名，就能记住“一块……”的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the colour of a clear daytime sky or a similar blue shade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈蓝色的，例如晴朗白天天空的颜色或相近色调。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-kulur tas-sema ċar matul il-jum jew lewn simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蓝色的
蓝色的；呈蓝色的

formal.mt: Fuq il-mappa, il-kulur blu jindika ż-żoni koperti bl-ilma.
formal.en: On the map, the colour blue indicates areas covered by water.
formal.zh: 在这张地图上，蓝色表示被水覆盖的区域。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema qmis se tilbes illum? Mark: Il-qmis blu, dik ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which shirt are you going to wear today? Mark: The blue shirt, the one by the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天打算穿哪件衬衫？马克：那件蓝色的，就是窗边那件。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天打算穿哪件衬衫？
messages.en: Which shirt are you going to wear today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那件蓝色的，就是窗边那件。
messages.en: The blue shirt, the one by the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 blu 与英语 blue 并排写在蓝色色卡上作拼写联想，再用深蓝衬衫和浅蓝天空巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 胡话；愚行；傻气；轻浮；愚蠢

teaching_sense.en_definition: Foolishness shown in words, actions, or a lack of good judgment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 言语或行为中表现出的傻气、愚蠢，或缺乏明智判断的表现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' għaqal li jidher fil-kliem, fl-imġiba jew fid-deċiżjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胡话；没有道理的言语或内容。
愚行；因缺乏明智判断而做出的事。
傻气；不够认真或显得幼稚可笑的表现。
轻浮；对事情缺乏应有的认真态度。
愚蠢；理解或判断能力不足的表现。
愚笨；不明智的想法或行为。

formal.mt: Li tittieħed deċiżjoni importanti mingħajr ma jiġu eżaminati l-fatti jkun bluha.
formal.en: Making an important decision without examining the facts would be foolishness.
formal.zh: 不审视事实就作出重要决定，是一种愚蠢的做法。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għamilt bluha: ħriġt mingħajr iċ-ċwievet. Ben: Għandek ċavetta oħra għand xi ħadd? Nina: Iva, għand oħti.
colloquial.en: Nina: I did something foolish: I went out without my keys. Ben: Does someone have a spare key? Nina: Yes, my sister does.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我干了件傻事，出门没带钥匙。本：有人拿着你的备用钥匙吗？妮娜：有，我姐姐那里有。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我干了件傻事，出门没带钥匙。
messages.en: I did something foolish: I went out without my keys.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek ċavetta oħra għand xi ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek ċavetta oħra għand xi ħadd?
messages.zh: 有人拿着你的备用钥匙吗？
messages.en: Does someone have a spare key?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我姐姐那里有。
messages.en: Yes, my sister does.

cognitive_memory_aid: 以欠缺明智判断为中心记忆：说出来可能是胡话，做出来可能是蠢事，态度上可能显得轻浮。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fine, calm weather, especially when the sky is clear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 晴朗、平静的好天气，尤指天空晴好的天气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Temp sabiħ u kalm, speċjalment meta s-sema jkun ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 晴好的天气。
晴朗的；阳光充足的。
晴朗、宜人的好天气。
晴好的；平静的，常用于描述天气或海面。

formal.mt: It-temp bnazzi ppermetta lill-istudenti jagħmlu l-attività barra.
formal.en: The fine weather allowed the students to do the activity outdoors.
formal.zh: 天气晴好，学生们得以在户外开展活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum hawn bnazzi. Immorru passiġġata? Mark: Iva, ejja mmorru ħdejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: The weather is lovely today. Shall we go for a walk? Mark: Yes, let's go by the sea.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天天气真好。我们去散步吗？马克：好，我们去海边吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天天气真好。我们去散步吗？
messages.en: The weather is lovely today. Shall we go for a walk?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我们去海边吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's go by the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bnazzi 配上蓝天与平静海面的画面，连记“天气晴好、海面平静”两种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pleasant to eat because it tastes good; also used of food made with good-quality ingredients.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容食物味道好、吃起来可口，也可形容食物所用的食材品质优良。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu togħma tajba; jingħad ukoll għal ikel magħmul b'ingredjenti ta' kwalità tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可口的；味道好的。

sense_translations.en_definition: made of good quality ingredients (used of food)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用优质食材制成的，用于形容食物。
美味的；十分好吃的。

formal.mt: Il-kok juża ingredjenti friski biex jipprepara ikel bnin.
formal.en: The cook uses fresh ingredients to prepare tasty food.
formal.zh: 厨师使用新鲜食材制作美味的食物。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm hu bnin dan il-ħobż! Pawlu: Għamiltu dalgħodu. Trid biċċa oħra?
colloquial.en: Sara: This bread is so delicious! Pawlu: I made it this morning. Would you like another piece?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个面包真好吃！保罗：我今天早上做的。你还要一块吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个面包真好吃！
messages.en: This bread is so delicious!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天早上做的。你还要一块吗？
messages.en: I made it this morning. Would you like another piece?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象尝一口面包后点头说 bnin，把这个词和“好吃、食材好”的感受一起记住。

gloss_zh: 公山羊；粗鲁的人；摩羯座

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male goat; figuratively, a rough or ill-mannered person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公山羊；比喻用法中也指举止粗鲁、没有礼貌的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-maskil tal-mogħża; b'mod figurattiv, persuna goffa jew bla manjieri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公山羊。

sense_translations.en_definition: a vulgar or rough person (figurative usage)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗俗或粗鲁的人，属于比喻用法。
公山羊。
没有礼貌的人；举止粗鲁者。
摩羯座，指天文学中的星座。
摩羯座，指黄道十二宫中的星座或星座符号。

formal.mt: Il-bodbod kien f'qasam magħluq ħdejn ir-razzett.
formal.en: The billy goat was in an enclosed field beside the farm.
formal.zh: 那只公山羊待在农场旁边一块围起来的田地里。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dak bodbod jew mogħża? Ġużeppi: Dak bodbod. Il-mogħża qiegħda ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is that a billy goat or a female goat? Ġużeppi: That's a billy goat. The female goat is beside the gate.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：那是公山羊还是母山羊？朱塞佩：那是公山羊。母山羊在门旁边。

messages.speaker: Marta (访客)
messages.zh: 那是公山羊还是母山羊？
messages.en: Is that a billy goat or a female goat?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak bodbod. Il-mogħża qiegħda ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Dak bodbod. Il-mogħża qiegħda ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 那是公山羊。母山羊在门旁边。
messages.en: That's a billy goat. The female goat is beside the gate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“农场里的公山羊”记住 bodbod；另开两张记忆卡，分别记录粗鲁的人和摩羯座义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Distance or the state of being far away from a place, person, or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 距离，或离某个地方、某个人或某件事物很远的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-distanza jew il-qagħda ta' min jinsab 'il bogħod minn post, persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 距离；相隔的远近。
距离；身处远方或相隔遥远的状态。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw l-għasafar mill-bogħod biex ma jfixkluhomx.
formal.en: The students observed the birds from a distance so as not to disturb them.
formal.zh: 学生们从远处观察鸟类，以免打扰它们。

colloquial.mt: Elena: L-istazzjon bogħod minn hawn? David: Le, ħames minuti bil-mixi biss.
colloquial.en: Elena: Is the station far from here? David: No, it's only a five-minute walk.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：车站离这里远吗？戴维：不远，走路只要五分钟。

messages.speaker: Elena (游客)
messages.zh: 车站离这里远吗？
messages.en: Is the station far from here?

messages.speaker: David (当地居民)
messages.zh: 不远，走路只要五分钟。
messages.en: No, it's only a five-minute walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上两点相隔很远，用 bogħod 记“远与距离”，再把 mill-bogħod 整体记为“从远处”。

gloss_zh: 抵制；联合拒绝参与或购买

teaching_sense.en_definition: A deliberate refusal to buy from, use, or participate in something as a form of protest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为表达抗议而有意拒绝购买、使用某种商品或服务，或拒绝参加某项活动的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rifjut intenzjonat li wieħed jixtri, juża servizz jew jieħu sehem f'attività bħala forma ta' protesta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抵制；为抗议而拒绝购买、使用或参与的行动。

formal.mt: L-għaqda ħabbret bojkott tal-prodotti tal-kumpanija bħala protesta kontra ż-żieda fil-prezzijiet.
formal.en: The association announced a boycott of the company's products in protest against the price increases.
formal.zh: 该协会宣布抵制这家公司的产品，以抗议涨价。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex m'intix tixtri minn dak il-ħanut? Daniel: Qed nieħu sehem fil-bojkott minħabba l-mod kif jittrattaw lill-ħaddiema.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why aren't you buying from that shop? Daniel: I'm taking part in the boycott because of how they treat the workers.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你为什么不在那家店买东西了？丹尼尔：因为他们对待员工的方式，我正在参与抵制。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex m'intix tixtri minn dak il-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex m'intix tixtri minn dak il-ħanut?
messages.zh: 你为什么不在那家店买东西了？
messages.en: Why aren't you buying from that shop?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nieħu sehem fil-bojkott minħabba l-mod kif jittrattaw lill-ħaddiema.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nieħu sehem fil-bojkott minħabba l-mod kif jittrattaw lill-ħaddiema.
messages.zh: 因为他们对待员工的方式，我正在参与抵制。
messages.en: I'm taking part in the boycott because of how they treat the workers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bojkott 和英语 boycott 并排作拼写对照，配上“为抗议而不买、不用、不参加”的行动画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fastening used to secure a belt or strap; also a clip used to hold hair in place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于扣紧腰带或带子的搭扣；也指固定头发的发夹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa li tintuża biex tagħlaq ċinturin jew ċinga; ukoll biċċa li żżomm ix-xagħar f'postu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 搭扣；用于扣紧腰带或带子的扣件。
发夹；用来夹住并固定头发的饰物或夹具。

formal.mt: Qabel ma juża ċ-ċinturin, l-utent għandu jiċċekkja li l-bokkla tagħlaq sew.
formal.en: Before using the belt, the user should check that the buckle fastens securely.
formal.zh: 使用腰带前，使用者应检查搭扣是否扣牢。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Rajt il-bokkla tax-xagħar tiegħi? Rita: Iva, qiegħda ħdejn il-mera. Dik il-ħamra, hux?
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you seen my hairclip? Rita: Yes, it's beside the mirror. The red one, right?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你看见我的发夹了吗？丽塔：看见了，在镜子旁边。是那个红色的，对吧？

messages.speaker: Anna (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你看见我的发夹了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen my hairclip?

messages.speaker: Rita (妹妹)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħda ħdejn il-mera. Dik il-ħamra, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħda ħdejn il-mera. Dik il-ħamra, hux?
messages.zh: 看见了，在镜子旁边。是那个红色的，对吧？
messages.en: Yes, it's beside the mirror. The red one, right?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“固定住东西”串联 bokkla 的两幅画面：腰带上扣住的搭扣，以及头发上夹住的发夹。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The early part of the morning; also, getting up early in the saying 'il-bokra ssewwi ż-żokra'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指清晨；在谚语 il-bokra ssewwi ż-żokra 中，也表示早起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħin bikri ta' filgħodu; fil-qawl 'il-bokra ssewwi ż-żokra', tfisser ukoll li wieħed iqum kmieni.

sense_translations.en_definition: waking up early (only attested in the saying 'il-bokra ssewwi ż-żokra')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 早起；此义仅见于谚语 il-bokra ssewwi ż-żokra。
清晨；一大早。

collocations.en: getting up early does you good

formal.mt: Il-qawl 'il-bokra ssewwi ż-żokra' ifaħħar id-drawwa li wieħed iqum kmieni.
formal.en: The saying 'il-bokra ssewwi ż-żokra' praises the habit of getting up early.
formal.zh: 谚语 il-bokra ssewwi ż-żokra 赞扬早起的习惯。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'bokra' f'dan il-qawl? Pawlu: Tfisser li tqum kmieni; il-qawl jgħid li dan jagħmillek il-ġid.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'bokra' mean in this saying? Pawlu: It means getting up early; the saying says that this does you good.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句谚语里的 bokra 是什么意思？保罗：指早起；这句谚语说早起对人有益。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这句谚语里的 bokra 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'bokra' mean in this saying?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li tqum kmieni; il-qawl jgħid li dan jagħmillek il-ġid.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li tqum kmieni; il-qawl jgħid li dan jagħmillek il-ġid.
messages.zh: 指早起；这句谚语说早起对人有益。
messages.en: It means getting up early; the saying says that this does you good.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bokra 连到清晨起床的画面，再整句记住早起谚语；表示“早起”时不要脱离该谚语随意套用。

gloss_zh: 衰老；趋于老迈；变得老糊涂

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow old, especially to become very old or develop the mental confusion associated with senility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指逐渐衰老，尤其是变得老迈，或出现老年时的糊涂状态；涉及认知衰退时措辞须留意语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jixjieħ, speċjalment li jsir xiħ ħafna jew jibda jitlef iċ-ċarezza tal-ħsieb fi xjuħitu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衰老；逐渐变老。
渐入老迈之年；趋于年老糊涂的状态。
变得老糊涂；出现老年性认知衰退。

collocations.en: he became senile in his old age

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-verb 'boloq' jiddeskrivi raġel li xjieħ ħafna u beda jinsa ta' spiss.
formal.en: In the story, the verb 'boloq' describes a man who grew very old and began to forget things frequently.
formal.zh: 在这篇故事中，动词 boloq 描写一个变得十分老迈、开始经常忘事的男人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser 'boloq' hawn? Mark: Li r-raġel xjieħ ħafna; hawn jissuġġerixxi wkoll li beda jinsa.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'boloq' mean here? Mark: That the man grew very old; here it also suggests that he began to forget things.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里的 boloq 是什么意思？马克：说这个男人变得很老迈；这里还暗示他开始忘事。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 这里的 boloq 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'boloq' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Li r-raġel xjieħ ħafna; hawn jissuġġerixxi wkoll li beda jinsa.
messages.mt_standard: Li r-raġel xjieħ ħafna; hawn jissuġġerixxi wkoll li beda jinsa.
messages.zh: 说这个男人变得很老迈；这里还暗示他开始忘事。
messages.en: That the man grew very old; here it also suggests that he began to forget things.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“变老、老迈、老糊涂”三张递进词卡记 boloq 的义项；具体落在哪一层，要看上下文。

gloss_zh: 炸弹；爆竹；大圆物；突如其来的消息

teaching_sense.en_definition: An explosive device such as a bomb or petard; also a large round object or a piece of unexpected news.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指炸弹、爆竹等爆炸物，也可指体积很大的圆形物体，或突如其来、令人吃惊的消息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett splussiv, bħal bomba jew murtal; tista' tfisser ukoll oġġett kbir u tond jew aħbar mhux mistennija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 炸弹。
炸弹；爆竹或小型爆炸装置。
任何体积很大的圆形物体。
突如其来的消息；令人吃惊的消息。

collocations.en: news that comes as a bombshell
collocations.zh: 如重磅炸弹般令人震惊的消息

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jikkonferma li nstabet bomba mhux sploduta qrib il-port.
formal.en: The report confirms that an unexploded bomb was found near the harbour.
formal.zh: 报告证实，港口附近发现了一枚未爆炸的炸弹。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi aħbar bħal bomba: se niżżewweġ! Nina: Tassew? Din ma stennejthiex! Prosit!
colloquial.en: Lara: I've got some bombshell news: I'm getting married! Nina: Really? I wasn't expecting that! Congratulations!
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我有个重磅消息：我要结婚了！妮娜：真的？完全没想到！恭喜！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi aħbar bħal bomba: se niżżewweġ!
messages.mt_standard: Għandi aħbar bħal bomba: se niżżewweġ!
messages.zh: 我有个重磅消息：我要结婚了！
messages.en: I've got some bombshell news: I'm getting married!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 真的？完全没想到！恭喜！
messages.en: Really? I wasn't expecting that! Congratulations!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bomba 画成四格词义卡：炸弹、爆竹、大圆物、重磅消息；这些画面帮助分义，不代表词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A greeting used when meeting or addressing someone in the evening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 傍晚或晚上见面、向人打招呼时使用的问候语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tislima li tintuża filgħaxija meta tiltaqa' ma' xi ħadd jew tindirizza lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 晚上好；晚间见面时的问候语。

formal.mt: Bonasira lil kulħadd, u merħba għal-laqgħa tagħna.
formal.en: Good evening, everyone, and welcome to our meeting.
formal.zh: 大家晚上好，欢迎参加我们的会议。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Bonasira, Ġorġ! Kif int? Ġorġ: Bonasira, Anna! Tajjeb, grazzi. U int?
colloquial.en: Anna: Good evening, Ġorġ! How are you? Ġorġ: Good evening, Anna! I'm well, thank you. And you?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：乔治，晚上好！你好吗？乔治：安娜，晚上好！我很好，谢谢。你呢？

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 乔治，晚上好！你好吗？
messages.en: Good evening, Ġorġ! How are you?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Bonasira, Anna! Tajjeb, grazzi. U int?
messages.mt_standard: Bonasira, Anna! Tajjeb, grazzi. U int?
messages.zh: 安娜，晚上好！我很好，谢谢。你呢？
messages.en: Good evening, Anna! I'm well, thank you. And you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象傍晚在门口遇到邻居，开口先说这个词，把它牢牢记作见面时的晚上好。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The stem of a plant; in a separate sense, a spear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物的茎；另一个独立义项指矛，须由语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iz-zokk ta' pjanta; f'tifsira oħra, lanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 植物的茎。
矛；长矛。
茎；植物的茎部。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa, il-bont tal-pjanta jidher bejn l-għeruq u l-weraq.
formal.en: In the picture, the stem of the plant is visible between the roots and the leaves.
formal.zh: 图中可以看到，植物的茎位于根与叶之间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-parti hija l-bont tal-pjanta? Toni: Iva, dan il-bont irqiq; dawn il-partijiet ħodor huma l-weraq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this part the stem of the plant? Toni: Yes, this thin stem; these green parts are the leaves.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这一部分是植物的茎吗？托尼：对，就是这根细茎；这些绿色的部分是叶子。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这一部分是植物的茎吗？
messages.en: Is this part the stem of the plant?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan il-bont irqiq; dawn il-partijiet ħodor huma l-weraq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan il-bont irqiq; dawn il-partijiet ħodor huma l-weraq.
messages.zh: 对，就是这根细茎；这些绿色的部分是叶子。
messages.en: Yes, this thin stem; these green parts are the leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 bont 准备两张独立图片：植物细茎和一支长矛。把图片并列记忆，遇到句子再用语境选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A greeting used to wish someone a good morning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 早晨见面时使用的问候语，相当于“早上好”或“早安”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tislima li tintuża filgħodu biex issellem lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示“早上好”的问候语。
早上好；早安。

formal.mt: Bonġu lil kulħadd. Il-laqgħa tal-lum tibda fid-disgħa.
formal.en: Good morning, everyone. Today's meeting begins at nine.
formal.zh: 大家早上好。今天的会议九点开始。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Bonġu, Mark! Kif int? Mark: Bonġu! Tajjeb, grazzi. U int?
colloquial.en: Anna: Good morning, Mark! How are you? Mark: Good morning! I'm well, thanks. And you?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克，早上好！你好吗？马克：早上好！我很好，谢谢。你呢？

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 马克，早上好！你好吗？
messages.en: Good morning, Mark! How are you?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 早上好！我很好，谢谢。你呢？
messages.en: Good morning! I'm well, thanks. And you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Bonġu 贴在早晨开门见邻居的画面上，练习“问候加姓名”，再接 Kif int? 形成完整寒暄。

gloss_zh: 无知的、头脑空空的（贬义）；胖乎乎的人；对狗的爱称

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ignorant or empty-headed, used as a derogatory description of a person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人无知、头脑空空，带贬损意味；须与“胖乎乎的人”和“对狗的爱称”两个名词义分开理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun injorant jew moħħu vojt; deskrizzjoni offensiva ta' persuna.

sense_translations.en_definition: Xahadd injorant li m ghandu mohhu iktar vojt mil priministru tan nazzjonalisti
sense_translations.zh_definition: 无知、头脑空空的；原释义含有拿国民党总理作比较的政治性贬损。
一个胖乎乎的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: A term of endearment for dogs.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对狗使用的亲昵称呼。

collocations.mt: 'boqni' bħala kelma ta' għożża għal kelb
collocations.en: 'boqni' used as a term of endearment for a dog
collocations.zh: 用作对狗的爱称的 boqni

formal.mt: Meta 'boqni' jintuża bħala aġġettiv bit-tifsira ta' 'injorant', għandu sens offensiv.
formal.en: When 'boqni' is used as an adjective meaning 'ignorant', it has an offensive sense.
formal.zh: 当 boqni 用作表示“无知的”的形容词时，它具有冒犯意味。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed issejjaħ lill-kelb 'Boqni'? Pawlu: Qed nużaha bħala kelma ta' għożża, mhux biex ngħid li hu injorant.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you calling the dog 'Boqni'? Pawlu: I'm using it as a term of endearment, not to say that he's ignorant.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你为什么叫这只狗 Boqni？保罗：我把它当作爱称用，并不是说它无知。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么叫这只狗 Boqni？
messages.en: Why are you calling the dog 'Boqni'?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nużaha bħala kelma ta' għożża, mhux biex ngħid li hu injorant.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nużaha bħala kelma ta' għożża, mhux biex ngħid li hu injorant.
messages.zh: 我把它当作爱称用，并不是说它无知。
messages.en: I'm using it as a term of endearment, not to say that he's ignorant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 boqni 时分成三张卡：贬义形容词、胖乎乎的人、狗的爱称。先看词性和对象，再判断语气。

gloss_zh: 一口液体；一小口；一大口

teaching_sense.en_definition: An amount of liquid taken into the mouth or swallowed at once, ranging from a sip to a swig or gulp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次含入口中或咽下的一口液体；可指一小口，也可指一大口，具体量和喝法由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont ta' likwidu li wieħed jieħu f'ħalqu jew jibla' f'daqqa, kemm jekk ikun ftit kif ukoll jekk ikun ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小口液体；轻啜的一口。
一大口饮料；畅饮的一口。
一大口；一下咽下的一口液体。

sense_translations.en_definition: a mouthful of, draft (of a liquid)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一口液体；一次饮下的量。

collocations.en: a sip or mouthful of water
a sip or swig of wine

formal.mt: Qabel beda d-diskors, il-kelliem ħa boqqa ilma.
formal.en: Before beginning the speech, the speaker took a sip of water.
formal.zh: 开始演讲前，发言人喝了一口水。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nieħu boqqa ilma? Mark: Żgur, ħu boqqa. Il-flixkun qiegħed fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I have a sip of water? Mark: Of course, take a sip. The bottle is on the table.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我能喝口水吗？马克：当然，喝一口吧。水瓶在桌上。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我能喝口水吗？
messages.en: Can I have a sip of water?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, ħu boqqa. Il-flixkun qiegħed fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, ħu boqqa. Il-flixkun qiegħed fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 当然，喝一口吧。水瓶在桌上。
messages.en: Of course, take a sip. The bottle is on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 boqqa 记成喝水时的“一口”：小啜或大口都可能，先抓住一次入口的量，再由情境判断大小。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money used to pay for things or kept for future spending.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于支付物品或服务，或留待以后花用的钱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flus li jintużaw biex tħallas għal affarijiet jew li jinżammu għal spejjeż fil-futur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钱；钱财。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, iż-żagħżugħ ifaddal ftit boqxiex kull ġimgħa biex jixtri ktieb.
formal.en: In the story, the young man saves a little money each week to buy a book.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个年轻人每周存一点钱，为的是买一本书。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Għandek ftit boqxiex għall-kafè? Lara: Iva, illum inħallas jien. Toni: Grazzi! Id-darba li jmiss inħallas jien.
colloquial.en: Toni: Have you got a little money for coffee? Lara: Yes, I'll pay today. Toni: Thanks! I'll pay next time.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：你有点钱喝咖啡吗？拉拉：有，今天我来付。托尼：谢谢！下次我来付。

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有点钱喝咖啡吗？
messages.en: Have you got a little money for coffee?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，今天我来付。
messages.en: Yes, I'll pay today.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi! Id-darba li jmiss inħallas jien.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi! Id-darba li jmiss inħallas jien.
messages.zh: 谢谢！下次我来付。
messages.en: Thanks! I'll pay next time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进买咖啡前摸钱包的画面，连同一点钱和挣钱两个搭配一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A duck, especially a wild duck; also used figuratively for a lazy person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸭，尤指野鸭；也可比喻懒惰的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Papra, speċjalment waħda selvaġġa; tintuża wkoll b'mod figurattiv għal persuna għażżiena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 野鸭。
鸭。
懒人；懒惰的人。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, l-istudenti raw borka tgħum fl-għadira.
formal.en: During the birdwatching session, the students saw a duck swimming in the pond.
formal.zh: 观鸟时，学生们看到一只鸭在池塘里游泳。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dik il-borka fl-ilma! Mark: Rajtha! Qed tgħum lejn ix-xatt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that duck in the water! Mark: I see it! It's swimming towards the shore.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看水里的那只鸭！Mark：看到了！它正往岸边游。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看水里的那只鸭！
messages.en: Look at that duck in the water!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了！它正往岸边游。
messages.en: I see it! It's swimming towards the shore.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 borka 配上一张池塘野鸭图来记；另画一个赖着不动的人，提醒自己它也有“懒人”的比喻义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pot or saucepan used for cooking food; also a scheme or intrigue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于烹煮食物的锅或炖锅；也指阴谋或暗中策划。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li jintuża biex jissajjar l-ikel; tista' tfisser ukoll intriċċ jew komplott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烹饪用的锅。
深底烹饪锅；炖锅。
阴谋；暗中进行的策划。

formal.mt: Poġġi l-ħaxix fil-borma, żid l-ilma u sajjar fuq nar baxx.
formal.en: Put the vegetables in the pot, add water and cook over low heat.
formal.zh: 把蔬菜放进锅里，加水后用小火烹煮。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hi l-borma l-kbira? Pawlu: Fil-kexxun ta' taħt, ħdejn l-għatu tagħha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where's the big pot? Pawlu: In the bottom drawer, next to its lid.
colloquial.zh: Sara：大锅在哪儿？Pawlu：在最下面的抽屉里，旁边就是它的锅盖。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 大锅在哪儿？
messages.en: Where's the big pot?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kexxun ta' taħt, ħdejn l-għatu tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kexxun ta' taħt, ħdejn l-għatu tagħha.
messages.zh: 在最下面的抽屉里，旁边就是它的锅盖。
messages.en: In the bottom drawer, next to its lid.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 borma 想成灶台上一口带盖的汤锅，连记“锅、锅盖、一锅汤”；再用“暗中酝酿阴谋”的画面辅助记住抽象义。

gloss_zh: 博尔姆拉（科斯皮夸，马耳他城市名）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bormla, known in English as Cospicua, a city in Malta and one of the Three Cities in the harbour area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 博尔姆拉，英语称 Cospicua，是马耳他港区“三城”之一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Belt f'Malta, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala Cospicua, u waħda mit-Tliet Ibliet fiż-żona tal-port.

sense_translations.en_definition: Cospiqua. A city in Malta, one of the Three Cities in the Harbour Area
sense_translations.zh_definition: 博尔姆拉，又称科斯皮夸；马耳他的一座城市，属于港区“三城”之一。

sense_translations.en_definition: Cospicua (a city and local council of the Port Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 科斯皮夸：马耳他港口区的一座城市及其地方议会辖区，马耳他语名为 Bormla。

formal.mt: Il-programm taż-żjara jinkludi mixja f'Bormla, waħda mit-Tliet Ibliet.
formal.en: The visit programme includes a walk in Cospicua, one of the Three Cities.
formal.zh: 参观行程包括在“三城”之一的博尔姆拉步行游览。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid immorru Bormla għada? David: Iva, nagħmlu mixja u nieħdu kafè hemm.
colloquial.en: Nina: Shall we go to Cospicua tomorrow? David: Yes, let's go for a walk and have a coffee there.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们明天去博尔姆拉好吗？David：好啊，去散散步，再在那里喝杯咖啡。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天去博尔姆拉好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go to Cospicua tomorrow?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nagħmlu mixja u nieħdu kafè hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nagħmlu mixja u nieħdu kafè hemm.
messages.zh: 好啊，去散散步，再在那里喝杯咖啡。
messages.en: Yes, let's go for a walk and have a coffee there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Bormla 和 Cospicua 写在同一张城市卡片的两面，再标上“马耳他三城之一”，记住这是同一地点的两个名称。

gloss_zh: 胎膜（出生时覆盖婴儿头部的薄膜）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thin membrane that sometimes covers a baby's head or face at birth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 婴儿出生时有时仍覆盖在头部或面部的一层薄胎膜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Membrana rqiqa li kultant tkun għadha tgħatti ras jew wiċċ tarbija mat-twelid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胎膜，尤指出生时仍覆盖婴儿头部或面部的一层薄膜。

collocations.en: to be born with a caul

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-kelma borqom tirreferi għal membrana rqiqa li tista' tgħatti ras tarbija mat-twelid.
formal.en: In the text, the word borqom refers to a thin membrane that may cover a baby's head at birth.
formal.zh: 在这篇文章中，borqom 指婴儿出生时可能覆盖其头部的一层薄胎膜。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser il-kelma borqom hawn? Marija: Membrana rqiqa li kultant tgħatti ras tarbija meta titwieled.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the word borqom mean here? Marija: A thin membrane that sometimes covers a baby's head when it is born.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的 borqom 是什么意思？Marija：就是婴儿出生时有时覆盖在头部的一层薄胎膜。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 borqom 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word borqom mean here?

messages.speaker: Marija (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Membrana rqiqa li kultant tgħatti ras tarbija meta titwieled.
messages.mt_standard: Membrana rqiqa li kultant tgħatti ras tarbija meta titwieled.
messages.zh: 就是婴儿出生时有时覆盖在头部的一层薄胎膜。
messages.en: A thin membrane that sometimes covers a baby's head when it is born.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“新生儿头上覆着一层透明薄纱”的示意图记 borqom；重点记住它是薄膜，不是帽子或衣物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Snow or sleet falling from the sky, or snow lying on the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从天空降下的雪或雨夹雪，也可指地面积雪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Preċipitazzjoni fil-forma ta' snowflakes jew taħlita ta' xita u silġ; ukoll il-borra li tibqa' fuq l-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雪；积雪。
雨夹雪。
雪；雨夹雪。

formal.mt: Wara lejl ta' borra, it-toroq tar-raħal kienu miksija b'saff abjad.
formal.en: After a night of snow, the village roads were covered with a white layer.
formal.zh: 下了一夜雪后，村里的道路覆盖着一层白雪。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ara kemm hemm borra barra! Leo: Ejja nilbsu l-kowtijiet u noħorġu nilagħbu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Look how much snow there is outside! Leo: Let's put on our coats and go out to play.
colloquial.zh: Anna：看外面的雪有多厚！Leo：我们穿上外套，出去玩吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (姐姐)
messages.zh: 看外面的雪有多厚！
messages.en: Look how much snow there is outside!

messages.speaker: Leo (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nilbsu l-kowtijiet u noħorġu nilagħbu.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nilbsu l-kowtijiet u noħorġu nilagħbu.
messages.zh: 我们穿上外套，出去玩吧。
messages.en: Let's put on our coats and go out to play.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 borra 写在一片白雪的图片上，再在旁边画雨滴夹着雪花，连记“雪”和“雨夹雪”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A figure shaped like a person and made from snow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用雪堆成的人形，即雪人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Figura magħmula mill-borra li jkollha sura ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雪人；用雪堆成的人形。

collocations.en: a snowman with a carrot nose
collocations.zh: 长着胡萝卜鼻子的雪人

formal.mt: L-istudenti għamlu borrinu fil-bitħa u żejnuh b'xalpa ħamra.
formal.en: The students made a snowman in the yard and decorated it with a red scarf.
formal.zh: 学生们在院子里堆了一个雪人，并给它围上红围巾。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Nagħmlu borrinu? Rita: Iva! Jien inġib karrotta għall-imnieħer.
colloquial.en: Ben: Shall we make a snowman? Rita: Yes! I'll get a carrot for the nose.
colloquial.zh: Ben：我们堆个雪人好吗？Rita：好啊！我去拿根胡萝卜当鼻子。

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们堆个雪人好吗？
messages.en: Shall we make a snowman?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 好啊！我去拿根胡萝卜当鼻子。
messages.en: Yes! I'll get a carrot for the nose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 borra“雪”和 borrinu“雪人”并排做图片卡：一边是散落的雪，一边是围着围巾的雪人，只作词义联想来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A heap or pile of things gathered together; in a separate sense, a tower.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指聚集或堆叠在一起的一堆东西；另一个独立义项为塔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd ta' affarijiet miġbura jew imqiegħda fuq xulxin; f'tifsira oħra, torri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 堆；堆积在一起的东西。
一堆；一摞。
塔；塔楼。
堆；一堆或一摞东西。

formal.mt: Wara t-tindif tas-sit, il-ħaddiema ġabru l-ġebel f'borġ wieħed.
formal.en: After cleaning the site, the workers gathered the stones into a single heap.
formal.zh: 清理场地后，工人们把石头集中成一堆。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn qiegħed il-ktieb tiegħi? Toni: Taħt dak il-borġ kotba fuq il-mejda. Sara: Sibtu, grazzi!
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is my book? Toni: Under that pile of books on the table. Sara: Found it, thanks!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我的书在哪里？托尼：在桌上那摞书下面。萨拉：找到了，谢谢！

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 我的书在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my book?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħt dak il-borġ kotba fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Taħt dak il-borġ kotba fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 在桌上那摞书下面。
messages.en: Under that pile of books on the table.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 找到了，谢谢！
messages.en: Found it, thanks!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上一摞书、地上一堆石头，都可配 borġ；另用塔的图片记住独立义项，避免见到就只译“一堆”。

gloss_zh: 袋；纸袋；小袋；钱包；证券交易所；股市；钱；阴囊

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bag or pouch used to hold or carry things, including a paper bag or purse; the word also has financial and anatomical senses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于装东西或携带物品的袋子、小袋，也可指纸袋或钱包；另有证券交易所、股市、钱及阴囊等义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jintuża biex jinżammu jew jinġarru l-affarijiet, bħal borża tal-karti jew tal-flus; il-kelma għandha wkoll tifsiriet finanzjarji u anatomiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纸袋。
小袋；袋囊。
证券交易所。
袋子；提袋。
钱包；钱袋；袋子。
股票市场；股市。
钱；金钱。
阴囊。

formal.mt: Il-klijenti huma mitluba jġibu borża magħhom biex iġorru x-xiri.
formal.en: Customers are asked to bring a bag with them to carry their shopping.
formal.zh: 请顾客自带袋子，以便携带所购物品。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tagħtini borża, jekk jogħġbok? Lara: Żgur. Trid waħda tal-karti?
colloquial.en: Mark: Could you give me a bag, please? Lara: Of course. Would you like a paper one?
colloquial.zh: Mark：请给我一个袋子，好吗？Lara：当然。要纸袋吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我一个袋子，好吗？
messages.en: Could you give me a bag, please?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.zh: 当然。要纸袋吗？
messages.en: Of course. Would you like a paper one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用购物袋记 borża，再做三组语境卡：装物的袋与钱包、金融中的交易所与股市及钱、解剖学中的阴囊；靠上下文选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of land covered with trees, such as a wood or forest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长有大片树木的地方，即树林或森林。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda art miksija bis-siġar, li tista' tkun żgħira jew kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 树林；这里指成片生长树木的地方。
树林；森林。

formal.mt: Il-mogħdija tgħaddi minn bosk dens u twassal għal wied.
formal.en: The path passes through a dense forest and leads to a valley.
formal.zh: 这条小径穿过茂密的森林，通往一处山谷。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Immorru nimxu fil-bosk illum? Toni: Iva, imma ejja nibqgħu fuq il-mogħdija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we go for a walk in the woods today? Toni: Yes, but let's stay on the path.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们今天去树林里散步好吗？Toni：好啊，不过我们沿着小径走吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们今天去树林里散步好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go for a walk in the woods today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ejja nibqgħu fuq il-mogħdija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ejja nibqgħu fuq il-mogħdija.
messages.zh: 好啊，不过我们沿着小径走吧。
messages.en: Yes, but let's stay on the path.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bosk 配成“一条小径穿过许多树”的画面，连记 fil-bosk“在树林里”；这里的英语 wood 要按树林理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes a large number or amount of people or things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示人或事物的数量很多，可理解为“许多”或“大量”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika għadd kbir jew kwantità kbira ta' nies jew affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 很多；充足的数量。
各种各样的；多种的。
许多的；大量的。

formal.mt: Bosta studenti ħadu sehem fil-proġett u ppreżentaw ix-xogħol tagħhom lill-għalliema.
formal.en: Many students took part in the project and presented their work to the teachers.
formal.zh: 许多学生参与了这个项目，并向老师们展示了自己的作品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kien hemm ħafna nies fis-suq? Mark: Iva, kien hemm bosta nies, u domna nistennew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Were there many people at the market? Mark: Yes, there were lots of people, and we waited a long time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：市场里人多吗？马克：是啊，有很多人，我们等了很久。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 市场里人多吗？
messages.en: Were there many people at the market?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien hemm bosta nies, u domna nistennew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien hemm bosta nies, u domna nistennew.
messages.zh: 是啊，有很多人，我们等了很久。
messages.en: Yes, there were lots of people, and we waited a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bosta nies 想成市场里密密麻麻的人群，再用 bosta drabi 联想到反复发生的许多次，就能记住“数量多”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pistachio tree or its fruit; the word can refer to either.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开心果树或这种树的果实；具体指树还是果实，要根据上下文判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġra tal-pistaċċi jew il-frott tagħha, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.en_definition: pistachio (used both of the tree and its fruit)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 开心果；也指开心果树，既可用于树木，也可用于其果实。
开心果树；开心果。
肚子；腹部。

collocations.en: the fruit of the pistachio tree

formal.mt: Fil-pjan tal-ġnien, ġie propost li titħawwel siġra tal-botna ħdejn il-ħajt tan-nofsinhar.
formal.en: The garden plan proposed planting a pistachio tree beside the southern wall.
formal.zh: 花园规划提出在南侧围墙旁种植一棵开心果树。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandkom siġra tal-botna għall-bejgħ? Pawlu: Iva, għandna waħda żgħira ħdejn id-daħla.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a pistachio tree for sale? Pawlu: Yes, we have a small one near the entrance.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你们有开心果树出售吗？保罗：有，我们在入口旁有一棵小的。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们有开心果树出售吗？
messages.en: Do you have a pistachio tree for sale?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (苗圃店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna waħda żgħira ħdejn id-daħla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna waħda żgħira ħdejn id-daħla.
messages.zh: 有，我们在入口旁有一棵小的。
messages.en: Yes, we have a small one near the entrance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 botna 做两张记忆卡：植物卡画开心果树和果实，身体卡画肚子。两种意思分别记，再靠句子里的场景判断。

gloss_zh: 矮胖的；身材矮而圆胖的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Short in height and stout or round in build.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容身高较矮、体形圆胖的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu statura qasira u ġisem imlaħħam u tond.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 矮胖的；个子较矮而体态圆胖的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru ewlieni huwa raġel botni li jilbes kappell kbir.
formal.en: In the story, the main character is a short, portly man who wears a large hat.
formal.zh: 故事中的主角是一个戴着大帽子的矮胖男人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Liema hu s-sajjied fl-istampa? Adam: Ir-raġel botni bil-kappell blu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which one is the fisherman in the picture? Adam: The short, portly man with the blue hat.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：图里哪一个是渔夫？亚当：那个戴蓝帽子的矮胖男人。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 图里哪一个是渔夫？
messages.en: Which one is the fisherman in the picture?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.zh: 那个戴蓝帽子的矮胖男人。
messages.en: The short, portly man with the blue hat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象绘本里一个个子矮、身形圆的角色，把 botni 和这幅轮廓一起记；意思同时包含“矮”和“胖”。

gloss_zh: 一窝幼兽；一窝幼雏；一茬收成；腹部；子宫

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of young animals born together, especially a litter of rabbits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 同一胎出生的一窝幼兽，尤其用于一窝小兔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' frieħ imwielda flimkien, speċjalment frieħ tal-fniek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一窝同胎出生的幼兽，例如一窝小兔。
同一窝的幼雏或幼崽。
一窝幼兽；尤指一窝小兔。

sense_translations.en_definition: crop, harvest (produce of each period of sowing/blooming)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一茬作物或收成；某一轮播种或开花所产生的收获。
肚子；腹部；子宫。

formal.mt: Fir-reġistru tar-razzett ġie nnutat li l-boton il-ġdid kien fih sitt ifrieħ.
formal.en: The farm register recorded that the new litter contained six young animals.
formal.zh: 农场登记簿记载，新出生的这一窝共有六只幼崽。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm hemm fniek fil-boton il-ġdid? Toni: Hemm ħamsa, u kollha qegħdin ħdejn ommhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: How many rabbits are in the new litter? Toni: There are five, and they are all beside their mother.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：新生的这一窝有几只小兔？托尼：有五只，全都在妈妈身旁。

messages.speaker: Sara (农场访客)
messages.zh: 新生的这一窝有几只小兔？
messages.en: How many rabbits are in the new litter?

messages.speaker: Toni (养兔人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ħamsa, u kollha qegħdin ħdejn ommhom.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ħamsa, u kollha qegħdin ħdejn ommhom.
messages.zh: 有五只，全都在妈妈身旁。
messages.en: There are five, and they are all beside their mother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用一窝挤在母兔旁的小兔记 boton 的常用义；再另列“幼雏、当季收成、腹部或子宫”义项卡，靠上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pointed remark that hints at something or mocks or offends someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有针对性的话语，可以是在暗示某事，也可以是在嘲讽或冒犯某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kumment li jalludi għal xi ħaġa jew li jwaqqa' lil xi ħadd għaċ-ċajt jew joffendih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘲讽；用来奚落或挑衅别人的话。
暗示；不直接说破而让人领会的话。
冒犯性的话；使人感到受辱或不快的评论。

formal.mt: Fil-laqgħa, il-kumment dwar id-dewmien ġie interpretat bħala botta indiretta lejn il-maniġer.
formal.en: At the meeting, the comment about the delay was interpreted as an indirect dig at the manager.
formal.zh: 会议上，那句关于延误的评论被理解为对经理的间接讽刺。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik kienet botta għalija? Mark: Le, kont qed nitkellem dwar is-sitwazzjoni b'mod ġenerali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was that a dig at me? Mark: No, I was talking about the situation in general.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那句话是在讽刺我吗？马克：不是，我是在笼统地说这个情况。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 那句话是在讽刺我吗？
messages.en: Was that a dig at me?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kont qed nitkellem dwar is-sitwazzjoni b'mod ġenerali.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kont qed nitkellem dwar is-sitwazzjoni b'mod ġenerali.
messages.zh: 不是，我是在笼统地说这个情况。
messages.en: No, I was talking about the situation in general.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 botta 想成一句“话里有话”：轻一些是暗示，带刺时是嘲讽，过分时会冒犯别人；具体语气看场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instrument used to find directions, such as north, south, east, and west.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来辨认东、南、西、北等方位的仪器，即指南针。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument li jintuża biex jinstabu d-direzzjonijiet, bħat-tramuntana, in-nofsinhar, il-lvant u l-punent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指南针；罗盘。
指南针；用于确定东、南、西、北等基本方位的仪器。
风向标；显示风向的装置。
门厅门；前厅处的门。

formal.mt: Qabel bdiet il-mixja, il-gwida użat boxxla biex tiddetermina d-direzzjoni tat-tramuntana.
formal.en: Before the walk began, the guide used a compass to determine the direction of north.
formal.zh: 徒步开始前，向导用指南针确定了北方的位置。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek il-boxxla miegħek? Pawlu: Iva, qiegħda fil-but. Ejja naraw fejn hi t-tramuntana.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have the compass with you? Pawlu: Yes, it is in my pocket. Let's see which way is north.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你带指南针了吗？保罗：带了，在我口袋里。我们看看哪边是北。

messages.speaker: Lara (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 你带指南针了吗？
messages.en: Do you have the compass with you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħda fil-but. Ejja naraw fejn hi t-tramuntana.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħda fil-but. Ejja naraw fejn hi t-tramuntana.
messages.zh: 带了，在我口袋里。我们看看哪边是北。
messages.en: Yes, it is in my pocket. Let's see which way is north.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 boxxla 配三幅独立小图：手中的指南针、屋顶的风向标、入口的门厅门。先牢牢记住指南针，再分图复习其他义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part of an electric lamp that produces light and can be replaced.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 电灯中产生光、通常可以更换的部件，即灯泡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' lampa elettrika li tagħti d-dawl u li tista' tinbidel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灯泡；电灯的发光部件。
灯泡。
电灯泡。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-manutenzjoni jindika li l-bozza fil-kuritur trid tinbidel.
formal.en: The maintenance report indicates that the light bulb in the corridor needs to be replaced.
formal.zh: 维修报告指出，走廊里的灯泡需要更换。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-lampa ma tixgħelx? Adam: Il-bozza maħruqa. Għandna waħda oħra fil-kexxun.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why won't the lamp turn on? Adam: The bulb is burnt out. We have another one in the drawer.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这盏灯怎么不亮？亚当：灯泡烧坏了。抽屉里还有一个。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 这盏灯怎么不亮？
messages.en: Why won't the lamp turn on?

messages.speaker: Adam (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bozza maħruqa. Għandna waħda oħra fil-kexxun.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bozza maħruqa. Għandna waħda oħra fil-kexxun.
messages.zh: 灯泡烧坏了。抽屉里还有一个。
messages.en: The bulb is burnt out. We have another one in the drawer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象台灯突然熄灭，你从抽屉取出一只 bozza 来更换。把“取灯泡、换灯泡、灯亮了”连成一个记忆场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a rounded, full body; plump.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容身体圆润、丰满或胖乎乎的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ġisem mimli u tond, xi ftit oħxon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 丰满的；圆胖的；胖乎乎的。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa jidher qattus boċni rieqed fuq siġġu.
formal.en: The picture shows a plump cat sleeping on a chair.
formal.zh: 图片中，一只胖乎乎的猫正睡在椅子上。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dak il-qattus boċni! Luqa: Iva, dejjem jiġi jorqod hawn fix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at that plump cat! Luqa: Yes, it always comes to sleep here in the sun.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看那只胖乎乎的猫！卢卡：是啊，它总来这里晒着太阳睡觉。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 看那只胖乎乎的猫！
messages.en: Look at that plump cat!

messages.speaker: Luqa (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dejjem jiġi jorqod hawn fix-xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dejjem jiġi jorqod hawn fix-xemx.
messages.zh: 是啊，它总来这里晒着太阳睡觉。
messages.en: Yes, it always comes to sleep here in the sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 boċni 配上一只身体圆润的小猫，把“胖乎乎、丰满”的外形直接记成画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small spherical ball used as a marble, or a spherical object more generally.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于游戏的小圆球，即弹珠；也可泛指球形物体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ballun żgħir u tond li jintuża fil-logħob, jew oġġett b'forma ta' sfera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一颗弹珠；用于游戏的小圆球。
球体；球形物体。
圆的；呈球形的。
矮胖的；用于形容身材矮而丰满的人。
弹珠，指球形的小球。
睾丸，属于粗俗的身体部位称呼。
胖乎乎的人；对体态丰满者的称呼。

formal.mt: L-għalliema poġġiet boċċa tal-ħġieġ fuq il-mejda biex turi l-forma ta' sfera.
formal.en: The teacher placed a glass ball on the table to demonstrate the shape of a sphere.
formal.zh: 老师把一个玻璃球放在桌上，展示球体的形状。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fejn hi l-boċċa l-blu tiegħi? Toni: Qiegħda taħt is-siġġu. Ara, ħdejn is-sieq.
colloquial.en: Lina: Where is my blue marble? Toni: It's under the chair. Look, beside the leg.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：我的蓝色弹珠在哪里？托尼：在椅子下面。看，就在椅子腿旁边。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.zh: 我的蓝色弹珠在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my blue marble?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħda taħt is-siġġu. Ara, ħdejn is-sieq.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħda taħt is-siġġu. Ara, ħdejn is-sieq.
messages.zh: 在椅子下面。看，就在椅子腿旁边。
messages.en: It's under the chair. Look, beside the leg.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用一颗圆弹珠记住 boċċa 的核心画面，再分别记球体、矮胖和粗俗身体称呼等不同义项。

gloss_zh: 剩余部分；其余的人或物；找零

teaching_sense.en_definition: What remains after a part has been used, taken, or counted; also money returned as change after payment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一部分被使用、拿走或计数后剩下的部分；也指付款后找回的钱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li jibqa' wara li parti tkun intużat, ittieħdet jew ingħaddet; ukoll il-flus li jingħataw lura wara ħlas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剩余部分；余下的数量。
找零；付款后退回的余额。
其余的人或物；剩下的部分。
找回的钱；找零。

formal.mt: Wara l-preżentazzjoni, il-bqija tal-laqgħa ġiet iddedikata għall-mistoqsijiet tal-parteċipanti.
formal.en: After the presentation, the rest of the meeting was devoted to the participants' questions.
formal.zh: 报告结束后，会议余下的时间用于回答参与者的问题。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-ħobż jiswa żewġ ewro? Għandi ħames ewro. Toni: Iva. Hawn il-ħobż u tliet ewro bqija.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does the bread cost two euros? I have five euros. Toni: Yes. Here is the bread and three euros in change.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：面包是两欧元吗？我有五欧元。托尼：是的。这是面包，找你三欧元。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħobż jiswa żewġ ewro? Għandi ħames ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħobż jiswa żewġ ewro? Għandi ħames ewro.
messages.zh: 面包是两欧元吗？我有五欧元。
messages.en: Does the bread cost two euros? I have five euros.

messages.speaker: Toni (面包店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Hawn il-ħobż u tliet ewro bqija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Hawn il-ħobż u tliet ewro bqija.
messages.zh: 是的。这是面包，找你三欧元。
messages.en: Yes. Here is the bread and three euros in change.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“五欧元减去两欧元，还剩三欧元”记 bqija：普通场景是剩余部分，收银场景里就是找回的零钱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Jellyfish: soft-bodied sea animals that may sting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水母：身体柔软、部分种类会蜇人的海洋动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimali tal-baħar b'ġisem artab li jistgħu jniggżu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水母。

formal.mt: Minħabba l-preżenza ta' bram fil-bajja, l-għawwiema ġew avżati biex joqogħdu attenti.
formal.en: Because of the presence of jellyfish in the bay, swimmers were advised to be careful.
formal.zh: 由于海湾里有水母，游泳者被提醒要小心。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm bram fl-ilma? Mark: Iva, rajt ftit ħdejn ix-xatt. Ejja nibqgħu hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are there jellyfish in the water? Mark: Yes, I saw a few near the shore. Let's stay here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：水里有水母吗？马克：有，我在岸边看见了几只。我们就待在这里吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 水里有水母吗？
messages.en: Are there jellyfish in the water?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, rajt ftit ħdejn ix-xatt. Ejja nibqgħu hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, rajt ftit ħdejn ix-xatt. Ejja nibqgħu hawn.
messages.zh: 有，我在岸边看见了几只。我们就待在这里吧。
messages.en: Yes, I saw a few near the shore. Let's stay here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bram 和海边看见一群透明水母的画面绑定，再用 ħafna bram 记住“很多水母”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capable, clever, or skilful at an activity or subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人在某项活动或某个学科上有能力、聪明或技艺熟练。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħila, intelliġenza jew kapaċità tajba f'xi xogħol jew suġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有能力的；能干的。
聪明的；机灵的。
聪明的；有天分的；熟练的。

formal.mt: L-istudent huwa bravu fil-matematika u jsolvi problemi diffiċli b'mod ċar u preċiż.
formal.en: The student is good at mathematics and solves difficult problems clearly and accurately.
formal.zh: 这名学生擅长数学，解答难题时思路清楚、结果准确。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min jista' jgħinni b'dan l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Staqsi lil Pawlu. Hu bravu fil-matematika.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who can help me with this exercise? Mark: Ask Pawlu. He's good at mathematics.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁能帮我做这道练习题？马克：问问保罗吧。他很擅长数学。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 谁能帮我做这道练习题？
messages.en: Who can help me with this exercise?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lil Pawlu. Hu bravu fil-matematika.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lil Pawlu. Hu bravu fil-matematika.
messages.zh: 问问保罗吧。他很擅长数学。
messages.en: Ask Pawlu. He's good at mathematics.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bravu 放在“他很拿手”的情境里记：做事能干、学习聪明、操作熟练，都围绕“有本领”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bracelet: a piece of jewellery worn around the wrist.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戴在手腕上的饰物，可指手链或手镯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ġojjellerija li tintlibes madwar il-polz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手链；手镯，戴在手腕上的饰物。

formal.mt: Il-klijenta għażlet brazzuletta tal-fidda bħala rigal għal oħtha.
formal.en: The customer chose a silver bracelet as a gift for her sister.
formal.zh: 这位女顾客挑选了一条银手链，作为送给姐妹的礼物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Togħġbok din il-brazzuletta? Mark: Iva, sabiħa ħafna. Se tixtriha għalik?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you like this bracelet? Mark: Yes, it's very pretty. Are you buying it for yourself?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢这条手链吗？马克：喜欢，很漂亮。你是买给自己的吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这条手链吗？
messages.en: Do you like this bracelet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sabiħa ħafna. Se tixtriha għalik?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sabiħa ħafna. Se tixtriha għalik?
messages.zh: 喜欢，很漂亮。你是买给自己的吗？
messages.en: Yes, it's very pretty. Are you buying it for yourself?

cognitive_memory_aid: 一边摸手腕一边读 brazzuletta，把词和佩戴动作绑定；再加 tad-deheb，想象一条金手链。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Brazil, a large Portuguese-speaking country in South America.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 巴西，位于南美洲的一个以葡萄牙语为主要语言的大国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż kbir fl-Amerka t'Isfel fejn jitkellmu bil-Portugiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巴西，国家名称。

sense_translations.en_definition: Brazil (a large Portuguese-speaking country in South America)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 巴西，南美洲一个使用葡萄牙语的大国。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi vjaġġ edukattiv lejn il-Brażil biex l-istudenti jipprattikaw il-Portugiż.
formal.en: The report describes an educational trip to Brazil for students to practise Portuguese.
formal.zh: 这份报告介绍了一次前往巴西、让学生练习葡萄牙语的研学旅行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Mark: Se mmur il-Brażil. Qed nitgħallem ftit Portugiż qabel nitlaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Brazil. I'm learning a little Portuguese before I leave.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你打算去哪里度假？马克：我要去巴西。出发前我正在学一点葡萄牙语。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur il-Brażil. Qed nitgħallem ftit Portugiż qabel nitlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur il-Brażil. Qed nitgħallem ftit Portugiż qabel nitlaq.
messages.zh: 我要去巴西。出发前我正在学一点葡萄牙语。
messages.en: I'm going to Brazil. I'm learning a little Portuguese before I leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Brażil、南美洲和葡萄牙语连成一张记忆卡，再用 fil-Brażil 练习说“在巴西”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: From Brazil or relating to Brazil, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自巴西的，或与巴西、巴西人民及其文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Brażil jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Brażil, man-nies tiegħu jew mal-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巴西的；巴西人的。

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or related to Brasil
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自巴西的；与巴西有关的。
巴西的；具有巴西国籍或背景的。
巴西人。

formal.mt: Il-programm kulturali jinkludi film brażiljan u diskussjoni dwar il-ħajja fil-Brażil.
formal.en: The cultural programme includes a Brazilian film and a discussion about life in Brazil.
formal.zh: 这项文化活动包括一部巴西电影，以及一场关于巴西生活的讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-plejer brażiljan? Mark: Iva, ġej mill-Brażil u issa jilgħab mat-tim tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this player Brazilian? Mark: Yes, he's from Brazil and now plays for our team.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这位球员是巴西人吗？马克：是的，他来自巴西，现在为我们队效力。

messages.speaker: Maja (球迷)
messages.zh: 这位球员是巴西人吗？
messages.en: Is this player Brazilian?

messages.speaker: Mark (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mill-Brażil u issa jilgħab mat-tim tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mill-Brażil u issa jilgħab mat-tim tagħna.
messages.zh: 是的，他来自巴西，现在为我们队效力。
messages.en: Yes, he's from Brazil and now plays for our team.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张卡区分词性：形容食物时是“巴西的”，指一个人的身份时是“巴西人”，都联系 Brażil 来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brake used to slow or stop a vehicle; also a break or short pause from an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使车辆减速或停止的刹车装置；也指工作或其他活动中的短暂休息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat biex vettura tnaqqas il-veloċità jew tieqaf; ukoll waqfa qasira mix-xogħol jew minn attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刹车；制动器。

sense_translations.en_definition: brake (device used to slow or stop a vehicle)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 刹车装置，用于使车辆减速或停止。

sense_translations.en_definition: break (rest or pause, usually from work)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 休息；暂停，通常指工作间歇。

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni tas-sewqan, l-għalliem spjega meta s-sewwieq għandu jagħfas il-brejk.
formal.en: During the driving lesson, the instructor explained when the driver should press the brake.
formal.zh: 在驾驶课上，教练讲解了驾驶员应该在什么时候踩刹车。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nieħdu brejk? Ilna naħdmu sagħtejn. Mark: Iva, ejja nieħdu kafè u mbagħad inkomplu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we take a break? We've been working for two hours. Mark: Yes, let's have a coffee and then carry on.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们休息一下好吗？已经工作两个小时了。马克：好，喝杯咖啡再继续吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我们休息一下好吗？已经工作两个小时了。
messages.en: Shall we take a break? We've been working for two hours.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nieħdu kafè u mbagħad inkomplu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nieħdu kafè u mbagħad inkomplu.
messages.zh: 好，喝杯咖啡再继续吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's have a coffee and then carry on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“让动作停一停”串联两义：车上踩 brejk 是刹车，工作时 tieħu brejk 是休息；靠情境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A scoundrel or rascal; in another use, a street urchin or mischievous child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行为恶劣或不诚实的人；也可指街头顽童或淘气的孩子，轻重取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġib ruħha ħażin jew b'diżonestà; jista' wkoll jirreferi għal tifel tat-triq jew imqareb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恶棍；品行卑劣的人。
街头顽童；常在街头活动的淘气孩子。
无赖；坏蛋；也可依语气指淘气鬼。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-brikkun iqarraq bin-nies tar-raħal biex jieħu flushom.
formal.en: In the story, the scoundrel deceives the villagers to take their money.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个恶棍欺骗村民，骗取他们的钱财。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar l-aħħar gallettin? Mark: Ħadu Pawlu, dak il-brikkun żgħir! Ħalla biss il-frak.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the last biscuit go? Mark: Pawlu took it, that little rascal! He only left the crumbs.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：最后一块饼干去哪儿了？马克：被保罗那个小淘气鬼拿走了！只留下了碎屑。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.zh: 最后一块饼干去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the last biscuit go?

messages.speaker: Mark (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadu Pawlu, dak il-brikkun żgħir! Ħalla biss il-frak.
messages.mt_standard: Ħadu Pawlu, dak il-brikkun żgħir! Ħalla biss il-frak.
messages.zh: 被保罗那个小淘气鬼拿走了！只留下了碎屑。
messages.en: Pawlu took it, that little rascal! He only left the crumbs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 brikkun 配两幅图：骗人钱财的无赖和偷吃饼干的小淘气；先看行为与语气，再选中文轻重。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Spiders, small eight-legged animals; this spelling also names the plant ovate goatgrass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蜘蛛的复数形式，指有八条腿的小动物；同形词也指卵穗山羊草这种植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-plural ta' brimba, annimal żgħir bi tmien saqajn; l-istess kelma tintuża wkoll għall-pjanta Aegilops geniculata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜘蛛，复数。
卵穗山羊草，学名 Aegilops geniculata。

collocations.zh: 称为卵穗山羊草的植物

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-pjanti, l-isem 'brimb' jirreferi għall-ispeċi Aegilops geniculata.
formal.en: In the plant list, the name 'brimb' refers to the species Aegilops geniculata.
formal.zh: 在这份植物名录中，名称 brimb 指的是卵穗山羊草，学名 Aegilops geniculata。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm brimb wara l-bieb? Mark: Iva, rajt tnejn ħdejn it-tieqa wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are there spiders behind the door? Mark: Yes, I saw two near the window as well.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：门后有蜘蛛吗？马克：有，我还在窗边看到了两只。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 门后有蜘蛛吗？
messages.en: Are there spiders behind the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, rajt tnejn ħdejn it-tieqa wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, rajt tnejn ħdejn it-tieqa wkoll.
messages.zh: 有，我还在窗边看到了两只。
messages.en: Yes, I saw two near the window as well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 brimb 分开建两张词义卡：窗边多只蜘蛛是一张，植物名录中的卵穗山羊草是另一张，避免同形混义。

gloss_zh: 英国的；英国人（通常指男性）

teaching_sense.en_definition: From Britain or connected with Britain or the United Kingdom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自英国的，或与英国及其事物有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Gran Brittanja jew li għandu x'jaqsam magħha jew mar-Renju Unit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英国的；英国人的。

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or related to Britain
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自不列颠的；与不列颠有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: British (of, from or relating to the United Kingdom)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 英国的：属于、来自或涉及联合王国的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Briton, Brit (native or inhabitant of the United Kingdom) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 英国人，即英国本地人或居民，通常指男性。

formal.mt: L-artiklu janalizza rumanz ta' kittieb brittaniku u r-rabta tiegħu mas-soċjetà ta' żmienu.
formal.en: The article analyses a novel by a British writer and its connection with the society of his time.
formal.zh: 这篇文章分析了一位英国作家的小说及其与当时社会的联系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kittieb brittaniku? Mark: Iva, ġej minn Manchester. Qrajt wieħed mill-kotba tiegħu?
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this writer British? Mark: Yes, he comes from Manchester. Have you read one of his books?
colloquial.zh: Maja：这位作家是英国人吗？Mark：是的，他来自曼彻斯特。你读过他的一本书吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这位作家是英国人吗？
messages.en: Is this writer British?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej minn Manchester. Qrajt wieħed mill-kotba tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej minn Manchester. Qrajt wieħed mill-kotba tiegħu?
messages.zh: 是的，他来自曼彻斯特。你读过他的一本书吗？
messages.en: Yes, he comes from Manchester. Have you read one of his books?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把英国护照和英国作家放在同一张记忆卡上：修饰事物时记作“英国的”，单独指人时再联系“英国人”这一名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A metal alloy made mainly of copper and tin, used for objects such as statues and medals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主要由铜和锡组成的金属合金，常用于制作雕像、奖牌等物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Liga ta' metalli magħmula l-aktar mir-ram u l-landa, użata għal oġġetti bħal statwi u midalji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 青铜，一种主要由铜和锡组成的合金。

formal.mt: Il-mużew esebixxa statwa tal-bronż u pprovda tagħrif dwar il-materjal u t-teknika tal-artist.
formal.en: The museum exhibited a bronze statue and provided information about the material and the artist's technique.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出了一尊青铜雕像，并介绍了所用材料和艺术家的制作技法。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din l-istatwa tal-bronż? Pawlu: Iva, tal-bronż. Ejja naqraw it-tabella biex insiru nafu min għamilha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this statue made of bronze? Pawlu: Yes, it is bronze. Let's read the label to find out who made it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这尊雕像是青铜做的吗？Pawlu：是的，是青铜的。我们读读说明牌，看看是谁做的。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.zh: 这尊雕像是青铜做的吗？
messages.en: Is this statue made of bronze?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tal-bronż. Ejja naqraw it-tabella biex insiru nafu min għamilha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tal-bronż. Ejja naqraw it-tabella biex insiru nafu min għamilha.
messages.zh: 是的，是青铜的。我们读读说明牌，看看是谁做的。
messages.en: Yes, it is bronze. Let's read the label to find out who made it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一尊青铜雕像胸前挂着铜牌，把 statwa tal-bronż 和 midalja tal-bronż 配成一幅图，记住 bronż 表示材料“青铜”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brush with coarse, stiff bristles used for scrubbing surfaces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刷毛粗硬、用于用力刷洗表面的刷子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xkupilja b'lanżit oħxon u iebes li tintuża biex togħrok u tnaddaf uċuħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗硬毛刷；刷毛较粗硬的刷子。
洗刷刷子；用于用力刷洗污垢的刷子。
无赖；恶棍，是对品行恶劣之人的贬称。

formal.mt: Għat-tindif tat-taraġ tal-ġebel, uża broxk u ilma bis-sapun biex tneħħi l-ħmieġ.
formal.en: To clean the stone steps, use a scrubbing brush and soapy water to remove the dirt.
formal.zh: 清洁石阶时，使用洗刷刷子和肥皂水去除污垢。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu l-broxk? Din it-tebgħa ma tridx tinqala'. Toni: Taħt is-sink. Ipprova ogħrok bi ftit ilma sħun.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the scrubbing brush? This stain won't come off. Toni: Under the sink. Try scrubbing with a little warm water.
colloquial.zh: Nina：洗刷刷子在哪里？这块污渍怎么也去不掉。Toni：在水槽下面。试着加一点温水刷一刷。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-broxk? Din it-tebgħa ma tridx tinqala'.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-broxk? Din it-tebgħa ma tridx tinqala'.
messages.zh: 洗刷刷子在哪里？这块污渍怎么也去不掉。
messages.en: Where is the scrubbing brush? This stain won't come off.

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħt is-sink. Ipprova ogħrok bi ftit ilma sħun.
messages.mt_standard: Taħt is-sink. Ipprova ogħrok bi ftit ilma sħun.
messages.zh: 在水槽下面。试着加一点温水刷一刷。
messages.en: Under the sink. Try scrubbing with a little warm water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“硬刷刷污渍”的动作记住实物义，再单列一张“无赖”的人物卡；两种语境分开练习，避免把贬人的意思带入清洁用品对话。

gloss_zh: 凉意；微凉；冷淡；缺乏热情

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling or quality of coolness, also used for a lack of warmth or enthusiasm in someone's response.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 凉意或不够温暖的状态，也可指人的回应冷淡、缺乏热情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens jew stat ta' kesħa ħafifa; tintuża wkoll għal nuqqas ta' ħeġġa jew sħana fir-reazzjoni ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凉意；使人感到微冷的感觉。
缺乏热情；兴致不高。

sense_translations.en_definition: tepidness; coolness (lack of warmth, a neutral temperature)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 温凉；微凉；缺少暖意、温度不冷不热的状态。
态度冷淡；反应不热烈；缺乏积极的热情。

collocations.en: to receive a proposal with little enthusiasm

formal.mt: Il-kumitat laqa' l-proposta bi bruda u talab aktar tagħrif qabel jieħu deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The committee received the proposal with little enthusiasm and requested more information before making a decision.
formal.zh: 委员会对这项提议反应冷淡，要求获得更多资料后再作决定。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħadt ġakketta? Għad hemm il-bruda ta' filgħodu. Ġanni: Iva, ħadtha. Nilbisha sakemm toħroġ ix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you bring a jacket? There is still a morning chill. Ġanni: Yes, I brought it. I'll wear it until the sun comes out.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你带外套了吗？早上还有些凉意。Ġanni：带了。太阳出来之前我先穿着。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadt ġakketta? Għad hemm il-bruda ta' filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħadt ġakketta? Għad hemm il-bruda ta' filgħodu.
messages.zh: 你带外套了吗？早上还有些凉意。
messages.en: Did you bring a jacket? There is still a morning chill.

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħadtha. Nilbisha sakemm toħroġ ix-xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħadtha. Nilbisha sakemm toħroġ ix-xemx.
messages.zh: 带了。太阳出来之前我先穿着。
messages.en: Yes, I brought it. I'll wear it until the sun comes out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅“温度偏低”的画面辅助记忆：清晨空气有凉意，收到提议的人反应冷淡；分别对应身体感受和热情程度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Eggplant or aubergine, a vegetable commonly cooked by grilling, frying or baking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 茄子，一种常用于烤、煎或焗制的蔬菜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxix li spiss ikollu qoxra vjola u li jissajjar mixwi, moqli jew fil-forn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 茄子，英语中称为 aubergine。
茄子，英语中也称为 eggplant。
茄子，复数或集合意义，指多个茄子。
眼周淤青；因受伤等形成的青紫眼圈。

formal.mt: Aqta' l-brunġiel fi flieli, idlikhom bi ftit żejt u sajjarhom fil-forn sakemm jirtabu.
formal.en: Cut the eggplant into slices, brush them with a little oil and bake them until soft.
formal.zh: 将茄子切片，抹上少量油，放入烤箱烤至变软。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'se nsajru għall-ikla? Għandna l-brunġiel. David: Nagħmluh mixwi bit-tadam u ftit ġobon?
colloquial.en: Marta: What shall we cook for the meal? We have eggplant. David: Shall we grill it with tomatoes and a little cheese?
colloquial.zh: Marta：这顿饭我们做什么？家里有茄子。David：把它和番茄、少许奶酪一起烤，好吗？

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.zh: 这顿饭我们做什么？家里有茄子。
messages.en: What shall we cook for the meal? We have eggplant.

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmluh mixwi bit-tadam u ftit ġobon?
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmluh mixwi bit-tadam u ftit ġobon?
messages.zh: 把它和番茄、少许奶酪一起烤，好吗？
messages.en: Shall we grill it with tomatoes and a little cheese?

cognitive_memory_aid: 主记忆画面设为切茄子、烤茄子；另用紫色作个人联想提示眼周淤青义。这只是记忆方法，不表示两个词义的历史来源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An intuitive sense or understanding of something without conscious step-by-step reasoning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未经有意识的逐步推理而产生的直觉、感知或领悟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens jew għarfien ta' xi ħaġa mingħajr ma wieħed jasal għalih permezz ta' raġunament pass pass.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直觉；不经明确推理而产生的感知或判断。
戏法手技；以灵巧手法造成视觉错觉的魔术技巧。
预测；对未来事件的预判或预言。

formal.mt: Meta l-informazzjoni tkun limitata, il-bsir jista' jgħin fil-formazzjoni ta' ipoteżi, iżda din trid tiġi vverifikata.
formal.en: When information is limited, intuition can help in forming a hypothesis, but that hypothesis must be verified.
formal.zh: 资料有限时，直觉可以帮助形成假设，但仍须对假设进行验证。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kif għażilt din it-triq? Omar: Imxejt bil-bsir, imma ejja niċċekkjaw il-mappa biex inkunu ċerti.
colloquial.en: Lina: How did you choose this road? Omar: I went by intuition, but let's check the map to make sure.
colloquial.zh: Lina：你怎么选了这条路？Omar：我凭直觉选的，不过我们看看地图确认一下吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么选了这条路？
messages.en: How did you choose this road?

messages.speaker: Omar (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Imxejt bil-bsir, imma ejja niċċekkjaw il-mappa biex inkunu ċerti.
messages.mt_standard: Imxejt bil-bsir, imma ejja niċċekkjaw il-mappa biex inkunu ċerti.
messages.zh: 我凭直觉选的，不过我们看看地图确认一下吧。
messages.en: I went by intuition, but let's check the map to make sure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做三张分开的场景卡：岔路口凭直觉选择、魔术师展示手技、记录对未来的预测。用场景辨认三个义项，不把它们强行解释成同一种能力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Suggesting or foretelling something that will happen in the future.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 预示未来事件的，或具有预言性质的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jindika minn qabel jew iħabbar xi ħaġa li se tiġri fil-futur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预示性的；显示某事将要发生的征兆的。
预言性的；具有预告未来事件性质的。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tar-rumanz, il-ħolm bsuri tal-protagonist jitqies bħala mezz biex il-qarrej jitħejja għall-ġrajjiet li ġejjin.
formal.en: In the analysis of the novel, the protagonist's prophetic dreams are viewed as a device that prepares the reader for coming events.
formal.zh: 在这篇小说分析中，主人公具有预言性质的梦被视为一种让读者为后续事件作好准备的手法。

colloquial.mt: Eva: Għaliex tgħid li fil-film hemm ħolm bsuri? Ben: Għax dak li joħlom il-karattru fil-bidu jiġri tassew fl-aħħar.
colloquial.en: Eva: Why do you say the film contains prophetic dreams? Ben: Because what the character dreams at the beginning actually happens at the end.
colloquial.zh: Eva：你为什么说电影里有预言性的梦？Ben：因为角色开头梦见的事，最后真的发生了。

messages.speaker: Eva (影迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li fil-film hemm ħolm bsuri?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li fil-film hemm ħolm bsuri?
messages.zh: 你为什么说电影里有预言性的梦？
messages.en: Why do you say the film contains prophetic dreams?

messages.speaker: Ben (影迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dak li joħlom il-karattru fil-bidu jiġri tassew fl-aħħar.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dak li joħlom il-karattru fil-bidu jiġri tassew fl-aħħar.
messages.zh: 因为角色开头梦见的事，最后真的发生了。
messages.en: Because what the character dreams at the beginning actually happens at the end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电影开头的梦境画面与结尾事件相互呼应，用箭头从梦指向后来发生的事，记住 bsuri 描述“具有预示或预言性质的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short holiday or a brief period away from one's usual work or routine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续时间较短的假期，或暂时离开日常工作与生活安排的一段休息时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vaganza qasira jew żmien qasir ta' mistrieħ mix-xogħol jew mir-rutina ta' kuljum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 短假；时间较短的休假。

formal.mt: Wara li temm il-proġett, l-impjegat ħa btajla ta' jumejn biex jistrieħ.
formal.en: After completing the project, the employee took a two-day holiday to rest.
formal.zh: 完成项目后，那名员工休了两天短假来放松休息。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'se tagħmel fi tmiem il-ġimgħa? Pawlu: Se nieħu btajla f'Għawdex. Marija: Idea sabiħa! Se tibqa' hemm jumejn?
colloquial.en: Marija: What are you doing this weekend? Pawlu: I'm taking a short holiday in Gozo. Marija: Lovely idea! Are you staying there for two days?
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你周末打算做什么？保罗：我要去戈佐岛度个短假。玛丽娅：好主意！你要在那里待两天吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 你周末打算做什么？
messages.en: What are you doing this weekend?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 我要去戈佐岛度个短假。
messages.en: I'm taking a short holiday in Gozo.

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Idea sabiħa! Se tibqa' hemm jumejn?
messages.mt_standard: Idea sabiħa! Se tibqa' hemm jumejn?
messages.zh: 好主意！你要在那里待两天吗？
messages.en: Lovely idea! Are you staying there for two days?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上圈出两天，旁边放一个小旅行包，用这幅短暂休息的画面记住短假。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A day or period away from ordinary work or study for rest, celebration or a vacation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因休息、庆祝或度假而暂停日常工作或学习的一天或一段时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jum jew perjodu ta' mistrieħ mix-xogħol jew mill-istudju, għal vaganza jew ċelebrazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个假日；一天休息日。
一个节日；举行宗教或其他庆祝活动的日子。
一次休假；一段用于休息或旅行的假期。
假日；休假；假期。
假期；休息时段；休假。

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju se jkun magħluq nhar it-Tnejn minħabba btala pubblika u jerġa' jiftaħ it-Tlieta filgħodu.
formal.en: The office will be closed on Monday because of a public holiday and will reopen on Tuesday morning.
formal.zh: 由于公共假日，办公室将于星期一关闭，并于星期二上午重新开放。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se tmur btala din is-sena? Mark: Se nqatta' ġimgħa Għawdex mal-familja. Għandi bżonn ftit mistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going on holiday this year? Mark: I'll spend a week in Gozo with my family. I need some rest.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你今年打算去哪里度假？Mark：我要和家人去戈佐岛住一周。我需要休息一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se tmur btala din is-sena?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se tmur btala din is-sena?
messages.zh: 你今年打算去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday this year?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nqatta' ġimgħa Għawdex mal-familja. Għandi bżonn ftit mistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Se nqatta' ġimgħa Għawdex mal-familja. Għandi bżonn ftit mistrieħ.
messages.zh: 我要和家人去戈佐岛住一周。我需要休息一下。
messages.en: I'll spend a week in Gozo with my family. I need some rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历上圈出一天公共假日，再圈出一整周旅行假期：同一个 btala 可以放进这两种休息场景，并用节庆图标提醒自己还有节日义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A broomrape plant, a parasitic plant that grows attached to the roots of another plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 列当，一种依附其他植物根部生长的寄生植物，也可指这类杂草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta parassita li tikber imwaħħla mal-għeruq ta' pjanta oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为杂草的列当；列当类寄生杂草
列当；列当类寄生植物

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni tal-għalqa, ġiet osservata pjanta tal-budebbus qrib l-għelejjel.
formal.en: During the field inspection, a broomrape plant was observed near the crops.
formal.zh: 在田地检查过程中，检查人员在作物附近发现了一株列当。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik il-pjanta fl-għalqa? Pawlu: Dak budebbus; jikber mal-għeruq ta' pjanti oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that plant in the field? Pawlu: That's broomrape; it grows attached to the roots of other plants.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：田里那是什么植物？保罗：那是列当，依附其他植物的根生长。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 田里那是什么植物？
messages.en: What's that plant in the field?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak budebbus; jikber mal-għeruq ta' pjanti oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Dak budebbus; jikber mal-għeruq ta' pjanti oħra.
messages.zh: 那是列当，依附其他植物的根生长。
messages.en: That's broomrape; it grows attached to the roots of other plants.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 budebbus 配上田里列当依附根部的画面，并用“田里的列当”这一短语一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A clown or comic performer who entertains people by acting in a funny way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过滑稽动作或表演逗人发笑的小丑、丑角。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel wirja b'ġesti u mġiba komiċi biex iddaħħaq lin-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小丑；以滑稽表演娱人的演员
滑稽的；好笑的；令人觉得有趣的
小丑；丑角；以逗趣娱人的弄臣

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-festa jinkludi wirja minn buffu li se jdaħħaq lit-tfal.
formal.en: The festival programme includes a performance by a clown who will make the children laugh.
formal.zh: 节庆活动安排了一场小丑表演，为孩子们带来欢笑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak bil-kappell buffu? Mark: Hu l-buffu taċ-ċirku. Ara kemm qed idaħħaq lit-tfal!
colloquial.en: Lara: Who's that wearing the funny hat? Mark: He's the circus clown. Look how much he's making the children laugh!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个戴着滑稽帽子的人是谁？马克：他是马戏团的小丑。看他把孩子们逗得多开心！

messages.speaker: Lara (观众)
messages.zh: 那个戴着滑稽帽子的人是谁？
messages.en: Who's that wearing the funny hat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu l-buffu taċ-ċirku. Ara kemm qed idaħħaq lit-tfal!
messages.mt_standard: Hu l-buffu taċ-ċirku. Ara kemm qed idaħħaq lit-tfal!
messages.zh: 他是马戏团的小丑。看他把孩子们逗得多开心！
messages.en: He's the circus clown. Look how much he's making the children laugh!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象 buffu 小丑戴着 kappell buffu 滑稽帽子：同一画面同时记住名词和形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes others laugh through jokes, amusing behaviour, or a comic role.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以笑话、滑稽举动或逗趣角色引人发笑的人，可指活宝或弄臣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ddaħħaq lil ħaddieħor biċ-ċajt, b'imġiba komika jew bi rwol ta' divertiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有趣而逗人发笑的人；活宝

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who is zany or droll
sense_translations.zh_definition: 举止古怪滑稽或诙谐有趣的人
弄臣；以逗趣表演娱人的丑角

formal.mt: Fid-dramm, il-buffun tal-qorti juża ċ-ċajt biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni tar-re.
formal.en: In the play, the court jester uses humour to attract the king's attention.
formal.zh: 在剧中，宫廷弄臣用笑话吸引国王的注意。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex kulħadd qed jidħaq b'Ġanni? Sara: Qed jagħmel il-buffun u jimita l-ħsejjes tal-annimali.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is everyone laughing at Ġanni? Sara: He's playing the fool and imitating animal noises.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：大家为什么看着詹尼发笑？萨拉：他在耍宝，模仿动物的叫声。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 大家为什么看着詹尼发笑？
messages.en: Why is everyone laughing at Ġanni?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jagħmel il-buffun u jimita l-ħsejjes tal-annimali.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jagħmel il-buffun u jimita l-ħsejjes tal-annimali.
messages.zh: 他在耍宝，模仿动物的叫声。
messages.en: He's playing the fool and imitating animal noises.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 buffun 和聚会上模仿动物叫声的活宝联系起来；连同 jagħmel il-buffun“耍宝”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who goes underwater to swim, explore, or work, often using diving equipment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进入水下游泳、探索或作业的人，通常使用潜水装备；潜水员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tinżel taħt l-ilma biex tgħum, tesplora jew taħdem, spiss b'tagħmir tal-għadis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蛙人；穿戴潜水装备执行水下任务的人员
潜水员；进行潜水的人
红喉潜鸟（学名 Gavia stellata）

formal.mt: Il-bugħaddas professjonali eżamina l-parti tal-bastiment li kienet taħt l-ilma.
formal.en: The professional diver examined the part of the vessel that was underwater.
formal.zh: 专业潜水员检查了船只位于水下的部分。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jfittex iċ-ċwievet li waqgħu fil-baħar? Mark: Se jiġi bugħaddas biex ifittixhom taħt l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who's going to look for the keys that fell into the sea? Mark: A diver is coming to look for them underwater.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁来找掉进海里的钥匙？马克：会有一位潜水员来水下寻找。

messages.speaker: Lara (船主)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jfittex iċ-ċwievet li waqgħu fil-baħar?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jfittex iċ-ċwievet li waqgħu fil-baħar?
messages.zh: 谁来找掉进海里的钥匙？
messages.en: Who's going to look for the keys that fell into the sea?

messages.speaker: Mark (码头工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Se jiġi bugħaddas biex ifittixhom taħt l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Se jiġi bugħaddas biex ifittixhom taħt l-ilma.
messages.zh: 会有一位潜水员来水下寻找。
messages.en: A diver is coming to look for them underwater.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 bugħaddas 画两张词义卡：一张是水下潜水员，一张是红喉潜鸟，用语境区分人和鸟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small, soft-bodied animal similar to a snail but without a visible external shell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种身体柔软、像蜗牛但没有明显外壳的小动物；蛞蝓，俗称鼻涕虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir b'ġisem artab, jixbah lil bebbuxu iżda mingħajr qoxra esterna viżibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蛞蝓；鼻涕虫，一种没有明显外壳的软体动物

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenti raw bugħarwien fuq werqa mxarrba.
formal.en: During their garden observation, the students saw a slug on a wet leaf.
formal.zh: 学生们在花园里进行观察时，看见一只蛞蝓停在湿润的叶片上。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dak fuq il-werqa! Hu bebbuxu? Pawlu: Le, dak bugħarwien. M'għandux qoxra bħal bebbuxu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at that on the leaf! Is it a snail? Pawlu: No, that's a slug. It doesn't have a shell like a snail.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看叶子上的那个！是蜗牛吗？保罗：不是，那是蛞蝓。它没有蜗牛那样的壳。

messages.speaker: Nina (孩子)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak fuq il-werqa! Hu bebbuxu?
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak fuq il-werqa! Hu bebbuxu?
messages.zh: 看叶子上的那个！是蜗牛吗？
messages.en: Look at that on the leaf! Is it a snail?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dak bugħarwien. M'għandux qoxra bħal bebbuxu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dak bugħarwien. M'għandux qoxra bħal bebbuxu.
messages.zh: 不是，那是蛞蝓。它没有蜗牛那样的壳。
messages.en: No, that's a slug. It doesn't have a shell like a snail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 bugħarwien 就想象湿叶片上没有蜗牛壳的鼻涕虫，用外形画面记住“蛞蝓”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sudden, painful tightening of a muscle that is difficult to control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肌肉突然发生、不易自主控制的疼痛性收缩；抽筋或肌肉痉挛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kontrazzjoni f'daqqa u bl-uġigħ ta' muskolu, li tkun diffiċli biex tikkontrollaha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抽筋；肌肉痉挛

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ, l-atleta waqaf minħabba bugħawwieġ fil-muskolu tar-riġel.
formal.en: During training, the athlete stopped because of a cramp in his leg muscle.
formal.zh: 训练期间，这名运动员因腿部肌肉抽筋而停了下来。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Għaliex waqaft tiġri? Maja: Għandi bugħawwieġ f'sieqi. Se nieqaf ftit.
colloquial.en: Toni: Why did you stop running? Maja: I've got a cramp in my foot. I'm going to stop for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：你为什么不跑了？玛雅：我的脚抽筋了，我要停一会儿。

messages.speaker: Toni (跑步伙伴)
messages.zh: 你为什么不跑了？
messages.en: Why did you stop running?

messages.speaker: Maja (跑步者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bugħawwieġ f'sieqi. Se nieqaf ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bugħawwieġ f'sieqi. Se nieqaf ftit.
messages.zh: 我的脚抽筋了，我要停一会儿。
messages.en: I've got a cramp in my foot. I'm going to stop for a bit.
