cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bżulija 联想成每天认真打一个学习勾：重点是持续努力的“勤奋品质”，搭配 bil-bżulija 记作“勤勉地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name used as a person's surname.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作个人姓氏的专有名称 Caruana，可音译为“卡鲁阿纳”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala isem tal-familja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏 Caruana，可音译为“卡鲁阿纳”。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Caruana bagħat it-talba tiegħu bil-miktub.
formal.en: Mr Caruana submitted his request in writing.
formal.zh: 卡鲁阿纳先生以书面形式提交了请求。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu kunjomok? David: Kunjomi Caruana. Maja: Tista' tiktbu hawn, jekk jogħġbok?
colloquial.en: Maja: What is your surname? David: My surname is Caruana. Maja: Could you write it here, please?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你姓什么？戴维：我姓卡鲁阿纳。玛雅：请你把姓写在这里，好吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (接待员)
messages.zh: 你姓什么？
messages.en: What is your surname?

messages.speaker: David (访客)
messages.zh: 我姓卡鲁阿纳。
messages.en: My surname is Caruana.

messages.speaker: Maja (接待员)
messages.zh: 请你把姓写在这里，好吗？
messages.en: Could you write it here, please?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Caruana 写在表格的“姓氏”一栏，配合“卡鲁阿纳先生”记忆，并保留开头大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a country in Central Africa, officially called Repubblika taċ-Chad in Maltese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 中非国家乍得的名称，马耳他语正式名称为 Repubblika taċ-Chad，即乍得共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' pajjiż fl-Afrika Ċentrali, bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika taċ-Chad.

sense_translations.en_definition: Chad (a country in Central Africa; official name: Repubblika taċ-Chad)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 乍得，中非的一个国家；正式名称为乍得共和国，马耳他语为 Repubblika taċ-Chad。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi mappa taċ-Chad, pajjiż fl-Afrika Ċentrali.
formal.en: The report includes a map of Chad, a country in Central Africa.
formal.zh: 报告附有中非国家乍得的地图。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn qiegħed iċ-Chad? Ben: Fl-Afrika Ċentrali. Ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is Chad? Ben: In Central Africa. Let's find it on the map.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：乍得在哪里？本：在中非。我们在地图上找找它吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 乍得在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Chad?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-Afrika Ċentrali. Ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-Afrika Ċentrali. Ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 在中非。我们在地图上找找它吧。
messages.en: In Central Africa. Let's find it on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在非洲中部的地图位置贴上“Chad＝乍得”，再把正式名称中的 Repubblika 联想到“共和国”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name used as a person's surname.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作个人姓氏的专有名称 Cini，可音译为“奇尼”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala isem tal-familja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏 Cini，可音译为“奇尼”。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Cini kitbet isimha u kunjomha fuq il-formola.
formal.en: Mrs Cini wrote her first name and surname on the form.
formal.zh: 奇尼女士在表格上填写了自己的名字和姓氏。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek appuntament, jekk jogħġbok? Anna: Iva, għandi appuntament. Kunjomi Cini. Mark: Grazzi, Sinjura Cini. Tista' tistenna hawn.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have an appointment, please? Anna: Yes, I have an appointment. My surname is Cini. Mark: Thank you, Mrs Cini. You can wait here.
colloquial.zh: 马克：请问您有预约吗？安娜：有，我有预约。我姓奇尼。马克：谢谢您，奇尼女士。您可以在这里等候。

messages.speaker: Mark (接待员)
messages.zh: 请问您有预约吗？
messages.en: Do you have an appointment, please?

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.zh: 有，我有预约。我姓奇尼。
messages.en: Yes, I have an appointment. My surname is Cini.

messages.speaker: Mark (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, Sinjura Cini. Tista' tistenna hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, Sinjura Cini. Tista' tistenna hawn.
messages.zh: 谢谢您，奇尼女士。您可以在这里等候。
messages.en: Thank you, Mrs Cini. You can wait here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象接待处叫到“奇尼女士”，把 Cini 与姓氏栏联系起来；拼写虽短，开头仍须大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become liquid through warmth, or to dissolve in a liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受热变成液体，或在液体中溶解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir likwidu bis-sħana, jew jinħall f'likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 溶解。
融化。
消失得无影无踪。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be very taken with sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常喜欢某人；被某人深深吸引。

sense_translations.en_definition: to melt (become liquid, especially through warmth)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 熔化；融化，尤指因受热而变成液体。
消失；不见。
变得消瘦；瘦弱下去。
流露温情；显出柔情。

formal.mt: Waqt l-esperiment, iz-zokkor dab fl-ilma sħun wara li t-taħlita tħawdet.
formal.en: During the experiment, the sugar dissolved in the warm water after the mixture was stirred.
formal.zh: 实验过程中，混合物经搅拌后，糖在温水中溶解了。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn hu l-butir li ħallejt hawn? Pawlu: Dab bis-sħana. Qiegħed f'dik l-iskutella.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where is the butter I left here? Pawlu: It melted in the heat. It's in that bowl.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我放在这里的黄油呢？Pawlu：天热，融化了。在那个碗里。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-butir li ħallejt hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-butir li ħallejt hawn?
messages.zh: 我放在这里的黄油呢？
messages.en: Where is the butter I left here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 天热，融化了。在那个碗里。
messages.en: It melted in the heat. It's in that bowl.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dab 配上两幅画：黄油遇热融化，糖进水里溶解；再用“融得看不见”联想消失义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To obtain or manage to get something; also used of catching an illness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 获得或设法弄到某物；也可指染上疾病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikseb jew jirnexxilu jsib xi ħaġa; jintuża wkoll meta wieħed jaqbad marda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获得；弄到。
染上；患上，指疾病。

sense_translations.en_definition: to leave or make a getaway (usually in the expression 'dabbar rasu')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 离开；溜走；逃走，通常用于表达 dabbar rasu。
引起溃疡或溃烂的东西。
形成溃疡；发生溃烂。

formal.mt: Wara diversi ġimgħat ta' tiftix, iż-żagħżugħ dabbar biċċa xogħol f'ħanut lokali.
formal.en: After several weeks of searching, the young man managed to get a job in a local shop.
formal.zh: 寻找了几个星期后，这名年轻人终于在当地一家商店找到了一份工作。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex Mark ma ġiex magħna? Lara: Dabbar riħ u baqa' d-dar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why didn't Mark come with us? Lara: He caught a cold and stayed home.
colloquial.zh: Rita：Mark 为什么没跟我们一起来？Lara：他感冒了，留在家里。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么没跟我们一起来？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark come with us?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他感冒了，留在家里。
messages.en: He caught a cold and stayed home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用搭配分开记：dabbar biċċa xogħol 是弄到工作，dabbar riħ 是染上感冒，dabbar rasu 整组记作溜走。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A patch or stain on a surface; also a sore or damaged area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面上的一块斑迹或污渍；也可指疮或受损部位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Roqgħa jew tebgħa fuq wiċċ; tista' tkun ukoll ferita jew parti milquta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斑块；一块与周围不同的区域。
污渍；污斑。
溃疡。
挫伤；瘀伤。
疮；疼痛或破损的皮肤部位。
撕裂处；裂口；破口。
债务；欠款。

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami, it-tabib innota dabra fil-ġilda u staqsa lill-pazjent kemm kien ilu jħoss l-uġigħ.
formal.en: During the examination, the doctor noticed a sore in the skin and asked the patient how long he had been feeling pain.
formal.zh: 检查时，医生发现皮肤上有一处疮，便询问病人已经疼了多久。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandi dabra fuq il-flokk. Marija: Iva, tidher. Forsi titlaq bil-ħasil.
colloquial.en: Anna: I've got a stain on my shirt. Marija: Yes, I can see it. Perhaps it'll come out in the wash.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我衬衫上有一块污渍。Marija：嗯，看得见。也许洗一洗就掉了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我衬衫上有一块污渍。
messages.en: I've got a stain on my shirt.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 嗯，看得见。也许洗一洗就掉了。
messages.en: Yes, I can see it. Perhaps it'll come out in the wash.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画三张记忆卡：衣服有污斑、皮肤有伤处、布料有破口；债务义另列一张，避免把所有义项混成污渍。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small object with marked faces that is thrown in a game to produce a result by chance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 游戏中投掷使用、各面带有标记并靠随机落面决定结果的小物体，即骰子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir b'uċuħ immarkati li jintefa' waqt logħba biex jagħti riżultat bix-xorti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骰子。

sense_translations.en_definition: die, dice (polyhedron used in games of chance)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 骰子，用于机会性游戏的多面体。

sense_translations.en_definition: cube (object more or less in the form of a cube)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 立方块；形状大致呈立方体的物体。

formal.mt: F'din l-attività, kull student jitfa' dada b'sitt uċuħ u jikteb in-numru li jidher fuq nett.
formal.en: In this activity, each student throws a six-sided die and writes down the number that appears on top.
formal.zh: 在这项活动中，每名学生掷一枚六面骰子，并记下朝上一面的数字。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Għaddili d-dada, jekk jogħġbok. Sara: Hawn hi. Imissek titfa'.
colloquial.en: Luca: Pass me the die, please. Sara: Here it is. It's your turn to throw.
colloquial.zh: Luca：请把骰子递给我。Sara：给你。轮到你掷了。

messages.speaker: Luca (同学)
messages.zh: 请把骰子递给我。
messages.en: Pass me the die, please.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 给你。轮到你掷了。
messages.en: Here it is. It's your turn to throw.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看着六面骰子记 dada：它既是游戏里的骰子，也能帮助你记住形状大致呈立方块的另一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To interlace strands of hair or other material to make a braid or woven object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把头发或其他材料的条股交叉编在一起，做成辫子或编织物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad friegħi ta' xagħar jew strixxi ta' materjal billi jqegħedhom waħda fuq l-oħra biex jagħmel nisġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 编织。
编结；编成辫状。

sense_translations.en_definition: leather thong used to fasten a horse's harness (crupper)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 固定马具用的皮带，即绕在马尾下方的后鞧。
把头发等编成辫子；编结。

formal.mt: Waqt il-wirja tas-snajja', l-artiġjan dafar qoffa quddiem il-viżitaturi u spjega kull pass.
formal.en: During the craft exhibition, the craftsman wove a basket in front of the visitors and explained each step.
formal.zh: 在手工艺展览期间，工匠当着参观者的面编了一个篮子，并讲解了每个步骤。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min dafar xagħrek? Nina: Missieri. Għoġbitni ħafna n-nisġa!
colloquial.en: Sara: Who braided your hair? Nina: My father. I really like the braid!
colloquial.zh: Sara：谁给你编的辫子？Nina：我爸爸。我特别喜欢这条辫子！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁给你编的辫子？
messages.en: Who braided your hair?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我爸爸。我特别喜欢这条辫子！
messages.en: My father. I really like the braid!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手模拟三股头发交叉编辫来记 dafar 的动词义；马具皮带的名词义单独配图，注意词性边界。

gloss_zh: 咒骂；亵渎；咒骂或亵渎的话

teaching_sense.en_definition: To utter curses or words that insult what is regarded as sacred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说出咒骂的话，或说出侮辱神圣事物的话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid kliem ta' saħta jew kliem li jinsulta dak li jitqies qaddis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咒骂；诅咒。
亵渎神明或神圣事物。
咒骂行为；咒骂的话。
亵渎行为；亵渎神明的话。
咒骂；说亵渎神明的话。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi kif ir-raġel dagħa bir-rabja meta sab il-bieb magħluq.
formal.en: The author describes how the man cursed in anger when he found the door closed.
formal.zh: 作者描写了那名男子发现门关着时如何愤怒地咒骂。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex dagħa hekk? Toni: Kien irrabjat għax tilef iċ-ċwievet.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did he curse like that? Toni: He was angry because he had lost his keys.
colloquial.zh: Marta：他为什么那样咒骂？Toni：他丢了钥匙，很生气。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么那样咒骂？
messages.en: Why did he curse like that?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 他丢了钥匙，很生气。
messages.en: He was angry because he had lost his keys.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记一幕生气后出口咒骂的情景：动词 dagħa 表动作，kliem ta' dagħa 中的名词表示亵渎言语。

gloss_zh: 爱咒骂的人；满口脏话的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who curses or uses blasphemous language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说咒骂话或亵渎话的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tidgħi jew tuża kliem li jinsulta dak li jitqies qaddis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咒骂者；说咒骂话的人。
出言亵渎的；满口脏话的；爱咒骂的。

collocations.en: a person who never stops cursing

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, id-dagħaj juża kliem offensiv waqt kull argument, u dan ibiegħed lin-nies minnu.
formal.en: In the story, the person who curses uses offensive language in every argument, and this drives people away from him.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个爱咒骂的人每逢争执就使用冒犯性的言语，因此人们都疏远他。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak ir-raġel dagħaj ħafna. Mark: Iva, kull darba li jirrabja jibda jidgħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: That man is very foulmouthed. Mark: Yes, every time he gets angry, he starts cursing.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那个男人真是满口脏话。Mark：是啊，他每次一生气就开始咒骂。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男人真是满口脏话。
messages.en: That man is very foulmouthed.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kull darba li jirrabja jibda jidgħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kull darba li jirrabja jibda jidgħi.
messages.zh: 是啊，他每次一生气就开始咒骂。
messages.en: Yes, every time he gets angry, he starts cursing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dagħaj 写在人物卡上：作名词指咒骂的人，放在 raġel 后作形容词则描述这个人满口脏话。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become sad, gloomy, or melancholic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得悲伤、郁郁不乐或忧郁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir imdejjaq, qalbu sewda jew bla ferħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得悲伤；难过起来。
变得郁郁不乐、悲伤或忧郁。

collocations.zh: 因那个消息而难过起来

formal.mt: Meta sar jaf li l-proġett kien twaqqaf, ir-riċerkatur dagħam u baqa' sieket għal ftit ħin.
formal.en: When he learned that the project had been stopped, the researcher became sad and remained silent for a while.
formal.zh: 得知项目被叫停后，这位研究人员难过起来，沉默了一会儿。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex Pawlu daqshekk kwiet? Toni: Dagħam meta sema' l-aħbar. Se noqgħod ftit miegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is Pawlu so quiet? Toni: He became sad when he heard the news. I'll sit with him for a while.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Pawlu 为什么这么安静？Toni：他听到那个消息后难过起来了。我去陪他坐一会儿。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 为什么这么安静？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu so quiet?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dagħam meta sema' l-aħbar. Se noqgħod ftit miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dagħam meta sema' l-aħbar. Se noqgħod ftit miegħu.
messages.zh: 他听到那个消息后难过起来了。我去陪他坐一会儿。
messages.en: He became sad when he heard the news. I'll sit with him for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用情绪变化记 dagħam：原本正常交谈，听到坏消息后低头沉默；重点是“变得”悲伤这一变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman or girl who is a native or inhabitant of Denmark.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自丹麦或居住在丹麦的女性；本词作为名词指丹麦女性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara jew tifla li hija mid-Danimarka jew li tgħix fid-Danimarka.

sense_translations.en_definition: female Danish (female native or inhabitant of Denmark)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 丹麦女性，指出生于丹麦或居住在丹麦的女性。

collocations.en: a Danish woman who lives in Malta
collocations.zh: 一名住在马耳他的丹麦女性

formal.mt: Daniża li tgħix Malta ħadet sehem fil-laqgħa tal-istudenti.
formal.en: A Danish woman who lives in Malta took part in the students' meeting.
formal.zh: 一名住在马耳他的丹麦女性参加了学生会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik it-tifla minn fejn hi? Lara: Hi Daniża. Qed titgħallem il-Malti magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is that girl from? Lara: She is a Dane. She is learning Maltese with us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个女孩来自哪里？拉拉：她是丹麦人。她正在和我们一起学马耳他语。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 那个女孩来自哪里？
messages.en: Where is that girl from?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hi Daniża. Qed titgħallem il-Malti magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Hi Daniża. Qed titgħallem il-Malti magħna.
messages.zh: 她是丹麦人。她正在和我们一起学马耳他语。
messages.en: She is a Dane. She is learning Maltese with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“Hi Daniża＝她是丹麦女性”整句记忆，把 hi 的“她”与这个词所指的女性人物绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To perceive or test the flavour of food or drink by tasting a small amount; also, to experience something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过尝一点食物或饮料来感受、判断其味道；也可表示体验或经历某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħoss jew teżamina t-togħma ta' ikel jew xorb billi tieħu ftit minnu; ukoll, tgħaddi minn esperjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尝某物；品尝某种食物或饮料。

sense_translations.en_definition: to have an experience of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 体验某事；对某种处境或感受有亲身经历。
尝出或感受到某物的味道。

sense_translations.en_definition: to taste, try (eat or drink a bit of in order to check the taste)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 尝尝；试吃或试喝少量，以判断味道。
经历；经受；亲身体验某种事情或处境。

formal.mt: Il-kok daq is-soppa qabel ma żied il-melħ.
formal.en: The cook tasted the soup before adding the salt.
formal.zh: 厨师在加盐之前尝了尝汤。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Mark daq il-kejk? Ben: Iva, daq biċċa żgħira u qal li hu tajjeb ħafna.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did Mark taste the cake? Ben: Yes, he tried a small piece and said it was very good.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克尝蛋糕了吗？本：尝了，他吃了一小块，说很好吃。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克尝蛋糕了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark taste the cake?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, daq biċċa żgħira u qal li hu tajjeb ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, daq biċċa żgħira u qal li hu tajjeb ħafna.
messages.zh: 尝了，他吃了一小块，说很好吃。
messages.en: Yes, he tried a small piece and said it was very good.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象“尝一口汤”，再联想到中文“尝过苦头”；用“尝味道”和“经历滋味”串起两个用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak or write about someone or something in a way that unfairly lowers their reputation or value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以不公正的言语或文字贬低某人或某事，损害其声誉或价值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħid jew tikteb affarijiet li jbaxxu b'mod inġust ir-reputazzjoni jew il-valur ta' persuna jew ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诋毁；贬损；以言语或文字损害某人或某事的声誉。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, l-awtur ddenigra x-xogħol tal-kollegi mingħajr ma ppreżenta evidenza.
formal.en: In his report, the author denigrated his colleagues' work without presenting evidence.
formal.zh: 作者在报告中贬损了同事的工作，却没有提供证据。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ddenigra x-xogħol tiegħek? Lara: Ma nafx. Se nitolbu jispjega x'hemm ħażin fih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark denigrate your work? Lara: I don't know. I will ask him to explain what is wrong with it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么贬损你的工作？拉拉：我不知道。我会请他说明其中有什么问题。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 马克为什么贬损你的工作？
messages.en: Why did Mark denigrate your work?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx. Se nitolbu jispjega x'hemm ħażin fih.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx. Se nitolbu jispjega x'hemm ħażin fih.
messages.zh: 我不知道。我会请他说明其中有什么问题。
messages.en: I don't know. I will ask him to explain what is wrong with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人用没有根据的话给别人的工作“抹黑”，把 ddenigra 与诋毁声誉的场景一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become worse in condition, quality, or functioning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指状况、质量或功能变得更差。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir agħar fil-qagħda, fil-kwalità jew fil-mod kif jaħdem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恶化；状况或质量变差。

collocations.zh: 这座建筑的状况变差了。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li l-istat tal-bini ddeterjora minħabba nuqqas ta' manutenzjoni.
formal.en: The report shows that the condition of the building deteriorated because of a lack of maintenance.
formal.zh: 报告显示，由于缺乏维护，这座建筑的状况恶化了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadna sejrin nimxu ħdejn il-baħar? Mark: Aħjar le. It-temp ddeterjora u beda jagħmel ħafna riħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are we still going for a walk by the sea? Mark: Better not. The weather has deteriorated, and it has become very windy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们还去海边散步吗？马克：最好别去了。天气变坏了，风也刮得很大。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们还去海边散步吗？
messages.en: Are we still going for a walk by the sea?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar le. It-temp ddeterjora u beda jagħmel ħafna riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar le. It-temp ddeterjora u beda jagħmel ħafna riħ.
messages.zh: 最好别去了。天气变坏了，风也刮得很大。
messages.en: Better not. The weather has deteriorated, and it has become very windy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把晴天变成狂风、完好的墙壁逐渐破损这两幅画面连起来，记住 ddeterjora 表示状况变差。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show clearly how something works or that something is true, using an example, an action, or evidence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过实例、操作或证据，清楚展示事物如何运作或证明某事属实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri b'mod ċar kif taħdem xi ħaġa jew li xi ħaġa hija vera, permezz ta' eżempju, azzjoni jew provi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 演示；清楚展示；用实例或证据证明。

formal.mt: Matul it-taħriġ, Mark ddimostra kif jintuża t-tagħmir b'mod sigur.
formal.en: During the training, Mark demonstrated how to use the equipment safely.
formal.zh: 培训期间，马克演示了如何安全使用设备。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Taf kif taħdem din il-magna? Pawlu: Iva, Mark ddimostra kif taħdem dalgħodu. Nista' nurik.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you know how this machine works? Pawlu: Yes, Mark demonstrated how it works this morning. I can show you.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你知道这台机器怎么用吗？保罗：知道，马克今天早上演示过。我可以教你。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你知道这台机器怎么用吗？
messages.en: Do you know how this machine works?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Mark ddimostra kif taħdem dalgħodu. Nista' nurik.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Mark ddimostra kif taħdem dalgħodu. Nista' nurik.
messages.zh: 知道，马克今天早上演示过。我可以教你。
messages.en: Yes, Mark demonstrated how it works this morning. I can show you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师一边操作一边说“看，就是这样”，把 ddimostra 与亲自演示、拿出证据的动作联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lose hope because a situation seems impossible to improve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因为觉得处境无法改善而失去希望、陷入绝望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef it-tama għax iħoss li s-sitwazzjoni ma tistax titjieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绝望；对处境失去希望。

collocations.en: despaired when he heard the news
collocations.zh: 听到消息时失去了希望

formal.mt: Il-karattru prinċipali ddispra meta tilef kull tama li jsib lil ħuh.
formal.en: The main character despaired when he lost all hope of finding his brother.
formal.zh: 主人公在完全失去找到兄弟的希望时陷入了绝望。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kif ħassu Pawlu wara l-eżami? Maja: Għall-ewwel ddispra għax ħaseb li ma għaddiex, imma issa qed jistenna r-riżultat.
colloquial.en: Lina: How did Pawlu feel after the exam? Maja: At first he despaired because he thought he had failed, but now he is waiting for the result.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：保罗考完试感觉怎么样？玛雅：起初他以为自己没及格，感到很绝望，不过现在正在等成绩。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.zh: 保罗考完试感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How did Pawlu feel after the exam?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-ewwel ddispra għax ħaseb li ma għaddiex, imma issa qed jistenna r-riżultat.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-ewwel ddispra għax ħaseb li ma għaddiex, imma issa qed jistenna r-riżultat.
messages.zh: 起初他以为自己没及格，感到很绝望，不过现在正在等成绩。
messages.en: At first he despaired because he thought he had failed, but now he is waiting for the result.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象希望的小灯暂时熄灭，一个人低下头说“没有办法了”，用这个场景记住 ddispra 的绝望含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name used to identify a person as a member of the Debrincat family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 姓氏，用于标明某人的家族姓为 Debrincat。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jidentifika persuna bħala membru tal-familja Debrincat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个姓氏，书写时首字母大写：Debrincat。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Debrincat bagħtet l-applikazzjoni tagħha qabel id-data tal-għeluq.
formal.en: Ms Debrincat submitted her application before the closing date.
formal.zh: Debrincat 女士在截止日期前提交了申请。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għandi appuntament mas-Sur Debrincat. Mark: Tajjeb, is-Sur Debrincat qed jistenniek fl-uffiċċju.
colloquial.en: Lina: I have an appointment with Mr Debrincat. Mark: All right, Mr Debrincat is waiting for you in the office.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：我和 Debrincat 先生有预约。马克：好的，Debrincat 先生正在办公室等您。

messages.speaker: Lina (访客)
messages.zh: 我和 Debrincat 先生有预约。
messages.en: I have an appointment with Mr Debrincat.

messages.speaker: Mark (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, is-Sur Debrincat qed jistenniek fl-uffiċċju.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, is-Sur Debrincat qed jistenniek fl-uffiċċju.
messages.zh: 好的，Debrincat 先生正在办公室等您。
messages.en: All right, Mr Debrincat is waiting for you in the office.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张门牌写着“家庭：Debrincat”，提醒自己这是姓氏，实际姓名中的首字母要大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A decline in quality or condition, or a reduction in a person's rank or position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 质量或状况的退化、恶化，也可指某人被降低级别或职位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fil-kwalità jew deterjorament fil-qagħda ta' xi ħaġa, jew tnaqqis fil-grad jew fil-kariga ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 退化、恶化；降级、降职。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi d-degradazzjoni tal-ħamrija u jipproponi miżuri biex titħares.
formal.en: The report describes soil degradation and proposes measures to protect the soil.
formal.zh: 报告描述了土壤退化的情况，并提出了保护土壤的措施。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Mark għadu jmexxi t-tim? Pawlu: Le, wara d-degradazzjoni tiegħu issa għandu rwol b'inqas responsabbiltà.
colloquial.en: Lina: Is Mark still leading the team? Pawlu: No, after his demotion he now has a role with less responsibility.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：马克还在带领团队吗？保罗：没有，他被降职后，现在的岗位职责少了一些。

messages.speaker: Lina (同事)
messages.zh: 马克还在带领团队吗？
messages.en: Is Mark still leading the team?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, wara d-degradazzjoni tiegħu issa għandu rwol b'inqas responsabbiltà.
messages.mt_standard: Le, wara d-degradazzjoni tiegħu issa għandu rwol b'inqas responsabbiltà.
messages.zh: 没有，他被降职后，现在的岗位职责少了一些。
messages.en: No, after his demotion he now has a role with less responsibility.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一支向下的箭头记住两个方向：物的质量往下降是退化，人的职位往下降是降职。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extremely narrow, with very little space from one side to the other.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容两侧之间空间极小，非常狭窄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dejjaq ħafna, bi ftit li xejn spazju bejn naħa u oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常狭窄的；极窄的。

formal.mt: Il-passaġġ bejn iż-żewġ binjiet huwa dejjaq katusa, u għalhekk ma jistax jgħaddi minnu tagħmir kbir.
formal.en: The passage between the two buildings is very narrow, so large equipment cannot pass through it.
formal.zh: 两座建筑之间的通道非常狭窄，因此大型设备无法通过。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nistgħu ngħaddu s-sufan minn hawn? Sara: Ma naħsibx. Il-kuritur dejjaq katusa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can we get the sofa through here? Sara: I don't think so. The corridor is very narrow.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们能把沙发从这里搬过去吗？萨拉：我觉得不行。走廊实在太窄了。

messages.speaker: Mark (搬家的朋友)
messages.zh: 我们能把沙发从这里搬过去吗？
messages.en: Can we get the sofa through here?

messages.speaker: Sara (帮忙的朋友)
messages.zh: 我觉得不行。走廊实在太窄了。
messages.en: I don't think so. The corridor is very narrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象搬沙发时卡在狭窄走廊里，记住整个短语 dejjaq katusa 表示窄得很，不必拆词推测来源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state or tendency of moral or cultural decline, often associated with excessive luxury and pleasure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 道德或文化走向衰颓的状态或倾向，常与过度追求奢华和享乐有关。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat jew tendenza ta' tnaqqis fil-valuri morali jew kulturali, spiss marbutin ma' lussu u pjaċiri eċċessivi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颓废；道德或文化的衰颓，常带有沉迷奢华享乐的意味。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-awtur juri d-dekadentiżmu ta' soċjetà li tagħti aktar importanza lill-lussu milli lir-responsabbiltà.
formal.en: In the novel, the author depicts the decadence of a society that values luxury more than responsibility.
formal.zh: 小说中，作者描绘了一个重奢华而轻责任的社会所呈现的颓废。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex sejjaħt dik ix-xena eżempju ta' dekadentiżmu? Pawlu: Għax il-karattri jaħsbu biss fil-festi u fil-lussu, u jinsew kull responsabbiltà.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you call that scene an example of decadence? Pawlu: Because the characters think only about parties and luxury, and forget every responsibility.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说那个场景体现了颓废？保罗：因为人物只想着聚会和奢华，把所有责任都抛在脑后。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex sejjaħt dik ix-xena eżempju ta' dekadentiżmu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex sejjaħt dik ix-xena eżempju ta' dekadentiżmu?
messages.zh: 你为什么说那个场景体现了颓废？
messages.en: Why did you call that scene an example of decadence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-karattri jaħsbu biss fil-festi u fil-lussu, u jinsew kull responsabbiltà.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-karattri jaħsbu biss fil-festi u fil-lussu, u jinsew kull responsabbiltà.
messages.zh: 因为人物只想着聚会和奢华，把所有责任都抛在脑后。
messages.en: Because the characters think only about parties and luxury, and forget every responsibility.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小说中一场奢华宴会，人物只顾享乐而忘记责任，用这个文学画面记住 dekadentiżmu 的颓废意味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Authorization allowing someone to act or vote on another person's behalf.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 允许他人代表自己办事或投票的委托或代理授权。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Awtorizzazzjoni mogħtija lil persuna biex taġixxi jew tivvota f'isem persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 代理授权；委托他人代表自己行事或投票的授权。

collocations.en: written authorization to act as a proxy

formal.mt: Il-membru ta delega bil-miktub lil persuna oħra biex tivvota f'ismu waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The member gave another person written authorization to vote on his behalf at the meeting.
formal.zh: 该成员书面授权另一人在会议上代表他投票。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għada ma nistax niġi għal-laqgħa. Nista' nagħtik delega biex tivvota f'ismi? Pawlu: Iva, ġib id-delega bil-miktub illum.
colloquial.en: Marija: I can't come to the meeting tomorrow. Can I authorize you to vote on my behalf? Pawlu: Yes, bring the written proxy authorization today.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我明天没法来开会，可以委托你代表我投票吗？Pawlu：可以，今天把书面代理授权带来。

messages.speaker: Marija (协会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada ma nistax niġi għal-laqgħa. Nista' nagħtik delega biex tivvota f'ismi?
messages.mt_standard: Għada ma nistax niġi għal-laqgħa. Nista' nagħtik delega biex tivvota f'ismi?
messages.zh: 我明天没法来开会，可以委托你代表我投票吗？
messages.en: I can't come to the meeting tomorrow. Can I authorize you to vote on my behalf?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (协会成员)
messages.zh: 可以，今天把书面代理授权带来。
messages.en: Yes, bring the written proxy authorization today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 delega 联想成一张“请你代表我”的授权纸；用 delega bil-miktub 记住书面授权，用 jivvota b'delega 记住代理投票。

gloss_zh: 脓肿；化脓；溃疡；已不适合役用的牲畜

teaching_sense.en_definition: A localized collection of pus in the body, often forming a swollen, painful area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体局部积聚脓液形成的脓肿，常表现为肿起且疼痛的部位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' materja f'parti tal-ġisem, li spiss tkun minfuħa u tweġġa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脓肿；身体组织内局部积聚脓液形成的病灶。
化脓；组织内形成脓液的过程或状态。
溃疡；皮肤或黏膜破损形成的疮面。
脓肿；溃疡，指局部积脓或组织表面破损形成的病灶。

sense_translations.en_definition: an animal no longer good for work
sense_translations.zh_definition: 已不再适合干活或服役的牲畜。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport ġie nnutat li l-pazjent kellu demla fuq id-driegħ tax-xellug.
formal.en: The report noted that the patient had an abscess on his left arm.
formal.zh: 报告记载，该患者左臂上有一处脓肿。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex ma ġejtx għax-xogħol ilbieraħ? Mark: Kelli demla fuq id-driegħ u mort għand it-tabib.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why didn't you come to work yesterday? Mark: I had an abscess on my arm and went to the doctor.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你昨天怎么没来上班？Mark：我手臂上长了个脓肿，去看医生了。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 你昨天怎么没来上班？
messages.en: Why didn't you come to work yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli demla fuq id-driegħ u mort għand it-tabib.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli demla fuq id-driegħ u mort għand it-tabib.
messages.zh: 我手臂上长了个脓肿，去看医生了。
messages.en: I had an abscess on my arm and went to the doctor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 demla 放进“手臂上鼓起一个脓包”的画面来记；化脓是过程，脓肿和溃疡是病灶，另用一张牲畜卡片单独记住“不再适合役用”的义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a fistula or having the form of a fistula.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容具有瘘管或呈瘘管形态的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu fistula jew li għandu l-għamla ta' fistula.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有瘘管的；瘘管状的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jiddeskrivi passaġġ demli.
formal.en: The medical report describes a fistulous passage.
formal.zh: 医学报告描述了一条瘘管通道。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'demli' f'dan ir-rapport? Mark: Hawnhekk ifisser li l-passaġġ għandu l-għamla ta' fistula.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'demli' mean in this report? Mark: Here it means that the passage has the form of a fistula.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这份报告里的 demli 是什么意思？马克：这里指这条通道呈瘘管状。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这份报告里的 demli 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'demli' mean in this report?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk ifisser li l-passaġġ għandu l-għamla ta' fistula.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk ifisser li l-passaġġ għandu l-għamla ta' fistula.
messages.zh: 这里指这条通道呈瘘管状。
messages.en: Here it means that the passage has the form of a fistula.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 demli 和“瘘管通道”的示意图一起记：它是描述有瘘管或呈瘘管状的形容词，练习时连读 passaġġ demli。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be established or worked out using available information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够依据已有信息加以确定或推算的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jiġi stabbilit jew ikkalkulat abbażi tal-informazzjoni disponibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可确定的；可判定的；能够查明或推算出来的。

formal.mt: L-ammont finali huwa determinabbli abbażi tad-data fit-tabella.
formal.en: The final amount is determinable from the data in the table.
formal.zh: 最终金额可依据表中的数据确定。

colloquial.mt: Nina: L-ammont finali huwa determinabbli issa? Pawlu: Iva, għandna l-prezzijiet kollha u nistgħu nikkalkulawh.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can the final amount be determined now? Pawlu: Yes, we have all the prices and can calculate it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：现在能确定最终金额了吗？保罗：能，我们已经有所有价格，可以算出来。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 现在能确定最终金额了吗？
messages.en: Can the final amount be determined now?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna l-prezzijiet kollha u nistgħu nikkalkulawh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna l-prezzijiet kollha u nistgħu nikkalkulawh.
messages.zh: 能，我们已经有所有价格，可以算出来。
messages.en: Yes, we have all the prices and can calculate it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 determinabbli 时想象一张资料齐全的价格表：金额“能够确定”，但未必“已经确定”，抓住这个可能性含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of working out the meaning of writing, symbols, or a code that is difficult to understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 辨认并理解难懂文字、符号或密码含义的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih wieħed jifhem kitba, simboli jew kodiċi li jkunu diffiċli biex jinqraw jew jinftiehmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 辨读；破译；解读难懂文字或密码的过程。

formal.mt: Id-deċifrazzjoni tal-messaġġ kienet teħtieġ analiżi bir-reqqa tas-simboli.
formal.en: Deciphering the message required a careful analysis of the symbols.
formal.zh: 破译这条信息需要仔细分析其中的符号。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fhimt x'jgħid dan il-messaġġ? Mark: Għadni le. Id-deċifrazzjoni tiegħu qed tieħu aktar ħin milli ħsibt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you worked out what this message says? Mark: Not yet. Deciphering it is taking longer than I thought.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你弄明白这条信息写的是什么了吗？马克：还没有。破译它花的时间比我想的长。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你弄明白这条信息写的是什么了吗？
messages.en: Have you worked out what this message says?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le. Id-deċifrazzjoni tiegħu qed tieħu aktar ħin milli ħsibt.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le. Id-deċifrazzjoni tiegħu qed tieħu aktar ħin milli ħsibt.
messages.zh: 还没有。破译它花的时间比我想的长。
messages.en: Not yet. Deciphering it is taking longer than I thought.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一串看不懂的符号逐个换成能读懂的文字，整个解谜过程就是 deċifrazzjoni。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of bleak emptiness or abandonment, or a deep feeling of loneliness and sorrow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地方空荡、荒废的凄凉状态，也指人内心深切的孤寂和悲苦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' vojt u abbandun f'post, jew sens qawwi ta' solitudni u niket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 荒凉、凄凉的状态；深切的孤寂悲苦。

formal.mt: Wara l-maltemp, id-deżolazzjoni fir-raħal kienet tidher fit-toroq vojta u fid-djar imġarrfa.
formal.en: After the storm, the village's desolation was visible in its empty streets and ruined houses.
formal.zh: 暴风雨过后，村庄的凄凉景象体现在空荡的街道和倒塌的房屋中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan il-post jagħtini sens ta' deżolazzjoni? Mark: Għax id-djar huma vojta u ma tara lil ħadd fit-triq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does this place give me a feeling of desolation? Mark: Because the houses are empty and you don't see anyone in the street.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么这个地方让我感到这么凄凉？Mark：因为房子都空着，街上一个人也看不到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-post jagħtini sens ta' deżolazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-post jagħtini sens ta' deżolazzjoni?
messages.zh: 为什么这个地方让我感到这么凄凉？
messages.en: Why does this place give me a feeling of desolation?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax id-djar huma vojta u ma tara lil ħadd fit-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Għax id-djar huma vojta u ma tara lil ħadd fit-triq.
messages.zh: 因为房子都空着，街上一个人也看不到。
messages.en: Because the houses are empty and you don't see anyone in the street.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把空街、废屋和孤独的人连成一幅画：deżolazzjoni 既能描写眼前的荒凉，也能描写内心的凄凉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of sadness, sorrow, or emotional distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因失去、离别或其他不如意的事情而产生的悲伤、忧愁或内心痛苦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' niket, swied il-qalb jew tbatija emozzjonali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈的内心痛苦；极度悲痛。
忧郁；低沉而绵延的悲伤情绪。
悲伤；难过。
深重的痛苦；悲苦。
悲痛；忧伤；内心的煎熬。
哮喘，属于呼吸系统疾病的义项，须与表示悲伤的情绪义区分。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tagħha, l-awtriċi esprimiet id-diqa li ħasset meta telqet minn pajjiżha.
formal.en: In her letter, the author expressed the sadness she felt when she left her country.
formal.zh: 作者在信中表达了离开祖国时感受到的悲伤。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għandek dik id-diqa kollha llum? Pawlu: Il-ħabib tiegħi telaq jgħix barra, u diġà qed inħoss in-nuqqas tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you so sad today? Pawlu: My friend has moved abroad, and I already miss him.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你今天怎么这么难过？Pawlu：我的朋友搬到国外生活了，我已经开始想念他了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandek dik id-diqa kollha llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandek dik id-diqa kollha llum?
messages.zh: 你今天怎么这么难过？
messages.en: Why are you so sad today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħabib tiegħi telaq jgħix barra, u diġà qed inħoss in-nuqqas tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħabib tiegħi telaq jgħix barra, u diġà qed inħoss in-nuqqas tiegħu.
messages.zh: 我的朋友搬到国外生活了，我已经开始想念他了。
messages.en: My friend has moved abroad, and I already miss him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diqa 放进朋友离别的场景，联想心里的难过、忧郁和悲痛；另用一张呼吸示意图单独记住“哮喘”义，避免混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The reproductive female bee in a colony, whose main role is to lay eggs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蜂群中主要负责产卵的雌蜂，即蜂王。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-naħla femminili f'kolonja li għandha r-rwol ewlieni li tbid il-bajd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜂王；蜂群中主要负责产卵的雌蜂。

formal.mt: Id-duqqajsa għandha rwol importanti fil-kolonja għax tbid il-bajd.
formal.en: The queen bee has an important role in the colony because she lays eggs.
formal.zh: 蜂王负责产卵，因此在蜂群中发挥着重要作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema waħda hi d-duqqajsa f'dan ir-ritratt? Pawlu: Dik fin-nofs. Qed tara kemm hemm naħal madwarha?
colloquial.en: Maja: Which one is the queen bee in this photo? Pawlu: The one in the middle. Can you see how many bees are around her?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张照片里哪一只是蜂王？保罗：中间那只。你看到它周围有多少蜜蜂了吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema waħda hi d-duqqajsa f'dan ir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Liema waħda hi d-duqqajsa f'dan ir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 这张照片里哪一只是蜂王？
messages.en: Which one is the queen bee in this photo?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik fin-nofs. Qed tara kemm hemm naħal madwarha?
messages.mt_standard: Dik fin-nofs. Qed tara kemm hemm naħal madwarha?
messages.zh: 中间那只。你看到它周围有多少蜜蜂了吗？
messages.en: The one in the middle. Can you see how many bees are around her?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 duqqajsa 配上一幅蜂王被蜜蜂围绕的图，再用“蜂王负责产卵”这句话巩固词义；这是情景记忆法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bird of the bunting species Emberiza aureola, known in English as the yellow-breasted bunting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鹀类鸟的一种，学名为 Emberiza aureola，中文名为黄胸鹀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Emberiza aureola, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala yellow-breasted bunting.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄胸鹀（Emberiza aureola），一种鹀类鸟。

collocations.en: a photograph of a yellow-breasted bunting
an observation of a yellow-breasted bunting

formal.mt: Il-gwida tinkludi ritratt tad-durrajsa ħamra u tagħti l-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Emberiza aureola.
formal.en: The guide includes a photograph of the yellow-breasted bunting and gives its scientific name, Emberiza aureola.
formal.zh: 这本指南收录了黄胸鹀的照片，并列出了它的学名 Emberiza aureola。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fil-ktieb? Mark: Durrajsa ħamra. Bl-Ingliż jismu yellow-breasted bunting.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this bird in the book called? Mark: A durrajsa ħamra. In English, it is called a yellow-breasted bunting.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：书里的这只鸟叫什么？马克：马耳他语叫 durrajsa ħamra，英语叫 yellow-breasted bunting，也就是黄胸鹀。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 书里的这只鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is this bird in the book called?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Durrajsa ħamra. Bl-Ingliż jismu yellow-breasted bunting.
messages.mt_standard: Durrajsa ħamra. Bl-Ingliż jismu yellow-breasted bunting.
messages.zh: 马耳他语叫 durrajsa ħamra，英语叫 yellow-breasted bunting，也就是黄胸鹀。
messages.en: A durrajsa ħamra. In English, it is called a yellow-breasted bunting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 durrajsa ħamra 作为完整鸟名，与“黄胸鹀”和学名 Emberiza aureola 写在同一张图片卡上，整体对应记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that achieves the intended result while making good use of time, effort, and resources.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以充分利用时间、精力和资源的方式达到预期结果；高效地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jikseb ir-riżultat mixtieq billi juża tajjeb il-ħin, l-isforz u r-riżorsi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 高效地；以较少的时间、精力或资源取得所需结果。

formal.mt: Billi qasam ix-xogħol skont il-ħiliet tal-membri, it-tim lesta l-proġett effiċjentement.
formal.en: By dividing the work according to the members' skills, the team completed the project efficiently.
formal.zh: 团队根据成员的技能分配工作，从而高效地完成了项目。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif lestejt kollox daqshekk malajr? | Mark: Għamilt lista u ħdimt effiċjentement, mingħajr ma qgħadt infittex l-affarijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did you finish everything so quickly? | Mark: I made a list and worked efficiently, without spending time looking for things.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你怎么这么快就把事情都做完了？ | 马克：我列了清单，高效地做事，没有把时间花在找东西上。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你怎么这么快就把事情都做完了？
messages.en: How did you finish everything so quickly?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt lista u ħdimt effiċjentement, mingħajr ma qgħadt infittex l-affarijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt lista u ħdimt effiċjentement, mingħajr ma qgħadt infittex l-affarijiet.
messages.zh: 我列了清单，高效地做事，没有把时间花在找东西上。
messages.en: I made a list and worked efficiently, without spending time looking for things.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 effiċjentement 配上“先列清单，再顺利完成”的画面；它说明动作做得高效，重点是善用时间和资源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reduce spending or use money, materials, or other resources carefully so that less is wasted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 减少开支，或谨慎使用金钱、材料及其他资源，以减少浪费。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas l-ispejjeż jew juża l-flus, il-materjal u riżorsi oħra bil-għaqal biex jevita l-ħela.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 节省；减少开支；节约使用金钱或其他资源。

formal.mt: In-negozju ekonomizza fuq l-ispejjeż billi kera uffiċċju iżgħar.
formal.en: The business economized on expenses by renting a smaller office.
formal.zh: 这家企业通过租用较小的办公室节省了开支。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif irnexxielu Mark ifaddal għall-vjaġġ? | Maja: Ekonomizza fuq l-ikel barra u beda jsajjar id-dar.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Mark manage to save up for the trip? | Maja: He economized on eating out and started cooking at home.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克是怎么攒够旅行的钱的？ | 玛雅：他减少了外出吃饭的开销，开始在家做饭。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克是怎么攒够旅行的钱的？
messages.en: How did Mark manage to save up for the trip?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ekonomizza fuq l-ikel barra u beda jsajjar id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Ekonomizza fuq l-ikel barra u beda jsajjar id-dar.
messages.zh: 他减少了外出吃饭的开销，开始在家做饭。
messages.en: He economized on eating out and started cooking at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把外出吃饭的钱省下来放进旅行储蓄罐，用这个动作记 ekonomizza：减少开销、节约使用资源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring weights, forces, or other factors into balance, or to offset one with another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使重量、力量或其他因素达到平衡，或用一个因素抵消另一个因素的影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib piżijiet, forzi jew fatturi oħra f'bilanċ, jew juża wieħed biex ipatti għall-effett ta' ieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: to balance, to equilibrate, to counterbalance
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使平衡；使达到均衡；以相反的重量、力量或影响进行抵消。

collocations.zh: 对车轮进行了平衡调整

formal.mt: It-tekniku ekwilibra r-rota billi żied piż żgħir fuq naħa waħda.
formal.en: The technician balanced the wheel by adding a small weight on one side.
formal.zh: 技术人员在车轮的一侧加上一个小配重，使车轮达到平衡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark poġġa borża oħra fuq in-naħa l-oħra tal-karrettun? | Pawlu: Hekk ekwilibra l-piż, u issa l-karrettun ma jmilx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark put another bag on the other side of the cart? | Pawlu: That balanced the weight, and now the cart does not tilt.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么在小推车的另一边又放了一个袋子？ | 保罗：这样就平衡了重量，现在小推车不会歪了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark poġġa borża oħra fuq in-naħa l-oħra tal-karrettun?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark poġġa borża oħra fuq in-naħa l-oħra tal-karrettun?
messages.zh: 马克为什么在小推车的另一边又放了一个袋子？
messages.en: Why did Mark put another bag on the other side of the cart?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hekk ekwilibra l-piż, u issa l-karrettun ma jmilx.
messages.mt_standard: Hekk ekwilibra l-piż, u issa l-karrettun ma jmilx.
messages.zh: 这样就平衡了重量，现在小推车不会歪了。
messages.en: That balanced the weight, and now the cart does not tilt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一辆向左倾斜的小推车，在右边补上一个袋子后恢复平衡；ekwilibra 就是这个“使两边均衡”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of supplying a place or system with electricity, or converting equipment or transport to electric power.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为地区或系统提供电力，或把设备、交通运输等改为使用电力的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih post jew sistema jingħataw provvista tal-elettriku, jew tagħmir u trasport jinbidlu biex jaħdmu bl-elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电气化；向地区或系统供电，或使设备、交通运输等改用电力的过程。

collocations.en: the electrification of the railway line

formal.mt: Il-pjan jipproponi l-elettrizzazzjoni tal-linja ferrovjarja sabiex il-ferroviji jkunu jistgħu jaħdmu bl-elettriku.
formal.en: The plan proposes electrifying the railway line so that the trains can run on electricity.
formal.zh: 该计划提出对铁路线进行电气化改造，使列车能够使用电力运行。

messages.speaker: Lara (乘客)

gloss_zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国；阿联酋

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 阿拉伯联合酋长国，简称阿联酋，是位于中东地区、西亚的一个国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Asja tal-Punent, fil-Lvant Nofsani, magħruf bħala l-Emirati Għarab Magħquda.

sense_translations.en_definition: United Arab Emirates (a country in West Asia in the Middle East)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 阿拉伯联合酋长国，简称阿联酋，位于中东地区的西亚国家。

collocations.zh: 住在阿拉伯联合酋长国
来自阿拉伯联合酋长国

formal.en: In her school report, the student identified the United Arab Emirates as a country in West Asia.
formal.zh: 这名学生在学校报告中指出，阿拉伯联合酋长国是一个西亚国家。

gloss_zh: 精力充沛的；充满活力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having or showing a great deal of energy and enthusiasm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 精力旺盛、热情充足，或在行动和表现中充满活力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu jew juri ħafna enerġija u ħeġġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精力充沛的；充满活力的。

formal.mt: Il-kantant żagħżugħ ta wirja bi stil enerġetiku li qanqal l-entużjażmu tal-udjenza.
formal.en: The young singer gave a performance in an energetic style that stirred the audience's enthusiasm.
formal.zh: 这位年轻歌手以充满活力的风格演出，激发了观众的热情。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħuk għadu jiġri wara l-logħba kollha? Mark: Iva, dejjem kien enerġetiku!
colloquial.en: Sara: Is your brother still running after the whole game? Mark: Yes, he's always been energetic!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：整场比赛结束后，你弟弟还在跑吗？马克：是啊，他一直都精力充沛！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk għadu jiġri wara l-logħba kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk għadu jiġri wara l-logħba kollha?
messages.zh: 整场比赛结束后，你弟弟还在跑吗？
messages.en: Is your brother still running after the whole game?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，他一直都精力充沛！
messages.en: Yes, he's always been energetic!

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想英语 energetic，脑中放一个比赛结束后还在跑的男孩，把 enerġetiku 与“精力充沛”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reference work containing information about many subjects or many aspects of one subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 汇集多种学科知识或某一领域各方面知识、供人查阅的工具书。

formal.en: The students consulted an encyclopedia to gather information about the planets.
formal.zh: 学生们查阅百科全书，收集有关行星的知识。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nista' nsib tagħrif dwar il-vulkani? Pawlu: Ħares f'din l-enċiklopedija; fiha wkoll stampi sbieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I find information about volcanoes? Pawlu: Look in this encyclopedia; it also has lovely pictures.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我在哪里能找到有关火山的知识？保罗：看看这本百科全书，里面还有漂亮的图片。

messages.zh: 我在哪里能找到有关火山的知识？

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares f'din l-enċiklopedija; fiha wkoll stampi sbieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares f'din l-enċiklopedija; fiha wkoll stampi sbieħ.

gloss_zh: 勃起；建筑物的建造、竖立

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state in which the penis becomes firm and enlarged, or the act of putting up a building or structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指阴茎变硬、增大的生理状态；也指建筑物或构筑物的建造、竖立。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat li fih il-pene jsir iebes u jikber, jew l-att li jinbena bini jew tittella' struttura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勃起，通常指阴茎变硬、增大的生理状态。
建筑物的建造、兴建或竖立。

formal.mt: Il-fuljett mediku jispjega li l-erezzjoni tal-pene tinvolvi żieda fil-fluss tad-demm.
formal.en: The medical leaflet explains that an erection of the penis involves an increase in blood flow.
formal.zh: 医学宣传册解释说，阴茎勃起涉及血流增加。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'erezzjoni' f'dan id-dokument? David: Hawn qed jitkellmu dwar l-erezzjoni ta' bini ġdid, jiġifieri l-bini tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'erezzjoni' mean in this document? David: Here they're talking about the erection of a new building, meaning its construction.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这份文件里的 erezzjoni 是什么意思？戴维：这里说的是一栋新建筑的兴建，也就是把它建起来。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)

messages.mt_standard: Hawn qed jitkellmu dwar l-erezzjoni ta' bini ġdid, jiġifieri l-bini tiegħu.
messages.zh: 这里说的是一栋新建筑的兴建，也就是把它建起来。
messages.en: Here they're talking about the erection of a new building, meaning its construction.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张语境卡：医学卡写“勃起”，建筑卡写“兴建”。遇到 erezzjoni，先看附近是 pene 还是 bini，再选择词义。

gloss_zh: 仿英雄体的；以英雄史诗腔调制造滑稽效果的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Treating a trivial subject in the grand style of heroic literature to create a comic effect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用英雄文学或史诗般的庄严风格描写琐事，从而产生滑稽效果的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jittratta suġġett żgħir jew trivjali bi stil grandjuż ta' letteratura erojka biex joħloq effett komiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仿英雄体的；以庄严的英雄文学风格描写琐事而产生诙谐效果的。

formal.mt: L-awtur juża ton erojkomiku biex jiddeskrivi t-tfittxija għal kuċċarina mitlufa bħallikieku kienet missjoni ta' eroj.
formal.en: The author uses a mock-heroic tone to describe the search for a lost teaspoon as though it were a hero's mission.
formal.zh: 作者采用仿英雄体语调，把寻找丢失茶匙的过程写得仿佛是一项英雄使命。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-poeta jagħmel daqshekk għaġeb dwar biċċa kejk? Toni: Qed juża stil erojkomiku; jagħmel ħaġa żgħira tidher qisha avventura kbira.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does the poet make such a fuss about a piece of cake? Toni: He's using a mock-heroic style; he makes a small thing seem like a great adventure.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：诗人为什么把一块蛋糕写得如此惊天动地？托尼：他在用仿英雄体，把小事写得像一场大冒险。

messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-poeta jagħmel daqshekk għaġeb dwar biċċa kejk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-poeta jagħmel daqshekk għaġeb dwar biċċa kejk?
messages.zh: 诗人为什么把一块蛋糕写得如此惊天动地？
messages.en: Why does the poet make such a fuss about a piece of cake?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)

gloss_zh: 色情的；具有性挑逗意味的

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与性欲有关，或旨在引起性方面兴趣、兴奋和挑逗感的。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 色情的；涉及或表现性欲的。
具有性挑逗意味的；令人产生性方面的好奇或兴奋的。

formal.mt: Ir-reċensjoni tanalizza kif il-kontenut erotiku tar-rumanz jirrifletti x-xewqat tal-karattri.

formal.zh: 这篇评论分析了小说中的情色内容如何反映人物的欲望。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan ir-rumanz hu adattat għall-grupp tagħna ta' qarrejja adulti? Ġorġ: Fih kontenut erotiku; tajjeb li nsemmuh meta nippreżentaw il-ktieb.

colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这本小说适合我们的成人读书小组吗？乔治：里面有情色内容，我们介绍这本书时应该说明。

messages.speaker: Marta (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-rumanz hu adattat għall-grupp tagħna ta' qarrejja adulti?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-rumanz hu adattat għall-grupp tagħna ta' qarrejja adulti?

gloss_zh: 夸大；言过其实；对某事过分挑剔

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something seem greater or more extreme than it is, or to make too much fuss about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把事情说得比实际更大、更严重或更极端；也指对某事过分讲究、挑剔或小题大做。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jippreżenta xi ħaġa bħala akbar jew aktar estrema milli hi, jew jagħmel wisq għaġeb dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夸大；夸张地描述，使事情显得超过实际程度。
夸大；言过其实。
对某事过分挑剔、过分讲究或小题大做。

collocations.en: he made too much fuss about a small detail
collocations.zh: 他对一个小细节过分挑剔

formal.mt: L-awtur esaġera d-daqs tal-problema meta sostna li kienet taffettwa lill-istudenti kollha.
formal.en: The author exaggerated the scale of the problem when he claimed that it affected all the students.
formal.zh: 作者声称问题影响了所有学生，夸大了问题的规模。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Luqa qal li stenna tliet sigħat! Ben: Esaġera; wasal għaxar minuti ilu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Luqa said he waited three hours! Ben: He exaggerated; he arrived ten minutes ago.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：卢卡说他等了三个小时！本：他夸大了，他十分钟前才到。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Luqa qal li stenna tliet sigħat!
messages.mt_standard: Luqa qal li stenna tliet sigħat!
messages.zh: 卢卡说他等了三个小时！
messages.en: Luqa said he waited three hours!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 他夸大了，他十分钟前才到。

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把“等了十分钟”说成“等了三小时”，记住 esaġera 的“夸大”；再联想为一个小细节反复挑剔，记住“小题大做”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put something on public display, expose someone or something to a condition or danger, or reveal something concealed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品公开陈列；使人或物接触某种条件、暴露于危险；或揭露被隐藏的事实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri xi ħaġa lill-pubbliku, iqiegħed lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa f'kuntatt ma' kundizzjoni jew periklu, jew jikxef xi ħaġa moħbija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 展出；公开陈列或展示。
使暴露；使人或物接触某种环境、条件或危险。
揭露；揭穿；使隐藏的事实或真实面目显现。

collocations.en: he exposed the workers to danger
collocations.zh: 他使工人暴露于危险之中

formal.mt: Il-ġurnalist espona l-qerq permezz ta' dokumenti li wrew kif intefqu l-flus.
formal.en: The journalist exposed the deception through documents showing how the money had been spent.
formal.zh: 记者通过展示资金使用情况的文件揭露了骗局。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Rajt il-pitturi ta' Daniel? Karl: Iva, espona xi xogħlijiet fil-gallerija ħdejn id-dar tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have you seen Daniel's paintings? Karl: Yes, he exhibited some works in the gallery near my house.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你看过丹尼尔的画吗？卡尔：看过，他在我家附近的画廊展出过一些作品。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看过丹尼尔的画吗？
messages.en: Have you seen Daniel's paintings?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, espona xi xogħlijiet fil-gallerija ħdejn id-dar tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, espona xi xogħlijiet fil-gallerija ħdejn id-dar tiegħi.
messages.zh: 看过，他在我家附近的画廊展出过一些作品。
messages.en: Yes, he exhibited some works in the gallery near my house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面记 espona：画挂进展厅是“展出”，工人身处险境是“暴露”，记者公开骗局是“揭露”；靠宾语和语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unusual in behaviour, appearance, or ideas, especially in a way that differs noticeably from ordinary expectations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行为、外表或想法与一般人的习惯明显不同的；古怪或不循常规的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu mġiba, dehra jew ideat mhux tas-soltu u differenti minn dak li normalment jistennew in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 古怪的；行为、外表或想法不循常规的。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru ewlieni huwa raġel eċċentriku li jżejjen kull kamra b'kulur differenti.
formal.en: In the novel, the main character is an eccentric man who decorates each room in a different colour.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，主角是个古怪的男人，他把每个房间都装饰成不同的颜色。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu dejjem jilbes żewġ kalzetti differenti? | Lara: Għandu stil eċċentriku, u hekk jogħġbu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does Pawlu always wear two different socks? | Lara: He has an eccentric style, and he likes it that way.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么总穿两只不一样的袜子？ | 拉拉：他的风格就是有点古怪，他自己喜欢这样。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu dejjem jilbes żewġ kalzetti differenti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu dejjem jilbes żewġ kalzetti differenti?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么总穿两只不一样的袜子？
messages.en: Why does Pawlu always wear two different socks?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu stil eċċentriku, u hekk jogħġbu.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu stil eċċentriku, u hekk jogħġbu.
messages.zh: 他的风格就是有点古怪，他自己喜欢这样。
messages.en: He has an eccentric style, and he likes it that way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 eċċentriku 和“一红一蓝两只袜子”的画面联系起来，记住它形容显得古怪、不循常规的人或风格。

gloss_zh: 特殊性；非同寻常的性质

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being exceptional, either because something is unusually outstanding or because it differs from the normal case.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人或某事非同寻常的性质，可以指格外出色，也可以指不同于一般情况的特殊性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li jispikka b'mod mhux tas-soltu jew li jkun differenti mill-każijiet normali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 特殊性；非同寻常的性质；格外出众的特质。

collocations.en: the exceptional nature of the case
the exceptional quality of the talent

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza l-eċċezzjonalità ta' dan il-każ u jispjega għaliex jeħtieġ attenzjoni speċjali.
formal.en: The report highlights the exceptional nature of this case and explains why it requires special attention.
formal.zh: 报告强调了这一案例的特殊性，并解释了它为何需要特别关注。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tifhem b'eċċezzjonalità f'din is-sentenza? | Mark: Li dan il-każ mhuwiex bħall-oħrajn u għandu jitqies għalih.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you mean by exceptionality in this sentence? | Mark: That this case is different from the others and should be considered separately.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句话里的“特殊性”是什么意思？ | 马克：就是这个案例和其他案例不同，应该单独考虑。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这句话里的“特殊性”是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean by exceptionality in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Li dan il-każ mhuwiex bħall-oħrajn u għandu jitqies għalih.
messages.mt_standard: Li dan il-każ mhuwiex bħall-oħrajn u għandu jitqies għalih.
messages.zh: 就是这个案例和其他案例不同，应该单独考虑。
messages.en: That this case is different from the others and should be considered separately.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一排相似的案例中，有一个被单独圈出来；eċċezzjonalità 就是被圈出案例的“特殊性”，也可表示才能的非凡之处。

gloss_zh: 埃及的；埃及人（通常指男性）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Egypt, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 埃及的；来自埃及的；与埃及、埃及人或埃及文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Eġittu jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Eġittu, man-nies tiegħu jew mal-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 埃及的；埃及人的。

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or related to Egypt
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自埃及的；与埃及有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Egyptian (of, from or relating to Egypt)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 埃及的，即属于埃及、来自埃及或与埃及有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Egyptian (native or inhabitant of Egypt) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 埃及人，指出生于埃及的人或埃及居民，通常指男性。

collocations.en: an Egyptian man living in Malta
collocations.zh: 一名住在马耳他的埃及男子

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-festival jinkludi film Eġizzjan u diskussjoni mad-direttur tiegħu.
formal.en: The festival programme includes an Egyptian film and a discussion with its director.
formal.zh: 电影节的节目包括一部埃及电影，以及与该片导演的讨论活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn hu l-istudent il-ġdid? | Lara: Hu Eġizzjan, u qal li jista' jgħallimna nsajru xi ikel Eġizzjan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the new student from? | Lara: He is Egyptian, and he said he can teach us to cook some Egyptian food.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新来的学生是哪里人？ | 拉拉：他是埃及人，还说可以教我们做一些埃及菜。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 新来的学生是哪里人？
messages.en: Where is the new student from?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu Eġizzjan, u qal li jista' jgħallimna nsajru xi ikel Eġizzjan.
messages.mt_standard: Hu Eġizzjan, u qal li jista' jgħallimna nsajru xi ikel Eġizzjan.
messages.zh: 他是埃及人，还说可以教我们做一些埃及菜。
messages.en: He is Egyptian, and he said he can teach us to cook some Egyptian food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“埃及学生端着埃及菜”的画面记 eġizzjan：修饰学生或食物时表示“埃及的”，作名词时可指埃及人，通常为男性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A folder used to organize papers, or a collection of documents kept together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来整理纸张的文件夹，也指集中存放的一组文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kartella li fiha jinżammu karti organizzati, jew ġabra ta' dokumenti miżmuma flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 文件夹；整理和收纳文件的用品。
集中保存的一组文件；卷宗。

collocations.en: put the papers in the file

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju jżomm fajl separat għal kull applikazzjoni.
formal.en: The office keeps a separate file for each application.
formal.zh: 办公室为每份申请单独保存一份档案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-fajl bil-kontijiet? Pawlu: Qiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa, ħdejn il-kotba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the file with the bills? Pawlu: It's on the shelf, next to the books.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：装账单的文件夹在哪里？保罗：在架子上，书的旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 装账单的文件夹在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the file with the bills?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 在架子上，书的旁边。
messages.en: It's on the shelf, next to the books.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把零散账单一起放进文件夹：fajl既可指收纳夹，也可指夹内成套的文件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mushrooms considered collectively or as a type of fungus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蘑菇，可统指若干蘑菇，也可指蘑菇这一类真菌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' fungu; il-kelma tista' tirreferi għal ġabra ta' dawn il-fungi jew għat-tip b'mod ġenerali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物爆裂的东西。
蘑菇，指多个蘑菇或蘑菇的集合。

sense_translations.en_definition: mushroom, mushrooms (several or a mass of them; the species as such)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 蘑菇，可指若干或一堆蘑菇，也可泛指蘑菇这一类。

formal.mt: Il-kok żied il-faqqiegħ mas-soppa qabel servieha.
formal.en: The cook added the mushrooms to the soup before serving it.
formal.zh: 厨师在上汤之前把蘑菇加了进去。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid il-faqqiegħ mal-għaġin? Mark: Iva, jogħġobni ħafna bil-faqqiegħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like mushrooms with the pasta? Mark: Yes, I really like it with mushrooms.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：意面里要加蘑菇吗？马克：要，我很喜欢加蘑菇的意面。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 意面里要加蘑菇吗？
messages.en: Would you like mushrooms with the pasta?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 要，我很喜欢加蘑菇的意面。
messages.en: Yes, I really like it with mushrooms.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一锅蘑菇汤来记faqqiegħ的集合用法；另把“引起爆裂的东西”单独做一张义项卡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A folded paper toy that makes a sharp popping sound when flicked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用纸折成、甩动时能发出清脆响声的玩具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġugarell magħmul minn karta mitwija li jagħmel ħoss qawwi meta wieħed ixejru b'ċaqliqa mgħaġġla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纸响炮；甩动时会发出响声的折纸玩具。

collocations.en: the sound of a paper cracker

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni, l-għalliema wriet lill-istudenti kif jagħmlu faqqusa tal-karti.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher showed the students how to make a paper cracker.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师向学生示范了如何制作纸响炮。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara l-faqqusa tal-karti li għamilt! Luqa: Kif tagħmel dak il-ħoss?
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at the paper cracker I made! Luqa: How does it make that sound?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看我做的纸响炮！卢卡：它怎么会发出那种声音？

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 看我做的纸响炮！
messages.en: Look at the paper cracker I made!

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.zh: 它怎么会发出那种声音？
messages.en: How does it make that sound?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上“折纸后用力一甩，啪地响”的画面，连同纸张和声音一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male bovine animal, described as an ox or a bull.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雄性的牛，可指公牛，也可指作役用的牛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal maskili tal-baqar, li jista' jinżamm għat-tgħammir jew jintuża għax-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 役牛；公牛。
金牛座，天文学中的星座名称。
金牛座，黄道十二宫之一的名称。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-bidwi kien juża l-fart biex jiġbed il-moħriet.
formal.en: The report describes how the farmer used the ox to pull the plough.
formal.zh: 报告描述了农民如何用役牛拉犁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu s-sinjal tiegħek? Rita: Jien tas-sinjal tal-Fart.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is your zodiac sign? Rita: I'm a Taurus.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你是什么星座？丽塔：我是金牛座。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是什么星座？
messages.en: What is your zodiac sign?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 我是金牛座。
messages.en: I'm a Taurus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画三张卡分别记：田里的公牛、星空中的金牛座、谈生日时的金牛座，区分普通名词与专名。

gloss_zh: 淫秽；下流言语；有伤风化的事物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Obscene or grossly indecent language, behavior, or material, especially offensive sexual talk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 淫秽或严重有伤风化的言语、行为或内容，尤其指令人反感的下流话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem, imġiba jew materjal oxxen jew indeċenti ħafna, speċjalment diskors sesswali offensiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淫秽；猥亵言行或内容。

sense_translations.en_definition: obscenity, something outrageous, especially indecent talk
sense_translations.zh_definition: 淫秽或令人愤慨的有伤风化之事，尤其指下流、猥亵的言语。

formal.mt: Ir-regolament tal-klabb jipprojbixxi kliem ta' faħx waqt il-laqgħat.
formal.en: The club's rules prohibit obscene language during meetings.
formal.zh: 俱乐部规定禁止在会议期间使用淫秽言语。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex tlaqt mill-konversazzjoni? Pietru: Kienet mimlija kliem ta' faħx, u ma ridtx nibqa' nisma'.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did you leave the conversation? Pietru: It was full of obscene language, and I didn't want to keep listening.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你为什么退出了谈话？彼得：他们满口下流话，我不想继续听了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么退出了谈话？
messages.en: Why did you leave the conversation?

messages.speaker: Pietru (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet mimlija kliem ta' faħx, u ma ridtx nibqa' nisma'.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet mimlija kliem ta' faħx, u ma ridtx nibqa' nisma'.
messages.zh: 他们满口下流话，我不想继续听了。
messages.en: It was full of obscene language, and I didn't want to keep listening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kliem ta' faħx 整块记成“下流话”，想象听者因言语猥亵而离开谈话的场景，记牢它带有强烈负面评价。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A union of organizations or states that cooperate under a shared structure while retaining some independence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 若干组织或国家在保留一定独立性的同时，按共同架构组成的联合会或联邦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqda ta' organizzazzjonijiet jew stati li jaħdmu flimkien taħt struttura komuni waqt li jżommu ċerta indipendenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 联合会；联邦，由若干成员组织或国家组成的联合体。

formal.mt: Il-federazzjoni sportiva ppubblikat ir-regolamenti l-ġodda għall-kompetizzjoni.
formal.en: The sports federation published the new regulations for the competition.
formal.zh: 体育联合会公布了新的竞赛规则。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-klabb tagħna hu membru tal-federazzjoni? Sara: Iva, u se nibagħtu rappreżentant għal-laqgħa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is our club a member of the federation? Sara: Yes, and we're going to send a representative to the meeting.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们俱乐部是联合会成员吗？萨拉：是的，我们还会派代表去开会。

messages.speaker: Mark (俱乐部会员)
messages.zh: 我们俱乐部是联合会成员吗？
messages.en: Is our club a member of the federation?

messages.speaker: Sara (俱乐部秘书)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u se nibagħtu rappreżentant għal-laqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u se nibagħtu rappreżentant għal-laqgħa.
messages.zh: 是的，我们还会派代表去开会。
messages.en: Yes, and we're going to send a representative to the meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几个俱乐部各有自己的队徽，却一起围桌开会；这幅图帮助记住federazzjoni的联合组织含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool or machine used to cut food or another material into slices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把食物或其他材料切成片的工具或机器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda jew magna li tintuża biex taqta' ikel jew materjal ieħor fi flieli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 切片器；用于把东西切成薄片的工具或机器。
切片器；切片机。

formal.mt: Il-ħanut juża felliel elettriku biex jaqta' l-ħobż fi flieli ndaqs.
formal.en: The shop uses an electric slicer to cut the bread into even slices.
formal.zh: 商店用电动切片机把面包切成厚薄均匀的片。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Fejn hu l-felliel tal-ħobż? Nina: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Where is the bread slicer? Nina: On the table, next to the bread.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：面包切片机在哪里？妮娜：在桌上，面包旁边。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (面包店员工)
messages.zh: 面包切片机在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the bread slicer?

messages.speaker: Nina (面包店同事)
messages.zh: 在桌上，面包旁边。
messages.en: On the table, next to the bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象整条面包经过felliel后变成整齐的一排薄片，用“整条进去、切片出来”的画面记词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a person's family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作个人家族名称的姓氏Fenech，中文可音译为“费内克”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala isem tal-familja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏Fenech，可音译为“费内克”。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Fenech bagħtet l-applikazzjoni lill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: Mrs Fenech sent the application to the office.
formal.zh: 费内克女士把申请寄到了办公室。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kunjom għandek? Mark: Fenech. Jisimni Mark Fenech.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's your surname? Mark: Fenech. My name is Mark Fenech.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你姓什么？马克：费内克。我叫马克·费内克。

messages.speaker: Maja (新同学)
messages.zh: 你姓什么？
messages.en: What's your surname?

messages.speaker: Mark (新同学)
messages.zh: 费内克。我叫马克·费内克。
messages.en: Fenech. My name is Mark Fenech.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在想象的名牌上写“Mark Fenech”，把后半部分框起来标成姓氏，并记住人名中F要大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become familiar with something by learning about it or gaining experience of it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过了解、学习或实际接触，使自己逐渐熟悉某事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir jaf xi ħaġa aħjar billi jitgħallem dwarha jew jikseb esperjenza tagħha; f'dan is-sens jintuża ma' ruħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己熟悉；通过了解或接触而熟悉起来。

collocations.en: he familiarized himself with the system
he familiarized himself with the rules

formal.mt: Qabel beda x-xogħol, l-impjegat ffamiljarizza ruħu mal-proċeduri tal-uffiċċju.
formal.en: Before starting work, the employee familiarized himself with the office procedures.
formal.zh: 开始工作前，这名员工先熟悉了办公室的办事程序。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Diġà ffamiljarizzajt ruħek mas-sistema l-ġdida? Luqa: Iva, issa naf kif nużaha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you familiarized yourself with the new system yet? Luqa: Yes, I know how to use it now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你已经熟悉新系统了吗？卢卡：是的，我现在知道怎么用了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你已经熟悉新系统了吗？
messages.en: Have you familiarized yourself with the new system yet?

messages.speaker: Luqa (新员工)
messages.zh: 是的，我现在知道怎么用了。
messages.en: Yes, I know how to use it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先读说明，再试操作，最后熟悉”三个画面记词，并把ruħu或ruħek一起记成“自己”的提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Without achieving the intended result, despite an effort or attempt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示虽然付出了努力或作了尝试，却没有达到预期结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bla ma jintlaħaq ir-riżultat mixtieq, minkejja l-isforz jew it-tentattiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 徒劳地；没有取得预期结果地。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkaturi fittxew fil-batal dokument li jikkonferma d-data.
formal.en: The researchers searched in vain for a document confirming the date.
formal.zh: 研究人员寻找能够证实该日期的文件，却未能找到。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sibt iċ-ċavetta? Mark: Le, fittixt fil-batal fil-borża kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you find the key? Mark: No, I searched the whole bag in vain.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你找到钥匙了吗？马克：没有，我把整个包都找遍了，还是没找到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你找到钥匙了吗？
messages.en: Did you find the key?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，我把整个包都找遍了，还是没找到。
messages.en: No, I searched the whole bag in vain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把包翻遍仍找不到钥匙：动作做了，结果没来，用 fil-batal 记住“徒劳地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A type of cape known as a ferraiolo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为 ferraiolo 的披风；学习时应将其作为特定服饰名称记忆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' mantell magħruf bħala ferraiolo.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 费拉约洛式披风，一种特定款式的披风。

collocations.zh: 一件黑色费拉约洛式披风

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-wirja jiddeskrivi firjol iswed u jagħti d-dettalji tad-drapp tiegħu.
formal.en: The exhibition catalogue describes a black ferraiolo cape and gives details of its fabric.
formal.zh: 展览目录介绍了一件黑色费拉约洛式披风，并说明了它的面料细节。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak il-mantell fil-vetrina? Pawlu: It-tikketta tgħid li hu firjol.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that cape in the display case? Pawlu: The label says it is a ferraiolo.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：展柜里的那件披风是什么？保罗：标签上说，那是一件费拉约洛式披风。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.zh: 展柜里的那件披风是什么？
messages.en: What is that cape in the display case?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 标签上说，那是一件费拉约洛式披风。
messages.en: The label says it is a ferraiolo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给想象中的展柜披风贴上 firjol 标签，把它当作特定服饰名记忆，避免泛指所有外套。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The iris species whose scientific name is Iris variegata.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Iris variegata 的杂色鸢尾这一植物物种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' fjurduliż li l-isem xjentifiku tagħha huwa Iris variegata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杂色鸢尾，学名为 Iris variegata 的植物。

formal.mt: It-tikketta fil-ġnien botaniku tagħti l-isem fjurduliż imżewwaq u l-isem xjentifiku Iris variegata.
formal.en: The label in the botanical garden gives the name fjurduliż imżewwaq and the scientific name Iris variegata.
formal.zh: 植物园的标签列出了马耳他语名称 fjurduliż imżewwaq，以及学名 Iris variegata。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif jisimha din il-pjanta? Toni: Skont it-tikketta, hija fjurduliż imżewwaq.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this plant called? Toni: According to the label, it is Iris variegata.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这株植物叫什么？托尼：根据标签，它叫杂色鸢尾。

messages.speaker: Sara (园艺学习者)
messages.zh: 这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 根据标签，它叫杂色鸢尾。
messages.en: According to the label, it is Iris variegata.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张双名植物标签：正面写 fjurduliż imżewwaq，背面写“杂色鸢尾／Iris variegata”，整组配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the front of something, viewed from the front, or occurring directly face to face.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与事物前部有关的、从正面观察的，或正面相向发生的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-parti ta' quddiem, jidher minn quddiem, jew iseħħ wiċċ imb wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正面的；前部的；迎面的，具体含义取决于所修饰的名词。

formal.mt: Id-disinn juri veduta frontali tal-bini u l-pożizzjoni tad-daħla prinċipali.
formal.en: The drawing shows a frontal view of the building and the position of the main entrance.
formal.zh: 图纸展示了建筑的正面视图和主入口的位置。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid ritratt frontali jew mill-ġenb? Adam: Frontali, jekk jogħġbok, biex jidher wiċċi kollu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Would you like a frontal photo or one from the side? Adam: Frontal, please, so my whole face is visible.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你想拍正面照还是侧面照？亚当：请拍正面照，这样能看到我的整张脸。

messages.speaker: Nina (摄影者)
messages.zh: 你想拍正面照还是侧面照？
messages.en: Would you like a frontal photo or one from the side?

messages.speaker: Adam (拍照者)
messages.mt_spoken: Frontali, jekk jogħġbok, biex jidher wiċċi kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Frontali, jekk jogħġbok, biex jidher wiċċi kollu.
messages.zh: 请拍正面照，这样能看到我的整张脸。
messages.en: Frontal, please, so my whole face is visible.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 frontali 与英语 front 的“前面”联系起来，想象镜头正对脸部，记住“正面的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a person's family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作个人家族姓氏的专名，可音译为“加莱阿”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala l-isem tal-familja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏 Galea，可音译为“加莱阿”。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Galea huwa mistieden jattendi l-laqgħa nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: Mr Galea is invited to attend the meeting on Monday.
formal.zh: 现邀请加莱阿先生出席星期一的会议。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhu l-kunjom tiegħek? Lara: Galea. Tridni niktibulek?
colloquial.en: Mark: What's your surname? Lara: Galea. Would you like me to write it down for you?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你姓什么？拉拉：加莱阿。要我写给你吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (新同学)
messages.zh: 你姓什么？
messages.en: What's your surname?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 加莱阿。要我写给你吗？
messages.en: Galea. Would you like me to write it down for you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张写着 Galea 的家庭门牌，再配上“加莱阿先生”的称呼；把它整体记作姓氏，书写时首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To attach or secure something using a hook.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用钩子把某物钩住、挂住或连接固定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwaħħal jew jorbot xi ħaġa permezz ta' ganċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钩住；用钩子挂住或连接。

collocations.en: hook the trailer to the car

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem gganċja l-ħabel maċ-ċirku tal-metall qabel beda jerfa' t-tagħbija.
formal.en: The worker hooked the rope onto the metal ring before beginning to lift the load.
formal.zh: 工人在开始吊起货物之前，把绳子钩接到了金属环上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Gganċja l-ħabel hawn, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Hawn sew? Lara: Iva, issa żommu sod.
colloquial.en: Lara: Hook the rope here, please. Mark: Is here okay? Lara: Yes, now hold it firmly.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：请把绳子钩在这里。马克：这里可以吗？拉拉：可以，现在把它握牢。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 请把绳子钩在这里。
messages.en: Hook the rope here, please.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 这里可以吗？
messages.en: Is here okay?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 可以，现在把它握牢。
messages.en: Yes, now hold it firmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中慢放“绳圈套上钩子”的动作，把 gganċja 和“钩住、挂接”一起记；重点是形成钩扣连接。

gloss_zh: 大不列颠；英国（另一用法）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of the island comprising England, Scotland, and Wales; also used in another sense for the United Kingdom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由英格兰、苏格兰和威尔士组成的大不列颠岛的名称；另有指英国这一国家的用法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-gżira magħmula mill-Ingilterra, l-Iskozja u Wales; f'tifsira oħra jintuża għar-Renju Unit.

sense_translations.en_definition: Great Britain (a large island (sometimes also including some of the surrounding smaller islands) off the north-west coast of Western Europe, made up of England, Scotland, and Wales)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 大不列颠：位于西欧西北海岸外的大岛，由英格兰、苏格兰和威尔士组成；有时也包括周边部分小岛。

sense_translations.en_definition: Great Britain (the United Kingdom, a kingdom and country in Northern Europe including the island of Great Britain as well as Northern Ireland on the northeastern portion of the island of Ireland)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 英国：此义指联合王国这一位于北欧的王国和国家，包括大不列颠岛及位于爱尔兰岛东北部的北爱尔兰。

formal.mt: Il-gżira tal-Gran Brittanja tinkludi l-Ingilterra, l-Iskozja u Wales.
formal.en: The island of Great Britain includes England, Scotland, and Wales.
formal.zh: 大不列颠岛包括英格兰、苏格兰和威尔士。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-Gran Brittanja fuq din il-mappa? Pawlu: Hawn, din il-gżira kbira ħdejn l-Irlanda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Great Britain on this map? Pawlu: Here, this large island next to Ireland.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张地图上的大不列颠在哪里？保罗：这里，就是爱尔兰旁边的这座大岛。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-Gran Brittanja fuq din il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-Gran Brittanja fuq din il-mappa?
messages.zh: 这张地图上的大不列颠在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Great Britain on this map?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn, din il-gżira kbira ħdejn l-Irlanda.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn, din il-gżira kbira ħdejn l-Irlanda.
messages.zh: 这里，就是爱尔兰旁边的这座大岛。
messages.en: Here, this large island next to Ireland.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先在地图上圈出英格兰、苏格兰和威尔士所在的大岛，记住岛名；遇到国家语境，再辨认它是否采用“英国”这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The common crane, a bird of the species Grus grus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 灰鹤，学名 Grus grus；可以指这种鸟的个体，也可以指这一物种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Grus grus; il-kelma tista' tindika għasfur wieħed jew l-ispeċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灰鹤；一种鸟。

sense_translations.en_definition: common crane (Grus grus) (several birds; the crane as a species)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 灰鹤（Grus grus）；可统指多只灰鹤，或泛指灰鹤这一物种。

collocations.en: a common crane near the water

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-grawwa hija identifikata bl-isem xjentifiku Grus grus.
formal.en: In the report, the common crane is identified by the scientific name Grus grus.
formal.zh: 报告用学名 Grus grus 标明了灰鹤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dik il-grawwa qrib l-ilma. Mark: Rajtha! Se nieħu ritratt minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that common crane near the water. Mark: I see it! I'll take a photo from here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看水边的那只灰鹤。马克：看到了！我从这里拍张照。

messages.speaker: Lara (观鸟伙伴)
