messages.zh: 看水边的那只灰鹤。
messages.en: Look at that common crane near the water.

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha! Se nieħu ritratt minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha! Se nieħu ritratt minn hawn.
messages.zh: 看到了！我从这里拍张照。
messages.en: I see it! I'll take a photo from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象观鸟笔记上贴着一张灰鹤照片，旁边并排写 grawwa、灰鹤和 Grus grus，用同一画面连接三种名称。

gloss_zh: 大石首鱼（与 gurbell 同义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A name for the meagre, Argyrosomus regius, synonymous with gurbell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鱼类大石首鱼（Argyrosomus regius）的名称，与 gurbell 同义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għall-ħuta tal-ispeċi Argyrosomus regius, bl-istess tifsira bħal gurbell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: gurbell 的同义名称，指大石首鱼（Argyrosomus regius）。

formal.mt: F'dan il-katalgu, l-isem gurbell rar jirreferi għall-ispeċi Argyrosomus regius.
formal.en: In this catalogue, the name gurbell rar refers to the species Argyrosomus regius.
formal.zh: 在本目录中，gurbell rar 这一名称指大石首鱼（Argyrosomus regius）。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek gurbell rar frisk illum? Toni: Iva, trid wieħed biex issajru fil-forn?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have fresh meagre today? Toni: Yes, would you like one to bake in the oven?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天有新鲜的大石首鱼吗？托尼：有，你要买一条回去用烤箱烤吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天有新鲜的大石首鱼吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh meagre today?

messages.speaker: Toni (鱼贩)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, trid wieħed biex issajru fil-forn?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, trid wieħed biex issajru fil-forn?
messages.zh: 有，你要买一条回去用烤箱烤吗？
messages.en: Yes, would you like one to bake in the oven?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gurbell rar 整体写在鱼摊标签上，下面标“大石首鱼”；再用等号连到 gurbell，记住两者指同一种鱼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A final struggle or convulsive movement as a person or animal is dying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或动物临死时出现的一次挣扎或抽动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħbita jew moviment qawwi li tagħmel persuna jew annimal fl-aħħar mumenti qabel il-mewt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 临终时的一次挣扎或抽动。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, is-suldat għamel l-aħħar għafja tal-mewt qabel ma ġismu waqaf jiċċaqlaq.
formal.en: In the story, the soldier gave a final death throe before his body stopped moving.
formal.zh: 故事中，那名士兵最后挣扎了一下，随后身体便不再动弹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'għafja tal-mewt' f'din l-istorja? Mark: Tfisser l-aħħar taħbita ta' xi ħadd li jkun qed imut.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'għafja tal-mewt' mean in this story? Mark: It means a final struggle by someone who is dying.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个故事里的“għafja tal-mewt”是什么意思？Mark：指一个人临死时最后的挣扎。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的“għafja tal-mewt”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'għafja tal-mewt' mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser l-aħħar taħbita ta' xi ħadd li jkun qed imut.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser l-aħħar taħbita ta' xi ħadd li jkun qed imut.
messages.zh: 指一个人临死时最后的挣扎。
messages.en: It means a final struggle by someone who is dying.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上故事中生命将尽时最后挣扎的画面，整块记成“临终挣扎”，不要只记成一般的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A snail, especially one that lives on land and carries a shell on its back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蜗牛，尤指生活在陆地上、背着螺旋形外壳缓慢爬行的软体动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir li jgħix fuq l-art, għandu qoxra fuq dahru u jimxi bil-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一只蜗牛。
陆生蜗牛，即生活在陆地上的蜗牛。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenti raw għakrux miexi bil-mod fuq werqa mxarrba.
formal.en: During their observation in the garden, the students saw a snail moving slowly across a wet leaf.
formal.zh: 在花园里观察时，学生们看见一只蜗牛正沿着湿润的叶子缓慢爬行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak l-għakrux fuq il-ħajt! Mark: Rajtu! Ħallih hemm, qed jimxi bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that snail on the wall! Mark: I see it! Leave it there; it's moving slowly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看墙上那只蜗牛！Mark：看到了！让它待在那里吧，它正慢慢爬呢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看墙上那只蜗牛！
messages.en: Look at that snail on the wall!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu! Ħallih hemm, qed jimxi bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu! Ħallih hemm, qed jimxi bil-mod.
messages.zh: 看到了！让它待在那里吧，它正慢慢爬呢。
messages.en: I see it! Leave it there; it's moving slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象叶片上一只背着螺旋小房子的蜗牛，把għakrux写在画旁；用“壳、慢爬、陆地”三个画面一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 喂养；给牲畜喂饲料；行贿

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give food to an animal, especially livestock; also, to bribe someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给动物，尤其是牲畜喂食或提供饲料；也可指向某人行贿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta l-ikel lil annimal, speċjalment lill-bhejjem; jista' jfisser ukoll li ta flus jew xi ħaġa oħra lil xi ħadd bħala tixħim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喂养，尤其指给动物喂食。
向某人行贿，用钱财或其他好处收买某人。
给动物喂食；给牲畜提供饲料。
行贿，以钱财或其他利益影响他人的行为或决定。

collocations.en: he bribed an official with money
collocations.zh: 他用钱贿赂了一名官员

formal.mt: Il-bidwi għalef il-baqar bil-ħuxlief u mbagħad iċċekkja li kellhom biżżejjed ilma.
formal.en: The farmer fed the cows hay and then checked that they had enough water.
formal.zh: 农夫给牛喂了干草，然后检查它们是否有足够的水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark għalef il-kelb dalgħodu? Anna: Iva, tah l-ikel qabel ħareġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark feed the dog this morning? Anna: Yes, he gave it food before he went out.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark今天早上喂狗了吗？Anna：喂了，他出门前给它吃的了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: Mark今天早上喂狗了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark feed the dog this morning?

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 喂了，他出门前给它吃的了。
messages.en: Yes, he gave it food before he went out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“农夫给牛添干草”的画面记喂养义；另做一张“拿钱收买人”的卡片记行贿义，靠上下文区分这两个意思。

gloss_zh: 他／它有；在他／它那里；到他／它那里

teaching_sense.en_definition: The third-person masculine singular form of għand, meaning at or to him or it, and commonly expressing that he or it has something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: għand的第三人称阳性单数代词形式，表示在他或它那里、到他或它那里，也常用来表达他或它拥有某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma ta' għand għat-tielet persuna maskili singular, li tindika post għand persuna jew pussess minnha.

sense_translations.en_definition: third-person masculine singular pronominal form of għand:
sense_translations.zh_definition: għand的第三人称阳性单数代词形式，所指对象为“他”或阳性单数的“它”。
在他或它那里；到他或它那里，具体含义由语境决定。
他有；它有，表示第三人称阳性单数对象拥有某物。

formal.mt: Kull student għandu kopja tat-test biex ikun jista' jsegwi l-lezzjoni.
formal.en: Each student has a copy of the text so that they can follow the lesson.
formal.zh: 每名学生都有一份课文，以便跟上课堂内容。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark għandu l-ktieb tiegħi? Anna: Iva, mur għandu wara l-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does Mark have my book? Anna: Yes, go to him after the lesson.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我的书在Mark那里吗？Anna：对，下课后去他那里吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 我的书在Mark那里吗？
messages.en: Does Mark have my book?

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 对，下课后去他那里吧。
messages.en: Yes, go to him after the lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“书在他那里，所以他有书”串起处所和拥有两种用法，再加一句mur għandu记“到他那里去”；这是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A crane: a large bird with a long neck and long legs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鹤，一种颈部和双腿都较长的大型鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur kbir b'għonq twil u saqajn twal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鹤，指鸟类。
鹤，一种长颈长腿的鸟。

collocations.en: a crane with a long neck

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, il-grupp ra għarnuq wieqaf ħdejn l-ilma.
formal.en: While birdwatching, the group saw a crane standing beside the water.
formal.zh: 观鸟时，小组看到一只鹤站在水边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak l-għasfur fl-istampa għarnuq? Mark: Iva, ara kemm għandu għonqu u saqajh twal!
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that bird in the picture a crane? Mark: Yes, look how long its neck and legs are!
colloquial.zh: Maja：图片里那只鸟是鹤吗？Mark：是啊，看它的脖子和腿多长！

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 图片里那只鸟是鹤吗？
messages.en: Is that bird in the picture a crane?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara kemm għandu għonqu u saqajh twal!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara kemm għandu għonqu u saqajh twal!
messages.zh: 是啊，看它的脖子和腿多长！
messages.en: Yes, look how long its neck and legs are!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给għarnuq配一幅水边长颈长腿的鹤的简笔画，读词时依次指向脖子和双腿，把词义固定在鸟类画面上。

gloss_zh: 窥探；仔细察看；搭建小屋；天空转阴

teaching_sense.en_definition: To peer, pry, or observe closely; in other uses, to build a hut or for the sky to become overcast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 探头细看、窥探或仔细观察；其他用法还包括搭建小屋，以及天空变得阴云密布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħares mill-qrib jew fittex li jara xi ħaġa; jista' jfisser ukoll li bena għarix, jew li s-sema mtela bis-sħab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 窥探，试图探看不易看见或他人不愿展示的事物。

sense_translations.en_definition: to build a hut or small dwelling
sense_translations.zh_definition: 搭建棚屋或简小的住所。
天空转阴，变得阴云密布。
搭建一间棚屋或小屋。
仔细看、窥探或观察。

collocations.en: he built a hut so that he would have shelter
collocations.zh: 他搭了小屋，好有个遮蔽的地方

formal.mt: Lejn filgħaxija għarrex is-sema, u l-grupp iddeċieda li jtemm l-osservazzjonijiet barra.
formal.en: Towards evening, the sky became overcast, and the group decided to end its outdoor observations.
formal.zh: 临近傍晚，天空转阴，小组决定结束户外观察。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark għarrex mit-tieqa? Anna: Sema' ħoss u ried jara min kien hemm barra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark peer through the window? Anna: He heard a noise and wanted to see who was outside.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark为什么透过窗户张望？Anna：他听到响声，想看看外面是谁。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: Mark为什么透过窗户张望？
messages.en: Why did Mark peer through the window?

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sema' ħoss u ried jara min kien hemm barra.
messages.mt_standard: Sema' ħoss u ried jara min kien hemm barra.
messages.zh: 他听到响声，想看看外面是谁。
messages.en: He heard a noise and wanted to see who was outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做三张情境卡：窗边张望、搭起小屋、天空布满云；三张都写għarrex，靠人物动作和天气主语辨义，不强编共同词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A man who is engaged to be married, or a bridegroom at his wedding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经订婚、准备结婚的男子；也指婚礼上的新郎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel li jkun għarajjex biex jiżżewweġ, jew ir-raġel fil-jum tat-tieġ tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经订婚的人。
新娘或新郎，即婚礼中结婚的一方。
未婚夫或未婚妻，即已经订婚的伴侣。
新郎或新娘，即举行婚礼的人。
新郎，婚礼上结婚的男子。

formal.mt: Wara ċ-ċerimonja, l-għarus u l-għarusa rringrazzjaw lill-mistednin tal-preżenza tagħhom.
formal.en: After the ceremony, the bridegroom and the bride thanked the guests for attending.
formal.zh: 仪式结束后，新郎和新娘感谢宾客们到场。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak Mark, l-għarus ta' Anna? Lara: Iva, se jiżżewġu s-sena d-dieħla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that Mark, Anna's fiancé? Lara: Yes, they're getting married next year.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那是Anna的未婚夫Mark吗？Lara：对，他们明年结婚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是Anna的未婚夫Mark吗？
messages.en: Is that Mark, Anna's fiancé?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，他们明年结婚。
messages.en: Yes, they're getting married next year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用同一男子的两张照片记għarus：订婚照对应“未婚夫”，婚礼照对应“新郎”；先看时间场景，再选中文译法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cover or lid that closes a container or opening, including a flap that folds over it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来盖住容器或开口的盖子，也可指能够翻动、折合的盖片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti li tgħatti jew tagħlaq reċipjent jew fetħa, u li tista' titneħħa jew tinfetaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盖；覆盖在物体或开口上面的遮盖物。
盖子，用来封住容器上部开口的部件。
翻盖；可以翻开或折合的盖片。
顶盖或盖子，即盖住物体上部或开口的部分。

formal.mt: Wara li timla l-vażett, agħlaq l-għatu sew biex il-kontenut jibqa' protett.
formal.en: After filling the jar, close the lid securely so that the contents remain protected.
formal.zh: 装满罐子后，请把盖子盖紧，以保护里面的物品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-għatu tal-borma? Mark: Ħdejn il-platt. Tridni ngħaddihulek?
colloquial.en: Maja: Where's the pot lid? Mark: Next to the plate. Do you want me to pass it to you?
colloquial.zh: Maja：锅盖在哪儿？Mark：在盘子旁边。要我递给你吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 锅盖在哪儿？
messages.en: Where's the pot lid?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 在盘子旁边。要我递给你吗？
messages.en: Next to the plate. Do you want me to pass it to you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 拿锅盖、罐盖和翻盖各做一次“打开再盖上”的动作，每次说għatu，把不同形状统一记成“盖住开口的部件”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To briefly close and open an eye, especially to give someone a signal; also used of a heavenly body that twinkles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 短暂闭眼再睁开，尤指向某人眨眼示意；也可形容星体闪烁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għalaq u fetaħ għajn malajr, speċjalment biex jagħti sinjal lil xi ħadd; jintuża wkoll għal ġisem tas-sema li jteptep.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 眨一只眼；眨眼示意。

sense_translations.en_definition: to twinkle (used of stars and heavenly bodies)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪烁，闪耀（用于星星及其他天体）。
眨眼；向某人眨眼。

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tax-xena, l-attur għemeż lill-udjenza biex juri li kien qed jiċċajta.
formal.en: At the end of the scene, the actor winked at the audience to show that he was joking.
formal.zh: 这一幕结束时，演员向观众眨眼，表示自己是在开玩笑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu għemeż lilek? Rita: Biex jurini li kien qed jiċċajta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu wink at you? Rita: To show me that he was joking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么向你眨眼？丽塔：为了告诉我他是在开玩笑。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么向你眨眼？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu wink at you?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jurini li kien qed jiċċajta.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jurini li kien qed jiċċajta.
messages.zh: 为了告诉我他是在开玩笑。
messages.en: To show me that he was joking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上“眨一下眼传递暗号”的动作记忆，再想象星星也像眼睛一样一闪一闪，串起两个用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Knowledge and understanding, including the wisdom to make good judgments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 知识与理解，也包括作出明智判断的智慧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li wieħed jaf u jifhem, kif ukoll il-ħila li jużah biex jiġġudika tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 知识；对事物的认识与了解。
智慧；作出明智判断的能力。
知识，智慧；所掌握的认识及明智运用这些认识的能力。

formal.mt: Il-proġett jgħaqqad l-għerf tal-esperti mal-esperjenza tal-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The project brings together the experts' knowledge and the workers' experience.
formal.zh: 该项目将专家的知识与工人的经验结合起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se nistaqsi lin-nannu x'jaħseb. Pawlu: Idea tajba. Għandu ħafna għerf u dejjem jagħti parir tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'll ask Grandpa what he thinks. Pawlu: Good idea. He has a lot of wisdom and always gives good advice.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我要问问爷爷怎么看。保罗：好主意。他很有智慧，总能给出好建议。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 我要问问爷爷怎么看。
messages.en: I'll ask Grandpa what he thinks.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Idea tajba. Għandu ħafna għerf u dejjem jagħti parir tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Idea tajba. Għandu ħafna għerf u dejjem jagħti parir tajjeb.
messages.zh: 好主意。他很有智慧，总能给出好建议。
messages.en: Good idea. He has a lot of wisdom and always gives good advice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“书中学知识，生活长智慧”来记：għerf 可以指知道的知识，也可以指善于判断的智慧。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A knot formed by tying something, or a lump that forms a compact mass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 绳线等打成的结，也指聚成一团的块状物或肿块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabta magħmula f'ħabel jew f'ħajta, jew massa żgħira miġbura f'post wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结；绳、线等缠绕或系扎形成的结。
团块；块状物；肿块。

formal.mt: Qabel jintuża l-ħabel, għandha tinħall l-għoqda li hemm fin-nofs tiegħu.
formal.en: Before the rope is used, the knot in its middle should be untied.
formal.zh: 使用绳子之前，应先解开绳子中间的结。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma nistax inħoll din l-għoqda. Pawlu: Agħtini l-ħabel, ħa nipprova jien.
colloquial.en: Maja: I can't untie this knot. Pawlu: Give me the rope; let me try.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我解不开这个结。保罗：把绳子给我，我来试试。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我解不开这个结。
messages.en: I can't untie this knot.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 把绳子给我，我来试试。
messages.en: Give me the rope; let me try.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象绳子打结后鼓起一个小团：用这个形状同时记住“结”和“团块”，再由上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young cow or bull; in another sense, a castrated male bovine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 幼小的牛，不论雌雄；另一个义项指阉公牛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fart żgħir jew baqra żgħira; f'tifsira oħra, fart ikkastrat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小牛；牛犊。
阉公牛；经过阉割的雄牛。
小牛，牛犊（幼小的母牛或公牛）。

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara fir-razzett, l-istudenti raw għoġol żgħir ħdejn ommu.
formal.en: During the farm visit, the students saw a young calf beside its mother.
formal.zh: 参观农场时，学生们看到一头小牛待在母牛身旁。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ara dak l-għoġol ħdejn il-baqra! Mark: Iva, qed jimxi wara ommu.
colloquial.en: Lina: Look at that calf beside the cow! Mark: Yes, it's following its mother.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：看母牛旁边的那头小牛！马克：是啊，它正跟着妈妈走。

messages.speaker: Lina (游客)
messages.zh: 看母牛旁边的那头小牛！
messages.en: Look at that calf beside the cow!

messages.speaker: Mark (农场主)
messages.zh: 是啊，它正跟着妈妈走。
messages.en: Yes, it's following its mother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 għoġol 和“跟着母牛走的小牛”画面绑定；遇到畜牧语境时，再留意它也可能指阉公牛。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An attitude of cherishing someone or something, expressed through affection and careful attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对人或事物怀有的珍爱之情，以及由此表现出的爱惜与悉心照料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imħabba u apprezzament lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, flimkien mal-kura u l-attenzjoni li jingħataw.

sense_translations.en_definition: the attitude towards sth. or sb. that is cherished
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对所珍视的人或事物怀有的珍爱、爱惜之情。

sense_translations.en_definition: great care taken of sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人或某物的悉心照料与精心呵护。
珍爱；充满感情的关怀与呵护。

formal.mt: Il-familja żammet l-ittri antiki b'għożża u għaddiethom lill-mużew.
formal.en: The family kept the old letters with loving care and passed them on to the museum.
formal.zh: 这家人一直珍爱地保存着这些旧信，后来将它们交给了博物馆。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għadek iżżomm din ir-ritratt? Rita: Iva, inżommha b'għożża għax fiha n-nanna.
colloquial.en: Lina: Do you still keep this photograph? Rita: Yes, I treasure it because Grandma is in it.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你还留着这张照片呀？丽塔：是的，我很珍惜它，因为照片里有奶奶。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还留着这张照片呀？
messages.en: Do you still keep this photograph?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inżommha b'għożża għax fiha n-nanna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inżommha b'għożża għax fiha n-nanna.
messages.zh: 是的，我很珍惜它，因为照片里有奶奶。
messages.en: Yes, I treasure it because Grandma is in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把珍贵的家庭照片轻轻收进相册：心里的珍爱加上手上的细心，就是 għożża 的记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of land surrounded by water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 四周被水环绕的陆地，即岛或岛屿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa art imdawra bl-ilma minn kull naħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 岛；四面环水的陆地。

formal.mt: Il-gżira hija mdawra bl-ilma minn kull naħa u tidher b'mod ċar fuq il-mappa.
formal.en: The island is surrounded by water on all sides and is clearly visible on the map.
formal.zh: 这座岛四面环水，在地图上清晰可见。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Trid immorru fuq dik il-gżira żgħira? Lara: Iva, ejja naraw meta titlaq id-dgħajsa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you want to go to that small island? Lara: Yes, let's see when the boat leaves.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你想去那座小岛吗？拉拉：想，我们看看船什么时候出发。

messages.speaker: Mark (旅行伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid immorru fuq dik il-gżira żgħira?
messages.mt_standard: Trid immorru fuq dik il-gżira żgħira?
messages.zh: 你想去那座小岛吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go to that small island?

messages.speaker: Lara (旅行伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja naraw meta titlaq id-dgħajsa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja naraw meta titlaq id-dgħajsa.
messages.zh: 想，我们看看船什么时候出发。
messages.en: Yes, let's see when the boat leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一块陆地，再用蓝色水圈把它完全围住，中央写 gżira；看到四面环水的画面，就联想到“岛屿”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A performer who entertains an audience with tricks that make impossible things appear to happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过表演幻术，让观众仿佛看见不可能之事发生的表演者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Artist li juri logħob tal-illużjoni u jagħmel affarijiet jidhru li qed jiġru għalkemm mhumiex kif jidhru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表演视觉幻术或魔术的艺人；幻术师。

formal.mt: L-illużjonista ppreżenta wirja fit-teatru u stieden lil xi spettaturi jitilgħu fuq il-palk.
formal.en: The illusionist gave a show at the theatre and invited some audience members onto the stage.
formal.zh: 幻术师在剧院进行了表演，并邀请几位观众上台。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif għebet il-karta minn idu? David: Ma nafx! Dan l-illużjonista tassew tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did the card disappear from his hand? David: I don't know! This illusionist is really good.
colloquial.zh: Sara：那张牌怎么从他手里消失了？David：不知道！这个幻术师真厉害。

messages.speaker: Sara (观众)
messages.zh: 那张牌怎么从他手里消失了？
messages.en: How did the card disappear from his hand?

messages.speaker: David (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx! Dan l-illużjonista tassew tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx! Dan l-illużjonista tassew tajjeb.
messages.zh: 不知道！这个幻术师真厉害。
messages.en: I don't know! This illusionist is really good.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 illużjonista 与英语 illusionist 对照记形，再想象舞台上让纸牌消失的人；用表演者的画面牢牢记住这是人物名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Water that contains some salt and is saltier than fresh water but less salty than seawater.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含有一定盐分、比淡水咸但比海水淡的水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilma li fih xi melħ, aktar mielaħ mill-ilma ħelu iżda inqas mielaħ mill-ilma baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盐度介于淡水与海水之间的微咸水或半咸水。

formal.mt: L-istudenti ġabru kampjun ta' ilma salmastru mill-għadira biex ikejlu kemm fih melħ.
formal.en: The students collected a sample of brackish water from the pond to measure its salt content.
formal.zh: 学生们从池塘中采集了一份微咸水样本，以测量其含盐量。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Hawn ilma ħelu jew ilma baħar? Ben: Hawn ilma salmastru, xi mkien bejn it-tnejn.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is this fresh water or seawater? Ben: It's brackish water, somewhere between the two.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这里是淡水还是海水？Ben：是微咸水，介于两者之间。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ilma ħelu jew ilma baħar?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ilma ħelu jew ilma baħar?
messages.zh: 这里是淡水还是海水？
messages.en: Is this fresh water or seawater?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ilma salmastru, xi mkien bejn it-tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ilma salmastru, xi mkien bejn it-tnejn.
messages.zh: 是微咸水，介于两者之间。
messages.en: It's brackish water, somewhere between the two.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条从淡水到海水的盐度线，把 ilma salmastru 放在中间；整组记作“有点咸的水”，避免直接等同于海水。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lacking the power or ability to act effectively or change a situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺乏有效行动或改变局面的力量或能力的；无能为力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma għandux is-saħħa jew il-ħila biex jaġixxi b'mod effettiv jew ibiddel sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无力的、无能为力的；也可指性无能的。

collocations.en: powerless in the face of the problem

formal.mt: Mingħajr ir-riżorsi meħtieġa, il-kumitat baqa' impotenti quddiem il-kriżi.
formal.en: Without the necessary resources, the committee remained powerless in the face of the crisis.
formal.zh: 由于缺乏必要资源，委员会面对危机仍然无能为力。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Inħossni impotenti; ma nista' nbiddel xejn. Lara: Nifhem, imma nistgħu nitolbu l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Mark: I feel powerless; I can't change anything. Lara: I understand, but we can ask for help.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我觉得无能为力，什么也改变不了。Lara：我理解，不过我们可以寻求帮助。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inħossni impotenti; ma nista' nbiddel xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Inħossni impotenti; ma nista' nbiddel xejn.
messages.zh: 我觉得无能为力，什么也改变不了。
messages.en: I feel powerless; I can't change anything.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我理解，不过我们可以寻求帮助。
messages.en: I understand, but we can ask for help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有心帮忙却推不动沉重障碍的人，用“想行动却使不上力”记住 impotenti；具体译法要结合一般处境或身体功能的语境判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not exact or accurate enough in measurement, description or information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在测量、描述或信息表达上不够精确或准确的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex eżatt jew preċiż biżżejjed fil-kejl, fid-deskrizzjoni jew fl-informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不精确的、不确切的或不准确的。

formal.mt: Il-kejl kien impreċiż, għalhekk ir-riċerkatur irrepetieh bi strument aktar adattat.
formal.en: The measurement was imprecise, so the researcher repeated it with a more suitable instrument.
formal.zh: 测量结果不够精确，因此研究人员使用更合适的仪器重新进行了测量。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Ir-rapport jgħid li ġew ħafna nies. Marija: Dan impreċiż wisq; għandna bżonn in-numru eżatt.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: The report says that many people came. Marija: That's too imprecise; we need the exact number.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：报告说来了很多人。Marija：这太不精确了，我们需要确切人数。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-rapport jgħid li ġew ħafna nies.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-rapport jgħid li ġew ħafna nies.
messages.zh: 报告说来了很多人。
messages.en: The report says that many people came.

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan impreċiż wisq; għandna bżonn in-numru eżatt.
messages.mt_standard: Dan impreċiż wisq; għandna bżonn in-numru eżatt.
messages.zh: 这太不精确了，我们需要确切人数。
messages.en: That's too imprecise; we need the exact number.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“很多人”和“确切人数”作对照，把 impreċiż 贴在含糊的一侧；再联想到测量偏差，记住它既能形容表达，也能形容数据不准确。

gloss_zh: 不具资格的；不符合条件的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not meeting the conditions required to take part in something, receive something or be selected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未满足参加某事、获得某物或被选中所需条件的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jissodisfax il-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa biex jieħu sehem, jirċievi xi ħaġa jew jintgħażel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不具备规定资格的；不符合参与、获选或领取条件的。

collocations.zh: 不符合补助金申请条件的

formal.mt: L-applikant ġie ddikjarat ineleġibbli għall-għotja għax ma ssodisfax il-kundizzjonijiet ippubblikati.
formal.en: The applicant was declared ineligible for the grant because he did not meet the published conditions.
formal.zh: 该申请人因不满足已公布的条件，被认定不具备获得补助金的资格。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Nista' nieħu sehem fil-kompetizzjoni? Rita: Din għal min għandu tmintax-il sena jew aktar; int għadek ineleġibbli.
colloquial.en: Luca: Can I take part in the competition? Rita: It's for people aged eighteen or over; you're still ineligible.
colloquial.zh: Luca：我能参加这个比赛吗？Rita：这是给年满十八岁的人参加的，你目前还不符合资格。

messages.speaker: Luca (学生)
messages.zh: 我能参加这个比赛吗？
messages.en: Can I take part in the competition?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din għal min għandu tmintax-il sena jew aktar; int għadek ineleġibbli.
messages.mt_standard: Din għal min għandu tmintax-il sena jew aktar; int għadek ineleġibbli.
messages.zh: 这是给年满十八岁的人参加的，你目前还不符合资格。
messages.en: It's for people aged eighteen or over; you're still ineligible.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象报名表旁的一张条件清单，有一项尚未满足，就标记 ineleġibbli；把它记成“资格条件未达标”，不要直接理解为能力差。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Computer technology that enables systems to perform tasks such as understanding language, learning from data, and solving problems.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使计算机系统能够理解语言、从数据中学习和解决问题等的技术。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Teknoloġija li tippermetti lil sistemi tal-kompjuter jifhmu l-lingwa, jitgħallmu mid-data u jsolvu problemi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人工智能；让计算机系统执行学习、理解语言和解决问题等任务的技术。

formal.mt: Dan ir-rapport jispjega kif l-intelliġenza artifiċjali tista' tgħin fl-analiżi tad-data.
formal.en: This report explains how artificial intelligence can help with data analysis.
formal.zh: 本报告说明人工智能如何协助分析数据。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din l-app tuża l-intelliġenza artifiċjali? Mark: Iva, tgħinni nipprattika l-Malti, imma xi drabi tagħmel żbalji.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this app use artificial intelligence? Mark: Yes, it helps me practise Maltese, but it sometimes makes mistakes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个应用使用人工智能吗？Mark：是的，它帮助我练习马耳他语，但有时会出错。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个应用使用人工智能吗？
messages.en: Does this app use artificial intelligence?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tgħinni nipprattika l-Malti, imma xi drabi tagħmel żbalji.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tgħinni nipprattika l-Malti, imma xi drabi tagħmel żbalji.
messages.zh: 是的，它帮助我练习马耳他语，但有时会出错。
messages.en: Yes, it helps me practise Maltese, but it sometimes makes mistakes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组与“能理解语言、协助解题的电脑系统”联系起来，看到它就联想“人工智能”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Involving a great deal of concentrated work, effort, or activity, often within a short period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在一定时间内集中投入大量工作、精力或活动的；强化的、密集的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi ħafna xogħol, sforz jew attività b'mod ikkonċentrat, spiss fi żmien qasir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强化的；密集的；需要集中投入大量时间或精力的。

formal.mt: L-istitut joffri kors intensiv tal-Malti li jdum erba' ġimgħat.
formal.en: The institute offers an intensive Maltese course lasting four weeks.
formal.zh: 该学院开设为期四周的马耳他语强化课程。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sejjer il-kors intensiv? Pawlu: Tajjeb, imma għandna lezzjonijiet kuljum u ħafna xogħol għad-dar.
colloquial.en: Sara: How is the intensive course going? Pawlu: Well, but we have lessons every day and a lot of homework.
colloquial.zh: Sara：强化课程上得怎么样？Pawlu：挺好，不过我们每天都有课，还有很多作业。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 强化课程上得怎么样？
messages.en: How is the intensive course going?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, imma għandna lezzjonijiet kuljum u ħafna xogħol għad-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, imma għandna lezzjonijiet kuljum u ħafna xogħol għad-dar.
messages.zh: 挺好，不过我们每天都有课，还有很多作业。
messages.en: Well, but we have lessons every day and a lot of homework.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把许多课时密密排进一周的课表：kors intensiv 就是投入集中、安排密集的强化课程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Communication or mutual influence between two or more people, things, or systems.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两个或多个个人、事物或系统之间的交流或相互影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Komunikazzjoni jew influwenza reċiproka bejn żewġ persuni, affarijiet jew sistemi jew aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 互动；交流；人、事物或系统之间的相互作用。

collocations.en: interaction between the teacher and the students
collocations.zh: 教师与学生之间的互动

formal.mt: L-attivitajiet fi gruppi jħeġġu l-interazzjoni bejn l-istudenti waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: Group activities encourage interaction among students during the lesson.
formal.zh: 小组活动能促进学生在课堂上的互动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kien hemm ħafna interazzjoni fil-lezzjoni? Ben: Iva, tkellimna fi gruppi u staqsejna ħafna mistoqsijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was there a lot of interaction in the lesson? Ben: Yes, we talked in groups and asked lots of questions.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这节课互动多吗？Ben：多，我们分组交流，还问了很多问题。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这节课互动多吗？
messages.en: Was there a lot of interaction in the lesson?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tkellimna fi gruppi u staqsejna ħafna mistoqsijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tkellimna fi gruppi u staqsejna ħafna mistoqsijiet.
messages.zh: 多，我们分组交流，还问了很多问题。
messages.en: Yes, we talked in groups and asked lots of questions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象课堂上两个人轮流提问、回答，用双向箭头记住 interazzjoni 表示互动或相互作用。

gloss_zh: 有创造力的；善于想出新办法的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Good at thinking of original ideas or finding new ways to do things or solve problems.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 善于提出新颖想法，或想出做事、解决问题的新办法的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li kapaċi joħroġ b'ideat oriġinali jew isib modi ġodda biex jagħmel xi ħaġa jew isolvi problema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有创造力的；善于构思新颖想法或巧妙办法的。

formal.mt: It-tim adotta approċċ inventiv biex inaqqas l-iskart fil-fabbrika.
formal.en: The team adopted an inventive approach to reduce waste in the factory.
formal.zh: 团队采用了富有创意的方法来减少工厂的废弃物。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif irranġajt il-lampa mingħajr ma xtrajt waħda ġdida? David: Użajt biċċiet li kelli d-dar; ridt inkun ftit inventiv.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did you fix the lamp without buying a new one? David: I used parts I had at home; I had to be a little inventive.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你是怎么修好这盏灯、又不用买新灯的？David：我用了家里现成的零件，得动点脑筋想个新办法。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irranġajt il-lampa mingħajr ma xtrajt waħda ġdida?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irranġajt il-lampa mingħajr ma xtrajt waħda ġdida?
messages.zh: 你是怎么修好这盏灯、又不用买新灯的？
messages.en: How did you fix the lamp without buying a new one?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Użajt biċċiet li kelli d-dar; ridt inkun ftit inventiv.
messages.mt_standard: Użajt biċċiet li kelli d-dar; ridt inkun ftit inventiv.
messages.zh: 我用了家里现成的零件，得动点脑筋想个新办法。
messages.en: I used parts I had at home; I had to be a little inventive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 inventiv 与“用现有零件想出新办法修灯”的画面相连，记住它形容有创意、点子多。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a city in Turkey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 土耳其城市伊斯坦布尔的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' belt fit-Turkija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伊斯坦布尔，土耳其的一座城市。

collocations.zh: 前往伊斯坦布尔的旅行
伊斯坦布尔的一家酒店

formal.mt: Il-konferenza se ssir f'Istanbul, belt fit-Turkija.
formal.en: The conference will take place in Istanbul, a city in Turkey.
formal.zh: 会议将在土耳其城市伊斯坦布尔举行。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Mark: Se mmur Istanbul u noqgħod hemm ħamest ijiem.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Istanbul and staying there for five days.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你要去哪里度假？Mark：我要去伊斯坦布尔，在那里住五天。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅行者)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur Istanbul u noqgħod hemm ħamest ijiem.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur Istanbul u noqgħod hemm ħamest ijiem.
messages.zh: 我要去伊斯坦布尔，在那里住五天。
messages.en: I'm going to Istanbul and staying there for five days.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Istanbul 当作地图上的城市标签，与中文“伊斯坦布尔”配对；用“去那里旅行、在那里住酒店”巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organization established for a particular purpose, especially education, training, or research.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为特定目的设立的机构，尤其指从事教育、培训或研究的学院、研究所等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Organizzazzjoni mwaqqfa għal skop partikolari, speċjalment għat-tagħlim, it-taħriġ jew ir-riċerka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学院；研究所；为教育、培训、研究等特定目的设立的机构。

formal.mt: L-istitut tar-riċerka ppubblika studju ġdid dwar il-kwalità tal-ilma.
formal.en: The research institute published a new study on water quality.
formal.zh: 该研究所发表了一项关于水质的新研究。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn qed tagħmel il-kors? Sam: F'istitut ħdejn l-istazzjon; il-lezzjonijiet jibdew fis-sitta.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where are you taking the course? Sam: At an institute near the station; the lessons start at six.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你在哪里上这门课？Sam：在车站附近的一家培训机构，六点开始上课。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在哪里上这门课？
messages.en: Where are you taking the course?

messages.speaker: Sam (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: F'istitut ħdejn l-istazzjon; il-lezzjonijiet jibdew fis-sitta.
messages.mt_standard: F'istitut ħdejn l-istazzjon; il-lezzjonijiet jibdew fis-sitta.
messages.zh: 在车站附近的一家培训机构，六点开始上课。
messages.en: At an institute near the station; the lessons start at six.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一栋挂着“培训与研究”招牌的楼，用这个场景记住 istitut 是学院、研究所一类专门机构。

gloss_zh: 权利；应有资格；自主意愿

teaching_sense.en_definition: A right or entitlement to something; also a person's own will or initiative, as in doing something of their own accord.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 享有某事物或采取某种行动的权利、资格；也可指个人自主的意愿，如自愿或主动做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dritt li persuna għandha għal xi ħaġa jew biex tagħmel xi ħaġa; ukoll ir-rieda tagħha stess, bħal meta tagħmel xi ħaġa minn jeddha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 权利；自由意志、自主意愿，也用于表示出于自己的意愿而行动。
一项权利；享有某种待遇、资源或机会的应有资格。

formal.mt: Kull persuna għandha l-jedd li tesprimi l-opinjoni tagħha.
formal.en: Every person has the right to express their opinion.
formal.zh: 每个人都有表达自己意见的权利。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tlabtu jgħinek iġorr il-kaxxi? Rita: Le, ġie jgħinni minn jeddu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you ask him to help you carry the boxes? Rita: No, he came to help me of his own accord.
colloquial.zh: Maja：是你请他帮你搬箱子的吗？Rita：不是，他是主动来帮我的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 是你请他帮你搬箱子的吗？
messages.en: Did you ask him to help you carry the boxes?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，他是主动来帮我的。
messages.en: No, he came to help me of his own accord.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景并记：举手主张自己应有的“权利”，以及无人要求便主动帮忙；minn jeddu 对应“他自愿地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Introduces a condition meaning 'if', or an indirect yes-or-no question meaning 'whether'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引出条件时表示“如果”；引出间接的是非问句时表示“是否”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintroduċi kundizzjoni, jew mistoqsija indiretta li t-tweġiba tagħha tista' tkun iva jew le.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 如果；假如，用来引出条件。
是否，用来引出间接的是非问句。
如果；假如，连接条件从句与主句。
是否，连接表示疑问或不确定情况的从句。

formal.mt: Jekk teħtieġ aktar informazzjoni, jekk jogħġbok ikkuntattja l-uffiċċju biex tistaqsi jekk hemmx postijiet disponibbli.
formal.en: If you need more information, please contact the office to ask whether any places are available.
formal.zh: 如果您需要更多信息，请联系办公室，询问是否还有名额。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taf jekk il-ħanut hux miftuħ? Ben: Le, imma jekk trid, nista' nċempel u nistaqsi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you know whether the shop is open? Ben: No, but if you want, I can call and ask.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你知道商店是否开着吗？Ben：不知道，不过如果你愿意，我可以打电话问问。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你知道商店是否开着吗？
messages.en: Do you know whether the shop is open?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, imma jekk trid, nista' nċempel u nistaqsi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, imma jekk trid, nista' nċempel u nistaqsi.
messages.zh: 不知道，不过如果你愿意，我可以打电话问问。
messages.en: No, but if you want, I can call and ask.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先判断句子功能：提出条件时把 jekk 读成“如果”，询问或不知道答案时读成“是否”；两种用法配例句一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to introduce a conclusion or to explain the preceding statement more precisely: therefore; that is.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于引出结论，或更明确地解释前面的话，表示“因此”或“也就是说”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex tintroduċi konklużjoni jew tispjega b'mod aktar ċar dak li jkun intqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因此；所以；由此可见，用于引出根据前文得出的结论。
也就是说；意思是，用于解释或换一种方式表达前面的内容。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa tibda fit-tlieta ta' waranofsinhar, jiġifieri fil-15:00.
formal.en: The meeting starts at three in the afternoon, that is, at 15:00.
formal.zh: 会议于下午三点开始，也就是15:00。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħanut jagħlaq fis-sitta. Mark: Jiġifieri rridu nitilqu issa? Maja: Iva, biex naslu fil-ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: The shop closes at six. Mark: So we need to leave now? Maja: Yes, so we get there on time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：商店六点关门。马克：所以我们现在就得出发？玛雅：对，这样才能及时赶到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 商店六点关门。
messages.en: The shop closes at six.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 所以我们现在就得出发？
messages.en: So we need to leave now?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，这样才能及时赶到。
messages.en: Yes, so we get there on time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成话语中的连接桥：往前推结论是“因此”，回头解释是“也就是说”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Another name for April Fools' Day, the first of April.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愚人节的另一名称，指四月一日。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ieħor għall-Ewwel ta' April.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 L-Ewwel ta' April 同义，指四月一日的愚人节。

formal.mt: Għal Jum il-Bluha, l-istudenti ħejjew ċajt ħafif u bla ħsara.
formal.en: For April Fools' Day, the students prepared lighthearted, harmless jokes.
formal.zh: 为了迎接愚人节，学生们准备了一些轻松、无伤大雅的玩笑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għada Jum il-Bluha! Mark: Se tagħmilli xi ċajta? Maja: Waħda żgħira biss!
colloquial.en: Maja: Tomorrow is April Fools' Day! Mark: Are you going to play a joke on me? Maja: Just a little one!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：明天是愚人节！马克：你要捉弄我吗？玛雅：只开个小玩笑！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 明天是愚人节！
messages.en: Tomorrow is April Fools' Day!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要捉弄我吗？
messages.en: Are you going to play a joke on me?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 只开个小玩笑！
messages.en: Just a little one!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个名称贴在“四月一日”的日历格上，再配一个小玩笑的画面，整块记住它表示愚人节。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An alternative name for April Fools' Day, observed on the first of April.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愚人节的另一种名称，指四月一日。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ieħor għall-Ewwel ta' April.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 L-Ewwel ta' April 同义，表示四月一日的愚人节。

formal.mt: L-għalliem talab lill-istudenti jiktbu storja qasira dwar ċajta ta' Jum il-Ġifa.
formal.en: The teacher asked the students to write a short story about an April Fools' Day joke.
formal.zh: 老师请学生们写一篇关于愚人节玩笑的短篇故事。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Illum Jum il-Ġifa, hux? Pawlu: Iva, l-Ewwel ta' April. Lara: Mela llum noqgħod attenta għaċ-ċajt!
colloquial.en: Lara: Today is April Fools' Day, right? Pawlu: Yes, the first of April. Lara: Then I'll watch out for jokes today!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天是愚人节，对吧？保罗：对，四月一日。拉拉：那我今天可得提防别人开玩笑！

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 今天是愚人节，对吧？
messages.en: Today is April Fools' Day, right?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 对，四月一日。
messages.en: Yes, the first of April.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 那我今天可得提防别人开玩笑！
messages.en: Then I'll watch out for jokes today!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个完整名称与“四月一日、留心玩笑”一起做成记忆卡；按节日名称整体记忆，不逐字猜意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capers: small edible flower buds used as a seasoning in food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刺山柑的可食用小花蕾，常用作食物的调味配料，也称酸豆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Blanzuni żgħar li jittieklu u jintużaw biex jagħtu togħma lill-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺山柑花蕾；酸豆，一种用于调味的食材。

formal.mt: Żid ftit kappar mal-insalata u ħallat sew qabel isservi.
formal.en: Add a few capers to the salad and mix well before serving.
formal.zh: 在沙拉中加入少量酸豆，上桌前充分拌匀。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid ftit kappar mal-insalata? Pawlu: Iva, imma ftit biss. Lara: Tajjeb, inżidlek ftit.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like some capers with the salad? Pawlu: Yes, but just a few. Lara: Okay, I'll add a few for you.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：沙拉里要加点酸豆吗？保罗：要，不过只加一点。拉拉：好，我给你加一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 沙拉里要加点酸豆吗？
messages.en: Would you like some capers with the salad?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 要，不过只加一点。
messages.en: Yes, but just a few.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我给你加一点。
messages.en: Okay, I'll add a few for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象往沙拉里撒几颗小小的酸豆，边撒边念 kappar，把词形与调味配料的画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose job is to receive customers' payments, for example in a shop.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责收取顾客付款的工作人员，例如商店里的收银员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tirċievi l-ħlas mingħand il-klijenti, pereżempju f'ħanut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收银员；负责收款的工作人员。

collocations.en: to ask the cashier for a receipt

formal.mt: Il-kaxxier ta l-irċevuta lill-klijent wara li rċieva l-ħlas.
formal.en: The cashier gave the customer the receipt after receiving payment.
formal.zh: 收银员收到付款后，把收据交给了顾客。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Int il-kaxxier? Pawlu: Iva, tista' tħallas hawn. Mark: Nista' nħallas bil-kard?
colloquial.en: Mark: Are you the cashier? Pawlu: Yes, you can pay here. Mark: Can I pay by card?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你是收银员吗？保罗：是的，你可以在这里付款。马克：我可以刷卡吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 你是收银员吗？
messages.en: Are you the cashier?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (收银员)
messages.zh: 是的，你可以在这里付款。
messages.en: Yes, you can pay here.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 我可以刷卡吗？
messages.en: Can I pay by card?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kaxxier 贴在脑海中收款、递收据的工作人员胸牌上，记住它指收银员这个人。

gloss_zh: 自豪的；傲慢的；自命不凡的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling pleased about oneself or someone else; in a negative context, showing an exaggerated sense of one's own importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因自己或他人而感到自豪的；在负面语境中，也指过分看重自己、表现傲慢的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss sodisfazzjon bih innifsu jew b'xi ħadd ieħor; f'sens negattiv, li juri li jqis lilu nnifsu importanti wisq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自豪的；骄傲的，因自己或他人的成就、品质等感到满足。
高傲的；傲慢的，表现出高人一等的态度。
自命不凡的；看不起人的，带有口语性的贬义。
自大而爱摆架子的；言行刻意显示自己重要的。

collocations.en: too proud to ask for help

formal.mt: Il-kap tal-iskola qal li kien kburi bl-istudenti għax ħadmu flimkien b'responsabbiltà.
formal.en: The headteacher said that he was proud of the students because they had worked together responsibly.
formal.zh: 校长表示，他为学生们感到自豪，因为他们认真负责地共同完成了工作。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaddejt mill-eżami! Pawlu: Prosit! Jien kburi bik. Mark: Grazzi talli għentni nistudja.
colloquial.en: Mark: I passed the exam! Pawlu: Well done! I'm proud of you. Mark: Thanks for helping me study.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我考试通过了！保罗：真棒！我为你感到自豪。马克：谢谢你帮我复习。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 我考试通过了！
messages.en: I passed the exam!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 真棒！我为你感到自豪。
messages.en: Well done! I'm proud of you.

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 谢谢你帮我复习。
messages.en: Thanks for helping me study.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“抬头挺胸”记住两面含义：为努力而挺胸是自豪，看不起别人而抬头则是傲慢，判断时看语境。

gloss_zh: 与某人说话；交谈；咨询；与某人交往

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak to or converse with someone, including seeking advice; in a romantic context, to be seeing or dating someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某人说话或交谈，也可指向某人咨询；在恋爱语境中，可表示与某人交往或谈恋爱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titkellem ma' xi ħadd, ukoll biex titlob parir; f'kuntest romantiku, tkun f'relazzjoni ma' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人说话；与某人说话。
交谈；进行对话。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be seeing sb. in a relationship
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与某人处于恋爱交往关系中；正在与某人交往。
说话；讲话。
咨询；向某人请教或征求意见。
与某人约会；与某人谈恋爱。

formal.mt: Il-ġenitur kellem lill-għalliem biex jiddiskuti l-progress ta' ibnu.
formal.en: The parent spoke to the teacher to discuss his son's progress.
formal.zh: 这位家长与老师交谈，讨论儿子的学习进展。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kellem lil Lara dwar il-proġett? Mark: Iva, kellimha dalgħodu. Maja: Tajjeb, mela nistgħu nibdew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did he speak to Lara about the project? Mark: Yes, he spoke to her this morning. Maja: Good, then we can start.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他跟拉拉谈过这个项目了吗？马克：谈过了，他今天早上跟她说了。玛雅：好，那我们可以开始了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 他跟拉拉谈过这个项目了吗？
messages.en: Did he speak to Lara about the project?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 谈过了，他今天早上跟她说了。
messages.en: Yes, he spoke to her this morning.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 好，那我们可以开始了。
messages.en: Good, then we can start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象两个人面对面交谈：向专业人士谈问题可理解为咨询；出现恋爱背景时，再联想到交往，不把所有说话都理解为约会。

gloss_zh: 多少个；几，用于单数名词前

teaching_sense.en_definition: A determiner meaning 'how many', used before a singular noun to ask about a number.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“多少个”或“几”的限定词，用于询问数量，后接单数名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża qabel nom fis-singular biex tistaqsi dwar in-numru.

sense_translations.en_definition: how many; construed with singular noun
sense_translations.zh_definition: 多少个；几，与单数形式的名词连用。

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, indika kemm-il persuna se tattendi l-laqgħa.
formal.en: Please indicate how many people will attend the meeting.
formal.zh: 请注明将有多少人参加会议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm-il ktieb għandek fil-basket? Pawlu: Għandi tliet kotba. Lara: Tista' ssellifni wieħed?
colloquial.en: Lara: How many books do you have in your bag? Pawlu: I have three books. Lara: Can you lend me one?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你包里有几本书？保罗：我有三本书。拉拉：能借我一本吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你包里有几本书？
messages.en: How many books do you have in your bag?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 我有三本书。
messages.en: I have three books.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 能借我一本吗？
messages.en: Can you lend me one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 记成“问的是多个，后面用单数”：多少本书说 kemm-il ktieb，把 ktieb 的单数形式一起背下来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cup used for drinking tea, coffee, or another drink.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来喝茶、咖啡或其他饮品的杯子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li jintuża biex tixrob it-te, il-kafè jew xarba oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咖啡杯。
杯子。
茶杯。
茶杯；咖啡杯。

formal.mt: Kull mistieden ingħata kikkra te qabel il-bidu tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: Each guest was given a cup of tea before the meeting began.
formal.zh: 会议开始前，每位来宾都得到了一杯茶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid kikkra te? Mark: Iva, grazzi. Mingħajr zokkor, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a cup of tea? Mark: Yes, thanks. Without sugar, please.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想喝杯茶吗？Mark：想，谢谢。请不要加糖。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想喝杯茶吗？
messages.en: Would you like a cup of tea?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Mingħajr zokkor, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Mingħajr zokkor, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。请不要加糖。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Without sugar, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把茶杯和咖啡杯并排想象：两只都叫 kikkra，再分别配上 te 和 kafè 来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who writes, especially someone who writes books, stories, or articles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事写作的人，尤其指创作书籍、故事或文章的作家、作者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikteb, speċjalment kotba, stejjer jew artikli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作家；作者；写作者。
动词 kiteb（写）的施事名词，指写作的人。

formal.mt: Il-kittieb ippreżenta r-rumanz il-ġdid tiegħu waqt attività fil-librerija.
formal.en: The writer presented his new novel at an event in the library.
formal.zh: 这位作家在图书馆的一场活动中介绍了他的新小说。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu l-kittieb ta' dan il-ktieb? Pawlu: Ma nafx, imma ismu qiegħed fuq il-qoxra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is the author of this book? Pawlu: I don't know, but his name is on the cover.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这本书的作者是谁？Pawlu：我不知道，不过封面上有他的名字。

messages.speaker: Sara (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu l-kittieb ta' dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu l-kittieb ta' dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 这本书的作者是谁？
messages.en: Who is the author of this book?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx, imma ismu qiegħed fuq il-qoxra.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx, imma ismu qiegħed fuq il-qoxra.
messages.zh: 我不知道，不过封面上有他的名字。
messages.en: I don't know, but his name is on the cover.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见书封面就找作者名字，并在心里说 kittieb；把这个词固定联想到拿笔写作的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gather and keep objects together, often because of an interest in a particular kind of object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品收集并保存起来，常指因个人兴趣而收藏某一类物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġbor u jżomm oġġetti flimkien, spiss minħabba interess f'tip partikolari ta' oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收集；收藏。

formal.mt: Matul ħajtu, Pawlu kkollezzjona muniti minn diversi pajjiżi u żamm rekord ta' kull waħda.
formal.en: During his lifetime, Pawlu collected coins from various countries and kept a record of each one.
formal.zh: Pawlu 一生收藏了来自多个国家的硬币，并为每一枚留下记录。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek tikkollezzjona l-bolol? Mark: Iva! Ilbieraħ sibt tnejn li ma kellix.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you still collect stamps? Mark: Yes! Yesterday I found two that I didn't have.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你还在集邮吗？Mark：是啊！昨天我找到了两枚以前没有的邮票。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还在集邮吗？
messages.en: Do you still collect stamps?

messages.speaker: Mark (集邮爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Ilbieraħ sibt tnejn li ma kellix.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Ilbieraħ sibt tnejn li ma kellix.
messages.zh: 是啊！昨天我找到了两枚以前没有的邮票。
messages.en: Yes! Yesterday I found two that I didn't have.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把邮票一张张放进收藏册：这个持续收集的动作就是 kkollezzjona，用 bolol 作搭配记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To commit a crime or make a serious mistake; with a reflexive expression, to commit oneself to an action or obligation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 犯下罪行或严重错误；与反身表达连用时，表示承诺采取某项行动或承担某项义务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwettaq reat jew jagħmel żball serju; meta jintuża ma' ruħu, jintrabat li jagħmel xi ħaġa jew jaċċetta obbligu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to commit, to perpetrate (a crime, blunder, etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 犯下、干出罪行或重大错误等。
作出承诺；使自己承担某项责任或义务。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, l-impjegat ammetta li kkommetta żball fil-kalkolu u spjega kif se jikkoreġih.
formal.en: In his report, the employee admitted that he had made an error in the calculation and explained how he would correct it.
formal.zh: 这名员工在报告中承认自己在计算中犯了错误，并说明了将如何纠正。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu kkommetta ruħu li jgħinna nhar is-Sibt? Mark: Iva, qal li jasal fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Pawlu commit himself to helping us on Saturday? Mark: Yes, he said he would arrive at nine.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu 答应星期六来帮我们了吗？Mark：答应了，他说九点到。

messages.speaker: Sara (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu kkommetta ruħu li jgħinna nhar is-Sibt?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu kkommetta ruħu li jgħinna nhar is-Sibt?
messages.zh: Pawlu 答应星期六来帮我们了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu commit himself to helping us on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Mark (同伴)
messages.zh: 答应了，他说九点到。
messages.en: Yes, he said he would arrive at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张情景卡区分：接 żball 想到犯错，接 ruħu 想到自己承担承诺，连搭配一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who gathers and keeps particular kinds of objects as a collection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某类物品收集并保存为藏品的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiġbor u żżomm ċerti tipi ta' oġġetti biex tifforma kollezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收藏者；收藏家。

formal.mt: Il-kollezzjonist sellef għaxar muniti rari lill-mużew għal wirja temporanja.
formal.en: The collector lent ten rare coins to the museum for a temporary exhibition.
formal.zh: 这位收藏者将十枚稀有硬币借给博物馆，用于一场临时展览。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex iżżomm dawn il-muniti kollha? Pawlu: Għax jien kollezzjonist tal-muniti. Kull waħda għandha storja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you keep all these coins? Pawlu: Because I'm a coin collector. Each one has a story.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么留着这么多硬币？Pawlu：因为我是硬币收藏爱好者。每一枚都有一个故事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么留着这么多硬币？
messages.en: Why do you keep all these coins?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (收藏者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jien kollezzjonist tal-muniti. Kull waħda għandha storja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jien kollezzjonist tal-muniti. Kull waħda għandha storja.
messages.zh: 因为我是硬币收藏爱好者。每一枚都有一个故事。
messages.en: Because I'm a coin collector. Each one has a story.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人站在自己的硬币收藏柜旁，把人物标签写成 kollezzjonist，牢记它指收藏的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or power that establishes control over another territory and its inhabitants through colonization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过殖民活动控制另一片领土及其居民的个人或势力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew qawwa li tistabbilixxi kontroll fuq territorju ieħor u l-abitanti tiegħu permezz tal-kolonizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 殖民者；对其他地区实施殖民控制的人或势力。

formal.mt: L-artiklu janalizza r-relazzjoni bejn il-kolonizzatur u l-popolazzjoni lokali.
formal.en: The article analyzes the relationship between the colonizer and the local population.
formal.zh: 这篇文章分析了殖民者与当地居民之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu l-kolonizzatur f'din l-istorja? Mark: Huwa l-ħakkiem barrani li jieħu l-kontroll tal-gżira.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is the colonizer in this story? Mark: It's the foreign ruler who takes control of the island.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个故事里的殖民者是谁？Mark：就是那个控制了岛屿的外来统治者。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的殖民者是谁？
messages.en: Who is the colonizer in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-ħakkiem barrani li jieħu l-kontroll tal-gżira.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-ħakkiem barrani li jieħu l-kontroll tal-gżira.
messages.zh: 就是那个控制了岛屿的外来统治者。
messages.en: It's the foreign ruler who takes control of the island.

cognitive_memory_aid: 阅读时先问谁在实施殖民控制，再给这个行动者贴上 kolonizzatur 的标签，抓住人物角色来记。

gloss_zh: 韩国人；朝鲜人；朝鲜半岛人士

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person from Korea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自朝鲜半岛的人；具体译为韩国人或朝鲜人，应结合语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna mill-Korea.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 韩国人；朝鲜人；来自朝鲜半岛的人，具体所指依语境而定。

collocations.zh: 一位来自首尔的韩国人
一位住在马耳他的韩国人或朝鲜人

formal.mt: Fost il-parteċipanti kien hemm Korejan minn Seoul li ppreżenta r-riċerka tiegħu.
formal.en: Among the participants was a Korean from Seoul who presented his research.
formal.zh: 与会者中有一位来自首尔的韩国人，他介绍了自己的研究。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int Korejan? Jisoo: Iva, jien minn Seoul. U int? Maja: Jien Maltija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you Korean? Jisoo: Yes, I'm from Seoul. And you? Maja: I'm Maltese.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你是韩国人吗？Jisoo：是的，我来自首尔。你呢？Maja：我是马耳他人。

messages.speaker: Maja (新同学)
messages.zh: 你是韩国人吗？
messages.en: Are you Korean?

messages.speaker: Jisoo (韩国男学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien minn Seoul. U int?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien minn Seoul. U int?
messages.zh: 是的，我来自首尔。你呢？
messages.en: Yes, I'm from Seoul. And you?

messages.speaker: Maja (新同学)
messages.zh: 我是马耳他人。
messages.en: I'm Maltese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Korejan 放进自我介绍问答 Int Korejan? 中记忆；遇到具体国别时，再看人物来自哪里。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The religion centered on Jesus Christ and his teachings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以耶稣基督及其教导为核心的宗教。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-reliġjon ibbażata fuq Ġesù Kristu u t-tagħlim tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 基督教。

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jippreżenta l-Kristjaneżmu u jispjega xi wħud mit-tagħlimiet ewlenin tiegħu.
formal.en: This chapter introduces Christianity and explains some of its main teachings.
formal.zh: 本章介绍基督教，并解释其部分主要教义。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dwar xiex hu dan il-ktieb? Pawlu: Dwar il-Kristjaneżmu. Qed naqrah għal-lezzjoni tar-reliġjon.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this book about? Pawlu: It's about Christianity. I'm reading it for religion class.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这本书讲什么？Pawlu：讲基督教。我正在为宗教课读这本书。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 这本书讲什么？
messages.en: What is this book about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar il-Kristjaneżmu. Qed naqrah għal-lezzjoni tar-reliġjon.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar il-Kristjaneżmu. Qed naqrah għal-lezzjoni tar-reliġjon.
messages.zh: 讲基督教。我正在为宗教课读这本书。
messages.en: It's about Christianity. I'm reading it for religion class.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本封面写着 Kristjaneżmu 的宗教入门书，把整本书的主题直接对应为基督教。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small spoon used for stirring tea or coffee or for measuring a small amount of an ingredient.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于搅拌茶、咖啡或量取少量食材的小匙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mgħarfa żgħira li tintuża biex tħawwad it-te jew il-kafè, jew biex tkejjel ammont żgħir ta' ingredjent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 茶匙；用于搅拌茶或量取少量食材的小匙。
咖啡匙；用于搅拌咖啡的小匙。
茶匙、咖啡匙；供茶或咖啡使用的小匙。

formal.mt: Żid kuċċarina zokkor mat-taħlita u ħawwad sew.
formal.en: Add a teaspoon of sugar to the mixture and stir well.
formal.zh: 在混合物中加入一茶匙糖，并充分搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tagħtini kuċċarina, jekk jogħġbok? Mark: Iva, hawn waħda ħdejn it-tazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Could you give me a teaspoon, please? Mark: Yes, here's one next to the cup.
colloquial.zh: Maja：请递给我一把茶匙，好吗？Mark：好，这里有一把，就在杯子旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 请递给我一把茶匙，好吗？
messages.en: Could you give me a teaspoon, please?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，这里有一把，就在杯子旁边。
messages.en: Yes, here's one next to the cup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kuċċarina 和咖啡杯旁的小匙一起记：搅一搅咖啡，也能量一小匙糖。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The members of a religious community who are not clergy, considered as a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宗教团体中不属于神职人员的普通信徒的统称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-membri ta' komunità reliġjuża li mhumiex membri tal-kleru, meqjusa bħala grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平信徒；宗教团体中非神职信徒的总称。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza r-rwol tal-lajċità fil-ħajja tal-parroċċa.
formal.en: The report emphasizes the role of the laity in parish life.
formal.zh: 报告强调平信徒群体在堂区生活中的作用。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'jiġifieri lajċità f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Il-fidili li mhumiex membri tal-kleru.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does lajċità mean in this text? Pawlu: The faithful who are not members of the clergy.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这篇文章里的 lajċità 是什么意思？Pawlu：指不属于神职人员的信徒。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 lajċità 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does lajċità mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 指不属于神职人员的信徒。
messages.en: The faithful who are not members of the clergy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lajċità 想成教堂里普通信徒的集体合照，记住它指平信徒群体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Occurring or active at night, or relating to the night.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在夜间发生或活动的，或与夜晚有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jseħħ jew ikun attiv billejl, jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-lejl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夜间的；在夜晚活动或发生的。

formal.mt: Il-qanfud huwa annimal lejli li jfittex l-ikel l-aktar billejl.
formal.en: The hedgehog is a nocturnal animal that looks for food mainly at night.
formal.zh: 刺猬是一种夜行动物，主要在夜间觅食。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma narawx il-qanfud matul il-jum? Ninu: Għax huwa annimal lejli; joħroġ l-aktar billejl.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why don't we see the hedgehog during the day? Ninu: Because it's a nocturnal animal; it comes out mainly at night.
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么我们白天看不到刺猬？Ninu：因为它是夜行动物，主要在夜里出来。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma narawx il-qanfud matul il-jum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma narawx il-qanfud matul il-jum?
messages.zh: 为什么我们白天看不到刺猬？
messages.en: Why don't we see the hedgehog during the day?

messages.speaker: Ninu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huwa annimal lejli; joħroġ l-aktar billejl.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huwa annimal lejli; joħroġ l-aktar billejl.
messages.zh: 因为它是夜行动物，主要在夜里出来。
messages.en: Because it's a nocturnal animal; it comes out mainly at night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用月亮下觅食的刺猬记 lejli：给动物贴上这个形容词，就想到夜间活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where books are kept for reading or borrowing, or a collection of books owned privately or made available to the public.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 保存图书供人阅读或借阅的场所，也指私人拥有或向公众开放的一批藏书。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jinżammu kotba għall-qari jew għas-self, jew ġabra ta' kotba privata jew miftuħa għall-pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 图书馆；保存图书供人阅读或借阅的场所。

sense_translations.en_definition: library (book collection, whether private or accessible to the public)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 藏书；私人拥有或向公众开放的图书收藏。

collocations.en: a private library or book collection
collocations.zh: 私人图书馆或私人藏书

formal.mt: Il-librerija pubblika tipprovdi kotba għall-qari u għas-self.
formal.en: The public library provides books for reading and borrowing.
formal.zh: 公共图书馆提供图书供人阅读和借阅。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn sejra wara l-iskola? Maja: Se mmur il-librerija biex nissellef ktieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are you going after school? Maja: I'm going to the library to borrow a book.
colloquial.zh: Lara：放学后你要去哪里？Maja：我要去图书馆借一本书。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 放学后你要去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going after school?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur il-librerija biex nissellef ktieb.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur il-librerija biex nissellef ktieb.
messages.zh: 我要去图书馆借一本书。
messages.en: I'm going to the library to borrow a book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 librerija：一幅是可借书的图书馆，另一幅是家里整套私人藏书。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular height, amount, degree, or standard of something, such as water, ability, or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物所处的高度、数量程度或标准，如水位、能力水平或难度级别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għoli, ammont, grad jew standard ta' xi ħaġa, bħall-ilma, il-ħila jew id-diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水平；级别；程度；高度，具体含义依语境而定。

formal.mt: Il-kors huwa adattat għal studenti b'livell bażiku tal-Malti.
formal.en: The course is suitable for students with a basic level of Maltese.
formal.zh: 本课程适合具备基础马耳他语水平的学生。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ktieb tajjeb għal-livell tiegħi? Sara: Iva, il-lingwa hija sempliċi u tista' tifhimha.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this book suitable for my level? Sara: Yes, the language is simple and you can understand it.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这本书适合我的水平吗？Sara：适合，语言很简单，你能看懂。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 这本书适合我的水平吗？
messages.en: Is this book suitable for my level?

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-lingwa hija sempliċi u tista' tifhimha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-lingwa hija sempliċi u tista' tifhimha.
messages.zh: 适合，语言很简单，你能看懂。
messages.en: Yes, the language is simple and you can understand it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 livell 画成一把刻度尺：量水得到水位，量学习能力得到水平，量任务得到难度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very large mammal with a long trunk, large ears, and thick legs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种体型很大、长有长鼻、大耳和粗壮四肢的哺乳动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mammiferu kbir ħafna b'tromba twila, widnejn kbar u saqajn ħoxnin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大象；长有长鼻和大耳的大型哺乳动物。

formal.mt: Il-ljunfant juża t-tromba tiegħu biex jiġbor l-ikel u jieħu l-ilma.
formal.en: The elephant uses its trunk to gather food and take in water.
formal.zh: 大象用鼻子取食和吸水。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara kemm hi twila t-tromba tal-ljunfant! Ninu: Iva, biha jista' jiġbor l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look how long the elephant's trunk is! Ninu: Yes, it can use it to pick up food.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看，大象的鼻子多长啊！Ninu：是啊，它可以用鼻子拿食物。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hi twila t-tromba tal-ljunfant!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hi twila t-tromba tal-ljunfant!
messages.zh: 看，大象的鼻子多长啊！
messages.en: Look how long the elephant's trunk is!

messages.speaker: Ninu (父亲)
messages.zh: 是啊，它可以用鼻子拿食物。
messages.en: Yes, it can use it to pick up food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ljunfant 时想象一头用长鼻卷起食物的大象，把词形和长鼻、大耳的轮廓一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: During the evening or night of the present day.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在今天的晚上或夜间，用来说明事情发生的时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Filgħaxija jew matul il-lejl tal-ġurnata tal-lum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 今晚；今天晚上。
在今晚；在今天晚上。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir llejla fis-sebgħa fis-sala tal-iskola.
formal.en: The meeting will take place tonight at seven in the school hall.
formal.zh: 会议将于今晚七点在学校礼堂举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi tiekol magħna llejla? Mark: Iva, niġi fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to come and eat with us tonight? Mark: Yes, I'll come at eight.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今晚想来和我们一起吃饭吗？马克：好，我八点来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今晚想来和我们一起吃饭吗？
messages.en: Would you like to come and eat with us tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我八点来。
messages.en: Yes, I'll come at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 llejla 和日历上今天的月亮图标配对记忆：说到这个词，就想到今晚的安排。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Together with someone or something, indicating company or accompaniment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示与某人或某物相伴、共同参与，相当于“和”“跟”或“与……一起”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex turi li persuna jew ħaġa tkun flimkien ma' persuna jew ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 和；跟；与……一起，表示伴随。
与……一起；伴随……，表示共同参与或同时发生。

formal.mt: Kull student għandu jaħdem ma' sieħeb biex ilesti l-eżerċizzju.
formal.en: Each student should work with a partner to complete the exercise.
formal.zh: 每名学生应与一位搭档合作完成练习。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ma' min sejjer iċ-ċinema? Pawlu: Sejjer ma' Marija. Trid tiġi magħna?
colloquial.en: Sara: Who are you going to the cinema with? Pawlu: I'm going with Marija. Would you like to come with us?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你要和谁去看电影？保罗：我和玛丽亚去。你想和我们一起去吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要和谁去看电影？
messages.en: Who are you going to the cinema with?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer ma' Marija. Trid tiġi magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer ma' Marija. Trid tiġi magħna?
messages.zh: 我和玛丽亚去。你想和我们一起去吗？
messages.en: I'm going with Marija. Would you like to come with us?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人并肩走路，中间写着 ma'；它把同行的人连起来，词尾的撇号也要一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Suffering from hardship or misfortune and deserving pity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因生活困苦或遭遇不幸而处境悲惨、令人怜悯的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab f'qagħda ta' tbatija jew sfortuna u jqanqal ħasra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 困苦的；悲惨的；令人怜悯的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel magħkus isib kenn u għajnuna għand familja fil-villaġġ.
formal.en: In the story, the wretched man finds shelter and help with a family in the village.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个困苦的男人在村里的一户人家找到了住处并得到了帮助。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak ir-raġel magħkus ħdejn il-bieb? Toni: Tilef daru fin-nar. Ejja naraw kif nistgħu ngħinuh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that poor man by the door? Toni: He lost his home in the fire. Let's see how we can help him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：门边那个可怜的男人是谁？托尼：他在火灾中失去了家。我们看看能怎么帮他吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel magħkus ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel magħkus ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 门边那个可怜的男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that poor man by the door?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Tilef daru fin-nar. Ejja naraw kif nistgħu ngħinuh.
messages.mt_standard: Tilef daru fin-nar. Ejja naraw kif nistgħu ngħinuh.
messages.zh: 他在火灾中失去了家。我们看看能怎么帮他吧。
messages.en: He lost his home in the fire. Let's see how we can help him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事画面记忆 magħkus：一个遭遇不幸、需要帮助的人；重点记住困苦处境和怜悯意味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small citrus fruits with orange skin that is usually easy to peel and flesh divided into segments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 橙色果皮通常容易剥开、果肉分成瓣的小型柑橘果实；此处指橘子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frott taċ-ċitru b'qoxra oranġjo li normalment titqaxxar faċilment u b'ġewwieni maqsum fi flieli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 橘子；蜜橘一类的柑橘果实。

formal.mt: Għall-attività dwar il-frott, l-għalliema ġabet mandolin u tuffieħ biex l-istudenti jqabblu l-kulur u t-togħma tagħhom.
formal.en: For the activity about fruit, the teacher brought mandarins and apples so that the students could compare their colour and taste.
formal.zh: 在水果主题活动中，老师带来了橘子和苹果，让学生比较它们的颜色和味道。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek mandolin ħelu llum? Ġużeppi: Iva, dawn ħelwin ħafna. Kemm trid?
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have sweet mandarins today? Ġużeppi: Yes, these are very sweet. How much would you like?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：今天有甜橘子吗？朱塞佩：有，这些很甜。你要多少？

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天有甜橘子吗？
messages.en: Do you have sweet mandarins today?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (水果摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dawn ħelwin ħafna. Kemm trid?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dawn ħelwin ħafna. Kemm trid?
messages.zh: 有，这些很甜。你要多少？
messages.en: Yes, these are very sweet. How much would you like?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mandolin 写在一袋橘子的图画旁，再用 kilo mandolin 练习买水果，靠剥皮分瓣的画面记住本义。

gloss_zh: 缺乏；短缺；缺失；过失；错误

teaching_sense.en_definition: An absence or insufficient amount of something needed; also a fault or mistake.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所需事物的缺失或数量不足；也可指行为或工作中的过失、错误。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas jew ammont mhux biżżejjed ta' xi ħaġa meħtieġa; ukoll żball jew nuqqas fl-imġiba jew fix-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缺乏；短缺；不足；所需事物的缺失。
过失；错误；行为或工作中的疏失。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-mankanza ta' tagħmir xieraq wasslet għal dewmien fix-xogħol.
formal.en: The report indicates that the lack of suitable equipment caused delays in the work.
formal.zh: 报告指出，缺乏合适的设备导致了工作延误。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex waqaf ix-xogħol? David: Minħabba mankanza ta' materjal. Il-kunsinna tasal għada.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why has the work stopped? David: Because of a shortage of materials. The delivery arrives tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：工作为什么停下来了？戴维：因为材料短缺。货明天送到。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 工作为什么停下来了？
messages.en: Why has the work stopped?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba mankanza ta' materjal. Il-kunsinna tasal għada.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba mankanza ta' materjal. Il-kunsinna tasal għada.
messages.zh: 因为材料短缺。货明天送到。
messages.en: Because of a shortage of materials. The delivery arrives tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张图记 mankanza：空水杯表示缺乏，作业上的错号表示过失；遇到上下文再选择对应义项。

gloss_zh: 小型钉头锤；小型棍棒式打击武器

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small mace: a club-like weapon with a heavy head used for striking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种小型棍棒式打击武器，前端装有较重的锤头，可译为小型钉头锤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arma żgħira b'manku u ras tqila, li tintuża biex tagħti daqqiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小型钉头锤；前端带有重头的短小棍棒式武器。

collocations.en: the head of the small mace

formal.mt: Il-mazzetta esposta fil-mużew għandha manku qasir u ras tal-ħadid.
formal.en: The small mace displayed in the museum has a short handle and an iron head.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出的这把小型钉头锤有一根短柄和一个铁制锤头。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhi dik l-arma żgħira fil-vetrina? Ruben: Dik mazzetta. Ara kemm hi kbira r-ras meta tqabbilha mal-manku.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is that small weapon in the display case? Ruben: That's a small mace. Look how large the head is compared with the handle.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：展柜里那件小武器是什么？鲁本：那是一把小型钉头锤。你看，它的锤头和柄相比多大。

messages.speaker: Anna (参观者)
messages.zh: 展柜里那件小武器是什么？
messages.en: What is that small weapon in the display case?

messages.speaker: Ruben (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik mazzetta. Ara kemm hi kbira r-ras meta tqabbilha mal-manku.
messages.mt_standard: Dik mazzetta. Ara kemm hi kbira r-ras meta tqabbilha mal-manku.
messages.zh: 那是一把小型钉头锤。你看，它的锤头和柄相比多大。
messages.en: That's a small mace. Look how large the head is compared with the handle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一件短柄、重头的小武器，在旁边标 mazzetta；用“小型钉头锤”的整体轮廓帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 织布梭；总是走来走去的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shuttle used in weaving to carry thread between warp threads; also a person who is always walking about.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 织布时携带纬线穿过经线之间的梭子；也指总是走来走去、闲不住的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda tal-insiġ li ġġorr il-ħajt bejn il-ħjut tat-tul; ukoll persuna li tkun dejjem iddur u timxi minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who walks about all the time
sense_translations.zh_definition: 总是走来走去的人；不停四处走动的人。
梭子，织布时用于引送纬线的工具。
织布梭；携带纬线穿过经线之间的织布工具。

collocations.en: that boy is always walking about
collocations.zh: 那个男孩总是走来走去

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni tal-insiġ, l-għalliema għaddiet il-mekkuk bejn il-ħjut tat-tul.
formal.en: During the weaving demonstration, the teacher passed the shuttle between the warp threads.
formal.zh: 在织布示范中，老师把梭子从经线之间穿了过去。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn hu Pawlu? Ilu dieħel u ħiereġ minn filgħodu. Ġanni: Dak mekkuk! Issa mar sal-ħanut.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where is Pawlu? He's been coming and going all morning. Ġanni: He's always on the move! He's gone to the shop now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：保罗在哪儿？他一早上都在进进出出。詹尼：他就是个闲不住的人！这会儿又去商店了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu Pawlu? Ilu dieħel u ħiereġ minn filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu Pawlu? Ilu dieħel u ħiereġ minn filgħodu.
messages.zh: 保罗在哪儿？他一早上都在进进出出。
messages.en: Where is Pawlu? He's been coming and going all morning.

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.zh: 他就是个闲不住的人！这会儿又去商店了。
messages.en: He's always on the move! He's gone to the shop now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mekkuk 的两个义项放在同一幅记忆图里：梭子来回穿线，旁边的人来回走动；这是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of animals, such as sheep or cattle, that live, graze, or move together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 共同生活、吃草或移动的一群动物，常用于羊、牛等牲畜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' annimali, bħal nagħaġ jew baqar, li jgħixu, jirgħu jew jimxu flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 兽群；畜群，尤指牛等聚集在一起的动物。
羊群等聚集在一起的动物群。
被成群驱赶或一起移动的牲畜群。
畜群；羊群；共同活动的一群动物。

formal.mt: Ir-ragħaj mexxa l-merħla nagħaġ lejn għalqa fejn kien hemm biżżejjed ħaxix u ilma.
formal.en: The shepherd led the flock of sheep towards a field where there was enough grass and water.
formal.zh: 牧羊人把羊群带向一块有充足青草和水的田地。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Ara dik il-merħla nagħaġ ħdejn it-triq! Mark: Iva, ejja nistennew sakemm jgħaddu kollha.
colloquial.en: Elena: Look at that flock of sheep by the road! Mark: Yes, let's wait until they have all passed.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：看路边那群羊！马克：是啊，我们等它们全都过去吧。

messages.speaker: Elena (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dik il-merħla nagħaġ ħdejn it-triq!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dik il-merħla nagħaġ ħdejn it-triq!
messages.zh: 看路边那群羊！
messages.en: Look at that flock of sheep by the road!

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nistennew sakemm jgħaddu kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nistennew sakemm jgħaddu kollha.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们等它们全都过去吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's wait until they have all passed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个圈把许多羊圈在一起，圈外写 merħla；这个词把动物看作一个群体，再搭配 nagħaġ 或 baqar 说明是哪种动物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At what time; used to ask about the time of an event or action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 什么时候；用来询问事件发生或动作进行的时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'liema ħin jew żmien; tintuża biex tistaqsi dwar il-ħin ta' ġrajja jew azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 什么时候；在什么时间。
当……时；在……的时候，用来连接表示时间的从句。

formal.mt: Meta jaslu d-dokumenti, l-uffiċċju jibda jeżamina t-talba.
formal.en: When the documents arrive, the office will begin examining the request.
formal.zh: 文件到达后，办公室将开始审核申请。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Meta se tasal? Pawlu: Għall-ħamsa. Nċempillek meta nasal.
colloquial.en: Marija: When will you arrive? Pawlu: At five. I'll call you when I arrive.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你什么时候到？Pawlu：五点。我到了就给你打电话。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你什么时候到？
messages.en: When will you arrive?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 五点。我到了就给你打电话。
messages.en: At five. I'll call you when I arrive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 meta 放在时间轴旁记忆：提问时是“什么时候”，连接两件事时是“当……时”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A utensil with a handle and a small bowl, used for eating, serving, or stirring food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 勺子；带有柄和凹形匙头，用来进食、盛取或搅拌食物的餐具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'manku u parti fonda żgħira, li tintuża biex tiekol, isservi jew tħawwad l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勺子；匙。
餐桌上使用的汤匙；大餐匙。
匙；作为餐具使用的勺子。

formal.mt: Ħawwad it-taħlita b'mgħarfa tal-injam sakemm tkun lixxa.
formal.en: Stir the mixture with a wooden spoon until it is smooth.
formal.zh: 用木勺搅拌混合物，直至顺滑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tgħaddili mgħarfa, jekk jogħġbok? Mark: Hawn għandek. Trid waħda kbira jew żgħira?
colloquial.en: Lara: Could you pass me a spoon, please? Mark: Here you go. Do you want a large one or a small one?
colloquial.zh: Lara：请递给我一把勺子好吗？Mark：给你。你要大的还是小的？

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 请递给我一把勺子好吗？
messages.en: Could you pass me a spoon, please?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn għandek. Trid waħda kbira jew żgħira?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn għandek. Trid waħda kbira jew żgħira?
messages.zh: 给你。你要大的还是小的？
messages.en: Here you go. Do you want a large one or a small one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一把有长柄、凹匙头的汤匙，把 mgħarfa 与“舀汤、搅拌”两个动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a noticeable taste of salt or containing a substantial amount of salt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 咸的；具有明显盐味或含有较多盐分的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu togħma ta' melħ jew fih ħafna melħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咸的；有盐味的。
不育的；指男性或雄性没有生育能力。

formal.mt: Dan il-ġobon għandu togħma qawwija u huwa mielaħ ħafna.
formal.en: This cheese has a strong flavour and is very salty.
formal.zh: 这种奶酪风味浓郁，而且很咸。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-ġobon mielaħ wisq għalija. Ġużeppi: Ħu ftit ħobż miegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: This cheese is too salty for me. Ġużeppi: Have some bread with it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这奶酪对我来说太咸了。Ġużeppi：配点面包吃吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这奶酪对我来说太咸了。
messages.en: This cheese is too salty for me.

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.zh: 配点面包吃吧。
messages.en: Have some bread with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“咸奶酪”画面记住 mielaħ 的味觉义；另把“雄性不育”单独做卡片，按语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To die or cease to be alive; also, to die down or lose strength. The form miet commonly means 'he died' or 'it died'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 死亡；也可指风势等减弱、平息。miet 这一形式通常表示“他死了”或“它消退了”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma baqax ħaj; jingħad ukoll għal xi ħaġa bħar-riħ meta titlef il-qawwa tagħha jew tieqaf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 死；死亡，失去生命。
减弱；逐渐平息或消退。

formal.mt: Il-kittieb miet wara marda twila, iżda x-xogħlijiet tiegħu għadhom jinqraw.
formal.en: The writer died after a long illness, but his works are still read.
formal.zh: 这位作家久病后去世了，但他的作品至今仍有人阅读。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ir-riħ miet? David: Iva, issa nistgħu noħorġu nimxu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has the wind died down? David: Yes, we can go out for a walk now.
colloquial.zh: Sara：风停下来了吗？David：是的，现在我们可以出去散步了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 风停下来了吗？
messages.en: Has the wind died down?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，现在我们可以出去散步了。
messages.en: Yes, we can go out for a walk now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 miet 配两幅画：生命停止是“死了”，风力消失是“平息了”；共同记住“活动终止”的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number one hundred, equal to ten times ten; used on its own to name this quantity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一百，即十乘以十；可独立使用，表示这个数目。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 100, jiġifieri għaxar darbiet għaxra; jista' jintuża waħdu biex jindika din il-kwantità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一百；表示数量的基数词。
一百；独立使用的数词形式。

formal.mt: In-numru ta' parteċipanti laħaq il-mija.
