formal.en: The number of participants reached one hundred.
formal.zh: 参与人数达到了一百。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm hemm siġġijiet fis-sala? Mark: Mija, eżatt.
colloquial.en: Anna: How many chairs are there in the hall? Mark: Exactly one hundred.
colloquial.zh: Anna：大厅里有多少把椅子？Mark：正好一百把。

messages.speaker: Anna (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 大厅里有多少把椅子？
messages.en: How many chairs are there in the hall?

messages.speaker: Mark (场地工作人员)
messages.zh: 正好一百把。
messages.en: Exactly one hundred.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象十排、每排十把椅子，共一百把；回答数量时直接说 mija，把读音与一百格方阵相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Again or afresh; used when an action is repeated or something is begun anew.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 再次；重新。表示重复某个动作，或从头开始做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għal darba oħra jew b'bidu ġdid; tintuża meta azzjoni ssir darba oħra jew xi ħaġa terġa' tibda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重新；从头开始。
再；又；再次。
再次；又一次。

formal.mt: Jekk id-dħul tad-data jfalli, il-proċess għandu jibda mill-ġdid.
formal.en: If data entry fails, the process must start again.
formal.zh: 如果数据录入失败，该流程必须重新开始。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ma fhimtx l-aħħar sentenza. Taqraha mill-ġdid? Ben: Iva, naqraha bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Rita: I didn't understand the last sentence. Could you read it again? Ben: Yes, I'll read it slowly.
colloquial.zh: Rita：我没听懂最后一句。你能再读一遍吗？Ben：可以，我慢慢读。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma fhimtx l-aħħar sentenza. Taqraha mill-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Ma fhimtx l-aħħar sentenza. Taqraha mill-ġdid?
messages.zh: 我没听懂最后一句。你能再读一遍吗？
messages.en: I didn't understand the last sentence. Could you read it again?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 可以，我慢慢读。
messages.en: Yes, I'll read it slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mill-ġdid 写在“重播”按钮上：按一下再来一次，回到起点则是“重新开始”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The pupil, the opening in the centre of the coloured part of the eye through which light enters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 瞳孔；位于眼睛虹膜中央、让光线进入眼内的开口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fetħa fiċ-ċentru tal-parti kkulurita tal-għajn, minn fejn jidħol id-dawl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瞳孔；也可指极其亲爱的人、心爱的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: pupil (the hole in the middle of the iris of the eye)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 瞳孔，即眼睛虹膜中央的开口。
小伤、小伤处；哄孩子或与孩子说话时使用的说法。

formal.mt: It-tabib eżamina l-mimmi tal-għajn waqt il-kontroll.
formal.en: The doctor examined the pupil of the eye during the check-up.
formal.zh: 医生在检查时查看了眼睛的瞳孔。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'inhi dik il-parti sewda fin-nofs tal-għajn? Marija: Dik il-mimmi tal-għajn.
colloquial.en: Lina: What is that black part in the middle of the eye? Marija: That's the pupil of the eye.
colloquial.zh: Lina：眼睛中间那个黑色的部分是什么？Marija：那是瞳孔。

messages.speaker: Lina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi dik il-parti sewda fin-nofs tal-għajn?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi dik il-parti sewda fin-nofs tal-għajn?
messages.zh: 眼睛中间那个黑色的部分是什么？
messages.en: What is that black part in the middle of the eye?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 那是瞳孔。
messages.en: That's the pupil of the eye.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先画眼睛中央的小黑圆记 mimmi“瞳孔”；再分别配爱心和小创可贴，记住亲爱的人与小伤两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At any moment; used for something that could happen very soon, without a known exact time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随时；表示某事很快就可能发生，但具体时间尚不确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fi kwalunkwe mument; tintuża għal xi ħaġa li tista' sseħħ dalwaqt, mingħajr ħin eżatt magħruf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 随时；任何一刻都可能发生，常指即将发生的事情。

collocations.mt: jista' jasal minn waqt għal ieħor
collocations.en: he could arrive at any moment

collocations.mt: mistenni jibda minn waqt għal ieħor
collocations.en: expected to start at any moment

formal.mt: Il-ferrovija mistennija tasal minn waqt għal ieħor; il-passiġġieri għandhom jibqgħu fuq il-pjattaforma.
formal.en: The train is expected to arrive at any moment; passengers should remain on the platform.
formal.zh: 列车预计随时会到站；乘客应留在站台上。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Għad għandna ħin nagħmlu kafè? Luqa: Aħjar nistennew. It-taxi tista' tasal minn waqt għal ieħor.
colloquial.en: Emma: Do we still have time to make coffee? Luqa: We'd better wait. The taxi could arrive at any moment.
colloquial.zh: Emma：我们还有时间煮咖啡吗？Luqa：最好先等着。出租车随时可能到。

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们还有时间煮咖啡吗？
messages.en: Do we still have time to make coffee?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar nistennew. It-taxi tista' tasal minn waqt għal ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar nistennew. It-taxi tista' tasal minn waqt għal ieħor.
messages.zh: 最好先等着。出租车随时可能到。
messages.en: We'd better wait. The taxi could arrive at any moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象站在门口等出租车，每一秒都可能听见车声；把整句短语与“随时就到”的期待感一起记。

gloss_zh: 下降处；登岸处；途中驿站

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place for descending or landing, or a stopping place along a journey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人下降、登岸的地点，也可指旅途中停靠或歇脚的站点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn wieħed jinżel jew jiżbarka, jew fejn jieqaf waqt vjaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供人下降或下去的地点。
供人登岸或下船的地点。
旅途中供人停靠、休息或中转的驿站。

formal.mt: Il-minżel ħdejn ix-xmara jintuża biex il-passiġġieri jinżlu mid-dgħajjes.
formal.en: The landing place beside the river is used for passengers to disembark from boats.
formal.zh: 河边的登岸处供乘客下船使用。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hu l-minżel tad-dgħajjes? Pawlu: Hemmhekk, ħdejn il-pont.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the landing place for boats? Pawlu: Over there, beside the bridge.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：船只的登岸处在哪里？保罗：在那边，桥旁边。

messages.speaker: Anna (游客)
messages.zh: 船只的登岸处在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the landing place for boats?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (向导)
messages.zh: 在那边，桥旁边。
messages.en: Over there, beside the bridge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项画成旅途中的三个地点：下坡处、下船处、歇脚站；用场景图区分含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Compassion shown by helping someone in distress or treating someone less harshly than one could.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对困苦者给予帮助，或对可以严厉对待的人予以宽容的仁慈与怜悯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħniena li tidher fl-għajnuna lil min ibati jew fil-maħfra lil min ikun żbalja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怜悯、仁慈；对他人的苦难表示同情，或在惩罚与责备上给予宽容。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, il-priġunier talab miżerikordja u wiegħed li jibdel ħajtu.
formal.en: In his letter, the prisoner asked for mercy and promised to change his life.
formal.zh: 囚犯在信中请求宽恕，并承诺改变自己的生活。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għamel żball, imma talab skuża. Ġużeppi: Mela ejja nuru ftit miżerikordja u nagħtuh ċans ieħor.
colloquial.en: Marija: He made a mistake, but he apologised. Ġużeppi: Then let's show a little mercy and give him another chance.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：他犯了错，不过已经道歉了。朱塞佩：那我们就宽容一点，再给他一次机会吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 他犯了错，不过已经道歉了。
messages.en: He made a mistake, but he apologised.

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja nuru ftit miżerikordja u nagħtuh ċans ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja nuru ftit miżerikordja u nagħtuh ċans ieħor.
messages.zh: 那我们就宽容一点，再给他一次机会吧。
messages.en: Then let's show a little mercy and give him another chance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人犯错后请求再给一次机会，把这个词与伸手帮助、宽容原谅的画面相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become salty, for example when salt is added or liquid evaporates.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得有咸味，例如因加入盐或液体蒸发而变咸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir mielaħ, pereżempju meta jiżdied il-melħ jew jonqos l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始有咸味或变得更咸。
变成咸的，强调咸味状态的变化。

formal.mt: Il-brodu mlieħ wisq wara li żdied il-melħ darbtejn.
formal.en: The broth became too salty after salt was added twice.
formal.zh: 因为加了两次盐，肉汤变得太咸了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-brodu mlieħ wisq! Mark: Żid ftit ilma u erġa' duqu.
colloquial.en: Lara: The broth has become too salty! Mark: Add a little water and taste it again.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：肉汤变得太咸了！马克：加一点水，再尝尝。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 肉汤变得太咸了！
messages.en: The broth has become too salty!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żid ftit ilma u erġa' duqu.
messages.mt_standard: Żid ftit ilma u erġa' duqu.
messages.zh: 加一点水，再尝尝。
messages.en: Add a little water and taste it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住汤从清淡到咸的变化箭头：这个动词表达变咸，学习时把重点放在变化过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The way in which something is done, happens, or is expressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做某事、事情发生或表达某种意思时所采用的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-manjiera li biha ssir xi ħaġa, tiġri xi ħaġa jew wieħed jesprimi ruħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完成某事的方法或途径。
行事、说话或表现时的方式。
方式、方法或做法，指事情如何进行。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jipproponi mod ġdid biex jitnaqqas il-ħela tal-ilma.
formal.en: The report proposes a new way to reduce water waste.
formal.zh: 报告提出了一种减少水资源浪费的新方法。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif nista' niftakar dawn il-kliem? David: Ipprova użahom f'sentenzi; b'dan il-mod tiftakarhom aħjar.
colloquial.en: Nina: How can I remember these words? David: Try using them in sentences; this way you'll remember them better.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我怎样才能记住这些词？戴维：试着把它们用在句子里；这样你会记得更牢。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 我怎样才能记住这些词？
messages.en: How can I remember these words?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova użahom f'sentenzi; b'dan il-mod tiftakarhom aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova użahom f'sentenzi; b'dan il-mod tiftakarhom aħjar.
messages.zh: 试着把它们用在句子里；这样你会记得更牢。
messages.en: Try using them in sentences; this way you'll remember them better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词贴在如何做的问题旁边：同一件事可以有不同做法，每一种做法就是一个 mod。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool with a toothed blade used for cutting wood or other materials.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有齿状锯片，用来切割木材或其他材料的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'xafra bis-snien li tintuża biex taqta' l-injam jew materjali oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一把锯子；用带齿锯片切割材料的工具。
锯，指切割用的工具。

collocations.en: to cut wood with a saw

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa uża munxar tal-idejn biex jaqta' l-bord skont il-qies meħtieġ.
formal.en: The carpenter used a hand saw to cut the board to the required size.
formal.zh: 木匠用手锯把木板锯成所需尺寸。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek munxar? Irrid naqta' din il-biċċa njam. Pawlu: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-bank tax-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a saw? I want to cut this piece of wood. Pawlu: Yes, it's on the workbench.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你有锯子吗？我想锯这块木头。保罗：有，在工作台上。

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek munxar? Irrid naqta' din il-biċċa njam.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek munxar? Irrid naqta' din il-biċċa njam.
messages.zh: 你有锯子吗？我想锯这块木头。
messages.en: Do you have a saw? I want to cut this piece of wood.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 有，在工作台上。
messages.en: Yes, it's on the workbench.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一排锯齿在木板上来回移动，把工具外形、锯木动作和 munxar 一起记住。

gloss_zh: 自然主义的；写实地表现自然或生活的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Representing people, objects, or events as they appear in nature or everyday life, especially in art.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尤指艺术中按照自然或日常生活的实际面貌来表现人物、物体或事件的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jirrappreżenta nies, oġġetti jew ġrajjiet kif jidhru fin-natura jew fil-ħajja ta' kuljum, speċjalment fl-arti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自然主义的；在艺术表现中贴近自然或现实生活面貌的。

collocations.zh: 以写实手法表现的肖像

formal.mt: L-artist għażel stil naturalistiku biex juri l-uċuħ u l-ġesti tal-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The artist chose a naturalistic style to depict the workers' faces and gestures.
formal.zh: 艺术家选择自然主义风格来描绘工人的面容和动作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan ir-ritratt jidher bħal persuna vera! Luca: Iva, l-artist juża stil naturalistiku u jagħti ħafna kas tad-dettalji.
colloquial.en: Sara: This portrait looks like a real person! Luca: Yes, the artist uses a naturalistic style and pays close attention to detail.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这幅肖像看起来就像真人！卢卡：是啊，画家采用自然主义风格，而且非常注重细节。

messages.speaker: Sara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-ritratt jidher bħal persuna vera!
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-ritratt jidher bħal persuna vera!
messages.zh: 这幅肖像看起来就像真人！
messages.en: This portrait looks like a real person!

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-artist juża stil naturalistiku u jagħti ħafna kas tad-dettalji.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-artist juża stil naturalistiku u jagħti ħafna kas tad-dettalji.
messages.zh: 是啊，画家采用自然主义风格，而且非常注重细节。
messages.en: Yes, the artist uses a naturalistic style and pays close attention to detail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用像现实生活一样来记：看画中面容、动作和细节是否贴近真实，再联想自然主义风格。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become clean as dirt or unwanted material is removed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随着污垢或杂物被清除而变得干净。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir nadif meta jitneħħa l-ħmieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得干净，由脏污状态转为清洁状态。

formal.mt: Il-paviment ndaf wara li nħasel bl-ilma u s-sapun.
formal.en: The floor became clean after it was washed with water and soap.
formal.zh: 地板用水和肥皂清洗后变干净了。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-paviment ndaf? Ben: Iva, issa ma baqax ħmieġ fuqu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did the floor come clean? Ben: Yes, there's no dirt left on it now.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：地板洗干净了吗？本：是的，现在上面已经没有污垢了。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 地板洗干净了吗？
messages.en: Did the floor come clean?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa ma baqax ħmieġ fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa ma baqax ħmieġ fuqu.
messages.zh: 是的，现在上面已经没有污垢了。
messages.en: Yes, there's no dirt left on it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象擦洗前后的地板对比图，用脏到干净的箭头记住这个动词表达状态变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel sorry for something wrong one has done and wish to put it right.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为自己做错的事感到后悔，并希望改正或弥补。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddispjaċih għal xi ħaġa ħażina li għamel u jkun jixtieq jirranġaha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悔改；认识到自己的过错并愿意改正。
感到懊悔；因自己的过错而内疚。
道歉；为自己的过错表达歉意。
悔改，感到懊悔；为自己做过的错事深感后悔。

collocations.zh: 为自己的所作所为感到懊悔

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, Pawlu stqarr li nidem għal kliemu u talab maħfra.
formal.en: In his letter, Pawlu stated that he regretted his words and asked for forgiveness.
formal.zh: 保罗在信中表示，他为自己说过的话感到懊悔，并请求原谅。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark għadu rrabjat miegħek? Toni: Le, nidem għal dak li għedtlu u tlabtu jaħfirli. Lara: Tajjeb li tkellimtu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is Mark still angry with you? Toni: No, I regretted what I said to him and asked him to forgive me. Lara: It's good that you talked.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克还在生你的气吗？托尼：没有了，我为对他说过的话感到后悔，也请求他原谅我了。拉拉：你们谈过就好。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克还在生你的气吗？
messages.en: Is Mark still angry with you?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nidem għal dak li għedtlu u tlabtu jaħfirli.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nidem għal dak li għedtlu u tlabtu jaħfirli.
messages.zh: 没有了，我为对他说过的话感到后悔，也请求他原谅我了。
messages.en: No, I regretted what I said to him and asked him to forgive me.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们谈过就好。
messages.en: It's good that you talked.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nidem 放进“说错话后低头认错”的画面，连着记住后悔、悔改和致歉三个相关意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To transfer a privately owned business or industry into state ownership.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把原本属于私人所有的企业或行业转为国家所有。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi kumpanija jew industrija minn sjieda privata għal sjieda tal-istat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将企业、行业或资产国有化，使其转归国家所有。

formal.mt: Il-gvern nnazzjonalizza l-kumpanija tal-ferroviji, li qabel kienet proprjetà privata.
formal.en: The government nationalized the railway company, which had previously been privately owned.
formal.zh: 政府将这家此前属于私人所有的铁路公司国有化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-kumpanija għadha privata? David: Le, il-gvern nnazzjonalizza l-kumpanija s-sena l-oħra. Maja: Allura issa hija tal-istat.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this company still privately owned? David: No, the government nationalized the company last year. Maja: So it now belongs to the state.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这家公司还是私营的吗？戴维：不是，政府去年把这家公司国有化了。玛雅：那么它现在属于国家了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这家公司还是私营的吗？
messages.en: Is this company still privately owned?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-gvern nnazzjonalizza l-kumpanija s-sena l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-gvern nnazzjonalizza l-kumpanija s-sena l-oħra.
messages.zh: 不是，政府去年把这家公司国有化了。
messages.en: No, the government nationalized the company last year.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 那么它现在属于国家了。
messages.en: So it now belongs to the state.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nnazzjonalizza 与英语 nationalize 对照记忆，再想象企业所有权从私人手中交到国家手中。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Situated in the middle or toward the central line of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于某物中间，或靠近其中央线的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab fin-nofs jew lejn il-linja ċentrali ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中间的，居中的；在解剖等位置描述中指靠近中线的、内侧的。

collocations.en: the median plane of the body

formal.mt: Fid-dijagramma, il-pjan nofsi jaqsam il-ġisem f'nofs tal-lemin u nofs tax-xellug.
formal.en: In the diagram, the median plane divides the body into a right half and a left half.
formal.zh: 图中，正中面将身体分成右半部和左半部。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser nofsi hawn? Luka: Ifisser li jinsab fin-nofs. Ħares lejn il-punt nofsi ta' din il-linja. Sara: Issa fhimt fejn hu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does nofsi mean here? Luka: It means that it is in the middle. Look at the middle point of this line. Sara: Now I understand where it is.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里的 nofsi 是什么意思？卢卡：意思是位于中间。看这条线的中间点。萨拉：现在我明白它在哪里了。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 nofsi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does nofsi mean here?

messages.speaker: Luka (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jinsab fin-nofs. Ħares lejn il-punt nofsi ta' din il-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jinsab fin-nofs. Ħares lejn il-punt nofsi ta' din il-linja.
messages.zh: 意思是位于中间。看这条线的中间点。
messages.en: It means that it is in the middle. Look at the middle point of this line.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 现在我明白它在哪里了。
messages.en: Now I understand where it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画一条线并标出正中央，把 nofsi 写在中央标记旁，记住它描述中间或靠近中线的位置。

gloss_zh: 被带来；受敬重；与人相处融洽

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be brought to a place; in other senses, to be highly regarded or to get along with someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被带到某处；其他义项表示受到敬重，或与某人相处融洽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi miġjub f'post; f'tifsiriet oħra, ikun stmat ħafna jew ikun f'relazzjoni tajba ma' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被带来、被拿来或被送到某处。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be held in high esteem
sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到高度敬重或推崇。
与某人合得来，相处融洽。

formal.mt: Il-ktieb nġab fil-klassi biex l-istudenti jkunu jistgħu jaraw l-istampi waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The book was brought into the classroom so that the students could look at the pictures during the lesson.
formal.zh: 这本书被带到教室，让学生能在上课时观看其中的图片。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-pakkett nġab id-dar? David: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Marta: Was the parcel brought home? David: Yes, it's on the table beside the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：包裹送到家了吗？戴维：是的，就在门旁边的桌子上。

messages.speaker: Marta (妻子)
messages.zh: 包裹送到家了吗？
messages.en: Was the parcel brought home?

messages.speaker: David (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 是的，就在门旁边的桌子上。
messages.en: Yes, it's on the table beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三张情景卡记忆：包裹被带来、人物受敬重、朋友相处好；用完整语境区分三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large mammal with thick fur, strong limbs and claws.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种体形较大、毛厚、四肢强壮且有爪的哺乳动物，即熊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal mammiferu kbir b'pil oħxon, saqajn b'saħħithom u dwiefer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 熊，一种体形通常较大、四肢强壮的哺乳动物。

formal.mt: L-istudenti qabblu ritratt ta' ors polari ma' ritratt ta' ors kannella.
formal.en: The students compared a photograph of a polar bear with a photograph of a brown bear.
formal.zh: 学生们将一张北极熊的照片与一张棕熊的照片作了比较。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'annimal hemm f'dan ir-ritratt? Ben: Ors kannella. Ara kemm hu kbir! Nina: Iva, u għandu pil oħxon.
colloquial.en: Nina: What animal is in this photograph? Ben: A brown bear. Look how big it is! Nina: Yes, and it has thick fur.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这张照片里是什么动物？本：一只棕熊。看它多大！妮娜：是啊，而且它的毛很厚。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 这张照片里是什么动物？
messages.en: What animal is in this photograph?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ors kannella. Ara kemm hu kbir!
messages.mt_standard: Ors kannella. Ara kemm hu kbir!
messages.zh: 一只棕熊。看它多大！
messages.en: A brown bear. Look how big it is!

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 是啊，而且它的毛很厚。
messages.en: Yes, and it has thick fur.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短词 ors 写在一只大熊的图画下，再配上 polari 和 kannella，分别联想北极熊与棕熊。

gloss_zh: 使高兴；使欣喜；顺从某人的意愿

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone pleased or delighted, including by doing what that person wants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人高兴、满意或欣喜，也可指通过顺从对方的意愿来使其满意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel lil xi ħadd kuntent jew ferħan, ukoll billi jagħmel dak li dik il-persuna tixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使高兴；使满意。
按某人的吩咐行事；顺从某人的意愿。
照某人的要求去做；听从某人的吩咐。
使欣喜；使十分高兴。

formal.mt: Il-kunċert paxxa lill-udjenza b'għażla sabiħa ta' kanzunetti.
formal.en: The concert delighted the audience with a lovely selection of songs.
formal.zh: 这场音乐会以精心选取的悦耳歌曲令观众十分欣喜。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif kien l-ikel? Ġanni: Il-kok paxxa lil kulħadd! Marta: Mela nerġgħu mmorru hemm.
colloquial.en: Marta: How was the food? Ġanni: The cook pleased everyone! Marta: Then let's go there again.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：饭菜怎么样？詹尼：厨师让大家都很满意！玛尔塔：那我们下次再去那里吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 饭菜怎么样？
messages.en: How was the food?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.zh: 厨师让大家都很满意！
messages.en: The cook pleased everyone!

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们下次再去那里吧。
messages.en: Then let's go there again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象厨师端出人人喜欢的菜，把 paxxa 记成“让人满意”；再联想到按对方心意做事也能使人满意。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action or process of entering into or passing through something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进入某物内部或穿过某物的动作、过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-proċess ta' dħul f'xi ħaġa jew ta' għadd minn ġo fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿透；渗透；进入某物内部的过程或程度。

formal.mt: L-esperiment kejjel il-penetrazzjoni tad-dawl minn ġo materjali differenti.
formal.en: The experiment measured light penetration through different materials.
formal.zh: 该实验测量了光线穿透不同材料的情况。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex qed inpoġġu din il-kisja fuq il-ħajt? Karl: Biex innaqqsu l-penetrazzjoni tal-ilma. Rita: Allura tgħin biex il-ħajt jibqa' niexef.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are we putting this coating on the wall? Karl: To reduce water penetration. Rita: So it helps keep the wall dry.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们为什么要给墙刷这层涂料？卡尔：为了减少水的渗入。丽塔：这样就有助于让墙保持干燥。

messages.speaker: Rita (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed inpoġġu din il-kisja fuq il-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed inpoġġu din il-kisja fuq il-ħajt?
messages.zh: 我们为什么要给墙刷这层涂料？
messages.en: Why are we putting this coating on the wall?

messages.speaker: Karl (维修工)
messages.zh: 为了减少水的渗入。
messages.en: To reduce water penetration.

messages.speaker: Rita (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Allura tgħin biex il-ħajt jibqa' niexef.
messages.mt_standard: Allura tgħin biex il-ħajt jibqa' niexef.
messages.zh: 这样就有助于让墙保持干燥。
messages.en: So it helps keep the wall dry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 penetrazzjoni 与英语 penetration 对照，脑中画出水渗入墙体、光穿过材料的两幅画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species Calidris melanotos, known in English as the pectoral sandpiper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类斑胸滨鹬，学名为 Calidris melanotos，英文名为 pectoral sandpiper。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' għasfur bl-isem xjentifiku Calidris melanotos, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala pectoral sandpiper.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斑胸滨鹬，学名 Calidris melanotos。

collocations.en: a sighting of a pectoral sandpiper
collocations.zh: 一次斑胸滨鹬的目击记录

collocations.en: a photograph of a pectoral sandpiper

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi ritratt ta' pispisella Amerikana u jagħti l-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Calidris melanotos.
formal.en: The report includes a photograph of a pectoral sandpiper and gives its scientific name, Calidris melanotos.
formal.zh: 报告附有一张斑胸滨鹬的照片，并列出其学名 Calidris melanotos。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fir-ritratt? Samwel: Pispisella Amerikana. Bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ pectoral sandpiper. Elena: Se nikteb iż-żewġ ismijiet fin-noti tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Elena: What is this bird in the photograph called? Samwel: Pispisella Amerikana. In English it is called a pectoral sandpiper. Elena: I'll write both names in my notes.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：照片里的这只鸟叫什么？萨姆韦尔：马耳他语叫 pispisella Amerikana，英语叫 pectoral sandpiper。埃莱娜：我要把这两个名字都记在笔记里。

messages.speaker: Elena (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 照片里的这只鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is this bird in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Samwel (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Pispisella Amerikana. Bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ pectoral sandpiper.
messages.mt_standard: Pispisella Amerikana. Bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ pectoral sandpiper.
messages.zh: 马耳他语叫 pispisella Amerikana，英语叫 pectoral sandpiper。
messages.en: Pispisella Amerikana. In English it is called a pectoral sandpiper.

messages.speaker: Elena (观鸟初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nikteb iż-żewġ ismijiet fin-noti tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Se nikteb iż-żewġ ismijiet fin-noti tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我要把这两个名字都记在笔记里。
messages.en: I'll write both names in my notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张鸟名卡，把 pispisella Amerikana、斑胸滨鹬和 Calidris melanotos 并排写，作为同一鸟种的三个标签记忆。

gloss_zh: 色情的；涉及色情内容的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing explicit sexual material intended to cause sexual arousal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含有以激起性兴奋为目的的露骨性内容的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih materjal sesswali espliċitu maħsub biex iqanqal eċċitament sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 色情的；含有以激起性兴奋为目的的露骨性内容的。

formal.mt: Ir-regoli tal-pjattaforma jipprojbixxu t-tixrid ta' materjal pornografiku.
formal.en: The platform's rules prohibit the distribution of pornographic material.
formal.zh: 该平台的规则禁止传播色情材料。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex imblukkajt dik il-paġna? Mark: Għax fiha kontenut pornografiku. Anna: Tajjeb, se nagħlaqha wkoll.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did you block that page? Mark: Because it contains pornographic content. Anna: Okay, I'll close it too.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么屏蔽了那个网页？马克：因为里面有色情内容。安娜：好，我也把它关掉。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么屏蔽了那个网页？
messages.en: Why did you block that page?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为里面有色情内容。
messages.en: Because it contains pornographic content.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我也把它关掉。
messages.en: Okay, I'll close it too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pornografiku 与英语 pornographic 对照，再用 kontenut pornografiku 这个搭配记住它是修饰内容的形容词。

gloss_zh: 潜力；潜能；发展的可能性

teaching_sense.en_definition: An ability or possibility that can develop and lead to future achievement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尚未完全发挥、但可以通过发展而带来成果的能力或可能性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħila jew possibbiltà li tista' tiżviluppa u twassal għal riżultati fil-futur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 潜力；潜能；尚待实现或发展的可能性。

formal.mt: Dan il-proġett għandu potenzjal kbir, iżda jeħtieġ aktar riċerka u ppjanar.
formal.en: This project has great potential, but it requires more research and planning.
formal.zh: 这个项目具有很大潜力，但还需要更多研究和规划。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li nista' nitgħallem indoqq il-pjanu? Lara: Iva, għandek potenzjal. Kompli pprattika kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think I can learn to play the piano? Lara: Yes, you have potential. Keep practising every day.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得我能学会弹钢琴吗？拉拉：能，你有潜力。继续每天练习吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li nista' nitgħallem indoqq il-pjanu?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li nista' nitgħallem indoqq il-pjanu?
messages.zh: 你觉得我能学会弹钢琴吗？
messages.en: Do you think I can learn to play the piano?

messages.speaker: Lara (钢琴老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandek potenzjal. Kompli pprattika kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandek potenzjal. Kompli pprattika kuljum.
messages.zh: 能，你有潜力。继续每天练习吧。
messages.en: Yes, you have potential. Keep practising every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成一颗尚未发芽的种子：现在还没成果，未来却有发展的潜力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To add punctuation marks to a sentence or text to make its structure and meaning clear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给句子或文章加上标点符号，使结构和意思更加清楚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżżid sinjali tal-punteġġjatura ma' sentenza jew test biex l-istruttura u t-tifsira jkunu ċari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给句子或篇章加标点；用标点符号划分和组织文字。

formal.mt: Ppunteġġja t-test b'attenzjoni sabiex il-qarrej jifhem fejn tintemm kull sentenza.
formal.en: Punctuate the text carefully so that the reader understands where each sentence ends.
formal.zh: 请仔细给文章加上标点，让读者明白每个句子在哪里结束。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Lestejt nikteb il-paragrafu. Pawlu: Tajjeb, issa ppunteġġja t-test u aqrah b'leħen għoli.
colloquial.en: Nina: I've finished writing the paragraph. Pawlu: Good, now punctuate the text and read it aloud.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我写完这段话了。保罗：好，现在给文字加上标点，再大声读一遍。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 我写完这段话了。
messages.en: I've finished writing the paragraph.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, issa ppunteġġja t-test u aqrah b'leħen għoli.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, issa ppunteġġja t-test u aqrah b'leħen għoli.
messages.zh: 好，现在给文字加上标点，再大声读一遍。
messages.en: Good, now punctuate the text and read it aloud.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给一串连续文字安装逗号和句号，让读者知道在哪里停顿，就能记住“加标点”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something considered more important than other things, or the importance that makes it deserve attention first.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 应当比其他事情更先得到处理的事项，或使某事应被先行考虑的重要地位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġa li titqies aktar importanti minn oħrajn, jew l-importanza li tagħmel ħaġa jistħoqqilha attenzjoni qabel oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 优先事项；优先权；应当先行考虑或处理的地位。

formal.mt: Is-sigurtà tal-istudenti għandha tkun prijorità ewlenija fl-ippjanar ta' kull attività skolastika.
formal.en: Student safety should be a main priority when planning any school activity.
formal.zh: 在规划任何学校活动时，学生安全都应当是首要考虑的事项。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Immorru nixtru l-ewwel? Sara: L-ewwel irrid niġbor lil binti mill-iskola; dik hi l-prijorità tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Shall we go shopping first? Sara: First I need to pick up my daughter from school; that's my priority.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们先去购物吗？萨拉：我得先去学校接女儿，那是我要优先做的事。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们先去购物吗？
messages.en: Shall we go shopping first?

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel irrid niġbor lil binti mill-iskola; dik hi l-prijorità tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel irrid niġbor lil binti mill-iskola; dik hi l-prijorità tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我得先去学校接女儿，那是我要优先做的事。
messages.en: First I need to pick up my daughter from school; that's my priority.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把待办清单最上面的一项画上星号：这件事要先做，它就是优先事项。

gloss_zh: 生产；制作；制成品；戏剧制作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making goods or creating a work, or the product or staged work that results.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制造物品或创作作品的过程，也可指由此产生的制成品、作品或舞台演出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' kif isiru oġġetti jew jinħoloq xogħol, jew il-prodott jew ix-xogħol teatrali li jirriżulta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生产或制作的行为与过程。
生产或制作出来的东西；制成品；作品。
戏剧制作；经过排练、舞台设计等制作过程呈现的戏剧演出。
生产；制作；依语境也可指产出或制作成果。

collocations.zh: 戏剧制作；一台戏剧演出

formal.mt: Il-fabbrika żiedet il-produzzjoni tal-għamara biex tlaħħaq mad-domanda.
formal.en: The factory increased furniture production to meet demand.
formal.zh: 这家工厂增加了家具生产，以满足需求。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kienet il-produzzjoni teatrali tal-bieraħ? David: Kienet sabiħa ħafna; l-atturi u x-xenarju kienu mill-aqwa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was yesterday's theatrical production like? David: It was lovely; the actors and the scenery were excellent.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：昨天那台戏剧演出怎么样？戴维：非常精彩，演员和舞台布景都很出色。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天那台戏剧演出怎么样？
messages.en: What was yesterday's theatrical production like?

messages.speaker: David (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet sabiħa ħafna; l-atturi u x-xenarju kienu mill-aqwa.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet sabiħa ħafna; l-atturi u x-xenarju kienu mill-aqwa.
messages.zh: 非常精彩，演员和舞台布景都很出色。
messages.en: It was lovely; the actors and the scenery were excellent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“做出来”串联词义：工厂做出产品，剧团做出演出；制作过程和制作成果都能联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An academic with the title of professor who teaches or conducts research at a university.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有教授头衔、在大学从事教学或研究工作的学者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Akkademiku bit-titlu ta' professur li jgħallem jew jagħmel riċerka f'università.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教授；具有相应学术头衔的大学教师或研究学者。

formal.mt: Il-professur tal-lingwistika ppreżenta r-riżultati tar-riċerka waqt konferenza internazzjonali.
formal.en: The professor of linguistics presented the research results at an international conference.
formal.zh: 这位语言学教授在一次国际会议上介绍了研究成果。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Professur, tista' tispjegali dan l-eżempju? Il-Professur Borg: Żgur, ejja nħarsu lejh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Anna: Professor, could you explain this example to me? Professor Borg: Certainly, let's look at it together.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：教授，您能给我解释一下这个例子吗？博格教授：当然，我们一起看看。

messages.speaker: Anna (大学生)
messages.zh: 教授，您能给我解释一下这个例子吗？
messages.en: Professor, could you explain this example to me?

messages.speaker: Borg (教授)
messages.zh: 当然，我们一起看看。
messages.en: Certainly, let's look at it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 professur 和英语 professor 并排记忆，再联想大学里讲课、指导研究的教授。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To kick with the legs, or to react with excitement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用腿踢蹬，也可指因兴奋而作出明显反应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti daqqa b'siequ jew jirreaġixxi b'eċċitament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 踢；用脚或腿踢蹬。
兴奋地作出反应；因激动而明显地动起来。

formal.mt: Iż-żiemel qamas meta sema' ħoss qawwi, u l-ħaddiem resaq lura.
formal.en: The horse kicked when it heard a loud noise, and the worker stepped back.
formal.zh: 马听到一声巨响后踢蹬起来，工作人员向后退了一步。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif irreaġixxa Ben meta għedtlu li sejrin il-baħar? Sara: Qamas bil-ferħ u mar jiġri jġib ix-xugaman.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Ben react when you told him we were going to the beach? Sara: He reacted with excitement and ran to get his towel.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你告诉本我们要去海边时，他有什么反应？萨拉：他高兴得激动起来，跑去拿毛巾了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irreaġixxa Ben meta għedtlu li sejrin il-baħar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irreaġixxa Ben meta għedtlu li sejrin il-baħar?
messages.zh: 你告诉本我们要去海边时，他有什么反应？
messages.en: How did Ben react when you told him we were going to the beach?

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Qamas bil-ferħ u mar jiġri jġib ix-xugaman.
messages.mt_standard: Qamas bil-ferħ u mar jiġri jġib ix-xugaman.
messages.zh: 他高兴得激动起来，跑去拿毛巾了。
messages.en: He reacted with excitement and ran to get his towel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个动作画面记忆：马用腿踢蹬，孩子听到好消息兴奋起来；再按语境区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow older or become old, or to become outdated and no longer suited to current needs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随着时间推移而变老、变旧，或变得过时而不再适合当前需要。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar anzjan jew qadim maż-żmien, jew ma jibqax adattat għall-ħtiġijiet tal-lum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐变老；随着时间推移而老化。
变老；变旧；进入年老或陈旧的状态。
变得过时；因不再符合当前用途或需要而落伍。

collocations.en: the computer became old or outdated

formal.mt: Il-metodu li kien jintuża qdiem u ma għadux jissodisfa l-ħtiġijiet tal-istituzzjoni.
formal.en: The method previously in use became obsolete and no longer meets the institution's needs.
formal.zh: 此前使用的方法已经过时，无法再满足该机构的需要。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex trid kompjuter ġdid? Nina: Dan qdiem u ma jistax iħaddem il-programmi li għandi bżonn.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why do you want a new computer? Nina: This one has become outdated and cannot run the programs I need.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么想要一台新电脑？妮娜：这台已经过时了，运行不了我需要的程序。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么想要一台新电脑？
messages.en: Why do you want a new computer?

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan qdiem u ma jistax iħaddem il-programmi li għandi bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Dan qdiem u ma jistax iħaddem il-programmi li għandi bżonn.
messages.zh: 这台已经过时了，运行不了我需要的程序。
messages.en: This one has become outdated and cannot run the programs I need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一台电脑沿着时间轴慢慢变旧，最后跟不上新需求；把“变老”和“过时”连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cook food in hot oil or fat; in another sense, to deceive or swindle someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把食物放在热油或油脂中煎炸；另一个义项是欺骗某人或骗取其财物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isajjar l-ikel fiż-żejt jew fix-xaħam jaħraq; f'tifsira oħra, iqarraq b'xi ħadd jew jieħu flusu bil-qerq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用热油或油脂煎、炸食物。
诈骗；以欺骗手段骗取他人的钱财。
欺骗；以不诚实的手段使他人受损或使自己获利。

formal.mt: Il-kok qela l-ħut fiż-żejt jaħraq u servieh ma' insalata friska.
formal.en: The cook fried the fish in hot oil and served it with a fresh salad.
formal.zh: 厨师把鱼放入热油中煎炸，然后配上新鲜沙拉端上桌。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min qela l-patata? Pawlu: Jien. Trid ftit melħ fuqha?
colloquial.en: Anna: Who fried the potatoes? Pawlu: I did. Would you like a little salt on them?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁炸的土豆？保罗：我炸的。你想在上面撒点盐吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.zh: 谁炸的土豆？
messages.en: Who fried the potatoes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 我炸的。你想在上面撒点盐吗？
messages.en: I did. Would you like a little salt on them?

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用热油锅里的鱼记住“煎炸”，再给“骗钱、欺骗”另画一张词义卡，依上下文分别辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feed a baby or young animal with milk from the breast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用乳汁喂养婴儿或幼小动物，通常指直接哺乳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titma' tarbija jew ferħ ta' annimal bil-ħalib mis-sider.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哺乳；用乳汁喂养婴儿或幼小动物。

formal.mt: Il-kamra privata tipprovdi post kwiet fejn omm tista' tredda' lit-tarbija tagħha.
formal.en: The private room provides a quiet place where a mother can breastfeed her baby.
formal.zh: 这间独立房间为母亲提供一个可以给婴儿哺乳的安静场所。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn nista' noqgħod biex tredda' lit-tarbija? Anna: Ejja, tista' toqgħod hawn ħdejja.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where can I sit so that you can breastfeed the baby? Anna: Come, you can sit here beside me.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我可以坐在哪里，方便你给宝宝喂奶？Anna：来，你可以坐在我旁边。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' noqgħod biex tredda' lit-tarbija?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' noqgħod biex tredda' lit-tarbija?
messages.zh: 我可以坐在哪里，方便你给宝宝喂奶？
messages.en: Where can I sit so that you can breastfeed the baby?

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 来，你可以坐在我旁边。
messages.en: Come, you can sit here beside me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“母亲抱着宝宝喂奶”的画面中记忆；搭配 lit-tarbija，整组联想为“给宝宝哺乳”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The reproductive female bee that lays eggs in a honeybee colony.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蜂群中负责产卵的雌蜂，称为蜂王。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-naħla femminili li tbid il-bajd f'kolonja tan-naħal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜂王；蜂群中负责产卵的雌蜂。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni tad-doqqajs, min irabbi n-naħal fittex ir-reġina tan-naħal biex jiċċekkja li kienet preżenti.
formal.en: During the hive inspection, the beekeeper looked for the queen bee to check that she was present.
formal.zh: 检查蜂箱时，养蜂人寻找蜂王，以确认她仍在蜂群中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema waħda hi r-reġina tan-naħal? Pawlu: Ara dik fin-nofs, ħdejn in-naħal l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which one is the queen bee? Pawlu: Look at that one in the middle, beside the other bees.
colloquial.zh: Lara：哪一只是蜂王？Pawlu：看中间那只，就在其他蜜蜂旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 哪一只是蜂王？
messages.en: Which one is the queen bee?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (养蜂人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dik fin-nofs, ħdejn in-naħal l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Ara dik fin-nofs, ħdejn in-naħal l-oħra.
messages.zh: 看中间那只，就在其他蜜蜂旁边。
messages.en: Look at that one in the middle, beside the other bees.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按词组画面记忆：reġina 是“女王”，tan-naħal 表示“蜜蜂的”；想象蜂群中的女王，就能记住“蜂王”。

gloss_zh: 踩；践踏；压迫；侮辱或虐待

teaching_sense.en_definition: To step on or trample something; figuratively, to oppress or treat someone without respect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用脚踩在某物上或将其踩踏；也可比喻压迫他人，或以不尊重、伤害性的方式对待他人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed siequ fuq xi ħaġa jew jgħaffiġha b'saqajh; b'mod figurattiv, jaħqar lil xi ħadd jew jittrattah bla rispett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 踩在……上；用脚踏上某物。
压迫；以权力或强势地位欺压他人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to tread on, to trample down
sense_translations.zh_definition: 踩踏；践踏；把某物踩倒或踩坏。

sense_translations.en_definition: to treat without respect, to disrespect, to abuse, to mistreat, to ill-treat
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不尊重地对待；侮辱、欺凌或虐待。

collocations.en: he trampled on the workers' rights

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif min iħaddem rifes id-drittijiet tal-ħaddiema billi ċaħħadhom mill-mistrieħ meħtieġ.
formal.en: The report describes how the employer trampled on the workers' rights by denying them the necessary rest.
formal.zh: 报告说明了雇主如何通过剥夺必要的休息时间，践踏工人的权利。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi ħadd rifes fuq sieqi fuq il-karozza tal-linja. Mark: Uġgħatek ħafna? Nina: Ftit biss, issa għaddieli.
colloquial.en: Nina: Someone stepped on my foot on the bus. Mark: Did it hurt much? Nina: Only a little; it has stopped hurting now.
colloquial.zh: Nina：有人在公交车上踩了我的脚。Mark：很疼吗？Nina：只有一点，现在已经不疼了。

messages.speaker: Nina (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd rifes fuq sieqi fuq il-karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd rifes fuq sieqi fuq il-karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 有人在公交车上踩了我的脚。
messages.en: Someone stepped on my foot on the bus.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 很疼吗？
messages.en: Did it hurt much?

messages.speaker: Nina (乘客)
messages.zh: 只有一点，现在已经不疼了。
messages.en: Only a little; it has stopped hurting now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记脚踩地面的具体画面，再联想到中文“践踏权利”；用“踩脚—践踏—欺压”的意义链连接各个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small marine animal with a rounded body covered in spines.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种身体大致呈球形、表面长有棘刺的海洋动物，即海胆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal tal-baħar b'ġisem tond miksi bix-xewk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海胆；身体表面覆盖棘刺的海洋动物。

collocations.en: a sea urchin on the seabed

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, l-istudenti raw rizza bejn il-blat u nnutaw ix-xewk li jgħatti ġisimha.
formal.en: During the observation, the students saw a sea urchin among the rocks and noted the spines covering its body.
formal.zh: 观察时，学生们在岩石之间看到了一只海胆，并留意到覆盖它身体的棘刺。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Oqgħod attent, hemm rizza ħdejn sieqek! Toni: Rajtha; se ngħaddi minn hawn biex ma nmisshiex.
colloquial.en: Sara: Be careful, there is a sea urchin beside your foot! Toni: I saw it; I will go this way so I do not touch it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：小心，你脚旁边有只海胆！Toni：我看见了，我从这边走，免得碰到它。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Oqgħod attent, hemm rizza ħdejn sieqek!
messages.mt_standard: Oqgħod attent, hemm rizza ħdejn sieqek!
messages.zh: 小心，你脚旁边有只海胆！
messages.en: Be careful, there is a sea urchin beside your foot!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha; se ngħaddi minn hawn biex ma nmisshiex.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha; se ngħaddi minn hawn biex ma nmisshiex.
messages.zh: 我看见了，我从这边走，免得碰到它。
messages.en: I saw it; I will go this way so I do not touch it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rizza 写在一幅“海底带刺小圆球”的图旁边；看到圆球和棘刺，就回想海胆这个具体形象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The powdery material left after something has burned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体燃烧后留下的粉末状残余物，即灰或灰烬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-trab li jibqa' wara li tinħaraq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灰；灰烬；物体燃烧后留下的粉末状残余物。

formal.mt: Wara li n-nar intefa u l-fuklar kesaħ, il-ħaddiem ġabar ir-rmied f'kontenitur tal-metall.
formal.en: After the fire had gone out and the fireplace had cooled, the worker collected the ashes in a metal container.
formal.zh: 火熄灭、壁炉冷却后，工作人员把灰烬收集到一个金属容器里。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għad hemm ħafna rmied fil-fuklar? Ġorġ: Iva, imma issa kesaħ; se niġbru.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is there still a lot of ash in the fireplace? Ġorġ: Yes, but it has cooled now; I will collect it.
colloquial.zh: Marija：壁炉里还有很多灰吗？Ġorġ：有，不过现在已经凉了，我来把它收起来。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 壁炉里还有很多灰吗？
messages.en: Is there still a lot of ash in the fireplace?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma issa kesaħ; se niġbru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma issa kesaħ; se niġbru.
messages.zh: 有，不过现在已经凉了，我来把它收起来。
messages.en: Yes, but it has cooled now; I will collect it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“木头燃烧后剩下一层灰粉”的过程记 rmied；重点抓住燃烧后的残余物，联想中文“灰烬”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A length of material wound into a cylinder, or a cylindrical tool that rolls over a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 纸张、布料等卷成的圆筒状物；也指能在表面滚动的筒状工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal bħal karta jew drapp imkebbeb f'forma ta' ċilindru, jew għodda ċilindrika li ddur fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.en_definition: a roll of sth. (e.g. fabric or paper)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一卷某种材料，例如一卷布或一卷纸。
滚筒；滚轮；在表面滚动使用的筒状工具或部件。
卷状物；滚筒或滚轮，具体含义由语境决定。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża romblu għaż-żebgħa biex jgħatti l-ħajt b'saff uniformi.
formal.en: The worker used a paint roller to cover the wall with an even coat.
formal.zh: 工人用油漆滚筒在墙面上均匀地涂了一层漆。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek romblu tal-karti kbir għall-poster? Rita: Iva, qiegħed taħt il-mejda; aqta' kemm għandek bżonn.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a large roll of paper for the poster? Rita: Yes, it is under the table; cut off as much as you need.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你有做海报用的大卷纸吗？Rita：有，在桌子下面；需要多少就剪多少。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 你有做海报用的大卷纸吗？
messages.en: Do you have a large roll of paper for the poster?

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed taħt il-mejda; aqta' kemm għandek bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed taħt il-mejda; aqta' kemm għandek bżonn.
messages.zh: 有，在桌子下面；需要多少就剪多少。
messages.en: Yes, it is under the table; cut off as much as you need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“一卷纸”和“刷墙滚筒”并排画出来：两者都有圆筒外形。借共同形状记住 romblu 的两个常用义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To prepare food for eating by heating it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过加热把食材做成可以食用的饭菜，即烹饪或做饭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħejji l-ikel biex jittiekel billi juża s-sħana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烹饪；做饭；用加热等方式把食物做熟。
厨师；负责烹调食物的人。
使成熟；使果实等达到成熟状态。

formal.mt: Il-kok sajjar il-ħaxix fuq nar baxx u żied ftit ilma biex ma jeħilx mal-qiegħ tal-borma.
formal.en: The chef cooked the vegetables over low heat and added a little water to stop them sticking to the bottom of the pot.
formal.zh: 厨师用小火烹调蔬菜，并加入少量水，防止蔬菜粘在锅底。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'se ssajjar illum? Pawlu: Se nsajjar l-għaġin biz-zalza tat-tadam. Lara: Tajjeb, jien inħejji l-mejda.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you going to cook today? Pawlu: I am going to cook pasta with tomato sauce. Lara: Great, I will set the table.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你今天打算做什么？Pawlu：我打算做番茄酱意面。Lara：好，我来摆餐桌。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你今天打算做什么？
messages.en: What are you going to cook today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 我打算做番茄酱意面。
messages.en: I am going to cook pasta with tomato sauce.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我来摆餐桌。
messages.en: Great, I will set the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文“熟”作课堂联想：饭菜做熟对应烹饪，果实变熟对应成熟；另把名词义“厨师”单独标为做饭的人。

gloss_zh: 美化；装饰；赞颂；持续到天亮

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone or something more beautiful, especially by decorating or improving its appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过装饰或改善外观，使人或事物变得更美，即美化、装点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa aktar sabiħa, speċjalment billi jżejjen jew itejjeb id-dehra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 持续进行直到天亮；一直做某事做到黎明。
美化；使人或事物变得更美。
装饰；装点；用饰物等增添美感。
修饰；润饰；添加细节以使其更美。
赞美；赞颂；颂扬某人或某事。
美化、修饰或装点，使外观更优美。
赞美、颂扬上帝；将荣耀归于上帝。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill sebbaħ il-pjazza billi ħawwel siġar ġodda u poġġa qsari bil-fjuri madwar il-bankijiet.
formal.en: The council beautified the square by planting new trees and placing flowerpots around the benches.
formal.zh: 地方议会种植了新树，并在长椅周围摆放花盆，美化了广场。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min sebbaħ il-bitħa b'dawn il-fjuri? Toni: Jien u ħija; ħawwilniehom ilbieraħ. Anna: Kemm ġiet sabiħa!
colloquial.en: Anna: Who beautified the courtyard with these flowers? Toni: My brother and I did; we planted them yesterday. Anna: It looks so lovely!
colloquial.zh: Anna：是谁用这些花把院子装点得这么漂亮？Toni：我和我哥哥，我们昨天种的。Anna：真漂亮！

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 是谁用这些花把院子装点得这么漂亮？
messages.en: Who beautified the courtyard with these flowers?

messages.speaker: Toni (住户)
messages.zh: 我和我哥哥，我们昨天种的。
messages.en: My brother and I did; we planted them yesterday.

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 真漂亮！
messages.en: It looks so lovely!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张记忆卡区分义项：鲜花装点庭院表示“美化”，开口颂赞表示“赞美”，忙到晨光出现表示“持续到天亮”；这是课堂联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In an ordered sequence, with one step or event following another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照一定次序，一个步骤或事件接着另一个地进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'ordni, b'pass jew ġrajja wara oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依次地；按先后顺序地。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta l-avvenimenti sekwenzjalment, mill-ewwel laqgħa sad-deċiżjoni finali.
formal.en: The report presents the events sequentially, from the first meeting to the final decision.
formal.zh: 报告按先后顺序呈现各项事件，从第一次会议一直写到最终决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nagħmel dawn il-passi kollha f'daqqa? Toni: Le, agħmilhom sekwenzjalment, wieħed wara l-ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do I do all these steps at once? Toni: No, do them sequentially, one after another.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些步骤我要同时做吗？托尼：不用，按顺序做，一个接着一个。

messages.speaker: Maja (学员)
messages.zh: 这些步骤我要同时做吗？
messages.en: Do I do all these steps at once?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, agħmilhom sekwenzjalment, wieħed wara l-ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Le, agħmilhom sekwenzjalment, wieħed wara l-ieħor.
messages.zh: 不用，按顺序做，一个接着一个。
messages.en: No, do them sequentially, one after another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象编号步骤一、二、三依次亮起，把这个词和“一个接着一个”的画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 感官享受；感官魅力；性感

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of expressing or evoking pleasure through the senses, sometimes with sexual attraction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过感官表达或唤起愉悦的特质，有时也包含性感或性吸引力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità li tesprimi jew tqanqal pjaċir permezz tas-sensi, xi drabi b'attrazzjoni sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感官享受或感官魅力；也可指性感、情欲的表达。

formal.mt: Il-kritika tiddeskrivi s-senswalità taż-żfin permezz tal-movimenti rotob u r-ritmu bil-mod.
formal.en: The review describes the sensuality of the dance through its soft movements and slow rhythm.
formal.zh: 这篇评论通过柔和的动作与缓慢的节奏来描述舞蹈的感官魅力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għoġbok l-aktar f'dak iż-żfin? Nina: Is-senswalità tiegħu; il-movimenti kienu rotob ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did you like most about that dance? Nina: Its sensuality; the movements were very soft.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那段舞蹈最吸引你的是什么？妮娜：它的感官魅力，动作特别柔和。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那段舞蹈最吸引你的是什么？
messages.en: What did you like most about that dance?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-senswalità tiegħu; il-movimenti kienu rotob ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Is-senswalità tiegħu; il-movimenti kienu rotob ħafna.
messages.zh: 它的感官魅力，动作特别柔和。
messages.en: Its sensuality; the movements were very soft.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用柔和舞步、悦耳音乐和舒服触感组成记忆画面，抓住“感官愉悦与魅力”的共同核心。

gloss_zh: 一次驾车；一段开车行程

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instance or period of driving a vehicle, often as a journey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次驾驶车辆的活动，或一段驾车行程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Darba jew perjodu ta' ħin li fih wieħed isuq vettura, spiss biex jagħmel vjaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次驾车；一段驾车行程。

formal.mt: Wara sewqa twila, is-sewwieq waqaf f'post sigur biex jistrieħ.
formal.en: After a long drive, the driver stopped in a safe place to rest.
formal.zh: 经过一段长途驾车后，司机在安全的地方停车休息。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-bajja 'l bogħod minn hawn? Sara: Le, sewqa qasira biss, madwar għaxar minuti.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the beach far from here? Sara: No, just a short drive, about ten minutes.
colloquial.zh: 马克：海滩离这里远吗？萨拉：不远，开车一小段就到，大约十分钟。

messages.speaker: Mark (游客)
messages.zh: 海滩离这里远吗？
messages.en: Is the beach far from here?

messages.speaker: Sara (当地朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, sewqa qasira biss, madwar għaxar minuti.
messages.mt_standard: Le, sewqa qasira biss, madwar għaxar minuti.
messages.zh: 不远，开车一小段就到，大约十分钟。
messages.en: No, just a short drive, about ten minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从上车、握方向盘到停车的一整段经历，用“一次驾车行程”记住 sewqa。

gloss_zh: 干量单位；相应量器；土地面积单位

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unit for measuring dry goods, a vessel holding that amount, or a unit of land area, with different values for volume and area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种计量干货的容量单位，也指相应容量的量器；另可用作土地面积单位，容量义与面积义采用不同的换算值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżura għall-prodotti niexfa, reċipjent li jesa' dak l-ammont, jew miżura tal-art, b'valuri differenti għall-volum u għall-erja.

sense_translations.en_definition: a unit of dry volume, equivalent to 6 kejla, that is officially 111 imperial cubic inches (1.818 L).
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种干量容量单位，相当于 6 kejla，法定值为 111 英制立方英寸（1.818 升）。

sense_translations.en_definition: a vessel of such measure, a bushel
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有上述容量的量器；用于量取干货的斗状容器。

sense_translations.en_definition: a unit of surface area, equivalent to 10 kejla, that is officially 224.1 imperial square yards (187.4 m2).
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种面积单位，相当于 10 kejla，法定值为 224.1 英制平方码（187.4 平方米）。

collocations.en: a field measuring one siegħ in area
collocations.zh: 面积为一 siegħ 的田地

formal.mt: Fit-test, siegħ jintuża bħala miżura tal-qamħ; f'deskrizzjoni ta' għalqa, l-istess kelma tista' tindika erja.
formal.en: In the text, siegħ is used as a measure of wheat; in a description of a field, the same word can indicate an area.
formal.zh: 文中的 siegħ 用作小麦的容量单位；在描述田地时，同一个词可以表示面积。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn miktub 'siegħ qamħ'. Xi jfisser siegħ? Pawlu: Hawn ifisser miżura tal-volum. Jista' jfisser ukoll ir-reċipjent, jew miżura tal-art f'kuntest ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: It says 'a siegħ of wheat' here. What does siegħ mean? Pawlu: Here it means a measure of volume. It can also mean the vessel, or a measure of land in another context.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里写着“一 siegħ 小麦”。siegħ 是什么意思？保罗：这里是容量单位。它也可以指量器，在别的语境里还可以是土地面积单位。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub 'siegħ qamħ'. Xi jfisser siegħ?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub 'siegħ qamħ'. Xi jfisser siegħ?
messages.zh: 这里写着“一 siegħ 小麦”。siegħ 是什么意思？
messages.en: It says 'a siegħ of wheat' here. What does siegħ mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser miżura tal-volum. Jista' jfisser ukoll ir-reċipjent, jew miżura tal-art f'kuntest ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser miżura tal-volum. Jista' jfisser ukoll ir-reċipjent, jew miżura tal-art f'kuntest ieħor.
messages.zh: 这里是容量单位。它也可以指量器，在别的语境里还可以是土地面积单位。
messages.en: Here it means a measure of volume. It can also mean the vessel, or a measure of land in another context.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画三格记忆卡：一份干粮、一个量器、一块田地；看到 siegħ 先看语境，再区分容量与面积。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The combination of separate ideas or elements into a coherent whole, or the result of that combination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把不同的观点或要素结合成连贯整体的过程，也指由此形成的综合成果或概述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li jgħaqqad ideat jew elementi differenti f'ħaġa waħda koerenti, jew ir-riżultat ta' dan il-proċess.

sense_translations.en_definition: If I knew I would not need a dictionary
sense_translations.zh_definition: 如果我知道，就不需要词典了。
综合；整合；把各部分结合成整体的过程或成果。

collocations.en: produce a synthesis of the results

formal.mt: Il-konklużjoni tipprovdi sintesi tar-riżultati u turi kif dawn huma marbuta ma' xulxin.
formal.en: The conclusion provides a synthesis of the results and shows how they are related to one another.
formal.zh: 结论综合整理了各项结果，并说明它们之间的联系。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandi ħafna noti. Kif nagħlaq il-preżentazzjoni? Ben: Agħmel sintesi tal-ideat ewlenin u uri kif jingħaqdu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Anna: I have lots of notes. How should I finish the presentation? Ben: Make a synthesis of the main ideas and show how they fit together.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我记了好多笔记，展示最后该怎么收尾？本：综合一下主要观点，说明它们怎样联系起来。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ħafna noti. Kif nagħlaq il-preżentazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ħafna noti. Kif nagħlaq il-preżentazzjoni?
messages.zh: 我记了好多笔记，展示最后该怎么收尾？
messages.en: I have lots of notes. How should I finish the presentation?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħmel sintesi tal-ideat ewlenin u uri kif jingħaqdu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Agħmel sintesi tal-ideat ewlenin u uri kif jingħaqdu flimkien.
messages.zh: 综合一下主要观点，说明它们怎样联系起来。
messages.en: Make a synthesis of the main ideas and show how they fit together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把散落的观点卡片拼成一张完整概念图，用“整合成整体”的动作记住 sintesi。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A set of connected parts, rules, or procedures that work together for a purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由相互联系的部分、规则或程序组成，并共同发挥某种作用的整体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sett ta' partijiet, regoli jew proċeduri marbuta ma' xulxin li jaħdmu flimkien għal għan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 系统；体系；由相互联系的部分或规则构成的整体。

formal.mt: L-iskola introduċiet sistema ġdida biex tirreġistra l-attendenza tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The school introduced a new system to record student attendance.
formal.zh: 学校引入了一套新系统，用于记录学生出勤情况。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif nibbukkja appuntament? Rita: Uża s-sistema l-ġdida fuq is-sit; tagħżel il-ġurnata u l-ħin.
colloquial.en: Mark: How do I book an appointment? Rita: Use the new system on the website; you choose the day and time.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我怎么预约？丽塔：用网站上的新系统，选好日期和时间就行。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 我怎么预约？
messages.en: How do I book an appointment?

messages.speaker: Rita (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża s-sistema l-ġdida fuq is-sit; tagħżel il-ġurnata u l-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Uża s-sistema l-ġdida fuq is-sit; tagħżel il-ġurnata u l-ħin.
messages.zh: 用网站上的新系统，选好日期和时间就行。
messages.en: Use the new system on the website; you choose the day and time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sistema 想成几个互相咬合的齿轮：每个部分相互配合，组成一个能运作的系统。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 96, one more than ninety-five and one less than ninety-seven.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字九十六，即比九十五多一、比九十七少一的数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 96, wieħed aktar minn ħamsa u disgħin u wieħed inqas minn sebgħa u disgħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 九十六；96。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport finali fih sitta u disgħin paġna, inklużi t-tabelli u l-appendiċi.
formal.en: The final report contains ninety-six pages, including the tables and appendices.
formal.zh: 最终报告共九十六页，包括表格和附录。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm għandha żmien in-nanna tiegħek? Lara: Għandha sitta u disgħin sena, u għadha tħobb il-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: How old is your grandmother? Lara: She is ninety-six, and she still loves the garden.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你奶奶多大年纪了？拉拉：她九十六岁了，还是很喜欢花园。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你奶奶多大年纪了？
messages.en: How old is your grandmother?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha sitta u disgħin sena, u għadha tħobb il-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha sitta u disgħin sena, u għadha tħobb il-ġnien.
messages.zh: 她九十六岁了，还是很喜欢花园。
messages.en: She is ninety-six, and she still loves the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按词序记成“六、和、九十”：sitta 是六，u 是和，disgħin 是九十，合起来就是九十六。

gloss_zh: 蝎子；天蝎座（星座或黄道星座）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small arachnid with eight legs, pincers, and a tail ending in a sting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种有八条腿、一对螯，以及末端带毒刺的尾巴的小型蛛形动物，即蝎子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir tal-grupp tal-araknidi, bi tmien saqajn, imqassijiet u denb li jispiċċa f'niggieża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蝎子，一种有螯、尾端带毒刺的蛛形动物。
天蝎座，天文学中的星座名称。
天蝎座，占星术中的黄道星座名称，也称天蝎宫。

formal.mt: Il-gwida tiddeskrivi l-iskorpjun bħala annimal bi tmien saqajn u denb li jispiċċa f'niggieża.
formal.en: The guide describes the scorpion as an animal with eight legs and a tail ending in a sting.
formal.zh: 指南将蝎子描述为一种有八条腿、尾端带毒刺的动物。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dak skorpjun ħdejn il-ġebla? Pawlu: Iva, ara d-denb tiegħu. Ejja nħalluh bi kwietu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is that a scorpion beside the stone? Pawlu: Yes, look at its tail. Let's leave it alone.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：石头旁边那个是蝎子吗？保罗：是，你看它的尾巴。我们别打扰它了。

messages.speaker: Nina (徒步者)
messages.zh: 石头旁边那个是蝎子吗？
messages.en: Is that a scorpion beside the stone?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara d-denb tiegħu. Ejja nħalluh bi kwietu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara d-denb tiegħu. Ejja nħalluh bi kwietu.
messages.zh: 是，你看它的尾巴。我们别打扰它了。
messages.en: Yes, look at its tail. Let's leave it alone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记住翘尾蝎子的形象，再用上下文分三类：地面动物、天空星座、占星符号，分别对应三个词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of regret or sorrow, especially about something one has done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某件事感到遗憾或悲伤，尤指因自己的行为而产生的懊悔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment ta' dispjaċir jew niket, speċjalment għal xi ħaġa li wieħed ikun għamel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遗憾；懊悔
悲伤；悲痛
懊悔；悔悟；悔过

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, id-direttur esprima sogħba għall-iżball u wiegħed li jirranġah.
formal.en: In his letter, the director expressed regret for the mistake and promised to correct it.
formal.zh: 主任在信中对这个错误表达了悔意，并承诺改正。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ċempilt lil Lara? Mark: Ħassejt sogħba għal dak li għedtilha, u ridt nitlobha skuża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you call Lara? Mark: I felt regret about what I said to her, and I wanted to apologize.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么给Lara打电话？Mark：我为自己对她说的话感到懊悔，想向她道歉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么给Lara打电话？
messages.en: Why did you call Lara?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt sogħba għal dak li għedtilha, u ridt nitlobha skuża.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt sogħba għal dak li għedtilha, u ridt nitlobha skuża.
messages.zh: 我为自己对她说的话感到懊悔，想向她道歉。
messages.en: I felt regret about what I said to her, and I wanted to apologize.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sogħba 放进“说错话后低头道歉”的画面：心里既难过又后悔，就能联想到遗憾、悲伤和悔悟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short account that presents the main points of a longer text, discussion, or event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把较长的文章、讨论或事件的主要内容简短概括出来的摘要。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Test qasir li jiġbor il-punti ewlenin ta' test itwal, diskussjoni jew ġrajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摘要；概要；总结
简要的；概括性的

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jibda b'sommarju li jippreżenta l-konklużjonijiet ewlenin tal-istudju.
formal.en: The report begins with a summary presenting the study's main conclusions.
formal.zh: 报告以一段摘要开篇，介绍研究的主要结论。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadek kemm qrajt l-artiklu? Tista' tagħtini sommarju? Pawlu: Iva, ngħidlek il-punti ewlenin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you just read the article? Can you give me a summary? Pawlu: Yes, I'll tell you the main points.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你刚读完那篇文章吗？能给我概括一下吗？Pawlu：可以，我告诉你主要内容。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek kemm qrajt l-artiklu? Tista' tagħtini sommarju?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek kemm qrajt l-artiklu? Tista' tagħtini sommarju?
messages.zh: 你刚读完那篇文章吗？能给我概括一下吗？
messages.en: Have you just read the article? Can you give me a summary?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 可以，我告诉你主要内容。
messages.en: Yes, I'll tell you the main points.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sommarju 想成“长文章缩成几句话”：作名词是摘要，作形容词则表示简要、概括性的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An account that makes something clear by describing its meaning, reasons, or how it works.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过说明含义、原因或运作方式，使某件事变得清楚的解释。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem li jagħmel xi ħaġa ċara billi jfisser it-tifsira tagħha, ir-raġunijiet għaliha jew kif taħdem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解释；说明；阐释

formal.mt: Il-manwal jinkludi spjegazzjoni dettaljata ta' kif jintuża l-apparat.
formal.en: The manual includes a detailed explanation of how to use the device.
formal.zh: 手册详细说明了这台设备的使用方法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma fhimtx dan l-eżerċizzju. Tista' tagħtini spjegazzjoni? Lara: Iva, ejja narawh pass pass.
colloquial.en: Maja: I didn't understand this exercise. Can you give me an explanation? Lara: Yes, let's go through it step by step.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我没弄懂这道练习题。你能给我解释一下吗？Lara：可以，我们一步一步来看。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma fhimtx dan l-eżerċizzju. Tista' tagħtini spjegazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Ma fhimtx dan l-eżerċizzju. Tista' tagħtini spjegazzjoni?
messages.zh: 我没弄懂这道练习题。你能给我解释一下吗？
messages.en: I didn't understand this exercise. Can you give me an explanation?

messages.speaker: Lara (老师)
messages.zh: 可以，我们一步一步来看。
messages.en: Yes, let's go through it step by step.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“听不懂时要一份 spjegazzjoni”：把问号变成明白的答案，就是解释或说明。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The spotted seabass, Dicentrarchus punctatus, a fish also called spnott.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指斑点海鲈，学名 Dicentrarchus punctatus，也称 spnott。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta tal-ispeċi Dicentrarchus punctatus, magħrufa wkoll bħala spnott.

sense_translations.en_definition: synonym of spnott: spotted seabass (Dicentrarchus punctatus)
sense_translations.zh_definition: spnott 的同义名称：斑点海鲈（Dicentrarchus punctatus）

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-ispeċi, l-isem spnott tat-tbajja' jirreferi għal Dicentrarchus punctatus.
formal.en: In the species list, the name spnott tat-tbajja' refers to Dicentrarchus punctatus.
formal.zh: 在物种名录中，spnott tat-tbajja' 这个名称指的是 Dicentrarchus punctatus，即斑点海鲈。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek spnott tat-tbajja' frisk illum? Toni: Iva. Kemm trid? Mark: Wieħed, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have fresh spotted seabass today? Toni: Yes. How many would you like? Mark: One, please.
colloquial.zh: Mark：今天有新鲜的斑点海鲈吗？Toni：有。你要几条？Mark：请给我一条。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天有新鲜的斑点海鲈吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh spotted seabass today?

messages.speaker: Toni (鱼贩)
messages.zh: 有。你要几条？
messages.en: Yes. How many would you like?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我一条。
messages.en: One, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把完整名称 spnott tat-tbajja' 写在“斑点海鲈”的鱼摊标签上，连同学名一起记，避免只记住一个泛泛的鱼名。

gloss_zh: 使系统化；有条理地整理

teaching_sense.en_definition: To organize things or information according to a clear, consistent system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照清晰一致的体系组织事物或信息，使其系统化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jorganizza affarijiet jew informazzjoni skont sistema ċara u konsistenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使系统化；按照一定体系组织整理

collocations.en: organized the records systematically by date
collocations.zh: 按日期有系统地整理记录

formal.mt: Il-koordinatur ssistema d-dokumenti skont is-suġġett u d-data biex ikun aktar faċli li jinstabu.
formal.en: The coordinator organized the documents systematically by subject and date to make them easier to find.
formal.zh: 协调员按主题和日期对文件进行了系统整理，以便查找。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ssistema dawn il-fajls kollha? Mark: Pawlu. Issa huma miġbura skont is-suġġett, u kull wieħed għandu numru.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who organized all these files systematically? Mark: Pawlu did. Now they are grouped by subject, and each one has a number.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁把这些文件都系统整理好了？Mark：Pawlu。现在它们按主题分类，每份还有编号。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 谁把这些文件都系统整理好了？
messages.en: Who organized all these files systematically?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu. Issa huma miġbura skont is-suġġett, u kull wieħed għandu numru.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu. Issa huma miġbura skont is-suġġett, u kull wieħed għandu numru.
messages.zh: Pawlu。现在它们按主题分类，每份还有编号。
messages.en: Pawlu did. Now they are grouped by subject, and each one has a number.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一堆散乱文件按主题分类、编号并建立目录：这整套“整理成体系”的动作帮助你记住 ssistema。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place serving as a station for transport or another service, especially a place where trains stop for passengers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供交通运输或其他服务使用的站点，尤其指列车停靠、供乘客上下车的火车站。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post li jservi ta' waqfa jew ċentru għal trasport jew servizz ieħor, speċjalment fejn jieqfu l-ferroviji għall-passiġġieri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 站；站点；服务站
火车站
站；车站，既可专指火车站，也可泛指其他站点

formal.mt: Il-passiġġieri għandhom jaslu fl-istazzjon tal-ferrovija għoxrin minuta qabel it-tluq.
formal.en: Passengers should arrive at the train station twenty minutes before departure.
formal.zh: 乘客应在发车前二十分钟到达火车站。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn niltaqgħu qabel naqbdu l-ferrovija? Pawlu: Quddiem l-istazzjon, ħdejn id-daħla prinċipali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet before catching the train? Pawlu: In front of the station, near the main entrance.
colloquial.zh: Maja：坐火车前我们在哪里碰面？Pawlu：车站前面，正门附近。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 坐火车前我们在哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet before catching the train?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 车站前面，正门附近。
messages.en: In front of the station, near the main entrance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“站点招牌”记 stazzjon：搭配 tal-ferrovija 想到火车站，搭配 tal-pulizija 想到警署，让后面的词提示站点用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express something clearly in words, especially as a declaration, statement, acknowledgment, or confession.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 明确地用语言表达某事，可指声明、陈述、承认事实或坦白过错。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimi xi ħaġa b'mod ċar bil-kliem, bħala dikjarazzjoni jew ammissjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 声明；宣告
陈述；明确说明
承认某个事实或情况
声明；陈述
坦白；供认；承认过错

collocations.en: acknowledged that he had made a mistake

formal.mt: Fid-dikjarazzjoni tiegħu, ir-rappreżentant stqarr li l-laqgħa kienet se ssir it-Tnejn.
formal.en: In his statement, the representative declared that the meeting would take place on Monday.
formal.zh: 代表在声明中表示，会议将于星期一举行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu qal min kisser it-tazza? Mark: Iva, stqarr li kien hu u talab skuża.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Pawlu say who broke the cup? Mark: Yes, he admitted it was him and apologized.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu说是谁打破杯子了吗？Mark：说了，他坦白是自己打破的，还道了歉。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: Pawlu说是谁打破杯子了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu say who broke the cup?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, stqarr li kien hu u talab skuża.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, stqarr li kien hu u talab skuża.
messages.zh: 说了，他坦白是自己打破的，还道了歉。
messages.en: Yes, he admitted it was him and apologized.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 stqarr 配两幅画面：发言人明确宣布安排，犯错者坦白承认责任。共同点是“把事情明确说出来”，具体译法看语境。

gloss_zh: 主观地；从个人感受出发

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way based on personal feelings, opinions, or experience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以个人感受、意见或经验为依据地；从主观角度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod ibbażat fuq sentimenti, fehmiet jew esperjenzi personali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主观地；从个人感受或看法出发

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti evalwaw suġġettivament il-kumdità tas-siġġijiet skont l-esperjenza personali tagħhom.
formal.en: The participants evaluated the comfort of the chairs subjectively, based on their personal experience.
formal.zh: 参与者根据各自的亲身体验，主观评价了椅子的舒适程度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema pittura tippreferi? Lara: Suġġettivament, nippreferi din għax il-kuluri tagħha jfakkruni fid-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which painting do you prefer? Lara: Subjectively, I prefer this one because its colors remind me of home.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你更喜欢哪幅画？Lara：从个人感受来说，我更喜欢这幅，因为它的颜色让我想起家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你更喜欢哪幅画？
messages.en: Which painting do you prefer?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Suġġettivament, nippreferi din għax il-kuluri tagħha jfakkruni fid-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Suġġettivament, nippreferi din għax il-kuluri tagħha jfakkruni fid-dar.
messages.zh: 从个人感受来说，我更喜欢这幅，因为它的颜色让我想起家。
messages.en: Subjectively, I prefer this one because its colors remind me of home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 suġġettivament 就在句前加一句“按我自己的感受来看”：评价取决于个人体验，这能帮助记住它是表示方式的副词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who delivers or sells milk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人送牛奶或出售牛奶的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li twassal jew tbigħ il-ħalib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 送奶人；卖奶人。

collocations.en: I am waiting for the milkman

formal.mt: Tal-ħalib iwassal il-ħalib lill-familji kull filgħodu.
formal.en: The milkman delivers milk to families every morning.
formal.zh: 送奶人每天早晨给各家送牛奶。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ġie tal-ħalib illum? Pawlu: Iva, ħalla żewġ fliexken ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did the milkman come today? Pawlu: Yes, he left two bottles by the door.
colloquial.zh: Marija：送奶人今天来了吗？Pawlu：来了，他在门边放了两瓶奶。

messages.speaker: Marija (家人)
messages.zh: 送奶人今天来了吗？
messages.en: Did the milkman come today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħalla żewġ fliexken ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħalla żewġ fliexken ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 来了，他在门边放了两瓶奶。
messages.en: Yes, he left two bottles by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和清晨门口的两瓶牛奶联系起来：这里指送奶的人，记忆重点是人物身份。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to beg, especially by leaving them without enough to live on.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人不得不乞讨，尤其指使其陷入无法维持生活的处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jittallab, speċjalment minħabba nuqqas ta' mezzi għall-għajxien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人乞讨；迫使某人靠乞讨维生。
乞丐；靠向别人乞求施舍维生的人。

collocations.en: poverty forced the family to beg
collocations.zh: 贫困迫使这个家庭乞讨

formal.mt: Il-faqar tallab lill-familja, li ma kellhiex mezzi oħra għall-għajxien.
formal.en: Poverty forced the family to beg, as it had no other means of support.
formal.zh: 贫困迫使这个家庭乞讨，因为他们没有其他谋生手段。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawn tallab tfisser persuna? Mark: Iva, imma bħala verb tista' tfisser li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jittallab.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does tallab mean a person here? Mark: Yes, but as a verb it can mean to cause someone to beg.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的 tallab 指一个人吗？Mark：对，不过作动词时，它可以表示使某人乞讨。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 tallab 指一个人吗？
messages.en: Does tallab mean a person here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma bħala verb tista' tfisser li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jittallab.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma bħala verb tista' tfisser li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jittallab.
messages.zh: 对，不过作动词时，它可以表示使某人乞讨。
messages.en: Yes, but as a verb it can mean to cause someone to beg.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画区分词性：人物旁标“乞丐”，贫困推着人去乞讨的画面旁标“使人乞讨”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very young child, especially one who still needs constant care.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 年龄很小、尤其仍需经常照料的孩子，即婴儿或宝宝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tifel jew tifla ta' età żgħira ħafna li jkollhom bżonn ħafna kura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宝宝；婴儿。
婴儿；年龄很小的幼儿。
宝宝；婴儿，指年纪很小、需要照料的孩子。

formal.mt: It-tarbija għandha bżonn irqad biżżejjed u kura regolari.
formal.en: The baby needs enough sleep and regular care.
formal.zh: 婴儿需要充足的睡眠和定时的照料。

colloquial.mt: Anna: It-tarbija għadha rieqda? David: Iva, ejja nitkellmu bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is the baby still asleep? David: Yes, let's speak quietly.
colloquial.zh: Anna：宝宝还在睡吗？David：是啊，我们小声说话吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 宝宝还在睡吗？
messages.en: Is the baby still asleep?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.zh: 是啊，我们小声说话吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's speak quietly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象摇篮里熟睡的宝宝，每次看到 tarbija 就配上轻声说话和照料婴儿的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of threatening someone, or words used to make someone fear harm or trouble.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 威胁或恐吓他人的行为，也指使人害怕受到伤害或遭遇麻烦的话语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li thedded lil xi ħadd, jew kliem li jbeżża' lil persuna b'xi ħsara jew inkwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 威胁；恐吓性的话语或表示。
动词 hedded 的动名词，表示威胁、恐吓这一行为。
进行威胁或恐吓的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tehdid li rċeviet il-ħaddiema waqt ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The report describes the threats the female employee received at work.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这名女员工在工作期间受到的威胁。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-messaġġ fih tehdid? Samwel: Iva, qed jgħid li se jagħmillek il-ħsara.
colloquial.en: Rita: Does this message contain threats? Samwel: Yes, it says he is going to harm you.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这条消息里有威胁的话吗？Samwel：有，它说他要伤害你。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 这条消息里有威胁的话吗？
messages.en: Does this message contain threats?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed jgħid li se jagħmillek il-ħsara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed jgħid li se jagħmillek il-ħsara.
messages.zh: 有，它说他要伤害你。
messages.en: Yes, it says he is going to harm you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tehdid 贴在一条令人害怕的威胁消息旁，记住它既可指威胁的话，也可指恐吓行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To go or move to a higher place; also, to rise in level or amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向更高的地方移动；也可指水平、数值或金额上升。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imur jew jitla' lejn post ogħla; ukoll jiżdied fil-livell jew fl-ammont.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上去；往高处走。
长大；成长。

sense_translations.en_definition: to reach a high amount (e.g. in price)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 达到较高的数额；例如价格涨到较高水平。
到某处去；前往某地。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be drawn in a lottery
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在彩票或抽奖中被抽中。

sense_translations.en_definition: to ascend; to rise; to soar; to climb up (move to a higher position)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 上升；升起；腾空；攀上，移到更高的位置。
正在兴建；处于建造过程中。
发酵膨起；指面团等因发酵而涨起。
当选；被选举产生。
获晋升；被提升职位或级别。

collocations.en: he went up onto the roof

formal.mt: Il-prezz tal-biljett tela' minn ħames ewro għal seba' ewro.
formal.en: The ticket price rose from five euros to seven euros.
formal.zh: 票价从五欧元涨到了七欧元。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn mar Pawlu? Ġużeppi: Tela' fuq il-bejt biex iġib is-siġġu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where did Pawlu go? Ġużeppi: He went up onto the roof to get the chair.
colloquial.zh: Marta：Pawlu 去哪儿了？Ġużeppi：他上屋顶拿椅子去了。

messages.speaker: Marta (家人)
messages.zh: Pawlu 去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Pawlu go?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tela' fuq il-bejt biex iġib is-siġġu.
messages.mt_standard: Tela' fuq il-bejt biex iġib is-siġġu.
messages.zh: 他上屋顶拿椅子去了。
messages.en: He went up onto the roof to get the chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先画向上的箭头，连接上楼、涨价和面团膨起等画面；其余义项另配语境记忆，并保留词尾撇号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave a place or depart; also, to leave someone or something behind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 离开某个地方或动身离去；也可指把某人或某物留下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitbiegħed minn post jew imur minn hemm; ukoll iħalli lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa warajh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 离开；离去。
留下；把某人或某物留在身后或原处。
释放；放走，使获得自由。

sense_translations.en_definition: to leave a partner or spouse
sense_translations.zh_definition: 离开伴侣或配偶；结束与其共同生活的关系。
退出；辞去；放弃正在从事的事情。

sense_translations.en_definition: to leave; to depart; to go away
sense_translations.zh_definition: 离开；动身；走开。

sense_translations.en_definition: to leave behind; to leave (also a spouse)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 留下某人或某物；离开某人，也可指离开配偶。
使虚弱；使乏力；削弱。
死去；离世。
发疯；精神失常。
用于构成起始表达，表示某个动作或状态开始发生。

formal.mt: Id-direttur telaq mill-uffiċċju wara li ntemmet il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The director left the office after the meeting ended.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，主任离开了办公室。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Mark għadu hawn? Leo: Le, telaq għax kellu jaqbad il-karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is Mark still here? Leo: No, he left because he had to catch the bus.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Mark 还在这里吗？Leo：不在，他走了，因为他得赶公交车。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 还在这里吗？
messages.en: Is Mark still here?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very small thing, piece, or amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 很小的东西、碎片或数量；一点点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġa, biċċa jew kwantità żgħira ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微小之物；少许；一点点。
某种很小的东西；小物件。
极少量；一点点。

formal.en: Add a tiny amount of salt and stir the mixture well.
formal.zh: 加入一点点盐，并把混合物搅拌均匀。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant Allium paniculatum, known in English as pale garlic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Allium paniculatum 的植物，英文名为 pale garlic，教学中可释作“淡色蒜”。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淡色蒜，指学名为 Allium paniculatum 的植物。

formal.mt: F'din il-lista, l-isem tewm safrani jirreferi għall-pjanta Allium paniculatum.
formal.en: In this list, the name tewm safrani refers to the plant Allium paniculatum.
formal.zh: 在这份清单中，tewm safrani 这个名称指的是 Allium paniculatum 这种植物。

colloquial.en: Elena: What is this plant called in the book? Karl: Pale garlic; the scientific name, Allium paniculatum, is here too.
colloquial.zh: Elena：书里把这种植物叫什么？Karl：淡色蒜，这里也写着学名 Allium paniculatum。
