teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出噼啪、啪嗒或吱嘎一类的声音，可用于描述开裂、突然折断或摩擦时的声响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss ta' qsim, ta' ksur f'daqqa, jew ta' tħaxkin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出噼啪声或开裂般的声音。
啪地折断；发出突然、清脆的啪声。
吱嘎作响；因摩擦或受力而发出嘎吱声。

collocations.en: the wood made a cracking sound

formal.mt: Matul l-ispezzjoni, il-bieb ċaqċaq kull darba li nfetaħ.
formal.en: During the inspection, the door creaked every time it was opened.
formal.zh: 检查期间，每次开门都会发出吱嘎声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak il-ħoss? Mark: Iva, il-bieb ċaqċaq meta ftaħtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that sound? Mark: Yes, the door creaked when I opened it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听到那个声音了吗？Mark：听到了，我开门时门吱嘎响了一声。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你听到那个声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that sound?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 听到了，我开门时门吱嘎响了一声。
messages.en: Yes, the door creaked when I opened it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċaqċaq 中重复的字母片段当作两次声音提示，想象“咔、咔”或“吱、嘎”；这是帮助记忆的联想，不代表词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clear and easy to understand or recognize; also used of water that is pure and not cloudy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清晰易懂或容易辨明的；也可形容水纯净、清澈而不浑浊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinftiehem jew jintgħaraf faċilment; jingħad ukoll għal ilma safi u mhux imdardar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清楚的；清晰的。
明显的；显而易见的。
解释清楚的；说明透彻的。
纯净的；清澈的（用于形容水）。
清楚的；明显的；显而易见的。
清澈的；纯净的；不浑浊的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta eżempju ċar tal-problema.
formal.en: The report presents a clear example of the problem.
formal.zh: 报告提供了一个清楚说明该问题的例子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-messaġġ tiegħi kien ċar? Mark: Iva, fhimt eżatt x'għandi nagħmel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was my message clear? Mark: Yes, I understood exactly what I need to do.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我说清楚了吗？马克：清楚了，我完全明白该做什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我说清楚了吗？
messages.en: Was my message clear?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 清楚了，我完全明白该做什么。
messages.en: Yes, I understood exactly what I need to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċar配上两幅图来记：一句清楚的话和一杯清澈的水，共同点都是清晰可辨。

gloss_zh: 撕；扯裂；撕碎；划破；撕扯者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tear or rip something, making a split or separating it into pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物撕开、扯裂或撕成碎片，使其出现裂口或分成几部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqsam jew tifred xi ħaġa billi tiġbidha jew tqattagħha, u tħalliha mċarrta jew f'biċċiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撕开；使某物出现裂口。
扯裂；用力撕开。
撕碎；撕成细条或小片。
划破；割开一道裂口。
撕扯东西的人；撕扯者。
撕开；扯开；把某物撕裂成几部分。

formal.mt: L-istudent ċarrat il-karta f'biċċiet żgħar għall-proġett tal-arti.
formal.en: The student tore the paper into small pieces for the art project.
formal.zh: 这名学生为美术项目把纸撕成了小片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ċarratt il-karta? Toni: Għax irrid nuża l-biċċiet għal stampa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you tear the paper? Toni: Because I want to use the pieces for a picture.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把纸撕了？托尼：因为我想用这些碎纸做一幅画。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么把纸撕了？
messages.en: Why did you tear the paper?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax irrid nuża l-biċċiet għal stampa.
messages.mt_standard: Għax irrid nuża l-biċċiet għal stampa.
messages.zh: 因为我想用这些碎纸做一幅画。
messages.en: Because I want to use the pieces for a picture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手把一张纸从完整撕到裂开，再撕成碎片，用这一连串画面记住动词义；名词义另配“撕纸的人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To flow in a small stream or fall in drops; also to spill or shed liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体细细地流动或一滴滴落下；也可指洒出、流出液体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joħroġ jew jinżel ftit ftit, bħala nixxiegħa żgħira jew fi qtar; ukoll li jxerred likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涓涓流淌；细细地流。
滴落；一滴滴地流下。
洒出；流出（液体等）。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, l-ilma beda jċarċar minn xaqq fil-ħajt.
formal.en: After the rain, water began to trickle from a crack in the wall.
formal.zh: 雨后，水开始从墙上的一道裂缝中细细流出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tisma' l-ilma jċarċar? Mark: Iva, ġej mill-vit tal-kċina.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear the water dripping? Mark: Yes, it's coming from the kitchen tap.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见水在滴吗？马克：听见了，是厨房的水龙头。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你听见水在滴吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the water dripping?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 听见了，是厨房的水龙头。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the kitchen tap.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċarċar反复读两遍，同时想象水一滴接一滴落下；这是声音联想，帮助记住滴落和细流。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A spring, stream, or cascade of flowing water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 泉、溪流或呈瀑布状落下的水流。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajn, nixxiegħa jew kaskata ta' ilma ġieri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 泉；溪流；瀑布。
瀑布；层层倾泻而下的水流。

formal.mt: Il-mogħdija twassal għal ċarċara żgħira bejn il-blat.
formal.en: The path leads to a small cascade among the rocks.
formal.zh: 这条小路通往岩石间的一道小瀑布。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nieqfu ħdejn iċ-ċarċara? Mark: Iva, irrid nisma' l-ħoss tal-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we stop beside the cascade? Mark: Yes, I want to listen to the water.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在瀑布旁边停一会儿好吗？马克：好，我想听听水声。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 我们在瀑布旁边停一会儿好吗？
messages.en: Shall we stop beside the cascade?

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 好，我想听听水声。
messages.en: Yes, I want to listen to the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给ċarċara画一张山水卡片：泉眼流成小溪，小溪再落成瀑布，用同一条水路串起各义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Flat, with an even surface or little thickness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面平坦的，或厚度很小、呈扁平状的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu wiċċ livell jew ftit ħxuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平的；平坦的；扁平的。
方言的；具有方言特点的。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun għandu jitqiegħed fuq wiċċ ċatt waqt il-kejl.
formal.en: The sample must be placed on a flat surface during measurement.
formal.zh: 测量时，样品必须放在平坦的表面上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ġebel ċatt biżżejjed? Mark: Iva, nistgħu nqiegħdu t-trej fuqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are these stones flat enough? Mark: Yes, we can put the tray on them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些石头够平吗？马克：够平，我们可以把托盘放在上面。

messages.speaker: Maja (野餐伙伴)
messages.zh: 这些石头够平吗？
messages.en: Are these stones flat enough?

messages.speaker: Mark (野餐伙伴)
messages.zh: 够平，我们可以把托盘放在上面。
messages.en: Yes, we can put the tray on them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记ċatt时把手掌平平摊开，再想象一块扁石头，用平坦表面和扁平形状一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A floating platform used to carry people or things on water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 漂浮在水面上、用来运送人或物品的筏状平台。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjattaforma li żżomm fil-wiċċ tal-ilma u tintuża biex iġġorr nies jew oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 筏；木筏。

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-vjaġġaturi qasmu x-xmara fuq ċattra tal-injam.
formal.en: In the story, the travelers crossed the river on a wooden raft.
formal.zh: 故事中，旅行者乘木筏渡过了河流。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed jibnu t-tfal għal-logħba? Mark: Ċattra żgħira tal-injam biex ipoġġuha fl-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are the children building for the game? Mark: A small wooden raft to put in the water.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：孩子们在为游戏做什么？马克：做一个小木筏，准备放到水里。

messages.speaker: Maja (家长)
messages.zh: 孩子们在为游戏做什么？
messages.en: What are the children building for the game?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċattra żgħira tal-injam biex ipoġġuha fl-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Ċattra żgħira tal-injam biex ipoġġuha fl-ilma.
messages.zh: 做一个小木筏，准备放到水里。
messages.en: A small wooden raft to put in the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċattra写在一幅木筏图下面：几根木头并排绑好，载着人漂过河，整幅画就是词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object that fits into a lock and is used to open or secure it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 插入锁中，用来开锁或上锁的物件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jidħol f'serratura biex jiftaħha jew jagħlaqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钥匙；用来开锁或上锁的物件。

formal.mt: Kull resident għandu jirritorna ċ-ċavetta mal-għeluq tal-kuntratt.
formal.en: Each resident must return the key when the contract ends.
formal.zh: 合同结束时，每位住户都必须归还钥匙。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi ċ-ċavetta tad-dar? Mark: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-telefon.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the house key? Mark: On the table, beside the phone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：家门钥匙在哪里？马克：在桌上，电话旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 家门钥匙在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the house key?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 在桌上，电话旁边。
messages.en: On the table, beside the phone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 每次拿起家门钥匙，就默念ċavetta，并想象把它插入锁孔转动，让实物动作帮助记词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A crow or raven; the supplied senses include the raven and the carrion crow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 乌鸦或渡鸦；所列具体义项包括渡鸦和小嘴乌鸦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur bħaċ-ċawlun imsejjaħ Corvus corax jew Corvus corone, skont it-tifsira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一只乌鸦。
渡鸦（Corvus corax）。
小嘴乌鸦（Corvus corone）。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, ġie rreġistrat ċawlun fuq fergħa qrib l-għalqa.
formal.en: During the observation, a crow was recorded on a branch near the field.
formal.zh: 观察记录中记下了田地附近树枝上的一只乌鸦。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt iċ-ċawlun fuq dik il-fergħa? Mark: Iva, u smajtu wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the crow on that branch? Mark: Yes, and I heard it too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见那根树枝上的乌鸦了吗？马克：看见了，我还听见它叫了。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟伙伴)
messages.zh: 你看见那根树枝上的乌鸦了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the crow on that branch?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟伙伴)
messages.zh: 看见了，我还听见它叫了。
messages.en: Yes, and I heard it too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċawlun贴在乌鸦图片旁记住大类；再把渡鸦和小嘴乌鸦分别配图，避免把两个具体物种混成一种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mulberry, especially a white mulberry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 桑或桑葚，尤指白桑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tut, b'mod partikolari tut abjad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白桑；白桑葚。
桑；桑葚。

formal.mt: L-istudenti ddeskrivew il-kulur u t-togħma ta' ċawsla misjura.
formal.en: The students described the color and taste of a ripe mulberry.
formal.zh: 学生们描述了一颗成熟桑葚的颜色和味道。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid idduq ċawsla? Mark: Iva, agħtini waħda misjura, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to taste a mulberry? Mark: Yes, please give me a ripe one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想尝一颗桑葚吗？马克：想，请给我一颗熟的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想尝一颗桑葚吗？
messages.en: Would you like to taste a mulberry?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, agħtini waħda misjura, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, agħtini waħda misjura, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 想，请给我一颗熟的。
messages.en: Yes, please give me a ripe one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċawsla和一颗白桑葚画在同一张词卡上，再配上成熟果实的画面，用颜色和品尝情景帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fill a hole or space, especially with rocks or stones.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 填塞洞穴或空隙，尤其指用岩石或石块填满。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimla ħofra jew spazju vojt, speċjalment bil-ġebel.

sense_translations.en_definition: to fill (usually used for rock or stone)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 填塞；填满，通常用于以岩石或石块作填料的情况。
填满，尤其指用石块填满。

collocations.en: fill the gaps between the blocks

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ċawwal il-ħofra bil-ġebel qabel kompla x-xogħol.
formal.en: The worker filled the hole with stones before continuing the work.
formal.zh: 工人先用石块填满坑洞，然后继续施工。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ġibt dan il-ġebel kollu? Toni: Biex nimla l-ħofra. Lara: Bħalma għamel missieri meta ċawwal dik ta' ħdejn il-bieb?
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you bring all these stones? Toni: To fill the hole. Lara: Like my father did when he filled the one beside the door with stones?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你搬来这么多石头干什么？托尼：用来填坑。拉拉：就像我爸爸用石头填门旁边那个坑那样吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 你搬来这么多石头干什么？
messages.en: Why did you bring all these stones?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.zh: 用来填坑。
messages.en: To fill the hole.

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħalma għamel missieri meta ċawwal dik ta' ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Bħalma għamel missieri meta ċawwal dik ta' ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 就像我爸爸用石头填门旁边那个坑那样吗？
messages.en: Like my father did when he filled the one beside the door with stones?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一块块石头塞进坑洞，直到空隙填满；用这个施工画面记住 ċawwal。

gloss_zh: 闲扯；喋喋不休；说些无关紧要的话

teaching_sense.en_definition: To talk at length about things of little importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长时间谈论无关紧要的事情；闲聊或喋喋不休地说话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titkellem fit-tul dwar affarijiet ta' ftit importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 絮絮叨叨地说些无关紧要的话。
叽叽喳喳地闲聊；不停地说话。

sense_translations.en_definition: to chatter, to prate, to engage in idle talk
sense_translations.zh_definition: 闲扯；喋喋不休；进行没有多少实质内容的交谈。

collocations.zh: 他絮絮叨叨地说了很久
他闲扯些无关紧要的事

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, wieħed mill-parteċipanti ċaċċar fit-tul fuq affarijiet bla importanza u dewwem id-diskussjoni.
formal.en: During the meeting, one participant prattled on about unimportant matters and delayed the discussion.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一名与会者长时间闲扯无关紧要的事情，拖延了讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dam daqshekk Pawlu għandek? Nina: Ċaċċar għal siegħa fuq il-ġirien, u l-ħin għadda bla ma ndunajna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu stay at your place so long? Nina: He chattered about the neighbours for an hour, and the time passed without us noticing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗怎么在你家待了那么久？妮娜：他聊邻居的事聊了一个小时，我们不知不觉就把时间聊过去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么在你家待了那么久？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu stay at your place so long?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċaċċar għal siegħa fuq il-ġirien, u l-ħin għadda bla ma ndunajna.
messages.mt_standard: Ċaċċar għal siegħa fuq il-ġirien, u l-ħin għadda bla ma ndunajna.
messages.zh: 他聊邻居的事聊了一个小时，我们不知不觉就把时间聊过去了。
messages.en: He chattered about the neighbours for an hour, and the time passed without us noticing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 ċaċċar 中重复的 ċ，可以想象话语一串接一串地冒出来，用这个画面记“闲扯不停”的动作；这只是记忆联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An informal conversation about everyday or unimportant matters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕日常或无关紧要的事情展开的随意交谈；一番闲聊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħdita informali dwar affarijiet ta' kuljum jew ta' ftit importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闲话；没有多少实质内容的闲谈。
轻松随意的闲聊；寒暄。

collocations.en: a chat over a cup of tea

formal.mt: Wara l-attività, il-parteċipanti għamlu ċaċċarata qasira qabel telqu lejn id-dar.
formal.en: After the activity, the participants had a brief chat before leaving for home.
formal.zh: 活动结束后，参与者们简短地闲聊了一会儿，然后各自回家。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandek ħin għal ċaċċarata fuq kikkra te? Marija: Iva, oqgħod bilqiegħda u għidli kif int.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have you got time for a chat over a cup of tea? Marija: Yes, sit down and tell me how you are.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你有空喝杯茶、聊一会儿吗？玛丽娅：有啊，坐下来，跟我说说你最近怎么样。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek ħin għal ċaċċarata fuq kikkra te?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek ħin għal ċaċċarata fuq kikkra te?
messages.zh: 你有空喝杯茶、聊一会儿吗？
messages.en: Have you got time for a chat over a cup of tea?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, oqgħod bilqiegħda u għidli kif int.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, oqgħod bilqiegħda u għidli kif int.
messages.zh: 有啊，坐下来，跟我说说你最近怎么样。
messages.en: Yes, sit down and tell me how you are.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċaċċarata 配上一杯茶的画面：它是可说“一番”的闲聊。用 tagħmel ċaċċarata 整组记住“聊一会儿”。

gloss_zh: 爱炫耀的人；吹牛者；话匣子

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who talks excessively, often boasting or trying to impress others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话过多的人，常带有吹嘘自己或试图引人注意的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem iżżejjed, spiss tiftaħar jew tipprova timpressjona lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱炫耀、爱显摆的人。
虚张声势、说大话唬人的人。
吹牛者；爱自夸的人。
话匣子；说起话来没完没了的人。

collocations.en: to be a chatterbox or braggart

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-protagonist huwa ċaċċarun li jiftaħar bis-suċċessi tiegħu u ma jħallix lill-oħrajn jitkellmu.
formal.en: In the story, the protagonist is a braggart who boasts about his successes and does not let others speak.
formal.zh: 故事中的主人公是个吹牛者，总爱夸耀自己的成功，也不给别人说话的机会。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark reġa' qalilna kemm hu tajjeb f'kollox. Toni: Kemm hu ċaċċarun! Nixtieq li jisma' ftit ukoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Mark told us again how good he is at everything. Toni: What a braggart! I wish he would listen a little too.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克又跟我们说他样样都很厉害。托尼：真是个吹牛大王！真希望他也能听别人说一会儿。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark reġa' qalilna kemm hu tajjeb f'kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Mark reġa' qalilna kemm hu tajjeb f'kollox.
messages.zh: 马克又跟我们说他样样都很厉害。
messages.en: Mark told us again how good he is at everything.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu ċaċċarun! Nixtieq li jisma' ftit ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu ċaċċarun! Nixtieq li jisma' ftit ukoll.
messages.zh: 真是个吹牛大王！真希望他也能听别人说一会儿。
messages.en: What a braggart! I wish he would listen a little too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ċaċċarun 配一个总抢着说话、还夸自己厉害的人物形象：记住它指“人”，再按语境区分话匣子与吹牛者。

gloss_zh: 否认；拒绝承认；与某人断绝关系；剥夺

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deny that something is true, or to refuse to acknowledge a claim, responsibility, or connection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 否认某事属实，或拒绝承认某项主张、责任或关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid li xi ħaġa mhijiex vera, jew jirrifjuta li jagħraf pretensjoni, responsabbiltà jew rabta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 否认；不承认某事属实。
声明不承认；否认自己与某事有关。
声明不承担责任或不拥有某项权利。
郑重恳求；严肃地要求某人做某事。
剥夺某人的某物、权利或机会。
拒绝承认与某人的关系；与某人断绝关系。
正式放弃某项权利、主张或信念。
坚决否认；拒绝接受或承认。

sense_translations.en_definition: to deny, disclaim, refuse, renounce, repudiate (something)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 否认、声明不承担、拒绝、放弃或坚决不承认某事物。
拒绝承认某人；与某人断绝关系；抛弃某人。
使某人失去某物；剥夺某人享有的事物。

formal.mt: Fid-dikjarazzjoni tiegħu, ir-raġel ċaħad l-akkuża u qal li ma kienx preżenti waqt l-inċident.
formal.en: In his statement, the man denied the accusation and said that he was not present during the incident.
formal.zh: 该男子在声明中否认了指控，并表示事发时他不在场。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu ċaħad li kiser it-tazza? Luqa: Iva, qal li t-tazza kienet diġà miksura.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did Pawlu deny breaking the cup? Luqa: Yes, he said the cup was already broken.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：保罗否认打碎了杯子吗？卢卡：是的，他说杯子本来就已经碎了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗否认打碎了杯子吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu deny breaking the cup?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qal li t-tazza kienet diġà miksura.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qal li t-tazza kienet diġà miksura.
messages.zh: 是的，他说杯子本来就已经碎了。
messages.en: Yes, he said the cup was already broken.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċaħad 与举手否认的画面连起来：面对指控说“我不承认”，面对责任说“我不承担”；具体义项要看后面的对象。

gloss_zh: 剥夺；使失去；否认指控者；剥夺他人者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deprive someone of something by taking it away or preventing them from having or enjoying it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拿走某人拥有的事物，或使其无法得到、享有某物，从而造成剥夺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħa xi ħaġa mingħand xi ħadd jew ma ħalliehx ikollha jew igawdiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剥夺某人的某物、权利或机会。
否认某项指控的人。
剥夺他人财物、权利或机会的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to deprive (to take something away; deny someone of something)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 剥夺；拿走某物，或不让某人得到某物。
否认者；剥夺他人所拥有事物的人。

collocations.mt: ċaħħad lil xi ħadd minn dritt
collocations.zh: 剥夺了某人的一项权利

formal.mt: Id-dewmien ċaħħad lill-istudenti mill-opportunità li japplikaw għall-borża ta' studju.
formal.en: The delay deprived the students of the opportunity to apply for the scholarship.
formal.zh: 这次延误使学生们失去了申请奖学金的机会。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma mortx għall-kunċert? Mark: Ix-xogħol ċaħħadni minn dik l-opportunità; kelli nibqa' l-uffiċċju.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why didn't you go to the concert? Mark: Work deprived me of that opportunity; I had to stay at the office.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么没去听音乐会？马克：工作让我错过了那个机会；我得留在办公室。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么没去听音乐会？
messages.en: Why didn't you go to the concert?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xogħol ċaħħadni minn dik l-opportunità; kelli nibqa' l-uffiċċju.
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xogħol ċaħħadni minn dik l-opportunità; kelli nibqa' l-uffiċċju.
messages.zh: 工作让我错过了那个机会；我得留在办公室。
messages.en: Work deprived me of that opportunity; I had to stay at the office.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“某人—失去—某物”的三格图记 ċaħħad：重点是某人被剥夺了什么；再与 ċaħad 的常用义“否认”对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stop resisting or give up, to hand something over to another person, or to become less intense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 停止抵抗或放弃，把某物让给别人，或指强度减弱；也可涉及耐心耗尽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieqaf jirreżisti jew jipprova, jgħaddi xi ħaġa lil ħaddieħor, jew jonqos fil-qawwa; jista' jirreferi wkoll għal sabar li jispiċċa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投降；停止抵抗。
放弃；不再坚持或尝试。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cede sth. to sb. else
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物或某项权利让给他人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to give up, to surrender, to cede
sense_translations.zh_definition: 放弃；投降；让出或转让。
耗尽耐心；使忍耐达到极限。
减弱；缓和；消退。
把某物送给或让给别人。

collocations.en: gave up his place to someone else
collocations.zh: 把自己的位置让给别人

formal.mt: Wara d-diskussjoni, id-direttur ċeda postu fil-kumitat lil kollega b'aktar esperjenza.
formal.en: After the discussion, the director gave up his place on the committee to a more experienced colleague.
formal.zh: 讨论结束后，主任把自己在委员会中的席位让给了一位经验更丰富的同事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ċeda postu fuq il-karozza tal-linja? Toni: Ħija; ra mara anzjana bilwieqfa u qam minnufih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who gave up his seat on the bus? Toni: My brother; he saw an elderly woman standing and got up straight away.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁在公交车上让座了？托尼：我哥哥；他看见一位老太太站着，就马上起身了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ċeda postu fuq il-karozza tal-linja?
messages.mt_standard: Min ċeda postu fuq il-karozza tal-linja?
messages.zh: 谁在公交车上让座了？
messages.en: Who gave up his seat on the bus?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija; ra mara anzjana bilwieqfa u qam minnufih.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija; ra mara anzjana bilwieqfa u qam minnufih.
messages.zh: 我哥哥；他看见一位老太太站着，就马上起身了。
messages.en: My brother; he saw an elderly woman standing and got up straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用放下坚持、让出座位、风势减弱三个画面记 ċeda；根据语境分别理解放弃、转让和减弱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of giving up or surrendering, or of handing something over to another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放弃或投降的行为，也可指把某物或某项权利让给他人的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iċedi, jieqaf jirreżisti jew jgħaddi xi ħaġa lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投降；停止抵抗的行为。
向他人让出或转让某物、权利等的行为。
放弃；投降；让出；转让。

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jiddeskrivi ċ-ċediment tad-drittijiet lill-kumpanija l-oħra.
formal.en: The agreement describes the transfer of the rights to the other company.
formal.zh: 协议说明了向另一家公司转让相关权利的事项。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ifisser 'ċediment' f'dan id-dokument? Mark: Hawn ifisser li d-drittijiet jgħaddu lil persuna oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'ċediment' mean in this document? Mark: Here it means that the rights pass to another person.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这份文件里的 ċediment 是什么意思？马克：这里指把权利转让给另一个人。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这份文件里的 ċediment 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ċediment' mean in this document?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser li d-drittijiet jgħaddu lil persuna oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser li d-drittijiet jgħaddu lil persuna oħra.
messages.zh: 这里指把权利转让给另一个人。
messages.en: Here it means that the rights pass to another person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċediment 放进文件标题里记：投降这件事、放弃这件事或权利转让这件事；它是表示行为的名词。

gloss_zh: 梳理并清洁羊毛；背后说人坏话

teaching_sense.en_definition: To clean and separate wool fibres by carding; in another sense, to speak maliciously about someone behind their back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过梳毛清洁并分开羊毛纤维；另一个义项是在背后恶意议论别人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaddaf is-suf u jifred il-fibri tiegħu b'għodda għat-tqardix; f'tifsira oħra, jitkellem ħażin fuq xi ħadd minn wara dahru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梳理并清洁羊毛。
用梳毛工具梳理纤维。
背后说人坏话；背地里恶意议论他人。

formal.mt: L-artiġjan ċefa s-suf biex neħħa l-ħmieġ u fired il-fibri qabel l-għażil.
formal.en: The craftsperson carded the wool to remove dirt and separate the fibres before spinning.
formal.zh: 手艺人在纺线前梳理羊毛，去除污物并分开纤维。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dan is-suf jidher aktar nadif u l-fibri tiegħu huma mifrudin? Nannu: Għax l-artiġjan ċefa s-suf dalgħodu; issa lest għall-għażil.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does this wool look cleaner, with its fibres separated? Grandfather: Because the craftsperson carded the wool this morning; now it's ready for spinning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么这些羊毛看起来更干净，纤维也分开了？爷爷：因为手艺人今天早上梳理过羊毛了，现在可以纺线了。

messages.speaker: Sara (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan is-suf jidher aktar nadif u l-fibri tiegħu huma mifrudin?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan is-suf jidher aktar nadif u l-fibri tiegħu huma mifrudin?
messages.zh: 为什么这些羊毛看起来更干净，纤维也分开了？
messages.en: Why does this wool look cleaner, with its fibres separated?

messages.speaker: Nannu (爷爷)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax l-artiġjan ċefa s-suf dalgħodu; issa lest għall-għażil.
messages.mt_standard: Għax l-artiġjan ċefa s-suf dalgħodu; issa lest għall-għażil.
messages.zh: 因为手艺人今天早上梳理过羊毛了，现在可以纺线了。
messages.en: Because the craftsperson carded the wool this morning; now it's ready for spinning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ċefa 分画两张学习卡：一张画梳理羊毛，一张画背后说坏话；两个义项分别记，避免混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in Central Europe, officially called the Czech Republic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 中欧国家捷克，正式名称为捷克共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Ewropa Ċentrali, bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika Ċeka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捷克。

sense_translations.en_definition: Czechia (a country in Central Europe; official name: Repubblika Ċeka)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 捷克，中欧的一个国家；正式名称为捷克共和国。

formal.mt: L-istudenti se jżuru ċ-Ċekja bħala parti minn programm ta' skambju.
formal.en: The students will visit Czechia as part of an exchange programme.
formal.zh: 学生们将作为交流项目的一部分访问捷克。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Mark: Sejjer iċ-Ċekja ma' ħabib tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Czechia with a friend.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要去哪里度假？马克：我要和一个朋友去捷克。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要和一个朋友去捷克。
messages.en: I'm going to Czechia with a friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把Ċekja写在中欧地图上的捷克位置，再连读“去捷克、住在捷克”两个短语，借地点画面记住国名。

gloss_zh: 支票；检查；将军（国际象棋）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A written instruction to a bank to pay money; also a check or verification, or a direct threat to the king in chess, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指要求银行付款的支票，也可依语境表示检查、核查，或国际象棋中王受到直接攻击的“将军”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument li jordna lil bank iħallas somma flus; skont il-kuntest, ukoll verifika jew theddida diretta lir-re fiċ-ċess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 检查；核查。
支票。

sense_translations.en_definition: check (chess: when the king is directly threatened by an enemy piece)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 将军：国际象棋中王受到对方棋子的直接攻击。
支票，即要求银行支付指定款项的票据。

formal.mt: Il-klijent bagħat ċekk biex iħallas il-kont.
formal.en: The client sent a cheque to pay the bill.
formal.zh: 客户寄来一张支票以支付账单。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ċekk! Ir-re tiegħek jinsab taħt theddida. Mark: Mela rrid insib mossa biex insalvah.
colloquial.en: Maja: Check! Your king is under threat. Mark: Then I need to find a move to save it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：将军！你的王受到攻击了。马克：那我得找一步棋来救它。

messages.speaker: Maja (棋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċekk! Ir-re tiegħek jinsab taħt theddida.
messages.mt_standard: Ċekk! Ir-re tiegħek jinsab taħt theddida.
messages.zh: 将军！你的王受到攻击了。
messages.en: Check! Your king is under threat.

messages.speaker: Mark (棋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela rrid insib mossa biex insalvah.
messages.mt_standard: Mela rrid insib mossa biex insalvah.
messages.zh: 那我得找一步棋来救它。
messages.en: Then I need to find a move to save it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给ċekk配三幅语境图：银行里的支票、清单上的核查、棋盘上受攻击的王；每次先看场景再选中文义。

gloss_zh: 缩小；减少；淡化；贬低；使受辱

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something smaller, shorter or less significant; also to belittle or humiliate someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物变小、变短或程度降低；也可指淡化其重要性，或贬低、羞辱某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa iżgħar, iqsar jew inqas importanti; ukoll ibaxxi l-valur jew id-dinjità ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缩小；使尺寸变小。

sense_translations.en_definition: to downplay the importance of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 淡化某事的重要性；把某事说得不那么重要。
羞辱；使受辱。
压缩；浓缩；使内容更精简。
减少；使降低。
使谦卑；使不再自大。
减轻；减弱；使程度降低。
诋毁；丑化；恶意贬损。

collocations.en: downplay the importance of the problem

formal.mt: L-editur ċekken l-istampa biex tidħol fil-paġna.
formal.en: The editor reduced the picture's size so that it would fit on the page.
formal.zh: 编辑缩小了图片，使其能够放进页面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din l-istampa kbira wisq. Mark: Ċekken l-istampa ftit u erġa' pprova.
colloquial.en: Maja: This picture is too big. Mark: Make the picture a little smaller and try again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张图片太大了。马克：把图片缩小一点，再试一次。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这张图片太大了。
messages.en: This picture is too big.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċekken l-istampa ftit u erġa' pprova.
messages.mt_standard: Ċekken l-istampa ftit u erġa' pprova.
messages.zh: 把图片缩小一点，再试一次。
messages.en: Make the picture a little smaller and try again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“把它变小”串联记忆：图片变小是缩小，事情的重要性变小是淡化，把人说得低微则可能是贬低或羞辱。

gloss_zh: 使咔嗒作响；叮当响；浅尝参与；唱歌；传谣

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a rattling or tinkling sound, or cause something to do so; other senses include dabbling, singing, and spreading a rumour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出或使物体发出咔嗒、叮当声；其他义项包括浅尝参与、唱歌以及传播谣言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel jew iqanqal ħoss ripetut ta' oġġetti li jaħbtu ma' xulxin; jista' jfisser ukoll li jieħu sehem b'mod superfiċjali, ikanta jew ixerred għajdut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出咔嗒声；使物体碰撞作响。
发出叮当声或咔嗒声；使物体叮当或咔嗒作响。

sense_translations.en_definition: to dabble (to participate in a casual or superficial way)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 浅尝参与；随意或肤浅地涉足某项活动。
唱歌；歌唱。
传播谣言；散布传闻。

collocations.en: jingle the coins in one's pocket
collocations.zh: 把口袋里的硬币弄得叮当响

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju tas-smigħ, l-għalliem ċekċek iċ-ċwievet u talab lill-istudenti jidentifikaw il-ħoss.
formal.en: During the listening exercise, the teacher rattled the keys and asked the students to identify the sound.
formal.zh: 在听辨练习中，老师把钥匙弄得叮当响，让学生辨认声音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ċekċek iċ-ċwievet? Ħsibt li wasal missieri. Toni: Jien, skużani! Kont qed infittex iċ-ċavetta tal-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who rattled the keys? I thought my father had arrived. Toni: Me, sorry! I was looking for the door key.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把钥匙弄得叮当响？我还以为爸爸回来了。托尼：是我，不好意思！我刚才在找门钥匙。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ċekċek iċ-ċwievet? Ħsibt li wasal missieri.
messages.mt_standard: Min ċekċek iċ-ċwievet? Ħsibt li wasal missieri.
messages.zh: 谁把钥匙弄得叮当响？我还以为爸爸回来了。
messages.en: Who rattled the keys? I thought my father had arrived.

messages.speaker: Toni (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, skużani! Kont qed infittex iċ-ċavetta tal-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, skużani! Kont qed infittex iċ-ċavetta tal-bieb.
messages.zh: 是我，不好意思！我刚才在找门钥匙。
messages.en: Me, sorry! I was looking for the door key.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ċekċek 时配合摇钥匙的节奏，先记叮当作响；另列浅尝参与、唱歌、传谣三张义项卡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An event or activity held to express happiness about a special occasion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为表达对特别日子的喜悦而举行的庆祝活动或庆典。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attività jew okkażjoni li fiha n-nies jesprimu l-ferħ tagħhom għal ġrajja speċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 庆祝；庆祝活动；庆典。

formal.mt: L-iskola organizzat ċelebrazzjoni fi tmiem is-sena skolastika.
formal.en: The school organised a celebration at the end of the school year.
formal.zh: 学校在学年结束时组织了一场庆祝活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tagħmlu ċelebrazzjoni għal għeluq snin ommok? Mark: Iva, se niltaqgħu d-dar u nieklu kejk flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you having a celebration for your mother's birthday? Mark: Yes, we're meeting at home and having cake together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们要为你妈妈的生日办庆祝活动吗？马克：是的，我们会在家里聚一聚，一起吃蛋糕。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tagħmlu ċelebrazzjoni għal għeluq snin ommok?
messages.mt_standard: Se tagħmlu ċelebrazzjoni għal għeluq snin ommok?
messages.zh: 你们要为你妈妈的生日办庆祝活动吗？
messages.en: Are you having a celebration for your mother's birthday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se niltaqgħu d-dar u nieklu kejk flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se niltaqgħu d-dar u nieklu kejk flimkien.
messages.zh: 是的，我们会在家里聚一聚，一起吃蛋糕。
messages.en: Yes, we're meeting at home and having cake together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到ċelebrazzjoni就想象大家围着生日蛋糕庆祝，把这个长词与一整场欢乐活动相连，记作“庆祝、庆典”。

gloss_zh: 浅蓝色的；天蓝色的；天上的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Light blue or sky blue in colour; also relating to the sky or heavens.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色为浅蓝色或天蓝色的；也可表示与天空、天界有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta' lewn blu ċar, bħal dak tas-sema; ukoll li għandu x'jaqsam mas-sema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 浅蓝色的。
天上的；天空的；天界的。
天蓝色的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-osservazzjoni ta' diversi korpi ċelesti.
formal.en: The report describes the observation of several celestial bodies.
formal.zh: 报告描述了对多个天体的观测。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema qmis tixtieq, il-bajda jew iċ-ċelesti? Mark: Iċ-ċelesti, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which shirt would you like, the white one or the light blue one? Mark: The light blue one, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想要哪件衬衫，白色的还是浅蓝色的？马克：请给我浅蓝色的。

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema qmis tixtieq, il-bajda jew iċ-ċelesti?
messages.mt_standard: Liema qmis tixtieq, il-bajda jew iċ-ċelesti?
messages.zh: 你想要哪件衬衫，白色的还是浅蓝色的？
messages.en: Which shirt would you like, the white one or the light blue one?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我浅蓝色的。
messages.en: The light blue one, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用天空画面同时记两个义项：天空的浅蓝颜色对应“天蓝色的”，天空中的星体对应“天上的、天体的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To call someone or dial a number by telephone, or to ring a bell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给某人打电话、拨打电话号码，或使铃响、按铃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel telefonata lil xi ħadd, iċempel numru tat-telefon, jew iddoqq qanpiena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打电话；使铃响。

sense_translations.en_definition: to call sb. on the phone
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某人打电话。
使铃等发出响声；摇铃或按铃。
拨打某个电话号码。
通过电话呼叫某人；给某人打电话。

formal.mt: Il-maniġer ċempel lill-klijent biex jikkonferma l-ħin tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: The manager called the client to confirm the meeting time.
formal.zh: 经理给客户打电话，确认会议时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ċempel lil ommok u għidilha li se ndumu ftit. Mark: Tajjeb, se nċemplilha issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Call your mother and tell her we'll be a little late. Mark: Okay, I'll call her now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：给你妈妈打个电话，告诉她我们会晚一点。马克：好，我现在就给她打。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċempel lil ommok u għidilha li se ndumu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Ċempel lil ommok u għidilha li se ndumu ftit.
messages.zh: 给你妈妈打个电话，告诉她我们会晚一点。
messages.en: Call your mother and tell her we'll be a little late.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我现在就给她打。
messages.en: Okay, I'll call her now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċempel和“让铃声响起”的动作相连：拨电话让对方电话响，按门铃让铃响；再用lil引出接电话的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A meal eaten in the evening, whether an ordinary supper or a more formal dinner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 晚上吃的一餐，可指日常晚饭，也可指较正式的晚餐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikla li tittiekel filgħaxija, kemm ta' kuljum kif ukoll f'okkażjoni aktar formali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 晚饭；晚餐。
晚饭；晚餐，即晚上吃的一餐。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċena għall-mistednin tibda fis-sebgħa ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: Dinner for the guests begins at seven in the evening.
formal.zh: 为来宾安排的晚餐于晚上七点开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se nieklu għaċ-ċena? Mark: Se nagħmel l-għaġin. Trid tgħinni?
colloquial.en: Maja: What are we having for dinner? Mark: I'm going to make pasta. Would you like to help me?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们晚饭吃什么？马克：我打算做意大利面。你想帮我吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 我们晚饭吃什么？
messages.en: What are we having for dinner?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我打算做意大利面。你想帮我吗？
messages.en: I'm going to make pasta. Would you like to help me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċena贴在傍晚餐桌的画面上，练习“准备晚餐”和“邀请吃晚餐”；先记住晚上这一时间线索。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Situated in or near the centre, or having a main and important role.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于中心或靠近中心的；也指在某事中处于主要、核心地位的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab fiċ-ċentru jew qrib tiegħu, jew li għandu rwol ewlieni u importanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中央的；中心的；主要的；核心的。

formal.mt: Il-komunikazzjoni għandha rwol ċentrali fis-suċċess tal-proġett.
formal.en: Communication plays a central role in the project's success.
formal.zh: 沟通对项目的成功起着核心作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu? Mark: F'dak il-kafè ħdejn il-pjazza; qiegħed f'post ċentrali u faċli biex naslu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet? Mark: At that café beside the square; it's in a central location and easy to get to.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在哪里见面？马克：在广场旁边那家咖啡馆吧；位置很中心，也容易到达。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dak il-kafè ħdejn il-pjazza; qiegħed f'post ċentrali u faċli biex naslu.
messages.mt_standard: F'dak il-kafè ħdejn il-pjazza; qiegħed f'post ċentrali u faċli biex naslu.
messages.zh: 在广场旁边那家咖啡馆吧；位置很中心，也容易到达。
messages.en: At that café beside the square; it's in a central location and easy to get to.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在圆圈正中画一个点来记ċentrali：地点在正中是“中心的”，作用处于最重要的位置就是“核心的”。

gloss_zh: 中心；中间；市中心；活动中心

teaching_sense.en_definition: The middle of something, the central part of a town, or a place where a particular activity takes place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物的中心或中间位置，也指城市的中心区域，或开展某种活动的场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tan-nofs ta' xi ħaġa, il-qalba ta' belt, jew post fejn issir attività partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中心；中央位置。
市中心；城市的中心地带。
中心；中间部分。

sense_translations.en_definition: center (place where a function or activity occurs)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 中心；用于开展某种工作或活动的场所。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċentru sportiv jinsab fiċ-ċentru tal-belt u joffri attivitajiet għat-tfal.
formal.en: The sports centre is in the city centre and offers activities for children.
formal.zh: 体育中心位于市中心，并为儿童提供活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu? Mark: Fiċ-ċentru tal-belt, ħdejn il-kafetterija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet? Mark: In the city centre, beside the café.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在哪里碰面？马克：在市中心，咖啡馆旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在市中心，咖啡馆旁边。
messages.en: In the city centre, beside the café.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个圆并标出中心，再把城市中心和体育中心放在旁边，用三个画面记住同一个词的常见用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sea fish called a grouper; the word can also refer to the wreckfish, Polyprion americanus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种海鱼的名称，可指石斑鱼，也可指大西洋多锯鲈（Polyprion americanus）。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' ħuta tal-baħar li jista' jirreferi għall-grouper jew għall-wreckfish, Polyprion americanus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 石斑鱼。
大西洋多锯鲈（学名 Polyprion americanus）。

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi ċerna moħmija bil-lumi, servuta mal-ħaxix.
formal.en: The menu includes grouper baked with lemon, served with vegetables.
formal.zh: 菜单上有柠檬烤石斑鱼，配以蔬菜。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek ċerna friska llum? Pawlu: Iva, tridha sħiħa jew imqatta'?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have fresh grouper today? Pawlu: Yes. Would you like it whole or cut up?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天有新鲜石斑鱼吗？保罗：有。你要整条的还是切好的？

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天有新鲜石斑鱼吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh grouper today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (鱼贩)
messages.zh: 有。你要整条的还是切好的？
messages.en: Yes. Would you like it whole or cut up?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鱼摊上的鱼名牌写着ċerna，再配上新鲜和烤制两个场景；另记它也可指大西洋多锯鲈。

gloss_zh: 转圈；在工作中兜圈子而未完成

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spin in circles, literally or figuratively when work continues without reaching completion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 转圈；也可比喻工作反复兜圈、仍在进行而没有完成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idur f'ċirku; jista' jintuża wkoll għal xogħol li jibqa' għaddej bla ma jitlesta.

sense_translations.en_definition: to spin in circles (used of work that is is in progress or unterminated)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 兜圈子；用于描述工作仍在进行或迟迟未完成。
转圈；绕圈旋转。

collocations.en: went round in circles over the same work
collocations.zh: 围着同一项工作兜圈子

formal.mt: It-tim ċerrek fuq l-istess xogħol għal ġimgħa sħiħa, iżda r-rapport baqa' ma tlestiex.
formal.en: The team went round in circles over the same work for a whole week, but the report remained unfinished.
formal.zh: 团队围着同一项工作兜了整整一周的圈子，报告却仍未完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tim lesta r-rapport? Mark: Le, ċerrek fuq l-istess xogħol il-ġurnata kollha u ma spiċċa xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the team finish the report? Mark: No, it went round in circles over the same work all day and finished nothing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：团队完成报告了吗？马克：没有，整天围着同一项工作兜圈子，什么也没做完。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 团队完成报告了吗？
messages.en: Did the team finish the report?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ċerrek fuq l-istess xogħol il-ġurnata kollha u ma spiċċa xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ċerrek fuq l-istess xogħol il-ġurnata kollha u ma spiċċa xejn.
messages.zh: 没有，整天围着同一项工作兜圈子，什么也没做完。
messages.en: No, it went round in circles over the same work all day and finished nothing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象人在圆圈里不停转，旁边的报告始终没写完，把实际转圈与工作兜圈两个意思连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A written document certifying a fact, qualification, or achievement, or providing a testimonial about someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于证明事实、资格或成绩的书面文件，也可指证明某人表现或品行的书面证明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument li jikkonferma fatt, kwalifika jew kisba, jew li jagħti xhieda dwar il-ħila jew l-imġiba ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 证书；证明某项事实、资格或成绩的文件。
书面证明；为某人的能力、品行或表现作证的证明材料。

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant li jattendi s-sessjonijiet kollha jirċievi ċertifikat ta' attendenza.
formal.en: Every participant who attends all the sessions receives a certificate of attendance.
formal.zh: 每位参加全部课程的学员都会获得出席证明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ġibt iċ-ċertifikat tat-twelid? Mark: Iva, qiegħed fil-folder mal-formola.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you bring the birth certificate? Mark: Yes, it is in the folder with the form.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你带出生证明了吗？马克：带了，和表格一起放在文件夹里。

messages.speaker: Maja (办事员)
messages.zh: 你带出生证明了吗？
messages.en: Did you bring the birth certificate?

messages.speaker: Mark (申请人)
messages.zh: 带了，和表格一起放在文件夹里。
messages.en: Yes, it is in the folder with the form.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċertifikat写在一张画有印章的证明纸上，再想象出生证明与出席证明，记住它是书面证明文件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A deer, a hoofed animal whose males in many species grow antlers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鹿，一类有蹄动物，许多种类的雄性会长鹿角。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal bid-dwiefer; f'ħafna speċi r-raġel ikollu qrun ramifikati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鹿。

formal.mt: Waqt il-mixja fil-foresta, il-grupp osserva ċerv minn distanza mingħajr ma resaq lejh.
formal.en: During the forest walk, the group observed a deer from a distance without approaching it.
formal.zh: 在森林徒步期间，小组远远观察了一只鹿，没有靠近它。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak iċ-ċerv ħdejn is-siġra! Mark: Rajtu! Ejja nibqgħu hawn biex ma nbeżżgħuhx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that deer beside the tree! Mark: I see it! Let's stay here so we don't frighten it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看树旁边那只鹿！马克：看到了！我们留在这里，免得吓到它。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 看树旁边那只鹿！
messages.en: Look at that deer beside the tree!

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu! Ejja nibqgħu hawn biex ma nbeżżgħuhx.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu! Ejja nibqgħu hawn biex ma nbeżżgħuhx.
messages.zh: 看到了！我们留在这里，免得吓到它。
messages.en: I see it! Let's stay here so we don't frighten it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在森林里的鹿旁边标上ċerv，朗读时想象它从树后探出头，用清晰动物画面固定词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Chess, a board game for two players whose aim is to checkmate the opponent's king.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 国际象棋，一种双人棋盘游戏，以将死对方的王为目标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħba fuq bord għal żewġ persuni, li fiha l-għan hu li tagħmel xakk matt lir-re tal-avversarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 国际象棋。

formal.mt: Il-klabb se jorganizza kampjonat taċ-ċess għall-istudenti nhar is-Sibt.
formal.en: The club will organise a chess championship for students on Saturday.
formal.zh: 俱乐部将于星期六举办学生国际象棋锦标赛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tilgħab logħba ċess miegħi? Mark: Iva, imma l-ewwel fakkarni kif jiċċaqlaq iż-żiemel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to play a game of chess with me? Mark: Yes, but first remind me how the knight moves.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：想和我下一局国际象棋吗？马克：想，不过先提醒我一下马怎么走。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 想和我下一局国际象棋吗？
messages.en: Do you want to play a game of chess with me?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel fakkarni kif jiċċaqlaq iż-żiemel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel fakkarni kif jiċċaqlaq iż-żiemel.
messages.zh: 想，不过先提醒我一下马怎么走。
messages.en: Yes, but first remind me how the knight moves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċess和英文chess并排写在黑白棋盘上，联想王、后和马，记住这里指国际象棋。

gloss_zh: 嬉闹消磨时间；四处闲逛

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spend time fooling about or wandering around without a serious purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过嬉闹或漫无目的地四处闲逛来消磨时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi l-ħin jiċċajta jew idur minn post għal ieħor bla skop serju.

sense_translations.en_definition: to while away the time by fooling about
sense_translations.zh_definition: 嬉闹着消磨时间；通过玩闹打发时间。
四处闲逛；到处游荡。

collocations.zh: 和朋友嬉闹着消磨时间

formal.mt: Wara l-lezzjonijiet, it-tifel ċieċ mal-ħbieb għal siegħa qabel ma mar id-dar.
formal.en: After lessons, the boy spent an hour fooling about with his friends before going home.
formal.zh: 下课后，男孩和朋友嬉闹了一个小时才回家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Mark wara l-iskola? Pawlu: Ċieċ magħna fil-pjazza, imbagħad mar id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Mark do after school? Pawlu: He fooled about with us in the square, then went home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克放学后做了什么？保罗：他和我们在广场上嬉闹了一阵，然后回家了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 马克放学后做了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark do after school?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċieċ magħna fil-pjazza, imbagħad mar id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Ċieċ magħna fil-pjazza, imbagħad mar id-dar.
messages.zh: 他和我们在广场上嬉闹了一阵，然后回家了。
messages.en: He fooled about with us in the square, then went home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象放学后和朋友在广场嬉闹，再沿街随意闲逛，用这两个连续画面记住消磨时间与四处闲逛。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mark left on the skin after a wound has healed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伤口愈合后留在皮肤上的痕迹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marka li tibqa' fuq il-ġilda wara li ferita tkun fieqet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疤痕；伤口愈合后留下的痕迹。

formal.mt: Wara li fieqet il-ferita, baqgħet ċikatriċi żgħira fuq id il-pazjent.
formal.en: After the wound healed, a small scar remained on the patient's hand.
formal.zh: 伤口愈合后，患者的手上留下了一道小疤痕。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġiet dik iċ-ċikatriċi? Pawlu: Waqajt minn fuq ir-rota meta kont żgħir.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you get that scar? Pawlu: I fell off my bike when I was little.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你那道疤是怎么来的？保罗：我小时候骑自行车摔倒了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你那道疤是怎么来的？
messages.en: How did you get that scar?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqajt minn fuq ir-rota meta kont żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Waqajt minn fuq ir-rota meta kont żgħir.
messages.zh: 我小时候骑自行车摔倒了。
messages.en: I fell off my bike when I was little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċikatriċi 和手上的一道旧疤联系起来，记住它指伤口愈合后留下的痕迹。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A food made from cocoa, often sweetened and eaten as a treat or used in desserts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用可可制成的食品，常加入糖，作为零食食用或用于制作甜点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel magħmul mill-kawkaw, spiss biz-zokkor, li jittiekel waħdu jew jintuża fid-deżerti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巧克力；用可可制成的食品。

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, dewweb iċ-ċikkulata u ħallatha mal-ħalib sħun.
formal.en: For this recipe, melt the chocolate and mix it with the warm milk.
formal.zh: 制作这道食品时，先将巧克力融化，再与温牛奶混合。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid biċċa ċikkulata? Mark: Iva, grazzi! Nippreferi ċ-ċikkulata skura.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like a piece of chocolate? Mark: Yes, thanks! I prefer dark chocolate.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你想吃一块巧克力吗？马克：好呀，谢谢！我更喜欢黑巧克力。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想吃一块巧克力吗？
messages.en: Would you like a piece of chocolate?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好呀，谢谢！我更喜欢黑巧克力。
messages.en: Yes, thanks! I prefer dark chocolate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象掰下一块巧克力，说出 biċċa ċikkulata；把词和品尝巧克力的动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large bird with long legs, a long neck, and a long bill.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种体型较大、腿长、颈长、喙长的鸟，即鹳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur kbir b'saqajn twal, għonq twil u munqar twil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鹳；一种长腿、长颈、长喙的大型鸟。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar, l-istudenti raw ċikonja ħdejn l-ilma.
formal.en: During the birdwatching activity, the students saw a stork near the water.
formal.zh: 在观鸟活动中，学生们在水边看到了一只鹳。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dik iċ-ċikonja ħdejn l-ilma! Toni: Qed naraha. Kemm għandha saqajn twal!
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that stork by the water! Toni: I can see it. Its legs are so long!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看水边的那只鹳！托尼：我看见了。它的腿真长啊！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看水边的那只鹳！
messages.en: Look at that stork by the water!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naraha. Kemm għandha saqajn twal!
messages.mt_standard: Qed naraha. Kemm għandha saqajn twal!
messages.zh: 我看见了。它的腿真长啊！
messages.en: I can see it. Its legs are so long!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ċikonja 时画一只站在水边的长腿鸟，用长腿、长颈、长喙三个特征联想到鹳。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Chicory, a plant whose root can be roasted and used as a substitute for coffee; also the coffee substitute made from it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 菊苣，一种根部可经烘焙后用作咖啡代用品的植物；也指由其制成的咖啡代用品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta li l-għerq tagħha jista' jinkalja u jintuża minflok il-kafè; ukoll il-prodott magħmul minn dan l-għerq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 菊苣。
菊苣，学名 Cichorium intybus。
菊苣咖啡代用品；用烘焙后的菊苣根制成、用于代替咖啡的产品。

collocations.zh: 用来代替咖啡的菊苣制品

formal.mt: L-għerq taċ-ċikwejra jista' jinkalja u jintuża biex issir xarba minflok il-kafè.
formal.en: Chicory root can be roasted and used to make a drink in place of coffee.
formal.zh: 菊苣根可以烘焙后制成饮品，用来代替咖啡。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan kafè? David: Le, din xarba taċ-ċikwejra. Trid tipprovaha?
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this coffee? David: No, it's a chicory drink. Would you like to try it?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这是咖啡吗？戴维：不是，这是菊苣饮品。你想尝尝吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是咖啡吗？
messages.en: Is this coffee?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, din xarba taċ-ċikwejra. Trid tipprovaha?
messages.mt_standard: Le, din xarba taċ-ċikwejra. Trid tipprovaha?
messages.zh: 不是，这是菊苣饮品。你想尝尝吗？
messages.en: No, it's a chicory drink. Would you like to try it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一株菊苣和一杯菊苣饮品作两张记忆图：ċikwejra 既可指植物，也可指咖啡代用品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A solid shape with two equal, parallel circular bases and a curved side, or a cylindrical container or machine part.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有两个大小相同、彼此平行的圆形底面和一个曲面的立体；也指圆筒形容器或气缸等机器部件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma solida b'żewġ bażijiet ċirkolari ndaqs u paralleli u b'wiċċ mgħawweġ bejniethom; ukoll reċipjent jew parti ta' magna b'din il-forma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圆柱体；圆筒；气缸。

formal.mt: Biex jikkalkulaw il-volum taċ-ċilindru, l-istudenti kejlu r-raġġ tal-bażi u l-għoli tiegħu.
formal.en: To calculate the volume of the cylinder, the students measured the radius of its base and its height.
formal.zh: 为了计算圆柱体的体积，学生们测量了它的底面半径和高度。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Din il-bott għandha forma ta' ċilindru? Ġanni: Iva, ara ż-żewġt itruf tondi tagħha.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is this can shaped like a cylinder? Ġanni: Yes, look at its two round ends.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这个罐子是圆柱形的吗？詹尼：是的，看看它两端的圆形。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-bott għandha forma ta' ċilindru?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-bott għandha forma ta' ċilindru?
messages.zh: 这个罐子是圆柱形的吗？
messages.en: Is this can shaped like a cylinder?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara ż-żewġt itruf tondi tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara ż-żewġt itruf tondi tagħha.
messages.zh: 是的，看看它两端的圆形。
messages.en: Yes, look at its two round ends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċilindru 和饮料罐的轮廓一起记：上下两个圆，中间一个曲面，就是圆柱体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chime or ringing sound; in a separate nautical sense, a thick rope used to secure or tow a vessel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指钟鸣声；另有航海义，指用来系泊或拖曳船只的粗缆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss ta' qanpiena; f'tifsira oħra marbuta mal-baħar, ħabel oħxon biex tintrabat jew tinġibed bastiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钟鸣声；钟铃发出的鸣响。
船用粗缆；用于系泊或拖曳船只的粗绳索。

formal.mt: Ċima qasira tal-qanpiena ħabbret il-bidu taċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: A short chime of the bell announced the start of the ceremony.
formal.zh: 一声短促的钟鸣宣告仪式开始。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Fejn hi ċ-ċima biex norbtu d-dgħajsa? Rita: Hawn, ħdejn saqajk.
colloquial.en: Toni: Where is the hawser for tying up the boat? Rita: Here, next to your feet.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：系船用的粗缆在哪里？丽塔：这里，就在你脚边。

messages.speaker: Toni (船员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi ċ-ċima biex norbtu d-dgħajsa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi ċ-ċima biex norbtu d-dgħajsa?
messages.zh: 系船用的粗缆在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the hawser for tying up the boat?

messages.speaker: Rita (船员)
messages.zh: 这里，就在你脚边。
messages.en: Here, next to your feet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 ċima 做两张独立画面卡：一张画响起的钟，一张画码头粗缆；靠钟声和船只语境分别提取两个词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where people who have died are buried.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安葬逝者的地方，即墓地或公墓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jindifnu l-mejtin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 墓地；公墓。
公墓；墓园；坟地。

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi huma mitluba jżommu s-skiet waqt iż-żjara tagħhom fiċ-ċimiterju.
formal.en: Visitors are asked to remain quiet during their visit to the cemetery.
formal.zh: 请来访者在墓园内保持安静。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għada mmorru ċ-ċimiterju biex inpoġġu l-fjuri fuq il-qabar tan-nanna? Pietru: Iva, niġi miegħek filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Shall we go to the cemetery tomorrow to put flowers on Grandma's grave? Pietru: Yes, I'll come with you in the morning.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们明天去墓园，给奶奶的墓献花，好吗？彼得：好，我早上陪你去。

messages.speaker: Anna (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada mmorru ċ-ċimiterju biex inpoġġu l-fjuri fuq il-qabar tan-nanna?
messages.mt_standard: Għada mmorru ċ-ċimiterju biex inpoġġu l-fjuri fuq il-qabar tan-nanna?
messages.zh: 我们明天去墓园，给奶奶的墓献花，好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go to the cemetery tomorrow to put flowers on Grandma's grave?

messages.speaker: Pietru (弟弟)
messages.zh: 好，我早上陪你去。
messages.en: Yes, I'll come with you in the morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċimiterju 放进安静献花的场景中记忆：它是整片墓园，单个墓穴则是场景中的另一件事物。

gloss_zh: 牵引绳；带子；裤背带；挽具背带

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strip or band used to hold, fasten, support, or lead something, such as a strap or a dog's leash.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于固定、系紧、支撑或牵引的条带，例如背包带或狗的牵引绳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strixxa jew faxxa li tintuża biex iżżomm, torbot, issostni jew tmexxi xi ħaġa, bħal ċinga ta' basket jew ta' kelb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牵引绳；用于牵着狗等动物的绳带。
带子；用于固定、携带或系紧物品的条带。
带子、细皮带、牵引绳或条带。

sense_translations.en_definition: suspenders (an item used hold up trousers)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 裤背带；用于吊住裤子的带子。
挽具背带；横跨役畜背部、起支撑或固定作用的带子。

formal.mt: Għas-sigurtà tal-viżitaturi, il-klieb għandhom jinżammu b'ċinga waqt li jkunu fil-park.
formal.en: For visitors' safety, dogs must be kept on a leash while in the park.
formal.zh: 为保障来访者的安全，狗在公园内必须用牵引绳牵着。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn hi ċ-ċinga tal-kelb? Samwel: Ħdejn il-bieb. Ħudha qabel toħroġ bih.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where's the dog's leash? Samwel: By the door. Take it before you go out with him.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：狗的牵引绳在哪儿？萨姆韦尔：在门边。带它出门前把绳子拿上。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 狗的牵引绳在哪儿？
messages.en: Where's the dog's leash?

messages.speaker: Samwel (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-bieb. Ħudha qabel toħroġ bih.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-bieb. Ħudha qabel toħroġ bih.
messages.zh: 在门边。带它出门前把绳子拿上。
messages.en: By the door. Take it before you go out with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċinga 想成一条能固定或牵引的长带；接上 tal-kelb 想到狗绳，接上 tal-basket 想到包带。

gloss_zh: 中国人，通常指男性；中国的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person from China, usually a man.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自中国的人，通常指男性中国人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna miċ-Ċina, ġeneralment raġel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中国人。

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or related to China
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自中国或与中国有关的人。
中国的；中国人的。

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or related to China
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自中国的；与中国有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Chinese (of, from or relating to China)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 中国的；来自中国的；与中国有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Chinese (native or inhabitant of China) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 中国人；中国本地人或居民，通常指男性。

collocations.en: a Chinese man who lives in Malta
collocations.zh: 一位住在马耳他的中国男子

formal.mt: F'din l-intervista, Ċiniż li jgħix Malta jiddeskrivi l-esperjenza tiegħu bħala student.
formal.en: In this interview, a Chinese man living in Malta describes his experience as a student.
formal.zh: 在这次访谈中，一位住在马耳他的中国男子讲述了自己的求学经历。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int Ċiniż? Li: Iva, jien miċ-Ċina u issa qed nistudja hawn Malta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you Chinese? Li: Yes, I'm from China, and I'm studying here in Malta now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你是中国人吗？李：是的，我来自中国，现在在马耳他这里读书。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你是中国人吗？
messages.en: Are you Chinese?

messages.speaker: Li (中国男学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien miċ-Ċina u issa qed nistudja hawn Malta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien miċ-Ċina u issa qed nistudja hawn Malta.
messages.zh: 是的，我来自中国，现在在马耳他这里读书。
messages.en: Yes, I'm from China, and I'm studying here in Malta now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张卡片区分用法：Ċiniż 单独指一位中国男子，student Ċiniż 中则修饰学生，表示中国的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large waterbird with a long neck; also used specifically for the mute swan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种颈部长的大型水鸟，称为天鹅；也可特指疣鼻天鹅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur kbir tal-ilma b'għonq twil; il-kelma tintuża wkoll speċifikament għall-ispeċi Cygnus olor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天鹅。
疣鼻天鹅，学名为 Cygnus olor。

collocations.en: a swan swimming in the pond

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher ċinju abjad jgħum f'għadira.
formal.en: The photograph shows a white swan swimming in a pond.
formal.zh: 照片中，一只白天鹅正在池塘里游泳。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ara dak iċ-ċinju fl-ilma! Pawlu: Iva, għandu għonq twil ħafna.
colloquial.en: Marija: Look at that swan in the water! Pawlu: Yes, it has a very long neck.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：看水里的那只天鹅！保罗：是啊，它的脖子真长。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 看水里的那只天鹅！
messages.en: Look at that swan in the water!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，它的脖子真长。
messages.en: Yes, it has a very long neck.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċinju 和池塘中伸着长脖子的白天鹅画面一起记，再用 ċinju abjad 练习“白天鹅”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A low wall or fence marking a boundary, or an area enclosed by such a boundary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于划定边界的矮墙或围栏，也可指由其围起的区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħajt baxx jew ilqugħ li jimmarka l-limiti ta' post, jew il-post magħluq bih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 矮墙。
围栏；围起的区域。

formal.mt: Ċint baxx tal-ġebel jifred il-ġnien mit-triq.
formal.en: A low stone wall separates the garden from the road.
formal.zh: 一道低矮的石墙将花园与道路隔开。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn ħallejt ir-rota? Pawlu: Ħdejn iċ-ċint tal-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where did you leave the bicycle? Pawlu: Next to the garden fence.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你把自行车放在哪儿了？保罗：花园围栏旁边。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你把自行车放在哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you leave the bicycle?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 花园围栏旁边。
messages.en: Next to the garden fence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给花园画上一圈低墙，把 ċint 记作划出边界的矮墙或围栏，也联系围起来的区域。

gloss_zh: 屋顶锐边；褶裥；带子；锐边；舷缘

teaching_sense.en_definition: A band or ribbon used to surround, hold, or decorate something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于围住、固定或装饰物品的带子或丝带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strixxa ta' materjal li ddawwar, iżżomm jew iżżejjen xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 屋顶的尖锐边缘。
缝纫中折叠并缝住的褶裥。
带子；丝带。
尖锐的边缘。
舷缘，即船舷的上缘。

formal.mt: Ċinta tal-ħarir ħamra ddawwar il-kaxxa tar-rigal.
formal.en: A red silk ribbon goes around the gift box.
formal.zh: 一条红色丝带环绕着礼物盒。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Liema ċinta nużaw għall-kaxxa? Pawlu: Il-ħamra; tmur tajjeb mal-karta bajda.
colloquial.en: Marija: Which ribbon shall we use for the box? Pawlu: The red one; it goes well with the white paper.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我们用哪条丝带装饰盒子？保罗：红色那条吧，配白纸很好看。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们用哪条丝带装饰盒子？
messages.en: Which ribbon shall we use for the box?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 红色那条吧，配白纸很好看。
messages.en: The red one; it goes well with the white paper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用礼盒上的装饰丝带记住 ċinta 的带子义；再分别配图记屋顶锐边、褶裥和舷缘，避免混淆各义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A band worn around the waist, especially to keep trousers in place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 系在腰间的带子，尤其用于固定裤子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Faxxa li tintlibes madwar il-qadd, speċjalment biex iżżomm il-qalziet f'postu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腰带；带子。

sense_translations.en_definition: belt (band around the waist worn principally to hold one’s trousers)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 腰带，围在腰间、主要用于固定裤子的带子。

formal.mt: Dan iċ-ċinturin tal-ġilda jżomm il-qalziet f'postu.
formal.en: This leather belt keeps the trousers in place.
formal.zh: 这条皮腰带用于固定裤子。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek ċinturin iswed? Rita: Iva, trid tipprova dan?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a black belt? Rita: Yes, would you like to try this one?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们有黑色腰带吗？丽塔：有，您想试试这条吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们有黑色腰带吗？
messages.en: Do you have a black belt?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 有，您想试试这条吗？
messages.en: Yes, would you like to try this one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前穿裤子、系腰带的动作，把 ċinturin 与腰间固定裤子的那条带子牢牢记在一起。

gloss_zh: 线脚刨；拘留室；木块；碎片或芯片；世系

teaching_sense.en_definition: A block of wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一块具有一定厚度的木头，即木块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa injam f'għamla ta' blokka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 线脚刨，用于刨削装饰线脚的木工刨。
临时拘留室；羁押室。
木块。
碎片；芯片，具体所指依上下文而定。
世系；血统；家族出身。

formal.en: The carpenter placed a block of wood on the workbench.

colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：请把那块木头递给我。保罗：这块小的吗？玛丽娅：对，就是那块。

messages.speaker: Marija (木工教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tini dak iċ-ċipp tal-injam, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Tini dak iċ-ċipp tal-injam, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请把那块木头递给我。
messages.en: Pass me that block of wood, please.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学员)

messages.en: This small one?

messages.speaker: Marija (木工教师)
messages.zh: 对，就是那块。
messages.en: Yes, that one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 ċipp tal-injam 和工作台上的木块配对记忆；其他义项分别做卡片，不把木块、拘留室和世系混成一义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of an island and country in the Mediterranean Sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地中海中的岛屿及国家的名称：塞浦路斯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' gżira u pajjiż fil-Baħar Mediterran.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 塞浦路斯。

sense_translations.en_definition: Cyprus (an island and country in the Mediterranean Sea, normally considered politically part of Europe but geographically part of West Asia)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 塞浦路斯，地中海中的岛屿及国家，政治上通常被视为欧洲的一部分，地理上则属于西亚。

formal.mt: Ċipru huwa gżira u pajjiż fil-Baħar Mediterran.
formal.en: Cyprus is an island and country in the Mediterranean Sea.
formal.zh: 塞浦路斯是地中海中的一座岛屿，也是一个国家。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn sejjer għall-btala? Pawlu: Sejjer Ċipru ma' ħija.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where are you going on holiday? Pawlu: I'm going to Cyprus with my brother.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你要去哪儿度假？保罗：我要和兄弟一起去塞浦路斯。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪儿度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要和兄弟一起去塞浦路斯。
messages.en: I'm going to Cyprus with my brother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ċipru 写在地中海地图上的塞浦路斯旁边，用“去塞浦路斯度假”串起词形与地名；正文中首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small round fruit with a stone in the centre, called a cherry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种中间有果核的小型圆形水果，即樱桃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta żgħira u tonda b'għadma fin-nofs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 樱桃。

formal.mt: Fuq il-platt hemm ċirasa ħamra b'għadma fin-nofs.
formal.en: There is a red cherry with a stone in the centre on the plate.
formal.zh: 盘子上有一颗红樱桃，果实中间有一颗核。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Trid ċirasa? Pawlu: Iva, grazzi. Kemm hi ħelwa!
colloquial.en: Marija: Would you like a cherry? Pawlu: Yes, thanks. It's so sweet!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你想吃颗樱桃吗？保罗：好啊，谢谢。真甜！

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想吃颗樱桃吗？
messages.en: Would you like a cherry?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 好啊，谢谢。真甜！
messages.en: Yes, thanks. It's so sweet!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手里的一颗红樱桃，边看边念 ċirasa ħamra；再用果肉甜、中央有核的画面巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of getting around a rule, restriction, or obstacle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设法绕过规则、限制或障碍的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed idur ma' regola, restrizzjoni jew ostaklu biex jevitah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 规避；设法绕过规则、限制或障碍的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' ċirkomvenzjoni tar-regoli tal-kompetizzjoni.
formal.en: The report describes a case of circumvention of the competition rules.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起规避比赛规则的案例。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Xi tfisser ċirkomvenzjoni tar-regoli? Pawlu: Meta xi ħadd isib mod kif idur mar-regoli biex jevitahom.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does circumvention of the rules mean? Pawlu: It's when someone finds a way around the rules to avoid them.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：规避规则是什么意思？保罗：就是有人想办法绕开规则，以免受其约束。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: 规避规则是什么意思？
messages.en: What does circumvention of the rules mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta xi ħadd isib mod kif idur mar-regoli biex jevitahom.
messages.mt_standard: Meta xi ħadd isib mod kif idur mar-regoli biex jevitahom.
messages.zh: 就是有人想办法绕开规则，以免受其约束。
messages.en: It's when someone finds a way around the rules to avoid them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把规则想象成路上的障碍，有人绕路避开它；用这个画面记 ċirkomvenzjoni 表示“规避”这一行为，而非执行规则。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A round shape whose boundary is equally distant from its centre; also a circus or a particular group of people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圆周上各点与圆心距离相等的圆形；也可指马戏团或特定的人际圈子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma tonda li kull punt fuq it-tarf tagħha jkun fl-istess distanza miċ-ċentru; ukoll spettaklu taċ-ċirku jew grupp partikolari ta' nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圆；圆形。
马戏团；马戏表演。
圆；环形边缘或轮缘。
圈子；具有特定联系的一群人。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-ġeometrija, l-istudent għandu jpinġi ċirku u jimmarka ċ-ċentru tiegħu.
formal.en: In the geometry exercise, the student should draw a circle and mark its centre.
formal.zh: 在这道几何练习中，学生应画一个圆，并标出圆心。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi ċ-ċirku magħna għada? Mark: Iva! X'ħin tibda l-wirja?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to come to the circus with us tomorrow? Mark: Yes! What time does the show start?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你明天想和我们一起去看马戏吗？Mark：想啊！演出几点开始？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天想和我们一起去看马戏吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come to the circus with us tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 想啊！演出几点开始？
messages.en: Yes! What time does the show start?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把圆形、圆形表演场和朋友圈连成三幅图：看到几何题想“圆”，看到演出想“马戏”，看到一群熟人想“圈子”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A written notice sent or distributed to a number of people to give them the same information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向多人发送或分发、传达同一信息的书面通告。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avviż bil-miktub li jintbagħat jew jitqassam lil diversi persuni biex jagħtihom l-istess informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 传阅通知；向多人分发的通告。
圆形的；呈圆周形状的。
通告；传单；通知。

formal.mt: L-iskola bagħtet ċirkulari lill-ġenituri biex tħabbar id-data tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: The school sent a circular to parents to announce the date of the meeting.
formal.zh: 学校向家长发出通告，公布会议日期。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qrajt iċ-ċirkulari tal-iskola? Pawlu: Iva, il-laqgħa se tkun il-Ħamis.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you read the school circular? Pawlu: Yes, the meeting will be on Thursday.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你看过学校通告了吗？Pawlu：看过了，会议在星期四。

messages.speaker: Sara (家长)
messages.zh: 你看过学校通告了吗？
messages.en: Have you read the school circular?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家长)
messages.zh: 看过了，会议在星期四。
messages.en: Yes, the meeting will be on Thursday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习卡区分词性：一张画“发给大家的通告”，记名词；另一张画“圆桌”，记形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official notice recording an offence or requiring someone to appear before a court.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 记录违规事项的正式处罚通知，或要求某人到庭的传票。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avviż uffiċjali dwar ksur ta' regola jew li jordna lil persuna tidher quddiem qorti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罚款；罚款处罚。
传票；要求到庭的正式通知。
违规告票；罚单。

collocations.en: to receive a summons or ticket
a summons to appear in court

formal.mt: Il-persuna rċeviet ċitazzjoni biex tidher il-qorti fid-data indikata fid-dokument.
formal.en: The person received a summons to appear in court on the date indicated in the document.
formal.zh: 该人收到传票，须在文件注明的日期到庭。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Sibt ċitazzjoni fuq il-karozza. Lara: Għall-parkeġġ? Ara x'hemm miktub fuqha.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)

messages.en: For parking? Check what it says.

teaching_sense.en_definition: The legal status of being a citizen of a country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为某个国家公民的法律身份，通常涉及相应的权利和义务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istatus legali ta' persuna bħala ċittadin ta' pajjiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公民身份；国籍。

formal.mt: L-applikant ippreżenta d-dokumenti meħtieġa għall-applikazzjoni għaċ-ċittadinanza.
formal.en: The applicant submitted the documents required for the citizenship application.
formal.zh: 申请人提交了申请国籍所需的文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek ċittadinanza Maltija? David: Iva, għandi ċittadinanza Maltija.

colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有马耳他国籍吗？戴维：有，我有马耳他国籍。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有马耳他国籍吗？
messages.en: Do you have Maltese citizenship?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我有马耳他国籍。
messages.en: Yes, I have Maltese citizenship.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进填写国籍申请表的场景，联想“我是哪国公民”，记住它表示公民身份。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to ordinary citizens or civil matters, rather than military matters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与普通公民或民事事务有关的；非军事的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam maċ-ċittadini jew ma' kwistjonijiet ċivili, aktar milli ma' affarijiet militari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 民事的；公民的；非军事的；也可表示有礼貌的。
平民；非军职人员。

formal.mt: Il-kors jintroduċi lill-istudenti għall-prinċipji tad-dritt ċivili.
formal.en: The course introduces students to the principles of civil law.
formal.zh: 本课程向学生介绍民法的基本原则。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Se tagħmlu żwieġ ċivili? David: Iva, u wara se nieklu mal-familja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you having a civil marriage? David: Yes, and afterwards we will have a meal with the family.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你们要举行民事婚礼吗？David：是的，之后会和家人一起吃饭。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们要举行民事婚礼吗？
messages.en: Are you having a civil marriage?

messages.speaker: David (准新郎)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u wara se nieklu mal-familja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u wara se nieklu mal-familja.

messages.en: Yes, and afterwards we will have a meal with the family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“民”字串起主要含义：民事婚姻、民法、平民；修饰事务时记形容词，直接指人群时记名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A developed human society with its own institutions, culture and organised way of life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有自身制度、文化和有组织生活方式的人类社会；文明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Soċjetà umana żviluppata bl-istituzzjonijiet, il-kultura u l-mod ta' ħajja organizzat tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 文明；具有制度、文化和社会组织的人类社会。
文明；具有制度、文化和社会组织的人类社会。

formal.mt: L-istudju ta' ċivilizzazzjoni antika jinkludi l-istituzzjonijiet, l-arti u l-ħajja ta' kuljum tagħha.
formal.en: The study of an ancient civilisation includes its institutions, art and everyday life.
formal.zh: 研究一个古代文明，需要考察其制度、艺术与日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ktieb hu dwar ċivilizzazzjoni antika? Toni: Iva, u fih ħafna stampi tal-bliet u tal-għodod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this book about an ancient civilisation? Toni: Yes, and it has lots of pictures of the cities and tools.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这本书讲的是一个古代文明吗？Toni：是的，里面有很多城市和工具的图片。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb hu dwar ċivilizzazzjoni antika?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb hu dwar ċivilizzazzjoni antika?
messages.zh: 这本书讲的是一个古代文明吗？
messages.en: Is this book about an ancient civilisation?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u fih ħafna stampi tal-bliet u tal-għodod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u fih ħafna stampi tal-bliet u tal-għodod.
messages.zh: 是的，里面有很多城市和工具的图片。
messages.en: Yes, and it has lots of pictures of the cities and tools.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“文明”装进一座想象中的城市：城里有制度、艺术和日常生活。用这三个画面一起记住这个长词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Civilisation as an organised society and its culture; also courteous and respectful behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为有组织社会及其文化的文明；也指待人有礼、尊重他人的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Soċjetà organizzata u l-kultura tagħha; ukoll imġiba edukata li turi rispett lejn l-oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 文明；有组织的社会及其文化。
文明礼貌；客气而尊重他人的态度或行为。
文明；有组织的社会及其文化。

formal.mt: Waqt id-dibattitu, il-parteċipanti għandhom jitkellmu biċ-ċiviltà u jirrispettaw l-opinjonijiet ta' xulxin.
formal.en: During the debate, participants should speak with civility and respect one another's opinions.
formal.zh: 辩论时，参与者应文明发言，并尊重彼此的意见。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ma naqbilx miegħu, imma rrid nitkellem biċ-ċiviltà. Mark: Sewwa, tista' tgħid x'taħseb mingħajr ma tgħajjat.
colloquial.en: Lara: I disagree with him, but I want to speak with civility. Mark: Right, you can say what you think without shouting.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我不同意他，但我想好好说话。Mark：对，你可以表达想法，不用大喊。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma naqbilx miegħu, imma rrid nitkellem biċ-ċiviltà.
messages.mt_standard: Ma naqbilx miegħu, imma rrid nitkellem biċ-ċiviltà.
messages.zh: 我不同意他，但我想好好说话。
messages.en: I disagree with him, but I want to speak with civility.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, tista' tgħid x'taħseb mingħajr ma tgħajjat.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, tista' tgħid x'taħseb mingħajr ma tgħajjat.
messages.zh: 对，你可以表达想法，不用大喊。
messages.en: Right, you can say what you think without shouting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 借中文“文明”的双重用法来记：历史课讲“古代文明”，日常交流讲“文明有礼”；看语境选择含义。

gloss_zh: 坐下（常用于对幼儿说话）；游手好闲；荡妇（贬辱性名词）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sit down, especially in speech addressed to a young child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 坐下，尤其用于成人对幼儿说话的语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joqgħod bilqiegħda, speċjalment fil-lingwaġġ użat ma' tfal żgħar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to sit down (a word used in child-direted speech)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 坐下；用于对幼儿说话的用语。

sense_translations.en_definition: a woman of loose morals (aterm of contempt)

坐下。
游手好闲；过无所事事的生活。
被指性行为放纵的女人；带有贬辱意味的称呼。

collocations.en: sit down here, said to a young child

collocations.en: sit down beside me, said to a young child
collocations.zh: 坐到我旁边，常用于对幼儿说

formal.mt: Fil-ktieb għat-tfal, l-omm tgħid lit-tifel: 'Ċiċċa hawn ħdejja u nħarsu lejn l-istampi flimkien.'

formal.zh: 在这本童书中，母亲对小男孩说：“坐到我旁边来，我们一起看图片。”

colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：本，坐到我旁边来。本：这里吗，妈妈？玛丽娅：对，我们一起读个故事。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)

gloss_zh: 小型有壳海生动物；蝉虾；螯虾
