teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有较硬外壳的小型海生动物，可用于指蝉虾等有壳海产。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlejjaq żgħar tal-baħar b'qoxra kemxejn iebsa.

sense_translations.en_definition: small sea creatures with a semi hard shell.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有半硬外壳的小型海生动物。
蝉虾；一种外形较扁的海生甲壳动物。
螯虾；小龙虾。

collocations.zh: 用ċkal这类有壳海产做的汤

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi soppa biċ-ċkal, servuta mal-ħobż.
formal.en: The menu includes soup made with ċkal shellfish, served with bread.
formal.zh: 菜单上有用ċkal这类有壳海产做的汤，配面包供应。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif se ssajjar iċ-ċkal illum? Pawlu: Bil-lumi u t-tewm. Trid idduq?
colloquial.en: Sara: How are you going to cook the ċkal shellfish today? Pawlu: With lemon and garlic. Would you like a taste?
colloquial.zh: Sara：今天你打算怎么做这些ċkal海产？Pawlu：加柠檬和蒜。你想尝尝吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天你打算怎么做这些ċkal海产？
messages.en: How are you going to cook the ċkal shellfish today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 加柠檬和蒜。你想尝尝吗？
messages.en: With lemon and garlic. Would you like a taste?

cognitive_memory_aid: 先画一盘带壳的小海产来记总义，再用“蝉虾”和“螯虾”两张词义卡分别记忆，避免把不同名称混成同一种动物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small or tiny in size, sometimes expressing affection for the person or thing described.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体积或个头小的、微小的；有时也带有亲昵语气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żgħir jew żgħir ħafna fid-daqs; kultant jintuża wkoll biex juri għożża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小的；尺寸或个头较小的。
微小的；非常小的。
小的；小小的，有时带亲昵意味。

formal.mt: Fil-vetrina tal-mużew hemm ktieb ċkejken b'kitba ċara u dettaljata.
formal.en: In the museum display case there is a tiny book with clear, detailed writing.
formal.zh: 博物馆的展柜里有一本小小的书，书中文字清晰而详尽。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dan il-ġugarell ċkejken! Toni: Kemm hu ħelu! Joqgħod fil-but?
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at this tiny toy! Toni: How cute! Does it fit in a pocket?
colloquial.zh: Maja：看这个小小的玩具！Toni：真可爱！能放进口袋吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看这个小小的玩具！
messages.en: Look at this tiny toy!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 真可爱！能放进口袋吗？
messages.en: How cute! Does it fit in a pocket?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一本小书和一个小玩具放进口袋，边放边说“ċkejken，小小的”；再联想“小男孩”中的亲昵语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become smaller in size, amount, or extent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体积、数量或范围变小、缩小或减少。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir iżgħar fid-daqs, fil-kwantità jew fil-firxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐变小。
时增时减；发生盈亏消长。
减少；减弱；缩减。
变小；收缩。

formal.mt: Wara li tneħħiet parti mill-materjal, il-munzell ċkien bin-nofs.
formal.en: After some of the material was removed, the pile shrank by half.
formal.zh: 移走部分材料后，料堆缩小了一半。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-flokk ċkien fil-ħasil! Lara: Iva, issa jidher ħafna iżgħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: This shirt shrank in the wash! Lara: Yes, it looks much smaller now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这件上衣洗过后缩水了！拉拉：是啊，现在看起来小多了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这件上衣洗过后缩水了！
messages.en: This shirt shrank in the wash!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，现在看起来小多了。
messages.en: Yes, it looks much smaller now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċkien和衣服洗后缩水的画面联系起来，记住它表示发生了变小或减少的变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being small; also childhood, childishness, or humility, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 微小的状态；也可按语境表示童年、孩子气或谦卑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' min jew ta' dak li hu żgħir; tista' tfisser ukoll it-tfulija, imġiba tat-tfal jew l-umiltà, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微小；体积或规模较小的状态。
童年；儿童时期。
小；微小；幼小的状态。
孩子气；幼稚的表现或性情。
谦卑；谦逊。

formal.mt: Fl-awtobijografija tagħha, l-awtriċi tiddeskrivi ċ-ċkunija tagħha f'raħal żgħir.
formal.en: In her autobiography, the author describes her childhood in a small village.
formal.zh: 作者在自传中描述了自己在一个小村庄度过的童年。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din ir-ritratt iġibli ħafna tifkiriet taċ-ċkunija. Lara: Lili wkoll; konna nilagħbu hawn kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: This photo brings back many childhood memories. Lara: For me too; we used to play here every day.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张照片勾起了我许多童年回忆。拉拉：我也是；我们以前每天都在这里玩。

messages.speaker: Maja (儿时朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din ir-ritratt iġibli ħafna tifkiriet taċ-ċkunija.
messages.mt_standard: Din ir-ritratt iġibli ħafna tifkiriet taċ-ċkunija.
messages.zh: 这张照片勾起了我许多童年回忆。
messages.en: This photo brings back many childhood memories.

messages.speaker: Lara (儿时朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lili wkoll; konna nilagħbu hawn kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Lili wkoll; konna nilagħbu hawn kuljum.
messages.zh: 我也是；我们以前每天都在这里玩。
messages.en: For me too; we used to play here every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用小时候的照片记ċkunija的童年义，再分别记住微小、孩子气和谦卑这些语境义。

gloss_zh: 蝴蝶结；系结物；结；蝴蝶形意大利面

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bow or decorative knot made by tying ribbon, fabric, or similar material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用丝带、布料等系成的蝴蝶结或装饰结。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għoqda dekorattiva magħmula billi tintrabat żigarella, biċċa drapp jew materjal simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蝴蝶结；结饰。
系结物；用于系束或装饰的结。
蝴蝶结；绳结或带结。
蝴蝶形意大利面。

formal.mt: Il-kaxxa tar-rigal kienet imżejna b'ċoff aħmar magħmul minn żigarella.
formal.en: The gift box was decorated with a red bow made from ribbon.
formal.zh: 礼盒上装饰着一个用丝带系成的红色蝴蝶结。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tagħmilli ċoff b'din iż-żigarella? Lara: Żgur; trid iċ-ċoff fuq il-kaxxa?
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you make me a bow with this ribbon? Lara: Of course; do you want the bow on the box?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能用这条丝带帮我系个蝴蝶结吗？拉拉：当然；你想把蝴蝶结放在盒子上吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能用这条丝带帮我系个蝴蝶结吗？
messages.en: Can you make me a bow with this ribbon?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 当然；你想把蝴蝶结放在盒子上吗？
messages.en: Of course; do you want the bow on the box?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象礼盒上的蝴蝶结来记ċoff，再用相似外形联想蝴蝶面；这是记忆图像，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 微小；小巧；谦卑；微不足道

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or state of being small in size, scale, or importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尺寸、规模或重要性较小的性质或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew il-qagħda ta' xi ħaġa li hi żgħira fid-daqs, fl-iskala jew fl-importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微小；尺寸或规模较小的状态。
谦卑；不自高自大的态度。
微不足道；不显著或不重要。
微小；小巧；渺小。

collocations.en: the small size of the island

formal.mt: Minkejja ċ-ċokon tal-kamra, id-disinn jippermetti użu tajjeb tal-ispazju.
formal.en: Despite the smallness of the room, the design allows the space to be used well.
formal.zh: 尽管房间狭小，这个设计仍能充分利用空间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Iċ-ċokon ta' din il-kċina jagħmilha diffiċli biex insajru flimkien. Lara: Veru; ejja nħejju l-ħaxix fuq il-mejda l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: The small size of this kitchen makes it difficult for us to cook together. Lara: True; let's prepare the vegetables on the other table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个厨房太小，我们很难一起做饭。拉拉：确实；我们去另一张桌子上准备蔬菜吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iċ-ċokon ta' din il-kċina jagħmilha diffiċli biex insajru flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iċ-ċokon ta' din il-kċina jagħmilha diffiċli biex insajru flimkien.
messages.zh: 这个厨房太小，我们很难一起做饭。
messages.en: The small size of this kitchen makes it difficult for us to cook together.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru; ejja nħejju l-ħaxix fuq il-mejda l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Veru; ejja nħejju l-ħaxix fuq il-mejda l-oħra.
messages.zh: 确实；我们去另一张桌子上准备蔬菜吧。
messages.en: True; let's prepare the vegetables on the other table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċokon记成小房间的那个小，强调小的性质；遇到人物态度或重要性时，再按语境理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lead, the chemical element that is a heavy, soft metal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铅，一种质重而柔软的金属化学元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku li huwa metall tqil u artab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铅；金属铅。
铅，化学元素。

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-oġġett tindika li huwa magħmul miċ-ċomb, metall tqil u artab.
formal.en: The description of the object states that it is made of lead, a heavy, soft metal.
formal.zh: 该物件的说明指出，它由铅这种质重而柔软的金属制成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan il-piż huwa daqshekk tqil? Mark: Għax huwa magħmul miċ-ċomb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this weight so heavy? Mark: Because it is made of lead.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个重物怎么这么沉？马克：因为它是铅做的。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-piż huwa daqshekk tqil?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-piż huwa daqshekk tqil?
messages.zh: 这个重物怎么这么沉？
messages.en: Why is this weight so heavy?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 因为它是铅做的。
messages.en: Because it is made of lead.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块小小却很沉的铅块来记ċomb；这里对应英语表示金属的lead。

gloss_zh: 修士兜帽；修会服；带兜帽的修士长袍

teaching_sense.en_definition: A monk's hood or religious habit, including a habit with a hood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 修士所戴的兜帽或所穿的修会服，也可指带兜帽的修士长袍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Barnuża ta' patri jew il-libsa reliġjuża tiegħu, inkluża libsa bil-barnuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修士的兜帽。
修会服；修士所穿的宗教服装。

sense_translations.en_definition: cowl (a monk’s hood; a habit with such a hood)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 修士兜帽；带这种兜帽的修会服。

formal.mt: Fil-pittura, il-patri jidher liebes ċoqqa kannella bil-barnuża.
formal.en: In the painting, the monk is shown wearing a brown hooded habit.
formal.zh: 画中的修士穿着一件带兜帽的棕色修会服。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha l-libsa tal-patri f'din l-istampa? Mark: Tissejjaħ ċoqqa; hawn tidher ukoll il-barnuża tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the monk's garment in this picture called? Mark: It is called a ċoqqa; you can also see its hood here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张图里修士穿的衣服叫什么？马克：叫ċoqqa；这里还能看到它的兜帽。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这张图里修士穿的衣服叫什么？
messages.en: What is the monk's garment in this picture called?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tissejjaħ ċoqqa; hawn tidher ukoll il-barnuża tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Tissejjaħ ċoqqa; hawn tidher ukoll il-barnuża tagħha.
messages.zh: 叫ċoqqa；这里还能看到它的兜帽。
messages.en: It is called a ċoqqa; you can also see its hood here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用修士穿着连帽长袍的画面记ċoqqa，把兜帽和修会服两个相关指称一起记住。

gloss_zh: 起雾；面色变黄；雾；薄雾；视物昏暗

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become foggy; also, of a person's complexion, to become sallow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天气变得有雾；也可指人的面色变得蜡黄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir imċajpar biċ-ċpar; jista' jfisser ukoll li l-kulur tal-wiċċ isir safrani.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 起雾；变得雾蒙蒙。
面色变得蜡黄。
雾。
薄雾；轻雾。
眼睛视物昏暗；视觉模糊。

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl it-temp ċpar, u filgħodu l-għoljiet ma kinux jidhru sew.
formal.en: During the night the weather became foggy, and in the morning the hills could not be seen clearly.
formal.zh: 夜间天气起了雾，到了早晨，山丘已看不清楚。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hawn ċpar dalgħodu! Lara: Iva, lanqas nista' nara t-tarf tat-triq.
colloquial.en: Maja: It's so foggy this morning! Lara: Yes, I can't even see the end of the street.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天早晨雾真大！拉拉：是啊，我连街道的尽头都看不见。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 今天早晨雾真大！
messages.en: It's so foggy this morning!

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, lanqas nista' nara t-tarf tat-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, lanqas nista' nara t-tarf tat-triq.
messages.zh: 是啊，我连街道的尽头都看不见。
messages.en: Yes, I can't even see the end of the street.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ċpar放进雾遮住街道的画面：名词是雾，动词是起雾；面色变黄义另记，勿混淆词性。

gloss_zh: 农妇穿的棉布长袍；宽松衣袍

teaching_sense.en_definition: A loose garment, especially a cotton gown worn by a female peasant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宽松的衣袍，尤指农妇穿的棉布长袍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Libsa wiesgħa, speċjalment libsa tal-qoton li tintlibes minn mara tal-biedja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含义未明（Fjf）。

sense_translations.en_definition: a gown made of cotton worn by female peasants
sense_translations.zh_definition: 农妇穿的棉布长袍。
宽松的衣服；宽大的衣袍。

formal.mt: L-istampa turi mara tal-biedja liebsa ċulqana tal-qoton.
formal.en: The picture shows a female peasant wearing a cotton gown.
formal.zh: 图中是一位穿着棉布长袍的农妇。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi ċulqana? Nina: Hija libsa wiesgħa; tista' tkun libsa tal-qoton li tilbes mara tal-biedja.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is a ċulqana? Nina: It's a loose garment; it can be a cotton gown worn by a female peasant.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：ċulqana 是什么？妮娜：是一种宽松衣袍，可以指农妇穿的棉布长袍。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: ċulqana 是什么？
messages.en: What is a ċulqana?

messages.speaker: Nina (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija libsa wiesgħa; tista' tkun libsa tal-qoton li tilbes mara tal-biedja.
messages.mt_standard: Hija libsa wiesgħa; tista' tkun libsa tal-qoton li tilbes mara tal-biedja.
messages.zh: 是一种宽松衣袍，可以指农妇穿的棉布长袍。
messages.en: It's a loose garment; it can be a cotton gown worn by a female peasant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象画中农妇穿着宽大的棉布长袍，把“农妇、棉布、宽松衣袍”三个画面线索连在一起记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wine heated with spices and served warm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 加入香料加热、趁温热饮用的葡萄酒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inbid imsaħħan bil-ħwawar u servut sħun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 香料热葡萄酒；加香料温热饮用的葡萄酒。

collocations.zh: 把香料热葡萄酒温热上桌

formal.mt: Waqt ir-riċeviment, iċ-ċumnata se tiġi servuta sħuna.
formal.en: At the reception, the mulled wine will be served warm.
formal.zh: 招待会上将供应温热的香料葡萄酒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tazza ċumnata? Pawlu: Iva, grazzi. Għadha sħuna?
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a glass of mulled wine? Pawlu: Yes, thanks. Is it still warm?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想喝一杯香料热葡萄酒吗？保罗：好，谢谢。还热着吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (主人)
messages.zh: 你想喝一杯香料热葡萄酒吗？
messages.en: Would you like a glass of mulled wine?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (客人)
messages.zh: 好，谢谢。还热着吗？
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Is it still warm?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一杯冒着热气、带香料香气的葡萄酒作记忆画面，看到 ċumnata 就联想到“温热的香料酒”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A structure or passage that carries smoke from a fire out of a building.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把炉火产生的烟排到建筑物外的通道或结构，即烟囱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura jew passaġġ li minnu joħroġ id-duħħan tan-nar minn ġo bini għal barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烟囱；供烟气排出建筑物的通道。

formal.mt: Id-duħħan joħroġ miċ-ċumnija li tinsab fuq il-bejt tal-bini.
formal.en: The smoke escapes through the chimney on the roof of the building.
formal.zh: 烟从建筑物屋顶上的烟囱排出。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Minn fejn ġej dak id-duħħan? Mark: Miċ-ċumnija tad-dar ta' ħdejna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is that smoke coming from? Mark: From the chimney of the house next door.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那股烟是从哪里来的？马克：从隔壁房子的烟囱里。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 那股烟是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where is that smoke coming from?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 从隔壁房子的烟囱里。
messages.en: From the chimney of the house next door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象屋顶上一根冒烟的烟囱，用“烟向上走”的画面记 ċumnija；再把它和表示热葡萄酒的 ċumnata 分开记。

gloss_zh: 白花植物；黑蒜（Allium nigrum）；锯齿拨料器；笨蛋；无用之人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A carpenter's tool used to adjust the sideways bend of saw teeth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 木工用来调整锯齿向两侧偏斜程度的工具，即锯齿拨料器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda tal-mastrudaxxa biex jaġġusta kemm jitgħawġu lejn il-ġnub is-snien tas-serrieq.

sense_translations.en_definition: flower with white flowers, blossoming in April/May
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种在四月或五月开白花的植物。

sense_translations.en_definition: carpenter's tool for adjusting saw teeth
sense_translations.zh_definition: 木工用来调整锯齿的工具；锯齿拨料器。
白痴；笨蛋，带贬义。
黑蒜，指植物 Allium nigrum。
锯齿拨料器；调整锯齿向两侧偏斜的工具。
无用之人；废物，指人时带侮辱性。

collocations.en: to adjust saw teeth with a saw set
collocations.zh: 用锯齿拨料器调整锯齿

collocations.en: the saw set on the workbench
collocations.zh: 工作台上的锯齿拨料器

collocations.en: the white flowers of the ċuplajs plant

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa uża ċ-ċuplajs biex jaġġusta s-snien tas-serrieq.
formal.en: The carpenter used the saw set to adjust the saw teeth.
formal.zh: 木工用锯齿拨料器调整了锯齿。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Fejn hu ċ-ċuplajs? Għandi bżonnu għas-serrieq. Toni: Fuq il-bank, ħdejn il-martell.
colloquial.en: Luca: Where's the saw set? I need it for the saw. Toni: On the bench, next to the hammer.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：锯齿拨料器在哪儿？我修锯子要用。托尼：在工作台上，锤子旁边。

messages.speaker: Luca (木工)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu ċ-ċuplajs? Għandi bżonnu għas-serrieq.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu ċ-ċuplajs? Għandi bżonnu għas-serrieq.
messages.zh: 锯齿拨料器在哪儿？我修锯子要用。
messages.en: Where's the saw set? I need it for the saw.

messages.speaker: Toni (木工助手)
messages.zh: 在工作台上，锤子旁边。
messages.en: On the bench, next to the hammer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给这个词画三张分开的记忆卡：白花植物、调整锯齿的工具、贬称人的笨蛋或废物。先看语境再选卡，避免把不同词义混在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person described insultingly as stupid or foolish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被贬称为愚蠢或缺乏判断力的人，即蠢人、笨蛋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tissejjaħ, b'mod dispreġġjattiv, iblah jew bla għaqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蠢人；笨蛋，此处作为指人的名词。
傻瓜；笨蛋，带贬义。

collocations.mt: tittratta lil xi ħadd ta' ċuples
collocations.en: to treat someone like a fool

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-kelliem isejjaħ lill-ġar tiegħu ċuples biex jesprimi d-disprezz tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the speaker calls his neighbour a fool to express his contempt.
formal.zh: 故事中，说话者称邻居为笨蛋，以表达轻蔑。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex sejjaħtli ċuples? Lara: Kont irrabjata. Ma kienx sew li ngħidlek hekk.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you call me a fool? Lara: I was angry. It wasn't right to call you that.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么叫我笨蛋？拉拉：我当时很生气。我不该那样叫你。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么叫我笨蛋？
messages.en: Why did you call me a fool?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont irrabjata. Ma kienx sew li ngħidlek hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Kont irrabjata. Ma kienx sew li ngħidlek hekk.
messages.zh: 我当时很生气。我不该那样叫你。
messages.en: I was angry. It wasn't right to call you that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċuples 放进“你为什么叫我笨蛋”的对话中记忆：它是指人的名词，语气带贬义；注意和拼写相近的 ċuplajs 区分。

gloss_zh: 木响板；耶稣受难日代钟响器；婴儿木摇铃；话匣子

teaching_sense.en_definition: A clapper or rattle, typically made of wood, that produces a repeated knocking sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常用木头制成、通过敲击或摇动发出连续响声的响板或摇响器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett, ġeneralment tal-injam, li jagħmel ħoss ripetut meta jitħabbat jew jitħarrek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 响板；通常用木头制成的敲响器。

sense_translations.en_definition: the clappers used instead of bells in church towers on Good Friday
sense_translations.zh_definition: 耶稣受难日教堂钟楼中用来代替钟声的木制响器。
婴儿玩的木制摇铃或摇响玩具。
话匣子；爱说个不停的人。

formal.mt: Nhar il-Ġimgħa l-Kbira, il-ħoss taċ-ċuqlajta jieħu post il-ħoss tal-qniepen fit-torri tal-knisja.
formal.en: On Good Friday, the sound of the clapper replaces the sound of the bells in the church tower.
formal.zh: 耶稣受难日，教堂钟楼里用木响器的声音代替钟声。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hi ċ-ċuqlajta tat-tarbija? Pawlu: Ħdejn il-kotba. Agħtiha lit-tarbija biex tilgħab biha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where's the baby's rattle? Pawlu: Next to the books. Give it to the baby to play with.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：宝宝的摇铃在哪儿？保罗：在书旁边。拿给宝宝玩吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 宝宝的摇铃在哪儿？
messages.en: Where's the baby's rattle?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-kotba. Agħtiha lit-tarbija biex tilgħab biha.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-kotba. Agħtiha lit-tarbija biex tilgħab biha.
messages.zh: 在书旁边。拿给宝宝玩吧。
messages.en: Next to the books. Give it to the baby to play with.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象木响器咔嗒作响，再分别放进钟楼和婴儿手里；指人时另记“嘴巴停不下来的话匣子”，用画面区分四个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small circular piece of jewellery worn on a finger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戴在手指上的小型环状首饰，即戒指。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ġojjellerija żgħira u tonda li tintlibes fuq saba'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 环；戒指。
戒指，戴在手指上的环状首饰。

formal.mt: Il-klijenta għażlet ċurkett tad-deheb u talbet irċevuta.
formal.en: The customer chose a gold ring and requested a receipt.
formal.zh: 这位女顾客选了一枚金戒指，并索取了收据。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hu ċ-ċurkett tiegħi? Mark: Qiegħed fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-ktieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is my ring? Mark: It is on the table, next to the book.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我的戒指在哪里？马克：在桌上，书旁边。

messages.speaker: Anna (妻子)
messages.zh: 我的戒指在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my ring?

messages.speaker: Mark (丈夫)
messages.zh: 在桌上，书旁边。
messages.en: It is on the table, next to the book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指上戴着一枚圆环，每次看到戒指就默念 ċurkett，把词形与首饰画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small sack or bag used to hold or carry things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于装东西或携带物品的小袋子、小口袋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xkora jew borża żgħira biex iżżomm jew iġġorr l-affarijiet fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小口袋；小型装物袋。
小袋子；小口袋。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem poġġa ż-żrieragħ f'ċurniena u għalaqha sew.
formal.en: The worker put the seeds in a small sack and closed it securely.
formal.zh: 工人把种子装进一个小袋，并把袋口封好。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek ċurniena biex inpoġġi l-ġewż fiha? Toni: Iva, ħu din. Hemm biżżejjed spazju fiha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have a small bag for me to put the walnuts in? Toni: Yes, take this one. There's enough room in it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你有个小袋子让我装核桃吗？托尼：有，拿这个吧。里面装得下。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek ċurniena biex inpoġġi l-ġewż fiha?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek ċurniena biex inpoġġi l-ġewż fiha?
messages.zh: 你有个小袋子让我装核桃吗？
messages.en: Do you have a small bag for me to put the walnuts in?

messages.speaker: Toni (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din. Hemm biżżejjed spazju fiha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din. Hemm biżżejjed spazju fiha.
messages.zh: 有，拿这个吧。里面装得下。
messages.en: Yes, take this one. There's enough room in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一把核桃装进小袋，再把袋口收紧；用“装一点、提着走”的具体动作记住 ċurniena 表示小袋子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person described as foolish or stupid, often as an insult.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被称为愚笨或糊涂的人，常带贬义或侮辱意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna meqjusa bla għaqal jew stupida; il-kelma spiss tintuża bħala insult.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 傻瓜；愚人，带贬义。
笨人；愚笨的人，带贬义。
愚蠢的；傻的，用作形容词。
愚笨的；用于形容人的愚蠢或糊涂。
白痴般的；愚蠢的，带贬义。

formal.mt: Fid-djalogu tar-rumanz, il-karattru jsejjaħ lil sieħbu ċuċ wara deċiżjoni bla għaqal.
formal.en: In the novel's dialogue, the character calls his companion a fool after an unwise decision.
formal.zh: 在小说的对话中，这个人物因同伴作出不明智的决定而称他为傻瓜。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kont ċuċ meta tlaqt mingħajr iċ-ċwievet. Maja: Jiġri lil kulħadd; ejja naraw kif nistgħu nidħlu.
colloquial.en: Mark: I was a fool to leave without the keys. Maja: It happens to everyone; let's see how we can get in.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我没带钥匙就出门，真是犯傻了。玛雅：谁都会遇到这种事；我们看看怎么进去吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont ċuċ meta tlaqt mingħajr iċ-ċwievet.
messages.mt_standard: Kont ċuċ meta tlaqt mingħajr iċ-ċwievet.
messages.zh: 我没带钥匙就出门，真是犯傻了。
messages.en: I was a fool to leave without the keys.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġri lil kulħadd; ejja naraw kif nistgħu nidħlu.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġri lil kulħadd; ejja naraw kif nistgħu nidħlu.
messages.zh: 谁都会遇到这种事；我们看看怎么进去吧。
messages.en: It happens to everyone; let's see how we can get in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用忘带钥匙后自嘲真傻的情景记ċuċ，同时记住它可作名词或形容词，称呼别人时有贬义。

gloss_zh: 蠢事；小事；轻而易举的事；极少量；失误

teaching_sense.en_definition: A silly action or remark, or something regarded as trivial.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愚蠢的行为或话语，也可指被认为无关紧要的小事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għemil jew kliem bla għaqal, jew ħaġa li titqies bla importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一件蠢事；一句傻话。
无关紧要的小事。
做起来轻而易举的事。
极少的一点；微不足道的数量。
愚蠢的失误；明显的差错。

collocations.en: a very easy task for me
collocations.zh: 对我来说轻而易举的事

formal.mt: Li tibgħat ir-rapport mingħajr ma tiċċekkja ċ-ċifri jkun ċuċata.
formal.en: Sending the report without checking the figures would be a foolish mistake.
formal.zh: 不核对数字就提交报告，会是一个愚蠢的失误。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għedt ċuċata waqt il-laqgħa u issa qed nistħi. Mark: Tinkwetax, tista' tispjega x'ridt tgħid.
colloquial.en: Maja: I said something silly during the meeting, and now I feel embarrassed. Mark: Don't worry, you can explain what you meant.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我在会上说了句傻话，现在觉得很尴尬。马克：别担心，你可以解释一下自己的意思。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għedt ċuċata waqt il-laqgħa u issa qed nistħi.
messages.mt_standard: Għedt ċuċata waqt il-laqgħa u issa qed nistħi.
messages.zh: 我在会上说了句傻话，现在觉得很尴尬。
messages.en: I said something silly during the meeting, and now I feel embarrassed.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 别担心，你可以解释一下自己的意思。
messages.en: Don't worry, you can explain what you meant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“说了句傻话”的场景记忆，再分别联想“小事一桩”“轻而易举”“只有一点”和“犯了失误”，靠语境区分各义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become foggy, cloudy, or unclear, as with the weather or a view.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得有雾、阴云密布或不清晰，可描述天气或眼前的景象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir imċajpar jew mhux ċar, bħal meta jkun hemm ċpar, sħab jew dehra mċajpra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 起雾；变得雾气蒙蒙。

sense_translations.en_definition: to become cloudy (used of the weather)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 天气转阴；变得多云。
ċajpar 的中间被动形式，表示变得朦胧或模糊。
起雾；变得有雾。
变得模糊；变得看不清楚。

formal.mt: Matul wara nofsinhar, it-temp iċċajpar u l-għoljiet ma baqgħux jidhru ċari.
formal.en: During the afternoon, the weather became misty and the hills were no longer clearly visible.
formal.zh: 下午天气变得雾蒙蒙，山丘也看不清楚了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ir-ritratt iċċajpar meta kabbarnih fuq l-iskrin. Mark: Ibgħatli l-oriġinal; forsi jidher aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: The photo became blurry when we enlarged it on the screen. Mark: Send me the original; it might look better.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们把照片在屏幕上放大后，它就变模糊了。马克：把原图发给我，也许会清楚一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-ritratt iċċajpar meta kabbarnih fuq l-iskrin.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-ritratt iċċajpar meta kabbarnih fuq l-iskrin.
messages.zh: 我们把照片在屏幕上放大后，它就变模糊了。
messages.en: The photo became blurry when we enlarged it on the screen.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 把原图发给我，也许会清楚一点。
messages.en: Send me the original; it might look better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把天空起雾和照片变糊并排想象：原本清楚的东西蒙上一层灰，帮助记住 ċċajpar。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To smooth or shape wood by removing thin shavings with a plane.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用木工刨子削去薄木屑，使木材表面平整或形成所需形状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twitti jew tagħti forma lill-injam billi tneħħi saffi rqaq minnu b'ċana.

sense_translations.en_definition: to plane (to smooth with a plane)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 刨平；用刨子刨削，使表面平整。

collocations.en: to plane the edge of the board
to plane the surface of the table

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa qed jiċċana l-bord biex il-wiċċ tiegħu jkun lixx.
formal.en: The carpenter is planing the board to make its surface smooth.
formal.zh: 木匠正在刨削木板，使其表面光滑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' tiċċana dan it-tarf? Pawlu: Iva, għax għadu mhux lixx.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you plane this edge? Pawlu: Yes, because it is still rough.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你能把这条边刨平吗？保罗：能，这里还不光滑。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.zh: 你能把这条边刨平吗？
messages.en: Can you plane this edge?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木匠)
messages.zh: 能，这里还不光滑。
messages.en: Yes, because it is still rough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象木工推着刨子，薄木屑卷起、木板变平；把这个动作和 ċċana 对应起来，记住是用刨子加工。

gloss_zh: 半途丢下；弃人不顾；离开工作；剥夺继承权

teaching_sense.en_definition: To abandon a task before finishing it or leave someone without needed support; also to leave work or disinherit someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把工作半途丢下，或在别人需要帮助时弃之不顾；也可指离开工作或剥夺某人的继承权。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħalli xogħol mhux lest jew jitlaq lil xi ħadd bla għajnuna; jista' jfisser ukoll li jitlaq mix-xogħol jew iċaħħad lil xi ħadd mill-wirt.

sense_translations.en_definition: to leave sth unfinished (e.g. a piece of work)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某事半途丢下，使其未完成，例如一项工作。

sense_translations.en_definition: to leave sb. in the lurch
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某人需要帮助时弃之不顾；使某人陷入无援的处境。
离开工作；离开工作岗位。
剥夺某人的继承权。

collocations.en: leave his companion in the lurch

formal.mt: Il-kuntrattur iċċanta x-xogħol qabel ma tlesta, u s-sid kellu jsib ħaddiema oħra.
formal.en: The contractor abandoned the work before it was finished, and the owner had to find other workers.
formal.zh: 承包商在工程完成前就把工作丢下了，业主只好另找工人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għadna rridu nispiċċaw kollox, u Pawlu iċċanta x-xogħol. Sara: Nibqa' ngħinek jien; ma nħallikx waħdek.
colloquial.en: Nina: We still have to finish everything, and Pawlu has abandoned the work. Sara: I'll stay and help you; I won't leave you on your own.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们还有一大堆事情要做完，保罗却把工作丢下了。萨拉：我留下来帮你，不会让你一个人做。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna rridu nispiċċaw kollox, u Pawlu iċċanta x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Għadna rridu nispiċċaw kollox, u Pawlu iċċanta x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 我们还有一大堆事情要做完，保罗却把工作丢下了。
messages.en: We still have to finish everything, and Pawlu has abandoned the work.

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nibqa' ngħinek jien; ma nħallikx waħdek.
messages.mt_standard: Nibqa' ngħinek jien; ma nħallikx waħdek.
messages.zh: 我留下来帮你，不会让你一个人做。
messages.en: I'll stay and help you; I won't leave you on your own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记工作做到一半人就走的画面，再分别记弃人不顾和剥夺继承权；遇到 ċċanta 要看宾语判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put electrical energy into a battery or device, or to ask someone to pay an amount of money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给电池或设备充入电能，或要求某人支付一定费用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimla batterija jew apparat bl-enerġija elettrika, jew jitlob ħlas għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 充电；收费，具体含义由语境决定。
充电；获得或补充电能。
收费；要求支付费用。

collocations.en: charge ten euros for the repair

formal.mt: It-tekniku iċċarġja l-batterija u ċċekkja l-apparat qabel irritornah lill-klijent.
formal.en: The technician charged the battery and checked the device before returning it to the customer.
formal.zh: 技术员给电池充电并检查设备后，才将设备交还顾客。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm iċċarġja l-ħanut biex jibdel il-batterija? Rita: Għoxrin ewro, u t-telefon issa jaħdem sew.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much did the shop charge to replace the battery? Rita: Twenty euros, and the phone works well now.
colloquial.zh: 马克：店里换电池收了多少钱？丽塔：二十欧元，现在手机用起来很正常。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm iċċarġja l-ħanut biex jibdel il-batterija?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm iċċarġja l-ħanut biex jibdel il-batterija?
messages.zh: 店里换电池收了多少钱？
messages.en: How much did the shop charge to replace the battery?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoxrin ewro, u t-telefon issa jaħdem sew.
messages.mt_standard: Għoxrin ewro, u t-telefon issa jaħdem sew.
messages.zh: 二十欧元，现在手机用起来很正常。
messages.en: Twenty euros, and the phone works well now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记 ċċarġja：插上电线是充电，报出价钱是收费；先看电池还是金额。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To look steadily at someone or something for a while, often with strong attention or surprise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 目光持续停留在某人或某物上，常表示专注、出神或惊讶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħares fit-tul u b'ħarsa fissa lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, spiss b'attenzjoni jew b'sorpriża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凝视；盯着看；目不转睛地看。

formal.mt: L-istudent kien qed jiċċassa lejn it-tieqa waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The student was gazing towards the window during the lesson.
formal.zh: 上课时，这名学生一直朝窗户出神地望着。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tiċċassa lejn l-iskrin? Mark: Qed nipprova naqra l-kliem żgħir.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you staring at the screen? Mark: I am trying to read the small print.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么一直盯着屏幕？马克：我在努力看清那些小字。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么一直盯着屏幕？
messages.en: Why are you staring at the screen?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在努力看清那些小字。
messages.en: I am trying to read the small print.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċċassa 配成目光停住几秒的画面；练习时连着 lejn 和注视对象一起说，记住“盯着某处看”。

gloss_zh: 翅膀；机翼；侧翼；拱肩；庇护

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wing: a body part used by a bird for flight, or a projecting part of an aircraft that helps it fly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 翅膀或机翼：鸟类用于飞行的身体部分，或飞机向外伸出、帮助飞行的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti mill-ġisem ta' għasfur li tintuża għat-titjir, jew parti li toħroġ mill-ġenb ta' ajruplan u tgħinu jtir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 翅膀；鸟等动物用于飞行的身体部分。
机翼；飞机上帮助产生升力的翼状部分。
侧面；侧翼；某物或某个阵列的一侧。
拱肩；建筑中拱券外缘与周围边界之间的区域，通常近似三角形。
保护；庇护，具有提供照顾或遮护的比喻意义。

formal.mt: It-tekniku eżamina l-ġewnaħ tal-ajruplan qabel it-titjira.
formal.en: The technician examined the aircraft's wing before the flight.
formal.zh: 技术人员在飞行前检查了飞机的机翼。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex dak l-għasfur ma jistax itir? Samwel: Għandu ġewnaħ imweġġa'; ejja nitolbu l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why can't that bird fly? Samwel: It has an injured wing; let's ask for help.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：那只鸟为什么飞不起来？萨姆韦尔：它有一只翅膀受伤了；我们去找人帮忙吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dak l-għasfur ma jistax itir?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dak l-għasfur ma jistax itir?
messages.zh: 那只鸟为什么飞不起来？
messages.en: Why can't that bird fly?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu ġewnaħ imweġġa'; ejja nitolbu l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu ġewnaħ imweġġa'; ejja nitolbu l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 它有一只翅膀受伤了；我们去找人帮忙吧。
messages.en: It has an injured wing; let's ask for help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“鸟翼—机翼”两张图记住 ġewnaħ，再分别添加“侧面、拱肩、庇护”三张义项卡；这些只是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An incident of conflict in which people argue angrily or fight physically.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们发生激烈口角或肢体冲突的一次争吵、争斗或打斗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tilwima jew konfrontazzjoni li fiha n-nies jargumentaw bir-rabja jew jiġġieldu fiżikament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 争斗；争吵；口角，可指言语上的冲突，也可指打架。
打斗；搏斗；交战，侧重争斗行为或一次打斗。

formal.mt: L-għalliem intervjena biex iwaqqaf ġlieda bejn żewġ studenti fil-bitħa.
formal.en: The teacher intervened to stop a fight between two students in the courtyard.
formal.zh: 老师出面干预，制止了两名学生在院子里的打斗。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex ma tkellimtx ma' Karl illum? David: Kellna ġlieda lbieraħ, imma se nitkellmu u nippruvaw nirranġaw.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why didn't you speak to Karl today? David: We had a quarrel yesterday, but we're going to talk and try to sort things out.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你今天为什么没跟卡尔说话？戴维：我们昨天吵了一架，不过我们会谈谈，试着和好。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tkellimtx ma' Karl illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tkellimtx ma' Karl illum?
messages.zh: 你今天为什么没跟卡尔说话？
messages.en: Why didn't you speak to Karl today?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellna ġlieda lbieraħ, imma se nitkellmu u nippruvaw nirranġaw.
messages.mt_standard: Kellna ġlieda lbieraħ, imma se nitkellmu u nippruvaw nirranġaw.
messages.zh: 我们昨天吵了一架，不过我们会谈谈，试着和好。
messages.en: We had a quarrel yesterday, but we're going to talk and try to sort things out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张“冲突”卡记 ġlieda：一面画争吵的对话框，另一面画打斗的动作，提醒自己根据语境判断冲突形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The religion of the Jewish people, including its beliefs and religious practices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 犹太人的宗教，包括其宗教信仰与实践。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-reliġjon tal-poplu Lhudi, inklużi t-twemmin u l-prattiki reliġjużi tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犹太教；犹太人的宗教信仰与宗教传统。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jintroduċi l-Ġudaiżmu u jispjega xi twemmin u prattiki reliġjużi tiegħu.
formal.en: The chapter introduces Judaism and explains some of its religious beliefs and practices.
formal.zh: 本章介绍犹太教，并解释其部分宗教信仰和实践。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dwar xiex inhu l-ktieb li qed taqra? Daniel: Dwar il-Ġudaiżmu; qed nitgħallem dwar it-tradizzjonijiet tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Rita: What is the book you're reading about? Daniel: Judaism; I'm learning about its traditions.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你正在读的书是讲什么的？丹尼尔：讲犹太教的；我正在了解它的传统。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar xiex inhu l-ktieb li qed taqra?
messages.mt_standard: Dwar xiex inhu l-ktieb li qed taqra?
messages.zh: 你正在读的书是讲什么的？
messages.en: What is the book you're reading about?

messages.speaker: Daniel (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar il-Ġudaiżmu; qed nitgħallem dwar it-tradizzjonijiet tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar il-Ġudaiżmu; qed nitgħallem dwar it-tradizzjonijiet tiegħu.
messages.zh: 讲犹太教的；我正在了解它的传统。
messages.en: Judaism; I'm learning about its traditions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ġudaiżmu、Judaism、犹太教写在同一张三语卡上，并配上“宗教”标签，帮助准确记住它所指的概念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A member of a jury in a court; in a separate sense, a grasshopper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指法庭上的陪审员；另一个独立义项指蚱蜢，须根据语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Membru ta' ġurija f'qorti; f'tifsira oħra separata, insett li jaqbeż fil-ħaxix.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蚱蜢；一种常在草丛中跳跃的昆虫。
陪审员；在法庭审判中担任陪审团成员的人。
陪审团成员；参与陪审工作的人。

formal.mt: Kull ġurat għandu jisma' x-xhieda bir-reqqa qabel jasal għal deċiżjoni.
formal.en: Every juror should listen carefully to the testimony before reaching a decision.
formal.zh: 每位陪审员都应仔细听取证词，然后再作决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak il-ġurat fuq il-ħaxix! Pawlu: Rajtu! Kemm jaqbeż 'il bogħod!
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that grasshopper on the grass! Pawlu: I saw it! It jumps so far!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看草上的那只蚱蜢！保罗：我看到了！它跳得真远！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看草上的那只蚱蜢！
messages.en: Look at that grasshopper on the grass!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看到了！它跳得真远！
messages.en: I saw it! It jumps so far!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景分开记忆：法庭里听证词的是陪审员，草地上跳跃的是蚱蜢；同一词形要靠语境辨义。

gloss_zh: 年轻的（男性）；小伙子，男青年

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a male who is still young, especially one between boyhood and full adulthood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容男性仍然年轻，尤其指处于少年与完全成年之间的阶段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna maskili li għadha żagħżugħa, speċjalment bejn it-tfulija u l-età adulta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 年轻的，少年般的；用于描述年轻男性。
年少的男孩。

sense_translations.en_definition: Person old enough to be called a man but still young enough to be called a boy
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容男性已长大到可以称作男人，但仍年轻得可以称作男孩。
年轻男子；男青年。
青春期的男性；少年男子。
男孩；小伙子。

formal.mt: Għalkemm għadu ġuvni, Pawlu diġà jieħu r-responsabbiltajiet tiegħu bis-serjetà.
formal.en: Although he is still young, Pawlu already takes his responsibilities seriously.
formal.zh: 虽然保罗还年轻，但他已经认真对待自己的责任。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak il-ġuvni ħdejn il-bieb? Lara: Dak ħija; qed jistennieni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that young man by the door? Lara: That's my brother; he's waiting for me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：门边那个小伙子是谁？拉拉：那是我兄弟，他在等我。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak il-ġuvni ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak il-ġuvni ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 门边那个小伙子是谁？
messages.en: Who is that young man by the door?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是我兄弟，他在等我。
messages.en: That's my brother; he's waiting for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把人物想成正在长大的小伙子：għadu ġuvni 描述他还年轻，il-ġuvni 则把这个年轻人作为谈论对象。

gloss_zh: 游荡；闲逛；四处乱跑；行为放纵

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move about from place to place without a fixed destination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有固定目的地地四处走动、游荡或闲逛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imur minn post għal ieħor mingħajr destinazzjoni fissa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 漫游；游荡；没有固定目的地地四处走动。
到处闲逛；四处游玩或串门，常含贪玩、闲不住的意味。
在性关系方面行为放纵；带有评价色彩。
游荡；走失；偏离原来的路线或所在范围。

formal.mt: Il-vjaġġatur qatta' l-ġurnata jiġġerra fit-toroq tal-belt mingħajr pjan.
formal.en: The traveller spent the day roaming the city streets without a plan.
formal.zh: 那位旅行者没有安排计划，在城里的街道上闲逛了一整天。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn sejjer? Ġużeppi: M'għandix pjan; se noqgħod niġġerra ftit ħdejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where are you going? Ġużeppi: I don't have a plan; I'm going to wander around by the sea for a while.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你要去哪里？朱塞佩：我没什么计划，打算在海边随便逛一会儿。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: M'għandix pjan; se noqgħod niġġerra ftit ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: M'għandix pjan; se noqgħod niġġerra ftit ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.zh: 我没什么计划，打算在海边随便逛一会儿。
messages.en: I don't have a plan; I'm going to wander around by the sea for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上一条没有终点的弯曲路线，记住 ġġerra 的“游荡”；涉及性行为的义项另设语境卡，不与普通散步混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number 65, one more than sixty-four.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数六十五，即比六十四多一的数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 65, wieħed aktar minn erbgħa u sittin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 六十五；数字65。

formal.mt: Għall-kors irreġistraw ħamsa u sittin student.
formal.en: Sixty-five students registered for the course.
formal.zh: 六十五名学生报名参加了这门课程。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm tiswa din is-siġġu? Rita: Ħamsa u sittin ewro. Mark: Tajjeb, neħodha.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much does this chair cost? Rita: Sixty-five euros. Mark: All right, I'll take it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这把椅子多少钱？丽塔：六十五欧元。马克：好，我买了。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这把椅子多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this chair cost?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 六十五欧元。
messages.en: Sixty-five euros.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 好，我买了。
messages.en: All right, I'll take it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“五、和、六十”的顺序记住 ħamsa u sittin：先说个位五，再接六十，合起来就是六十五。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Worms: small animals with long, soft bodies, including earthworms and marine worms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体细长柔软的蠕虫，包括生活在土中的蚯蚓和海生蠕虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimali żgħar b'ġisem twil u artab, fosthom dawk li jgħixu fil-ħamrija jew fil-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蠕虫；身体细长柔软的虫类。
蚯蚓；生活在土壤中的蠕虫。
海生蠕虫；生活在海洋中的蠕虫。

formal.mt: Matul l-attività fil-ġnien, l-istudenti osservaw ħanex fil-ħamrija niedja.
formal.en: During the garden activity, the students observed worms in the damp soil.
formal.zh: 在花园活动中，学生们观察了潮湿土壤里的蚯蚓。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ara kemm hemm ħanex taħt din il-ġebla! Pawlu: Iva, ejja nħalluh hemm u npoġġu l-ġebla lura bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lina: Look how many worms there are under this stone! Pawlu: Yes, let's leave them there and gently put the stone back.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：看这块石头下面有多少蚯蚓！保罗：是啊，让它们待在这里吧，我们轻轻把石头放回去。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hemm ħanex taħt din il-ġebla!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hemm ħanex taħt din il-ġebla!
messages.zh: 看这块石头下面有多少蚯蚓！
messages.en: Look how many worms there are under this stone!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nħalluh hemm u npoġġu l-ġebla lura bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nħalluh hemm u npoġġu l-ġebla lura bil-mod.
messages.zh: 是啊，让它们待在这里吧，我们轻轻把石头放回去。
messages.en: Yes, let's leave them there and gently put the stone back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“细长柔软、慢慢蠕动”的画面记 ħanex，再用泥土和海水两种背景区分蚯蚓与海生蠕虫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Peaches considered collectively, or peach as a fruit type or flavour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为集合称呼的桃子，也可指桃这一水果种类或桃的风味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frott tal-ħawħa meqjus flimkien, jew il-ħawħ bħala tip ta' frott jew bħala togħma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 桃子（多个桃子的集合称呼）。

sense_translations.en_definition: peach, peaches (several fruits; peach as a mass, taste, species)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 桃，桃子（指多个果实，也指作为整体的桃、桃味或桃这一种类）。

formal.mt: Għall-preparazzjoni tal-ġamm, aħsel il-ħawħ u neħħi l-għadam qabel it-tisjir.
formal.en: To prepare the jam, wash the peaches and remove the stones before cooking.
formal.zh: 制作果酱时，先洗净桃子并去核，再进行烹煮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek ħawħ frisk illum? Mark: Iva, kemm trid? Maja: Kilo, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have fresh peaches today? Mark: Yes, how much would you like? Maja: A kilo, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天有新鲜桃子吗？马克：有，你要多少？玛雅：请给我一公斤。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天有新鲜桃子吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh peaches today?

messages.speaker: Mark (水果摊主)
messages.zh: 有，你要多少？
messages.en: Yes, how much would you like?

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我一公斤。
messages.en: A kilo, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħawħ 记成“一篮桃子的总称”，再联想桃汁和桃子果酱，就能同时记住果实集合与桃味的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Green colour or green vegetation; also bitterness, spite or jealousy in a person's feelings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 绿色、绿意或绿色植被；也可指情感上的怨恨、恶意或嫉妒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kulur aħdar jew il-veġetazzjoni ħadra; ukoll imrar, kattiverija jew għira fis-sentimenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绿色。
草木形成的绿意或绿色景观。
茂密繁盛的绿色植被。
恶意、残忍或嫉妒。
呈绿色的性质或状态；青绿程度。
绿植、草木或植被。
情感上的怨恨或愤懑。

formal.mt: Il-ħdura tal-wied tagħmel dan il-post ideali għal mixja fir-rebbiegħa.
formal.en: The greenery of the valley makes this place ideal for a walk in spring.
formal.zh: 山谷的绿意使这里成为春日散步的理想地点。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ara kemm hawn ħdura wara x-xita! Pawlu: Iva, il-wied kollu aħdar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Look how much greenery there is after the rain! Pawlu: Yes, the whole valley is green.
colloquial.zh: Marija：看，下过雨后这里多么绿意盎然！Pawlu：是啊，整个山谷都绿了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hawn ħdura wara x-xita!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hawn ħdura wara x-xita!
messages.zh: 看，下过雨后这里多么绿意盎然！
messages.en: Look how much greenery there is after the rain!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，整个山谷都绿了。
messages.en: Yes, the whole valley is green.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用雨后山谷满眼绿色的画面记住 ħdura 的绿意义，再单独用“心中积怨”的画面记住情感义，避免见到它就只译作绿色。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work or activity of joining or making things with a needle and thread, including sewing and tailoring.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用针线缝合或制作物品的工作或活动，包括针线活、缝纫和裁缝工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li bih tgħaqqad jew tagħmel affarijiet bil-labra u l-ħajt, inkluż ix-xogħol tal-ħwejjeġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用针线完成的手工活；针线活。
用针线缝合或制作物品的活动；缝纫。
缝纫、裁制或修改衣服的工作。

formal.mt: Il-kors tal-ħjata jinkludi tagħlim dwar l-użu tal-magna u t-tiswija tal-ħwejjeġ.
formal.en: The sewing course includes instruction on using the machine and repairing clothes.
formal.zh: 这门缝纫课程包括缝纫机使用和衣物修补方面的教学。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taf tagħmel il-ħjata? Rita: Iva, nista' nsewwilek il-qalziet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you know how to sew? Rita: Yes, I can mend your trousers for you.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你会做针线活吗？Rita：会，我可以帮你补裤子。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你会做针线活吗？
messages.en: Do you know how to sew?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 会，我可以帮你补裤子。
messages.en: Yes, I can mend your trousers for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ħjata 和桌上的针、线、布连成一个学习画面，再搭配“缝纫机”和“缝纫课程”一起记，掌握它表示缝纫活动的用法。

gloss_zh: 胸怀；怀抱；一抱的量；上腹部；其中

teaching_sense.en_definition: The breast or bosom, or an amount that can be held in the arms; it can also refer to the upper abdomen or the midst of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胸部、胸怀或怀抱，也指双臂能抱住的一份量；另可指上腹部或某事物之中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sider jew il-parti ta' quddiem tal-ġisem fejn tħaddan lil xi ħadd; ukoll kwantità li ġġorr f'dirgħajk, il-parti ta' fuq taż-żaqq, jew il-qalba ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胸部；胸前部位。
胸怀；可供依偎的怀抱。
双臂抱住的一份量；一抱。
胸部、胸怀或怀抱。

sense_translations.en_definition: epigastric region (the part between the chest and the belly)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 上腹部，即胸部与腹部之间的区域。
一抱的量；少量。
中间、内部或其中。

formal.mt: It-tifel sab il-faraġ f'ħodon ommu wara l-esperjenza tal-biża'.
formal.en: The boy found comfort in his mother's bosom after the frightening experience.
formal.zh: 经历了那件可怕的事后，男孩在母亲怀里得到了安慰。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ġibt ħodon fjuri? Mark: Għax illum għeluq snin ommi!
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you bring an armful of flowers? Mark: Because it's my mother's birthday today!
colloquial.zh: Nina：你怎么抱来这么一大抱花？Mark：因为今天是我妈妈的生日！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么抱来这么一大抱花？
messages.en: Why did you bring an armful of flowers?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为今天是我妈妈的生日！
messages.en: Because it's my mother's birthday today!

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习时把“胸前怀抱”和“双臂抱满鲜花”并排画出来，分别对应身体部位和一抱的量；上腹部与“其中”两义另列卡片记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To do or judge something incorrectly, make a mistake, or depart from the correct path.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做事或判断有误，犯下错误，也可指偏离正确的道路。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa ħażin, jagħti ġudizzju mhux korrett jew jitbiegħed mit-triq it-tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出错；在判断、行为或理解上有误。
走偏；偏离正确的道路或方向。
犯错误；把某件事做错。

collocations.en: made a mistake in the calculation

formal.mt: L-awtur żbalja fid-data tal-laqgħa u ppubblika korrezzjoni l-għada.
formal.en: The author got the meeting date wrong and published a correction the following day.
formal.zh: 作者把会议日期写错了，并在第二天刊登了更正。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex morna fil-bini l-ieħor? Toni: Is-sewwieq żbalja fl-indirizz. Lara: Mela ejja mmorru fil-post it-tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did we go to the other building? Toni: The driver got the address wrong. Lara: Then let's go to the right place.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们怎么去了另一栋楼？Toni：司机弄错地址了。Lara：那我们去正确的地方吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 我们怎么去了另一栋楼？
messages.en: Why did we go to the other building?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 司机弄错地址了。
messages.en: The driver got the address wrong.

messages.speaker: Lara (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们去正确的地方吧。
messages.en: Then let's go to the right place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把算错数字、写错地址、走错方向连成三个画面，共同记住偏离正确结果的意思。

gloss_zh: 施粪肥者；制肥者；垃圾收集工

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who collects rubbish, applies manure, or makes fertiliser from dung or waste, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据语境，可指收集垃圾的人、施用粪肥的人，或用粪便和废弃物制作肥料的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiġbor l-iskart, tqassam id-demel fl-għelieqi jew tagħmel fertilizzant mid-demel jew mill-iskart, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 施粪肥的人；把粪肥施到田地里的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who makes fertiliser from dung or waste
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用粪便或废弃物制作肥料的人。
一名垃圾收集工；负责收运垃圾的人。
垃圾收集工；从事垃圾收集工作的人。
施肥者，尤指施用粪肥的人。

collocations.en: a garbage collector who collects waste
collocations.zh: 收集废弃物的垃圾收集工

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi x-xogħol ta' żebbiel li jagħmel fertilizzant mill-iskart organiku.
formal.en: The report describes the work of a fertiliser maker who produces fertiliser from organic waste.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一名制肥工人的工作，他用有机废弃物制作肥料。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min ġabar il-boroż minn quddiem id-dar? Ġanni: Iż-żebbiel ġie dalgħodu. Nina: Tajjeb, issa t-triq nadifa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who collected the bags from outside the house? Ġanni: The garbage collector came this morning. Nina: Good, the street is clean now.
colloquial.zh: Nina：谁把屋前的袋子收走了？Ġanni：垃圾收集工今天早上来过了。Nina：好，现在街道干净了。

messages.speaker: Nina (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ġabar il-boroż minn quddiem id-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Min ġabar il-boroż minn quddiem id-dar?
messages.zh: 谁把屋前的袋子收走了？
messages.en: Who collected the bags from outside the house?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (邻居)
messages.zh: 垃圾收集工今天早上来过了。
messages.en: The garbage collector came this morning.

messages.speaker: Nina (住户)
messages.zh: 好，现在街道干净了。
messages.en: Good, the street is clean now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张职业卡记忆：收垃圾、把废物制成肥料、给田地施粪肥；根据工作场景选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a surface that makes people or objects slip or slide easily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面容易使人或物体打滑、滑动的，常用来形容湿滑的地面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu wiċċ li fuqu persuna jew oġġett jista' jiżloq faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会使人或物体打滑、滑动的。
滑的；容易使人滑倒或使物体滑动的。

formal.mt: Wara t-tindif, il-paviment baqa' żellieqi u tqiegħed sinjal ta' twissija ħdejn id-daħla.
formal.en: After cleaning, the floor remained slippery, and a warning sign was placed near the entrance.
formal.zh: 清洁后，地板仍然很滑，因此入口附近放置了警示牌。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Oqgħod attent, il-paviment żellieqi! David: Grazzi, nimxi bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Marija: Be careful, the floor is slippery! David: Thanks, I'll walk slowly.
colloquial.zh: Marija：小心，地板很滑！David：谢谢，我会慢慢走。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 小心，地板很滑！
messages.en: Be careful, the floor is slippery!

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.zh: 谢谢，我会慢慢走。
messages.en: Thanks, I'll walk slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚拖过的地板和小心地滑警示牌，把脚底打滑的感觉与这个形容词联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an elongated shape, especially an oval or rectangle whose length is greater than its width.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状较长、长度大于宽度的，尤指长圆形或长方形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu forma tawwalija, speċjalment ovali jew rettangolari, bit-tul akbar mill-wisa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长圆形的；长方形的；长度明显大于宽度的。

formal.mt: Fid-disinn, il-qafas żenguli għandu tul ta' tletin ċentimetru u wisa' ta' għoxrin ċentimetru.
formal.en: In the design, the oblong frame is thirty centimetres long and twenty centimetres wide.
formal.zh: 在设计图中，这个长方形框架长三十厘米、宽二十厘米。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Liema kontenitur trid, it-tond jew iż-żenguli? Simon: Iż-żenguli, għax il-kejk twil.
colloquial.en: Elena: Which container do you want, the round one or the oblong one? Simon: The oblong one, because the cake is long.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你要哪个容器，圆的还是长形的？Simon：长形的，因为蛋糕比较长。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema kontenitur trid, it-tond jew iż-żenguli?
messages.mt_standard: Liema kontenitur trid, it-tond jew iż-żenguli?
messages.zh: 你要哪个容器，圆的还是长形的？
messages.en: Which container do you want, the round one or the oblong one?

messages.speaker: Simon (朋友)
messages.zh: 长形的，因为蛋糕比较长。
messages.en: The oblong one, because the cake is long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画一个圆，再把它想象成横向拉长的形状；用长大于宽来记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The metallic chemical element zinc, used, for example, as a coating to protect iron.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 金属化学元素锌，例如可用作铁表面的保护镀层。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku metalliku li jintuża, pereżempju, bħala kisja biex jipproteġi l-ħadid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锌，一种金属。
锌，化学元素。

formal.mt: Il-kisja taż-żingu tipproteġi l-ħadid mis-sadid.
formal.en: The zinc coating protects the iron from rust.
formal.zh: 锌镀层保护铁，防止其生锈。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Din il-folja taż-żingu? Ben: Iva, u dik l-oħra tal-aluminju. Rita: Tajjeb, għandi bżonn dik taż-żingu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is this sheet made of zinc? Ben: Yes, and the other one is aluminium. Rita: Good, I need the zinc one.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这张板是锌做的吗？Ben：是的，另一张是铝的。Rita：好，我需要锌的那张。

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.zh: 这张板是锌做的吗？
messages.en: Is this sheet made of zinc?

messages.speaker: Ben (店员)
messages.zh: 是的，另一张是铝的。
messages.en: Yes, and the other one is aluminium.

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.zh: 好，我需要锌的那张。
messages.en: Good, I need the zinc one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żingu 和英语 zinc 并排写在金属材料卡上，再画一层保护铁的锌镀层辅助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To release a lock or fastening so that something can be opened or moved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 解除锁或扣件的固定，使某物能够打开或移动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiftaħ serratura jew iħoll qafla biex xi ħaġa tkun tista' tinfetaħ jew tiċċaqlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开锁；解开或松开扣件，使原本锁住或固定的东西可以打开。

formal.mt: Qabel il-wasla tal-viżitaturi, il-gwardjan żlokkja l-bieb prinċipali.
formal.en: Before the visitors arrived, the caretaker unlocked the main door.
formal.zh: 访客到达前，管理员打开了大门的锁。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-bieb għadu msakkar? Luqa: Le, missieri żlokkja l-bieb ftit ilu. Anna: Tajjeb, nista' nidħol.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is the door still locked? Luqa: No, my father unlocked it a little while ago. Anna: Good, I can go in.
colloquial.zh: Anna：门还锁着吗？Luqa：没有，我爸爸刚才已经开锁了。Anna：好，那我可以进去了。

messages.speaker: Anna (来访朋友)
messages.zh: 门还锁着吗？
messages.en: Is the door still locked?

messages.speaker: Luqa (屋主的儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, missieri żlokkja l-bieb ftit ilu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, missieri żlokkja l-bieb ftit ilu.
messages.zh: 没有，我爸爸刚才已经开锁了。
messages.en: No, my father unlocked it a little while ago.

messages.speaker: Anna (来访朋友)
messages.zh: 好，那我可以进去了。
messages.en: Good, I can go in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钥匙转动后门锁咔嗒打开，再联想到扣件松开；共同点是解除固定、允许打开。
